He is a great guy, makes lectures fun and interesting. He did assign a textbook, but it wasn't required to read or take notes on. Participation is definitely important because most of the in-class activities show up on the tests. If you need help with something, he's really accessible outside of class and is very helpful overall. Would take again!
He has low self esteem and it shows. He literally bullies students when he feels threatened.
Awesome guy. Mainly lectures but he finds a way to make it fun and indulges the class correctly. Exams are straight from notes and good grades are easily attainable. 100% recommend.

Here's the deal - You've gotta go to class. He does quizzes every class based on what you learned from his lectures. It's a very applied class meaning you can't just take notes and be fine. You have to DO the lab applications and DO the in-class activities. there were only 2 tests that were EASY. He is an ok teacher but wouldn't take him again.

tags: ['Accessible outside class', 'Graded by few things', 'Lecture heavy']
comment: Graded based on 3 exams, a paper, a project, and participation. Exams aren't too bad but you need to study notes and images from the powerpoint. The paper is enjoyable because you get to choose your own topic. the project is simple so it is a good way to boost your grade. Go to class b/c he offers free and easy participation points often.

Great guy! Lectures were off a powerpoint which was posted online. Test were fair, you needed to know specifics in the powerpoint such as graphs. Really inspired me and amazing teacher, really knows his stuff. 10/10 would take class with him again

Definitely one of the best professors I've ever had. He lectures alot but makes them interesting so I dont mind. Very helpful in office hours and genuinely cares about his student and their opinion on the matters

Dr. Tulowiecki is probably one of the best professors I have ever taken. He interacts with his class, and you have to participate to receive a grade. Hes very flexible and his office hours are always helpful. Take this class!

No doubt Allen is one of the most caring professors I have had. He has been incredibly accommodating in the midst of the pandemic and is very accessible. He applies what he teaches in his own classroom and very clearly knows what he is talking about. The class is challenging but no absurdly difficult. Do yourself a favor, take this class!

I am taking PSYC 350 with him online synchronously and he is the only professor I have this semester who has said he "understands" the particular stressors of college during a pandemic, and other life factors that would impact school, and actually shows it. Genuinely the sweetest and very responsive.

Prof Allen is a great teacher and it's clear that he cares a lot about all of his students. Grades are based on 3 tests and 2 papers (he lets you bring a cheat sheet to the tests) as well as group work that is very easy. The class can get kind of boring and repetitive but that's a given in a research methods class.

Doctor Allen is one of the most caring, passionate, and motivating professors I have had at SUNY Geneseo. His expectations are clear and he is willing to help you. He really notices effort and participation. If you attend class, contribute to class discussion, and work hard you will do well. Everyone should take at least one class with Doctor Allen

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: Professor Williams gave a very well written syllabus that is self explanatory and as long as you read it and make yourself familiar with it you will know what to expect. There are weekly chapter outlines, discussions, and two essay tests from the required reading and as long as you do the work you will pass the class.

Worst professor I have ever had. Do not take a class with him. He lectures the whole class, thinks he is gods gift to the earth, very arrogant and thinks he knows everything. Tests are pretty hard, papers are confusing.

comment: This was a cool class. Prof. Williams tells a lot of stories that would not be on the test. 1st test: Persian war, 2nd test: Peloponnesian war. comment: I enjoyed this class. He gives out a simple 10 question, multiple choice quiz every week based on the reading, but they are almost always on Wednesday. As long as you take the quizzes, they will boost your grade. The tests aren't hard, nor are the two papers. If you pay attention in class, it will be easy. He gets sidetracked often.

"What can I say" about Dr. Williams and HUMN I?  When it comes to the Bible he is the most accurate.  Students may not want to hear it because they want to believe what they want to believe (or maybe afraid of what they think they will have to give up to believe any other way).  Dr. Williams does digress during lecture but does return to topic.

His lectures will often spiral into litanies of anecdotes (his record was 11 minutes straight before a lecture began) but if you do the reading, his lecturing will make the  material more understandable, and if you don't, it won't make much sense. He's also very approachable if you have questions. Papers are a cakewalk. Really chill guy, too. Read!

This class was about Greece which is Williams' specialty. He's brilliant as a scholar but he's boring in class. He still uses overhead projectors and transparencies for visuals. Papers are pretty easy if you do the reading. He spends about a quarter of each class talking about anecdotes which usually aren't related to class material.

Williams is a really nice guy, and he's incredibly knowledgeable. But as a professor, he's scatterbrained. His lectures, which feel 10 hours long, usually go off-topic for quite a while. He's never clear about what he wants for assignments. He gives reading quizzes that are hard even if you read. Don't take a class taught by him unless you have to.

Dr. Williams is brilliant and knows a lot about everything. Class is not terribly hard. Easier grader on tests than papers. Gives too many IDs to prepare for but still not a bad prof. The only issue is he gets REALLY far behind. We covered Hamlet in 20 minutes. Overall not bad as long as you actually interested in learning about humanities.

Couldn't have asked for a more knowledgeable professor.  I'm a history major but came into class not having study ancient Greece since high school. I was very intimidated at first, but he helped me pick it right up. Only downside (though his thoughts were always interesting) was he often got himself off topic while lecturing. Highly recommended.

Don't be too intimidated by the amount of reading he requires for his course.  Do the reading and there will be no surprises on the tests and quizzes. Always gives multiple choices for essay questions and provides ample study material. Only thing to be weary of is grammar on assigned essay, he will light you up for even the smallest grammatical err

Williams is brilliant. If you want to learn and be challenged, take his class. If you're looking for an easy grade, do not take his class. He knows absolutely everything about his subject which helps and gives bonus on the tests.

DO NOT TAKE DO NOT TAKE. Took hum with him and he made my semester horrible. He is arrogant and thinks he knows everything. He preaches to you, so you better believe what he does or you're screwed. His tests are absolutely nuts, he thinks we are machines. Spends over a month on the bible. I will never ever take a class with him again EVER!!!

Very smart and capable teacher. Truly passionate about his teaching. Well read on the material and very helpful. Go to office hours if you need help with the essay. Anecdotes in class are usually funny.

Williams only lectures for the whole time you're in class, so it might be a bit of a drag. Weekly quizzes are given but they're not too bad. very knowledgeable historian. Has read all the texts in their original language so he understands the way things are translated to help you better understand the authors meaning. Easy grader. very enthusiastic about his class

Super enthusiastic, really loves teaching and loves the material. A little bit eccentric, and assigns a lot of reading, but as long as you do the reading and have a sense of humor, you should have problem doing well.

He is an arrogant professor who thinks he knows everything. You cannot challenge his beliefs at all. He is very religious and it comes out in his lectures. grades essays based on your opinion not how your present it

Prof. Williams is an amazing professor! He is extremely knowledgeable about history and is always willing to explain something. There are weekly quizzes but as long as you do the readings you should be fine. The exams are essay based, but again you have to study... if you put in the effort it will definitely pay off and Williams is very enjoyable
Great professor, fairly easy class. All the material is straight forward. Weekly quizzes (easy) to make sure you are attending class. Would recommend!

great guy, great class. unorthodox teaching method (we presented the subjects in oral reports) it all made sense when i looked it over though. fair grader, weekly tests, interesting man. take him if you can.
he's the man. period. very entertaining and fair.

Brilliant man, goes off on wild digressions but interesting ones at that.  Very interesting except for the when we got to the bible.  I missed 3 classes and got an A-, I am a chemistry major.  Draw your own conclusions, it's really not bad.  I liked the class quite a bit for the most part.

I ended up getting an ok grade in the class but it was a lot of stress that wasn't worth it.  He was very arrogant and rude.  I almost feel asleep everyday, so boring.  127 IDfs to have five on the test is a big waste of time but needed to pass this course.  Take with another teacher if possible!
Gives weekly quizzes, pretty easy grader. I don't think I learned a thing though.

Alright.. for Humn I, he's been great. I was intimidated at first, especially when writing a paper on Thucydides (he has a PhD from Yale in Greek & Roman History..) but he's a nice guy & fair. He really knows what he's talking about, and he can be amusing. Definitely lots of tangents, focuses disproportionately on his particular interests. I'm not sure if he ever mentioned it, but I think he's a protestant.  Goes off on ridiculous tangents that are completely irrelivant to the class. He knows his stuff, thats for sure, talks a lot about it, to the poin of rambling at some time, still the class isnt bad, not good, but not bad

horrible. rambles about nothing. grades the paper like its an english class and not history, wants everyone to agree with just him. no clue what i was supposed to read because he revised the syllabus every class! said mycourses responses would count 10 percent, but changed his mind at the last second resulting in my B-, totally unfair. never take!

The worst professor I've ever had.  He can not stay on topic, unless the topic is how great he believes himself to be.  A ridiculous amount of reading crammed into the beginning and end of semester because he wants to spend 7 weeks on the bible.  He thinks he is the most righteous person around.  The tests & quizzes are ridiculous. DO NOT TAKE HIM!

Amazing professor. He really knows his stuff and wants to teach it. The class is not that difficult with one paper and weekly readings. Be sure to come to class because he gives weekly quizes. Good for Core fulfillment and History Majors. There are no quick questions with him. You will have 15 min answers with Tangents. Totally Crazy in a good way.

TANGENTS, TANGENTS, TANGENTS. He clearly can't follow a topic. What I learned most through this class was his "wild" college days. Does not follow an outline, a lot of ERES reading. you can tell he really loves history, but he babbles incoherently about useless information. it's impossible to take notes because he follows no sort of outline.  gave a list of 175 identifications to study and 5 on them were on the test. avoid!!!!!

well, this guy is crazy... took him for a biography course on Alexander the great, by midterm we still had not talked about Alexander himself. since this is his area of expertise he knows everything there is to know about anything, overwhelms with work, had students teach his class through presentations everyday,he is obsessed with his kids soccer

He is an absolutely amazing prof!!! he genuinely cares about his students and does everything he can to help them.  He is also extremely intelligent and tells funny stories! i would highly recommend him.

He is a really good professor,more so if you are interested in History. He goes on ALOT of tangents but usually they are very funny andalittle weird. He is helpful outside of class but sometimes over-answers your question, which isnt always a bad thing. Tests are really easy if you take good notes Go to class, I highly recommend him for this class.

Not a perfect professor, but a nice person. Tests are all essay questions--no multiple choice. Lots of reading required, but the reading is interesting if you're interested in the course. he's a little unclear in lectures sometimes, goes on LOTS OF TANGENTS which can make taking notes difficult. word of advice- write EVERYTHING THAT MAN SAYS. EASY quiz every week, but you MUST READ the 200 plus pages a night to do well. Tests are great if you pay attention and study. essays are graded fairly easy. i don't love him, but i'd recomend.

Great professor; extremely intelligent! He gives quizzes every week but if you read the notes and the readings you'll be fine. This guy is amazing! He's like an encyclopedia, and is very helpful in class. Don't be afraid to approach him, he's really nice and will help you.

he really knows what hes talking about, and is a very fair grader. i skipped the entire second half of the semester, only going to turn in papers, and got a B+. he is also very willing to work around students needs, like accepting my final paper without the required revisions when i had an illness in the family. looking forward to HUMM with him.

Jim Williams is an interesting guy, review sessions are helpful and tests are fair.  Tests cover alot of material though and studying is a must.

Take Aimee's class, you won't regret it! She doesn't do tests, only take home, and the work load is rather light and mostly done in class. Aimee is an amazing professor. Being a high school teacher at the same time, she treats you like one of her own kids, learning about your interests and being very accommodating with due dates. One of the best professor's I have had thus far at Geneseo. Mrs. Rose genuinely cares about all of her students and is so helpful. She wants everyone to do well and is willing to do what she can to help you out. Highly recommend her for anything.

I wish she taught calc! The best math professor I have every had ! She is right to the point with her lectures. Gives practice problems before exams which is really close to how exams would be. She is one of the greatest teachers I have ever had. She wants you to understand and will never make you feel foolish for asking questions. There is no such thing as a stupid question. If you need extra help, she is more then willing. Take advantage of such a helpful teacher!

As someone who has struggled with math in the past, I can say this is one of the best math courses I have ever taken. Prof. Rose is so helpful and her lectures are clear. She is very sweet, if you attend the classes and ask for help, you will be fine. the class involves a lot of hw, but in the end it will help your grade.

take this class! you are a complete moron if you fail any of his quizzes because he goes over all info needed for quizzes and tells you exactly what is on the midterm and final hes a great teacher and makes going to class not torture

Very interesting prof. Most importantly he knows what he is talking about and I love his personality and teaching style. Funny guy but also very serious at times; but classroom set is very relax and welcoming. Charismatic in many ways.
I love this man. Best. Prof. Ever. Enough said.

I take lessons with Dr. Stanley and I enjoy going to lessons because she really tries to understand what will help you progress. Honestly, she cares about you as a person too and you'll find you get in a lot of conversations about all different kinds of things.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: She is such caring professor that will inspire you to love piano and sight-reading too!  She's a really sweet person who really knows her stuff, and she makes me actually WANT to practice :) This class was Piano A, so really basic piano and I learned SO MUCH in just one semester!!  5 quizzes ,1 final,  EASY just playing prepared material for her.

I took Theory Skills 2 with Dr. Stanley and while I could tell she understood the material, I felt she was not helpful in class. She focused mainly on sight reading and rhythm and barely reviewed dictations, which was my weakness in the class. When I asked for help, I received none. I don't understand why she did not want to help me.

I do not recommend this class. I have a music background and this class confused me. He expects you to have perfect pitch just like him, and he doesn't explain things clearly at all. Doesn't reply to e-mails in a timely fasion-still waiting for a reply 5 days later.
Cutest old guy you'll meet at Geneseo. Take his class if you want to get to know this funny guy.

Textbook is used inclass. He doesn't take attendance but he'll know if you're not there cause he learns everyone's names. Funny in an old guy way. Classes are easier for people with musical experience. Study and go to class and you'll do well. Quizes in the beginning but die out towards the end. Exams are not hard. He's willing to help you.

Quality professor. Great class for fine arts requirement. Teaches basic music theory, if you have any experience with music you will be golden. Beginners are given special attention (he loves them!), so don't worry. A few written tests, and a piano exam (basic). Gives the class kazoos which he makes you play sometimes for fun. Highly recommended.

Nicest guy.  The class is pretty easy if you have any music background.  If not, he is still a pretty easy grader.  Go to class, listen, and practice the performance stuff before the exam.  Also, he is very willing to meet before or after class for anyone that wants extra help.  I would definitely recommend Basic Musicanship with him!

This man is so nice it's ridiculous. He's funny, intelligent, and amazing musician.  The material is difficult, especially for someone who has no idea about theory- so don't expect and easy ride.  He's very good about meeting before class for extra help. Definitely recommend him.

This man makes me laugh harder than any prof I've ever had. The class isn't necessarily easy, but he's willing to go over things as many times as it takes. He's very liberal on his grading, especially on performance exams. I would strongly recommend the class- I have little musical background, and received an A, as well as many laughs.

Richard is awesome! If you're interested in music and are willing to put forth the effort, this class is perfect for you.  He can be a little hard to understand if you haven't had any exposure to music, but he tries very hard to help everyone understand.

This class was not as easy as originally expected and I can not imagine taking it without previous musical background. With that said, Balkin is a cute old guy who REALLY wants you to be interested... although he has a tendency to jump around the book and rush to teach at the end of class

This class is VERY easy if you have ANY musical background... if you don't, he is very helpful at making you understand what is going on, so it is not hard in that respect either. Recommended either way if you want a fun and easy class. He is a little scatter-brained at times and it is pretty funny. I actually look forward to going to class.

Richard is such a sweet guy and likes to make class fun for people. You just want to hug him. People with no music background will find the class hard cause he's not too clear at times. Class almost always is let out early. Awesome guy and fun class!
Richard is the best, and possibly the nicest person I know!

I'm not sure if he even still is a professor here because I heard he was leaving at the end of last semester. HE IS BY FAR THE BEST OPTION FOR OB IF YOU WANT FAIR GRADING AND TO ACTUALLY LEARN. He is by far the better option it is literally not close. Exams are a story format where it's contextualized MCQs as you go with 2-3 SAQs at the end.

Everything was going well in this class, had an A average and was exempt from the final exam. However, I had a bad group project member who tanked my group's project. I reasonably went to Redlo to explain the issue, he said it wasn't his problem. My grade dropped from an A to a C and it was not my fault at all. Decent professor, not a great guy

Class is pretty easy, Online quiz answers can be found in the free online textbook he provides. The professor is nice, a little odd, blunt at times, but funny. Exams arent hard if you study. There is a group presentation at the end, and his grading is fairly easy. Assignments are helpful for school of business students.

I love Redlo. He has a pretty chill personality and can be super funny. The textbook he had us use was free and his grading made sense. Sometimes the quiz questions were weird, but you can look in the textbook for answer

tags: ['Clear grading criteria', 'Lecture heavy', 'Graded by few things']
comment: Redlo was overall a great professor. He is clear about his expectations and his assignments are extremely doable. Hes good at explaining things if you need help or clarification. He can be funny. However he has a strong no BS attitude and is very blunt/direct. He will NOT baby you or make exceptions without a good reason.
na
Truly awful. Haven't learned a thing. When asked a question about a test she told a student she was't going to talk to them. Childish and a terrible teacher.

This is the first class I've ever taken that I've liked IN SPITE OF the professor. Her lectures are incredibly boring and half the time she can't answer students' questions. Obviously knowledgeable about the subject but an absolutely TERRIBLE teacher. Avoid at all cost. Don't bother going to lecture, read the book at home, it's easier to learn from
No Comments

Prof Brea is amazing, caring, and funny. I learned so much more about the Spanish language and I appreciate it. Take the class if you love learning Spanish and aren't lazy. As someone who loves the Spanish language, it is frustrating when students don't care as much or seem lazy. She obviously cares about her students and teaching, so do the work.

Super interesting lady. This particular course relied heavily upon the students ability to speak and understand basic Spanish, but she was super helpful and very funny. You can tell that she cares about her job. Some complain that she's hard to understand and unorganized, but if you pay attention, she's a smart lady who knows what she's doing

Professor Brea is an angel. She is definitely a bit tough on grading sometimes, but she is hilarious, so sweet, and you genuinely learn so much in her class. This was a class I was actually excited to attend.

tags: ['Tough Grader', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: This class was tough because she was so lax. Half the time we never knew what our homework really was and she'd get mad if we didn't do it. She does not know how to use Canvas so you have to keep track of your grades via a brightly colored paper. Always take the quizzes seriously to maintain your grade. Not always reachable despite what said.

Pay attention in class, because something she mentions once will probably be on the final. Her lectures are really random, as are the projects. Make sure to really ace the conjugation quizzes to keep you grade high. She is a tough grader on homework, which can be time consuming, so don't procrastinate it.
Professor Brea is really, really good at teaching Spanish and she's really funny. There's a good amount of work to do but it's easy if you work decently hard.

Prof. Brea is the sweetest thing, she cares about her students education and is from Spain so is obviously very good at what she teaches. There's lots of homework but nothing that is unbearable. Her tests & quizzes are easy as long as you pay attention in class. I would 100% take a class w/ her again. She's so funny is available whenever you need.
Not bad to take for your Language requirement. Somewhat inconsistent with the syllabus, but she makes students aware when changes are made. She's fun and makes class enjoyable. I would recommend

Pretty easy professor who is really nice. Confusing at times and is fairly inconsistent with the syllabus.  Real fun however and makes a spanish surprisingly enjoyable.  Definitely one of the better professors out there and one whom I would recommend.
I like her as a person, and she is an OK teacher. If you go to class, and do the homework/diaries you will do well.

Fun teacher, but not especially clear. I always am unsure of when assignments are due and what to do on assignments. But if you know your spanish, her tests are really easy. haven't studied for one and get 95's. journal entries and essays are common. homework assignments take a while when using textbook. If you like fun classes I'd suggest this.

I really like brea. Shes really funny and very nice. Wasn't that difficult of a class but still a lot of work involved if u want a good grade. At the end of the year a lot of assignments were thrown at us and it got to be challenging and brought my grade down. Not a bad class but I wish it would have prepared me better for higher level SPN classes.

This must have been Brea's first time teaching Composition because she did not do a good job of it. I worked by butt off for a B-. No one went to class (I went everyday) and it didn't even matter because we did nothing substantial to help us with our writing. Our assignments were unclear and her feedback was useless. Learned nothing from her.

Brea is such a cute and funny lady, but I wasn't such a big fan of her teaching methods. She'll definitely go over new topics but there's going to be material that she won't cover, and you'll have to learn it on your own while studying. It's not too difficult or tedious though. She can be an easy A if you do study.

She was certainly a little loco and would reveal personal information about students to the class (things from e-mails, who dropped, etc.). Her teaching methods were frustrating and seemed pointless sometimes but the tests and hw were easy

Brea is great! She is really, really funny. She explains everything, including grammar, in Spanish, so be prepared to actually listen. Her requirements aren't bad. She makes class so entertaining, though!
shes really fun interesting a nice.. but not a great teacher per se.  i didnt learn much in her class. very unclear

This class was pretty much of a review for me, but helped me solidify a lot of things. She can sometimes be hard to follow, and if Spanish is really easy for you you might get bored. But she's nice, funny, and if you do your work you'll do well.
Although this was my lowest grade, it was my absolute favorite class to attend.  She is very funny and very helpful.  If you know anything about spanish you will have a much easier time then I did.
Nice professor, helpful, and knowledgeable of subject.
She's a very nice and funny lady who'll help you as much as she can. Her quizzes are mostly easy but her exams can be hard. I do think I could have put more effort in studying.

Entirely one of the sweetest professors I've had at Geneseo.  She genuinely cares about how you're doing, inside and out of the class, and is very understanding.  The hints during quizzes and tests don't hurt either. She once handed my quiz back to me seven times over to fix things on it. It was strange, but very nice of her to do.

Silly little lady and a good professor. Can grade hard on projects but an easy grader on tests and homework. Is very random and entertaining, gives lots of hints during quizzes and tests. Just don't forget to study your vocab and verbs!
She's very funny and sweet.  Her class can be a little confusing sometimes, but overall shes a good professor.
She's a sweet woman and she'll totally pass you if you act like you're really trying.
Buena, Buena, Buena

She's a little crazy but absolutely adorable.  If you struggle with spanish she'll try very hard to help you as long as you put forth the effort yourself.  She doesn't tend to assign too much work.  And if you fall behind she doesn't hold it against you.

Brea is the best.  She is the first spanish teacher that actually made the subject enjoyable.  She cares about how students do and helps in any way that she can.  It is an easy class as long as you look over the stuff real quick before class and do the homework.  Tests are sorta hard.

BEST TEACHER IN THE WORLD! She cares about you and your progress. She keeps class interesting, she is funny, organized and helpful. He tests can be on the hard side but she will help you in any way possible. HIGHLY HIGHLY RECOMENDED! YOU WANT THIS PROFESSOR!

was so helpful outside of class, very understanding and funny. She definitely made Spanish fun and if I had to take another semester of it, it would be with her. She works you hard, but if you go to class and pay attention, you'll do fine.  She really does care about how you do.

One of my favorite classes here so far!  She's a harder grader & she gives a lot of writing assignments.  On the other hand, however, you can retake conjugation tests as many times as you want.  A very funny woman and VERY helpful - HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!
I love Señora Brea!!!  She is hysterical and so cute.  She is a hard grader, but she lets you rewrite your papers and retake quizzes.  A lot of work outside of class.

Senora Brea is the BEST spannish teacher i have ever had!! She helps you in anyway possible and always make her class fun. She can be a hard grader, but you can re-take a quiz or test if you just plain messed up. Really I HIGHLY recommend her!! 10/10!
BEST SPANISH TEACHER EVA!!!!

She is a very fun teacher to have, and her quizzes are very easy, but her tests can be hard, but she will let you take them over so it doesn't really matter.  The only bad thing about her is that she doesn't really clarify what you are supposed to be doin

Easy tests and quizzes, very nice lady, occasionally her jokes aren't funny, but you have to laugh at her effort, at least she tries.  Highly recommended if you don't do well with foreign languages (at least for 102)
Crazy! Hard grader!
Awesome Professor!
If you really struggle with foreign languages this is the profesor to take.

I absolutely did not like this class. It was EXTREMELY repetitive, and he makes it VERY clear that he wants students to have this class be the main focus of their life. He loves theater, and is very passionate about it. He made me dislike theater completely, and want nothing to do with it. He reinforced why I love musical theater and not theater.

Professor Boucher is very passionate about his work. I really enjoyed the plays that we read in this class, they were very interesting. He is very angry if you do not show up to class, so make sure to attend all classes. He is an okay professor. Not someone I would want to take again. Sweet but a little over the top.

I took this online theater class thinking it would be an easy A. This class was fairly easy and manageable, but he is a harsh grader. I got points off for little things that I shouldn't have. I thought it was very unfair that he only gave us 30 minutes to complete a 30 question quiz that was not easy and very specific and detailed.

tags: ['Amazing lectures', 'Clear grading criteria', 'Graded by few things']
comment: Ray is an amazing professor. Hes very laid back and doesnt require much effort; he does like to have class participation, but he doesnt force anyone to answer his questions. There is no final, just three module quizzes that were fairly easy if you did the previous assignments. Highly recommend him as a teacher, hes very fun to interact with.
Great professor. Very passionate about what he does and always has a story to tell which makes the class interesting. Assignments are simple. Would highly recommend!

This class is an easy A. You can tell Boucher is very passionate about theater and from the lectures, I went to I did learn a lot from him! A test for each module and discussion posts based on plays we discussed. I highly recommend him, he is great!

Prof Boucher is a great teacher. Grades only on a few things but it's easy to get a 100. Most information is in the lecture notes (which are also posted on Canvas) and the textbook. Textbook material is dry but not difficult. He doesn't mind alternative ways to learning the material as long as you understand it.
Awesome guy, cannot recommend him enough. Just make sure you submit assignments on time and you're guaranteed an A. It's a super interesting class too.

txtbk used once for paper, borrow from friend. great acting advice, but strict grader. does not post assignment details on canvas, and forgets to explain them. a lot of emotional labor, but if you show up and meet with your partners outside class to rehearse you'll be fine. doesnt accept 'excuses', but cares about wellbeing

Without a doubt, Ray Boucher has been one of the best professors I've had so far. He takes the time to get to know each individual student, and really cares about your personal growth as an actor. He also gives AMAZING feedback. There is one book required for the class that there is a test on, but it's an easy read. HIGHLY recommend Ray's courses!
Amazing professor. Tests are basically vocab from the slides. Some plays to read from the textbook but not too bad. extremely easy class. Would recommend 100%

Drops the lowest test grade, tests really just come down to memorizing the lectures and plot of the readings we are assigned to read. You don't really even need to go to class to do well. This should be an easy A, I was just lazy and really didn't put any effort into this class. Ray is a great guy and makes his lectures rather interesting.

Ray is very kind. The material including the tests are pretty straightforward and easy. You have to pay attention and read in order to pass. The lectures are engaging because he talks to you and expects participation but doesnt force you. Hes passionate about theatre and teaching it. Even if you dont enjoy theatre you wont regret taking him.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Graded by few things', 'Amazing lectures']
comment: Professor Boucher makes the course Introduction to the Theatre all the better. Not only do you learn a lot if you're taking this course for a GenEd credit or not, you actually become engaged with how rich the history of theatre is by the way he teaches. I definitely have a better appreciation for theatre now, all thanks to Professor Boucher.

He makes lectures enjoyable considering people take his class because it is a gen ed requirement. Attendance isn't necessary, but if you do want the A I suggest it because he explains things very well which helps for exams. Exams are straightforward, just make sure you READ THE PLAYS and study his slides. If you do you will most likely get the A.
Very good professor, he reads your work and gives good feedback, forgiving, easy going, easy grader, and I wish I could take another class with him!

class is easy as long as you do the basics. Show up to class and study a bit. Good to show up to class to know what is on the test specifically & class discussions are tested. do the extra credit. Lowest test gets dropped. You can skip the last test if you're happy with your grade. Highly recommend for fine arts gen ed, not a lot of work required

Easy and fairly interesting class. Very interesting and funny lectures. I enjoyed going to his class. A few plays and videos to watch outside of class but other than that lectures are online. Tests get harder as the class goes on but nothing too crazy. I enjoyed this class. Great teacher and very caring toward his students.

I didn't even like theater but he made class pretty enjoyable for me. Very fun and upbeat guy. Easy A class if you just study the slides and the gist of the plays. He gives you extra credit and drops the lowest test grade. I would take this class with him for an easy gen ed grade booster.

I took this class as a requirement - no interest in theatre whatsoever. He makes lectures interesting and posts the slideshow notes on canvas, so if you really wanted to, you could never go to class. Occasionally lets you out early. Only 4 exams, 1 quiz (on a play you have to see during the year). Very nice guy, easy class. Would recommend 100%

Lectures are a lot of fun. Attendance isn't mandatory but you'll do much better if you show up. You will have to read plays but he gives you a fair amount of time to do it, just make sure you keep track of what you need to read when because he doesn't remind you. Lecture is very interactive, but you don't have to participate if you don't want to.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Graded by few things', 'Amazing lectures']
comment: Boucher is an amazing lecturer. I would definitely recommend him for your fine arts gen-ed. There are four exams and one required viewing of a play with a quiz the next class. All the powerpoints are posted online so it is possible to do well without attending class, although his lectures are great. Make sure you read the plays.

Tests are just memorization of terms and people. Need to read a few plays that aren't hard to read. Lectures can be boring. Easy fine arts credit. Extra credit assignment can give you 3 more % points to final grade.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS', 'EXTRA CREDIT']
comment: It was an easy A over the winter session, there were a few things that were graded discussions were graded fairly easy as long as you were very well thought out the papers were not bad either although he is a little tougher about grammar. He also accessible through email pretty quickly so you can always reach out if you need help with anything.

Because Boucher is an actor he presents the material in an entertaining way-coming from someone who only took it for the credit. Easy A if you make flash cards for the tests. Sometimes it's helpful to show up to class because he'll emphasize information for the tests.

tags: ['Clear grading criteria', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS', 'EXTRA CREDIT']
comment: Take this class for an easy A for a fine arts credit. All of the notes are posted on a powerpoint so attendance isn't mandatory. The readings in the textbook are covered in the notes, but make sure you read the plays. Lots of easy extra credit, so take advantage of it.

4 tests and 1 quiz. Posts notes online so you don't have to go but he makes everything super easy to understand if you do. Reading the textbook isn't necessary but reading the plays will help ensure you do good on the tests. Have to see one play. If you can memorize things easy and want an A for your fine arts credit this is the class for you.

He is really passionate about what he does but lets be honest, most people are looking for an easy A to get the fine arts credit over with. I would definetly take this class again but you do have to devote some time going over power points and plays if you want to do well
He is great and hilarious. test are medium hard, make sure to learn all slides and read plays. alot of extra cerdit to save your grade.

Boucher's lectures are mandatory if you want to pass but I always forget that because his classes are that good. He's hilarious, keeps everything upbeat, is honest and really shows that he's passionate about what he does and compassionate for his students. Super easy class, but not boring.

Boucher is one of the most interesting people I've met. His stories are so cool and his lectures are just all around fun. The tests are super easy if you take notes and listen in class. There are a few plays you need to read but they're great. If you do a worksheet with the play, you get bonus points.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS', 'EXTRA CREDIT']
comment: Super chill, he'll tell you to call him Ray. Everything you do in class will be posted online in a powerpoint, so you don't really need to show up. However, discussion can actually be interesting and can certainly help you remember specific info. Graded based on four unit tests that are 40 multiple choice questions. Pretty much all memorization.

Great professor who really cares about his students. Easy A IF you put in the work and read the plays he assigns. A lot of the questions on the tests are based off the plays you are assigned so read them. Also gives extra credit so take advantage and do it. Some questions on test are on what he says in class and not on slides.

He is a real homie, he takes boring lectures and somehow makes them hilarious and interesting. He expects a lot from you so all you need to pretty much is read the plays and go to class and pay attention. The lectures are actually funny and he sometimes gives you hints on the test. He's a real peach 10/10 recommend.

Not an easy A at all especially for a fine arts requirement. Could not get above a B- on any of the tests despite the fact that I felt like I was overstudying for theatre. However, lectures are always fun with Boucher. I never missed a class.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Clear grading criteria', 'TEST HEAVY']
comment: This class is NOT as easy A. It is way more work than what should be required for a 100 level theatre class. Even the theatre majors in my class didn't get an easy A. He makes the questions on the plays (which take hours to read) so specific. He also teaches each class as if it were theatrical performance and it gets old super quick.

Ray was a great professor, he makes the topic interesting and you can see he really cares about theatre. His tests were easy, and he gives 10 points just for seeing a show. A fair professor, but you have to read the assigned plays or you won't pass the class.

Basically writing here to tell you not to buy the book if for class. There are readings from the book that are focused on the test, yes, but you can find all the readings online. Class if pretty easy if you do the readings and go to class. He also gave us an extra credit oppurtunity which was cool.

Only had 3n tests in the class. Had to go to one school production for easy 10pts to grade. Didn't have to show up to lectures only to tests. Couldn't pass class if you skipped tests. Lectures are fun and easy to follow along. Great class to get an easy A and to boost your GPA if needed. 10/10 would TOTALLY recommend

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'TEST HEAVY']
comment: Super boring but you have to pay attention in lecture because he tests on the little things he says in class. Constantly goes on tangents. At least 10 VERY detailed questions on each play you read per exam. Decided he would offer one extra credit after people bombed the test, had to pay to go to the play and then write an essay on it.

I took Theater 100 in my first semester of freshman year and Boucher really made my very first semester memorable! He's a wonderful teacher who makes lectures interesting and easy to understand. There are only a few grades altogether but he offers extra credit and the tests are mostly definitions straight from his lectures. Would recommend!

Easiest class I have taken at SUNY Geneseo. Ray is super nice, and his lectures are very entertaining. If you pay attention in lecture you can pass the tests with minimal studying. He makes the class fun. Changes my concentration to Theater because I loved this class with him so much.

This was one of my FAVORITE classes, taken for Fine Arts GenEd credit.  Ray is AWESOME and he really tries to give you every opportunity to get an A. Tests are VERY fair and pretty easy if you know the material... just showing up will help you pass because the lectures are really helpful. He gives A LOT of extra credit, only 3 tests and 1 quiz

tags: ['Clear grading criteria', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS', 'EXTRA CREDIT']
comment: Easy class, but also fun. I didn't mind it at all.

Boucher was a pretty good professor.  It was a class i actually didnt mind getting up early for.  3 tests, and a quiz makes up the grade, but there is a lot of opportunity for extra credit.  I'm not a theatre person at all, i just took the class for my fine arts gen ed, but I definitely learned a lot in his class.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Clear grading criteria', 'EXTRA CREDIT']
comment: Boucher is amazing- makes lectures entertaining, provides examples of different theater styles in relatable ways (ex- a scene from Beauty and the Beast). Attendance isn't mandatory- powerpoints are online so you can catch up. Make sure you read the assigned plays or you'll fail the tests, but there are good extra credit opportunities just  in case.

Makes an 8:30 not bad to go to! Attendance isn't mandatory but i'd go anyway because he gives really good lectures. Posts all the notes online and grades are only 3 tests and a quiz. Definitely a good fine arts credit class.

He's really passionate and has a really good way of explaining things so even boring topics seem interesting. He's very engaging, but participation isn't mandatory. The tests are super easy as long as you've paid attention (look over the textbook readings and listen in class), and he gives lots of opportunities for extra credit.
Thea100 is an easy a. That is if you put in the work, if you don't, get ready to be annoyed. he also gives an absurd amount of extra credit, so take advantage.

This class was supposed to be easy but it is my hardest class. He is really condescending and thinks he knows everything. Will ask really stupid questions and want to shoot yourself. Do not take, he is the worst. :(
Straight forward professor with semi-interesting lectures

Overall a wonderful teacher and experience. The class is fairly easy due to already having acting experience, but even if you don't he's quick to help, and will help you to personally grow. He is understanding and caring about disabilities. My only complaint is that he thinks he's really specific on what he wants for papers, but he really isn't.

As long as you read the plays, read the textbook, and attend class you will get an A. If you do one of those three things you will pass. The quizzes were all very easy. I got a 70 on the final and still got an A. He is very nice and interesting.

I did not expect to enjoy a 8am intro theater class, but he made lectures and discussion interesting enough that it was one of my favorite classes! He makes the class very discussion based, which makes it way more enjoyable. There's little to no textbook reading, but a lot of the test is from the lecture/discussions, so go to class and take notes.

He's super enthusiastic, and very well put-together. Always prepared for class, and enjoys class discussions ( you don't really need to participate, but pay attention!). Take advantage of his easy 10 ec points by volunteering in the theater because that saves your grade. Gives quizzes based on plays but you can take them at home. Take notes!!!
1010 would recommend. Boucher gives fantastic feedback and insight as long as you are willing to keep an open mind.

Boucher was a nice guy, and he used our semester as a guinea pig for doing online quizzes, which were pretty simple, definitely a grade booster. My main issue was he seemed unorganized, many quizzes had errors and we had to fight for answers. He changed things luckily, but it was frustrating. Also, asked very specific test questions.

I adored Dr. Boucher's lectures. Boredom is a rarity in his classes, and overall, it's a very nice way to earn your fine arts requirement. I am one that likes class discussion, and so this was the perfect class for me. I learned quite a bit over the semester, and would absolutely take another theater class with him. Read your textbook, folks!

Professor Boucher has a bad rep for being egotistical but I found him to be really funny and genuine! He clearly is well-educated in theatre and performance and is very understanding. He gives some great extra credit opportunities that barely anyone takes advantage of. If I was more interested in theatre, I would definitely take from him again!

For me, this class felt a lot harder than it was. If you show up for classes you will probably get a solid grade. If you do the readings and  take notes, an A is guaranteed. His extra credit is very helpful and fair. He is also gives generous curves on the mid-term and final exams. This is a good class to take for one fine art gen ed credit!

Get ready to read a ton of plays from your textbook because he gives 20 question quizzes on those plays almost every week. Not a lot of paper assignments but a ton of studying and you must go to class. Also, if you work behind the scenes on a show with Johnnie Farrell, you can get up to 10 extra credit points, which will really help.

I didn't like his personality at all, so I rarely attended class. However, it's easy as long as you use his website for notes and make sure to actually READ AND OUTLINE the text book because there can be questions on test from book  that aren't in the class notes. I found it helpful to read the plays then watch them on youtube. Do extra credit!!!!

Boucher has definitely made this class harder than before. The quizzes had confusing choices and sometimes asked really specific questions. You have to read the plays. GO TO CLASS because at least half of the test questions are class discussion based that cannot be found on his website. He can be kind of condescending but it's not too bad.

Nice guy. Easy to get an A -- if you go to class. A lot of test material is based on class discussion. So go! (I skipped a bunch of classes toward the end of the semester and the grade I got on my final reflected that). Quizzes are simple IF you do the readings, but you shouldn't expect to be able to just look at SparkNotes and get a great grade.
Read the plays and show up for classes and you'll get an A.

Overall pretty easy. Learned that he changed his quizzes to make them longer and slightly harder than past semesters, but otherwise, not too bad. His lectures are long and mostly him ranting about something unimportant. His notes are all on his website, so it's not completely necessary to come to class although tests are partly based on discussion.

Always complains about people skipping his class. Always complains when people leaves class after his quizzes. He's an easy A though. I had a perfect score throughout the class and just winged the final and still got an A. Really boring.

Take Acting with Ray Boucher! He is a real guru and will make you a much better actor. I was always impressed by the performances of my classmates after they received instruction from Boucher, and mine definitely improved over the course of the class. The class is almost all participation and effort with a paper or two. Best class, highly recommend

Great option for a fine arts requirement. The professor and information were easy to understand. He also makes it interesting. There's some general reading of plays required, but nothing unreasonable or that can't be handled. Overall, loved him and the class.

TAKE THIS CLASS. I AM TELLING YOU TO TAKE THIS CLASS. I missed half the classes, went in for the quizzes and the final exam and BOOM I got an A. I suggest you do go into class (even though it's 8:30) because though his quizzes can be sparknotes'd, his final is based on class material. Do the extra credit! It's an easy 5 point booster on your grade.
He's a good guy, but his ego is too much. His quizzes and tests are very easy, but he definitely carries a holier-than-thou attitude.
Very easy class but he tends to act out anything that he says which can be very annoying at 8:30 in the morning.

Easy A IF you read and GO TO CLASS! He helps attenders by telling what to study. He puts notes online. 2 exams (midterm and a final). A few small 10 question quizzes on the plays. Had to see one play on campus. As a Christian, I disliked the material because of its content. Also didn't enjoy his ego, but overall he was a "nice guy."
Great guy! learned so much from him and had a lot of fun doing it. Don't make him mad or he can be scary but for the most part he is always positive and fun. Take any class you can with him!

I would only recommend this class if you are looking for an easy A. However to have him as a professor, I would not recommend him at all. He is very cocky and even though he is extremely enthusiastic for 8 am, he ego is hard to listen to

Great professor! The class is an extremely easy was to get an A. Such a nice guy, but make sure you don't text during his lectures, because he WILL call you out on it in front of everyone. Highly recommend this class for a fine arts requirement!!!!

You can tell he really loves theather and really know a lot about it which is very refreshing. He makes class exciting and engages the students. I love his class it is really a great way to start off the day.
Lectures were straight from his notes online, tests were straight from the notes. Very easy class. Ray can be frustrating with his occasional rants but overall a decent experience.

As someone with no interest in theatre, Boucher made the class surprisingly enjoyable.  He loves theatre and his passion resonates in the class.  He got me interested in it, and for something that I never thought would happen, that's saying someting.
Fantastic guy. Engaging and fun. Made theatre a joy to go to 8:30 MWF

Professor Boucher is great! I was not looking forward to theatre, but he makes it so interesting and fun to learn about theatre. I actually enjoy theatre now and appreciate it more than I used to. He's a great guy and very clear in his expectations. Take him if you get the chance, you won't regret it!

such a pleasure to work with. Boucher is such an animated teacher who's enthusiasm is infectious. I appreciated his humbleness and willingness to work with his students regardless of their individual level of skill. Acting I is a fun and easy class for sure, but Boucher just makes it 10x better. Couldn't have asked for more

BOUCHER!!!! Such a great professor! Everything is pretty much class discussion with an easy paper every couple of weeks. Only complaint was how much out-of-class time was needed for the final project, which isn't hard anyway. Great sense of humor. I always looked forward to his class.

This class is by far the easiest way to fulfill a fine arts requirement. I attended the first class, the days papers were due, the midterm, and the final, and never looked at the textbook and still managed an easy B+.  If you go to class you're in for a definite A.

Got an A. I have no interest in theatre, but he is well-spoken and makes it somewhat interesting. I only took notes if the info wasn't on his website. Read through the notes 4 times or so before the exams and know the writers/works. Plenty of extra credit available if you need it. If you skip, make sure you watch the videos on your own.

Boucher's class was fun, sarcastic and easy. I didn't attend most of the classes, but I wish I had dragged myself out of bed and went. I ended up getting an A- but could have easily gotten an A had I gone to more classes. Highly suggest him.

By far one of the best teachers I have had at Geneseo, especially in the SOE! She is extremely helpful, accommodating, and knowledgeable, plus just an overall fun, happy person. TAKE A CLASS WITH HER!
A wonderful teacher who is extremely clear about expectations.  Everything she teaches is meaningful and valuable.  She is always willing to help and provides a lot of support.  Fabulous!

She is a nice lady who is knowledgeable about the subject. Sometimes she was difficult to understand, but not bad. She would often change her answers to questions about assignments. Class overall is not difficult. Tests are online. Not a bad teacher overall.

Dr. Jung is awesome. Even though sometimes you can't understand a word of what she says, she will continue to reexplain herself to help. There were a lot of handouts in this class but I think I really learned a lot.

Professor Becker was a great chemistry professor! I understood so much more of the material by having him as a teacher, and I did much better than I expected to do! He's very friendly and approachable, and funny in class! Would definitely recommend.

Prof. Becker was a great teacher, very clear on what he wanted you to know for exams, and his exams were concept based and fair. Pay attention in class, do practice/old exams, and do all the homeworks (not many of them) and you'll do well. I highly recommend taking chem with him! I learned more chem from him than any other geneseo teacher thus far!

Becker is a good professor but he isn't always on his game. While he will teach everything that you need to know he makes mistakes on his lecture slides and sometimes his test answer keys. He'll give you back the credit if you catch them thought. I'd recommend him as a professor.

Professor Becker is a great teacher. He makes the material easy to understand. And his lecture is always the first one to run out of space. Some times he cracks corny jokes to lighten up the mood. Super nice guy!
Very friendly and helpful! Pretty Easy grader, is willing to explain anything you don't understand. I really enjoyed having him as a teacher

He is a great professor and teaches the class in a fun manor and is very approachable. Walking through halls he knows who's in his class. He also has a lot of hw that greatly helps GPa. Tests are fair and he gives out reference tables to help with them. My favorite professor so far.
Very easy!! he has lots of homework to boost gpa. in class assignments for extra credit. He also drops the lowest test score out of 4 tests!

I can easily say she is by far the worst prof I've ever had. Professor Heller is very knowledgeable in her field of work, she made my least favorite class very enjoyable. If you have the chance, take a class with her

tags: ['Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Would take again']
comment: Dr. Heller is my favorite professor at Geneseo by far. Her experience in the field (4 deployments overseas) and her genuine care for the subject matter and her students make her far superior to any other professor I've ever taken. I liked biology with spear. He wasn't the most lively guy but what do you expect when they are basically there to read off notes and add a little here and there. You have to definitely study in order to pass.

This guy should get more respect than students give him... Phenomenal teacher and really smart guy. Do the work and you'll get the grade.

Ray's role in this semester flipped from being harder than O'Donnell to being surprisingly easier in terms of test material. The final was exceptionally easy, and I have never felt so good after leaving a test in general. Read the textbook! You will get nowhere without it. He is very nice.
Dr. Spear is a little dry in lecture.  He's a decent teacher though. Do the practice exam for the final!
This class is super easy. His lectures are boring, but if you do the mastering biology assignments, he takes the exact questions and uses them on the test

This guy is all over the place. The syllabus says one thing and he does another. He is fairly simpler than O'Donnell (Who teaches the first half of the class). The book will probably help more than his lectures. Also, very boring.

A decent instructor, except his in-class notes do not cover everything and tend to jump around, and his lecture style is hard to pay attention to.  Eager to help students.  Personally, I didn't need his lectures and was able to keep up with the class just by reading the book.

NOT A BAD GUY, the class demands diligence. This isn't high-school. Best econ course I've taken. Dr. Spear is horrible. He doesn't believe in his students and only tries to discourage people from staying in the major. Nice guy, but this is the worst textbook I've ever encountered. Class is somewhat confusing and doesn't really go over that much.

Its a shame that 300 level bio classes are easier than 100 level bio classes at geneseo. Its backwards. This class isn't much work and you do well gradewise. I have no interest in this subject whatsoever, but this course is designed for seniors who don't care anymore. I took spear for intro to bio and thought he was pretty boring, but took him for ecology lab and he was awesome. TAKE HIM FOR LAB!!!

He's a nice professor but can indeed be boring in his lectures. However, that's just the way he speaks imo. He's actually very passionate about biology and knows what he's talking about. An extremely nice guy and will help you with absolutely anything. Not into ecology, but YOU SHOULD TAKE IT for an easy/fun elective lab. BORING. Not a hard class if you read the textbook but coming to class is pointless since his powerpoints come right from the textbook company so you don't learn anything new. Spear is a very nice guy and is willing to help you with any issues/problems you may have. Not the worst prof to get stuck with-read the textbook

Monotone. Excessively boring. Terrible quizes and homework question. Random (PRS) questions. Very boring plant material covered. Nearly useless information unless interesting in being a Biology Professor.

Holy crow this guy is boring.  You literally start drifting to sleep during class.  He steals his powerpoints off a website online, thus proving his disinterest in the class.  His exam questions are difficult.  He's also really bad with computers and spends way too much time trying to figure out how to get the PRS system to work.

Spear is the most monotonous and boring professor I have had at Geneseo. in his defense, he is a really nice guy.  however, he is a horrible teacher, confuses himself beyond belief, can't answer questions, his voice will bore you to death and you will inevitably fall asleep.  he's really bad at teaching but it's worth sticking him out because you get ODonnell for half and he is the best.

Dr.Spear was a great improvement over Dr.Simon as he actually answered questions and taught, but he is the most monotone and boring professor ever. His lectures are extremely dull and hard to sit through. Nevertheless, he is 10 times better than Simon.
goes too fast.

Very monotone and boring if your the type that has trouble paying attention you are going to have trouble in this class. The only reason why he goes slowis because he cant go any faster or he'll get more confused then he already is. He tries to go slow to make sure everyone understands, but it just doesn't work that way. At least the final isn't cummulative. Go to review sessions!

This guy put me to sleep every day.  I wouldn't have gone to the class if I hadn't had classes before and after it.  He's not helpful at allllllll.  Doesn't respond to e-mails, isn't great in office hours.  definitely wouldn't reccommend him
Good professor but can be monotonous so sometimes it's hard to pay attention.  Read the text and use his notes.

he has a very nice teaching style and tends to go back and forth betweent he power point presentation and the overhead, he explains things multiple times and still gets all the information covered, he grades pretty easily too

After weeks of Simon, you will be praising whatever god you believe in that Spear has arrrived. Much nicer (in voice and manner) and much more helpful. Not phenomenal, but a good guy and a good teacher. After Simon's stuttering, incomprehensible crap, you will like Spear.

Although a relief after listening to Simon for 3 weeks, my grades actually dropped with Spear due to his inability to write quiz/test questions. Boring and monotonous in class, but by far does a better job than Simon at actually answering questions on the study guide.

Had him for general bio 2--really nice guy and he's unfairly compared to O'Donnell all the time (he has very different teaching style). Coming to class is a requirement as he goes over huge amounts of stuff not in the slides. Very good teacher--just study the book, slides, and notes and it's an easy A. He tries to help students as much as possible.

Dr. Spear takes his lecture notes from the book. They are not very clear and you have to read the book in order to understand the material. There is no way to avoid him if you take general bio. His voice is very monotonous and you will find yourself falling asleep. Have to teach the class to yourself.

Had him with Odonnell, and spear was horrible compared to Odonell. He is boring and the questions on his test are wordy and confusing. My grades on spears tests droped 10 points lower then my grades did in Odonnell.

more helpful than simon. nice guy although his lectures are monotone and make the class look like its never gonna end. lenient with grading tests and his tests are not hard
Had him with Odonnell and Odonnell is a MUCH better teacher. Stopped going to classes cause I learned more by reading the book. He is soooo boring and sooo monotone!

I had Spear along with Simon, and Spear is a MUCH better teacher.  He explains things really well, and is willing to help you more if you don't understand something.  He is a really nice man, and he kind of looks like a little turtle :)  I haven't had other classes with him, but if you can manage to take him without taking Simon, DO IT.

If you want to experience high school biology again, take this class. You just have to read the chapters and study. His lectures oversimplfy things, which is good in some cases, but not all. Monotonous, sounds constipated all the time SUCKS
Spear was good at relaying the information but he wass kinda of dry so it was hard to pay attention sometimes. Overall a good teacher just bring coffee of get some sleep before class

I had him with Simon, and I thought he was WAY better.  He is really approuchable and seems to know his stuff.  Answers questions without making you feel like a criminal for asking them.  A bit soft spoken, so you may have the urge to fall asleep.

Great Guy! He has a very soothing voice, so be sure to bring coffee to class so you don't zone out. If you pay attention during lecture, you will find he has a wealth of info to share especially about Evolution - he makes it really interesting. Very approachable. Tests are not too difficult either.

Spear is a really nice guy, but no matter what you do BIO 117 is gonna be hard.  People that say he sucks are wrong - no matter who you have for BIO 117 you're gonna have to read the text and study quite a bit to get an A.  He does make lectures a bit boring but he knows what he's talking about.
He's nice enough to speak in a low enough tone so sleep is inevitable
long boring lectures and he sometimes seems like he doesnt know what hes talking about. if you're trying to learn, you might as well stay home and read the textbook.
Nice guy and a fairly good teacher. His notes are..interesting..however. But I recommend him.
he sucks
very slow when lecturing- boring class- notes dont make sense a lot
He goes really slow and makes it very boring. He is really nice though.

Gental older man - so nice! Teaches the class with Dr. Simon (switch every 4 weeks). I highly discourage taking any class with the other teacher, Dr. Simon ever, but Dr. Spear is so great and awesome!!! A very fair teacher.

lectures are crystal clear!  makes biology interesting :o)
Very nice guy, non-intimidating. Will help you with anything you need.
amazing, understanding, helpful!

One of the most informative professors I've taken at Geneseo. Professor Abbas is extremely knowledgeable in her field, and always pushes for her students to further their arguments and provide additional context in their papers. Super lovely awesome lady who is SO on top of things (even though she will try to tell you she's not)! You will be missed.
Honestly the best professor I have ever had the privilege of working with. You can really tell she cares about her students and the course material and goes above and beyond to help you succeed.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Amazing lectures']
comment: Really great at giving lectures and explaining the readings in an easy way to understand. The content covered in the class is interesting and you can tell she's very passionate about what she does. 4 easy quizzes based on lecture material and 3 papers that require some critical thinking. Overall, an enjoyable class. You will learn a lot.

In this class you will have to read a lot, do not underestimate reading assignments. Half or not all her material is philosophical in nature. She really cares and is very flexible to help by having effective office hours.

Dr. Abbas isn't a very good lecturer, but she's super helpful. She's really passionate about the topics she teaches (Islamic Studies), which makes class bearable. She's always available if you need help, and wants you to pass. Participation is important and a large part of your overall grade, but as long as you do the work, you're golden.

Her HIST 301 class was the best class I've had at Geneseo. She took on really complex philosophical and historical topics and made them understandable. Her papers might've sometimes been a little difficult, but they were never tedious and they often made you think about important things. Best professor in the history department imo
Professor Abbas was meant to be a professor. Take her class. She is the best professor Geneseo has!

Professor Abbas is the best professor at Geneseo. She is truly brilliant, but explains things in such an understandable way. She has expectations for her students, but she isn't unreasonable about them (and she is extremely helpful if you go to her for help). I've learned more from her than any other professor. Definitely take a class with her!

Professor Abbas is absolutely brilliant. She cares about her students and wants them to succeed. If you show some concern for your grade, she will work with you. Her feedback is amazing and incredibly helpful. She is the best professor in the department, and they are lucky to have her. I can't express enough how wonderful professor Abbas is.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: Abbas is spectacular. You will learn a lot in her class and the grade is mostly paper based but quizzes help boost you up. I found the lectures really engaging and informative. I highly recommend her, she is great.

Professor Abbas is great. I honestly don't know why her rating here isn't higher. She assigns a lot of reading, but it's all really engaging and she explains it really well in class if you missed the reading.  The quizzes she gave were pretty basic stuff and she was always willing to talk through a paper or a problem in her office hours.

Dr. Abbas gives tests with ridiculously high levels of detail for a 200 level class, assigns unreasonable amounts of course readings that are not easy to keep up with, and only gives two very differently organized papers, which does not help students to practice applying their knowledge and honing their skills to perform better.

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Get ready to read', 'ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS']
comment: Dr. Abbas gives interesting lectures, she expands your knowledge of whatever she is teaching. She doesn't give out exams, which is good if you're a bad test taker, but instead she assigns papers. And the papers are difficult. Go see her during her office hours because her prompts are confusing. The grade is mostly based on these papers.

Professor Abbas is the best professor at Geneseo. She is absolutely brilliant; gives excellent feedback; is accessible outside of class; has clear grading criteria (and grades fairly); and explains things amazingly well. Professor Abbas is one of those people who was meant to be a professor. The history department is lucky to have her.

Professor Abbas is probably one of my favorite professors at Geneseo and her class on Orientalism is definitely my favorite class here so far. She deals with challenging topics really well, but at the same time is an understanding grader. She's not trying to give ppl bad grades for no reason. This is my second class w/ her and I plan to take more!
Best Professor in Geneseo

Dr. Megan Abbas is the best professor I've had at Geneseo. More than anything else she wants her students to succeed. I'm a math major and wish she was my advisor!
Dr. Abbas is incredible. Her class makes you think and certainly isn't the easiest class around, but she wants you to succeed and as long as you are willing to work for it with her you will do well.

Professor Abbas is a great teacher.  Her lectures are very illuminating and interesting. A fair grader most of the grade is determined by rather easy quizzes and three papers.  Decent writers will be fine.
One of the best teachers I've had so far. She is a delightful woman and an amazing teacher. I like her so much I'm taking another class with her next semester.

Very disorganized. At the beginning he laid it down saying we will have lots of quizzes and 10-15 times where we would have to go up in front of the class to speak. We've only had two presentations. His teaching is unconventional compared to other professors. If you come to class and participate you'll get an A. He genuinely cares about the success of his students. Lots of extra credit points. Test questions are straight from the practice test and textbook.
He is basically the thinnest skinned professor you will ever have (if he continues teaching).
She wasn't cool or hot. I don't understand the other reviews.  More than anything it was horrible to listen too--that voice! Thank the gods she's gone.
Best professor of the year for me. awesome and interesting class.
energetic in her class and very engaging.  good eye candy too.

Amazing woman.  Understands how it is to be a student and makes accommodations if necessary. Best professor i've had at Geneseo.

Dr. Harrigan is great! Her lectures are super interesting and her bright, cheerful, and energetic personality successfully kept me alert and attentive, despite the fact that the class was 2.5 hours. Great Prof, 3 tests, some papers, website won't let me write anything else #confused
One of the best professors I have ever had!

She is one of the best professors I have ever had.  I thouroughly enjoy this class as she keeps it interesting and is very enthusiastic about teaching it!  She cares about her students and gives great feedback.  I suggest taking a class with her!
The best professor at Geneseo. Take as many classes as you can with her.

best teacher i have ever had. inspired me to declare my major. her class notes are SO HELPFUL and SO organized. she is nice and very approachable. do not  be nervous to go to her office hours. her few assignments are fun and interesting. if you raise your hand she will always make it seem like wat your saying makes sense even if it doesnt..TAKE HER
Greaaaaaat Teacher! Her enthusiasm and kind spirit kept the class interesting. Was always there and ready to offer help even when she didn't have to. By far my favorite teacher to date!

This is a really great teacher. She makes this class so fun and interesting. She has so much energy and really wants everyone to be successful in it. Marko is such a kind hearted person. She makes the things she teaches so interesting and you can totally apply what you learn to your life. She is one of the most approachable profs. i've ever encountered. I highly recomend her.
A GREAT professor...she is always perky and excited and one of the nicest people I know. I definitely recommend taking any of her classes...

She is a great teacher. she follows the book for the most part and her tests are very fair. i recomend taking her
