comment: 4 exams and thats pretty much your grade. You don't need to go to class at all as long as you look through his slides and read the textbook.
Best professor Ive had so far. Tests are mostly on lectured info, plus some textbook. AMAZING!

tags: ['ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS', 'EXTRA CREDIT']
comment: Dr. T is really passionate about what he teaches. His lectures tend to be pretty big, mine had about 400 students in it. You are graded on 4 exams and have the chance to get up 6 points added to your final grade. Tests are fair, and he gives out detailed study guides based on lectures. He posts his lectures so its not necessary to attend class.

tags: ['Clear grading criteria', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS', 'EXTRA CREDIT']
comment: Professor Taber-Thomas only means the best. Although his lecture is big, he really tries to accommodate to the entire class. The textbook is helpful in some instances but not entirely necessary. His discussions in class go hand-in-hand with his notes, so that's a plus. He gives decent study guides, and the test are not that difficult. Fair class.

tags: ['Clear grading criteria', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS', 'EXTRA CREDIT']
comment: Great prof! Gives up to 6 points in extra credit added onto your cumulative grade when you participate in psych studies. He's funny and "hip" uses memes in his lectures. Also gives a HELLA useful study guide. Not hard to pull an 85 with an adequate amount of studying.
ehhh, fairly nice but that's about it. avoid if possible.

does about 10% of the teaching and makes the students do the other 90% and not in a productive way. gives really stupid assignments and then grades however she likes. affirmed my dislike for anything related to the humanities.

There's one word that describes Waddy: brilliant. She is not only an amazing educator but a person as well. Yes she is harder but it only makes you work harder and benefits you. She has my respect. BY FAR the best professor in the History department.

Dr. Waddy is kind. She could stand to be a little more clear about her assignments. She is very helpful with the presentations each student gives in 3 person groups. She's not a stickler about making exams up. She's flexible with deadlines for essays. Exams are open book but she expects a lot of quotation of materials. Excellent book choices too!

A tough professor.  She pays more attention to the details of your work than anyone else- but it's all to ultimately benefit you.  Don't take the class if you don't want to do the work, but if you want to better yourself (especially as a writer), Waddy's the one to take

She's a tough one, that's for sure. Won't test you on the books, or anything. All grades come from writing. Ultimately, this class does nothing but benefit you. Teaches how to do individual, research and thesis development, all without the hand-holding. Don't be scared away. You'll walk away that much more prepared for capstone.

Took Holocaust class with Waddy- she DOES NOT TEACH. Half the class is watching History Channel movies, the other half is library research. The books are never used or quizzed on. Assignments are vague. Specifics are EVERYTHING with her- citations will MAKE OR BREAK YOU. Vague. Sits in a corner. Speaks rarely and is inaudible when she does.

She is boring and very annoying! The class doesn't pass unless you bring a laptop and do other work during class! She lets the students teach, and just sits in a corner, and interferes them which makes the process very difficult as you are trying to present. I received a C in the class, despite going to all classes, and doing all the work.

After coming to RateMyProfessor.com to check out Waddy I got pretty freaked out! But I went to class, did the reading, participated in class and went to see her about my papers. I took her advice on fixing my papers and did wellin the class. She really isn't that bad

Knows an insane amount, but doesn't know how to present it in a clear way. Hard grader -seems very stuck in her ways. If it isn't her way, it isn't the "right way"-VERY frustrating. Expects too much detail on in class essays. Reading is very interesting, and more helpful than lecture. Lots of group work. Frustrating, but easy B if you do the work.

Not as bad as some say. I get the sense that her tough grading is the cause of a lot of resentment. Though her lectures were a little dry, she has a very good command of the subject matter.  Her criticim definitely helps you to become a better writer/historian.  Good professor overall.
Go to class and take good notes. She stresses important information. Tests are easy, but a lot of reading.
No Comments

Old, participation/attendance really counts.  Its weird cause she never actually teaches.  The students take turns teaching.  Not that hard for a hum class at all.  For final we use laptops to type essays... get my drift?? Easy
lectures are very boring, but the reading material is excellent and if you go to her with your paper, she'll give you good direction, just remember to diversify your sources

Waddy is boring as all hell.  I skip class most of the time because I cant stand her english accent.  Grading policy is pure randomness, I assume she passes most people to avoid hassles.  Not a bad choice for HUMN requirement, but very boring.

Absolutely ridiculous woman.  Too old to still be teaching.  Sometimes gives outright incorrect information.  Teaches excerpts from readings she's never read the entirety of (e.g. The Aenied).  Pretty easy grader but only as long as you regurgitate word-fo
just bla bla bla all class...good class to sleep in

Helena Waddy is one of the best professors I had in college.  She is extremely intelligent and expects your best effort on everything, but if you work hard and prove you want to do well it is not difficult to pull at least a B if not an A.

This lady was into herself and her studies a little too much. The class was boring and her papers were graded according to how she likes to write, including a question at the end of an introduction. Nothing was right unless it was done by her.
No Comments
She does not grade based on ability or quality, but rather on her personal attitude towards the student.

I came into Geneseo as a History major and left as a Business major and this class was the reason for my  switch!  It wasn't just me, several of my friends also switched out of History because of her class.
Very unclear on directions, not very helpful.  Extremlely hard grader because she doesn't explain what she wants.  Very monotone.

Professor Waddy takes some getting used to.  At first she may come across as offensive, but after a while you realize that she is only trying to help! You will quickly learn she's willing to help you improve your work, you just have to be willing as well!
Although she was very helpful and knowledgeable, I thought she was an incredibly tough grader.

Dr. Waddy has been one of the most knowledgeable instructors I have ever had.  I graduated over 10 years ago and even know as I finish my PhD I think about how much I learned from her - not just history but teaching excellence as well.
No Comments

Had her for History of Rock and Roll. Really fun class. All we did was watch YouTube videos of rock music for an hour and fifteen minutes each day. If a lot of students got the same multiple choice question wrong she'd throw it out. Easy class if you come to class and pay attention.
I would definitely recommend her to anyone! She's so nice and the hardest part about her class is waking up at 8:30. Either way, I had a fun time in her class and would take her again.

I took 'History Of Rock & Roll' with her. She's a very enthusiastic, energetic woman passionate about music. She realizes its a GenEd at 8:30am and tries to make it easy and painless as possible. The lecture consists of just watching YouTube videos and listening to her input (while not forcing her opinions on you). Pretty easy class and fair grader

Her review sheets were very throughly written however, she put a lot of material on them. Take this class if you like music history. I failed almost every test but did well on my creative project and ended up getting a B.

The class requires a lot of knowledge in Stage Musicals prior to starting, so if you don't already know who Andrew Llyod Webber is, you are probably better off taking another class. She is a nice lady but expects you to know a lot. On the plus side, she gets very passionate and excited about musicals.

History of Rock was a great class. Just watch YouTube videos every day. Reynolds is very enthusiastic which surprised me since its a core req class. Tests aren't too bad and she dosn't count questions if a lot of people get them wrong.

History and Rock and Roll was by far one of the best classes I took in college. Dr. Reynolds is extremely enthusiastic and cheerful and loves showing youtube videos of famous songs and artists. Definitely the best fine art class offered. Tests aren't bad if you read the text and she throws out some questions if a lot of people get them wrong.

Had her for "Stage Musicals," and overall I thought it was an interesting class. She's a bubbly and eccentric, so chances are you'll either love her or hate her. But she a genuinely-nice person and very sympathetic to students. Some of the workload was a bit unrealistic, but fortunately exams were way easier than she  made them out to be. 7/10
Reynolds is really nice but this class is kind of a joke. Class is nothing but youtube videos. Busy work is frequent, and you have to attend class for quizzes on the musicals. Easy B+.

Reynolds was a good professor. I had her for both INTD and Music 100. She is a cool lady, always very excited about the subject matter. Music 100 was a lot harder than I thought it would be as she tests on a lot of information but was able to pull off a B+ in both classes. All in all, looking back I definitely enjoyed her classes
I love Dr. Reynolds! She will keep your attention because she jumps all over the place and will do anything to get through to you. I hate history, but I could never fall asleep in her class!

Very interesting professor.  Very liberal, and focused a lot on what she was particularly interested in.  You get an automatic A for most classes just for attending.  Her tests were confusing as there were very specific questions that I had no idea how to answer.  All multiple choice though, which was nice.

Fairly easy class, lots of automatic As for in class assignments, out of class assignments are easy as well. Tests are long and have questions that require remembering specific information. Lectures include lots of youtube videos. Great lady, decent class.

Extremely nice woman teaching an extremely interesting subject. Attendance in class isn't necessary to know the material but she has a lot of in class assignments where you get an A just for handing in the work. Test questions come directly from the textbook and the notes. If you read the textbook and attend class, it is an easy course.
Really wouldn't recommend taking an INTD with her. Wasn't helpful at all and grading was extremely tough. DON'T TAKE THIS CLASS
Extremely sexy woman.   She has fantastic stories of the past and makes learning a lot more fun.  It is a tough class but she will meet with you after hours and will guide you on how to pass.

This class was by far one of the easiest & interesting classes at Geneseo. You use the textbook; you get an A on in class quizzes just for attending. While the class was early in the morning, it's beneficial to go to class. Tests are a little difficult, but if you use the textbook it will be a fun class for you and an easy A.

Dr. Reynolds is hysterical and very upbeat. She's a sweet woman, and the class is extremely interesting. She gives in class "quizzes" that you get an A on just for being there so make sure you go to class. The tests are easy if you read the textbook. Do the chapter quizzes from the book website - some questions are word for word copied to the exam.

Fun class! Very cool if you're into music. Reynolds is upbeat, makes things exciting. However, will spend a lot of time on things she personally likes and not a lot of time on others. 1st time teaching class, only knows as much as the students about some topics. Fun personal stories. Reading textbook is key to good grades. Overall fun, easy A.
awesome class. if you like any type of rock music definitely take it. reynolds is very upbeat and helpful. read the book and listen to the music samples, tests are easy.

Don't take this class if you don't have a music background or don't like jazz.  It's really easy if you have a jazz/music background but I think it might be tough if you don't.  Prof Reynolds is extremely happy and energetic -- too much for 830 am.
I HATE THIS CLASS
This is a really hard class for someone with no music experience

Fun class if you love musical theater! She's very cute and enthusiastic and acts like a teenybopper. The class is very easy and enjoyable. You will just watch a lot of video clips and presentations and there is homework often but only a few easy questions to answer.Also a really easy grader.

To be successful in this course,  you have to go to class to watch the videos & listen to the music samples. Class notes & little facts that she mentions will show up on  the tests. There is a guaranteed listening portion on the quiz in which you have to identify the song & who played it. Reynolds is enthusiastic & always willing to help.

I would not take this class unless you love jazz. She expects you to memorize 30 songs for a test and then identify them when she plays a clip. DONT TAKE IF YOU WANT AN EASY COURSE!!! She is very energetic but it is very boring unless you love jazz.

I love this teacher!! Very energetic and entertaining. Her lectures can be unorganized, so if you don't pay attention you will get lost, though she is always willing to help. Take notes because she doesnt use the textbook. Tests are easy if you study. Lots of chances for extra credit.
Spews her politcal views all class. For final, had us write an essay basically comparing Bush and America to Hilter and Nazi Germany. What a nutcase!

Absolutely loved her class.  It is extremely difficult but she will help if you put the effort in.  She has no problem meeting with people during office hours and to be honest she is hot so its pretty easy to go to class.  nothing better than a class where you listen to music and look at a gorgeous woman!!
I took INTD with her and yes she is very fill of energy but lacks clarity for you to understand what you are supposed to do and the material was terribly tedious i feel.

Very high energy. She was my first class of the day and always put me in a good mood. Listening quizes can be confusing if you only listen to excerpts once. Gave me a greater appreciation for music. Take her class!
horrible teacher, confusing, thinks you know everything about music because she does. wouldn't recommend this class
she is an awesome teacher!! i wish i had her in the morning because she is always loud,interesting and entertaining!

her class is tough but she is so friendly and helpful that it really doesnt seem to be that bad.  I would say her stories of the past are extremely interesting.  She is extremely hot woman that makes going to class even that much easier.

Super happy ALL THE TIME.Very good at creating excitement for subject!SOO much work for an INTD class.NOT HARD-can edit papers as many times as needed,and lots of interesting movies!But those are TIME CONSUMING.3 movies in 1 week?With writing and reading on top of it? Ridiculous!WAY TOO MANY USELESS HANDOUTS! Result:fun? And actually learned a lot!
Great teacher; so enthusiastic and knowledgeable; take her if you can get in to her classes which usually fill up fast.

Horrible teacher!  Very misleading in class, gives opinions on music, then asks about HER opinions on the test ex:"So and so is great party music" then she'll have a question about that on the test. Random questions on test just to "see if anyone gets it right"  She is NOT HOTT. HELL NO! She's weird with red hair and colorful clothes. She's a joke.
great teacher but very tough....she is willing to help though and does give extra credit.  Very hot woman too...has great stories of the 60's
No Comments
very bubbly, california girl hippie cool

This class is really hard for being a 100 level course.  Though she is a nice person she doesn't really communicate well as a professor.  Found her class to be very hard and really confusing.  Wouldn't suggest this class with her however I hear that she is awesome with the Jazz class that she teaches.
tough professor but willing to help outside of class.  Offers extra credit, which really helps.  Very interesting and funny in class.

the class is a lot of work but if you do it you'll do really well. hard for a fine arts, but you learn a lot. no musical background n im doing just fine.  such a nice lady.  see does however expect a lot from you outside class (movies and performances)

Amazing professor!  The best professor I've ever had.  Energetic, uses lots of examples. She makes it fun.  I heard  the jazz course was difficult but I had her for survey of musical styles, it wasn't really difficult.  Must to the listening multiple times for quizzes and must enjoy classical music.

She is so nice and helpful, but for a 100 level course the material is pretty hard if you dont know music.  I had to work hard to get a B as I didnt have the background in Jazz most of the others seemed to have.
DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS if you need a fine arts core.  She makes it WAY too hard, and it WILL bring your GPA down.  She is very nice, but asks way to much for a 100 level class.

What a terrible course.If you want an arts core that brings down your ENTIRE GPA take her.Class is interesting but the tests are absolutely IMPOSSIBLE!!! She must not know we are only taking  her freaking course because we are forced to fill the arts requirement.  horrible...don't take it!
Ridiculous.

Energetic, straightforward and nice lady. Must attend a few performances throughout semester. Three 3 page papers. tough grader on papers but AS MANY REWRITES as you need to get a good grade. A few writing assignments scattered throughout. Helps like crazy on papers when asked in advance. Great lady

hard class especially if you dont have a background in music, she is really nice tho, crazy and funny, the test are impossible tho memorizign tons of songs and abunch of stupid facts about musicians....difficult
Impossible- she is crazy and offers little to no help. If you don't have a background in music, DO NOT TAKE THIS COURSE!

Nice lady, class is interesting, but the course is too difficult.  And who in the right mind would want to memorize the title, artist, instrumentation, and style of 40 different jazz songs for a quiz, let alone listen to jazz in the first place?
Such a lively teacher and she is very good at passing on her enthusiasm to her students.  Great class!
Not gonna lie - i don't like her at all. Her tests are super hard (at least our class thinks so) unless you know about music beforehand. I would suggest other courses...
She's funny, extremely nice, insightful but challenging. She is always more than willing to help her students, and goes out of her way to do so.
this woman is completely insane, but equally enthusiastic...  what's not to love?!
Just go for it. The class itself is a bit hard but you'll get around it as the course progresses. You'll have tons of fun with her!

she was a great teacher, very simpathetic about absences.  The make-up quizzes were harder that the original ones, which sucked.  I didn't do as well as I had hoped, but if you do the listening and study you can do well.
I LOVE her!!!  So much energy and happiness- going to her class was entertaining!  And you can learn a lot from her.

She is so awesome. She loves what she does and makes you love it too. Even if you don't like music this is still a good class. The tests are a little hard but if you use the book and the review sheet you can do well. She is so fun!

She is so funny! insane actually, but in a good way! the class was hard for me because i wasnt prepared ( high level music course no music background) but she was so clear and helpful that i did quite well. she totally cares and is willing to help out.
Very funny teacher and extremely clear and knows what she's talking about. Would highly recommend her to anyone who wants to take the course. Best teacher I have ever had!!!

SO passionate about music. Classes are easy and boring. She gives out review sheets for quizes, which if you know all that is on the sheets, you'll do great (requires a lot of studying). Performance writeups are easy, she just looks for effort.
SOOOOOOOO easy, i went performances **** and still got a-/b+'s on the reviews, the lectures are really boring. tests are easy if you study, I never read the book and ended up with a B+ in the class
WONDERFUL!  she is incredibly intelligent and a bunch of fun!!!  sooo energetic!  class was super interesting and fun!

reynolds is crazy in the best sense of the word. you can tell she loves music so much just by watching her talk about it. however, i wouldnt recommend the class unless you dont mind sitting through three tedious performances on friday nights
Taking a class with her is worth every minute. She forces culture on you (which by the by, is difficult to find in Geneseo) and you end up impressed with yourself for enjoying it!
REALLY long "quizzes" but she is a bundle of energy and always laughing which makes the class more enjoyable.  Required to go to 3 concerts and write up 2 pg respsonses.  Class is SOOOO easy!!
Really funny and nice, but can get a bit off topic....
Her quizes are crazy, but shes a nice person...but then again, all she does is put on a video and watch it with us (and she gets paid) so boo her!
Holy Cow. Bundle of Methamphetamine... probably Speedball somedays. More energy than I should be able to handle, but I had a GREAT time even though I got my butt handed to me.
She is awesome!!! Though her quizzes are insane she will do anything she can to help you succeed in her class...take advantage of the extra credit assignments!!..they really help!!!
Totally goofy, and makes the class fun.  Expects you to know CRAZY WEIRD details, like who recovered from heroin addiction and who didn't.  Overall, a good teacher.
What a freak.
What a freakin' ditz... You are required to go to concerts on Friday nights and her "quizzes" have 50+ questions. That ain't a quiz, that's a final.

I think of her smile and energy each and every time I listen to "Maple Leaf Rag," Berlioz, "Shake, Rattle, and Roll," Chopin, Debussy, Dizzy Gillespie, Schubert, and so much more that she exposed us to!
She is absolutely brilliant
wonderful professor...very knowledgable and helpful...cares about her students' success

Wonderful professor!  She is extremely kind and will do everything in her power to give you a hand with whatever is giving you a problem.  Very knowledgable, presents material in a very interesting, energetic manner.  Highly recommended!!!!!
hyper and fun and really knows her stuff
As sweet as she is pretty.  Excellent prof also!
great class

The dude isn't the most stable, basically sent out a suicide note to everyone in the class. His class was easy, but boring as hell. We read every class for basically the entire class, unless we were watching a movie. If you want an easy A, take this class. Prepare to be bored out of your mind.

I actually took WGST - 205. The class was interesting and Dr. Rutkowski was very nice and a good person. However, I took this thinking it would just be a fun extra class but it was a lot of work. Lots of readings, lots of writing, and I couldn't seen to do better than a 90 on anything. You will not receive a 100 in this class.

ENGL 458: Louisa May Alcott. Rutkowskis the GOAT. Every English major should take one of her classes. The English program here is great, but we hit a lot of interesting concepts that were more interesting than the text may have been at face value.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: You will never receive a 100 but always a 95 if you try so you still get an A. Don't take the class if you're not passionate about LGBTQ+ topics and issues as it's heavily based on that but if it is something you are passionate about 100% take it. Also Alice is amazing and funny

I took ENGL467 with Rutkowski and LOVED IT! We have one quiz and one discussion post a week that go with readings, and one final paper for course work. She has all of her texts provided via link and Brightspace, so you also don't have to buy any books. She is a lovely, witty professor! Definitely consider taking her, she's now one of my faves

I actually took WGST 205 but that wasn't an option. I like Dr Rutkowski a lot as a person, but she is so so as a professor. We didnt have a syllabus for a few weeks which stressed me out, sometimes the class went totally off topic and she never redirected. Work load was really easy, until it wasn't and we had multiple things to do in the last week.

Best WGST professor. Hands Down. I assume that RAs or education majors would have to take this class, but if you just want an easy A or even a job opportunity in the future, take this class! Alice is such a nice person and genuinely cares for her students both inside and outside of class hours.

Safe Zone training program. amazing resource to meet other allies and members of the LGBTQ+ community educators on campus. grades very easily except on final reflective paper, where you should pay attention to grammar. has students pick textbooks and facilitate program. so supportive for tough circumstances

tags: ['Tough grader', 'Get ready to read', 'Gives good feedback']
comment: showstopping, incredible, amazing. great feedback, but harshest grader i've had. 12 page paper for final, but you'll be well prepared. uplifts student voices and perspectives. based on in class discussions, but easy to make up with special assignments

She is a DOLL. So sweet, but make sure you participate- it is a participation/convo-based class. It was all online this semester, so things were a bit different but she was still a rockstar. Get all of the texts she asks you to get because they will be used for class. Her quizzes are easy and essays are fair and never too long or tedious.

Prof. Rutowski genuinely loves teaching, and it's plain to see. Her (online) classes were enjoyable and I genuinely felt regret if I missed any for a reason. The work she assigns is complimentary to each other and makes sense, though for this specific course, was pretty depressing at first. I recommend her if she continues teaching WGST classes

I am currently taking two classes with this professor and she is' awesome. She doesn't just ramble on and on like many other professors. She connects with her students and os very understanding. We also get a break during our hour and 45 min class which isn't required to have a break.

This Fem&Porn course contains A LOT of reading assignments, and the class only consists of discussions. She tends to interrupt while students are speaking to interject her viewpoints. The papers are comparable to a 300 level (challenging criteria, very conceptual). She is passionate and nice, but I wouldn't recommend. Too challenging to enjoy.

I had taken her for humn as a soph, and after all I heard about how hard HUMN is, I was delightfully surprised with her class. She is insanely caring, funny, and will help you if you need it. Beware, there are quizes every day but if you read and take some notes they are easy As each time. Only two papers and one final. I absolutely loved her!

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: Far too harsh of a grader, even after seeing her about one of the papers I still received a bad grade. There is a quiz EVERY DAY- if you skip class your grade will drop every day as you will receive a 0 on a quiz. Quizzes are so difficult that even after reading the books I didn't know the answers. No extra credit.A good person but not a good prof.

Not an "easy A" for sure, but hands down the most influential professor and class I've ever taken. You read, you'll do fine. Tips: GO TO CLASS and take good notes and mark down page numbers when she says them to refer back to

An unreasonable amount of reading, even for an English class. The class was discussion based, but her questions didn't facilitate interesting discussions and she often rushed through people's explanations. She's helpful for the writing process, but her grading criteria is very unclear and seemed somewhat subjective

I'd say Professor Rutkowski is easily one of the best professors to take if you're new to the major (or just want a cool lens to look at 19th century literature through). Interested in queer/gender theory? You'll Iove any of the classes she teaches. Overall, a fun and laid back classroom experience. She wants you to get an A.

She's pretty fair but if class discussion isn't up to her standards, she gets really angry. She is a harsh but fair grader, and I didn't realize how hard the grading would be based on how easy everything else is. The readings are insane. 200+ pages sometimes between classes and forum postings have to be done way before class, which makes you rush.

Great teacher. She is very knowledgable and loves what she does. There are several readings throughout the course, but most of them are very interesting. It is a discussion class, so participation is graded. There are also weekly forum postings, but she lets you miss 2 of them. She is very helpful is asked and overall a great person.

She get's really into all the texts and she is a tough grader. Make sure you have someone check over your work before handing in anything. The class is very interesting but majority of the readings are really dry!!!

Professor Rutkowski's "Voices and Perspectives" class was a very interesting class to attend, being based exclusively on discussion, the best way to study Literature. Her grading was never clear though, and papers were tough to do very well on. Aside from that, she gave simple reading quizzes and one group project (also tough grading).
The class itself is wonderful- great discussion, and Prof. Rutkowski is so fun and interesting. It is hard to get As on her papers though, and she's never totally clear on what you did wrong

Do not take an Alice Rutowski class... shes one of those teachers who gives you a bad grade if your work doesnt reflect her thoughts/opinions on a topic. One of the worst classes I took at Geneseo in my four years. AVOID HER AT ALL COSTS

I love Alice Rutkowski. She always has an incredible amount of energy; sometimes it's even hard to keep up. The class discussions are always really interesting and engaging, although because everyone has so much to say, sometimes she will call on the next person on the very tail end of your comment. It's very fast-paced. The reading isn't too bad.

Professor Rutkowski is very passionate about what she teaches and it come across in the way she teaches it. Class was entirely discussion based and you didn't have to talk but your grade would suffer if you didn't occasionally chip in. She makes the class fun and doesn't mind going off topic a bit. She does require a lot of reading though.

Prof. Rutkowski is extremely nice. Class went quick for an hour and a half and the readings very actually interesting. She treats the class as an equal discussion and interjects with her own points. Worth it.

She's great. The class is really interesting but easy to fall behind in the reading. It seems like those in the class that don't read can do pretty well in the long run. I read for every class and she keeps the class very interesting. I'd take her for Humn but it's too early in the morning for me.

A nice lady but arrogant and somewhat self-centered. Class consists mostly of discussion; she interrupts often and doesn't let students finish their thoughts. Unnecessarily hard grading. She didn't make Thoreau, Hawthorne and Emerson interesting.

Alice is extremely helpful in and outside the classroom.  she is tough dont get me wrong but you can go to her anytime for help and she will work with you until you understand or are on the right track.  The class is fun with lots of discussion. Not very tough to go to class though as she is gorgeous.  If the question is hot or not..  HOT

We read a lot and class was mostly discussion- don't expect her to just talk to you. Very friendly, very approachable and helpful during office hours. She grades tough on papers, but why shouldn't we have to work hard for our grades?

Energetic lady, but I'm not entirely sure what I learned in her class. We read weird/bad books, the meaning of which she never explained to us. Encouraged class discussions, but cut people off mid-sentence... Doesn't explain expectations clearly and grades unnecessarily hard. Pretty fun to be in class, though.

When I switched to the English department, I got her for an advisor. She really helped me straighten out the path in which I will achieve my goals. Very helpful. I'll also get her for a class next semester, and I'm thrilled about it!
Amazing I learned lots of stuff... The end of the class you view movies and her choices were awesome! if you can take a class with her do it!
Co taught the class. Very helpful and easy to listen to. she is very hot...very easy to go to class see such a beauty
She is awesome, totally makes you look at things from a different perspective.  Stay involved in the class, it's easy to get lost, but she's always helpful with understanding.
No Comments

She rocks, plain and simple. You have to talk to get a good grade and her paper grading is a little tough, but she is so much fun. You will like class with her trust me, especially 237 but she was good in 330 and 235 as well.

VERY BORING CLASS. Seems like she has us do groupwork as a way for her to get out of actually trying to get people to talk. Kind of a hard grader and assigns a RIDICULOUS AMOUNT OF READING. Plus, no one ever seemed to really want to really talk about Melville--even Rutkowski--but who can blame her?
Alice is very helpful outside of class.  I really enjoyed going to each class.
Has a great teaching style where she doesn't just lecture the whole time, thought the small group discussions are often boring. Lots of little stupid quizzes but overall really kickass Prof

Rutkowski is definitely one of my favorite professors at Geneseo.She's not easy but she is so energetic that you can't help but get involved. She is very easy to relate to and is always willing to help students out. also, she is quirky and fun!

The discussion is one of the best parts of the class. Her syllabus even says if the discussion is superficial that you should redirect it. She's a great teacher and her grading is not easy, but in no way is it terribly hard. I recommend her class.

Discussion oriented class, you will not get much out of it if you don't talk.  Hard grader, unreasonably so as I recall but it gets easier once you know what she wants.  I probably won't take her again but only because I enjoy some of the other English teachers at Geneseo so much more.
She cotaught my Humn class. It was horrible. She is a hard grader and boring teacher.
I had her for American Lit and Humanities, she lays things out clearly, there are no surprises in her class.  Excellent teaching style.

Her grading is too tough for a professor that does not teach anything. She assumes that students know what she is talking about and never makes completely clear what she wants from assignments. When "tired" she decides to do unstimulating group
ugghh... she is way too bent on "creative teaching" and class discussion.. but she is a nice lady. Her grading is a little too tough and she is unclear with what she wants.

Did not find the class to be well-organized or very structured. All writing assignments were extremely dull, and always strictly analysis, not leaving much room for any creative expression.  Teacher is nice, but I didn't learn much.
Discussions of the texts are usually superficial. The group presentations are always boring.

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: Professor Dedes is a good teacher but gives out way too much work. Easy to get a good grade if you complete all the assignment and participate. The only reason I wouldn't take again is because of the unnecessary workload he gives.

She's a really great professor and she's very passionate about her work, but she expects you to know an insane amount. She's an easy grader but assigns so much work that takes forever. Says something should take an hour but it actually takes 3. Just prepare for complex assignments, especially if you miss class you have to make it up.

Had Dr. Gerringer for Marine & she was amazing. Lectures were engaging & encouraged conversation with classmates and her. She's an expert in her field & will try to make information as accessible as possible.Tests were lecture dependent and a combo of short/long answers. But her classes make you want to study if that makes sense
I love professor gerringer, best professor at geneseo
I took marine biology with her. She is super passionate about her work and passes that on to her students! Makes hard topics very approachable

Dr. Gerringer has been nothing but an amazing professor this past semester. She really cares about you and your mental well being, while also being a supportive, and caring professor. There will never be any pop quizzes or anything that wasn't taught on exams, and she will always give a clear criteria of what will be on exams. Amazing professor.
She's amazing! She really cares about her students well-being and it shows. Grades a little tough, but it's expected for an easy bio class. I wish more professors were like her :')
Best Bio prof the school has.

A phenomenal professor--very knowledgeable, thoughtful, and caring. She goes out of her way to help and support her students. She made the class very applicable and it made me realize just how important science communication is in the real world. She also incorporates current events and issues into the class discussion, which is so important. 10/10

Dr. Hartman was fantastic. You learn a lot about effective ways to critique research. There are weekly papers but they are only 1-2 pages and can be on a topic you choose for the semester. There are classes every night for summer sessions but they are only an hour and are helpful for getting tips on what to look for in your research articles!

Dr. Hartman is an incredibly kind man. I always felt comfortable in his class and I knew that I could ask him any questions that I may have had. He grades very fairly, and never asks too much of his students. His class was informative and very much student led, which I loved. I learned a lot through doing the research myself and he is encouraging,

Had him for both 215 and 216. Class can be long and tedious as he just talks about the power points. Gives a 15 minute break which really helps. In 216 we did a lot of in class assignments but never got any credit for it. Tests are relatively easy. Nice to find out the grade right away if you choose to. Good if you don't mind 2.5 hours at night.
Really easy. If you didn't do well on the tests he allows you to do a paper (A LONG PAPER) but it'll replace your grade. He's really easy to talk to and he's available when you need him.

I hated his class. Participation is expected and whenever you answer a question he has follow up questions and continues to press on you making you feel stupid. I am an english major and did terrible on his essays. His expectations are way too high! I was super hard working and almost didn't pass. Take this class with another professor!!

A literal angel on this earth made me very passionate about byzantine history and reignited my love for history. Reading is important, but the passages aren't long and they are interesting! Was extremely understanding with COVID and is generally extremely helpful. Always go to him before tests to make sure you are on the right track.

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Graded by few things']
comment: Dr. Brubaker isn't the kind of teacher to half-ass anything. Be ready to show up to class, read the sources, and discuss them. If you're confused, reach out to Dr. Brubaker and you'll be met with a helpful, thoughtful discussion of the material. I left class every day feeling that I'd learned something new. Not every class is that rewarding.

Dr. Brubaker is a great professor and a fun guy. Lectures and thorough and interesting. He is always happy to help and wants you to succeed but you do have to work. Attendance and participation are super important to getting everything you can out of the class. I learned a lot and would do it again.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read', 'Participation matters']
comment: Dr. Brubakers HUMN was well worth my time. Papers are a challenge but they force you to think critically and do some research. Office hours are worth their weight in gold!! Participation is key so talk every day, read closely, and make connections to the world today and you will come out a deeper individual. A great challenge for any student!!

Professor Brubaker does not give out easy As, but if you work hard it is 100% achievable! He encourages students to see him in office hours and ask questions so that is definitely something to take advantage of. Writing an essay in his class is tough, but it was the most valuable learning experience of the entire year for me!

Worst professor I've had at genny so far. He has such ridiculous standards for his students and if he doesn't like you, you won't do well. This is by far the hardest class I've taken here, which it shouldn't be. I enjoyed the subject matter but he was mean in and out of class. I went to every class but didn't participate so my grade tanked. RUN

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read', 'Participation matters']
comment: We learn through reading but it's not too overwhelming. There are quizzes but only 2 of them count towards your grade. Participation in class is mandatory and he is specific. He will reward hard workers so put in the effort! It will be worth it. He never asks us questions we don't already know the answer to and always has us thinking critically!

tags: ['Participation matters', 'Graded by few things', 'Beware of pop quizzes']
comment: This class was a tough class. He expects a lot of participation (20% of your grade!) so you need to do the readings and be ready to discuss in class. There are 2 exams and a research paper. Many pop quizzes over the semester, only counts 2 of them. Basically as long as you put hard work and effort in, you should get a good grade. Pretty cool guy.

Upon finishing taking this class i can easily say that the material covered was fascinating to learn about, thought provoking, and taught in a manner that made participation easy and fun when it came to class discussions. The written assignments for this class were manageable, and Brubaker was always accessible when it came to giving feedback.

One of the worst professors I have ever had. He taught three class periods all semester, choosing instead to take the easy way out by making his students teach material we were expecting to learn, not have to teach. Class is 100% discussion without lecture which is crazy. He's not a nice dude and is overly harsh in grading papers. DON'T TAKE HIM.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Beware of pop quizzes']
comment: Brubaker's a great guy definitely. Really difficult course material and very high expectations. Expects a lot of participation, several readings and a lot of memorization. Not a compliant grader, will not take any answer that deviates from what he wants to see during tests. Will talk with you, but doesn't offer much genuine support. Good Luck!

Dr. Brubaker is the best professor at Geneseo! If you participate in class and show him you are putting in the effort you will do amazing in his classes. My best advice would be to go to his office hours to have him look over your essay or outline. He will go over the essay with you and substantially improve your writing skills! I highly recommend!

tags: ['Accessible outside class', 'Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: Brubaker requires a lot of participation from every student. He won't ask you anything you don't know, but he does expect a lot of class discussion. He gives the readings ahead of time and there are pop quizzes on the material. Only 2 quiz grades count towards your average. He doesn't give any hw (just readings) and he offers lots of extra credit.

Professor Brubaker takes a boring gen ed requirement and makes it fun. You will have to put effort in for this class but if you attend class, do the readings, and participate youll do fine. The essays are a challenge but Professor Brubaker is more than willing to help during his office hours, make sure you get your draft reviewed before turning in

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: If you don't participate you will not do well. I never missed class but did terribly because of participation. He is super biased while grading. Not a bad teacher just make sure he likes you or you will not do well.

Easily one of the best professors I've had at Geneseo. He's very passionate about the material and teaches in a way that allows students to come to their own conclusions on the readings. He made a boring class really interesting and I always looked forward to going to class! Its a challenging but rewarding class.

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: Brubaker is a really nice guy and on a personal level I really liked him! But in terms of humananities he's a bad teacher and does not outline correctly what he would like you to say.
i really appreciate the guy. he is kind and connects well with the class. he obviously loves what he does so that a plus. i would recommend him.

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: Group discussions on readings 99.9% of classes- you have to speak or you don't get credit-even if youre active listening, taking notes, etc. If you speak and it wasn't exactly what he wanted to hear, he makes you feel stupid. Get ready to blow all your $$$ fast from all the readings (16+) you need to print out all the time. The worst professor

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES', 'ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS']
comment: He is a great preofessor in the fact that he extremely passionate on the subjec and great at lecturing. In my personal experience he was able to make his lectures entertaining. His class is hard but you'll leave the class leaving with something whether that be knowledge on the topic (i.e Byzantine History) or learning how to write.
I really like the guy on a personal level, but his expectations are RIDICULOUSLY high. I would not recommend him to a friend.

Dr. Brubaker is a really nice guy, but unfortunately he has trouble conveying his lessons across. His expectations for our essays were extremely vague and myself and many others did not know what was expected of us. I would not take him again and I advise others not to take his humanities class.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read', 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: Dr. Brubaker made a boring INTD105 topic fun. His lectures are great! Only three main papers, some in-class writing and a lot of group discussion which requires participation. He appreciates when you speak up in class!

Great Professor, knowledgeable of the subject. Participation matters between participation and quizes you can get an easy 40% of your grade maxed out. He is accessable in office hours and will accomedate a student if they have a conflict with the hours. If a student works a normal amount you can get an easy B, youll have to put in more for an A

Great Proffesor, I have taken two classes now. Dr. Brubaker knows the topics he discusses. If someone were to take time to go to offoce hours and work on issues they have the student will be successful.
Great class. 10/10

Good luck getting and email back fast or at all. She does pop quizzes but they are open note. If you pay attention in class you don't need the book. Her lectures are boring and repetitive. She does group work. After 2 absences your grade goes down half a letter each class you miss. Don't get caught on your phone. Don't take her if you don't have to

Class was very easy I never needed to study heavily and tests were easy. Attendance was mandatory and she starts dropping your grade after you miss two classes. She does group work and pop quizzes but they are open note. Good luck on trying to get an email response from her.

Professor Quick is a very sweet person. She is obviously new to teaching, so it is hard to pay attention at times. This class is easy if you attend and participate, but be warned, she only lets you have 2 absences and drops your grade by one letter every time you miss an additional class which is kinda absurd.
Classes were mandatory and people would be penalized for not being there, even though they are quite redundant lectures. Myself and others felt like our time was wasted.

Mostly a lecture. She is very nice but her attendance policy can really hurt your grade. She takes half a letter grade off per absence & only gives 2 free days. Forces everyone to participate in answering questions & group activities for attendance credit. Gives pop quizzes but they are open note & easy exams. Takes forever to respond to emails.
super easy class but if you miss more than 3 classes she starts dropping your final grade by half a letter for each additional absence. hit or miss on if she'll respond fast to your emails as well.

i truly could go on and on about how amazing professor house is. as a student who struggled with math in high school i found his teaching style very easy to understand and scored very well on all tests. he is such a kind human being and wants each and every student to succeed. he is very accommodating and will do everything he can to help you pass!

Where to begin with Don House. He is by far the best professor I've had while attending Suny Geneseo. He makes class engaging and fun while learning math which is a tough subject for most. He cares about his students and does anything he can to accommodate them with whatever they may need. If you can take a class with him I 100% recommend.

I failed math 140 last semester with a different teacher, and I got a 97 this semester with House. He was honestly the best professor I've had so far here at Geneseo. I absolutely love him. He is so understanding and always there to help you out. I was always excited to come to class. Would 10/10 recommend.

House loves what he does and it shows. He knows what he is talking about and always has different ways of explaining concepts. Going to office hours helps if you are struggling, and it is useful to go to get points back on quizzes/tests; helps in the long run. Hardly any homework and all quizzes/tests were fair. Don't be scared to participate!

Donald House is incredible and I highly recommend him. After failing math 140 with Jeff Johanes, I took House's 140 and got a C in the class. In 141 I utilized office hours much more and got an A. He does test corrections in office hours and you get some points back, and if your grade is 90 or above (typically), you don't have to take the final.

As a transfer student, I'm struggling since it's clear he taught his math 140 class things I didn't learn in my equivalent and I was expected to understand them right away. Review sessions are kinda pointless since it may or may not reflect the actual quiz, and puts things on the quiz we might have spent a single day on. Just a huge headache.

After having a bad experience taking 140 with a different prof. I retook the class with house and had a great experience. I've always struggled in math but he always made sure to let me know that I was doing well which really motivated me. I cannot recommend him enough and I look forward to taking 141 with him.

House is awesome. Hardly any homework, practice sheets here and there, but not graded. Go to review sessions- reviews are nearly identical to quiz. He will give you points back on quizzes/tests if you go to office hours, it helps a lot! He is very funny. Participate in class whenever you can. I learned so much from him. Taking 141 with him next sem

By far my favorite professor. House cares about his students and will do his best to help you succeed. There is no mandatory homework, five quizzes, and two hourly's. If you go to the TA sessions they are basically replicas of the quizzes and House's office hours are so helpful. If you go to every class and put in effort the class is an easy A.

Professor House is one of the best professors that i've had. He is extremely passionate about teaching and he cares about his students. He is willing to explain something to you a bunch of different ways until you understand. I will be taking his Math 141 class and I can't wait. I absolutely recommend taking Math 140 with him.

Such a good professor, just don't go on your phone(he hates it). His class is very manageable, no homework, a quiz about every other week, 3 hourly's and if you go to his TI's review sessions its a perfect replica of the actual quiz. If you struggle just go to his office hours, but overall he's such a good professor.

Professor House is one of my favorite professors at Geneseo. He always took the time to make sure everyone understood the topic and always offered to review. He related his lectures to real-life teaching scenarios. The tests and quizzes were fairly easy and required little to no studying. If you show up and pay attention you'll pass with an A.

One of the best professors at Geneseo hands down! Professor House, despite the class being online, did a great job teaching Math 141. He was very funny, cares about his students and learning the material, and only gave a few quizzes, in which we could work with others. A great professor and highly recommend taking his class!!

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: Professor Hwang a great and funny teacher. There's a quiz every class and you have to read before, but they're easy if you read. Tests are short answer and he gives you the questions before. If you read the material and study for the quizzes, you'll do well

Dr. Hwang is a great professor. The way the class is designed is very clear and helpful when preparing for exams. For each chapter you take a quiz on the reading, he lectures and the next class is an activity on the topic. Then you have the exam which is short answer but he gives you the prompts beforehand to prep for it.

Overall, Dr. Hwang is a good guy. His class was extremely organized and well-explained. If you know the vocab from the chapters, you'll get an A on all of the weekly quizzes. His exams aren't bad either, you know exactly what to study. However, the policy project was extremely vague and left a lot of confusion. In general, if you show up  A.

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: He's so sweet and such a nice guy. He really listens to his students and tries to get feedback from them. Also, he's very lenient as he will drop a lot of quiz and participation grades.

Such a good professor. He's great at answering any questions you may have. There's a short 10 question quiz almost every class and 3 exams in total. He has an accent which can be hard to understand at times but he's always willing to clarify whatever you don't understand.

Honestly one of my favorite professors at Geneseo. I failed psych100 since the class was not taught well, but with Dr. Hwang for psych 216 I'm passing with a good average. He is very fun and relatable and wants everyone to do well. All you have to do is skim the chapters and show up to class for the easiest A you will recieve
Literally my favorite professor Ive had here at Geneseo, always willing to help if youre confused and sets the class up for you to do well

Woosang has an accent, but don't let that intimidate you! He tries very hard to relate to his students and present things in a way that makes you understand. Also, don't give any eye contact or he WILL call on you in class :)

Amazing person, not necessarily a good teacher. He would put up slides with questions/chemistry related equations prior to actually explaining them to us, and have us try to figure them out. This would go on for the whole class. If you think you can teach yourself everything go for it, but I couldn't, and the majority of the class got below C.

I would 100% take every class with Barnabas if I could. He is very nice but will also never stop joking around, though he will not always give the best feedback in lab, it is just beause he wants you to be able to figure it out on your own. On the last day of lab he gives an inspirational speech that you will want to listen to.

This lab overall is just a complete mess. Don't bother even trying on the lab reports because they are graded via AI (actual copy and paste) which will mark your answers as incorrect. Ur lucky to get a B on every lab report.
The reports are literally graded with AI, so prepare to get in the B-B+ range on everything, even if it's an A. Instructions to the labs are very unclear.

Barnabas is a great, hilarious guy, but not the best teacher. Lectures start simple but get messy as the material gets harder. They feel more like reviews than actual teaching, so homework and asking him questions directly are key. Exams are also very difficult.

Barnabas is a fantastic lab professor. When asking him a question his responses and be vague and a little riddle-like. You will do fantastic in the lab if you read over the lab prior to performing it. I highly recommend Barnabas. Barnabas does not grade labs.

I LOVE BARNABAS!! He was the perfect first chem lab professor for me.  He'll make fun of you if you're not a chem/biochem major but it's all in good fun and he really loves seeing his students succeed and discover their potential. If he likes you enough, he'll give you a nickname.  To get on his good side, tell him you love golfing and steaks.

he's a great prof and wants to see u do well, but some people don't like the way he talks to students. he makes some "mean" jokes but he can take a joke right back so i didn't really see it as genuinely rude, he just likes to laugh with you. always willing to help out tho, if you're taking chem lab take it with barnabas.

He is very funny and always joked around with my friends and me. I took AP Chem, and Chem 2 was all the same material, so it was an easy class for me. You can vote for the exam layout, and I would suggest doing the more math-heavy ones because the should-know questions are more difficult.

Incredible professor!!! Take him for Chem119, he knows the labs like the back of his hand which is super helpful when asking questions. He is very inspirational academically and always willing to help. Although your LAs will do most of the grading you can always go to Barnabas with questions on reports and lab notebook questions. Stay Happy!

Very funny, friendly & good hearted, always teaching random life lessons. Likes to joke around a lot & poke fun, but he's a good prof, lecturer, & helpful in the lab when needed (LA's will mostly help). Reports due after every lab, pre-lab quizzes suck, & the final is based on lab report material.

accent makes him a little hard to understand at times, and sometimes he doesn't explain the greatest, but will make sure you are able to ask any questions if needed, overall good prof and extremely positive. stay happy!!

Barnabas is a very funny yet inspirational professor. He explains the experiments well during the pre-lab lecture but relies on the LAs to answer questions. He really likes organized lab notebooks so start of on a good foot. He has a final for the course that is really hard that tests on the math used in each lab so review that towards the end.
One of the best professors I've ever had! He genuinely cares about his students, always offers help whenever it's needed, and most importantly, he truly believes in you.
Barnabas' "kindheartedness, grace, and patience" helped me "triumph" through these "turbulent and perilous times".  Plant good seeds and you will succeed.  Stay happy, you have incrediable value.

Barnabas is a funny and engaging professor, but he's also a tough grader, especially on lab notebooks. The class can be challenging, but with hard work, office hours, and tools like Unstuck AI, you can succeed. He wants everyone to do well, just don't claim you're not a chem major!

I love Barnabas but some of the pre-lab quizzes were so bad, and grading for labs were a little weird. Also the final... be prepared, everyone has to take it tho. He is a super nice guy tho and the experiences are pretty easy, just find a decent lab partner.

Professor Gikonyo is one of the best chemistry lecture professors. He has a clear grading criteria and attendance is 2% extra credit! His office hours are the most helpful and most engaging. (Go to them if you can) He tells what is going to be on the exam so there's no surprises. Some students might get a nickname but that him just teasing you.
He really is so funny and loves to make connections with the students. I really enjoyed having him but he was a veryyyy strict grader when it came to the lab notebook. Beware.
Barnabas truly made Chem Lab an achievable and enjoyable class. The perfect medium between challenging course work, and support from the professor.
Fantastic professor, lectures are easy to understand and he gives detailed notes. Fair grader and always eager to help students. Whatever they're paying this man it isn't enough.
BEST PROFESSOR EVER... if I could take Barnabas for every class I would. He cares so much about his students and goes out of his way to help. His office hours makes learning fun!

does not teach well and can only get the notes if in class. Doesn't explain things very clearly and when you tell him you don't understand he doesn't help you at all. Also puts up the lowest test scores on the board which I find very disrespectful even if names are not attached.

One of the nicest Professors in Geneseo! He is very understanding if you are not completely grasping the material and will help you understand to the best of his ability. He is picky about lab notebooks being well done and written but other than that hes amazing and extremely helpful #stayhappy
Barnabas is a hysterical professor who makes this horrific class manageable, however, be ready to put in the work and make sure you keep a great notebook. #stayhappy

I have to retake this course because I struggled to understand the labs/ chemistry is not my friend, and even with that, I prefer to retake it with the same teacher. I am a Bio major but to him ill always be communications, and if ur anything but a chem major you'll probably also be in that boat haha. he teases but just knows he's joking.

LOVE Barnabas! Gen Chem lab is hard no doubt, the grading is TOUGH. Wrong sig figs? -5 points each. It will consume a lot of time and energy but go to office hours and talk it out with Barnabas and you will be fine. He will tease you, and don't even think about saying you're not a chem major, but he wants everyone to succeed (a good harvest!)

If you put in the work, you can easily do well in this course with Barnabas. He s a caring professor who only wants to see his students succeed in every single lab. I HIGHLY recommend going to see him during office hours to check over lab reports and ask questions, it is extremely helpful and a main reason I did well in this class. I love Barnabas.

I honestly love this man to death! He's hilarious and definitely motivational. I only took him for lab, but I love coming to this office hours once in a blue to say hi. He honestly cares about his students and wants everyone to succeed. His labs are very clear and all you do is follow directions and hand in labs!

tags: ['Accessible outside class', 'Get ready to read', 'Graded by few things']
comment: You can tell that he genuinely wants his students to succeed but his instructions for everything are almost impossible to comprehend

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Gives good feedback', 'Caring']
comment: Professor B really cared if we passed. He gives you as many chances as he can to give you as much credit as possible. If you couldnt show up to lab he would provide a video to use for the experiment. The lab notebooks we used were easy to understand and easy to complete. Make sure you study for the lab quizzes and use those to study for the final.

I loved him hes very student friendly and offers many office hours. For covid if he missed in person class he would send the video of the lab. Hes very understanding would recommend him for lab. And he explains the lab well!

Barnabas makes the 4 hour long lab enjoyable. As long as you attend his office hours to check on your lab work, you will do well in the class. He is very accessable and answers emails quickly as well. Graded on a bell curve, so only a few students get an A. Make sure to keep up with your lab notebook as well. Definitley recommend for Chem 119 lab.

He makes chem labs actually fun, he doesn't mind repeating directions or working with students outside of class. However, prelab quizzes are extremely hard and will bring down your grade. In class labs are easy as long as you pay attention, and while he is a hard grader, if you put in effort it will pay off. Expect to get a nickname in his class!

Barnabas is an amazing professor. He's funny and has a lot of patience with his students. Although the lab was hard, he made every moment of it bearable. I would definitely take him again in a heartbeat!

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'SO MANY PAPERS']
comment: He's a really nice person. But General chem Lab is literally rigged to fail pre-bio freshmen. It's also really unorganized and you get taught the content.
He's an amazing professor and he gives you what you need to succeed in later classes. A definite gem for incoming freshman. Just beware not to get stuck with a bad nickname.

Barnabas is one of my favorite professors. I took someone else first semester and then switched to Barnabas for gen chem 2 and got a better grade. Going to his office hours are KEY. His office hours are always full but he is the funniest and most caring. He will give you lots of practice problems if you ask, and he has old exams you can practice!

He's funny and also a great professor! He likes to joke a lot but in a good way that it makes class entertaining. Tests are easy if you study for it. No tricks. Office hours are helpful. Took him for lab and lecture. Tried to convince me to switch to chemistry but not my thing haha! Definitely a true gem in Geneseo and I'm glad to met have him.

Some people dislike his teasing but that is not enough to discount his unwavering care for his students. He Will work with you so you learn the material and believes that no matter how low youre score is in the class, if you put in the work, he will help you suceed. He is the most inspiring professor and Is one of the best at This college
