Good professor, but her exams are kind of ridiculous. There is so much material for this course that it is quite a pain. Not all the questions are straight forward. Tried making flashcards for an exam and there were about 200.

Dr. Storms is awesome! I learned so much from her. Lectures are interesting. She is a practicing therapist so we get to hear about real life examples. Highly recommend Dr. Storms! Can't wait to take her again next semester!

Professor Storms is awesome. She is a very fair grader. Her lectures are very interesting and she makes them easy to listen to. She is practicing so she tells stories of her patients. Take her class!!

Interesting class. Storms is a good teacher. She is also a practicing clinical psychologist so she shares lots of stories about her clients. four tests-can be tricky, but they're not bad. journal entries reflecting on material are also due on test days-one per week. quizzes on each chapter but not bad if you do readings and study definitions!

Very clear professor. MC on tests are easy, fill-in-the-blanks surprisingly difficult. Go to class, study all the terms and you'll do fine. Very helpful outside of class, easy grader on the paper. Got an A- with some work.

Storms is the nicest lady ever. Her class was very straight forward. Go to class, take good notes, read the specific sections in the book she tells you to before exams and you will be fine. Shes picky on fill in the blanks on exams but the rest of the questions are MC and the project and the paper are extremely easy.  Definitely recommend her.

Storms grades much easier than some of the other Psych professors. There are 4 tests, a presentation and a paper. As long as you read the textbook before class, and take notes during the lecture you should be able to be an A or high B.

Don't bother asking questions, she will give you an annoyed answer for interrupting her lecture. Doesn't like to admit when an exam question is wrong, even when she contradicts it in lecture. Take it with someone else who isn't just teaching for extra money

Storms is very clear when it comes to her notes. Everything you learn from class is from the textbook but you should still attend because her notes are very verbatim to her test questions. I learned a lot in this class, & there were many interesting topics covered. Overall though, she can be a hard grader & tends to ask specific questions on tests
Amazing professor! I took an 8:30 class was her but she made getting up early worth it. Kept class interesting, funny, really nice. Tests aren't hard if you study for a couple hours. Take her class!

Doesn't post syllabus online. Tests are very specific. Grading for papers is odd. You shouldn't get a grade worse than a B- if you go to every class and study though. I can see how getting an A would be really hard
Storms is a very nice teacher. She makes it easy to do well as long as you study a little for the exams and quizzes. Her papers are very very easy. You should take this class.

Storms is an amazing professor!!!  I loved the class and if you read the textbook and do the work, you'll get an A.  She lets you drop your two lowest quiz grades and your lowest test grade, which definitely helps.  There's a lot of material covered, but she makes it fun and interesting.

Her classes are helpful but a lot of information needs to cover. Quizs are likely once a week and fairly easy if you read the book percisely. Exams are a little hard, but if you study hard and read the textbook over and over, it should be okay for you. Other than the exams, her class is helpful and useful.

Really nice and very easy to understand. Although going to class is pretty mandatory (quizzes at the beginning and journal entries due) she makes it fun and interesting. Her quizzes and tests are not difficult if you read the book and she drops one test grade so it is okay if you do badly on one. TAKE THIS CLASS!
Shes really nice and really easy. Take classes with her

Simply put, this class is a joke! It is a guaranteed A!!! She basically gives you the answers to the quizzes, and the final exam is take home. The one paper is five pages, but she even tells you that she gives everyone an A. So easy.
LOVED the class. LOVED the teacher. highly recommend taking a class with her. she kept the class interesting and she was very entertaining!

LOVED this teacher. i took her for abnormal and child development and it was the easiest A's i've ever received...but at the same time i feel like i learned so much from her. she's really bubbly and absent-minded, but that just makes her all the more entertaining. if you have the option of taking a class with her, definitely take it.
the bomb. easy, and nicest lady ever.

Professor Storms was an extremely good teacher. Her Psyc 260 class was the easiest class I have taken at Geneseo. She is very accomidating to any issues you may have and her quizzes and tests are fair and pretty easy if you pay attention in class.
No Comments

I took abnormal psych with Professor Storms, and it was one of the easiest classes I've EVER taken. She is a VERY nice woman, EASY TESTS, and as long as you read the chapters in the text you will do wonderfully. Highly recommended to anyone who wants an easy A and entertainment.

He was a fairly good teacher, although he had a heavy accent, that didn't discredit his ability much. He would be happy every time he was in class and if you spoke to him at least a few times after class or for office hours, he'd just be happy to see you in class. The hate for him isn't warranted. He was a fairly good teacher if you took your time.

Professor Yan is smart and kind. He is more than willing to help students but will not just give you the answers, which I think many students see as annoying and unhelpful. Not only does he repeat concepts as many times as needed, he also provides many chances for students to earn points back on the HW and final. If you try, you will pass easily.
He will randomly call on you and laugh in your face. Avoid him at all costs. Class is dreadfull.

In my opinion, Prof Yan was not as bad as his ratings. This class is all Excel based, and if you pay attention to the in class exercises, it'll be so much easier to do your homework. I found the excel formulas more important than most of the content. Heavy accent, and he will cold call on people.

Paul is a very intelligent man lacks the skill to rub his knowledge off onto others. His lectures have no structure and he is constantly all over the place. If you ask a question in class, he will never give you a clear answer, probably just restate your question and then disagree with something then continue on to something else completely new.

From the other two responses, I can agree to some extent that the professor doesn't teach as great. However, compared to other DANL-100 professors he teaches his class through physical learning using actual coding rather than reading and memorizing. IF you wish to learn how to properly program then Paul Yang is the man.

Taken in Fall 2021.
Does not explain the material and will make comments, if your question in class. 
Was not helpful during Office Hours.
Heavy accent.
Utilize Tutor, instead of professor

tags: ['Lots of homework', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Tough grader']
comment: not a good professor. will not answer your question but he does know his stuff. doesn't explain it well at all

Does not teach or answer questions. I learned nothing from this course with him. This is a 100 level class taught as a 500 level. We are beginners learning coding and he expects us to be at his level.
Not an enjoyable experience to say the least. He does care though which is nice but don't take his class if you don't have to

Awful. He has a very thick accent and at times struggles to find the correct word. He is quite literally the worst teacher I have had in my entire life. Make no mistake about it, Professor Yan is very intelligent, he just does not possess the ability to teach people in any capacity whatsoever. Messes up grading so check if he graded correctly

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Graded by few things', 'Tough grader']
comment: The only reason I gave this man a 2 and not a 1 is that I think he does care for his students. He's just so incredibly bad at teaching. He will come up to you and ask you questions that you probably don't know the answers to. Homeworks are challenging and if you ask for help he just restates the question. Zooms don't work, and he won't fix them.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Lecture heavy', 'Tough grader']
comment: I take this class online through zoom and he doesn't put the sound on so you don't know what's going on. Save yourself

In all honesty, this prof has a very heavy accent which makes him hard to understand. His lectures are all over the place, and nothing he "teaches" ever seems to have a goal. No one ever really knows what he's talking about and he is available for office hours, but it has never really helped me understand any of the topics he discusses.

Speeds through all of the programming within the course and does not explain it at all. Assumes that students have knowledge of programming prior to entering the course and assumes that students could not pass high school math. Spends time explaining how to substitute a variable into a math formula opposed to how to write code or answer questions.

First time this class was offered so everyone was figuring out what is entails. We spent most of our time playing games and learning about cultural communication. Not a lot of outside work. One group project at the end of the semester where you facilitate a game for the rest of the class. Very easy class. Would take her classes again

terrible, made a 100 class awful, much harder than it had to be. Took points off of grades for her own mistakes, never gave clear instructions, not reachable outside of class, makes her TAs do all the work for her. Lectures consist of her reading the textbook, which we already had to read for homework, so class feels extremely boring/repetitive.

Tons of quizzes and discussion posts, based off a chapter from textbook each week. Quizzes are easy and at home, so textbook can be used even though it is timed. Attendance is mandatory, but TA's are the ones taking attendance. Lectures are boring and serve 0 purpose if you are only in the class for credit. Little guidance on final paper, use TA's.

I actually took XLRN-150 with her as an elective, but class wasn't available to click on here. Wouldn't recommend this class if you're actually trying to learn about identities. In my opinion, she makes everything about race. Which is fine if that's what you're into, but it got very repetitive and took away from learning. A lot of small projects.
shes awesome
HWs are easy, Speech is fine, lectures are boring as most. Overall just an easy A without effort. Professor Watson is caring and fun to talk to.

Dr. Watson is a very nice and easy going professor. However, her lectures got repetitive and boring because she would just read off the slides that were straight from the text book chapter that you read prior to class to do your weekly quiz. Relies on her TAs a lot so don't email her she doesn't always answer. Overall very easy just boring.

Class was super easy. Multiple assignments each week but they're not long or difficult at all, just tedious. Class gets boring and lectures aren't usually necessary, but she tries her best to make it entertaining and genuinely wants to improve as a professor. TAs are first point of contact. Just stay on top of your assignments and you'll do fine.

Watson is pretty hip, but her lectures were very boring. Attendance is mandatory but the content is just regurgitating what you read in the textbook, word for word, I found it hard to keep going after 2 months.The TAs do all the student interaction, very odd for Geneseo professors to stand back, but she did supply the text for the course online.

Dr Gonder has been one of the best, and most supportive professors I have encountered in my academic career. He is tough because he wants you to learn the material, but he is always willing to help you figure it out if you are willing to put in the work.
Always available for outside class consult. Really wants his students to succeed, so encourages them to complete assignments, and takes them up in class.
Excellent prof

One of my favorite profs at Geneseo. Why? He works even harder than we do - papers always graded by the next class, speaks intelligently, ALWAYS available outside class. He respects the nature of the interaction and his students.

Gonder uses language expertly, always brings materials for use in class, and spends every minute of time working. When I went to consult with him, he was pleasant and helpful. He does have a reputation for dealing strongly with students who cheat, and they are trying to trash him here. I only wish I could have taken more classes with him!

Gonder is a fine prof. I met with him lots outside of class - it was very helpful. One of the few profs that deals with cheaters - I heard one of them say they would trash him on RateMyProfessors. Personally, I think he should do something about cheaters. He is clear, bright, always gives extra materials to help us learn - if we do our own work.

He is absolutely awful. Dr. Gonder is condescending and boring, and will make you hate piano even if you love taking it. You'll find, also, that he does not help struggling students; he simply gets mad at them for asking for help. Dr. Gonder should not be a professor.
Gonder is an outstanding teacher. He works hard and expects you to. Very quick turnaround in assignments. Always accessible outside of class. Tough, but worth it.

As someone with a LOT of musical experience, this class was a lot less rough than it certainly could've been. The lectures are incredibly dry and boring and the homework takes forever, just the same questions over and over again. The pop song project completely destroyed the class for me though, it's a huge pain. Do NOT take for gen. ed. credit.

Professor really does know the content of the material he is teaching. Somewhat enthusiastic. comes off as a jerk at times, & a know it all. Talks in a way that seems like he's talking down to his students. Be on time to class when assignments are due or no credit. Lots of assignments, don't take very long. Learn quick or have lots of background.

Gonder is an excellent professor. A lot of material was covered very quickly in one semester, so I understand why it may be challenging for some, however it was very easy for me as I have previous music experience. He wants us to succeed and always answers questions to the best of his ability. Easy fine arts credit for those with experience.

tags: ['Tough Grader', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: Worst teacher ever, Id rather take 300 organic chem lectures then take this class again.. do not take this elective.

He is awful. Until this point I thought teachers were here to help students. Geneseo is a good school and further employing this man is going to severely hurt their reputation. He goes through immense trouble in order to harm students grades. Most teachers are here to help us do well but I can say with confidence that he is not. DO NOT TAKE CLASS

This man is possibly the worst professor in Geneseo. I have heard many students talk baldy of him and now I have experienced it for myself. I have spoken to the dean about him to which he answered he always hears complaints about him. I question his agenda, if he is here to help students or hurt them. I am appalled that he is still employed. AVOID!

tags: ['Tough Grader', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: He says he doesn't care if you come to class, but he gives you a grade on your attendance. He begins the class at a very basic level, then gets difficult extremely fast.

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: Not invested in students' success

Gonder is very knowledgeable in what he teaches. If you have any basic music "theory" knowledge you could fly through this class. Attendance is not mandatory, but you receive a grade for your participation so you should show up. He is very specific in what he wants when grading but also tells you what he wants.

tags: ['Tough Grader', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: Truly one of the hardest and most tedious classes I have taken in my college career. Expects you to know the material without barely covering in class. The fact that this is a 100 level course blows my mind. Homework takes 1-2 hours minimum and tests are insanely hard. Frustrating that a fine arts gen ed is bringing down my GPA immensely.

If you are looking for an easy 100 level fine art credit, DO NOT take this class. Thought I had musical experience, I was wrong. Loads of homework, and a "Pop Song" group project that is a total hassle. Don't even ask your friends for help on hw, he will accuse you of cheating and reduce your grade. The class avg. for the final was a C for 100level

If you have no music back ground or very little do no take. I did all the homework which is a lot for a 110 class he takes off 10 points if its not stapled correctly and u have to draw every note perfect or else u get points off. His test were impossible when i went to extra help he offered no help. I would spend hours doing the hw got a D.

I've been playing and reading music since I was 7. This class is more about theory than anything else, and even I found it difficult. He is a nice guy and clearly cares about music and his students but he doesnt take excuses. He is a strict grader and his tests are difficult. Take theater if you want an easy a. take this if you want a challenge

Very Difficult Class that is not even basic musicianship. This class is more of music theory. Even having 8 years of musical experience I struggled in this class. Hands out plagiarism charges yearly. (6 this semester.)

Took this class for my fine arts credit.... yea no take intro to theatre or dance if you are looking for an easy A. This class was made much harder than level 100 should be.... I expected a much higher grade because I had history in music yea no too much tedious work. This isn't an easy class, plus it was at 8:30... take dance... just take dance
Easily my least favorite professor I've had. I'd take a class Donald Trump before I'd take another class with Jon Gonder.

I'm pretty intimidated by the guy. You CANNOT show up to class late or be absent on days you hand in homework (which is almost everyday). Or else, you get a zero out of however many points it is worth (up to 300 points). Homework usually takes about 1-2 hours. I was late twice, so I had three 0/100 and had to work my butt to finish off with an A-.

My favorite class of the semester! He's a great guy and jokes around. I loved this class but partially because I already have prior experience in music. If you don't understand material, he's always there to help. Office hours are great! Tests are kinda hard but if you study, you'll do fine.

Great professor. Really knew what he was talking about and could answer any question thrown at him. Might be difficult for people with no music knowledge but he will help you. great class to take for fine arts credit

This class is not for someone without any prior musical knowledge - I did well only because I knew most of the material prior to taking the class. Professor Gonder requires you to come to class and be on time, as well as to submit assignments on time. He's not very lenient. However he clearly knows his subject and was a great teacher.

Although the class is labeled basic musicianship, it is far from basic. The idea that you don't need a music background is false. Worked very hard (3+ hours on some assignments) and still failed. Everyone else I know failed or got a D or C-. Course moves quickly and gets quite complex at the end. Be wary unless you really know music.

Great teacher. If you dont have musical background, this class might not be for you. Hes very easy to understand and very helpful, but music is music and it's very nit-picky. Unless you're super careful you will make careless mistakes. Havent opened the textbook for anything other than the hw assigned so I wish you didn't need to buy it but oh well

He loves what he does; if you do not take the class seriously, he won't reward you with a good grade. But if you put in a little time, or have any musical background coming in, he makes the class fun. Asks participation questions, so attendance is mandatory. But the tests are easy!
Super nice and understanding. Topics were well thought out although videos were often dated. He is a very tough grader for a 100 level class.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Amazing lectures', 'Gives good feedback']
comment: My favorite professor at Geneseo. Classes are a little bit reading-heavy but you can get away with reading a few pages to get the main idea. Makes all of the readings easy to access with pdfs. Imo the lectures are super interesting and he does a great job of keeping everyone engaged. Overall a great guy and great professor. 10/10 would recommend
Gives amazing lectures and I loved going to class. I did feel the grading was a little harsh for a 100 level class but overall love this guy
Tough grader
top 2 best professors of all time wrd bro.

Reece is one of my favorite professors; he genuinely cares about what he's teaching.  There is a required textbook, but it is available as a pdf.  There is a lot of required reading, which is useful for the quizzes/memos.  However, he doesn't exactly check that you've read it.  His office hours should be used.  Only two tests, with a cheat sheet.

Reece is my FAVORITE prof I've EVER had the pleasure of taking a class for. Also took SOCL220 with him. Super approachable, office hours are very helpful, lectures are so engaging and never boring. He made me WANT to learn. I never felt awkward speaking up in class. He truly wants to see you succeed and will help however he can. USE HIS OFFICE HRS!

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Gives good feedback', 'Graded by few things']
comment: Nice guy. Boring class with too much reading
Reece is such an enthusiastic and engaging lecturer. There's something about his presentation that really gets discussion rolling, and with gusto.

I LOVE DR. REECE TORRES. I wish I wasn't graduating so I could take more classes with him. His lectures are engaging so you don't even feel like you're in a class, he truly loves his job and cares about the students, he works with you, wants you to prioritize your well-being, and is super approachable (calls us gang). TAKE THIS CLASS WITH HIM!!!

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Amazing lectures', 'So many papers']
comment: I enjoyed taking Socl 102 with Reece. He wants all of his students to do well. Prepare to read but its very interesting and weekly papers based on class and readings
Great professor, a choice of 3 Essays with 5 different deadlines and a midterm and final. ; Overall I learned a lot and would recommend the class to anyone interested in sociology and psychology.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Clear grading criteria', 'Gives good feedback']
comment: Torres is hands down the best professor I have ever taken at Geneseo. He is very clear about what you need to do to succeed in his class and is very accessible in helping you get there. He is willing to go above and beyond to ensure you understand the content and feel confident in your work. Overall, a real asset to the sociology department
Really really enjoyed this class- the lectures were really engaging and the tests were very approachable.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Gives good feedback']
comment: Reece is an amazing professor! He's very passionate about what he teaches and is very adamant about matching your energy in class, so don't be afraid to participate! The assigned readings were lengthy and the summaries due at the end of every class were sometimes difficult to complete, but Reece gives great feedback on papers and summaries.

I really enjoyed this course. It is a lot of reading, but he gives us assignments that will help write the paper at the end. He makes the course very interesting an engaging to listen. There are a lot of books you need so i would reccomend getting them free on Z library, they had every book on there.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'So many papers']
comment: Reece is a great professor. Not only was the content itself interesting, but Reece himself made the class fun and always tried to facilitate good discussion. Be prepared to read a lot write a paper after. He's a great professor to go to office hours for, he will "match your energy" and make an effort to look out for you if you start to struggle.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'So many papers']
comment: Reece is very caring and will match your energy, he was also very easy to access outside of class time. If you sent him your draft early enough to, he would look at it and give you feedback to help you better it before you turned it in. Great professor, you can clearly tell he cares. Make the effort to reach out to him and you'll succeed!
amazing professor and very helpful. as long as you read and put in the effort for the class you will do well, and the topics are very interesting.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Gives good feedback', 'So many papers']
comment: His motto is that he will 'match your energy' and he does. After the first memo grade, I thought that I was going to fail the class but after talking to him and learning what he looks for, I got my grade up to an A. If you put in the effort to talk to him, he will give great guidance for how to write your papers. Participation in class is also key

Very valuable lectures that encourage open discussion on heavy topics. Welcomes criticism and opposing arguments with open arms. Very easy to work with in office hours. Makes you form your own thoughts and opinions, come to your own conclusions.

Reece is an incredible professor. He is incredibly caring and is very adamant about 'matching your energy'. He is so passionate about his teaching and gives great feedback on papers. Class discussion and participation is expected, however it is very engaging. Would 100/10 take a course with Reece again!

Bennett is an AMAZING professor! His lectures are interesting, and mandatory to attend if you want an A (bonuses for attendance). 3 exams, 2 papers, and weekly quizzes (ridiculously easy if you read the books). Start the papers early and he will help you with them. Rewards hard work when he sees it. Humn is worth taking with Bennett!
Love your intellect!
Tough grader, read the books!

Bennett is tough but fair. He has some pretty good stories to share and has an overall good outlook on life. Definitely harder than a lot of the other professors, but I cant stress enough what a good person he is.  Take it if you like to read and want to learn about how to put things in perspective.

Bennett is understanding to a point.  If you are upfront and honest he will work with you.  GO TALK TO HIM.  He is super funny, although it can be missed if you are not paying attention.  His lectures can be dry but he has a lot to offer.

This course was far too in-depth for a course mandatory of all Geneseo students, let alone a 200-level.  Bennett is an extremely well-informed professor but gave extremely long and relatively uninspiring lectures with a few hilarious connections to modern life.  I got little out of his teaching style. two 7-9 page papers and three 3-5 pg papers.

Had the PRIVILEGE to take humn with Bennett.  A kind, caring, and hilarious professor who truly cares about his students.  Gets you to think critically and not just merely regurgitate facts.  Yes its a lot of work, but his class is well worth it.

Bennett is a very funny man. He knows the material well and is willing to help you. However, his section is definitely hard. 3 tests(test+essay) and 2 papers. I have no idea how I didn't fail miserably because it's a hard class and he's not exactly easy. The readings are definitely necessary.

Gets you to think about real life and that can not be said about many other professors.  Is a lot of work, but a good grade is possible with work.  If you apply yourself, you will not only find him great but take a lot of the class.

From all the hype I thought this prof was going to be amazing. HE IS NOT! He talked about his ultra conservative views almost daily. He was late getting my papers back to me. If you have to take HUM with him just don't get on his bad side or you'll stay there.

Bennett is a great dude, really funny. I was dreading humn and he always made class enjoyable. I wouldn't really recommend him if you are looking for an easy A as he did require a good amount of work. Random quizzes were the worst but he gives a lot of free points. I'm happy I got to experience a class with Bennett, he is extremely genuine

Bennett the funniest and most genuine professor Ive had. He really makes the class interesting with funny stories and anecdotes. The only thing I didnt like was how long it took to get everything back and how much reading and essays he required compared to other profs. I would recommend taking his class. He really cares about his students.

Excellent teacher. Gives you a lot of perspective on things that you would have not expected to be interesting. Definitely a hard class, especially over the summer, but well worth it. He is by far the best humanities teacher that you will find....just read the books and you should be fine for the tests.
Had Bennett for Hum 1 & 2 and got A's in both. Fair grader, gives extra credit, and wants to help you get a good grade. Plus he's hilarious and his class is always fun/interesting. highly recommend

Prof. Bennett was a fun teacher whose lectures were always entertaining.  The tests weren't too bad if you read the books.  Daily quizzes were hard but they helped considering most of the multiple choice test questions were straight from the quizzes.  Bennett is definitely a great choice for Humn one.

I'm really upset that his hum 2 classes for next semester are filled. Took his first test, got a 96 and he told us that was going to be the hardest exam all year... WHAT? amazing teacher, hilarious, and he makes modern day analogies and really makes it easy to understand. tests are simple straightforward and nothing confusing.

Professor Bennett is a wonderful professor and individual.  Of all the professors I had at Geneseo, he influenced me the most. Genuine.  His lectures can be structured or discussion based.  They are always informative, engaging, and best of all they're funny and entertaining. The content/readings can be difficult but Bennett explained the concepts

BEST LEFT HANDED GINGER!Bennett is great! HE MAKES YOU THINK!  Didn't tell you how or what to think!  Summer Humanities aren't easy courses.  Especially if you have a life outside of college.  Tons of reading, several quizes, a few tests and a couple of papers.  Bennett made crappy boring Humanities INTERESTING.
Great Prof.  Was nervous about taking Hum I and II.  Bennett made it much more interesting that I ever expected!  Fair to all sides.  Fair grader.  HELPFUL.  FUNNY.  One of the best "Gingers!"
Awesome

Always go to class! Classes are interesting, he's a really funny guy, and the notes you take will help you on the exams. If you don't read and use Sparknotes instead, you'll do fine...if you consider a "C" fine. Tests are detailed and random, but he is an easy paper grader and offers extra credit. He's also probably the nicest guy in Geneseo.

Great professor, class discussions are sometimes informative but sometimes just philosophical debates. Attendance isn't absolutely necessary. Tests and quizzes are moderately difficult. Reading is not a must but will help.
Funny dude .. Tests and quizzes are tough .. can get by without reading as long as you participate .. real opinionated .. but funny

I took HUMN One with Bennett over the summer and absolutely loved him. He's a funny guy and, for the most part, keeps class interesting. VERY helpful outside of class and loves to talk about his subject. Tests weren't bad, as long as you listened in class and looked back at the things he stressed. Also gives interesting essays.

I had Edgar for Hum 1 and Bennett for Hum 2. Bennett was far and away the better Hum professor. Entertaining, funny, loved his sense of humor. Tests are far easier than in Edgar's class (Edgar had at least 8+ quotes each test in hum 1). His tests are choose 5 of 8 ID and 3 of 5 quotes or something like that. Good/fair prof. Quiz once/wk but not bad

He's a great guy.  I took both hum classes with him and enjoyed every minute.  He's funny, but in a dry and even self deprecating way.  He's immensely likeable and among my favorite professors at Geneseo.  That being said, his tests are very difficult.  I put up with it because he made two classes I was dreading a lot of fun.

Extremely difficult class, i took humn I with him over the summer (i'm an english major with a 3.8 gpa), and I ended up getting a B in this class because the tests and essays were so arbitrary. You need to spent A LOT OF time reading and rereading the books in order to do well on the test (got a 70 on the first test, 90, and then an 80)

Great guy. Geeky but in a good way. Makes the class really interesting, and helps you out in a big way. I'm taking both summer sessions with him and I couldn't be happier. Just go to class, read the SparkNotes, know how to write an essay, and participate in discussions (which you'll want to do) and you'll get at least a B+ in this class.

Oh my god this guy is a riot!  He's not easy, and knows his stuff, but he goes out of his way to make sure that you're doing what you're doing for the sake of understanding and enjoyment.  He does what he can to make things easier, and his sense of humor is so sharp and subtle!  Totally great!
Not fun
Best Professor I've had at Geneseo so far.  You do a lot of writing but it is not hard at all.  Class can be boring at times, but he is the nicest guy.

She is very nice and cares about her students. She is very helpful during lab. She always answers emails in a timely manner and will be flexible if you need to make up work. I would love to take other classes with her.

The best for BIO222. On top of being very likeable and helpful, she goes out of her way to review quizzes and exams after the fact and offers a couple grade-boosting opportunities. comment: I loved Professor Hutchison! She was a really good teacher. I took this class online (Covid) and the lectures were split among the 3 teachers. I always understood the material she taught best and the videos were 10-15 min pieces which made it easier to focus. She was also super helpful during office hours and very accessible. Definitely recommend!

Dr. Hutchison is the best professor I have had here at Geneseo. She is the kindest person on this campus, and she is always willing to help her students. The class was really interesting. However, her class was the hardest biology course I have ever taken. For perspective, I am taking cell biology now, and it is easier than Genetics.

In lecture she is pretty good, and really explains things. Make sure to go to class since what she discusses in class is not always in the online notes. Her tests are not fair, besides the final, because they rely on process of elimination not an actual understanding of the material. Literally memorize the notes and everything in them to do well.

Dr. Hutchison is an amazing lecturer. She does a good job presenting material in a way that is easy to understand. The class itself is difficult. People complain that she makes you know everything she says but isn't that kind of the point?  There is nothing on the test that she hasn't told you about. Reading not required if you go to class.

Grade only based on 3 tests, quiz and homeworks. Prof Hutchison was one of my favorites though and I'm planning to take micro with her. Her tests are hard but its possible to do well in her class if you read the textbook. She is the best and her lectures are really organized and easy to follow

Had her for both microbiology and genetics.  She expects you to memorize every single detail and if you don't mention every single detail she will take off points.  Very nit picky which makes getting a good grade difficult.

I have not one negative thing I could possibly say about Hutch. She  now my favorite professor! I have achieved goals I never thought I would be able to achieve in the class (I got a 95 on one of her exams) & she makes going to an 8:30 a pleasant experience. She gives topic sheets for every exam so you know exactly what to study. TAKE HER!

I was so sure that I wasn't going to be able to get an A in this class because of how hard the tests were, and how stubborn I was about getting help. However, Dr. Hutchison is the most approachable professor I've ever had at Geneseo! She literally saved me and never made me feel bad for asking really stupid questions. Definitely take her for class!

Professor Hutchison is the best biology professor I have encountered at Geneseo. She cares about her students doing well and gives you all the materials necessary to get an A. She is also very approachable during office hours. She assigns 2 homework per test, but they are very applicable to the material and are helpful when studying.

Dr. Hutchison was an amazing professor and made me love the subject. Genetics is a difficult class no matter who you take it with, so expect to study a lot. She is very helpful in her office hours and review sessions, and is always very friendly and helpful. I would definitely recommend for genetics.

I wouldn't say this class is a walk in the park by any means. You have to study really hard for these exams and there is a ton of material to understand and memorize. Class averages were pretty low and there is no curve. Wonderful woman, genuinely hard class. Don't take it lightly.

Micro with Hutchison was a great course. She is very organized and thorough, and there are usually no surprises on the exams as long as you study the material covered in class. Some of the material can get a little boring, but she does her best to keep you interested and allows for class discussion. She is also very willing to work with students.

She's an AMAZING professor!! I love genetics because of her! Somehow she made the subject very interesting. Her notes were very detailed and home works were very helpful. She's usually available in her office and super patient. I've learned so much from her in just one semester. She's definitely one of the best professors I had at Geneseo.

Excellent professor! Extremely helpful during office hours or by email. Her exams are challenging. A topic she spent 3 days on in class might have one question, while something she barely mentioned might have 5 questions. Overall she is excellent and very knowledgeable.

Hutchison is the genetics teacher to get, after taking her class I'm confident I would take her over Millitello if I had to retake the class. She's very organized, responds to emails much faster than any teacher I've had, and her class is not overbearing like Haynie and Lovett's. Go to class and do the hw's and you should at least get a b+

This class was the best place to get my notes on the reading done. I never listened to her lectures and used the textbook to learn the material and did well. She gets confused often, but she makes up for it by taking off questions on the test so your grade is higher. I would only suggest to take bio with her if you have a background on it already.

comment: Even though I had to take this class for my major, I would never take it again. I would have learned more from a rock.

Absolutely the worst professor I have ever had. She lectures like she just read the textbook the night before and makes things way more difficult than they need to be. Dr. Bailey was great and they split the semester teaching the class. I was extremely disappointed to go from Dr. Bailey to her. STAY AWAY!!!

Lectures are extremely confusing and difficult to find value in. Conflates her personal feelings with the evolution portion of the course, making it difficult to discern between scientific evidence-supported theory and external opinions.

She is a nice woman but extremely unorganized. If you read the textbook and pay attention you should do well. Tests are very ambiguous and she has many homework assignments but they are easy. She is never clear on exactly what she is asking for in class and on tests and very discussion heavy with a lot of group work.

She was a decent teacher. She made us do "think/pair/share" during class when we talked about genetics, but her ways of teaching did not help me retain the info. She has a monotone voice. I learned more by reading the textbook, going to SI sessions, than from her lectures. Overall, she's an okay teacher.

Insanely unapproachable, her tests are very ambiguous and subjective. I would study close to 10 hours a week for her class alone and i would see no results. I don't know why people have a problem with her. Of course the quizzes don't count much, they are there to make sure you read. The tests are pretty easy and the written response questions are based on the in class discussions. Not that difficult if you have a brain.

The class is very interesting, and not that difficult if you read the textbook carefully and study for the exams. One of the worst professors I have ever had. Tests are ambiguous, and the books is not helpful much at all for them. turned vertebrate biology into an evolution class. tests very ambiguous, so kind of hard to study for.  labs are basically just one stupid poster project after another, and she doesn't grade them very easily either.  probably better then plant phys for a diversity course, but shes definitely not my favorite teacher.

Little note taking in class; learn on your own.  Lots of group discussion.  More notes in class and having more focused lecture would be great.  If you like the material, good class.

Nice person, but a bit socially awkward. She turns Vert into an Evolutionary Biology class-it is ALL about evolution, so beware. The book is really for vertebrates, not evo. The class is not laugh at easy but its no organic chemistry either. If you go to the review sessions she will give away whats on the test. We got an easier text this year but it does not make up for the class so you actually have to be present to know whats going on. She's a bit too concerned with the student's mental health.
The class was very boring, but she is a nice teacher, and will try to make things easy.  The text this year was horrible, but if you tried, it's possible to pass the class.
Her class is obnoxiously easy and then you get to the tests and it's like "Where the hell did this come from?"  However, I'm taking another class with her, so she's not that bad.

My initial first impression of Rachel Korn on the first day of class was not a favorable impression but as the semester progressed I realize that she is not that bad.  I hope that she continues teaching because she is capable of contributing much to the field of Social Psychology and academics.
Though he is retiring this year, he was very good professor. His tests and lectures were very tough, but overall, he is a very good professor and knows a lot.

Aagesen was honestly so funny. I thought his ego really added to the class and made it funny. Professor Aagesen is a great professor and if you can you should 100% take him. He is very funny and makes the class interesting. Aagesen is one of the best professors at Geneseo. Human geography with him is so interesting! There are two easy papers, three tests, and 5 in-class assignments that are also not hard. Aagesen definitely isn't for everyone; his jokes can definitely fall outside someone else's sense of humor but he does what he can to lighten up his lectures, which are information heavy and so useful that I only picked up the textbook for figures in labs. comment: His lectures are interesting because he's so energetic and funny. He's SUCH a nice and caring guy, loves what he does and is so helpful. I wouldnt take this class if you have trouble paying attention in lecture. You have to take really good notes and pay attention to detail in order to do well on the tests. attendance is not mandatory but definitely GO TO EVERY CLASS. Uses class as a platform to talk about his own travels and wastes half the time on anecdotes, but tests are actually difficult. He is an overall great professor and great person. He makes the subject fairly easy to understand and is very clear with his class instructions. It's best to visit him in his office hours if you have any questions about material on exams or lab quizes. Highly recommend taking a class with him.

Aagesen is one of my favorite profs at Geneseo. I always enjoy his lectures and really respect him as a person. The class consist of him talking and showing blurring info, on an outdated overhead. This is the only time in the class you will receive any useful information. The Professer is a good guy with a a lot of experience in his field, would recommend.
The class is SO easy to the point of it being a joke. However, it is very interesting and you do learn a lot. Nice guy/practical minded. I recommend.

Aagesen is one of the most caring professors you'll ever have, and definitely one of the best traveled. He's awesome, but this class in not an easy A.

Aagesen is fantastic! He is very knowledgeable about his field and excited for you to learn about it too. The tests are somewhat difficult, but if you come to class you can do just fine. He's very personable and loves to tell stories of his travels. I went into the class thinking about the possibility of majoring in geography and came out certain!

Honestly one of the best professors I've ever had. He's very willing to help you with anything you need and his lectures are very interesting and easy to follow. Would highly recommend taking his class.
Not a difficult class at all. Don't bother buying the book as the exams are completely based on his excellently-delivered lectures. He's a great professor.

Aagesen I a great man. As a person, he is the best. As a teacher, its more tougher. There are only 3 test  and that is the only thing that your grade is based on. He's a chill guy, because he doesn't teach. Just shows pictures of his adventures around the world. His tests are on all the things he didn't get around to teaching which is why they're impossible. Have to use the textbook for exams.

Lively, nice guy. Lots of stories. Funny. Has a few writing assignments, but they're fairly simple and straightforward.  But his tests are super tough. Like, you have to remember specific things he said once in a lecture two months ago. Take good notes. Study hard!

Aagesen is a nice guy. He knows his stuff really well, and has first-hand experience with a lot of the stuff he teaches. My biggest complaint is that his exams are incredibly difficult. Very clear and helpful. Gives handouts in the beginning of class with important info he touches on that day. Textbook is not necessary mostly, and  when it is he tells you what to study from it. Aagesen is a good guy with lots of stories. His class is interesting, but gradually becomes more and more boring. His tests are very hard and you must understand overall concepts-not an easy A. Good guy and good class, but not easy.

Professor Aagesen is a awesome professor! He gives clear outlines to follow along with in class and his lectures are very interesting. Real cool guy with a ton of stories, but for a 100 level natural science I found him somewhat hard.  Certainly spiked my interest in geography, but if you are looking for an easy A steer clear.  If you want a cool professor though he's your man.
Aagesen definitely sparked my interest in Geography. A very nice person, lectures are easy to understand and he outlines information well for tests. Overall a very good experience.

Professor Aagesen is honestly the best teacher I've ever had.  He is someone that is not only incredibly knowledgeable in his field, but he also inspires students to pursue whatever they deem to be important.  Human Geography was not too difficult, but always interesting as Aagesen as so many stories from his travels.
Professor Aagesen is definitely easygoing in class but his tests are much harder than I thought they would be. He is way overrated.

BEST PHYSICAL GEOGRAPHY TEACHER!I had ZERO interest in this field but Aagesen makes it fun and interesting. And I love when he goes out into tangents. If you have to take a Natural Science Ged-Ed, take one with him as the professor

Professor Aagesen was by far the best professor I have had yet at Geneseo, even though I've been here for 1 semester. He's extremely passionate about Geography and conveys his knowledge really well. educates even the most uninterested, Aagesen is a phenomenal professor by being able to relate to students and present information is a clear fundamental manner that is not condescending or elitist. Had no interest in geography before this class. now its my major. If you need to take a natural science take Aagesen.

Hands down the best professor at Geneseo. Passionate about the geography, has a great sense of humor, and is all around a kind and fun guy. Explains things so clearly it's absurd. See; his lecture on seasonality. Not a tough A if you go to class, and though I'm not a geography major, he has influenced me more than any other professor here

Such an incredible professor; needed to take the course for my natural science credit, loved it, not a science person in the least but went to class everyday, studied hard for the exams (because you must) and ended up with a great grade and a lot of great advice. He is a gem at geneseo, we are lucky to have him

Aagesen is the man. Great professor, easy labs, interesting stories what more could I ask for? The tests are a little more difficult than I thought they would be, but I would definitely suggest taking this for your natural science. He makes me want to go to class.
I really liked his lectures. He always supports me to understand well! He is a great professor.

If you're looking for a good way to fill your natural science requirement, there is no better class to take! I am science phobic but I managed to pull of an A in this class. Aagesen is an amazing professor. Very entertaining; classes are almost always interesting and he has a great habit of ending class early.
Best professor I've had in my college career. Hands down. Extremely interesting, helpful, and funny. I looked forward to class every time and did very well in the class

Greatest teacher I've ever had at Geneseo. He's hilarious, fun, and so inspiring! He makes me want to be a geography major just to take more classes by him!

Class was interesting and professor was really chill. Tests were a little tricky, have to be an active listener. Not stressful at all. I would highly reccomend the class (and professor) to anyone.

Great teacher.

good teacher easy class
