comment: Myzelev is as boring as it gets. To make it worse, she doesn't tolerate phones under any circumstances. She will literally stop her 200 student lecture to walk up to someone and tell them to put their phone away. English is her second language, so it's pretty hard to understand her most times. She also takes attendance every class so don't skip.

Class was really interesting. Projects really easy. Easy extra credit. Tests were difficult. Quizzes were super hard though, brought down my grade :,( Other than that though as long as you study a bit you'll be good.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'TEST HEAVY', 'Amazing lectures']
comment: Her lectures are very interesting although very long (she does however give breaks which I was grateful for). I feel as if I have gained a new appreciation for art that I wouldn't have had otherwise. Her tests are a bit difficult but fair however the projects were fairly easy. Also take advantage of the extra credit she offers. Good class overall.

Lectures are so boring it feels like they're never going to end. You can tell she's really knowledgeable about what she's teaching but not very good at conveying that knowledge to students. The tests aren't necessarily hard but she doesn't make it clear what to study and then she puts very specific dates on them which was annoying

Overall a good professor. She knows so much about the subject and you can tell that she is passionate. She puts a picture of a painting on the screen and talks about it endlessly off the top of her head. Tests require you to think critically about the art work. I found her to be somewhat inaccessible in that she is only available one a week.

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Get ready to read', 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: She is the worst prof ever in my life. Midterm and final are multiple choices, but her grading criteria is very unclear and subjective when it comes to other assignments. She is not welcoming and responsive if you send email to her. Well, good luck if you decided to take her class, but I would not recommend to take her ARTH 173.

Her classes are not very helpful. There are power points with pictures on them but thats about it. Unless you are very into art and want to be there to learn about the different paintings the class is rather boring and unhelpful. Her office hours are only once a week so it is hard to get any extra help.

Myzelev is overall a bad professor. English is not her first language so be prepared for a lot of unclear instructions. If you do email her with questions, she will never respond to your emails because she will claim that she "considers the issue redundant." You will never know what's going to be on the test because her review sheets don't cover it
While a confusing Prof., she is a nice one. Her class is an easy B as well

I'm not sure why Dr. Myzelev is getting such bad reviews on here. She's not that hard to understand at all. She's really nice and her lectures are actually very interesting, even though they're long. She always gave us a break and sometimes ended class early. As long as you show up and do the extra credit, you should be able to get an A.

I don't understand why she doesnt have a better review. She is the absolute sweetest and will go above and beyond to help you.  I had no interest in the class and had no idea what i was doing and she really helped. You have to study but that's with anything.  Definitely use her office hours and ask her questions

Myzelev is a really nice lady, just not fun to have as a professor. Whatever you learn in lecture will only be tested on during the midterm and final. All of the online quizzes had really nitpicky questions that depend on you reading the whole textbook, and you still wont know any of the answers. A miserable class that I would warn ppl from taking

Don't understand why people have trouble with her accent. I found it easy to understand. You do have to put in sufficient time when studying to get good grades but she gives you a review sheet with what she expects you to know so the tests are not that bad. Side projects are quick and easy and help boost your grade. Got an A!
HORRIBLE. Her accent is extremely thick and she's hard to understand. I stopped going to class halfway through the semester and taught myself rather than sitting through her awful lectures.

Myzelev is not a clear speaker. You'll have difficulty understanding her a majority of the time as she has a thick accent and uses a microphone to scream into.  Her powerpoints are poorly done and have useless information. You look at 100 paintings and need to know like 15. She's unclear about what she's grading on and wrong about her own material

I can understand why some people might be put off by her teaching style- she talks conversationally and wants a lot of participation, but usually she can bring in a lot of engaging material. Tests were a little disorganized, but if you read and come to classes you should be fine. She expects good work, but there aren't many actual assignments.

She's a nice lady and knows her material but powerpoint slides and the textbook are not enough to help you study for the tests. Small and easy assignments are there to boost your grade especially since the tests are extremely specific. Big extra credit worth 5 points at the end of the semester!

Myzelev is one of the nicest professors I have ever had. She is cute and tries to joke around. However, during the class you feel like staring at a wall is more interesting than the lecture and the textbook. You will not get good grades but she does give a ton of extra credit and she does care. SHE DOES CURVE. Go the her office hours!!!!

Avoid for the fine arts credit. She's hard to understand in class, lectures are long and tests are based off weirdly specific things she may or may not have covered. No matter how much you study for the exams you still probably won't get an A unless you write down everything she says and can read past the grammatical errors in the questions.

Extremely boring and you can't understand what she is saying 90 percent of the time.  Based on two small projects, mid term, and final.  Projects were easy, but the exam were ridiculous.  She gave you a study guide  which had almost nothing to do with what was on the final.  Ridiculously  specific questions.  Worst fine arts class

Almost half of our grade was made up of small assignments leading up to our final paper.  She grades ridiculously hard on things that really should just be completeincomplete and she is impossible to understand in lecture. Good luck staying awake and paying attention.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS', 'Caring']
comment: Haynie is an interesting man. His Genetics lab is fairly straight forward if you show up, talk to him, and hand in the assignments (you probably wont get them back) you will get an A. He is a rambler so it can get a little off-topic but he has good intentions, cares about the subject, and wants his students to learn from his class.
boring and hard

Dr. Haynie, while he is disorganized and tends to ramble, is very knowldegable and extremely helpful. If you're on facebook etc. during lecture, you're not going to do well. You need to engage and pay attention, sometimes monotanous. Overall, his tests were fair and if you actually show an interest he is very helpful and kind. DO the HW.

He did not hand back any of our assignments, so no one had any idea how they were doing. The lab manual is wordy and sometimes confusing (which makes sense because he wrote it). Take genetics lab with someone else.

One of the worst professors that I've had. He is all over the place. He rambles on about stuff that isn't going to be covered on the test and rushes through the stuff that is. He slides are repetitive and confusing. He skips through most of them anyways.
He reads from his slides he's easily distracted and I think he's useless

He is all over the place. Hardly ever assigns any work or lab reports, but don't take that as a good thing. Asking him for help is virtually useless; all he does is go off on tangents even when you're genuinely interested in the answer to the question you asked.
Take him for genetics lab! A little disorganized (you won't get most of your labs back... Ever) but he's nice and helps you out if you're confused

DO NOT TAKE GENETICS WITH HAYNIE. WASTE OF YOUR LIFE!!!!!!! Lectures are pointless and tests are ambiguous. You dont learn anything or ever know what youre gonna be tested on. IF CANT TAKE GENETICS WITH MILLITELO...DONT TAKE IT AT ALL

Do anything you can to avoid taking Genetics with Haynie. Slides are full of random pictures and lectures are pointless to attend. It is impossible to do well, multiple choice questions are ambiguous and horribly written. He also can't answer any of your questions. Do yourself a favor and wait to take it with Militello.

Take it with Militello. Although Haynie is better than Lovett (he has powerpoints which can actually be useful), he still sometimes spends more time talking about the scientists involved and what they were eating for lunch that day instead of the material you will be tested on.
I don't know about lab but DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME taking a class with him!! You will only suffer (mentally and academically)!
Read the text book chapters at least 2 times and you might pass.

I would have rather spend an entire semester extra at college than take another class with this man. He puts you to sleep in class and I spend more time trying to figure out what the questions on the tests are asking than actually answering them. If you can avoid this man like the plague.

If you can get him for Bio 100 Lab, do so!  I don't know what he's like in class or other labs, but for this, if you don't have enough time to do something, he won't make you do it. Easy grades on labs and he's incredibly entertaining.
No Comments

An extremely lazy professor. He hasn't updated his slides in years, and they still have mistakes on them from when he first made them. He does not prepare for class and arrives literally 10 minutes before it starts. Half the slides he can't even explain because he hasn't looked at them since last semester. His tests are brutal and ambiguous too.
A good teacher. His slides are ok, doesn't spend a lot of time on them but he does post them online.
HORRIBLE!!....I'll leave it at that..

He can't teach to save his life.  The only reason I passed this class (even with studying) was because the tests were multiple choice so you could at least narrow down answers.  Lovett isn't much better, but take her instead, at least you may get something out the class.
Rambling idiot. Powerpoint slides are just copy and pasted pictures from the book with no explanation.
He doesn't want to help, he doesn't even know what he's talking about half the time, he talks about topics other than what he has on his power points!

I'm not quite sure the man knows a thing about genetics.  He says the word "esoteric" about 15 times during ever lecture which is filled with 50 powerpoint slides that make no sense at all.  Seeing as he knows nothing, he uses huge words to compensate and you have no idea what he's talking about.
He needs to seriously change the way he does things, like stop breezing through the powerpoint notes.
This man is incompetent. He is knowledgable but he can't transmit his knoweledge. He talks too fast, he repeats himself, he doesnt give you time to write the notes. Avoid if you can.
mad boring class, hes a baaaaaaddddd teacher
Repeats himself and his material unnecessarily, usually moves either too fast or too slow, multiple choice tests are simple, but not sure that I'm learning anything in his class.
just read the book and dont bother with class; tests are rather easy if you teach it to yourself
idiot.  acts like it's the first time he has seen the information he presents in class
Uses powerpoint and moves too quickly thru slides to take down notes.  Terrible teacher.
mean, does not know material
he is the worst professor i have ever had!!

I think Professor Charlebois got tired of being the easy A so she made her tests harder.... forgetting to teach in the process. Tests were too long for 50 minute periods many students did not finish. Also swears often not sure why (and not in a charming, funny way). Taught myself organic chemistry this semester. Consistently canceled office hours

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Get ready to read', 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: Charlebois buys her slides from an outside source and doesn't read them before class starts. Her lack of knowledge on the slides causes her to rush through things without explaining them. The homework is extremely difficult and she never covers anything like it in class. You will have to teach yourself organic chemistry. Good luck.

She knows nothing, she googled questions in class on multiple occasion. Buys her lectures and doesn't read them so she has no idea whats going on. Doesn't grade her own exams. A very lazy professor. Amazing women who does have mood swings but just can't teach. You will be teaching yourself the material. She flies through her lectures. Good Luck!

Charlebois was a decent professor. She seems very nice at first but can be very moody some days, and usually not in your favor. Her tests are very long  and she knows it. She is very pleased with herself when she knows a test is hard. Direct quote from exam 3 2016 "This is the hardest test I've ever given" *smug smile*.

Dr. C was an alright professor for Orgo 1 & 2.  She rushes through slides too fast, and assigns so much homework that it is sometimes unmanageable.  She is helpful in office hours and goes over stuff before class - but I felt like I HAD to go to her extra sessions to succeed. Also her tests are too long for the time allotted.  You'll survive.

Dr C. is a good lecturer and helpful but can be hard to follow. She skips through lecture slides too fast and doesn't always describe material clearly. If you want an easy A in organic keep looking because it doesn't exist. At least not here

Dr. C is very nice and helpful but she swamps you with homework and her tests are very long and can be rather difficult to finish in the time given. She is also a tough grader on problem sets and test and isn't always very clear on certain aspects of material. Take Geiger or Helms you're better off.

Dr. C is new to Geneseo, but she is truly one of the best professors there. She honestly cares about her students and gives them the materials needed to succeed. All organic chemistry is going to be hard, but she makes it fun and a lot less painful than the other professors. I am looking forward to taking her for Orgo II next semester!
I sucked at this class but she attempted to make me understand. I'm just dumb.
Was tough but doable. Just do your work and there's no issues.

Professor Jewels is truly remarkable. Her kindness and willingness to engage with students' inquiries set her apart. While some peers may underestimate her due to her youth and beauty, those who look beyond her appearance quickly realize the depth of her intellect and the clarity she brings to complex subjects.

I took this class for intersession and at first she was really nice, but she provided a lot of long homework assignments. There were lots of writing assignments that didn't even seem relative to the material at hand. She had quizzes almost everyday, which was a bit frustrating, and the class itself is very discussion board post heavy. Beware!
Rude, disorganized and disrespectful to students.
Great Professor! She is extremely passionate about what she is teaching and involves everyone in class discussions.

Lots of busy work for this class feel like I didn't really learn anything relevant. She will call you out in front of the class and embarrass you, which I found extremely rude. Final paper was very tedious. Overall wouldn't recommend.

Seems like she hates her job which makes class boring. Due dates constantly change, topics for homework are not brought up until the night it is due, always has multiple large assignments due within days of each other, and feedback is not helpful if given at all. Otherwise, concepts are easy to understand, she is just not great at delivering it

Had her online. Told us to watch the lectures but no such lectures existed. Mainly just studied off her power point notes. All of our major assignments were from videos off of youtube. What would have been redeeming is if she was an easy grader since she barely puts in effort in teaching but class averages were very low for a 100 course

Professor Jewels White does not care about teaching. It is so obvious that she is just speaking to get the content out, and is uninterested in the words coming out of her own mouth. She does not answer emails, and is not accessible outside of class if you can't make her office hours. The final is spoken of so vaguely, and is so confusing when asked

Professor White does not respond to emails well and her office hours are extremely inconvenient. It was hard to get outside help from her especially for the final paper which is worth most of your grade. The grading criteria was also not consistent and did not make sense as there was no feedback for most of the assignments.

Shows clear interest in the topic, passion bleeds into lectures. Changes due dates often. Reads off slides, posts them later, but grades on attendance. Takes time to strictly grade. Easy class if you read the textbook, quizzes on very specific material (open book). Interview project for midterm, essay for final. Vague feedback.
Is a very slow grader and gave us an assignment due on thanksgiving. Enough said.

Professor White rarely returns emails. Everything she teaches in her lectures is straight from the textbook. Her office hours are twice a week form 8:30 to 9:30 am which is very inconvenient. Very slow grader. On one of the biggest projects, she graded the first part after I had already turned in the second so I had to redo them both.

Pretty disorganized and seems like she doesn't want to be there half the time/doesn't enjoy teaching. Changes due dates often/no submit option half the time on canvas. Grading criteria isn't that good either/doesn't always give feedback for points taken off. Seems confused about her own syllabus/dates. Can also be pretty rude.

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Tough grader']
comment: I wanted to like this class. Problem was, there was rarely an actual submit button on the Canvas assignments. This usually resulted in her pushing back the due date or asking us to print the paper. Also, she would only give important info to the people who showed up to class, such as what we were actually writing the paper on.

it was technically a hybrid class but you could easily pass without going to class. personally, I thought the material was rather easy and she often gave extensions on projects and paper. she is very enthusiastic and knows what she's talking about. just follow the syllabus and you'll be fine.

She doesnt actually teach. She just gives you the modules and never answers her emails. She insists you just talk to each other in the faq board, but no one answers. Dont take class with her. There are so many better options.

Professor White made sure that the class was easy to complete online entirely despite being a hybrid class. Her lectures are straightforward and are basically a walkthrough of lecture slides for that week. Her assignments are easy to understand and as long as you complete your work her class is easy to pass. She also offers extra credit!

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Test heavy']
comment: Interesting course, professor read straight off of the slides and uploads them later. Gave weekly quizzes on the chapters of the textbook. Seems unapproachable at first but is actually sweet. Also a lot of reading will be done.

She was very cold during all of her lectures, it did not seem like she wanted to be teaching. There was lots of homework but would never be posted on time, instead, she would just give us an extra day to do it. She gave little to no feedback and expected you to know everything.
Very nice professor, give a decent amount of work but all reasonable. She is wiling to work with you. Also offers extra credit.

I was worried with the pandemic and everything that online classes would be pointless, but Prof White was much more engaged and helpful than my other professors this semester. Lots of work but it made the course feel fulfilling I guess. I would take again. But there is a lot of reading. She does give a lot of extra credit too.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Test heavy', 'Beware of pop quizzes']
comment: I was disappointed at how standoffish and cold A lot of my friends in the same programs told me not to take any of her classes. I gave prof white the benefit of the doubt and the only one hurt was me. How can I learn from someone who misspells the names of well known anthropologists. I dont want to be taught incorrectly. In the end, i look bad

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Tough grader']
comment: her quizzes and hw are pretty easy but she does have time-consuming work. she is rude and takes forever to answer questions and emails. Make sure to stay on top of the syllabus because not everything is posted on canvas so it gets confusing. the lectures are pretty slow and she always seems annoyed and not happy to teach

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Test heavy', 'Beware of pop quizzes']
comment: Do not take a class with her. As a level 100 class it was absolutely 100x more difficult than it should be. Every night there's about 80 pages to read and she does pop quizzes on then. She's very cold and unapproachable. She also locks the doors as soon as class starts so if you're even 2 mins late you'll be locked out. The tests are VERY hard!

This was Prof White's first time teaching and it showed. She gave at least 60-80 pages of reading a NIGHT for a 100 lv class and had quizzes on them. Her class is very lecture heavy but the lectures are poorly explained and the slides are not organized. The class grades were so bad that she had to offer many extra credits just to boost the average.

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Tough grader']
comment: Very cold to the class. I felt like I couldn't approach her. You really need to read, a lot. A lot of the questions on the final were not discussed in class. I went to every class, every extra credit opportunity, and studied each study guide religiously, only to end up with a B. HARD 100 level & it just didn't even seem like she knew the material.
Great professor. I would love to take her again but I dont need more anthro classes... I would recommend her, BUT you need to be ready to read

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: She was cold to students during class, so doesn't seem approachable at all. She doesn't have a lot of background with the material, so lectures were confusing and slides with the names of basic concepts and famous anthropologists were misspelled. The majority of reading was not discussed in class but she had essay questions on them anyway.

Jewels is the most dope, not easy but she gets that students have a lot on their plate so she pushed the due date on our final paper back 2 times without us even asking to give us more time to do a good job. She also made a study guide before every exam which was super helpful.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Clear grading criteria', 'Get ready to read']
comment: Lots of reading. Lectures can get pretty dry at times but not always... shes generally a great person, she clearly explains what is expected for literally everything, and she gives positive feedback when its due. Read, study, and youll be fine. Prof. White is great

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Lots of homework', 'Accessible outside class']
comment: One of my favorite professors. Prepare to read a lot, but its nothing to complain about when compared with everything else. Shes also very approachable which helps tremendously

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: The readings are heavy for sure. But she gives a clear outline of whats expected and she isnt a tough grader at all. There isnt really any homework aside from readings, so as long as you read & pay attention in class, youll be fine with literally everything else. Also... shes intimidating at first but really friendly outside of class

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Accessible outside class', 'Get ready to read']
comment: Tough and expects a lot of work done, but willing to go over and answer all your questions. Study guides and quiz questions are helpful for exams. Dont take unless you expect to work and learn something.

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Beware of pop quizzes']
comment: Okay so this lady is a wondeful person I'm sure outside of the classroom but inside the classroom she teaches the intro level courses as the info shes giving you is something you should have already learned/know. The amount of reading she makes us do is unrealistic and gives "random" quizzes on the readings but they are every single class. Avoid!!

Her lectures are very easy to understand, and she is great about answering questions. Never tried to get help outside of class, but I didn't need to because her lecture slides are thorough and everything is posted online. Highly recommend her for Cell Bio!!

Best bio professor in the department! A lot of detailed material was covered, but her teaching style made it easy to understand and keep up with. Tests are extremely fair and bonus point quizzes and homeworks are good checkpoints throughout the semester. Definitely take her for cell!

Dr. Cox is really a great professor. Her lessons are very clear and she provides alot of resources on mycourses. She gives learning objectives for each unit covered and if you put effort into answering them, you should be set for the tests. Her homeworks are very useful and she even gives some extra credit opportunities. I definitely reccomend her!
AWESOME!
idk what everyone is raving about! this class was really hard and dr. cox was not that great of a teacher! tests are tricky as hell! i dropped her class, retook it with chang, and got an easy A

Love her!  One of my new favorite professors at Geneseo.  She's super nice and an excellent teacher.  Take her for cell bio if you can!  Didn't find the class that hard, study for tests and you'll be fine.
AMAZING. they need to send hoops packing and have her teach every  section for cell bio. definitely  not an easy class but she is a phenomenal teacher!

She is absolutely great!  The best cell teacher by far.  She makes the class as enjoyable as possible and is very approachable and fun.  Tests are tricky but much more fair than the other cell options.  I highly recommend her!!!

Extremely disorganized and graded things super late. Somehow got an A (but pass/failed), literally didn't get a single exam grade until Nov. Exams are all essays, there is one discussion board. Did a 3 part final because of bad scheduling, there were supposed to be 6 discs, ended up with 1. Gets upset if ppl don't know answers during lecture. Avoid

I have taken several classes with Bonnie. While she talks a little too long during lectures, she is so sweet to all of her students and truly cares about each one of them. She really wants everyone to do well and tries her best to make sure the due dates are reasonable. Take at least one class with her, she practically is like the mom of the dept.
Very well organise lecture. Always try to make people laugh. Friendly to student and gives proper suggestion about exam.

He is disorganized, but he is a great teacher and cares about his students. He gave a mid term and a final and a several quizzes in between. Very easy grader and will give partial credit wherever he can. If you are confused or need help, he will walk you through it until you get it. Great teacher and great guy! Take a class with him if you can.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Beware of pop quizzes', 'Tough grader']
comment: Professor Szucs is usually unprepared for class and forgets papers and his own calculator. He gives pop quizzes on every unit and makes 3 question quizzes worth 100 points... If you make an adding mistake, get ready to lose 20 points for it. If you don't show up, you will seriously not pass. Textbook required but seldom used unfortunately.

He's a nice guy and knows his material. Tests are exactly like the review sheets he hands out. Like others have said though, he's very disorganized and comes to class unprepared (which wastes class time, solid). If you have the opportunity, definitely take Calc with Szucs

He's a good guy. Clear lectures. Pretty disorganized. If you're nervous in class already you will not vibe off of his frantic energy. But once he gets everything to class with him and he starts teaching, he presents the information neatly.
Extremely disorganized and does not respond do emails. Class is easy but never gives the review sheets that he says he will give until maybe the day before the exam if you are lucky

Szucs was very helpful, he was always clear and did a great job helping anyone he could. He obviously cares about his students, I wasn't too excited about precalc but I enjoyed the class! He would show up late to class, but he made up for it. Great Prof if disorganized, he will let you make up tests you missed etc. try and you will pass!

Professor Szucs is the best professor to take for Calc I!  He gives lots of quizzes, but they are very easy, and tests have the same format as the quizzes.  He takes a long time to grade tests, but that is my only critic! He really wants you to do well in his class, and will give you all the help you need to succeed!
If you need to take a math class look for Szucs first! An absolutely amazing professor. Probably the best and easiest I've ever had.
Made this difficult class an easy A

He is by far the best professor I had in my first semester at Geneseo. He clearly wants his students to succeed (if the entire class tanks on a quiz, he won't grade them). If you work through the practice exam and understand it, you will get in the 90s on the exam. Professor Szucs is seriously the man, and I wish my other profs were more like him.

Quizzes: 15%, 3 Exams: 20% each, Final: 25%. Szucs is the man. Quizzes are given regularly and are unannounced. Makes a somewhat boring subject matter very enjoyable. If you need to take Calc for one of your requirements, you have to take it with Szucs.

Szucs is a great teacher and by far the most straight forward. Never tries to trick you, and will be extremely flexible... Didn't get the test grade you wanted (which could only happen if you didn't study at all) he will def work something out with you. Nice, funny, reasonable.

Loved this class. Szucs made it really easy to learn all the topics. A lot of notes, but they definitely help clarify everything. easy quizes almost every other class, and test questions are pretty simple and just make sure you understand the topics. Homework not checked, but looking at them helps ensure that you know everything
easily one of the best teachers i have ever had.

This guy is THE MAN. There is no better option for calc 2. He is crazy smart and makes a hard subject doable. I wish he taught more classes because I would love to take more classes with him. The class is easy is you pay attention and take a shot at the homework problems before each class. Youll actually like the class.

The best professor you can ask for in Geneseo. If you don't understand a problem even in the final, go ask him and he'll show you half the solution(!). There are quizzes but you can easily make up for them so if you're good then you can skip some classes. He even reviews materials before quizzes/exams so he is basically beyond anyone's expectation.

Seech is the man. Very intelligent, undercover comedian, and wants his students to do well. Very clear in explaining things and test and quizzes were very fair. Hate math but took precalc with him because what the heck. I would switch to a math major if I could take every class with this guy.

If you get his class, God bless you. He's absolutely the best professor ever and actually wants his students to do well. As long as you read over your notes and pay attention in class, you'll get an easy A.

Calc II with this guy is A MUST!! He covers all topics and tries to be very fair with grading. As long as you study and ask questions you should be fine. I did find him a bit disorganized at times and he would give random quizzes.. but its nothing to fear over.

As a math major, I liked him a lot. His notes were very clear and to the point. He tries to make the class funny and sometimes succeeds. Quizzes happen almost every day, so you have to come (but they're really easy). Tests are fair - if you know how to do the problem, you'll do fine on them. There's generally no tricks to them.

Szucs is the BEST!! I hate math but in his class I managed to love the subject and pull off an A. I had a long class (an hour and 45 min) so attendance was mandatory because we learned so much in one class. The tests were incredibly fair, especially the final since he gave us the exact test with different numbers for practice. Very approachable guy

Great professor.  I really suck at math but taking Precalc with this guy both got me really interested and a great grade.  He's kind of disorganized (gets to class late sometimes and isn't swift in getting back quizzes/tests), but he's really good at teaching the material and is incredibly fair.  Highly recommended!

Such a great professor. Notes are incredibly detailed. Homework isn't graded or collected but test questions are often exactly like homework questions. Quizzes are easy and the exams are also pretty decent. He goes over the material right before. I definitely recommend taking Calc 2 with Szucs.

He is a great professor and knows what he's talking about. Homework isn't graded or collected, and tests are easy and if you don't finish he lets you come back and take them. He goes over what's on them before hand as well. Overall he's a good teacher and tries to be funny.

If you go to class every day and take notes, you will do fine. I never did any HW problems. He goes over everything that'll be on a test immediately before giving that test, so studying is not necessary. Szucs "Seech" is a fun guy. Makes lots of jokes that aren't funny but are entertaining.

Very clear with his notes in class and tests are pretty straight forward.  Sometimes went a little overboard with showing proofs and giving a LOT of notes but he has a great sense of humor and was usually available for help outside of class if needed.

After 4 years of college he is the worst professor I have ever had. Unclear lectures, when prompted with questions he says he is unsure of answers. Doesn't show how to do calculations just shows the answers and wants you to learn how to do equations out of class. Very unorganized teaching style, does not know what he is doing.

He is the worst lab professor ever. Does not have a single clue what he is doing and will advise you in the wrong direction (like literally gave me three wrong answers on a lab) and when you confront him about why he marked it wrong he tells you he was unsure at the time and had to review the answer key. Will give 60s on fully completed labs.

Professor Pandey is a very nice guy who I think genuinely cares about his students, but his teaching technique is just not very good. He never really was able to make lectures engaging, most of the time he would just solve equations on the board then face the class and ask right? As if we surely understood, before quickly moving on to a new topic

He's so quiet when he speaks that you can't here him even if you sit a few rows back. Also, he uses these Power Points from a different professor who teaches at his old university. He assigns one to two online assignments a week so its not too much homework, but it's a lot of independent work if you want to get a good grade.

His accent is a little thick but can easily be understood. Many opportunities for points with HW and Mastering quizzes. Tests were kind of all over the place with some being easy and others being impossible.

what isn't there to love about yamagishi sensei? very kind and cute professor. you will have homework about every night, but it isn't terrible; her class is very energizing for an 8:30 am class. she is very clear about due dates. GO TO HER OFFICE HOURS IF YOU CAN! she will help you and she is so friendly!!!

Tomomi Tewksbury is one of the best teachers I've had. She's genuinely so sweet and funny. She cares about the teaching Japanese and the culture.I was scared to take her class at first because the workload seems like a lot but wasn't, it's very easy if you like the class which you will.I can't wait to take her again at Geneseo. Highly recommend!

Yamagishi sensei is an exceptionally caring and good teacher, she wants her students to do well and is very accomodating. She is more lenient on homework and quizzes than most college professors. The only negative of taking a class with her is the type of students that may take it with you as well. Students take advantage of her kindness.

Other reviews about her being adorable are correct. Yamagishi-sensee is the sweetest teacher I've ever had, and her lessons are paced perfectly. Though, you should still be serious about learning the language in this class and study well or your grades will suffer. The one issue is she can be a bit hard to understand at times, but that's it.

My absolute favorite professor ever. She's an excellent teacher, and while the language could be hard to learn the way she teaches and grades makes it as easy as possible. She also accepts late work without penalty and allows makeups for missed quizzes and tests. She's also just the sweetest person ever and I hope to keep in touch after college.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK', 'Hilarious']
comment: She is incredibly sweet and her lectures are always fun! She packs a lot of material into each class and puts a lot of emphasis on participation, so going to class is definitely a must. She also gives a lot of homework, but for the most part it's very easy and really helps you learn. As long as you go to class and try your best, it's an easy A

Yamagishi-sensee is great! She's friendly, helpful, and a good teacher. You learn a lot during a class period, so you can get behind if you miss class. She also assigns a good amount of homework, but it's helpful as it really helps you learn the language. If you're interested in learning Japanese, you'll have a great professor!

She's awesome! She is so sweet and adorable, she will go out of her way to help you and she is very clear when teaching! I personally was really interested in learning Japanese so the class was not hard at all! With her help, Japanese is super fun and easy. Take it!! You'll love her!

I am not extremely good at japanese I will preface my review with that but honestly Yamagishi-sensee is one of the best professors at the school and if it were not for her I do not think I would have continued the language at all. She is utterly phenomenal. That said I recommend passfail.
She could've made this class much, MUCH harder.  But she makes it as easy possible, takes her time with difficult stuff, and makes class fun.  ???????

She's the sweetest women ever! We talk a lot about tv shows and just random things. She loves naruto btw ! Always go to class because the text book doesn't give many examples + participation counts! Quizes, exams and home work are easy just stay on top of getting it done. To get really high grades, practice your handwriting.
Love her <3

She's awesome! All aspects of class are clearly explained and outlined to you, so you always know how to study for quizzes and exams. Show up for class, it's part of your grade. Culture day is great! Study and keep up. This is not a class you can procrastinate for. Revise your homework for a better grade. She's so fashionable. So open to questions!

She is utterly, utterly awesome.  She is a very clear teacher, and the only problem you will ever have in her class is understanding Japanese grammar, as it is very different from English.  Watch her clothes, though:  she never wears the same outfit twice.

Have to go to class. Class is very structured and clear. She outlines the structure of the exams/quizzes. Review sheets are harder than the exams. Buy a used textbook but new workbook. You don't need the cds. Try not to get the packaged deal at the school store or sundance. She is prompt in returning grades.

She's great, funny and easy to learn from! She really cares about her students. She's a teacher worth getting up at 8:00am. Course is not hard if you study the book, and she actually extended the Japanese language to 202 for selected students, so try hard! :) Gambatte!

I actually took this with her last spring but was so busy I forgot to rate her again! Once again, it was my favorite class and she was the best teacher ever. Very clear, precise, and very nice! She even let me see her wedding photos where she was in shiromuku and uchikake kimono. I can't wait until the school gets off its ass and offers japn 201!
I love this teacher. You learn alot in her class. She speaks really good english and is very friendly. she's so tiny! I would definitely recomend her as a teacher.

Yamagishi-sensei is absolutely the best Japanese teacher. Ever. I love her class so much, she makes things so easy to understand quickly, her English is clear, and she is SO cute! Yamagishi-sensei wa kawaii desu! The best! You're lucky if you get her class.

Professor Bia is a great professor, granted his essays are a lot if you are not used to writing in a single space but I feel as if I can write much better due to his course. I suggest attending class even though his class is an essay base class the points do add up.

Bia was a very great teacher. I recommend taking this class with him because he is very passionate about what he does. There are many readings that have to be done for this class but he chose interesting reads and films to prepare for class discussion instead of lectures. He is very caring for his students and cares a lot about what he is teaching!

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Amazing lectures', 'Gives good feedback']
comment: Bia is excited about the information he teaches, and clearly cares about what he's presenting on. Presentations are easy to pay attention to, and he's very receptive to feedback and questions about the class. There is a lot of reading, but it's very interesting stuff.
Not understanding or accommodating to students personal needs in the slightest.

I actually enjoyed this class, and it was better than I expected. You really get a lot out of this course, and she makes you think and problem solve like a teacher should. She does grade tough so really follow the rubrics when completing assignments and projects, quizzes are the most important part of your grade, always do them and always read!

Rommel wasn't as bad as I heard/expected her to be this semester. She grades extremely tough and it's nearly impossible to get a B. Her quizzes are hard and you will rarely get a 100%. Quizzes are the biggest part of your grade too. Other than that I found Rommel easy to talk to and she was nice. I would take her again if I was not being graded.

I wholeheartedly know that Professor Rommel is the worst professor I have ever or will ever have. The amount of times that she was rude and mean to myself as well as other students was ridiculous. When my dad had a heart attack, she was mean about it and threatened to tank my grade if I missed class to visit him in the hospital. Don't ever take her

Professor Rommel is the worst professor I have ever had. She is an incredibly hard grader and give extremely vague instructions. If you can avoid her do so at all costs. If you have no other option I am very sorry. She has made me doubt myself more times than I can count. Really has affected my self esteem as a future teacher.

tags: ['Tough grader', 'Lots of homework', 'Graded by few things']
comment: Creates a negative environment full of very snappy remarks and belittling. Leaving this class learning nothing due to the coursework being random and not very well explained. Have taken multiple tests/ exams without ever seeing a true grade in the grade book and the amount of work we are being graded on is very little. Transferring after one class.

Really a fantastic class. While on the surface development politics seems a little dry, the class really exposed me to the meaning of the word "politics" in a way I was not before. This one class taught me more about political science than any other. Lucas was a little awkward, but I feel that his class is the only politics class of real substance

I wish we would have spent some more time focusing on conflict resolution, but I feel like I learned a lot about civil wars. Actually, I think I learned more in this class than in any other polysci class I've taken.

This class was super difficult, especially as a gen-ed.  The reading load was simply too much, and the class actually covers more economics than politics.  He gives pop quizzes after impossibly long readings and just acts mildly annoyed when the whole class fails.  He never curves, and the material is dry as hell. 1/10 would not recommend.

The absolute worst. I am a transfer student and having him on day 1 scared me. His voice is really annoying and requires you to read about 100+ pages a week. Attendance wasn't part of your grade and notes were online. If you just need a M/ credit,  I suggest avoiding this class.

He makes you read excessive amounts of the textbooks, and just re-hashes the readings in class.  The class title is a misnomer; it's all about politics and development. He forces you into discussion groups with random kids for the whole semester, so it's a nightmare for introverts.  Avoid this class like the plague.

Honestly, he's a pretty nice teacher and wants you to do well. He's pretty open to office hours and if you have a question on an assignment he's willing to help. The reading load is heavy. Sometimes the material is dry, at least in my opinion, but it helps out so you know what's going on in class.

I believe that Prof. Lucas genuinely wants his students to do well in his class and he does a good job of encouraging people to participate in class.  The reading load was pretty heavy, but the essay assignments and the final exam weren't too hard.

I had prof Bullinger at Oneonta and I had a good experience. He gives manageable work and I like the way he did online because it makes this class much better. I had him as an 8:30 class and for a class that early it wasn't bad. He is a nice guy and will always give feedback if you need help. If you are taking public speaking I definitely recommend

I took a class with Professor Bullinger at SUNY Oneonta and he was a nice guy but tough grade for no real reason. I took public speaking with him and he told me he was grading me harder than the rest of the class because I was a sophomore, which I thought was unfair. Overall he was a nice guy but if you're looking for an easy grade stay away.

Bullinger is not an intelligent man. He's very elitist and pretentious with his language, but when it comes down to it he's a bad communicator. Every time he gives feedback or responds to student commentary I think "THAT's what you got from that?" Totally off-base and very obviously filtered through his own preconceptions. Shockingly out of touch.

A lot of the ratings are really bad and is actually pretty good. I have him for "Intro to Communication" and it isn't an easy A but it definitely isn't difficult to pass with a good grade. Overall I would suggest taking this class with him, it isn't an amazing class but it is probably better than a lot of other communications classes.

Must go to class because attendence is a big portion of the grade. Speeches may sound good to you but he grades heavily if you are not practiced. Makes it a comfortable environment for you to speak in and gives good feedback but he does grade tough
This guy deserves to teach at Harvard or something

I recommend taking his class. He is very passionate about teaching/ the information he is teaching. Although the class requires a lot of outside reading, it prepares you well for the next class discussion. He is very open to comments and/or questions and wants the best for his students.
Bullinger is the man. Knows what he's talking about, passionate about his students and the subjects he teaches, overall cool dude.

Bullinger is a good professor. He cares for the material, and is overall a nice guy. That being said his classes are very abstract. This class was theory of argument and I learned near nothing about arguing/debate. He is also very subjective and plays favorites, so impress him.

Had her for two different classes and she was terrible for both. Will never admit that she taught something the wrong way or was unclear in the syllabus even if her entire class is confused. Between her and Rommell in one semester, its honestly enough to make you question if its better to just off yourself and avoid the depression and anxiety.

She is a horrific professor. Her course layout is haphazard and difficult to navigate. She is unclear in her heading criteria and proceeds to grade harshly. Horribly rude. If she doesn't like you she announces it to the world and talks badly about you in front of other students. A disappointment to the education dept. at this school and needs to not be a professor anymore. Also an unreasonable grader and her comments will be unhelpful and just to spite you. Wish i didn't have to take her in block 5.

She is not very kind. Her grading is harsh and she includes some comments that make no logical sense. In my opinion, the layout of her class is not very clear. I had a decent experience with her and all of her courses. The content and work required is useful and applicable in the classroom. Her demeanor is just difficult to get used to. tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Gives good feedback', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: LOVE Dr. O'Brien. One of, if not the best professor I have had in the School of Education so far. She teaches a lot about real-life situations that will happen in the classroom. She taught me so much about the field that I will implement in my classroom. Lots of work, but it is doable and important for learning about the profession.

Dr. O'Brien was the best professor I've ever had at Geneseo. Her class discussion is easily relatable to future practice, and she teaches about real-life situations and skills. She is always there for students, and even is flexible with pushing back deadlines during stressful weeks. I highly recommend her!

I actually took two classes with Dr. O'Brien and If I did anything right by attending Geneseo it was taking her classes. She is a brillant woman and educator. I strongly urge people to take her class if your truely interested in Education. Best of luck to everyone!
very good

Such an amazing woman. She really stands by what she believes in terms of her philosophy of teaching. Participation and attendance are the two most important parts of class, and class discussions really make you question the norms of teaching. I love her.

She is by far one of the best teachers! She's extremely friendly and understanding. Assignments can take up alot of your time but you learn a lot from them. -Very fair grader. She gives take home essay exams that she allows you to edit for a higher grade if you want! If you Participate in class and do all your work you'll get an A!

Leigh O'Brien was my favorite professor in the Nazareth graduate education program.  Her teaching style was consistent with her philosophy of teaching.  She created a classroom climate of inquiry.  She is also a great person.  I highly recommend her.

Also took EDUC 214 with L...My favorite prof at Geneseo. Makes learning fun, and interesting. Projects are content heavy, and there are lots..stay ahead!! Take home tests are not too bad..i love Leigh O'Brien. I wish she ran the ECED program!!!

I really liked her class. It was very easy, but I still felt like I learned something. O'Brien is really nice, helpful, and has a great sense of humor. You can tell she loves what she does, and she seems like she really has experience with what she teaches. Take a class with her - you won't regret it!
Great teacher. She seemed eh in the beginning, but she really grows on you. Really understanding and not a bad class at all with her.

I LOVE O'Brien! I had her every semester and each time was a GREAT experience! I've learned so much from her. She is extremely helpful and makes class interesting and fun. She is kind to every student and listens to students and their feedback constantly. O'Brien definitely is my favorite professor and inspired me. I recommend her to everyone!

Dr. O'Brien was very helpful and insightfull while taking classes from her. Throughout my whole experience at Geneseo I have never come accross a professor that has been more genuine and outgoing as Dr. O'Brien. I would reccomend her to any student.
not the most organized class, but she is very willing to work with each student to make the class work for them.

She is a very nice woman but the class seems very unorganized and assignments are not laid out clearly. She gives test questions out a couple days before the test day if you study those you will get a good grade.
No Comments

Hartvigsen is one of the best you could take at Geneseo. The class was interesting and informative. He wants all of his students to do well and offers plentiful extra credit on every exam. Exam questions were fair and very similar to class material. Take him whenever possible.
A lot of r coding, Exams are challenging but reasonable when studied for.

Hartvigsen is a great professor and a very fair one as well. He gives you access to ALL of his previous exams and you can go to his office hours to ask him questions about them. With this in mind all you have to do is go to class, study the exams, ask questions and repetition is key. Not a free A but it can definitely be earned! Also he curves!
Dr. H is great and rly wants u to succeed but his classes r difficult and u will have to think for urself. Read the text book before class

Hartvigsen is a great professor. You can tell he has true passion for teaching and really cares about his students. His tests are based on lectures so although attendance is not taken you won't succeed in his class without attending lecture. Overall a great class to take!

He is very interested in the stuff he teaches, and tries to engage everyone with the subject matter. He provides an online copy of the textbook, and its recommended you read it, but its not super necessary. He does require attendance at the lectures, as his PowerPoints dont have any text on them, so you miss might out on important information.

His class is not very difficult but it is incredibly boring. Most of it could be learned on your own except all of his lecture slide have only pictures, forcing you to go to class. In class he will take extreme amounts of time explaining very obvious concepts and stop to make bad jokes. The R isn't bad- just read directions and go to office hours.

tags: ['Accessible outside class', 'Graded by few things', 'Tough grader']
comment: Dr. H is one of the few professors I have developed a relationship with, solely from going to office hours. It is unlikely you will do well in this class without office hours. He posts the solutions sets and the textbook is his own publication, which you need for homework. You don't need to attend class but should. Start the final project early!

tags: ['Accessible outside class', 'Graded by few things', 'Test heavy']
comment: First class Ive ever failed. The hw is insanely difficult and took people hours to complete because R studio is so complicated and the equations so cryptic. I thought this was biology, not stats. This class was far more stressful than stats, and every time I left one of his lectures I didnt feel like I learned anything. What a waste of effort.

He is one of those professors who thinks he's funny, and then there are those people who suck up to him like crazy. There are very little grades so everything is worth a lot. Think twice before taking this course with him.

Only 3 modules which act as your HW. You get to choose how much the final exam weighs so if you struggle at the beginning you still have that opportunity to boost yourself. Occasionally offers extra credit. Not an "easy A" but its doable and you will walk away learning a lot. Highly recommend!

It's difficult to put into words how great of an impact Dr. Hartvigsen had an effect on me he taught me in undergrad. His passion for the use of computational biology and programming is infectious and led me into an incredible career. He's a brilliant lecturer, and a wonderful human. Do yourself a favor and take a class with him.

Dr. H is so caring and really wants you to succeed in ecology and biology in general. He is super approachable in and out of the class. That being said, his lectures are more conversational and pretty scattered so I recommend reading the textbook and attending office hours to clear things up. Overall, he is on the best profs I've taken at Geneseo!!

SUCH a sweet guy. Great professor and leads very interesting lectures. He teaches very R heavy with little instruction but if you go to office hours, the R homeworks are easy! Gives extra credit assignments and questions on every test. Super personable and understanding. Gives some group pop quizzes that you WILL get 100s on. HIGHLY recommend!!

Fantastic teacher. Hilarious and makes lectures very laid back, almost conversational. Not a lot of information provided in lecture notes, mostly teach yourself unless you are good at learning via him talking. Learn very valuable skill of R form the master himself. Not graded on a ton, doesn't post grades online

tags: ['Tough Grader', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS']
comment: He is a nice person, but Biodata Analysis was a ridiculous class. We are graded on such few things, most of them being at the end of the semester. The class is teach yourself style and the lectures are fast and I got nothing out of them. The final project is worth about a third of your grade, and if your group isn't good , you're screwed.

Dr. Hartvigsen is by far the best professor I've had/probably will ever have. He is so impressively intelligent, while also being down-to-earth and helpful. Choose this class over an "easy-A"!! Lectures are very interesting, math-heavy but not horrible. There is a lot of R, but he is so willing to help. Hard tests, but not impossible!
Take the class. Any class, Biology, Ecology, it doesn't matter. This is the best professor I have every had at Geneseo. You won't regret it, I promise.

Dr. H is one of the best professors you could ever have here. Not only are his lectures entertaining and interactive, he is one of the most approachable people on campus. He really truly wants all of his students to succeed in ecology and biology and will help any way he can especially in office hours. Would suggest always reading the textbook!

One of my favorite professors ever. I think people are scared to take eco with him bc of R, but there are only 3 homeworks with R and they are grade boosters bc TA's are there to help you. He gives you all his old tests to look at and that helps a lot with tests

Harvigsen was my favorite professor and really got me interested in Ecology. His lectures are bit scattered but are definitely entertaining. He isnt afraid to joke around and mess with the students, especially when teaching the topics he enjoys. I would definitely take him again and I am taking data analysis only because he is teaching it

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Clear grading criteria', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS']
comment: Love Hartvigsen. He's really smart, a little wacky and blunt, and makes class interesting. At some points (in this course specifically) you'll probably wish that he'd be more helpful, but in this data and computer heavy course you have to learn on your own. Makes the course tough, but gives you everything you need to succeed and lays it all out.

Love Hartvigsen, he's a mix of a being really cool and at the same time really smart and a little awkward. Expect to do a lot of modeling and R with him--he literally wrote the book on R that the college uses for intro bio lab.  Tests are very reasonable and ecology modules (R homeworks) clearly laid out with a lot of help available.

Hartvigsen is one of the best professors at Geneseo!  Make sure you show up to class and take good notes in addition to slides.  He gives you the book. Go to office hours w questions, he is always super helpful!  R modules can be tough but if you go to the tutor they are doable.  Class always put me in a good mood; he is super funny and chill

Best and most useful class I've ever taken at Geneseo. If you have the choice between this and another, easier stats course, take this. You will certainly give up the easy A by taking this class, but you have a chance to get an A in a class that will undoubtedly help in the long run!

The best professor I've ever had at Geneseo. Great and interesting lectures that are also funny! I learned so much from him, and his organization of the class is excellent. If you want to learn a lot, work a good amount, and really enjoy coding--TAKE THIS CLASS!

Hartvigsen is the best! His lectures are very engaging and he makes the class very fun. He definitely makes his tests challenging, but as long as you go to class and take notes to supplement his lecture slides you'll do well! If you ever have a question just go to his office hours (and get there early, he's very popular)!

TAKE HIS CLASS! Fantastic! Lectures are fascinating. Hilarious, passionate, caring, helpful; an all around great guy! This was my first semester at Geneseo (transfer student) and he made the semester for me. Tests are hard. Looking at past exams helpful; can't rely on it. Go to office hours and reviews. He provides textbook. Don't skip! Cute too :)

Be prepare to go to class every time. If you skip one class, it will be chaotic later. The lecture slides are not clear, just pictures and graphs. There are no descriptions in the slides. R modules are really hard, if you don't know R, you will have a hard time. He has his own textbook and he doesn't test much from them.

He is the best instructor I have had thus far. Don't take the class with him if you are looking for an easy A. Tests are tough! But I genuinely enjoyed his lectures. He is an interesting guy! He's very helpful if you go to office hours. Don't be afraid to ask questions. It'll probably have a significant effect on your grade. And DON'T skip classes!

Majority of this class seems like an extension of Bio205: tested little on ecology and mostly on R. If you don't know R well, you won't do well. Class lectures are also very chaotic and he goes on many tangents. Tests on something brought up once, although provides past tests to study from.  Cool person, but needs better organization as a teacher
His powerpoint are just pictures and graphs, no descriptions about it. The r modules are tough. I would take apple class for ecology.

Enjoys teaching, but doesn't like the students. Mostly because this course is required for bio majors, he holds grudges. Started out ok, as the semester progressed he became more spiteful of those skipping class. Talks about how he doesn't like certain people, which takes away from material. Most do poorly on the 1st exam. Political and vegetarian.

His classes are usually the more enjoyable ones in my schedule. He livens up the class by giving us anecdotes and asking us about our day. A very confident professor,  he requires you to take note of his teaching style and what he tells you to study for the tests. To do well,you have to be genuinely interested in the class you are taking with him.

He definitely knows what he's talking about but he can be very arrogant at times. He is very helpful in office hours and his tests are easy if you look up his past test and take really good notes in class. He tests on a lot of stuff he only says once in class, so be ready to pay attention. Also, go to class!

Dr. Hartvigsen is an intelligent man that presents the material in an enthusiastic manner. However, he can come across as extremely arrogant and dismissive. I would not recommend taking this course with him.
very intellegent guy. knows everything about statistics. learning R is difficult but he does a good job teaching it.
wasnt event a science major- was a bio minor.  this class was soooooo easy.  if you cant do well in this course ur an idiot.  hartvigsen is pretty cool too.

I was fascinated with Ecology until I took this class. It is basically a math class, you have to derive stuff and tests and it is all graphs. He does about 10% teaching and 90% saying "well your book talks a lot about this" and then advancing the slide. Tests are impossible. Don't expect to learn anything. Take Apple. He is an awful human being.

He is great! His lectures are great and he is always willing to help students out! His tests are somewhat challenging but certainly not impossible if you study at all.  I HIGHLY recommend him for anyone to take!

VERY nice person, and is entertaining in his lectures. Knows his stuff and isn't affraid to joke around. Didn't have to read the textbook at all. Relatively easy, but he isn't very clear on what he wants on projects and it's hard to know what he's going to put on tests. I would recomend him.

nice guy, dont expect an easy a.  tests are toughhh!!!  didnt like the new book so he barely used it.  which was tough bc we didnt know how to study really.  overall wouldnt chose to take the class.  definitely not one of my favorites.  nice guy though.  tells it like it is.
politics don't belong in an ecology classroom...really put a damper on my experience with him as a teacher because he seemed like a decent professor.

Overall very good teacher. He is helpful both inside and outside of class. However, his test are fairly difficult and require a lot of studying in order to do well. His behavior in class borders on funny and condescending, but this will keep you interested and will hold your attention. I would recommend him as a teacher, but don't expect an easy A.

Enthusiastic and fun teacher- makes 8:30 class worth it. Few assignments, so do well on tests. Common complaint is that he's condescending- I think it's more that he sometimes tries a little too hard. Don't be put off- really nice guy who teaches his stuff well.
This teacher is a trip. One of the funniest and good humored professors I have ever had. Tests were hard but the lectures were fun most of the time.
I hate bio and his tests, but overall it was a good class... He is a really good 8:30 in the morning teacher, keeps you awake, funny, helpful, just hard...  But he ended up being reallt fair too!
I hate bio and his tests, but overall it was a good class... He is a really good 8:30 in the morning teacher, keeps you awake, funny, helpful, just hard...  But he ended up being reallt fair too!

There are two sides to this man. There is the prof that everyone loves and then there's that other guy. Overall a good teacher, just don't get on his bad side. Can be condescending, mean, and childish.

This guy is ridiculous. I have no idea what his bio classes are like, but judging from his INTD class, they are probably pretty sweet. very eccentric, loves to tell stories. i want to be like him when i grow up; i feel weird saying that, but he's the man. one of my favorite teachers here.

Dr. H rocks. That's the best way to describe him really. In my mind he is Remus Lupn on a sugar high. He's always helpful, and very approachable and this is the hardest yet funnest class I've taken so far...

Man, what an awesome proff!!!  Very funny with a little bit of sick humor, somewhat arrogant but you would be too if you were as smart as he is.  He is difficult but if your interested in the material, you'll do fine.  Definitely a must take althought he is leaving on sabatical next year.  Take him when he comes back.

Dr. H is by far the greatest professor I've had here at Geneseo. Always willing to help whenever he can. Sincerely interested in his students' success. Returns assignments in a decent amt of time. Returned final exam 2 days after we took it. Difficult exams but an overly fair grader. Always cheery. Loves to tell stories! You wont regret taking him.

He's great.  He's always there to help or just talk to you.  This class is fun.  He goes off-topic a lot and tells lots of funny stories.  You have to be open to some craziness, but I think you'll find him fun.  I really enjoyed having class with him, and I really wish that I had been a biology major just so that I could have him as a professor.

the best teacher that i have had at this school.  the only reason that people say that he may be difficult is the fact that he makes you actually learn, not just spit out facts for a test that will be forgotten two days later. Always there to help, I HIGHLY recommend him.
He really try's to spur an interest in the work and uses his own work to do this often. Want to inspire students to go beyond what is expected.

Dr. H is a great prof.  He's always available when you need help and wants his students to learn something useful instead of just sailing through tests.  I learned a ton from him.  He is very energetic and makes class time enjoyable.
he's really nice and friendly and always willing to help you out. the six degrees of separation class is somewhat fun. we have interesting discussions and we build cool social networks
Dr. Hartvigsen is in love with his own achievements and wants you to feel inferior.
Very interesting teacher.  I like his jokes but if youre a freshmen dont ever take his class because it will be very difficult for you to get a passing grade.
Super, really smart scientist

material isn't too bad, but he loves to hit you up with hard tests. always available to help, really passionate about his subject, very energetic. it's challenging, but probably the best teacher i've had here
if he is in any way as friendly, open, and easy to talk to in his real classes as he is in my INTD, i would definitely take his other classes. :)
He's very challenging, which isn't necessarily bad, and he's fun.  Always willing to help.
Fair grader, but you need to go to the lectures to do well...don't count on the book. Fairly easy-going.
Secretly bitter man.  Don't let him fool you.
No Comments
very lecture heavy, you will sit there the whole time and read off the slides she presents. The course is one of the easiest courses I have taken however I feel it is extremely boring.

The material is easy, and papers aren't graded harshly. Recommended if you want an easy A! I spent a lot of time conversing with her after class to discuss topics, and the conversations were always very insightful. She related a lot of things in class to life around us, and I found it helpful. Most of the class is slideshows, but I loved it!

I'll start off saying I succeeded in Orgo 1. I have never worked so hard for a course and failed so badly. She is an awful teacher, shows favoritism, tests are nothing that she teaches in class. Her classes once a week was absolutely horrible just stated what she said on the video lectures. Her video lectures were horrible.

I honestly think Varghese is AMAZING for lab. If you go to office hours per week w/ questions, she will help. Almost all of my labs were high 90s. It is hard with covid because there are no partners, however, you are still allowed to ask people in the class for help. She is so funny and wants you to do well in lab. My friends and I loved the class

Do not take Nisha!!! She is the least respectable professor Ive ever had! She will not let students ask questions in class and if you do she will laugh at you. Makes multiple mistakes when grading so you have to go through your exams to catch her mistakes! Very unreasonable and disrespectful. She does not care about her students.

She was not meant to be a professor. She does not know how to teach the material at all in a way that the students understand. She laughs at them when they ask relevant questions. She is extremely passive aggressive and condescending. Grades tests wrong every single time because of her arbitrary and illogical thought processes. Avoid at all costs.

Cancelled a review 3 minutes before it even happened and was out the whole week before her exam. She also refuses to curve even when the other orgo professor does for his students while she makes her class work for it. She is a very passive aggressive person and does not stand to be questioned She is very unclear about what she wants from her class

DO NOT MAKE THE MISTAKE OF TAKING NISHA . YES ORGO IS HARD AND YES SOME OF YOU WILL STILL GET AN A WITH HER BUT THE POINT, IS THAT IS BECAUSE YOU DEDICATED HOURS TO STUDY, SHE HERSELF WILL TEACH YOU NOTHING. SHE'S PASSIVE AGGRESSIVE, PRONE TO ERRORS, AND OVERALL JUST CONFUSING. DR T IS DEFINITELY THE BETTER OPTION. SHE DOESN'T CARE FOR STUDENTS
