comment: Will teach something in class and right away except her students to be masters of the subject and how it can interact with previous material without explaining how and why. She is passive aggressive towards her students and cant understand why one section did worse than the other. Quizzes are difficult with most of the questions with many answers

Do not take class with this professor. She is one of the worst i have taken. She is very passive aggressive when students ask questions believing that once she says something she doesn't have to repeat herself. Also, when she does answer a question she just raises her voice loudly. She has no respect towards her students and that some are verybusy

Prof. Varghese is very unapproachable outside of class and has difficulty clearly explaining topics to students. Had trouble responding to emails quickly. Will never curve or give any extra credit- doesn't believe in giving students points "they don't deserve". Her grading is extremely hard and tests are tricky. Would not recommend.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS', 'LECTURE HEAVY']
comment: The best way to succeed in this class is to do the practice sheets that Dr. Varghese posts online. These problems are very similar in difficulty to what she expects you to be able to do on tests. Her tests can be tricky because she combines multiple concepts to make up a single question, but they are definitely doable. You 100% get what you put in

tags: ['Tough Grader', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS']
comment: While it's certainly difficult to do well in this class, it's not impossible. My biggest suggestion would be to do the readings well in advance. Her answers to questions aren't clear if you don't know the material already (which defeats the purpose of asking a question). Know the readings inside and out, watch youtube videos and you'll be fine.

Nisha has difficulty explaining any topics to her students. Asking questions rarely helps as she simply repeats what she just said but louder. Her tests were pretty hard overall and almost always were heavily based off concepts we learned literally the class before.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS', 'LECTURE HEAVY']
comment: Avoid taking organic chemistry with her. She's very unclear about what she expects, and makes the test difficult. No curving or extra credit offered.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Gives good feedback']
comment: Doggett is smarter than you'll ever be, and he knows it. I took his Poetics 203 class, and even though I don't care for poetry, I found his lectures beneficial. Lots of reading and discussion. Exams are cumulative and high stress (imo). He's a great professor.

I personally really like the discussions we have in this class, and I feel like I'm actually learning things I've never heard of before. I feel like I'm learning more perspective and how to think better. He's kind of like a funny grumpy old man.
hes very personable and kind. he really tries his best to be a good mentor even though he goes on a million side tangents during class.

Dr Doggett is an amazing professor, I always try to take his classes when I can. His passion for teaching makes learning enjoyable, and he encourages students to think and ask questions. He is very knowledgeable and dedicated, which makes his classes some of the best I've taken.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Gives good feedback']
comment: I liked him a lot but he goes off topic so quickly making his lectures so boring. There are not slides and he just talks at you for hours and moves rather quickly through concepts. He is very flexible about the midterm and final exam and gives super detailed feedback on papers. I would not recommend taking this class if you do not have to though.

Doggett's absolutely hilarious, a genuinely good dude. He is super personable and gives amazing feedback on papers. Almost intimidatingly smart, but a great professor. He holds you accountable and his class isn't easy, but you will learn a ton. Definitely take a class with him at least once in your time here.

One of my favorites! When a class I needed was taught by him, I would work to make it fit in my schedule. He tends to ramble a little, but he very entertaining and has an enjoyable wit. He is obviously knowledgeable in his field, a true intellectual. He gives great feedback and works with students to improve class, can be reading and essay heavy.

Very very funny guy, this class is just an intro the the english major so it's pretty much nothing but he gives good advice and tells hilarious stories about his life. You only do one writing assignment a week and it's cool to see a different side of the professors.
Professor Doggett is a kind and caring man. This class was to help freshman find their major, and the class was extremely helpful and fun. It was also very easy.

Rob is great. He truly wants all of his students to do well. The readings he assigns can be long and boring but he does not expect much of you in class. He goes over the readings in class and wants to hear what you have to say and know how you feel. He gives great feedback and really wants you to improve in your writing. He is very caring.

This class is experimental, but it did help me a little bit. Prof. Doggett was funny and serious. He was very open about himself and his life journey, which I think was the most helpful thing for this "first year seminar". I definitely appreciated this class and the work done for it. It is a 1/2 sem. class and it doesn't hurt to take it.

Very thorough and helpful feedback. Great and engaging lectures that made English literary techniques more clear and defined. Good at engaging with students in class. Wanted feedback on the class at the end of the year, indicating a willingness to strive. Really nice guy and had a good time in class.

Rob is pretty amazing. I hope you like Ireland and existential crises because he sure does. He has the best sense of dry humor. He's too smart for his own good. He'd rather be in a smokey pub day-drinking and taking poetry with other middle-aged men, but he also makes a very good professor. I've taken too many classes with him at this point.

doggett is pretty alright. spent two weeks studying dead poets society and how everyone in the movie is gay. He really loves Ireland if you're in to that. the midterm and test are rouGh lemme tell ya. he has a fairly decent dry sense of humor so on occasion you'll chuckle. On the last day he told us that everything he taught us isn't real.

Dr. Doggett is easily the smartest professor I have ever had. He is extremely knowledgeable about the material and very helpful if you are struggling. He gives very detailed notes on essays which made me a better writer overall. I highly recommend his class, he made me remain an English major.

"Inspirational" isn't really the word I would use, but he is the SMARTEST man I have ever met in my life. Smart to the extent that I could not really comprehend what he was saying. His work is essay-based, there were no tests. Participate in class, as he looks for that. And read the material, otherwise you'll fail. Seriously.

Doggett writes long and specific responses to each paper, which I really liked and have never experienced with another professor. This was really useful in improving each paper that I wrote from the last. He also encourages stimulating discussions that make going to class easy. I've learned more in this class than any other I've taken.

I LOVE Dr. Doggett. His class was so interesting and inspired me to stay with my English major. He is very well educated and has a wide-range of knowledge, which he is willing to share with the class. Very funny and interesting, but easy to be intimidating. Tough grader, but you will come out better because of it.

Get past his arrogance and you'll be alright. He likes to hear himself talk. Clear authority complex, but definitely knows what he's talking about. His favorite line: "Yeah, yeah. I think that's right." Writing papers for him is discouraging, but if you go to his office hours and demonstrate interest (or fake it) he'll be more than willing to help.

My favorite professor at Geneseo. He's the type of guy you want to grab a beer with & sit around & listen to him talk just for fun. He is very intelligent - doesn't hesitate to explain or offer extra help after class. Goes above and beyond for his students just make sure to always go to class and participate. That is why you're in college, right?

Doggett's dry humor was definitely entertaining and he was very helpful during office hours. He is a good professor but sometimes the things he talks about are based on his own philosophical assumptions. I would recommend him for Humn but keep in mind that he looks for good writing and participation in class.

Easily the best professor I have had at Geneseo. He is extremely brilliant and really passionate about his profession. Hilarious too! I always enjoy going to class, knowing I will learn a lot and have a good laugh. Great guy.

Brilliant, enthusiastic professor that every English major or minor should take at least once. Reading Ulysses in his Joyce class is truly enjoyable, and you can tell he cares deeply about what he's teaching. Expects students to keep up with the reading, but you're in college, come on. Fair in grading and very helpful all around

got an A but had to work my a.. off! hardest ENG class i've ever taken—including 300 levels. if you're looking for an easy A, take someone else. but, if you want to be a better academic writer, take Doggett. CONS: heavy workload, harsh grader, very opinionated. PROS: reciprocal of respect & you'll get your $'s worth when it comes to your education!

Dr. Doggett is brilliant and will work with you if you don't understand something. He's extremely patient and doesn't call people out for being stupid even when they deserve it. He takes students and grades seriously-- effective in boosting writing/critical thinking skills. I've taken 2 poetry classes with him and would definitely take him again!

Doggett is a cool guy. He seems intimidating at first, but once you sit in his class you realize he's got quite the sense of humor. Expect a lot of homework! He's a tough grader, but he does want to see everyone do well. Attend the class though, most of the grades comes from responses and quizzes!I would take another class with him.

He really cares about what he teaches. I was always very interested in everything he said. He is passionate about English and he wants you to be also. Just make sure you really put work into what you write, I met with him before every major paper and got As on both. His TA will grade your minor response papers, but they helped boost my grade a lot.

Ok heres the deal rob's a cool guy super helpful with anything and everything, but a VERY tough grader. He tells you class average is a C and there is a great deal of reading 50-100 pgs per class. If you do the work and pay attention you'll learn a lot but not necessarily do well.

He's a great professor, very interested in what he's teaching. Really helped me improve my essay writing in the end, but he tore my essays to shreds, no matter how many weeks in advance I worked on them.

Best professor I've ever had.  Intelligent, funny, and eloquent.  Very down to Earth.  Receptive to the ideas of students. 2 essays and a final; he is somewhat of a tough grade, but provides excellent typed analyses of your work.  The amount of reading was a little much, usually 80+ pages per class, but it is well worth it.

Doggett knows his subject, and is very explicit in what he expects of students. He's a tough grader, but it's easy to do well if you master the material. His classroom is political, but he presents very good reasons for teaching the way he does.  Makes you very aware of teaching styles, in relation to prevalent contemporary approaches to English.

Awesome class, engaging and funny. never dreaded going to class. wish he was teaching Hum II. Daily quizzes aren?t bad, I read 2/3 of the time and sparknoted the rest.  Great class, highly recommended if you are a decent writer for the 2 papers and can draw some conclusions on your own for the two exams.

Easily one of the smartest men I've ever met. He is a really, really tough grader on papers... With that being said, he offers all kinds of help outside of class and wants to see you succeed and grow as a writer. His feedback is amazing, he literally types a page for each student explaining how they can improve on major papers. I learned so much.

Rob Dog is the man.  He made the texts interesting and provided a higher level of analysis than I've gotten out of any other professor- regardless of discipline.  His assignments are fair and reasonable; they require good class attendance and reading the texts. If students do the work, the class is rewarding and exciting.

One of the worst professors I've ever had the misfortune of knowing.  He was not helpful whatsoever, and only respects people who have the same opinion as him.  Constantly tells people that they are wrong just because he disagrees with them.  I will NEVER have him as a professor again.

He's extremely intelligent and has a great personality, but he's very difficult... you're expected to do a ton of reading and understand them. MUST attend class!!! he's a very hard grader, i still got an A-, but i worked my butt off.

An amazing professor if you are willing to put the effort in.  All of the reading is necessary for the class participation which will boost your grade a LOT..so attendance is a must as well.  Despite the workload and hard grading, Doggett is fair, open minded and a great guy.  I learned a lot from him. =)

Dr.Doggett is a great prof! It sucks that everyone has to take humn, but i would def recommend doing it with him! He made an 8 am class actually enjoyable! Its a hard class and a lot of work, but he is by far the best i've had so far!

Doggett is one of the more interesting professors on campus,and is usually pretty brilliant.Perceptive, open minded, helpful, hilarious, charming, self aware, self deprecating, and confident all at the same time. Not a pansy (don't let the monogrammed shirt fool you).

Rob Doggett is amazing.  Not only is he hot.  He's also completely sarcastic (in a really funny way).  I've taken a few English classes with him so far and I'm never disappointed.  He makes me want to attend class, even at 8 in the morning.  He is a tough grader but he's fair.  My favorite professor by FAR

Dr. Doggett is awesome!! If you do the reading you will do fine on his assignments, and the papers, as long as you put in the effort, you will do well. He makes himself very available for help with papers and is in general very fair. His classes are entertaining, and overall I would totally recommend taking his class!

Completely full of himself, boastful, and a bit rude.  Not to mention he's a bit of a pansy.  I can't stand this guy.  Also, puts way too much emphasis on Yeats.  I get that he likes him, but there are other poets in the world!

Class can get kinda boring but he gives a 5 min. break. He likes to joke around a lot which helps you get through the early morning class. Grades papers like everyone is an English major but is pretty fair overall.

tough grader on papers, but if you read and attend class and speak up once in a while its fairly easy.  tests are straight forward, whatever he writes on the board will be on the test and are very important to remember.  He likes to talk alot, but is a pretty good teacher.

Had him for Irish Theory and Lit. Personally, I hated the subject, thought it was real boring. He took attendance and made it count for 20% which sucked because I didn't like to go and sit there and listen about crap I didn't read. Funny guy though. Class seemed really enjoyable for those around me...

Doggett is a funny guy.  This class was always interesting--we read great books that were all new to me and he would do his best to make class entertaining.  It might not be an easy A but if you're an eng major than you should know a good professor is more worthwhile than an easy grade.
pretty dreamy.... like, the brooding, Heathcliff kind...

He seems nice n' all, but I dunno. Whenever I've gone up to him he seemed kinda stuck up and mean... which is kinda awkward. He's sorta creepy, but he says some funny stuff once in awhile. Not enough grades though... I still haven't gotten my paper back (handed it in like 2 months ago)

Really knows his stuff, helpful if you seek it out, and great in class. Careful, however, he likes the sound of his own voice (in the sense that he'll read passages in this whisper-like voice...) and if as a class you guys don't think he's the funniest guy, he may not love you. Laugh at his jokes, do the reading and you'll be fine.
I think I fell in love with him.  The class was very interesting.

His class flew by everyday.  I'd just sit down and it seemed like the class was over.  Not a boring moment.  The other students got into the class too.  This professor loves his subject and cares about his students.  He is a great guy and a great teacher.  I had no idea who he was when I signed up for his class, but I'm sure glad I did.

Very helpful guy. Had him for writing and actually learned to write a little better. Doesn't screw around with grading, you may struggle. However, he writes a full page for you after every paper about what you did well or did wrong. Cool guy and fun stories. Take him if you want to learn and don't mind a bit of work.
Good guy all-around.

I love love love this professor.  Funny and teaches a great lesson.  The class is over in no time and I don't mind getting up for it.  Most people say they hate humn but I love.  He makes it pretty easy to get a good grade: do the reading (which he cuts down), write 10 short responses (1 page) and come to class.  I'm so glad gambled with Doggett.
Class on Ireland was great last semester. Carries on very interesting class discussions. Agreed with everyone else on the difficult grading, but it's constructive.
Extremely well versed in the subject (Yeats and Heaney).  A fair guy, he just wants you to work for him.  Show up, talk and actually write your paper and youll do fine.
A difficult course. He does enhance his students writing quite a bit, but at the expense of their GPA's.  Don't take it hoping for an easy A - but it is interesting and you learn a lot.

Very hard on grading.  Not an easy A.  If you are looking for someone who will take time to really read your paper and give lots of feedback, take a class with him.  If looking for the easy A that most Freshman writing courses are, try to avoid.  He is a nice guy though and knows a lot in the subject area.  Very focused on bettering you as a studen

You pretty much have to be a charles dickens to get an A on a paper in this class. He is more worried about you "learning" then getting a good grade so you know a C is fine. He is Very bias, and contradicts himself.....He only gave out 1!!! A in the class, ONE!!!!!

Very very hard grader. Nearly impossible to get an A in that class. Its a intro class its supposed to be easy but he's an idealist who thinks that everyone should become an incredible writer. very biased and not an interesting class

Dr. McKnight is a nice person outside of lectures, however in class the lectures often exceed scheduled class time and are filled with tangents that don't mean anything to the course itself. Quizzes are the length of exams & exams the length of finals. The most niche questions will be asked and you will be lost if you don't pay attention in class.

Professor McKnight is one of the hardest chem graders I have ever had during my time at Geneseo. Take orgolab with either duran or barnabas if you want to get a decent grade. McKnight makes grading errors, gives points of for little things that don't matter.

He is a good professors with just about "weekly" quizzes or jeopardy sessions. His quizzes are based on lectures but you do not need to attend in order to get a good grade as he posts all his lecture recordings on brighspace. He also heavily bases his exams on his quizzes so if you use his videos and old quizzes to study you will do fine.

tags: ['Tough Grader', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LECTURE HEAVY']
comment: He is a tough grader and doesn't clearly communicate his expectations. He is a stickler when grading lab reports and you can never include enough information. Very condescending to talk to & makes a clear effort to make you feel dumb. If you're a female he is guaranteed to talk down to you. Clearly very intelligent but definitely not my cup of tea.
Dr. Mcknight is the coolest guy in geneseo, his lecture takes forever but lab is a great time.

He's very picky with grading and expects us to know everything that comes out of his mouth. The problem comes from the fact that it's impossible to retain everything he says. Honestly, felt like he didn't care about his students. Take cell bio lab instead, you'll thank yourself. I thought I was in hell during this lab.
Currently in his Monday section, and feels like hell sometimes. Completely unhelpful and his office hours are useless. Doesn't give us what he wants. Unfortunately he's the only one teaching lab.

McKnight is very intelligent throughout the fields of chemistry, but his instructing is unsuccessful. Try to avoid. Not impossible to get an A, but involves intense dedication. I only got an A because I took AP Chem in high school. Has a thick accent and can be unclear in lecture. Go to lecture EVERY DAY. Don't skip!! Textbook is very necessary.
It's a hard class no matter who teaches it but he is hard to follow along with during lecture and isn't helpful in office hours.

He has probably been one of the most unhelpful professors I have err had. He did not stick to the syllabus when it comes to what is on certain quizzes and tests. He takes 30 minutes to explain what the textbook says in one sentence. I went to his office hours looking for help, and he turned me away saying "this is easy you already know this"

McKnight is sometimes quite hard to understand and his lectures are not exciting. He tries to make jokes, but they aren't effective. He is a nice guy, but his instructing skills are a bit off. If you take any Chemistry class with him, make sure you come in with an already large understanding of the subject and you should get an A with some work.
Yes he is tough at times, but come on guys this is college. anyways, great professor. Now as a doctor myself, I look back and remember his teaching the most. Thank you

Professor Mcknight is a very condescending professor. He is unwilling to assist students during office hours especially pertaining to specific questions. He flies through the material and sometimes gives quizzes and exams on slideshows that were never taught in lecture. Don't take his class.

He is a hard grader and I would not recommend taking him! He has a different grading scale and weighting than the other orgo lab professors. He is very hard to understand at times, especially with the fume hoods going all the time. It wasn't horrible, but it wasn't an easy A.

Dr. McKnight was at times very confusing. He tends to fly through the material and he doesn't take the time to go through the difficult material which was problematic. Can come off as uninterested and arrogant.

His accent is very heavy and he is not easily understood at all. He is also very condescending and not helpful in his office hours. Lean towards the air of precaution if you are considering taking his class.

Difficult to do well in this class, points are taken off for the smallest things and he sometimes comes off as condescending. You can never include enough information for the abstracts/lab reports to be adequate.

Best professor to take lab with! He will help you a lot in the beginning as you get accustomed to lab. Of course you need to have an idea of what you're doing, but he is def easy to approach and a great personality to have lab with. Take him!!

He gives you everything you need to pass the class. There's a lot of homework and its pretty boring but if you do it you'll do fine. A very good guy to talk to if you ever attend his office hours, I would take a class with him again as long as it wasn't lecture style.

Hes boring and his examples are useless. You're going to learn most of the subject material on your own through masteringchem... His accent is really distracting when youre trying to do hw in class. He doesnt post his slides until after class... Pretty useless teacher in my opinion. Tests, depends on how well you understand relationships nd luck...
This guy is the man, man. I feel like I am in a caribbean island drinking a malibu rum punch when I'm in this class. McKnight is makes it awesome it's the place to be

I personally didn't like Dr. McKnight even though i did well in his lab. He is very confusing...tells you about 65% of what he wants in your lab report, but the other 25% you're just suppose to  magically "know". He's hard to understand because of his accent and stutter. He is, however, a very nice man and helpful in other aspects.
McKnight is clear about what he wants and is very helpful! TAKE HIM for orgo lab. Pretty reasonable grader too.
At first, I couldnt stand him; I felt quickly judged. Overtime I adjusted and he became one of my favorite proffesors.  Very personable guy and is quite helpfull. Likes to see students improve
very passionate about the subject, and is extremely helpful during office hours. really hard class tho
McKnight does a good job of teaching Chem 100 and letting the students get to know the chemistry department...  He's also very pleasant to work with if you have any questions..

I liked Dr. McKnight's class. I never really had trouble understanding what was being taught and he was always more than willing to help me when I needed it. He is very interested in chemistry himself, and it shows in his teaching. His exams are straight foward and not terribly hard. He's a good guy and I'd definitely take another class with him.

He posts his powerpoints, which is good if you should happen to miss class. However, his lectures can be difficult to follow, and asking him questions in class does not often result in coherent or useful answers. He can be really touchy. If all the "best" professors are taken this semester, take Dr. McKnight's class- be prepared for Mastering Chem.

>>Professor McKnight: Covers a huge amount of information, but doesn't make it clear how you'll use it, and fails to make it memorable. Lacks clarity and defensive about even constructive criticism. Good guy, but teaching needs work. >>Biochem: Hardest and most complicated Topic @ Geneseo. Intense memorization and understanding required to pass.

This teacher wasn't good at teaching- his power-point slides weren't very useful. You learned a lot on your own. However the final was relatively easy and he gives practice tests and lots of referance sheets. Over all, not too bad.

I did not like this class.  His lectures are disorganized and difficult to understand.  Fortunately I had prior knowledge of the subject so it wasn't too difficult for me.  Otherwise I would have been lost.  Tests are fair, he usually gives a practice test which is very similar to the test.  Reading is not required, and all lectures are online.

He made me want to run to my dependable high school AP Chem teacher. You really need to examine the book outside of class because his lectures are pointless. Suddenly Jamaican slang is more important than chemistry. You need to go to the tutors because he is of no help whatsoever. His tests are relatively easy, but he is a hard grader. >:O

I HATED this class.  He makes people so miserable.  It was an 8:00 class and he stopped lecture because some poor kid yawned in his class.  Do not take a class with him.  He makes you feel like you're a complete moron.
Test is largely based on calculations.  Sometimes goes over things too much and skips over the more difficult topics.
This was a class that I hated to drag myself to. I learned more Jamaican slang than actual chemistry. Unless you like to learn most of the concepts on your own, I wouldn't recommend McKnight.
He is NO help whatsoever outside of class, he moves way too fast, and he wastes so much class time repeating himself or teaching Jamaican slang. I don't recommend him as a teacher.
McKnight never focuses on the more difficult concepts, only the simple ones, but tests you more on the complex.
McKnight is a nice man, but not a very good teacher. He goes too fast in certain areas, and beats simple concepts to death. The tests are pretty straight forward--you just need to study

Really nice fun guy, but a hard teacher. Expects you to memorize lots of material for his tests and is sometimes hard to understand. He has his up and down days. Just know that if he drinks water at 830 in the morning, its gonna be a good day!

I like McKnight a lot on some days and not so much on others. Expects you to know a rediculous amount of information for his tests, but he is willing to give extra credit too.  Nice guy, fun, but not as straight forward as Wendy.
No Comments
Too many good things to say. The best professor ever!! You'll have fun for sure!!!!

You could really tell that she cared about the course and all the students in it. She gave out a workbook that was only $20, had examples of all the material and practice problems for exams. She also posted the completed workbook if you missed class.

There is lots of problem sets to do, all have no clear grading criteria and you will do poorly on the first couple of them and just have to catch up and find out what she wants. There are 16 problem sets total and there isn't really a clear connection between lectures and the homework she has a do. she lowkey wont respect you if youre a woman :(

I struggled in this class but Prof. Aguilar is amazing She is very kind, intelligent, and allows you to complete homework with a partner. Gives mini quizzes that can drag down your grade if you're not careful about studying. Don't be shy about office hours, I wish I had gone to more to study! She also drops the lowest hw and quiz grade.

This class is difficult, but if you put in the work and do the assignments, you will be fine. There is 6 homework's, tests and quizzes, and she will drop your lowest. She is a tough grader, but is always willing to help and you can do retakes if you ask and go to office hours. Very nice professor and would take her for 141 if I could!!

You cannot miss any days of class, or you will fail the next test. She goes way too fast and does a poor job of explaining math concepts. Example questions are easy, and then the test questions are extremely difficult.

Professor Aguilar is a good professor but I struggled in this class. Lectures went incredibly fast and I found myself mindlessly writing down notes to keep up. Going to office hours helps and so do SI sessions. It's crucial to go to class as it is very easy to fall behind. She is very supportive so make sure you reach out if you need help.

Dawn was an amazing professor, she always came prepared to teach, and would always make time to anwser questions. She was very smart and knew what she was teaching, and was always on top of things. I would say the tests were difficult, but if you stud you will do fine.
Was an amazing professor. Very patient and was always willing to help. She created such a safe and enjoyable environment in the classroom. Her teaching was clear and organized.

For being an easier level class, it sometimes makes me want to pull my hair out. She is a very good professor and knows exactly what she is doing. And the fact that she also made a notebook that had all of the problems in it. The tests are just a little bit difficult.

Professor Aguilar I think was one of the best professors I could ask for. She gives a clear understanding on the lessons. Dawn is a tough grader, it is very hard to get a 100 on an assignment as little points are always taken off which can add up quickly. But besides that, she definitely cares about her students and wants to see them succeed.
She is a very clear instructor and really keeps me engaged in class.

I like the way in which she teaches the class but the homework never looks like what we did in class; the problems are always ten times more difficult. She is the toughest grader I've ever met and takes any points possible off, even for the smallest mistakes. Would not recommend nor would I take a class that she teaches ever again.

Listen this class is pretty easy if you show up and pay attention. This seems to be an issue for many people in my section, as we routinely have under 50% attendance. Although I did expect that somewhat, seeing as many in this class are burned out business majors with senioritis. She's a fair grader, teaches well, and doesn't ask too much.

Moves at a very fast pace in class it is very hard to keep up. The tests are not like the notes you take. The test is just a way harder version of the quizzes and worksheets. She does not do a good job explaining whats on the test and makes homework's due the night before tests.
She was very nice and overall I enjoyed her math 140 class, just make sure to show all of your work on assignments and read directions

I have never worked so hard in a class in my entire life. It was very unfair that she graded SO harshly when i would spend HOURS at office hours. My friend was a math major and actually dropped her major after taking this class. I took this class over a year ago as a freshman and she truly caused so much anxiety. I did hours of work every day

She is an awesome professor. She is very nice and is always willing to help. She is a tough grader but you can always go to her office hours for help. Not many assignments, this semester we have 5 homework, 4-5 quizzes, 4 basic skills quizzes, and 3 tests and a final. No make up quizzes or tests if you miss class and no late homework.
adds things to canvas with no heads up, very VERY hard grader, no sympathy for late work or sick days. genuinely i was out sick for ONE day and she did not care gives zeros for everything you miss.
Professor Aguilar is always available for extra help if needed. She is extremely caring and wants the people who care to do well. She is an amazing teacher and is very organized.
She's super nice and always available to help but she's a hard grader.

comment: A few takeaways from Professor Aguilars 140 class. Attendance is mandatory or you will be so lost. No extra credit at all. Homeworks are incredibly difficult so they will make or break your grade. Go to office hours and show you care. Extremely hard grader on exams. You wont pass this class if you dont put the effort in. Amazing Professor tho

She is one of the worst professors I've had at this school. She is also not helpful at office hours. I had to get a private tutor, and even then, still struggled as she is a tough grader and moves at such a fast pace. I would not recommend taking this class to anyone. Her only advice is to keep re reading the notes but the notes make no sense.

Professor Aguilar is super helpful and approachable. She's always willing to answer questions and ensure you have a good understanding of the homework problems when you ask about them, but doesn't just give answers. There's an hour long tutorial every week where she does practice problems separate from the office hour which is also very helpful.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Group projects', 'Tough grader']
comment: Took her at the beginning of covid and she did too much. Cameras on lockdown browser which is crazy. She makes you take pictures and convert your work pages into a pdf and you still have to beat the time allotted for the test. Just overall annoying
She is very quick to respond over email. Only bad thing I would have to say is she is a hard grader, especially on homeworks, so going to office hours helps a lot.

I feel like Professor Aguilar teaches in a way that made it easy to understand. The lectures made sense and really explained each detail carefully. I was struggling in her class but every time I met with her after class I walked away feeling a lot more confident. She makes you work for it and is a tough grader but is very caring towards students.

Aguilar is a good professor but a hard grader. She will make you work for your grades but is willing to do everything she can to get you there. Wonderful woman but again a hard grader. If you are not willing to study you will not have good grades. If you put in the effort you will be fine. Also the review sessions are extremely helpful before test.

I absolutely loved having Professor Aguilar! She is so passionate about what she does, I especially recommend her for Math 141. She also really cares about her students and is quite accessible for help or questions.

Professor Aguilar is such a sweet human being. She really cares about all of her students, and wants everyone to succeed. Her homework is a little hard to do because she wants it done a certain way, but once you get used to it you'll be fine. The test and quiz questions are from the notes and the practice problems.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Tough grader']
comment: Professor Aguilar is very kind and caring. However, her homework is very difficult. Gives good test reviews before tests. For me it was more the class subject itself was very difficult, but I found some things she didn't explain well. Office hours saved my grade, but know going to the math learning enter will not help, you must go to office hours.

Very tough. I lived in the math learning center and even they were confused half of the time. The homework reflected material we did not learn yet and when having one on ones about my future in this course I was told math wasn't for me when I had gotten an A in pre calc a semester earlier

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Test heavy', 'Tough grader']
comment: worst professor ever! class is extremely hard! I went to office hours once to get help with a homework question and left thinking I had to change my major (Math major). She tried helping me by giving me advice but in the end, she said that I don't have what it takes to be a math major and I should switch majors now before I get too far.

Not only was Math 140 easy because of her, but she made class easy and specified what we needed to know before any test. She alternated between quizzes Andnit homework assignments weekly, which was nice. She is kind and understanding when you miss class. I loved her and glad I got to have her as my teacher.

Professor Aguilar is great. She is super helpful if you ask questions and go to her office hours. Her notes are pretty good but got a little confusing towards the end. She really cares about all her students and gives a lot of partial credit. Her tests are challenging but you can do well if you work hard.

Professor Aguilar is a great teacher. She is willing to slow down and go over a topic more than once if the class is confused. Her tests are a lot harder than her homework and quizzes, but she is very lenient when grading. She is a very caring person and is willing to help you at any time. I would definitely recommend her.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK', 'Caring']
comment: Professor Aguilar is so sweet! She is very clear during class and shows you really good examples, however her tests are always so much harder than the examples she gives but if you go to her office hours she's always willing to help!

Professor Aguilar was a decent professor. She is very organized and meticulous, but also nit-picky and specific. One time I solved a problem differently than the method we did in class, and it wasn't 'good.' Isn't the point of math to find different ways? I spent significantly more time on her 100-level course than I did on a 200-level course.

Professor Aguilar was the BEST! She so so nice and genuinely wants all her students to do well. Her office hours are also really helpful. However, her tests were very difficult. Sometimes she did add in things on the test that we never really went over. None the less, she is still an amazing professor and I HIGHLY recommend taking her class!

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: Prof Aguilar is new to Geneseo, and I absolutely loved her! She did a great job explaining everything you needed to know and had a clear way of grading, which she told you! She was great- 10/10 would take her class again!
She really engages with students and material. Though provoking class!

I love her. She clearly cares about what she teaches. Does she go on tangents? Yes. If you're in a sociology class this high of a level, you care about insight from the professors. If you don't think you'll be really interested in this class let someone else take it. I really enjoy her teaching style and can't wait to take more classes with her.

comment: Dr. Braksmajer is a great professor, she is super passionate about what she teaches and you can sense it from her classes and the way she conducts them. There is weekly journals you have to submit based on the 2 reading every week, there is a group project but she makes you do a peer evaluation and its confidential!

Absolutely awful professor. Weekly essays over 25 different articles and research papers you have to read. Big group assignment at the end of the class (only reason why I got a C and not a B that I had all semester) She is awfully rude to everyone besides her “favorite students”. Lacks a lot of respect and empathy for others.

Cool class and different from the others ive taken. As someone who struggles sometimes with understanding sociology classes I am happy to say that this one did the best job at explaining the concepts in an interesting and digestible way. Braksmajer is very nice and I recommend it. The final and midterm are kinda hard and a lot of reading.
The class is very interesting!  There are weekly reading quizzes and a big group project that takes place throughout the semester.

She was nice enough and the class was genuinely so easy, but the point of a sociology class is to broaden your mindset, something although she verbally encouraged, she never followed through. If you ever ask a question and don't fit a certain visual demographic she will yell at you.

Honestly I did not enjoy this class. Her lectures were not engaging, and oftentimes she went on long tangents during class. She's not very accessible outside of class, and in class she could come across as rude and demeaning. She's definitely well-versed in what she teaches, but I never felt comfortable contributing or talking to her.

super passionate and makes topics interesting, her lectures are never boring because she always adds some humor and says wild things. really into activism and often talks about real world issues and how we can make a difference. she really cares about her students and the subject, for Sociomedical take Professor Braksmajer

The content of this class seemed cool but I didn't find the lectures engaging. The discussion boards every week were a lot of work. There is a large final project due at the end of the semester that you dont get time in class on and she grades harshly. I did worse on the midterm and final exams than I thought despite studying and attending class.

Very unorganized and unclear with assignment expectations. Took weeks to answer a single email. She also assigned a HUGE final project in addition to the final exam. No in class time to work on the project was given. I wanted to complain to the chair of the department but then realized the department chair is her husband so good luck.....
overall she is a decent professor. she does NOT answer her emails in a timely manner so be prepared to wait several days for a response -_-.

material is not hard (my crap grade was a personal failure, no issue of professor) but god forbid you have a different opinion than her, prepare to be passively aggressively ripped apart. also talks a lot about sex

Professor Braksmajer was very helpful throughout this semester. Her classes were engaging and you can tell that she is passionate about the subject that she is teaching. In terms of exams and coursework, you don't need to study too much, show up to class and PAY ATTENTION.

Overall pretty good, but will talk about her opinions on anything. There are weekly discussion boards that have three or four extensive readings to base the responses on. The tests were somewhat easy, but have to make sure you read the lectures. Group project at the end of semster is difficult and she doesnt even know how to do it.
Professor was amazing!!

Overall, this is not a difficult class if you do the work. The reading reflections were irritating at times, but not terrible. I think she's an okay professor, and the midterm and final were online which made it a lot easier. I did learn some interesting things throughout this class, and I would take a class with her again if I had to. Easy A.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Lots of homework']
comment: Have to do a journal entry based off readings every week and write 2-3 pages about it. One group assignment and presentation. Will call on you in class, but this class is nothing without different perspectives. Final Lit Review 10-12 pages which was not fun. Overall, the material is interesting and she is very accommodating/nonjudgmental.
Dr. Braksmajer is one of my favorite professors I've had at Geneseo. She is always willing to meet with you and work out any issues and keeps class interesting.
This class could have been more fun if she stopped including her opinion on things. Also, her exams were fairly easy but she contradicts her own teachings in class when giving you feedback.

Professor Braksmajer is awesome! While the class is extremely lecture heavy she makes them very engaging and easy to follow. The concepts you learn are incredibly applicable to every day life and very easy to grasp. She is super approachable and good about answering emails! Only weekly discussion posts, two tests and a group project.

Prof Braksmajer is all about participation, so if you don't feel comfortable talking in class then you will get a 0. When you do talk if its not the same opinions as her she will destroy you in a passive aggressive way. You have to lead a class discussion once for the entire class, weekly journals, and a final paper. Interesting class turned boring

Wesp was an amazing prof. He retired and only a month after last semester passed away. Basically, read the rest of the comments. They'd make a great Eulogy... We loved Wesp. He was a great funny man. Will be missed. Rest in Peace Wesp!
Lectures are a bit hard to  follow but you can see his passion for theater. Go to class, read the textbook and you will get an A. He also offers up to 10 bonus points on your overall grades.
Hands down the best professor at Geneseo

Nice, funny guy. Lectures are all over the place, he goes off on tangents for a majority of the class, which makes tests somewhat difficult. Studying the textbook in addition to the lectures is helpful. Not a terrible class but definitely not the best

I really enjoyed this guy even though I could have done better. It is a bit tougher than you would expect for an intro theatre course. Absolutely use the slides to study. I used the text books for the first 3 quizes and saw a huge jump when I switched methods. Will point out distracting/disrespectful people. Q's on play readings are easy points.

He is excellent at engaging the class and helping to make the plays more interesting than just sitting in a classroom and reading. He constantly engages with the class, so if you don't want to be called out sit in roughly the middle, on either side. Reading is NOT optional though, or you'll fail completely.

Fun theatre teacher. He only assigns a few noncumulative multiple choice tests which is nice. They can be a little specific but reading the book helps. The class is not demanding and he makes it interesting.
Wesp is okay.  It's a basic introductory class and I did get a basic understanding of the theater.
Take it. Just take Theatre 100 with him. Yes, it's at 8:30, but you don't have to go more than half the time. He doesn't care and you'll still pass. Just take it.
Wesp made an 8:30am class enjoyable. He is very outgoing and energetic that early in the morning. He is everything a theatre professor should be. TAKE THE CLASS!

Wesp loves to act and uses that to his advantage. But don't worry, his 5 "quizzes" of 25 questions are so easy. Just show up to class and read what he tells you and it's an easy A and GPA booster. He's funny and obviously loves what he does. Take it for a breather from all the other hard classes you're probably taking this semester.

Prof Wesp is exactly what I expected a theatre teacher to be like (in a good way). He's very animated, humorous, and goes on amusing tangents. I thought he did a great job making the lectures fun. Love his casual style of teaching. Class is a cinch and I'd highly recommend him for knocking out the fine arts courses.

Wesp is an amazing professor and man. He makes his classes fun. He pretty much only lectures, but due to his personally, they're fun to listen to. Sometimes he goes on tangents and you get a little lost, but it's okay because he acknowledges that he does it. Definitely take a class with him!!

Wesp is wonderful! he is full of energy, even though this class is at 8:30 am i was willing to get up for it every day because it was so fun! Wesp is very funny, even if your not a huge fan of the material you will still enjoy the lectures. also gives extra credit that requires some reading but goes directly to your final avg. TAKE THIS CLASS!

he is an amazing professor who is interesting and very understanding. Going to office hours and asking his about the tests beforehand are a huge help. He also gives extra credit that is fairly easy. He is everything a theater teacher should be, despite the few confusing parts in his notes. He will clarify is asked. loved him!

Wesp is an interesting guy. Tries his best to make the material interesting. He gives 5 quizzes that determine your grade. You must go to class and take notes. Most of the questions on the quizzes are from class. You have to attend a play. Easy A but must pay attention

Wesp is one of the most talented lecturers on campus. He is engaging, energetic, and passionate. I am by no means a theatre person but Wesp makes the class as enjoyable as an 8am lecture hall could be. The one thing I'll say is that for a 100 level class it is not as easy as many would expect. You have to really study to do well

Wesp is very engaging and looks to strike up a conversation more so than force what he thinks is right or wrong about the subject material. In fact, he's not against changing his own views in light of another good argument. He's a little zany at times but in a good way that keeps you on your toes and interested.

Wesp is a great professor. Although I have no interest in theatre, he makes the class interesting for a lecture. There are 5 short "quizzes" and as long as you read the textbook and the plays, it's an easy A.  He is also helpful during his office hours.

I really really liked him! Having it at 8:30 I thought would be a problem but he teaches like he acts and is very entertaining.  An A as long as you do the work.  I personally loved his class even though I have no interest in theatre.

Wesp is definitely passionate about what he teaches. He's very funny and easy to have a conversation with. However, I sometimes found him boring but that could be because I wasn't that interested in the subject. He's an easy grader though and always willing to look over your work beforehand.

Wesp is a great teacher. He really knows what he is doing and he loves talking about it. He's funny and gets to know his students. He wants you to do well and will help you get a good grade. If you put in moderate effort, you will get a good grade.

Wesp! He's great and extremely knowledgeable. It's really not a difficult class. As long as you have a pulse, you shouldn't have any problem getting at least a B. If you put in ANY effort, in addition to having a pulse, you shouldn't have any problem getting an A.
Great professor, easy class! Just show up to class most of the time and read the textbook/plays and you'll be golden!
Very nice man and entertaining. Tests are not hard, but his wording can be confusing. He is willing to clarify test questions if you ask.

Wesp was by far one of my favorite professors I have had at Geneseo yet. He made each class interesting and laid back. The class is an easy A with minimal effort; just pay attention in class. It was based off of 5 in class analysis writings and a final out of class 3-5 page paper. I HIGHLY recommend this professor to anyone
Mr. Wesp is so great and made each class interesting. His class is an easy A if you put in 1-2 hours a week.

Mr. Wesp was one of the most witty teachers I had at Geneseo. He made classes interesting; we watched movies and discussed plays. As long as one puts in an hour or two a week to do the readings this class will be an easy A.

Wesp is a good guy. I went to most classes and ended up doing well in the class. You need to read the plays and the textbook if you want to do well. If you do not study for this class it will be incredibly difficult. The extra credit questions on tests can add 10 percent to your overall grade, proving to be very important. Test wording is confusing

Wesp seems like a nice guy until you take the first test, tests are extremely difficult and he doesn't seem to care that everyone in the class failed his 100 level tests. I took theatre thinking it was the easiest course offered at Geneseo and found it extremely difficult with Wesp. Don't take unless you like getting C's.

Nice guy, but does not understand how to properly structure the class in a suitable way for non-majors. Lectures lack focus and do not touch upon major test topics sufficiently. Class involves too much work to be a good option for fine arts credit requirements.

In the begininning, he seemed like a funny guy, but his tests are ridiculously difficult for a theatre class. The questions are either small details he mentions once or completely from the textbook and not gone over. I would find a better professor for theatre unless you don't mind getting a C in a fine arts class.

This was her last semester teaching at Geneseo- She got a job out of state, but she was a great professor. The class topic was dull but she tried to make interesting, and always gave detailed handouts, and tried to answer any questions you have. She also gives a lot of grades so that if you do bad on a quiz, etc it won't affect your grade too much!
Her class is extremely easy with very little work required. She is a very nice person but hard to understand and you wont learn much from her.

Class is kind of worthless. I skipped a ton, and when I went, I usually was on my computer the entire time. Incredibly easy grader. I BOMBED a quiz and still had a 95. Slow at getting things back to you and sometimes it's hard to understand her, but it's an easy class.

I belive she has good intentions, but I honestly did most of my learning from the textbooks, not from her. She is not very clear about the assignments, and she does not give much feedback. All in all, the class with her was so-so.

my advice to you is to just do the assignments and dont freak out. you will get a good grade in her class as long as you do the work and attend class. even if you miss points on her little quizzes, you will still be fine. dont be uptight!

There was a good deal of reading.  She was willing to change the syllabus to help us out and spend more time on what we wanted to learn about.  The projects were hard but kind of interesting. She really helped us develop our own opinions on literacy.

I had Professor Liwanag for EDUC 215 and I think that she her class is an easy A.  People complain that she isnt clear, but they just wanted her to do the work for them.  You do have to think yourself in this class, but she is very broad in what she is looking for. Just use your intution in thisclass, and you will be fine.
No Comments

I had Prof. Liwanag for EDUC 215 and it was awful! She is extremely unclear about assignments (what she expects, when they are due, etc.) and when you ask her to clarify, she avoids answering you! I don't recommend taking this class with her...

I LOVE this man, but his class is pretty boring. He is very soft-spoken, which makes it very hard to pay attention. He is SO nice, though, and sometimes the cute old man things he says are BEYOND adorable. Rambly, though. Not sure what he's teaching sometimes.

Walter, and you must refer to him by his first name, is probably one of the sweetest professors at SUNY Geneseo.  He grades his papers fairly but if you want an edge just greet him with a smile and a "Good Morning Walter." :)

for a 100-level class he graded too harshly. even after i met with him prior to a paper being due i wouldn't do as well as i liked. he's soft spoken/monotone which can be rough. he can be cute/funny sometimes though. two papers and a presentation- not terrible but not great.

I'm not sure what the level was, but I had Freed for American Lit.  It was a super easy class that doesn't require too much reading and has few assignments including a fill in the blank midterm.  Although the class is a bit boring, Freed is a genuinely sweet man and is super helpful during his office hours.

I've had him for two classes at Geneseo. He gives a fair amount of work but nothing overwhelming. I've heard he grades harshly, but I've found him to be an easy grader personally. He can be very boring because he straight lectures, but he cares about literature a lot, likes his students, and can be funny. Classes would benefit from discussion.

Talks far too softly- you cannot hear him unless you sit in the front row and even then you will miss what he says when someone rustles their jacket in the slightest. Class is boring. Teaching style can best be described as "rambling". Subject matter is spurious. Grading is suspect. Does not assign much work: 3 papers, 1 presentation, some quizzes.
I've had a few classes with him.  He is nice and sometimes funny and clearly loves literature, but he may make you fall asleep. Not a very hard class. 3 papers, 5 quizzes, and a presentation.

The class itself is not difficult--I took it under Short Fiction.  My problem is with Freed's teaching style... he does not try to engage the class at all.  He simply talks about the reading for the day, and yes, sometimes his opinions are interesting, but he's practically asking us to fall asleep.  Easy A, yes; interesting course, not at all!

Very soft spoken, so sometimes it's hard to hear him. Extremely passionate about what he his teaching. Can be very funny often times dispite his intimidating apperance. My only complaint is the lack of structure for his papers.

This class is horrible.  He may be mellow and nice but as a teacher he's HORRIBLE.  He doesn't care to know who anyone is and claims class participation is important when he rambles the entire time about things not even relevant to the reading. Worst class ever. Oh and guaranteed every day he keeps talking for 10 mins after class has ended.

He is very mellow while talking until he finds something that he thinks is important, then will he raise his voice and wave his cane in the air.  Random quizzes about the stories that are to be read before coming to class.  Also has a specific idea in his head for papers, if your idea isnt what he is looking for, you will have to rewrite your paper

This class was pretty easy as long as you actually go to class.  He likes to have a random quiz once in a while.  Definitley drink some coffee before class, he's a bore.  Really nice guy.  Pretty random outbursts of interest in stories which makes for a good laugh when you're about to fall asleep. Nice guy, boring though.

While Professor Freed can be a harsh grader when it comes to papers, his midterm and group presentation are both fair and easy. As long as you put time into the class, and make a genuine effort, you should do well. He is also extremely enthusiastic, kind, and funny at times. There are a lot of notes, but that doesn't take away from the class.

This is the best english teacher I've had here. He knows the material inside and out and teaches it with enthusiasm. He makes it interesting and uses his cane for demonstrations. The group presentation is easy as were his tests. Fill in the blank for a midterm? It doesn't get any better than that.

SOOO boring, difficult to stay awake. He rambles on the entire class like students aren't even there. IMPOSSIBLE to predict what will be on tests, questions are soo specific even though there is such a wide range of material! STAY AWAY!!!

At first glance, Freed may SEEM boring. If you LISTEN, however, he really ISN'T; He's just soft-spoken. He has such passion! I absolutely loved hearing him talk, whether it was explaining the stories or telling his own personal anecdotes. He is extremely smart, VERY VERY well-spoken, and responds kindly to every response. Got an A, somewhat easily.

I had Dr. Freed (Yes, he has a PhD, he's NOT JUST a "lecturer") for Eng 200 and he was such a delightful man I absolutely had to take his class again. I love his talks and he makes me feel all nostalgic when he talks about his life. Yes, occasionally you will be behind the syllabus, but his talks are absolutely worth it. I absolutely LOVE this man!

He's got a ton of interesting things to say and real life experiences to share. This short fiction class is great becuase you read one short story per class (maybe not even that) and you have two papers and one presentation. He's rather soft spoken but very intense about everything he does.

read everything on the syllabus! he may seem boring at first, but he is very interesting  once you get into class a little bit. it is amazing how much he knows and how interested he is in the subject himself. take good notes and go to him if you need help on your paper. read everything on the syllabus no matter what he does in class.

HE is soo boring. He is unclear about the assignments, papers, and everything in general. HE doesn't give direction and specific advice, but gives bad grades. Overall, I would not rate this teacher very higly. He is a nice guy and is approachable, but as far as the topics and his insight...not very helpful.

We are way behind in class, not following the syllabus. Write a decent paper, you'll get a decent grade. Write a good paper, you'll get a good grade. Problem is the quizzes. They're random facts, nothing about the text. Easy, but disappointing because of the lack of focus/structure.
Indescribable lecturer.  Communicates his passion for the topic.

INCREDIBLE MAN. I got As on EVERY paper. I LOVED his lectures (well its different for everyone) and I was always on the tip of my toes when he spoke. Very funny and interesting. He grades pretty rough though. Be aware of that. Otherwise, this was my fav course ever. Freed is so awesome, I love this man.

well, he has some interesting stuff to share.  Lots of reading, papers have no guidelines except length requirements.  His quizes and test questions are VERY random.  He grades papers hard, but I got through the course alright.

I wouldn't recommend him, if only because I'm still not sure whether he really knew what he was doing or not. Essay assignments got little to no direction or mention in class, and tests were purely based on trivial facts about the authors, not about the texts themselves. Overall, an odd class.
Freed is the F'in man.  You won't be sad.

boring. boooring. booooring. he literally whispers in class, so the whole class can be quiet and listen to him. he's a tough graders, he looooves giving out Bs, so be careful. He's not clear at all with assignments, it seems like he makes it up as he speaks. anyhow, he's boring. take another teacher
Umm.. He doesn't seem to have any clear goals, motives, or themes in his lecture. He gives pointless quizzes to see if you did the reading so watch out.
A boring guy and not very helpful. Assignments were kind of juvenile which was disappointing for someone who actually wanted to get something out of the class.

He has a voice of a true poetl his tone is rich and indescribable. He is very intelligent and articule; this class is always my favorite class of the day. I used to hate writing, but now I like it- all because of him. He knows how to teach, teaches effectively, and entertains the rest of us as well.
his tests are pretty hard but you should be fine if you keep up with the reading. can put anybody to sleep within 10 min.

I took him for 2 classes b/c he placed me in them as my advisor. He is so boring it's out of control. Although he isn't a difficult prof, he is EXTREMELY boring and frustrating when you're trying to feel excited about the subject. His speaking voice is annoying as well.

Freed gives very helpful tips and encourages his students to explore new styles of writing.  I strongly feel that my writing improved a great deal during that one semester.  As long as you approach each assignment sincerely and as he librally directs, you will enjoy success in his class.

Really nice guy who is very passionate about writing & stories. He picks on little things in your essays, but does so because he wants you to learn how to write properly. You get only 3 or 4 essays & alot of time to work on & reivise them. The class can be boring if you dont like discussing stories.
Nice man, insightful and interesting.  Lots of lecture, little discussion.  If you like that type of teacher and you're an English major, make friends with Walter Freed.

Freed is perhaps the most boring professor to ever grace Geneseo. His dry, neverending lecture is supplemented by well timed cane thrusts. The class is not overly hard but good luck staying awake through it!

He is very intelligent, and if you pay attention and attend class regularly, he will teach you a lot. Take his advice when he grades... your writing gets better! He doesn't assign too much, so the work load is incredibly light.
Really interesting fellow.  loves to cut us off and his essay arent that bad
don't even bother going to class

He's quite a character, but he's remarkably intelligent though he may not come off that way to some. If you aren't put off by his slow teaching style, you may actually learn a great deal from him. I don't mean that in a negative way.
Definetly a sleep through. Likes to douse my papers in red, i hate grammar. Terribly boring, he's into it but no one else is.
Eeasy class, he just speaks so slow and don't get him started on the word "like" or "cool"

Well he knows what he's talking about if you can stay awake long enough to try and follow him.  Not a bad guy or a bad teacher, he...just....speaks....reallly....slowly.....and...in....a...monotone....
No Comments

I want him to be my grandpa/uncle.  He's so nice and gets so into it.

She's a sweetheart, and tries her best to explain things thoroughly in class, but her tests are pretty hard unless you've already learned the material prior to taking the class. Makes class very not-boring!

She's super cute and bubbly! I enjoyed having her as my professor and I'm kinda upset that she's leaving :( Overall this class was somewhat hard for me. The material was understandable but you think you're doing great in the class until she gives you your grades... If she was still teaching, I would totally recommend her!!

I like her. She's really bubbly and happy. She may not be able to clarify what you've done wrong on previous tests because she never goes over them. But her material isn't cumulative so I don't think you need to go over it. Her tests are harder than what she teaches in class, however. I suggest practice. I barely did anything, however.

If you are looking for a 140 class, I suggest you take Donald House. This woman was not a good teacher and her tests are hard. They have a lot more to do with explaining than math. The stuff she teaches in class was easy but it was so different from the test. I highly suggest you take House, he is an easy A and is the nicest guy ever.

Barbara's a really great teacher. Overall she's just a very enthusiastic and nice lady, and I would reccomend her to anyone. A little scatterbrained but she's still enjoyable to be in class with and has no problems with you calling out any mistakes she may make.

Stewart is great! Not only is her class easy, but she makes class interesting and fun. She's also very open when it comes to student opinions. If the entire class has a problem with something, she will almost always negotiate with us and help us out! I would absolutely take her class if you can! She's awesome!!!
Best class ever!  Its so easy and a lot of fun!

She is one of the most eccentric people I've ever met. She'll most definitely keep your attention. If you are not great at math, you might struggle, so I suggest do ALL the homeworks and whatever she assigns before class- whatever you don't get go to her office hours. She is great explaining one-on-one. Be a kid, and you'll enjoy this class.

i had a bumpy start by sitting in the back, texting and not doing any hw.  at this point i had a 62.  Toward the end of the semester i attended office hours twice a week and her one-on-one sessions were great.  not only did i pass my last two exams, but i bumped my average up from a D- to a C+.  She's great!!

She is the reason I get through my week! I have her two days a week T+R for 2 hours each! She is a ball of delightful energy and is always laughing! I don't think she can have a bad day! She will explain anything you need help on and is willing to spend as much 1:1 time with you as you need! She won't give you the answer but helps you! (A-)

Hands down the best option for calc I. She gives good notes and does a nice job explaining the equations and such. Tests are very difficult and much harder than the material she teaches. Gives opportunities for extra credit. Nice lady, good professor

Terrible at explaining things and she made calc confusing and impossible. I'm not bad at math, but all she did was write equations on the board without explaining them and expected you to use them during the exam. And the exams are HARD. Don't get me wrong, she's a wonderful lady, but a horrible professor.

Barby-Stews is awesome.  She's a little kooky, but makes class fun.  Probably the best professor for Calc I.  Calc in general isn't the easiet subject but she does pretty well.  Also gives a a few good opportunities for extra credit.  Take her if you can.
Loved her.  Online homework helps boost your grade!  Math is not my thing but I managed an A because she was always willing to help at office hours.

Take her if you can! Explains everything so well and gives great examples. Grade is based completely on tests and quizzes, but quizzes are usually take home or group work. She also gives plenty of opportunity for extra credit, but it's not needed to do well. Doesn't collect homework but you need to complete it do keep up and do well. Take her!

not exactly the BEST at explaining things (especially for someone who's not great in math), but is incredibly nice and accommodating. she's always willing to help and modifies instruction one-on-one in a way that you will understand. definitely see her in her office if you don't understand something! i'd recommend her.

I have never been particularily good at math but I got an A+ in her class. Barb rocks. Class is very organized and if you actually put in the effort you will succeed. She is excellent at getting the point across and is very fair. One of my favorite professors so far..wish calc 2 could have gone as well..ha
she's bubbly as hell, she has one of the strangest laughs you'll ever hear, but she keeps you awake and is generally very helpful outside class. highly recommended-
VERY NICE WOMAN!! Very helpful ourside of class.  Does move fast so if you don't understand something you have to go see her about it.  tests can be tricky but not unmanagable.
WONDERFUL professor. She was always energetic and made the class interesting and fun, which is very difficult at 8am!! I highly recommend taking a class from her!
Great professor!  Always energetic and makes class interesting even for a 9:30!  I recommend taking her classes! She really loves what she does and is always there to help.

Love her! Very interesting, energetic and an all around good teacher. She is a little strange (you'll notice her singing to herself when ever she's not talking)but you'll never fall asleep in this class!

She is AWESOME!  The nicest lady ever.  She is very helpful and explains the material very thoroughly.  She's very energetic and you can tell she loves what she is doing!  Love the class, and will take whatever classes I can from her!

Babs is awesome! Possibly the nicest professor at Geneseo. I was sick and had to leave class early one day and after class she came and sat with me at the Health center. The class is fairly easy and interesting.
a kooky lady but explains stuff well.

A little frusterating because she has students grade rotate and grade papers, and for some reason, students hate to give their peers good grades, so it brings your average down. Other than that, easy class and she is a pretty easy teacher...a little weird
Good teacher. Very fair. A little on the strange side, but is really good. I advise taking her for Math 140 or 141
wonderful professor and an easy class...explains things very clearly, and incorporates a lot of activites into the class
The class is a breeze as long as you put the proper time in to do the assignments. They can be very long and tedious but they're basic.
Everything is online, easy A if you put in the work

Classes can be dry, but Prof Wood is great. He wants you to learn, is always willing to help & doesn't give nonsense assignments- I learn from all of them. Tests are challenging, but very fair with no surprises-  as long as you read & study, you're golden. Highly recommended.
Its an easy A but you do not learn anything at all. He does not teach he just reads the slides he doesn't even make himself. Doesn't care at all.

Professor Wood is the man as long as you take initiative.  The class is set up such that if you want to succeed you can.  Going to class makes the course a lot easier, wouldn't recommend skipping out.

This guy does not teach. He just sits and answers questions. You do not learn ANYTHING by going to class. The class structure is "Learn it yourself and ask me if you need help." Class is an easy A if you keep asking for help with the problems. But the problems sets are super long and do not cover anything close to what he teaches.

Wood! He's honestly a really nice guy and willing to help if needed. He basically just runs through the slides, he doesn't teach. But there are 5 homework assignments and tests ALL online! pretty easy to get an A. I'd recommend him

He transformed from an attendance taking, demanding jerk to a laid back sarcastic guy within the first 3 weeks of class.  Grades are based on homework and tests which are all assigned online.  One downside is that he does not really cover material in lectures, but just skips through slides.  Review and come with questions or you wont learn anything

Didn't learn much in the class, but Dr. Klima is a sweetheart! She has high expectations but is flexible as long as you get the work done in a reasonable amount of time. She is very passionate about what she teaches which seems to get in the way of her organization skills. Would've liked to see more structure especially for a tough class like this.

Professor Klima is great to take INTD 105 with. Klima is deeply passionate about what she teaches and makes the content very engaging. She helps you learn vital writing and research skills throughout the course. Professor Klima is also very accessible during office hours and will always help you with any questions about assignments.

This is my second semester having Dr. Klima, and she is one of my favorite teachers and professors of all time! Her lectures are full of enthusiasm and energy, she offers half credit for quiz and test corrections, and you can tell she always thinks of her stud
Extremely harsh grader, is very unclear about assignments. Understanding in person but then gets bold over email
