comment: Probably the worst professor I've had at Geneseo. Very unclear with assignments. Tests and quizzes seem easy but she is a very hard grader. She is very nice but very ambigous with what she wants. Everyone is in the same boat where no one knows what is going on.
shes very eccentric! I really enjoy her class and it is an easy a if you study  a little bit every day!

Very nice person, and very passionate about German. However, she is unclear about assignments that she wants you to complete, and often will e-mail you with a new assignment within eight hours before it is due. If you ask questions she's very willing to help but if you email her she will complain that she has too many students emailing her.

She rants and does not even hint at what is important. It is the opposite of what teachers are supposed to do. She picks random identifications that are sometimes not even mentioned in class. It is really easy to get a B but the tests are too unfair to get an A. I wouldn't recommend this class.

I took this INTD Central European History because it was the only one left when I did my orientation I went in thinking it was going to be awful but Klima makes it interesting. She is a little weird so it makes class funnier. We watched a bunch of movies that weren't that bad, only wrote 1 paper over 2 pages I didnt open a book and got a b. Take it

A very nice person, very funny, but her classes are SO ANNOYING! She doesn't teach anything in class that's useful and goes off on tangents, but still gives very difficult tests on the subjects she didn't teach. Too much emphasis on translation an too little on grammar topics- if you don't speak up and ask questions, she'll never teach a topic.

Well this class pretty much gave her an excuse to rant however much she wanted to, but it was simple.  If your German is good before you take this, then you'll get a good grade.  If not, you'll have to work a lot!  She seems good at explaining hard grammar topics, and she's a very nice person.  Try not to get her angry though.

Learning a new language is a lot of work so the fact that she sometimes gives a lot of homework does make sense. Sometimes she'll email the assignments the day before it's due, some students don't even recevie the e-mail until 11pm that night. This may not be her fault though due to the server. Tests are pretty straight-forward. You'll learn alot.

Awful professor and very unhelpful. Classes are a completely unorganized waste of time. She goes on tangets and rambles on for half of lecture about meaningless crap. She also wears shirts two sizes too small. Not everyone wants to see her stomach! She seems like a nice person, but she's not a good professor.

AWESOME! Had her for German and it was a rough time, but in Humn (where she's speaking english) it's suuuper easy! If you get an A on your first paper, you don't have to write a second one. Lectures are fun and her stories are hilarious!

Horrible professor, but AMAZING person! Her stories are hilarious and make class totally worth going to, but don't except to learn much from her in the way of German. Lot's of talking about beer though... Lectures very unorganized and often times pointless. But she's a fun person.
I love Dr. Klima.
Very entertaining.  She makes class interesting.  Kind of a hard grader but she is fair.

Dr. Klima is great, very intelligent, funny and helpful.  I took this as a summer course and never dreaded going!  She has tons of GREAT stories and really just knows so many interesting things!  I loved this class because of her. I went all the time, participated in class, read just enough and got an A.  I really did learn so much b/c of HER!!!

Worst professor I've ever had.  The essays are impossible for you to write.  She loves to share her political and religious views on you.  All she does is ramble on and on and if you do not share her views she disregards you.  DO NOT TAKE HER!
Amazing... enough said...
Had Professor Klima for German and Hum. II.  I definitely enjoyed her for both.  Definitely demanded more of students in German, though.  Thanks in part to her, I'm fluent in German.

I cant say enough good things about this woman. I had her for humn over the summer... 3 hours every morning, & she made it completely bearable. She's got great stories, an adorable texas accent and is a wealth of knowledge about culture and language. Yes, when she gets excited her eyes do bug out of her head, and her texas drawl gets thicker. haha

Klima is absolutely insane, but in the best possible way. The three semesters of Russian I've taken are the best 3 semesters I've had at Geneseo. I'd totally hang out with her outside of class. Plus, I learned a whole lot.
Dr. Klima is a wonderful professor and really made Russian fun!!

Fabulous woman with huge eyes to keep you awake in the morning.  Discussion based classes, tests aren't too bad if you're in class.  Gives you extra credit for taking notes and seeing films.  LOVED her!!

If all of my classes were this fun and entertaining, I would never want to graduate.  Dr. Klima is simply amazing!  Russian is certainly no easy language, but Klima is fair and always encouraging.  & FUN! FUN! FUN!!!!  I'm so glad that I took this class!

She doesn't know what she's talking about.  She treats half the class like it's an amateur hour at a comedy cafe (her jokes suck!!) and the other half she just spouts unoriginal ideas that you could find on sparknotes or form yourself.  HER EYES BUG OUT OF HER HEAD!!!  Her paper topics are vague and boring.  Pick her if you like a Texas accent.

Amazing professor. love going to her class everyday. makes a hard language easy to understand. gives alot of work, but its all relevent. frequent tests, but not too hard. take her if u get the opportunity.

Dr. Klima is the best professor at Geneseo! She's so enthusiastic about what she teaches, and her sense of humor is great. She gives a lot of work, but it's all conducive to learning. Even if you hate languages, take a class with her. She'll make you love them.
Excellent teacher.  Always willing to help.  Is fair with grading and always tries to make things interesting with different assignments and activities.
Very smart woman---very helpful too! She was great for HUMN II!
She just rocks!!!
Dr.Klima is the best professor I've had in Geneseo. I highly recommend taking her classes, and getting to know her, she is a wonderful and intelligent woman!
Sometimes it seems like there is a lot of work, but in order to learn a language you need to do a lot of continuous work.  She is good teacher and a nice woman.
Probably the worst professor I've had hear as she thinks she knows more than she actually does.  Do not take her class because you'll regret it.
She favors people alot in her classes
Klima is great! Her enthusiasm and sense of humor make class enjoyable! Heavy work-load(lots of home-work), but she is fair with grading. I highly recommend her.
Dr. Klima is an awesome professor. Very intelligent & fun. Even if you're terrible with languages, she'll help you do great. Always willing to help you with anything. I definitely recommend her!
I actually learned a lot.  I loved her!

Awesome teacher! She made every class interesting and has a great sense of humor. Her comments on papers are helpful and she is always willing to go out of her way to help you understand something better. Highly recommend
Dr. Klima only teaches this Humn II class in the fall, at 8:05, but she is the best teacher I've had at Geneseo. She made class really interesting; she is an awesome teacher!!

Greatest professor in the school of education. She is very smart--she is more like a professor (instead of an extended high-school teacher). No paper, crayons, or "cute" activities. Go to office hours and talk with her, she has great ideas and is willing to help with key assignment. My unit was the best piece of work I ever completed.

Unprofessional - late to every class including the final. Pathological liar - will say one thing, will do another. Not available - will lie to you and say she's not available to meet when she clearly is, and won't take the time to even talk to you. Doesn't learn anyone's names, doesn't have a real grading system, and is the worst professor ever.
She is the bright spot in my semester.Dr. L. is awesome.
I just got my unit back and I can honestly say it is the best piece of work I have ever done. Dr.L. let me revise and helped me focus my lessons. This is a class where you learn something.

I am so done with this class. Dr. Lauricella has no idea what she's doing. She revised the syllabus 3 times without telling us. She baits-and-switches you on assignments. Her way of writing objectives is bunk, and she thinks iMovies are the best thing since sliced bread. I don't know how she hasn't gotten fired yet. She has made me hate teaching.

Dr. Lauricella expects a lot. I learned a lot and became interested in social studies--(I am a math concentrator)). Anyone who thinks education courses are easy sure have not had her. It was one of my favorite classes yet.

Hot mess! She is very vague in her expectations for assignments and fails to follow her syllabus in ll aspects of the course.She does not provide updates on your progress in the course until final grades. You don't know what she wants until it’s too late.She returns very few assignments with grades on them. Avoid her, its not worth the headache!!!

Such an awesome person and so wise...but this class was the hottest mess. If you know what's good for you, do the unit plan as she "suggests" you to do it, otherwise you'll be stuck with a 100-page project at the end of the semester. Good luck!
This was my favorite class this semester. Dr. Lauricella is awesome.

Dr. Lauricella is a kind person, but not someone I could have as a professor. It wasn't until we had another professor half way through the semester until I realized she wasn't that great of a professor. Her expectations are unclear, causing there to be inconsistency among grades. She does know a lot, I'll give her that, but her clarity is lacking.
great
She is my favorite professor. I love talking with her and hearing her views. Her classes (I have taken 2 with her) make me think hard about education and life in general. And, she is very kind.
I loved her, she is clear and really challenged my views. She made me revamp everything that I had taken true of education. Best professor at Geneseo.
She is my favorite professor in the school of education. She knows history and education. You'll love her too--she has a great personality and is fair.

Although she is somewhat disorganized and off topic in class, she is very intelligent and helpful if you talk to her individually. She wants to help her students and she forces you to think. Follow the syllabus and unit plan requirements and you will do well.

She's insane. You never know what she's talking about, never stays on topic. She did sit with me for over an hour going over my unit plan and gave me good ideas, but she's pretty unclear about what she wants. Doesn't tell us about assignments until the last minute. Makes us do huge assignments and doesn't grade/give feedback.

I love this lady...the time in class goes fast. I wish I could take her for more education courses because you have these moments of "oh, I get it!" and you start thinking about things in a different way.

She is great. I was just hired on-the-spot! I brought my unit plan and talked through the content and different methods (gotta love those DBQs) and the interview team asked if I could continue to develop curriculum. I feel like I could having gone through this course.

She is really useless. I had to redo my unit plan multiple times because she gave such unclear directions.  I wrote an amazing unit but because it was not what she was looking for, I had to do it all again.  She wants it to be 100 pages and if it is you will get an A.  Class is pointless and directions are totally not helpful.
I just picked up my unit plan from last semester and I can't believe all the comments...she cares about your work. I would recommend her, you'll learn a lot.

I loved Dr. Lauricella. She is different in her approach but not wacky--she is smart and makes you do the work...Anyone can lecture, she gives tons of ideas that I used to make the killer unit plan (which is the key assignment that is over 100 pages long). The class was awesome.

She's pretty wacky and the class is mostly useless. Considering this is the only class we get in social studies methods there are NO methods being taught. You don't have to go to class, she won't even notice. Just make a killer unit plan and you'll get an A.

I learned a lot. As a history major I learned about connecting content to students. Don't look for specific methods here though, you have to do this yourself with your unit plan...she doesn't like activities too much.

THE BEST AT GENESEO!! She is my favorite professor of all time. I was so frustrated at first and she helped me find an idea I could really be excited about. Every time I meet with her I feel like I can take on the world and be the greatest teacher ever.

Awesome Prof. Lauricella is knows a lot about social studies and education in general. She can remember page numbers of articles and books where we could look to find more about an idea (scary)! She is heady sometimes...but brilliant really. If no one else in education, you should expereince her.
The best professor I have ever had.  Learned a lot in this class.  Seems the only people who don?t like her are the ones that miss lots of classes or hand the work in late.
One of the best at Geneseo. Because of this course, I am excited to be teaching social studies and not dreading it. Was extremely helpful and personable. Can hardly wait to research with her.

This was the most useless class I ever took at Geneseo.  Lectures were pointless and random, and often had nothing to do with this course. Half way through the semester she decided that she wanted assignments to be graduate level. She has no idea how to stay on task and how to teach things that would be useful to me as a teacher.

I found this class to be boring and watered-down. Could've gotten an A on the final projects without ever attending class, but there were in class worksheets that you have to attend class for. For PSYC 390 Top: Psych Digital Everywhere.

Great class with amazing discussions. Graded on weekly discussions, class participation, and a group assignment at the end of the semester. Love Van Stolk shes an amazing professor and I loved this class.

Love love love Prof Van-Stolk, she's a great prof with very interesting lectures. Honestly fav class by far at Geneseo and I am a Junior Psych major! attending class was crucial in order to do well but the classes were interesting so it didnt feel like a chore. she gave good review sessions (with snacks) before exams and provided a study guide

QUEEN. She cares about the success of her students so much and she is so easy to reach out to. While attendance isn't mandatory she doesn't post her full slides in brightspace so show up to every class. Held test review sessions where she went over everything in detail and gave us snacks.

By far the best teacher at Geneseo. She's very easy to talk to and her lectures are actually interesting and she always makes in engaging. Hands down the best professor I have ever had. Genuinely cares about her students, passionate about what she teaches and wants everyone to succeed. Excellent

Awesome, chill guy. Deadlines are always flexible and you can turn things in whenever. Good instructor, moves at a good pace, really tailors his feedback according to individual ability. he's the absolute best!

Wonderful!  My best professor yet at Geneseo.  Gives great instruction for watercolor being such a difficult subject.  Always friendly, fair grader and easy to find and talk to.  Highly recommend even with no art experience.

I've had Tom for watercolor I, printmaking I and figure drawing I and every time i love him as a professor.  he is clear, nice, helpful and the best ever...he's like fatherly.  I recommend his classes to everyone, major and non-majors alike.

AWESOME GUY. AWESOME CLASS. i highly recommend this professor. he teaches watercolor like you've never done it before, giving good direction and feedback... but if you have done watercolor, you will still be challenged.

dr gravelin so so sweet and shes a really nice lady, and she really cares for her students. she is there for you both in and out of class.  but her psyc191 class was soo boring. it felt like a class meant for those who have never been to a school ever.

she is an absolute saint of a professor! she is so funny and kind and she's very knowledgeable about social psychology. she always makes class fun and I always walk to her class with a smile on my face. i HIGHLY recommend taking a class with her, you will not regret it one bit!

PSYC 191 as a freshman intro course that was half a semester was fully worth the time. She taught it very well and was always looking for class participation but not forcing it. Taught what the class wanted to learn and always asked for feedback and acted on that feedback.

I think Dr. G is a very kind and caring person, but I'll be honest and say that her exams are hard, and there are many assignments. (Psych 191 didn't have option on rate my)Great professor and person. Very understanding and knowledgeable on life in general not just her courses. This course was very helpful as a psych major highly recommend.

Dr. Gravelin is a very kind person. She facilitates thoughtful and interesting discussions in class. Don't believe rate my professor for her high ratings. Psych 251 is supposed to be an introductory class but she doesn't treat it that way. Grades tough just for fun. Get ready to sacrifice your GPA and mental health by taking this with her.

Class is geared towards graduate school or career depending on what your interested in after SUNY Geneseo. Dr. G is very respectful and helpful, if you need help on a assignment or looking at grad schools/careers Dr.G will spend her personal time helping you find what you are looking for.
One of the best professors I have encountered. Truly made me love the topic and truly cares about her students. Take advantage of office hours with her, it was so beneficial!!

Graded super harshly and didn't curve. Feedback was not applicable to assignments, if you want super good grades, go over assignments with her 20 times. A ridiculous amount (65+ pages) of work and writing. You have to do everything despite whether it makes a difference to you. Had a B- and the final was so harshly graded based on an unposted rubric

Gravelin's nice & accomodating online - but will all of the sudden drop a ton of work on you. A paper, create a website, a presentation, and a write-up due all during finals week. She could've spaced the assignments better so the final project and 2nd paper weren't due two days apart.

At the beginning of the semester, I thought this was going to be a pretty easy A/A-. However as the semester went on, especially the last month, Dr Gravelin began assigning a ton of work all at once. She grades the final paper very harshly which is what brought my grade from an A- to B+. Only take this class if you are very serious about your work

Ive taken two courses with Dr. G and worked with her outside of class. She is extremely patient and understanding with her expectations and deadlines. Her classes are cool and interactive. Lots of group work. Overall shes super cool and helpful.

Dr. G was one of the nicest professors I've had at Geneseo. All of her work is done with intent to prepare you for actually learning the material. There are reading quizzes due for every chapter in the book that are due before the lecture pertaining to the chapter. She puts so much effort into reading our papers and giving very good feedback. Extremely intelligent, I love her mannerisms and personality, so sweet, funny, gives lots of extra credit opportunities, and says that "this course is designed for you to succeed," goes over everything and practices with us, minimal work is done outside of class.

I love Dr. G. She's well-spoken, keeps class interesting and really cares about our progress. She struggled to keep us on schedule, but she always changed the syllabus to give us more time. Lots of outside quizzes/handouts, but they're pretty easy and if you do them, you'll get an A. She takes attendance, but policy isn't crazy.

Research Methods is typically a difficult class but with her the material was easy to learn. Good chances for extra credit too. Only down side hard grading on final paper

Was nervous taking a new professor at first but she was pretty helpful and clear about what she expected. She took attendence but you could miss a few classes if you wanted. You do need to do the readings because the notes you take are graded

Weekly readings with graded notes and group discussions, easy tests if you read the textbook and do the study guide, and two essays with over a month to write them and good feedback if you ask for it.

I love that Dr. Gravelin doesn't just lecture for hours. She really cares about her students and would definitely take a class with her again- I learned a lot!

Dr. Gravelin was new at teaching this year and it definitely showed.  However, her class was super enjoyable and well structured. Dr. Gravelin is an outstanding teacher. She genuinely cares about her students, and made a class like research methods actually enjoyable. It was very obvious that Gravelin was new to teaching. If you needs to take research methods, take it with her and it will be and easy A if you just show up to class. Everything is taught like high school. Biggest down fall was it took nearly a month for her to grade each assignment.
Literally the nicest professor I have ever met. Passionate about her students and what she teaches.

Content is very hard especially if you have no prior knowledge from hs. Prof is nice though, she grades her exams fairly, and is always willing to change syllabus/class if the class votes on it. Nice lady. All the notes are online but she takes attendence presumably for a grade so you should go. If you have any knowledge of economics from highschool than you should be able to do fairly well in this class, even if its a little bit.

Christy is honestly one of my favorite professors. She graduated from Genny not long ago and understands that you are a student with multiple classes and a lot of stress. She's so great! Two tests, 4 easy and short papers, and a group presentation with some participation thrown in. Such an easy class if you go, but it's not necessary that you do.

This professor is wonderful she is really funny to me. She is very clear of what she wants and expects from you. Her lectures are enjoyable but can be boring at times. really interesting to listen to, creates a comfortable class environment you know
