comment: Great person, very sweet and caring, just all over the place. Not clear with what's due, how to do it, and what needs to be done at all. Syllabus changes a lot over the course of the semester. Lots of reading and writing. Overall, she's a scatterbrain. Super nice and sweet, just all over the place, which means you will be all over the place too.

Discussions are great but she is NOT accessible outside of class. Literally did not respond to 1 email the entire semester. Did not grade anything for almost nearly all of the semester until the day before grades were due which then changed everything. She went back and changed grades that were put in bc everyone had an A. Very frustrating

Shes a great professor. Shes kind, funny, extremely flexible and understanding. The other comments about disorganization are true, as well as the sometimes not following the syllabus... however, those dont really hinder everything else as much as theyre just unfortunate. Anyhow, she grades very fair and will always make accommodations. Amazing

Dr. Adams is probably the nicest professor at Geneseo. Her class was really easy and the workload is super light. If you go to class and say at least one thing, you'll be fine. However, she's really disorganized and rarely on track in class. Assignments take months to be graded, so if you want organization, take someone else.

She is extremely unorganized. She changed the syllabus many times. Many mandatory assignments due non-class days every week. Online learning didnt change the course bc inclass was unproductive and unrelated to HW. Very slow to respond to emails. HUGE group project. Dont buy the Books I Used 2/5. Hard grader on papers. Offers little extracredit.

Dr. Adams is easily my favorite professor at Geneseo. A bit disorganized at times, yes, but she is always available for questions and takes the time to go through things you don't understand and understands the stress that other courses take on you.

so i took a class with professor adams and while she is a very nice person, she is also the most disorganized person i have ever met. nobody in our class knew what to read for class, she hardly followed the syllabus. we have two grades in for the entire semester and it is finals week. how can you do well in a class when there are no guidelines?????

She's a really neat, energetic person. However, the class is mostly discussion and half of the time I didn't feel like I gained anything from it. The whole class is based on 2 exams (written) and 2 papers, so it doesn't leave room for error.

Professor Adams is a super nice person but her lectures literally have nothing to do with the class. The only reason people show up is to take the quick one question quiz every single class. 3 papers and 1 presentation total. 13 weeks into the semester and she hasn't posted a single grade so I have no idea how I'm doing in the class.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: Class is pretty easy, but the lectures have literally nothing to do with the class. The only reason most people show up is to take the easy one question quiz administered at the beginning of EACH class. There are a few essays that are longer than necessary, but as long as you work hard on them it shouldn't be hard to get an A.

Prof. Adams is really into her subject. If you show interest yourself she really takes to that and helps you out a lot with feedback if you go and ask. She can be slightly disorganized at times but if you ask her she clarifies anything. Her quizzes for reading aren't hard as long as you read and she changed most of our exams to take homes.
I liked Professor Adams a lot. She could be disorganized at times but she seemed really interested in the subject and she was very chill. I'd recommend her.
Fairly easy class.  Quiz everday as attendance but they are extremely simple.  As long as you do the readings and somewhat listen you are fine.

Daily quizzes based on long readings. Her lectures are useless but she gives you a review sheet that makes it difficult to do poorly on a test. She's really nice and wants you to do well and genuinely has an interest in course materials.
Kind and willing to help any students that come in for advice! A lot of work, but very worth it.
Prof. Adams is brilliant and incredibly helpful if you seek it out. I definitely recommend her courses!
She's a really nice person, but the amount of work she expects can be a little overwhelming at times

Worst teacher I've had in college, including the community college I went to.  She expects everything of us but does NOTHING herself and doesn't seem to understand the material herself.  She talks about personal stuff that is completely unrelated but thinks that she's really cool or something... Couldn't stand being in class.

professor adams is just plain lazy... she reminds me of my high school teachers who tried to scare us into doing stuff but were scatter brained themselves.  its really annoying, but at least its easy to fake it in this class b/c i don't think she actually cares at all.  i would say don't take her unless you absolutely have to...

I dreaded going to this class because the professor was just dull and useless.  The reading for the class was great, but she ruined all of it.  I feel like I could teach the class better and I have no idea how she ever got a teaching job.

She is really bad.  It seems like she doesn't want to be in class at all and presents everything from a powerpoint which she reads right off of or she reads off a paper.  She expects you to respect every deadline and come to class every day when she NEVER has anything ready, always 'oops, forgot' something, and is just disorganized. Don't take her.

I'd recommend. She assigns lots of reading, but encourages you to use notes on the quizzes. She is a genuinely kind person who seems to care what is going on in a person's life. She is also interesting in her lectures. She does expect you to go above and beyond for an A.

adams is extremely disorganized and unclear about her expectations. she assigns things and then one class before they are due she has added on more to the assignment. she says she will provide study guides long before a test and we only receive them the night before the exa,m.

The professor is disorganized and at times unclear about things, but she tries. Extremely conversational (she'd just talk with us for the first few minutes of every class). Very nice and humorous. Lots of reading though.
nice woman. very funny and laid back. lots of work though.. but possibly b/c i had her for hist220

She says she wants one thing and a month later she actually says that she wants you to go way beyond what she had originally said! She doesn't update her study guide until 2 days before the test. You also never know what is going to be discussed in class because we really don't follow the syllabus. Her grading is very random!!!

Her grading is screwy. She says she wants one thing but when you hand it in she wants something different. To get a good grade she wants you to go above and beyond what she originally asked for. Her tests are not that bad. She gives you a study guide and you know exactly what will be on the test. She is a nice person.
Unclear expectations, I never knew what was going on! The class has potential to be interesting, but she flaked out halfway though.  No constructive feedback on papers, gives everyone a 90.
No Comments
Wasn't very nice and put me down quite a lot. For being a gen chem class he wasn't very helpful and made me feel bad about myself. I will not be continuing through chemistry because of this.

Webb is a great professor, I had him for 118 which isn't an option but his lectures are always good. Tests are representative of the material which can be difficult if you don't go to class a lot like me lol, but for the most part I did okay. I believe they aren't curved though. But overall he's a super great guy and kind professor

tags: ['Clear grading criteria', 'Beware of pop quizzes', 'Accessible outside class']
comment: The course material was challenging for me but Prof. Webb is always willing to answer questions and help. Great guy. Class exams don't get curved which is a big switch from other Chem. classes but he will give extra credit here and there or bonus points on exams to help students out.
I took him for CHEM100 but it wasn't an option on here, anyways, really chill dude, gives great feedback on assignments

mr. webb had to fill in for the friday section organic chemistry lab, and although he was a very sweet and helpful prof outside of class-- he is a very harsh grader. the lab average was 60-70, and there was no curve. it was very frustrating as I put in a lot of work and turned everything in time, yet I barely got into the B range.

tags: ['EXTRA CREDIT', 'Clear grading criteria', 'Beware of pop quizzes']
comment: Dr. Webb is amazing! Will listen to feedback/have conversation and offers lots of extra credit opportunities. Be aware that there are frequent pop quizzes on content and missing the class unexcused will result in a 0 for that quiz. Posts answer keys after due dates to allow you to determine where you lost points and why, he will always explain too!

tags: ['Tough grader', 'Gives good feedback', 'Beware of pop quizzes']
comment: He's a tough grader but very fair and gives lots of extra credit. He also genuinely tries to get to know students and is very accessible in office hours (he's also willing to answer questions whenever his office door is open) and by email. He's a great professor and I'd highly recommend him!

tags: ['Clear grading criteria', 'Gives good feedback', 'Accessible outside class']
comment: The class was challenging but that's expected for upper level chem courses but I enjoyed the class overall. He is always available to help with HW and is willing to explain and walk you through problems and he grades very fairly. Dr.Webb is by far one of the best chem professors I've worked with. Highly recommend!

I had him for Chem 330, 331, and 334. He is very easy to get ahold of and will help you work through the homework. His tests were difficult, but that comes with the territory of advanced chem classes. He gets to class early and he'll talk to you and get to know you. Overall one of the best professors I have ever had.
I had him for gen chem lab and he was amazing. He always made sure his lectures were short and concise. He responded to me multiple times after 9 the night before the lab was due.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'SO MANY PAPERS', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: Great professor, especially for an online course! Was very helpful, and would respond right away when contacting by emails. I learned a lot about international business from his PowerPoints and the material. Many papers and PowerPoints for projects, but it is manageable if you don't get behind. Would definitely recommend!!

Gives out a good amount of homework assignments, but they're all fairly easy and tend to be 1-2 page responses at most. Class is largely driven by group projects in which you and a partner present on an area (ex: economic or political environment) in a specific country. Really awesome guy who listens to feedback and genuinely cares about students.

Lectures are so boring and are not at all crucial for tests (which are online) and papers (many short papers + case studies). You can literally skip every class and still manage to pull out an A-. His grading are crazily arbitrary, my friend and I always compared our tests / paper but never get the same grade despite having the same answer.

Nice guy, easy class, poor professor.  All he does is tell stories about his job working with supermarkets and selling cool whip and bbq sauce.  If you want an easy A with minimal effort take it, but don't bother if you actually want to learn something.

Nolan is a poor teacher. He makes little attempt at understanding other viewpoints. Even after full explanation and answering all suggestions, he blows off your response and tells you that you didn't understand the material. Disappointing, although the class is extremely easy.

Nolan is an amazing professor! I took International Business with him, which is more of a practical course and I learned a lot. He definitely brings a different prospect into the classroom. His classes are interactive, he loves participation. The class was based on group presentations; no exams!
Jim Quinn is one of the best professors I have ever had. Always an opportunity for extra credit, and really engaging lectures. He is also extremely accommodating and truly cares about his students.

Good professor, sometimes its a boring class to sit through. Listen when he says what will be on the quizzes and tests. Read the notes and use them for the allowed cheat sheets for the tests and quizzes.

QUIZ HEAVY. This class definitly is challenging, so be prepared to put work in. You don't HAVE to read the textbook but it does help you understand the material a lot more. Even though Quinn drops your lowest quiz grade, gives extra credit opportunity, and curves your class grade DON'T rely on these factors to pass the class.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Graded by few things']
comment: I dont have much about the professor, considering at least 90% of the class was taught about another class by someone other than the professor. The few times he did teach class, it was boring and slow, talks more about his time at Kodak than anything. He has the potential to be a great professor, only if he would've taught the material of the class

Quinn Is able to keep lectures interesting with stories and examples that relate back to the topics he's going over. There are only 4 quizzes and 3 tests and he hints at what is going to be on them. Definitely one of the best professors here. Highly recommend taking a class with him.
Very caring professor. Not a lot of homework. Test and quiz questions are a little difficult but he uses a good curve. Love him

Quinn is a tough professor. His lectures are heavy and he often goes of on tangents and strays away from the important material. Only three quizzes and two tests the entire semester and those are the only assignments. I have studied so hard for everything and have still managed to fail every quiz and test. Offers up to three points of extra credit.

Professor Quinn goes on long tangents during his lectures that make it very difficult to pay attention and get a general idea of what he is talking about. His tests and quizzes are very application-heavy and quite confusing because there is no review for this type of question beforehand. You can study as much as you want and still fail.

Professor Quinn is very knowledgeable and passionate about Business Law. Very few assignments, 3 tests and 3 quizzes. Very easy tests/quizzes as he basically spoon feeds the questions on test/quizzes throughout lectures. Very amazing guy who makes law very interesting. Loved the class and professor!

Amazing Professor, he genuinely cares about his students and wants to see you succeed. Lots of experience and tests are pretty straight up, just make sure to write down any of the small details he adds in during lectures. Pay attention in the lectures and youll be fine.

Jim Quinn is one of the best professors I have had so far. The class was based off of 3 tests and 2 quizzes, so you have to do well on those to get a good grade. This wasn't hard to do as his lectures were very informative and actually interesting. He cares about his students and was very accommodating during the pandemic.

Prof Quinn is by far one the nicest and best professors I have had. The class grade mainly comes down to the three exams, each are based highly on his lectures, at least for his online zoom class. If you pay attention, take notes, and study, this class should be a breeze. I highly recommend taking his classes, he's the best!

Professor Quinn is by far the best professor that i have ever taken a class with, his tests are modeled after his notes which he makes very easy to follow and accessible outside of class, I look to see what classes i can take with him being the professor, 10/10 would recommend definitely take his class

He tries to make lectures fun and engaging. Sometimes class can get a little boring, but the cases are pretty interesting. He has two classes, one where you take a midterm and don't have hw, and one where you write a paper, have hw but don't take a midterm. His class is very doable if you study. Very intelligent and has a lot to share.

Everyone seems to love him. I thought he was ok. Tests are difficult (its law cant blame him) and graded on a curve. But the curve gets messed up because so many people cheat. I dont know if he lets it happen, but it was incredibly obvious he either literally couldnt see or didnt care. His lectures were good, entertaining to an extent.

Quinn is one of the most amazing people I've ever met, let alone taken classes from. Fantastically conveys information in a way that is engaging and memorable. He inspired me to go to law school. Even if you don't think you'll be interested in the material, TAKE HIS CLASS. You definitely will get something out of the class. Can't recommend enough.

tags: ['Respected', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS']
comment: Good lectures, he makes it interesting. But his tests and quizzes are filled with trick questions where you have to know very specific things.

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Caring']
comment: You need to read the textbook, not just the slides if you want to fully understand the class material. Good luck trying to write your own notes during the lecture because he goes lightning fast through the slides. The quizzes are designed to trick you. Go see him during office hours, this will help him get to know you.
Very good teacher, have to put in the work to do well. Not easy A or A-, but if you put in the time the results will defiantly show. Recommend going to cllass

Quinn does NOT LET YOU bring a cheat sheet to the midterm and final anymore. His lectures are insanely boring , the quizzes are very hard and I feel bad for any business major who needs to take this. You can put in 4 hours of studying and still manage to do poorly. He's a nice man but makes his class causes stress and is difficult for no reason.

tags: ['Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'TEST HEAVY']
comment: I have no idea why everyone is raving about him on this site. His quizzes are extremely difficult and he makes you study about 3 lectures with a bunch of material to ask the questions that you slightly missed or he barely went over. His material is boring, but he tries to make it interesting. However, his class is definitely NOT an easy A.

Didn't LOVE this class but he does his best to try and make a boring topic interesting He shows videos and lets us bring a cheat sheet to the midterm which is nice but I found the tests very difficult and a lot more advanced than what we went over in class I actually would study and still struggle with the tests

Professor Quinn is a genuinely good, smart man. However, he had a very difficult time controlling unnecessary and useless questions throughout the course. There would be class discussions about material that were not part of the curriculum. As a result, the lectures were difficult to follow and we didn't cover 4 units listed on the syllabus.

Probably one of the best professors in Geneseo, Quinn is a great guy. He has easy material (only didn't get an A because i got a 73 on the midterm. He is open to discussion on quizzes and such, and if you plead a good case he will change your score. He has a lot of real world knowledge, put up with my dumb questions, and makes lectures fun. Take it

Jim is a great guy! He is very sweet and cares about his students, sometimes he brings food in and gives it to you for answering questions. The material is very dry but he tries his best to make it a little more interesting. He's very accommodating as  well. There are 5 quizzes and 2 tests, all are curved and you can have a cheat sheet for tests.

He's the nicest dude out there. Gives out cupcakes, candy, food for answers sometimes. He's so intelligent, but not an ass about it. He will admit when he's not sure about something and he will 100% have a better understand of it by the next class and give a better explanation. So helpful, so nice, gives extra credit and curves quizzes.
NICEST MAN ALIVE. he is so kind and willing to help anyone. it's a boring class, but he tries his best to make it interesting. if you need to take Blaw, make sure you get Quinn.

Took MGMT263 as an elective; it was very interesting. His powerpoints are dull and long, but the quizzes are generally easy. What he presents is what is on the test. Nothing is that confusing as long as you study. He gives extra credit opportunities and allows a cheat sheet for the final.

Quinn is a great teacher, tried hard and suceeded in making a dry class more fun and interesting. I always attended class but more than half the class never showed up and it didn't matter because all the power points he used for class were online! Didn't really need the hefty textbook that the class required so skip out on it-it was pricy!

Took him for 263 and now 264. He's the man. You can get a 1% grade boost and the curve is very generous. Participation is important because if you're between a letter grade (he rounds up from .5, though) such as having an 89 instead of 90, he'll give you the boost if you participated. Quinn is the best professor I've ever had. Take him.

I think Quinn might be the nicest professor at Geneseo. You won't do well on his exams if you don't adequately prepare, but he is clear about what is on them, so study and you'll do fine. He lets you have large index cards or a half of a notebook sheet for the midterm and final. And again, he's the sweetest man ever.

Only two tests for 60% of your grade but he has a phenomenal curve. Class average gets curved to a B+ so just beat the class rather than beat his tests.  He is helpful, gives good feedback and is an all around amazing professor. Recommend highly.  Basically all test questions are covered in in class lectures so the textbook is a bit unnecessary.

Definitely by far one of the best professors at Geneseo. BLaw is difficult but Quinn tries really hard to help students understand the material.  He helps you by allowing a cheat sheet for the two exams, holds multiple review sessions, offers extra credit and quizzes are always curved. He is always available for help. Would definitely take again.

Quizzes can be pretty difficult, but he curves to an 85, so it can be easy to get a 95 on a quiz you didn't study for just because everyone else bombed it. Jim makes law a lot more interesting than it really is and I can't imagine having a much better professor for the class.

Quinn is honestly the greatest professor Ive had at Geneseo. Makes a boring class interesting and cares a lot about his students. Midterm and Final with quizzes throughout the semester. Tests are hit or miss with difficulty, but overall not that bad of class. Took a class I dreaded to making me consider law school upon graduation. Quinn is the bomb

Quinn is a really nice guy. Its a law class so generally the material is pretty dry and boring, but he does his best to keep you interested. His test review sessions really help. Study for the exams and you'll do well, also lets you bring an index card in with notes. Only a midterm and a final, and quizzes throughout the semester.
Professor Quinn is a fantastic professor.
He's one of the best professors in SUNY Geneseo. everything about him is so great. He always brings foods to class as well.

He is an amazing professor! He helps everyone out and is very clear about what is expected. Very good about letting you take exams the following class if you have to miss and quizzes are very easy. Midterms and Finals you're allowed an index card. Material very interesting as well and very clear.

Professor Quinn is THE man. He will do anything and everything to help any of his students. Took this class as a requirement for my Accounting major, and was not looking forward to it. By the end of the semester he has me thinking about law school. Cant wait for MGMT 264 this coming spring with him! Definitely take his class- you wont regret it!

Professor Quinn cares more about his students' success than any other professor I've had at Geneseo. He does everything he can to keep students interested in topics that are commonly thought of as dry. Since he allows an index card "cheat sheet" on exams, it isn't too difficult. Definitely take a class with him- he's a really nice and cool guy.

Quizzes: 30%, Midterm: 30%, Final: 40%. The two exams are curved. This guy is the man. Graduated from BC for undergrad and Cornell Law. Very laid back. Makes class enjoyable. By the end of the semester, he will have you considering law school. I definitely recommend

Definitely one of the best professors I've ever had. He is so good to talk to if you are interested in law school and he really wants everyone to do well in his classes. Tests are curved nicely so doing well is not hard as long as you put in some work.

LOVE HIM! I took this class on a whim wondering if I wanted to be a business minor and literally fell in love with this class and now maybe even law school. The class is not hard! A midterm and a final (which you're allowed to bring an index card of info with you) and 6 quizzes. There are bonus points, and he is so helpful! An AMAZING professor!

Professor Quinn is a great professor. He's funny and really wants his students to succeed. He used to be a lawyer and has a lot of personal experience to add to the class which keeps you interested. He's pleasant, clear, approachable and responsive. Highly recommended.

Great class! It's helpful to read the textbook, but Quinn's lectures are very thorough. He also holds review sessions and law school info sessions! You can tell that he is passionate, and you will appreciate his humor! My favorite teacher! Highly suggested!
So helpful, went out of his way to hold review sessions and even a law school information session for interested students.  Pretty funny and truly passionate about law.  Highly recommended

Easy grader but the trade off is having to deal with an egotistical person who loves belittling students. Imagine if Dwight Shrute was your professor. I got up to use the bathroom and he shouted “OK BYE, DON'T FORGET TO WRITE!” in front of the entire lecture hall. Humiliating. He made me extremely uncomfortable

This professor is the most petty grader I have ever had.  He takes points off for the most minuscule and non-important details.  Will literally comb through your excel and take points off for a wrong parenthesis.  The reasoning given for taking points off is so vague.  Put wrong grades into the grade book that I had to pester him to change.  beware

He needs to retire already. He's very rude and not considerate. He grades very!! hard, he doesn't explain experiments, students always correct him, he gets annoyed and makes fun of you whenever you ask a question. Also when he gets upset at students, his favorite thing to tell them is to "take us around back and hang us" and other gruesome stuff.

HORRIBLE. Even the best students beware. He makes up half of the grades he enters into the computer. I had to refute most grades I had in this class, even get a grade changed the semester after because he incorrectly entered my final project as a zero. If he's not getting mad at you for asking for a grade correction, he'll be dozing off during lab.

tags: ['Tough grader', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Beware of pop quizzes']
comment: I took general physics I lab with Adelson. Only a 1-credit lab, but I ended up being more stressed about this lab than any of my other classes. He grades very harshly and everything is only out of a few points, so your average goes down quick. Not a very nice or accessible guy either, which made everything more stressful in and out of lab.

He doesn't know how to do the material which he is teaching. Zooms through power points and talks in a monotone voice making it impossible to get the notes down without falling asleep. gave us an extra test on the last day of classes a week before the final. Says there's no curve but almost certain he is going to have to

He doesn't know how to answer the questions that he's given, and gets angry when they're asked. Just reads off of the powerpoint slides made back in 2010, and expects you to understand and do things yourself. Exams are okay, not quite impossible, but there were 4 exams plus a final with no curve and half of the class failing...

Horrible professor,  assigned homework randomly and expected them done the next day without announcing them. Tests are ridiculous and never cover the class material. He never explains anything well in class and his notation is awful along with his handwriting.  Labs are frequent and long usually 10+ page reports.  DO NOT TAKE THIS PROF IS YOU CAN.

If you take this lab be ready, he answers your questions by saying what you asked him back to you and walking away. I put huge effort towards this class and managed a B-. His "pre lab lecture" is almost completely irrelevant to the lab and mostly nonsense. Also his knowledge of calculus was beaten by a student in calc 3. Also sleeps in lab a lot.
Very tough. He sleeps through most of class.
For a class that was supposed to be an easy A as a lab, Adelson made my life a living hell just so i could scrounge around for a C

His lectures are very general and do not apply to the homework or the exams. The homeworks are so far fetched and take hours to complete. Exams are similar to homework but harder.He has trouble addressing questions in class and out of class.

Does not understand the material he is trying to teach. Class and textbook are both useless, tests are taken from the other section's teacher and so not related to class material. Gets angry or frustrated at in-class questions. Exams and final completely from homework, which he cannot help with and gets wrong himself. Useless and shouldn't teach.

Very thankful this guy was available to teach this section of physics, which is usually not offered in the fall. Tests are hard need to read the notes he gives and the text book diligently to do well on. Having notes and text book out also helps with online HW problems.
Bad bad bad. Doesn't answer questions with any clarity, talks down to people that ask questions. Tests are a few notches above the homework that he gives.
Wow... just wow. Never seen anything quite like him.

Still wondering why he is a professor at this school. This guy makes no effort to teach, instead he zooms through his slides and assumes we know what he is talking about(Im sure he doesnt even know). He often repeals statements and uses poor examples. Dont take his class. If you have to, pray for a curve.

Made Physics lab a lot harder than it needed to be. He will help you a little if you visit him in office hours but he was't very friendly toward questions. I love physics, but this class was a BAD experience for me.
Worst Professor ever. The end.

Adelson, where do I start? Lecture is  useless because he just goes through the book. The book is useless. CAPA questions are the only things you need to worry about, and the book doesn't help so go to the physics learning center. Adelson literally has no idea what he's talking about. Tests are pulled from the homework...EASY! Final is impossible.
kind of a corky guy but he means well he just shouldn't be teaching. doesn't try to trip you up on exams class is straightforward but certainly not rivetting

Really nice guy. Puts up all of his powerpoints online after class. Unfortunately he sometimes gives you online CAPA assignments/quizzes on topics that he hasn't covered in lecture yet... If you use your textbook you'll be fine. It's a hard class. He's not going to hold your hand.
He is actually the least helpful professor that I have ever had.

Adelson is a professor like no other. His class is long and entirely uninteresting. His presence drains the physics from the room. Asking him a question yields no help, only some poorly executed wry humour and a belief that you should be able to do it yourself.(likely because he can't) I also have a sneaking suspicion that he is, in fact, a bear.

To say he is incompitent would be a drastic understatement. His inability to comprehend any of the material covered coupled with his abbrassive, annoying, intruding personality makes me dread that class every week. Avoid him at all costs. Even a brief encounter with this man could cause a drop in your IQ. I hope your sake he retires.

He is refered to as "Mr.", not "Professor". The first indication of his incomptencey. He does not have any idea knowledge of physics and only serves to further confuse students. The class would be better off with only the lab manual and nessecary lab equipment. How he is employed here is a mystery to me. NEVER TAKE ANY CLASS WITH HIM!!!

Oh, you're looking at Lawrence Adelson's page? I bet you expect him to have low ratings, right? Why d'you think that? Is it because he's annoying? He is annoying. You are justified to think that he is bad. He is bad. Did you see The Final Destination? The 3D one? He is worse than that movie and that movie's bad. It had no plot! It had no resolution

You may notice that he looks like Wolf Blitzer. This is the high point of his existence. He is deliberately annoying, refuses to answer simple questions and will mock students in what he believes are subtle, witty ways. Also, he's incompetent. He is bad at his job. BAD. He is the Stalin of the sucky physics lab instructors. He is sadness incarnate.
The worst professor ever. He's adjunct for a reason. Extremely rude and useless in office hours. Budget cuts are the only reason this man has a job anyways.

The phrase "dangerously incompetent" comes to mind when thinking of him.  He doesn't actively try and fail you, and actually grades very easily, but that's because he has almost no idea what he's doing almost all the time, and unless you know what's going on already, you need to do extra work to pass.

Very unorganized. I was in his summer physics2 class. By the 2nd week we were almost 1 week behind in lecture. We were given only half of the syllabus at the start of the class. The professors explanation was that he did not finish it yet, but we never did receive the rest of it. professor was never prepared for class. overall not a good experience

He's not your standard professor and many kids in the class were upset by that, but if you overlook that and realize he's not as serious as you may think he is, he can be enjoyable. Pretty easy grader and found that he did well in lectures.
By far the worst professor I have ever had. Kept me at a B+ even though my average was an 89.85. I don't think he tries to be rude but just comes off like that.

Adelson seemed to have known what he was talking about. He was great in that he went through homework with us and taught us new things. But, when it came time for exams, you'd see things that are similar to what he taught just at an extremely advanced level. He had to curve every single one of his exams.

Terrible teaching skills, went from engineer to professor without learning how to teach. he seems like a pretty smart guy but he should not be teaching other people. never got the right answer when doing problems on the board
He's not as bad as you might think, its just a hard class.

Nice guy, but has good & bad days; some classes are very on track & organized, and others, he can't get the right answers or explain his own examples. I had Probability and statistics with him.. I can only imagine the hell those in Calculus are facing!

Cannot recommend Professor P enough. So sweet and caring, uses personal anecdotes of raising her children to connect to course curriculum. Exams are easy and follow the practice quizzes, she even makes Kahoots of exam content to help you prepare. An easy grade and a good time.

By far my favorite professor I've had so far, it is very clear how much passion she has for teaching and all students. She talks a lot in lecture, some not relevant. she has quizzes and ASR's that reflect what's on the exams. She is very understanding and I highly recommend taking her class.
Very easy class but the elementary style teaching is very aggravating at 6 PM on a Thursday.
lowkey half her lecture slides have nothing to do with what were tested on. just read the textbook and look over the ASRs/ other study materials she provides

She is not at all accessible outside of class. She is really nice, but it is sort of like being in a 3rd grade classroom although I do appreciate her trying to make the class fun sometimes the amount of stuff that we do in the beginning and the end can be a lot especially if you are having a bad day. The tests are easy and online, but in person.

Prof P is the most caring professor I've ever had and I'm so thankful I had her for PSYC215. Quizzes are all online, sometimes tests too. She is the sweetest professor and super understanding. She is here to teach her real world experience not just lecturing off slides. She has exams but she prepares you really well. She gives you lots of materials that you can go over like kahoots and study guides that really help.
Professor Piscani is the nicest lady ever, I am not even a psych major and I took this class as an outside major requirement. Super easy and sweet! I would definitely take from her again.

She was awesome. Easily the best professor I have ever had at Geneseo and in general. Her class is mandatory to attend, but it is very engaging. I had one super easy paper and four exams including a final which she gave us online!!! Would definitely take her.

Loved her. She was so sweet and always had good lectures. I learned more from her in a semester than I did in high school. Any question you have she will answer. She ties content in to real world scenarios which helps. She has online quizzes and 4 exams, including final. Only the final was in person. Cancels class often. PowerPoints are distributed
Literally so kind, I learned a lot about teaching from her. Always gave candy and I always found myself thinking about what we talked about outside of class.

Piscani is by far the best professor I have ever seen. She is caring, thoughtful, and fun. She makes sure every question is answered in depth as well as committing so much of her time to make sure we understand the material. Her lectures are interesting as well as informative. Also she gives out candy, which is a huge bonus.

Sara Piscani is the most amazing inspirational professor ever. She does everything she can to learn more about her many professions. She cares about her students and when a student comes up to her with a hypothetical she helps figure it out. Lectures are so interesting and easy to follow. Take her class.
She was an incredible professor. Take her class

I have never in my years of school life gotten a good professor that actually teaches in a way that everyone can understand. Piscani is very understanding and genuinely loves what she does, if you need help DO NOT HESITATE to contact her, she will be there for you and is extremely understanding!! I can assure you, you will have fun in this class!!!
She is just the best, so caring, loves her students, and is incredibly understanding!

piscani had to be the best prof i've had so far at geneseo. she's extremely understanding if you need to make up any missed work, and is willing to listen to you with all ears. she has got to be one of the sweetest ladies i've met. the lectures are always posted, and the exam questions come right off the notes. 100% would have her as my prof again.

She is the best professor that I have had so far at this school. She is super enthusiastic about the topics and makes learning about them interesting. I definitely recommend taking a course with her. She really cares for her students and wants us to succeed.

SARA PISCANI IS THE BEST PROFESSOR AND PERSON I HAVE EVER MET. She is SO empathetic, kind hearted, understanding, and fair. On top of that, she is an amazing teacher and makes learning fun. This is the only class I've enjoyed this year, all thanks to her.
