comment: She's very good at explaining confusing topics and breaking things down. She seems intimidating at first, but genuinely wants you to succeed and makes herself available if you need help. The only thing you're graded on is tests and there's no homework, but if you study the lecture notes and do the practice problems before tests, it's an easy A.

She is an extremely rude professor, yells at students all the time. However, she is a fair grader and very passionate about her Animal Behavior Class. Work on the paper early because its long and tedious and she takes the time to go over every detail. Her exams are straight-forward and she gives a study guide.

She gives NO HOMEWORK,  classes are basically all writing notes from her pwpts. Be sure to keep up, you don't need to participate, she doesn't care, but she loves it when you ask questions. DO THE PROBLEMS IN THE BACK OF THE BOOK to prepare for her tests, GO TO THE REVIEW SESSIONS before the test and you will be fine! Help is always avail!!!

Very easy class and GPA booster. Do like half the problems at the end of the chapters in the textbook and go to the review sessions and youre golden. Easy A. My lowest test grade was a 93. Definitely would recommend her over other 250 professors. Others are very hard.

Completely unapproachable and demeaning. She has no consideration for other human beings. I love animals which is why I took 338 with her because she is the only person who teaches it. The class isn't the worst if you plan ahead and put in the time and effort. But still, I'm not sure if the class is worth taking because she is extremely unkind.

Probably the easiest class I took at this school. She is very clear and knows what she's talking about. She can be condescending and unapproachable though. If you go to class and do the end of chapter problems that's an easy A!
This class is a must before you graduate! Get on her good side!

I tried my best, but I do not like Ruddy. She is unapproachable & is condescending when you ask her questions. Thankfully, her syllabus, study guides, & notes are very straight forward. The only reason I continue to take her class was because it was an easy A. If you have someone to give you past notes, going to class & the textbook are a waste.
A goddess. If you have an extremely low self esteem you probably think she's not approachable. You just gotta know how to talk to her and trust me she's very nice.

Ruddy is the easiest teacher, its like being back in 3rd grade. She's not approachable or polite, but go to class and you won't have to read the book or ask questions. Make sure to do the end of chapter problems, because they're harder than the test questions. Go to the SI sessions before tests and you're golden. Easy A!

CRAZY LADY!!! Her notes are helpful and the textbook is the most important part of the class. I am terrible at Math and I managed just fine. Don't bother asking questions in class or out she is not appreciable.

Really great professor. Lecture is easy to follow even if you're not great at math. Doing the problems in the textbook guarantees you an A on the test because  the test questions are way easier. Very unapproachable outside of class due to her hot and cold personality. But the class was easy and I feel like I really learned stats.

Class is easy and sometimes interesting but she needs to leave Geneseo. Easily the most unapproachable PERSON I've ever met nevermind professor. Absolutely unhelpful and rude, ANYONE would be better for teaching this course. Take her class for an A and then ruin her on the SOFIs. Lets get her fired, seriously.

This class was so easy. Easy A for a stats requirement for bio majors. She can be rude at times and others shes super nice. The book breaks things down and was basically what got me an A in the course. Her exams are easier than the questions in the text book. Not the best lecturer, but the textbook is a great substitute. Definite GPA fluffer!

Love this woman. I have no idea how anyone can call her rude or what have you; she is one of the most helpful and carrying people I know. She knows the subject extremely well and does well teaching it. 3 multiple choice tests, 1 report (detailed table of contents). Don't need text if you go to class. Wish she taught more courses, really enjoy her.

Dr Ruddy is by far VERY INTERESTING....she is.... like  a Quinten Tarentino movie, multi-layered. Please by all means read the other reviews & chuckle.I did. Simply put she gets it.... if you need to pad the GPA... move on.... if you want to learn and be challenged then sign up. Like your hip parents she cannot be b'sted. We loved her!!!!

If math isn't your strongest subject you should go to class and get the notes. The tests are all multiple choice and are pretty easy as long as you go to class or read the book before the exam. The final was the hardest test for me because I missed so many of the classes prior to the test.  If you are good at math she will be extremely easy for you

She's definitely an interesting one, but I find it hilarious. Tests are extremely easy in that most of the questions are from the review book, GET IT. Final was the only difficult test. Class only lasts for about 20 out of the 50 min. I recommend.

Dr. Ruddy is pretty unapproachable and comes off as totally rude. But, animal behavior is definitely the easiest bio psych requirement fulfillment. You write a "table of contents," which I wrote in like 3 hours and got a 100 on. The tests are fair if you study, but she flies through notes at lightning speed, so be prepared to write your hand off.

AWFUL, AWFUL, AWFUL!!! She is a disgrace to the school and educational system; one of the rudest people I have ever met. Mean attitude and doesn't understand students at all. Class is ok, but STAY AWAY FROM HER! Her rudeness and unprofessionalism and boring style of teaching is the worst I have ever seen here. Arrogant/selfish; never wants to grade

Ruddy is a tad bit off her rocker, but she is definitely the easiest professor to take stats with. Her tests are all multiple choice and very easy, but she is painfully boring and will put you to sleep.
Extremely easy class.  Tests are straightforward if you just go to class and pay attention.  You really don't even need to read the textbook, but I did to be sure I knew the material.
Like Second Grade. Don't listen to the person below. Denim.
If you enjoy learning, getting good grades, and having a teacher who makes you feel good DO NOT TAKE RUDDY

Interesting intro class to animal. Very clear about what she wants on tests. A kind of scary and abrasive woman in class. Very helpful with my project in class. Not many questions on tests so if you blow a couple you are in trouble. Project is very easy

Fantastic teacher, as everyone says she's very special... Highly amusing to listen to. Doesn't put anything on the test that wasn't explained in class, wicked easy! If you do the practice problems you will get an A. Highly recommended.

She. is. an alien. an alien who does not teach i hardly went to class tho, when i did go i never took notes and i never cracked the book...gonna get an A/A-  def good way to punt but if you need statistical knowledge stray away

I wonder sometimes in class if she knows we exist... Very dry and boring. Notes prewritten on projection paper, hard to decipher. I did other homework during class. Not a lot of work, 4 tests, no homework, a great way to B.S. this requirement. If you go to class you don?t need the book. If you a serious about being a psych major take someone else.
She is a good teacher, but is a ****oo in real life.
Easiest. Class. Ever. Seriously.

What can I say? She is a special case. Not only is it very hard to follow her lecture notes as she erases them a few seconds she puts them up, she is also very condescending and rude if you come to her for help. Advice to everyone: DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS!

Do not take a class with her! She tries to come off as a professor that will help you BUT she won't. She will not listen to anything you say to her one on one. She may be easy but not even worth your time to deal with.
Ruddy is awesome! You can tell that she loves this material. Class was easy and fun. I fully recommend her :-)

This class is incredibly easy. She encourages questions but if you actually catch her attention long enough to ask one she is very rude and looks at you like you have 6 heads.  If she deems your question worth answering she will just kinda repeat back your question as a statement and nod enthusiastically.

I loved her, she goes pretty fast in class, which keeps you on your toes. She's a very strange lady though. She does a great job of explaining information. She's not very nice in person though she acts annoyed if you ask a question. Her tests are SO easy though. Go to class, take notes, and do some practice problems and you're golden.

you do not want to take this class with her. She is really hard to understand. I had no idea what was going on ever. I never missed a day of class and i couldn't believe i passed...but barely...i really would recommend taking this with a different prof. because this was bad

A little crazy, but adorable. If you have a question you need to really flag her down, as once she gets started lecturing she's like a train, or a bull, or a large round boulder that never changes her clothes. Material is easy, especially for a 200 level couse. As long as you show up chances are you'll get an A or B, even without doing the reading.

Obnoxious prof. should be considered legally senile. It is beyond easy material and an easy A but if you like to seek help DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. she doesn't believe in computers so emailing is useless. The most interesting part of the class= whether or not she owns 20 of the same shirt or wears the same thing each day.
Prof. Ruddy is a great prof.  She is very clear and concise.  She is easy to understand and is very enthusiastic.  Take her class.

Dr. Ruddy is a very nice professor. She gives silly ways to remember things (platy is flatty),but they work. Tests are very easy if you know the material, however, she sometimes makes questions relate to each other, such that if you got the first answer wrong, you will ALWAYS get the second one wrong, even if you employ the correct method.Recommend

DO NOT take this class with her unless you are comfortable teaching yourself from the book. Her slides are hard to follow, lectures are useless, and while she says that she welcomes questions, I found her to be very rude and condescending when interacting with students. I learned little and recommend taking your chances with someone else.
Her slides in class are extremely fast and often difficult to write down so quickly, but but class attendance isn't mandatory.  Her tests are very fair and what she's asking for is very clear.
very interesting class, loved it

nasty and bitter woman, non negotiable and hard to work with one on one, doesn't take any of your thoughts into consideration and if you don't meet her standards it's simple because you didn't care enough, even if you tried your hardest... miserable teacher

she isnt very nice. she gets impatient and annoyed very easily but she is very, very, very easy. while her slides are quick, everything is in the book and you can easily ace a test without going to class, at all...take her for stats
No Comments

I hate math with a passion so I hated this class but as a teacher she is okay. I found it easier to teach myself though, instead of trying to keep up with her. If you don't understand something she will answer any questions you have. she amuses me, I got her to watch ebaums the end of the world and the definition of the word f*** hahaha

This was defiantly not my favorite class and I found it challenging. Professor Ruddy did seem to really know what she was talking about but the pace of the class was fast. At times I had trouble keeping up and still really retaining the information.

If you keep up with the readings, take good notes, and pay attention in class, you will get through it just fine.  She works very hard to help you understand the course work, and has a good sense of humor.

She is very nice and willing to help...a little crazy and obsessed with the authors of the textbook.  Very clear, uses easy numbers and tries to make the course as easy as possible.  Tests aren't hard, and she gives the formulas.  It can be boring, but as long as you show up and take notes, you'll be fine.

The class was really easy. Ruddy use's basic numbers for her problems and does her best to make the material easy to learn. She is a little crazy but if you need an easy A then take psych stats with her.

The tests are OK, especially if you read the book. However it's very hard to take notes because she switches the slides so fast that you can't listen to her talk and copy at the same time, so it's very hard to get anything out of the actual class. Kind of a crazy personality but no biggy.
Easy, boring, all multiple choice exams, would reccomend

I'm not sure what all the high marks are for. I didn't think she was that great of a professor. She never left slides up for very long so students had trouble getting all the notes copied in time. I got better test grades when I didn't go to class and just studied the textbook the night before.
GO TO CLASS, pay attention and you have your self an A. a day or two of pre test studying and your're golden. Repetition helps you remember everything important. loves her subject! RECOMEND

She is incredibly enthusiastic about the subject matter. She points out the important things in the notes so well (different colors on overheads) that as long as you are conscious in class you'll know EXACTLY what to study. She makes an otherwise dull class a pleasant experience.
take this class with her if you can-- very easy A but you do have to study her notes and come to class- study her notes before the test and it will be an A.

Fabulous teacher. She makes stats. really easy but even so it's not a blow-off class. You need to go every day, study your notes and read the texts you'll have an A no problem. She lives by the syllabus so don't expect her to make any exceptions for you.  If you miss the test you will get a zero.
Easy A. Use the study guide and do the problems in the book before the test.  You don't have to read the text because she repeats the important info.

This class is easy if you go to class and do problems from the book before tests. The tests are multiple choice. She is very good at explaining things in ways that are easy to understand. I would recommend this class if you need a math requirement.

had no problem with her until I talked to her personally..was absolutely rude and insulting...not pleasent to look at, boring class involving taking notes very RAPIDLY...easy A, not a likeable person..also take note that she wears the same shirt everyday

Dr. Ruddy may seem a bit eccentric, but she genuinely cares and expresses great enthusiasm in her teaching.  I would recommend this class to anyone--It's not the most interesting material but her style makes it manageable.  She also repeats things often so it's easy to pick up on key concepts.

She's a little strange, but after a while it just becomes endearing.  She's a very sweet lady and an extremely good professor.  She does repeat herself a lot but it makes the material engrained in your brain without you even realizing it. Def take this class with her, all tests are mult. choice.
great prof, easy class, if you study the notes you don't really need the book, very helpful, kind of repetitive but it really helps you remember the stuff
Very repetitive, so understanding the material comes naturally if you go to class.  Lots of notes on the overhead.  4 exams, no homework.
easy course...a bit annoying...but still easy

Dr. Brookes never responded to any of my emails and did not grade a single assignment until the last week of the semester. The class wasn't too bad and she is a nice professor, but don't expect any outside communication from her.

This class was hybrid and she never once answered a single one of my several emails over the course of the semester. She also did not grade almost anything until the final week of the semester which she claimed was because of foot surgery she had during the first couple weeks of the semester. This class is very easy but I would find a dif professor

Dr. Brookes takes forever to respond to emails and grade assignments. She has a clear grading criteria and everything is laid out in the syllabus. Mandatory attendance. The workload for her class isn't bad. 2 papers, biweekly discussions, one informal presentation that takes 2 minutes, one final. While she isn't my favorite prof, shes not the worst
Super easy class I never even read the textbook and got an A because her lectures are so good.
Terrible Communication. Don't underestimate the tests. Doesn't respond to emails but will still grade heavily. Grades until the last minute. Don't even waste your time or breath. She's weird.

Professor Brookes seems like a decent person outside of being a professor but her class???
Criteria wasn't bad at all. Pretty easy and straightforward. I've emailed her multiple times about the class and no response. Takes forever to grade. It's just ironic how she teaches a communication class but doesn't know the first thing about communicating.

I took her coms 100 class online. Her exams were definitely more difficult than i expected. She took a very long time grading and never provided feedback for the final drafts before the final and still graded everything extremely harsh. I definitely would not recommend her especially for an intro level class as her expectations are unrealistic

I love Dr. Brookes. She is very nice, caring, and quirky in her own way. She tries her best to get the class to laugh. The class is long, but she will give a 10 minute break to make it feel shorter. All quizzes and tests are online which is nice. She does take forever to respond to emails, so best bet is to email the TAs.

Took Mass Media and Youth (COMN 452) with Brookes. The class is really interesting and the lectures made the almost two hour class go by in what felt like 15 minutes. My major complaint with Brookes is that she takes forever to grade and is such a harsh grader it is hard to boost your grade after a mistake. Should of had an A- but with Brookes, B.

Brookes is my favorite COMN professor. She has clear passion for media, entertainment, and applicable communication. I have taken 4 classes with her and loved every one. Readings are usually given to you, exams are straightforward based on a study guide, and lectures are lengthy but interesting. She is so sweet and has a fun nerdy personality.

Dr. Brookes has been nothing but a fantastic professor! The workload consisted of the following: a discussion post and responses to two other posts through Brightspace weekly, one weekly quiz, 3 sona research credits, and a paper due at the end of the semester. A really easy but super interesting class! Dr. B is approachable and down to earth!

Love this woman. Very fun, and she is super sweet. About two assignments and a quiz per week, but all very simple, though the quizzes are always like 9 questions so it can be hard if you get one wrong. The textbook is free online, and you will be using it for discussions as homework. Would absolutely take a class with her again.

This class rotated professors so students could get to know every professor in the comm department, but Prof Brookes was the main professor, and she was one of my favorites. One paper, weekly online quizzes and discussion posts. Can only miss 3 classes without it affecting your attendance grade. Made class interesting, I plan to take more with her.

Very nice teacher and accommodating. However her tests are very hard and have little to do with the study guide. Not only that but she takes forever to grade and grades papers very harshly. Personally I would find any other professor else but her.

This is not a college professor. She doesn't know how to engage students, she stands at the board all day and reads from a PowerPoint. This is the worst teacher I have had at this school. She is nice and you will get a good grade because the class is easy, but you won't feel like you learned anything. She will also take 3 years to grade your paper.

Dr. Brookes is very nice and usually accommodating. However, she is a slow grader. She also puts very specific information on her tests that make them basically impossible to do well on. She lectures for the entire class period and takes an attendance grade.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Graded by few things', 'Accessible outside class']
comment: Dr. Brookes is amazing. She makes class interesting and is a great professor and human overall. Class was great, exams were a little tough but nothing major. Highly recommend this prof.

Dr. Brookes is a great teacher. She is quirky and will try to make jokes while lecturing, but she's such a millennial they come off as corny sometimes. Her content is very interesting, but it is very lecture heavy. There are also weekly discussion posts which can get annoying. I don't have the best attendance but I was in almost all of her classes.

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Lecture heavy']
comment: Brookes is a really great professor, by the book and very easy to understand. She makes all of her lectures interesting and all the work is pretty straightforward. There are weekly assignments but they aren't actually hard, you just have to respond to the readings.

Absolutely fantastic. Brookes is so sweet, and her fun, nerdy personality makes lower-level comn. classes so much fun. Not to mention that she teaches some of the most interesting upper-level classes in the department. Would recommend her classes to anyone!

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Accessible outside class', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: She lectures a lot but puts everything online so its easily accessible if you skip class. Gives study guides that are literally the test so that makes it super easy. I like the way she teaches but she's very bubbly and energetic and goes on random tangents a lot so that can be kinda annoying especially for a morning class.

Lecture heavy, case study group project that you work on throughout the semester, online quizzes, exams. Very nice and very invested in her lectures. She is quirky and a very nice person overall. Whenever I emailed her, she got back to me super quick. She is awesome really

Brookes is very smart and invested in her courses. She is kind of awkward but she's a very nice person and easily accessible. However, lectures tend to drag. There are 2 papers that are really easy but almost all of your grade comes from 3 exams. You have to prepare a lot for the exams and ace them.

Dr. Brookes' public speaking class was ridiculously easy. She's very caring and understanding that students are nervous. As far as tests go, if you take notes from the slides you'll get all of those right, but I was surprised how much textbook info she puts on them. Overall she's very sweet and a very reasonable grader

She is absolutely amazing. She is every student's dream professor because she comes in with a great atitude, and she actually wants you to win. I've taken two classes with her and I found that you can skip the readings because her lectuers and study guides are thorough. She's so kind and helpfull. YAY Brookes!!!!!!!!!
Sarah Brookes is one of the sweetest people I have ever met. She is clearly passionate. Lectures are interesting and a lot comes from common sense. She genuinely wants everyone to succeed.

I absolutely ADORE Sarah Brookes!! She brings so much needed vibrancy and passion to the COMN department; her enthusiasm for teaching and for media is obvious to absolutely anyone. She's a genuinely nice person and really encourages classroom discussion in a non-intimidating manner. Easy A as long as you show up and read over her PowerPoints.

One of Geneseo's best. She's the dorkiest, most lovable professor here. Tests are easy and her study guides tell you everything you need to know. Papers are short and simple. You can also miss up to 3 classes without it hurting your grade, but you can just shoot her an email if you're sick/out of town and she'll be fine with it. Highly recommend!

Brookes is a super chill and quriky professor. She makes lectures relateable and interesting.  Tests are easy just review notes. Participation makes the lecture run faster. She is laid-back and very knowledgeable for her classes.

Public speaking is a terrifying class for most but Mrs. Brookes made it comfortable and doable. Not a harsh grader, tries to make dry material more intersting. Sweet woman, always answers emails quickly. Takes attendance,  you cannot miss class but most of the time you just sit their and listen to her anyways! Easy A if you put the work in!

Very easy for 300-level class. 3 easy papers, 2-3 pages. Wording on tests can be tricky... just take notes and skim them beforehand and you'll be fine. Gives a handy little study guide before each test, with important topics in bold. Goes over every chapter in lecture. Overall, very nice, young(er) professor who cares about the material.

McClure does not grade your understanding of material whatsoever only grades on the condition that you follow his prompt to a tee. Was over the word count on an essay and he took off 25 pts and then held a grudge over me on every assignment after that. Gave no feedback and didn't grade any assignments until the day grades were due.

First time taking an online class at Geneseo and my last class at Geneseo altogether. Glenn is extremely passionate about his work and it really shows. To be honest he's out of this college's league and it's frustrating to see such a great professor with students who couldn't care less. 10/10 gem

Glenn is a really nice guy; however, his grading is pretty arbitrary. He doesn't seem to care about content. To get the A, you much use short, declarative sentences and use up the entire word count. If he says that there is a 200 word maximum, you should write 198 words. Class is made up of 2 take-home exams, 1 in-class exam, 2 papers and final.

Glenn is a great guy who truly cares about his students. He can sometimes be a tough grader, but is always there to talk with you and help. Very passionate about the subject and makes learning humanities as enjoyable as it can be
Best HUMN professor at Geneseo.

I absolutely love McClure! I was terrified of Humn before I took it but he truly made it my favorite class, and that says a lot. He makes everything super easy to understand and I actually miss being in that class. Really wish I could've taken him for Humn 221 :/  Almost wrote a bad review so someone would drop it haha. You will love this class.

GLENNY BOY! Such a great man. Makes great connections and truly cares about his students and what he does. I was planning on dropping Humn before I started, but he made me enjoy the class! THREE CHEERS FOR GLENN!

I took Hum1 and INTD105 with Glenn.  I love this man! He has such a wonderful character.  he makes great connections that make the courses interesting.  tests and essays are very manageable.  sometimes he will honor the class with singing and banjor playing!  take every possible course with him :)

Overall, a pretty fair grader. His analogies get kind of annoying after a while and he definitely favors his music/education students in the class. He is pretty timely in answering emails and grades a lot easier than Herzman on exams.

I think shes overall a good person & had good intentions but she was a bit rude to me. She told me I had to come speak to her privately as if I did something wrong. I met with her & she told me I dont really like you at one point & how I dont smile enough & seem cold. Um no thanks I didnt ask. She also talked to my past teachers like really??

Dr. Falk is amazing! If you have the chance to take a class with her, do it! She is so sweet and her lectures are so fun and engaging. I always look forward to her class. She really cares about her students and has a lot of good tips for future teachers. I definitely recommend!

Love her, love her, love her! She is the best and makes the content feel like a cakewalk. Enjoys student input and makes it feel like a genuine discussion and not just a lecture but when she does lecture it is amazing and I appreciate her for it. 11/10 would love to take her again.

Prof. Falk is hands down one of my favorite teachers in the Education department. She's had so many years of experience, and clears any questions that you may have for her. She genuinely wants you to succeed, and has that mom-vibe. She cares. Definitely take a class with her if you have the chance.

Professor Falk is truly inspirational. After the first day of class, I knew I would love the whole semester with her. She cares more about actually teaching you how to TEACH than anything else and it is a refreshing and welcome change of pace. I so wish I could take more classes with her!!
Most amazing professor I have ever met in my life.  She is so genuine and I wish I could take more courses with her.  She is kind and understanding, make sure to go and talk to her.

There isn't enough nice things to about Falk. She goes out of her way to help you for class and life. She has 30  years of teaching and teaches you strategies you will really use. Her goal is to give you ways to help you stay in your job and be happy as well as effective. She is flexible and her classes are easy as long as you do the work.
People like her are the reason I want to teach. Absolutely brilliant in every sense of the word.

She is an absolutely amazing person and professor. You actually learn something valuable in her class (a new experience for me). She used to be an Elementary school teacher, so she has a lot of knowledge, stories and advice that she brings in the classroom. Loved the class and love Prof. Falk! She's the best prof I've had from Geneseo yet!

I love Prof. Falk. She is the nicest prof. anyone will have at Geneseo. She is caring and will go out of her way to help you. Also she brings experience and stories to her classes which make them more interesting. Definitely take a class with her, you won't regret it.
Such a great professor! I learned so much in this class that will really help me outside of Geneseo. Falk is a nice person who really cares about her students. Definitely take her class!!
Great teacher! Uses her 30 + years of teaching experience to give practical advice that I'll actually use when I teach. Challenging but very encouraging. Do all you can to try and get her.
Best teacher ever! If you are looking for real life information to apply to your future she is the teacher.

She is the best~She really made this class exciting and I learned so much from her.  She shows much enthusiasm when she teaches.  Quizzes were easy if you pay attention in class.  If you truly are interested in teaching then you will look forward to going to her class.

Falk's class was extremely easy but I learned so much from her. She teaches you so much about actually being in the classroom and her advice is stuff you can actually use when teaching. I learned more from hearing stories about her teaching than from lesson planning and doing all the other soe junk. Take a class with her!

One of my favorite professors in Geneseo.  Going to her class is fun and you always come out learning something or at the very least, hearing a funny story.  Workload is almost non-existent but I feel like I've learned more in this class than in classes with 10 times the work.  If you are ever given the chance, take Professor Falk!

SHE IS THE BEST TEACHER IN THE EDUCATION DEP. She give you strategies that you will actually use in your classroom not just useless philosophy. She's funny and makes you want to go to class. Its an EASY A, plus she makes you enjoy the work.

Easily my favorite professor at Geneseo.  She teaches you things that you will actually use as a teacher, which is a nice change.  If you can take a class with here DO IT!  She knows what she is talking about and is extremely helpful in and out of class.  It's an easy good grade and you will have a lot of fun going and participating in class!
easily my favorite professor. she makes me excited to go out and teach!
Best teacher at Geneseo. Unfortunately they might not be keeping her which would be the worst decision. She teaches you things you will actually use in real life. If you can take her definitely do.

So far my favorite professor at Geneseo.  I walk out of her class everyday excited to go into the world of teaching.  She was an elementary teacher for a number of years so she definitely knows what she is talking about.  She has AWESOME ideas for lessons, and shares them with the class frequently.  If you get a chance, take a class with her!!

Dr. Schneider is an amazing professor. She set up her curriculum so you rewire the way you study but if you just trust the process it is so rewarding. Her entire class is set up to grow with you and promotes academic confidence. I would recommend this course with Dr. S to any Psych majors as you will actually remember the material years later.

Doesn't use slides but there was lots of TA office hours if you needed, cared about you at least passing. Will work one on one with you to create a plan to pass the class or get help of your struggling.

Dr. Schneider is an amazing professor. Tests are 80% of your grade but she gives many opportunities for extra credit and is incredibly caring. She is lecture heavy so if you don't come to class you will fail but I found her class super interesting.

Dr. Schneider is an amazing professor. She gives many opportunities for extra credit and is incredibly caring. She is lecture heavy so if you don't come to class you will fail but I found her class super interesting. Great class to take if you are a psych major

Took this class with intention of being an easy credit filler in my schedule. Not easy whats so ever. She is a nice professor and means well, just her tests are all over the place. She doesn't do anything besides talk for an 1hr and 15 min and goes really fast. Hard to take notes.

Seems like a very nice lady, but your entire grade is based on 3 tests with 50 multiple-choice questions. If you want extra credit you have to go to check-ins, just to get one extra point on your test. Don't take this class as a filler, unless you're a psych major, because I don't know how it's possible to get a good grade on 150 mcq's.

I love her. She has lots of options available to help students and boost their grades, including good extra credit activities. She's very animated and engaging and speaks very well and clearly, making it easy to take notes. 10/10

She doesn't have notes that you write off of, it's mostly just her talking and you having to follow along with her and write your own notes. you will have to pay attention, read the textbooks, and go to the study review sessions if you want to do well in this class.

Loved her. Super sweet and my fav professor. She was super understanding when i had to go back home due to family member's passing and even helped me set myself up with the dean and explain my brief leave of access. I will say tho she doesn't really reply that fast and that attendance is a HUGE part of your grade. Test are straightfoward.
love this diva

Dr. Schneider's Psych 100 class lacks structure and flexibility. She relies on outlines and insists on one learning method—her own. When covering mental illness, she provided notes in case people were unable to attend because of the subject matter, but that was the only time I got anything out of lecture. I taught myself the course.

This class would be amazing if it was required for my degree. If I was a Psychology major or something, this class would definitely prepare you for upper level classes. If this class isn't required/ helpful to your major, I wouldn't suggest it. Not an easy A, and you learn a lot of stuff that you genuinely do not need to know. She really cares tho.
Every class is a lecture with class handouts.  Prof Schneider explains topics well and makes class interesting with her references.

She is extremely unorganized and easily gets off topic due to students asking random questions. She expects you to know background knowledge even though she never gives it to you. Even though her tests are open note they are insane, and she never understands why they take forever to complete even though each question has about 5-9 parts each.

Dr. Schneider is extremely accessible for non-majors. She is very knowledgeable and applies what you learn in class to real life things. The course is very much based on memorization and being able to regurgitate information, so it's pretty easy to do well on tests even without being super smart.

Very passionate about what she teaches and cares a lot about her students. She lectured without slides and often repeated herself multiple times. Some people may find this helpful but her classes were pretty boring. I could read the material in the textbook in 10 minutes what it took her an entire lecture to get through.

Dr Schneider is an extremely kind and understanding person. She really wants to see you succeed and takes you through each difficult aspect of the course step by step holding your hand. It is hard to take notes when she rambles (and it can be a bit overstimulating) but if you do what you're asked you will still do well in her class.

Monica Schneider is a very passionate professor who cares a lot about teaching but her class is really unorganized. She doesn't use PowerPoint slides and you have to take notes by ear. It also took her around a month to grade handouts and exams. Her 3 exams are open note but they're all written conceptual questions and are worth 60% of your grade.

No textbook all she does is talk at you for lecture and is ALL OVER THE PLACE while lecturing. Spends about 85% of class time answering students questions instead of actually teaching. Exams are honestly difficult but open note, however its impossible to take notes when all she does is ramble nonsense instead of teaching. Also uses no slideshows

She is so nice explain things in multiple ways to make digestible. she makes it easy to get extra credit, sometimes her tests have questions would only make sense if you were in the class so just pay attention. She doesn't use PowerPoints, but she has a really good explanation as to why and it logically makes sense and has helped me study better.

Dr. Schneider was an amazing professor! She explains things clearly and in depth. She also cares a lot about you doing well and provides ample amounts of extra credit. Her test grading scale also benefits you a lot. Just make sure you go to class because missing even one will cause you to lose a lot of material.

Dr. Schneider cares deeply for her students and takes time out of her busy schedule to help students. She teaches you study tactics and how to improve your grades in other classes. She genuinely likes what she's teaching which always helps. I 1000% recommend her!

AMAZING PROFESSOR! does not use PowerPoints, but if you pay attention, write notes, attend the check ins and actually try you will do great with no doubt. Takes attendance via tophat so you have to go. Hard to catch up if you miss a day, she goes over so much so fast. tests 50 multiple choice and application based- have to actually understand.

She is very thorough in lectures, which meant that you had to make sure to pay attention or you would miss something big. Missing class was also hard because the notes were so important for tests. She has an online textbook you don't have to pay for which was awesome. Need to be good at tests for this course. She cares a lot but is very busy.
lecture heavy, she is very all over the place and her notes aren't put together well.

Class is extremely lecture heavy. You must be able to take impeccable notes or you surely will be missing information for the tests. Attendance is a part of your grade, and if you don't show up, you will miss what feels like weeks of notes. Tests are all multiple choice, but all conceptual. Do not underestimate this class.

I loved this professor. 3 exams, no final, lots of extra credit. Textbook is free online. Takes attendance via tophat. Professor Schneider is caring and helpful, and her lecture style is very effective. Several TA's that hold review sessions. I will be taking Schneider's upper level courses
Unpopular opinion but i loved Schneider! Sit close to the front and pay attention to the lectures and you'll get an easy A. Only three exams, no final. STUDY!!!

Doesn't use PowerPoints and just lectures all day. Personally, it did not fit my learning style even thought I got an A. Offers extra credit. office hours are booked because she has hundreds of other students. course content was interesting but it could have been better. I would avoid her if you like PowerPoints.

Dr. Schneider is very passionate about her lectures, and spends a lot of time going over the same material so everyone understands her. she is also very passionate about first year students acclimating to college life both socially and academically and is very easy going. also gives a ton of extra credit

Dr. Schneider is sweet and passionate about social justice issues. I feel that I retained a lot of knowledge I can use in daily life. Her teaching style is more discussion-based, but she tends to take over the conversation and start rambling, which makes it difficult to contribute as students. There are open notes essays and one group presentation.

This professor was so kind, but I disliked her way of teaching. She gets very distracted in class, losing important class time. She answers anyone's questions during class which is helpful, but not when she made us learn an entire unit on our own before the test. Some of my friends liked the way she taught, and others (+I) strongly disliked it.

Favorite psychology professor. You can tell she is very passionate about what she talks about and makes you interested as well. Never have to be scared to answer or ask questions, as she is extremely helpful. She does not use lecture slides so you will need to listen and take notes, but not as hard as it seems. Very easy to do well

She may talk fast and ramble on , but she is an amazing professor. One of the best at Geneseo. Very understanding, kind, and when she talks its so informative and interesting. Definitely would recommend her to other students

I took this class based on the reviews. She is a great professor but it is a hard class so do not be fooled. If you aren’t taking good notes and studying hard, you won’t do well. Her exams are based off of a lot of information She will give a paragraph then you pick the best fit answer. You need to know how to apply terms

My only complaint is that when she lectures, SHE LECTURES. She rambles on a lot and it can be hard to follow, but you'll be fine. She gave SO many extra credit opportunities as well and really just wants to see you succeed. Study for her tests and go to review sessions. Her tests are applied, so it's not just spitting out definitions.

Schneider is the best Professor. She gives so much extra credit, weighs your highest exam the most, and is very informative about due dates. In my opinion, the tests were 50/50 but if you have good notes from the lectures and textbook you should be fine

comment: Professor Schneider is really passionate about psychology and makes lectures interesting by connecting stories to them. She does talk rather fast, but if you take the class online she posts the recordings which are very helpful to go back to.

comment: You can tell she genuinely cares about her students and wants to help whenever she can.
LOVE HER. Best professor. She's always so willing to help and shows that she genuinely cares about her students.

tags: ['Accessible outside class', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Amazing lectures']
comment: She doesn't use powerpoints but she has an outline so you know what to take notes on. In fact she is clearer about what you should know for the test than any other professor. Very interesting subject and Professor Schneider is very passionate about it. She one of the nicest people and my favorite professor I've had so far. Definitely recommend!

Monica is the nicest human being ever. She has such a bright energy and she cares deeply about her students. She doesn't do powerpoints and she talks a little fast, but she explains things a lot so you can write things down. Her tests are hard but if you do the study guide you should be fine. You have in class assignments so go to class.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read', 'LECTURE HEAVY']
comment: Dr. Schneider is very passionate about psychology and teaching! She is very energetic in lectures. She does not use powerpoints, so be prepared to listen and take good notes! She is extremely helpful and gives great feedback for studying and on assignments!

I took intro to psych with her and loved it! it really inspired me to continue with the psychology major. I found her difficult at first due to the fact that she didn't use power points and she would sometime talk very quickly. Once i adjusted i really enjoyed the class.

Dr. Schneider is a peach, she is the most caring prof at Geneseo. Her class wasn't an easy A but it wasn't difficult you need to put the work in but she is very clear with what she expects of you. She's a real gem and if you can take a class with her I 10/10 recommend.

Dr. Schneider is one of the best professors I've ever had. She genuinely cares about students taking important information that they can apply to their own lives. It's not the easiest class to get an A in, notes are taken based off what she says and the notes are not online. However, she's definitely worth taking. Just make sure to pay attention.

Personality is a hard course, but manageable when you go to her for help. Organize your binder the way she recommends, do the study guide, and read notes (esp. in class assign.)-the study guide is not as important as knowing the studies from class. No book reading besides the few things she wants you to look at for the study guide. Paper is not bad

She explains everything in details and tries to make every class efficient. Her class is fairly interesting (material wise), and the way she presents the material was not boring at all. You have to be there every class to get all the notes and watch the videos in the class so that you will get extra credit and do good on her exams.

Speaks fast and goes into much detail about how she plans to lecture before she actually lectures each class, but you can learn to filter what she says and find whats important, based on the clear lecture outlines she  provides. Simply integrate clearly structured class notes w textbook info via study guide for tests, and meet hw deadlines. Easy A!

tags: ['ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS', 'EXTRA CREDIT']
comment: Schneider is knowledgeable and is very accessible outside of class. However her lectures are difficult to follow and tests are difficult.

By far my favorite teacher I've had here. She is so kind and so knowledgable. Lectures are interesting and easy to follow. You definitely need to pay attention because she doesn't write much down. Tests aren't bad as long as you pay attention in class and study hard. Class can be an easy A if you are willing to put the effort in. Great class!!

Incredibly sweet and wants you to succeed. Very understanding, approachable nd knowledgeable. She doesn't give powerpoints, so you need to go to class and take good notes to be able to pass (some info isn't in the text). Tests are straightforward and if you follow the study guide and study examples from class, they're easy. Highly recommend!

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Amazing lectures', 'EXTRA CREDIT']
comment: Best professor I've ever had. Keeps class interesting and her lectures are awesome. You need to go to class to take a lot of notes, write everything she says. but her tests are VERY straight forward and she gives you a study guide (really helps). Really approachable - follow her studying technique advice. Would highly recommend her she's the best.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LECTURE HEAVY']
comment: Notes are important. Good professor I enjoyed the class didn't do well on the first two because I didn't have good notes to study off of. Really easy A if you can pay attention and read the book.

I loved Psych 100 with Monica. Her teaching style was very hands on and she was clear about what was expected of homework assignments and what would be on exams. Gave a lot of extra credit and is very caring. Loved her!!

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Clear grading criteria', 'LECTURE HEAVY']
comment: Best professor I've ever had. She keeps the class interesting and her lectures are awesome. You need to go to class to take a lot of notes but her tests are straight forward and she gives you a study guide. Would highly recommend her she's the best

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Amazing lectures', 'EXTRA CREDIT']
comment: Dr. Schneider encouraged students to talk to her -in class, after class, or in her office hours. She was super friendly/approachable to talk to about course problems or even personal problems. Her teaching style is so effective bc of relatable examples and the outlines make it as organized as it can get. do what she asks to do well. BEST TEACHER.

She is amazing. She is always willing to meet with students about the coursework and other personal questions regarding the topics discussed in class. She is enthusiastic about what she talks about and speaks so fluently about the information. She is brilliant and down to Earth and her sole purpose is to make sure her students do well.
Take notes on the textbook and during class. Follow the outline. Know real-life examples of everything. Hilarious and super fun, feel free to ask questions. Super interesting class. Very passionate.

She's great. She loves what she teaches, so if you pay attention in class and cover the study guide she gives you-- you'll do well. Tests are 50 multiple questions from the class notes and a few from the textbook. She tests you on whether you could apply what you've learned. Plus, she's super approachable and always answers my questions thoroughly!

This class was interesting, however the exams were brutal. Information that she did not go over in class were fair game for the exams. Exams are worth 90% of your grade, so if you do poor on one, your grade will reflect it. During lectures she talks very fast, so it is difficult to write everything down. She does offer extra credit.

She understands how the mind absorbs info, & she structures her lessons so that they match up with this process (it actually works). Her lectures force you to pay attention-notes are based off lecture. Super helpful& she gives you a study guide of exactly what will be on the exam.  As long as you know the study guide really well it's an easy A.

I absolutely loved her class! She is one of the professors on campus, there are no powerpoint slides so you must take good notes. In the beginning of the semester she'll show u how to do so & she's super approachable so definitely go to her if you are confused about anything. Her test can hard so keep up with so stay on top of the study guide!

This is a class where as long as you show up and listen for an hour, you'll pass easily.  It's much better to just go to class than to just read the book bc she teaches a lot of things differently than the book.  She is a super fun lecturer, and is always willing to provide help.  Also if you don't understand things she says, there are 2 TIs help

I love Schneider! Her class inspired me to be a psych major. Her tests are a little tough, but if you put in the effort an A is feasible. She knows a lot about psych and answers any question you have. If you need to take this class, take it with her!

I loved this class! It was entertaining and I learned a lot. The only problem is that the tests are pretty specific and the only grades you get are from the 3 tests and a few in class activities. Otherwise, great class.
Dr. Schneider is energetic and enthusiastic about everything!!

monica gives an excellent lecture. you must go to class to take notes as much of the test is information you will only receive in lecture. tests are pretty easy and she gives you a study guide. if you like psychology, you will love this course.

Schneider is an awesome professor and person.  She is very helpful during her office hours.  The lectures can be very interesting at times and she uses a ton of real world examples to help people understand the concepts.  There are 3 tests (3 unit exams, the last one counting as the final). I highly recommend taking any class you can with her!
SUPER AWESOME! One of the best professors I've ever had. Engaging, friendly, and funny. It's a great class!

She is the nicest woman in Geneseo.  Her lectures are kind of all over the place but she uses a ton of real world examples during discussions.  Tests are hard, but she gives lots of extra credit opportunities.  Extremely doable.

She was great for psych 100! Only thing is the lectures are extremely easy to follow and then the tests are 1/2 on information from the textbook that is never covered in class. She gives you a study sheet and tells you exactly whats on the test though, its just a lot of outside time when you cram.

She was a fantastic professor. Very engaging during lectures and it's clear that she wants her students to do well. Must actually know the material for tests (not just memorization of definitions). Her class made me decide to become a psych major!

Tests are difficult because they are application based questions. Go ask her for a lesson on how to study for her exams. You can buy the 9th ed textbook and go to her office and borrow the 10th ed to study. Be extremely prepared for tests. Make sure to go to class for the notes. She's very enthusiastic and fun. Not boring at all. Work hard!

Her hands never stop moving. Sit in the back of the class if you like to see her face more than half of the class. Cant really say how knowledgeable she is bc anytime someone asks a good question she says I really dont know and then rambles on about related things. Stay on top of reading and take good notes(esoec ex's) and you'll get a good grade.
She's awesome :D

M. Schneider is the bomb. She's very energetic and knowledgeable. She expects a very reasonable amount of work and wants to you do well and to learn. She's SUPER talkative, though. Ask her a yes or no question and she talks forever. Seriously, though, I love her.
She is awesome and really knows what she is talking about. She makes things easy to understand and keeps class interesting!
She's really enthusiastic about everything. Her lectures are interesting. You have to read the book, but she gives you a study guide so you know exactly what you need to know for the tests.

Take this class! She's a great professor and makes the class so interesting. She gives great lectures and examples and is very willing to help outside the classroom. Tests are largely based on the textbook which she doesn't discuss in class so you have to do that on your own but it's a  great class.

Professor Schneider is a wonderful professor.  She's extremely helpful and will go out of her way to help you understand the  material better and score higher on tests. Throughout the semester I did better on tests with her help.  She also was very understanding when I got behind due to a family situation.  I highly recommend her and this class!!!!

She is such a wonderful professor! Sooo enthusiastic! Class was fun, the material was interesting, and she would always really try to explain it so we could understand it. Not too much work, tests were fair, you can't just cruise along in this class though. Highly recommended professor!

best teacher ever. She teaches in a very organized way, making notetaking a breeze and the material easy to learn. She really cares about her students and loves to answer questions, which is think is great. I would recommend her to anyone.
She's energetic and fun and really knows and cares about her work. She's very helpful if you need it, (and you will, Psychology isn't easy.) Sometimes gets sidetracked during lessons though.

Absolutely captivating. She's always happy, energetic, caring. She'll encourage you to come and see her not only about classwork, but about anything at all. Regarding the class, she gives out study guides for each exam WEEKS in advance. These study guides are your friends--with them, you're golden.

Super nice teacher, definitely keeps you interested in class. Class not mandatory to attend but if you go you can score an extra 2 points based on silly things she says in class. Talks about relationships a lot, so fun if you're a girl and you like to gossip.
Great Professor! Very nice and enthusiastic. Easy to get an A if you read the textbook and show up to class. Very fun professor!
Even though her 352 requires more papers and seems to be harder than others, she is right there with you every step of the way and tries her hardest to make sure everyone understands. go to class!!

Prof. Schneider is one of the nicest, most helpful teachers Geneseo has to offer.  She will hold office hours in the beginning of the year just to teach kids how to better study for her exams.  Although this was the most difficult course I've taken in Geneseo I would recommend it to anyone who even remotely interested about psychology.
One of (if not the) best professors at Geneseo. She's extremely engaging during lectures, and makes learning fun. I would take every class she teaches if I were a psych major.

Great class and great professor. She made the material interesting and the class easy. She was very energetic in class and funny so you stayed awake. Key is going to class. If you go and pay attention you will get an a regardless if you read the textbook. Shes an awesome professor and take it with her if you can.

she is the best teacher you could ask for - understanding, genuine, helpful, and she is so smart she really knows her stuff.  you can tell she loves teaching and she will keep you awake during class because she's so energetic.  she's super... definitely take her if you can.

She is the best adviser a college student could ever ask for. She's been incredibly helpful in helping me figure out what's next after college. You give her a rough idea of what you want to do and she'll point you in several different directions as to how to get there.

She is the best teacher EVER!!!  She understands how people learn and is able to apply everything to your life!  If you are going to take this class (especially Psychology majors), take it with her!!! Two other things:1)Read the chapter on memory first, b/c it will help you learn everything else, and 2)Interact with her, because she's so helpful!!!
No Comments

Monica Schneider definetely takes happy pills bc she is always smiling and laughing (a lot) when she lectures, and you can tell she really enjoys teaching. You need to go to her lectures and study the textbook to do well on her tests, but she will bend over backwards to help you and she's very smart. Take her for your psych classes; she's great.
Monica Schneider is the best professor that I have ever had.  I have an undergraduate degree and a graduate degree and I have never had a professor better. She is clear and makes learning fun!

This woman is AMAZING!! I highly recommend her! She is passionate about teaching and very considerate of student needs. She brings a lot of energy to each class and makes the subject material highly relevant and understandable. Her tests do suck but she is a very fair grader.

Really nice & funny woman! Willing to come to class early to go over tests/concepts & of course during office hours. She gives good notes, but whatever isn't covered in class is mentioned later in study guides that highlight Everything in the textbook that you should know (& she isn't kidding!). Whatever is in notes or the study guide will show up.

She is awesome, I haven't even finished the class and I've learned more in a month then i feel like i've learned from some professors in  a semester. You'll look forward to going to class as crazy as that sounds. Take any class you can with her!!
I am in graduate school now, and i must say although Dr. Schneider's classes were harder than most of my doctoral level classes, you learn so much.  She is my fav professor.

She is a breath of fresh air from normal lecturers. She is very energetic and loves what she does. She'll answer any questions whether in class or she goes home and researches it. Her tests are hard if you just expect to regurgetate info. If you Study read and go to the review session you will be ok
Her tests are killer. She isn't the clearest when it comes to lecturing. She's a nice lady and is really helpful, but I struggled in the class because the tests are so damn hard.

She is one of the most helpful teachers I've had and really enjoys teaching, which I think makes a difference. Sometimes when she lectures she can get a bit off topic, and her tests are really hard. But, you learn a lot.

Very good, enthusiastic teacher.  Admits when she isnt sure, then finds out, and tells you next class (I find that very important).  Hard tests (but heavily curved) and good notes.  Also, my TA was very hot.
very, very nice lady who is always willing to help and loves you if you participate and ask for help.  Her tests are very tough, though.
Schneider gets a lil too hyper during class.  Talks about things that are a tad bit off topic.  She tries to be incredibly helpful tho and she is fun and sometimes interesting.  Her tests are hard!
Great teacher, class is fun. However, watch out for the tests!
She's one of the nicest professors ever.
She is always there to help!!
I love this lady.

If this class didn't have a TA, we all would have been screwed. He is the worst professor; you cannot understand him. This is a 100-level course but it is definitely not treated like one. AVOID HIM AND THIS COURSE BY ALL MEANS!

This is the worst professor I've ever had! He doesn't speak English and doesn't know what he's talking about. He mumbles to himself during lectures and can barely explain what his powerpoints mean. He would say not to study something and then put it on the midterm and final. Overall, I wouldn't even recommend this class to my worst enemy.
He is a really bad professor. Thinks he is teaching a graduate course. All we did is talk about game theory. Plus you cannot understand a word he is saying. Avoid at ALL COSTS.

worst class i've taken at geneseo. extremely unclear and confusing. Talked in depth about topics that are not relevant or worth talking about. Nothing of importance discussed. I am a poli sci major so i went into the class with a good attitude, but i learned nothing
He takes time to make sure everyone understands.

He taught his thesis, the Game Theory, in my PLSC 140 class. He would often spend the whole class writing mathematical equations on the board before realizing that no one could understand what he was talking about. He knows a lot of Game Theory but can not articulate the material he is excepted to be teaching.

As long as you attend classes and review his lecture notes uploaded on the mycourses, you'll be fine. He helps out very closely during his office hours, so I would definitely recommend you to visit him as frequently as possible if you don't understand his materials. Not much burdens at all, but good learning experience.
He gives all the lecture notes on mycourses, and if you study the lecture notes then you will be fine. He tries hard to give you a good grade if you just attend the class regularly.

This was by far the worst class I have ever taken in my entire life. Jung is very confusing and repeats himself continuously. I have a great interest in international politics and this class gave me headaches. THINK hard before taking a class with him, if you really want to learn something, take it with someone else.

I loved her but this class was a lot so be prepared. Everyone write 3 poems which you read and write a 2 page response to each, group presentation, recitation, discussion posts, 5 poem E-chapbook (which you also present), 5 additional poems, a paper, and you a responsible for reading someone else's chapbook.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Lots of homework']
comment: Don't take CBH's class if you're not an English major. Workload is excessive and you will spend hours every week completing additional coursework. Participation is mandatory and 35% of your grade. Grades aren't provided until after the semester is over. Picky about little things. Overall a friendly woman and easily accessible, but demands are high.

Caroline is the single most caring professor you'll ever meet at SUNY Geneseo. She's brilliant with a big heart. you obvs didn't read the syllabus if you're complaining about workloads or grading policies. When I was unsure about how I was doing in the course, she always made time for me. You will be a better writer and person for taking her class!
SO MUCH WORK!! Even for a 200 level. Crazy.

Extraordinarily unclear grading criteria, but contrary to other reviews, I have never found it unfair. Accessible through office hours--appointment appreciated but not required. If you need feedback, this may not be a good professor for you; you won't hear anything back until the end of the semester (excluding your workshop piece, naturally).

This Professor uses opinion when grading, she does not like your work even if it fits the requirements, it will be harshly graded. She is hard to get a hold of. The only way to contact her was through email and she rarely responded leading to having to email her multiple times, which effected students needing help with upcoming assignments.

She is such a kind hearted person! She really wants her students to learn how to be better critics to writing whilst being better writers themselves. Very accessible when it comes to e-mails and is dedicated to inspire students. Would totally take her class again!

CBH IS THE BEST! Period. Whoever gave her less than a stellar review must be lazy or insane. I've taken 3 classes with her and she knows her stuff! She's really passionate about what she teaches and genuinely supports you as a student and helps you be a better writer. I couldn't recommend this professor more. She's a gem! Love love love this woman!

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Lots of homework']
comment: Get ready to read. A LOT of work for an introduction class but if you put in the effort to revise papers and go to office hours you will be fine. Also, be ready for class participation!!

The reading is tough and there is a lot of it. A lot of the class discussion is complicated and there is a need for a good understanding of difficult vocabulary in order to answer contribute. She is very detailed oriented and looks for specifics when asking questions and grading papers. She gives good feedback with the opportunity to revise.
Assigns some long and hard novels and three large papers which are heavily graded, but she gives opportunity to revise with her help.

Professor Beltz- Hosek was so so sweet and honestly it felt like you could talk to her about nearly anything. I would get nervous every once in a while about doing well in the class just because there was a lot to keep track of, but in the end it was not a difficult class and she is always there to help you!

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'So many papers']
comment: She is a nice enough woman, but she assigns a lot of reading (like too much) and you have to write one page journals on each reading. On top of discussion posts that are several paragraphs long. There is also constantly a paper assigned and you are always doing work for her class. It's like she forgets we have other classes.

Professor Beltz-Hosek was one of the best professors I've had. She clearly knows a lot about her research but she makes it fairly easy to understand. She is also just generally a sweet and kind-hearted person and class is always a lot of fun. She gives really good feedback for essays and will do her best to help you improve at writing.

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'So many papers']
comment: You won't know what your total grade for the semester is until the very end. She grades everything differently, ranging from a letter grade out of 0 a check out of 0 or even just a complete out of 0. She also never gives you a break, you will not know a moments rest until the end of the semester.

Not understanding at all with covid and any kind of emergency. If you don't show proof you were sick or in a hospital she gets very annoyed. Not a nice professor at all. She believes her class is the most important thing in the world.

Caroline is a very nice professor. Although her class can be boring at times, it was an easy A. She loves when you participate and sets clear deadlines. The workload isn't too bad and she is very through in her expectations for each assignment she gives. No tests at all just a few short essays and projects.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: Although I'm not a huge fan of group work, this class is made very easy by simply showing up and reading the assigned book. She's clearly very knowledgeable and passionate about the subject, and in my experience not too harsh of a grader as long as you do what is asked in the rubric. Make sure you like a book before you take an entire class on it.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Group projects', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: Dr. Beltz is a very sweet lady! You can tell she is very passionate about literature. The class has weekly group presentations, which are easy and nice because on that day class is often let out early. If you read you will definitely succeed, if you sparknote you probably will too. The midterm was very fair. No tests or quizzes, but one paper.

She made a painfully long nearly 3 1/2 hour long class seem like 1 1/2 hours. She has a quirky sense of humor & style; she is warm and interesting. Bronte Sisters involves weekly online posts, a group presentation, 3 response papers, 1 analytical paper, &final exam. You will need to participate, cannot be shy. Not too difficult, but a lot of work.

By far the best professor I have ever had. She is extremely knowledgeable, and is always open to hearing other opinions. Yes, you have to work for your grade, but I honestly didnt mind the work because I was interested in the subject matter and had a feeling I would see good results. Awesome and easy to talk to; I couldnt recommend her more.

She's honestly the most amazing professor I have ever had. There are few teachers who stick with you, and she is by far one of them. I loved the class wholeheartedly. Of course, there's a lot of reading, but the poems she chose were most definitely now some of my favorites. I couldn't recommend her more.

LOVE this professor. She's passionate about writing and offers thorough feedback on everyone's papers. Class is always fun and interesting. There is quite a bit of work to do and I did have to spend many hours critiquing my classmates' work but it was all enjoyable and worth it for the improvement I saw in my own writing over the course of the sem.

I love this woman. She goes above and beyond for her students- from covering a 20 page fiction piece with paragraphs of critique to setting up an extravagant breakfast buffet for the final exam. A true gem in Geneseo. She loves what she does. If you put in blood, sweat and tears you will do very well. That being said, she can sniff out BS.

Professor Beltz-Hosek is amazing. I enjoy going to her class so much! During creative writing workshops she makes her students feel very comfortable and supported. She is so sweet and fun! Definitely take a class with her if you have the chance.  P.S. Professor Beltz-Hosek give fantastic feedback on creative essays, poems, etc.

As someone who doesn't really like reading or writing, I found the class very difficult. I spent hours every day reading the very difficult books and writing many long papers. That being said, I learned so much in the class and found the lessons very inspirational.

There is a lot of reading in a very short amount of time. Shes a pretty tough grader so make sure you spend a lot of time editing your paper before you hand it in. Very helpful if you go to her office hours. Participation is a huge part of your grade so be prepared to talk.

Such a lovely woman, good professor and fosters greats discussions. If you're taking the Woman Writer INTD there is a LOT of reading in a very short time and obviously a lot of writing. The class itself is enjoyable and a good introduction to feminist criticism if you're interested.

Caroline is clearly very intelligent and she is very nice.  Even if it doesn't seem at first like she notices you, she will take the time to let you know if you've done something that impressed her.  That goes a long way.  Has some strict rules, but she is approachable and her critiques are very helpful.

Wonderful professor. She's extremely intelligent and well spoken without being pretentious. She definitely expects a lot, but she is also very willing to help you out in any way she can. The structure of the classes can get repetitive (lectures), but she's so passionate about what she teaches that it's hard to get bored.

A little bit picky grader but still ended with an A. Don't really have to read the books if you attend class. Ridiculously good with emails and will go over as much of your papers as you want and as many times as you want. Lets you out early sometime times. I recommend.

really enjoyed this class. one of the most caring, open and intelligent professors i've had. she's passionate about what she teaches and it shows. definitely recommend if you're willing to show up and do the work.

Sweet woman but I found her class a little difficult. A lot of work in a short period of time and the essay topics are a little challenging. Sometimes I don't understand what she is saying in class but the times I understood her, she was helpful. She takes attendance so going to class is mandatory and participation plays a big part of your grade.

Loved this class, she makes lectures interesting, and wants you to participate.  The only bad part of the class were the pointless "group" presentations, they were a waste of time, and I would have preferred lecture. Also she sprung a cumulative final on us, it took the entire final time! Overall the class was worth it.
Funny. Smart. Super pretty.  Definitely take her creative writing class but she also makes Humanities lectures worth attending.

Her class wasn't too hard and reading the books isn't necessary to do well and participate in class discussions. Make sure you participate cuz she goes on and on about participation. Overall she wasn't too bad but I thought she was kind of fake and not as nice as she acts.
She is a pretty good teacher, but the books we read aren't the best. It is just a lot of work in general but she is a pretty good teacher.

Although I thought she was a great teacher, she is an English teacher.  I loved this about her, but if you have trouble writing papers then take humanities with someone else, she grades them like she would in an English class and does so harshly.  A brilliant teacher with a good sense of humor, if you can write, you have nothing to lose.
Superb. If it weren't for the 8:05 timing, I would have been all over this class. This gal is passionate about teaching.
not bad to look at either

Prof. Beltz-Hosek is amazing!! One of the best teachers I've had at Geneseo!! She's very intelligent and really cares about her students. She's a hard grader but college is supposed to be challenging.
Ridiculously hard grader. Just regurgitate everything she thinks and you'll do okay.

Dr. Scott requires a weekly discussion post that she will absolutely pick apart. She grades harder than any English teacher I've ever had and seems like she will never give out a 100 by how much she'll pick apart your work

Was condescending when leaving notes on work and seemed rude. Made sure to tell us not to contact her first with questions and to ask a help desk since she was busy and might not get to it. Wants specific answers even though it's more of an opinion-based class.

tags: ['Tough grader', 'Get ready to read', 'Lots of homework']
comment: one of the worst professors I have ever had. very judgmental and unapproachable. gives you the grade she "feels like you deserve" rather than your grade average. openly talks badly about students in class. an overwhelming amount of reading, and writing. very closed minded about many sociological topics.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'So many papers']
comment: This professor uses out dated articles and is never accessible. She is disorganized and disrespectful. She has her TAs do all the grading and does not keep  with how her students are doing. She will announce to the class if you did poorly on an exam and will berate you for it. Her exams are not well structured either.

Needs to retire immediately, overshares about her personal life, doesn't grade any of her own work, it's all done by these sophomore TAs who don't know what they are doing. Overall I would avoid taking any classes with her.

DO NOT TAKE! tough grader, goes off topic all the time, TAs grade stuff really hard even though they went though this class. makes you buy 4 books and has so many other articles to read. group discussion lead once a semester where she will dominate the conversation and then bash on you for not talking. i learned nothing from this class. DO NOT TAKE

Very tough grader and is not at all cohesive as to what she is looking for. She grades based off of opinion, not facts. she has her own grading system- the tests are fine if you go to the reviews. She gets distracted and WILL cut off students when presenting to go on a tangent. this class is extremely heavy on the readings so must read everything.

tags: ['Tough grader', 'Get ready to read', 'Lots of homework']
comment: She creates her own grading scheme so don't think your number grade is what you finish with because it is actually lower. If you go to her for a complaint, she will bully you and tell you that you are a horrible student. She does not agree with anyone and just dismisses people when they try and participate. Oh, good luck with discussion posts!
Test are impossible and everyone failed the first exam

Her tests are awful as she does not make it remotely clear on what specifically she is looking for. Her lectures are all over the place and she gets side tracked so easily. It honestly is a lot of work just for an intro class, I would not recommend unless you want to cry yourself to sleep every night.

One of the worst professors I have ever had. She has no grading criteria, and only grades based on her own opinions. Weekly discussions have readings with 40+ pages long.
