comment: Personally I had a great time in this class; it was pretty easy and a great space for creative experimentation. I found that meeting with Prof B outside of class was the best way to show that you're putting in effort and to get a good grade by running things by her. It was easy to follow; the course itself was very class discussion based

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Gives good feedback']
comment: (class 113 doesn't give an option) overall she picked some interesting books to read and if you didn't understand something she actually takes the time to explain it. Lectures are rather long but overall would take her again and highly recommend

Professor Bilocerkowycz was the most understanding professor I've ever had. Never felt there was too much work. There are short readings around 3-5 pages or less due every class that we discuss. Participation is mandatory (worth 40% of the grade). She made me feel so confident about my work! no tests, just a final short story. highly recommend!!
Professor B's class is awesome. She does not have a tough grading policy and provides great feedback. If you do the work and go to class you shouldn't get anything lower then an "A".

Prof. B. is so incredibly kind and understanding. She is always willing to elaborate on something if you're confused and she always provides constructive criticism on your work. She always has something nice to say and is accessible outside of class. I would 1000% recommend her to anyone interested in writing.

Professor B is the BEST English professor at Geneseo by far!!! Such an easy A if you show up and participate. If you have the chance to, just take a class with her. She's so easy to talk to and allows the class to guide a lot of due dates and conversations.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Accessible outside class', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: Sonya is so sweet. She really is clear with what is expected in the syllabus and sends out a message every Monday breaking down the week. Every week we write a prompt and have to provide peer feedback on three other classmates' prompt. It's kind of a lot of work for a 100 level course but it's really not that hard.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read', 'Participation matters']
comment: Sonya Bilocerkowycz is a great professor, I loved her Poetry and Prose course. In the class there were 3 major writing assignments, 3 letters to authors, and a final portfolio(thorough feedback given on assignments). The course was heavy on reading. Pop quizzes and class discussion counted towards 30% of final grade.

McCartney is a really nice guy. His lectures are pretty solid and he includes a lot of really interesting information and side jokes. He's pretty easily available outside of class and seems to really want his students to do well. I would definitely recommend him, especially for gen bio.

Easily accessible though he filters between two labs. Very cool guy and is willing to answer any questions no matter how dumb. He does really sick research on snakes and his office hours are a good time. Would def recommend for bio lab.

Dr. McCartney was a joy to have a lecturer. Although I felt that he didn't really expand much on his powerpoint slides, all of the info is in the textbook. He's very accessible outside of class. He makes small side jokes that you won't really hear or get unless you're paying attention but it makes the lecture a little more interesting. Take him!

Dr. McCartney is one of the best professors I've had at Geneseo. He is incredibly passionate about what he teaches, which makes the class really enjoyable. He also genuinely cares about his students and very helpful in his office hours if you need help. I wish he taught more classes because I would take anything he teaches. Go snakes!

He's alright. Not the worst but not the best. He gives so much reading homework so the textbook is a must have and you really have to be disciplined to do the homework and reading if you want an A. He posts his powerpoints online so you don't have to go to class but in lecture he tends to skip over a lot of material but tests you on it.
He is amazing, just take him! Very funny!
I love bio 119 with McCartney! He's super willing to work with you and help. He's young with energy. He saved my biology grade. Textbook use is essential. HIGHLY RECOMMEND.
I love Monica, the class was pretty easy as long as you were there and paid some attention, plus there are many extra credit opportunities, and I just find her fun and it seems like she really cares.

tags: ['Lecture heavy', 'Graded by few things', 'Accessible outside class']
comment: She's very nice and explains the content clearly. It's not required to go to class but she does not have slides so you definitely should. Has office hours most weekdays if you can't attend the class that day. Only has 2 assignments and 3 exams throughout the semester but the best scoring exam is heavily weighted.

I have her for Psych240 and she is One of my favorite professors. She is passionate about what she teaches and really works to make sure u understand. All tests are short answers but open book. Just make sure to take good notes. No pp so notes are lecture based. she can over explain so clarifying questions are helpful

Doesn't use PowerPoints and just lectures all day. Personally, it did not fit my learning style even thought I got an A. Offers extra credit. office hours are booked because she has hundreds of other students. course content was interesting but it could have been better. I would avoid her if you like PowerPoints.

Incredibly sweet woman, but her lectures are a nightmare. She does not use PowerPoints, and teaches the information off of purely stream of consciousness. It is incredibly frustrating trying to take notes; you never know what she is talking about because she is all over the place when she lectures.

Love love loved her, she was so amazing. I enjoyed every class and would 1000% take her for every other psych class if I could. You definitely have to study if you want to do good, but she offers so much extra credit and multiple TA sessions a week to help improve your grade.

lectures were amazing. She cares about your success and gives you tips for studying. she gives you credit for going to class and has extra credit opportunities. she weighs the exams to make sure you get a good grade. recommend 100% and would take her again

She is a nice teacher and cares about her students but it is very lecture based. It depends how you learn but I struggled a lot because she just talked the whole time and you had to take notes. The only grades in are tests, so if your not a strong test taker good luck! It is also really hard to get a hold of her because she has 100 other students.

She is actually the worst lecturer ever.  She continues to talk the entire lecture and everyone just falls asleep.  You will never understand what she's talking about.  Make sure you take the class with a friend so you have someone to share in the pain.  She's actually so bad and annoying.

Professor Schneider is the most understanding professor at Geneseo. She truly. cares about her students excelling and is very accessible outside of class as she prioritizes students needs first. She has a lot of lecture and talks fast so be prepared to keep up and her assignments are mostly for the betterment of your grade. Would recommend!

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Graded by few things', 'Caring']
comment: She is literally the best professor Ive had. She is so nice and kind to her students. She is a fast talker tho so try to keep up w/ notes. This semester because of covid we only had 4 exams and top hat attendance is important. And in class/ out of class mini assignments are too. If you plan on taking psyc take it with her!

Don't take this class unless you are going to put effort into it. Dr. Schneider is passionate and knowledgeable, but that also means she has a lot to say. Fast talker. No visuals (just lectures, no ppts).

Monica is one of my favorite teachers at Geneseo. She is so passionate and understanding. If you want an A... go to class, take good notes, read the parts of the text she tells you and combine them with your class notes. She also gives extra credit! She honestly wants you to do well and I learned a lot from her. I cannot recommend her enough!!!

Dr. Schneider has been my favorite professor at Geneseo. Her intent is to help students succeed, not try to trick them. She makes study guides to work through while you read chapters in the book, so you know exactly what to read from the book. She deferentially weighs tests. She's extremely helpful outside of class.

LOVED this class! Made me consider being a Psych major! She's a great teacher and always willing to help. Most of the class was easy, only a few confusing parts but either she explained or I saw them in the book. Book wasn't necessary to pass. Hilarious professor, great class, easy A for people who like psychology.
SUCH an easy A. I didnt even read the book just take good notes that exactly wht the test is on.
no matter how long I studied for her exams were impossible to pass
Incredibly difficult exams with little curve. Makes the homework and quizzes very easy and the tests are nearly impossible. Class average was 71 for a 100 level class

comment: I am a bio major and I love science. Ms. R was by far the worst science professor I have ever had. She will tell you to go to office hours to talk, then just tell you to study harder. Almost all of your grade is based on the exams (which everyone failed) to the point she revised her syllabus to make a 55 a C-. Do not take her class. no extra credit

I had her for intro chem lab and it was rough. She was a harsh grader, pre-lab lectures were confusing at times, and it was genuinely hard to get a good grade on a lab, especially in the beginning when I hadn't learned how she grades things yet.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Graded by few things', 'Tough grader']
comment: I really really don't like Prof Romonosky. Her lectures are so confusing, and there were many times where she would even question herself mid-lecture. I ended up teaching myself everything out of the textbook and for chemistry that's a recipe for disaster. She is by far one of the worst professors I've ever had, Don't recommend.

She did a horrible job this semester. She was not empathetic at all with students and was often times harsh when it came to her grading policy. The class itself isnt easy but she made it 10x worse than what it shouldve been. The tests are far more difficult than any of the practice problems done in lecture. Would not recommend this professor.

The material really isnt hard. Shes a decent teacher but is very particular about how and when assignments are turned in. I forgot to turn in the page showing my work twice and didnt find out until it was too late, and that dropped my final grade from a 91 to an 83. Not a hard class but difficult to manage during covid.

She is easily the worst professor I have ever had. We are in the middle of a pandemic and she will not accept make up exams or late work (very unfair and shows she doesn't care about us). Her tests are very unfair and way harder than the material we learn. Going to lectures was a waste of time because she has no idea what she is talking about.

If you do not need this class dont take it. Covid made her class so much harder. In person classes she doesnt explain anything she wants you to know everything. She doesnt give extra credit. But SI sessions were helpful so I recommend to go to those. She doesnt explain much in her videos so you actually need the textbook.

I recently asked Dr. Romonosky if it would be possible to expand the time limit on our quizzes. I often do not have enough time to finish. She emailed me back and said that she would not change the time she was not given a letter from the Office of Accessibility. But I have no valid issue that would involve the Office of Accessibility.

One of the worst professors ever. She flys through the material and her lectures are not very well written so I ended up teaching myself everything out of the textbook. Definitely be prepared to spend a lot of time with the SI because shes more helpful than the actual teacher

Dr. R was hands down my favorite professor this past academic year. She is truly such a knowledgable and down to earth woman who really cares about her students. I would absolutely recommend her to anyone looking to take chem 116, 118 or 119 (lab). She truly wants to see every student succeed and does her part in making sure they do.

Dr. Romonosky is a fair professor to choose when taking CHEM116 or CHEM118. She tends to race through lectures rather quickly (if you take her class I recommend taking notes before or after lectures). It feels sometimes as though when she explains new concepts, she is explaining them to a room full of professionals rather than freshman students.
very lovely lady, her lecture is very easy to understand which made chemistry easy, very helpful during office hours, if you need help def go for sure, her labs are also pretty easy

I really liked professor Romonosky. Her lectures were really good considering that general chemistry is a very dry subject. She does lots of examples in class too which helped me learn the material and kept me awake at 8:30. I definitely recommend her but be willing to put in the work to go to class, do the hw and study for tests.

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Graded by few things', 'Test heavy']
comment: Dian is a very sweet lady and it's like she's a college student herself-- she's understanding and knows how college kids think. Going to class isn't mandatory as she doesn't really take attendance-- only a few top hats during the semester (go to the class after the test) and study the practice tests for the actual test as it is pretty similar!

Mostly just reads off of the slides (which mostly come from the textbook). Tests are not out of many points, which isn't great since only missing a few questions hurts your grade a lot. Overall lectures weren't very helpful, but she's pretty accessible and willing to help in office hours.
Recommend going to her office hours she is very nice and helpful

tags: ['Clear grading criteria', 'Test heavy', 'Graded by few things']
comment: Dr. Annala is a good guy and he's so funny. He has clear expectations and will never surprise you with anything. I will say however that in class he often yells random things and screams and it is definitely headache giving. Other than the overstimulating-ness of him yelling randomly he's great. Also make sure to study, exams are 75% of your grade.

Could not ask for a better professor for Intro Macro. Tells the best stories and is super clear about his expectations. If you do the work you will get an A, if you don't you will not. Super fair course and it is a really fun time.

Dr. Annala is everything a professor should be. His lectures are highly engaging and accessible, you learn the subject well, he's a funny person, and he really wants you to succeed in his classes. Definitely the best professor I have ever had.

Gives curves on every exam, and gives online quizzes for the chapters in the exam. You get the option to take the final or not and drops lowest exam score. I never really went to class because I found the lectures boring, but if you take the time to study the quizzes and power points you will pass. Tough course as well.

Professor Annala Is AMAZING. His lectures are interesting and engaging. He's funny and charismatic. Very chill guy, he doesn't like it when you take pictures of the board though(the notes are online so it doesn't really matter). 10/10 would take again

exams are worth 75% of your grade which is so messed up. exams are not curved and he will not round your grade up not even by 1 point, even if it determines if you pass/fail that class. he is not understanding when it comes to grades, and his class is just frustrating

Professor Annala is a great professor to take Introductory Microeconomics with. His lectures are very interesting, and he incorporates lots of real-world examples to make the course content easier to understand. He cares about his students and is very helpful during office hours. As long as you show up to class consistently, you will succeed.
Overall, Professor Annala cares about his students.  The class is insanely difficult though.  Intermediate macro with him is close to impossible.  Nice guy but expects a lot.

Quizzes are able to be retaken as many times as possible up until the due date. The final is cumulative, and every exam will leave you guessing between two answers. Each answer in the exams is similar to one another causing there to be a big area for mistakes

Professor Annala is easily one of the best profs at this entire school. I have taken a bunch of classes with him and he never fails to make lectures interesting. He is such a great person outside of the classroom and genuinely cares about his students. I literally have nothing bad to say about him at all.

This is my second class with professor Annala and he is amazing. He gives weekly homeworks but they are doable and he wants you to succeed. His in class lectures are always stimulating and interesting. I took him during the pandemic and he was very understanding and lenient on the time he gave us to do work. I highly recomend him!

Professor Annala makes lectures on economics interesting and easy to understand. Outlined notes make for easy studying and online quizzes are simple. Tests are easy if you go to class and study a little.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS', 'Amazing lectures']

Great teacher loved him, really interesting class, wish he taught more classes, I recommend taking this class with him even if you don't need to!

comment: Annala is a great professor and he makes class entertaining. He gives you his own notes and you have to fill in some things so make sure you either go or have friends to take notes for you. If you have the notes, you'll do fine.

Professor Annala is a strait up gangster. Extremely strait forward just like the subject. Really liked his approach of just laying the information out and connecting the graphs with the concepts. Is sometimes hard to participate with pp style, but I really couldn't see the class working any other way considering the size and nature of the class.

Annala is a great professor he teaches for students knowledge not for memorization. He tells you how to study. He has clear notes from a power point. Study really hard and READ the textbook and notes frequently!!

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK', 'Caring']
comment: Such an easy class, all you have to do is show up and try your best. She will give you writing prompts and you must write a poem, short story, etc. according to the prompt. She grades based on effort, so you don't have to be an amazing writer to do well. She is also very sweet and understanding!

MJ is the cutest and sweetest professor on the planet! She teaches creative writing in a unique way and keeps the class interesting, even with boring material. She always has comments and positive feedback when it comes to your writing and loves when you share your work with the class. MJ is an awesome teacher, I would recommend her always!

M.J. is an amazing professor. She clearly laid out what she wanted for the semester. Short stories to read with 1-2 page responses, it was super easy if you just put the time in. The two exams that were given we had a preview of. The books she picks as well are amazing. I would highly recommend her to anyone.

Took her during my first semester at Brockport. Such a nice lady and great teacher. Her quizzes are usually done in a group or given advanced notice. Great class to take to expand your writing talents.

She is very personal with her students and cares enough to learn names and such. She has daily in class assignments that are supper easy. Quizzes are done in groups and super easy. No tests, but there are a few larger projects for the Midterm and Final. There is homework out of the book.
She's an amazing lady! Hilarious, very sweet, a lot like my grandmother. Would take again, you need to at least decently like creative writing to enjoy this class. So small and so much fun!
Very friendly and nice.  Decent grader, nothing too hard just more work than some of the other teachers in same course.

Awesome lady. Nicest person ever and really understanding about everything. If you do the work, you will get a good grade. You do a lot of writing, but it really is a lot of fun. All she cares about is that you like your own writing. Class was small, so we got really close and had a lot of laughs together. Definitely take this class.

Leaned a lot about 4 genres.  Loved poetry and playwriting.  Who knew I would love plays. She uses great examples of each genre.  Inspiring.  I loved writing the quilt essay. The semester just flew by. She's a professional writer too.

She is a great person, but I feel like I did not learn much from the class. It was a great time, but I didn't really walk away with more creative writing knowledge. Easy and fun A as long as you have a pulse in the class.

I had a great time taking the class since she's a nice and easygoing teacher. I learned a lot, but she's a bit disorganized regarding the lessons and handling of assignments. My main concern is how there were students/kids who took advantage of her kindness and were disrespectful. She really needs to work on dealing with these kinds of students.

Amazing class!  Learned so much.  This was well worth it.  It changed the way I see things.  It made me appreciate writer's craft. loved the writers workshop. So glad i took this course.  it will influence all of my other writing courses.  Hope to take another poetry class.

Had A's and B's on papers. Missed two classes for illness, and one representing the college, and she grew mean. Then she was rude and her contract should not be renewed. If you take a class with her, you will not learn. DO NOT TAKE A CLASS WITH HER!

Great professor and very open to emotion.  a little oversensitive and sometimes misunderstands innocent intentions.  Very helpful with constructive criticism and extremely knowledgeable about local writers.
A very fun person with a great personality!  If you take a class with her you will love her!  She is helpful and an easy grader:)
MJ is a great teacher, she's fun, really nice, and challenged us as writers. I would definitely take another class with her!
I love MJ!!! She's an intellegent, amazing woman, wooo!

I think MJ is absolutley wonderful. In our class of 30, 7 of us followed her to her other class the next semester. She is very friendly and knows her stuff. She is understanding and kind and you won't be disappointed.
DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! She is the worst professor ever, she talks about absolutely nothing until the end of class and always keeps you late. Seriously the worst class i've ever taken!

Unfortunately, this semester was Janet's last semester working at Brockport. I was so glad to have taken a class with her. She was so caring for all of the students, very understanding, easy to get ahold of and would reply quickly, easy grader, and overall a wonderful professor!
Took her class for 3-D design. Genuinely an amazing professor who is very understanding. Most of the class is work time, but she pops around and helps as needed. Overall 10/10.

As long as you showed up and worked then you will be able to pass. She is so chill and was very lenient with critiquing. She always asked if anyone needed help and never made you feel like unheard. Gave great ideas and helped you to get out of your comfort zones and create art you never thought you would.
personally i would put in a ton of work and she still didnt like my work so I usually got a bad grade
Really great teacher. Class can be kind of boring/challenging if you're not into art and just taking it for the gen ed requirement. Makes class and projects fun.

Class can be sometimes boring when she gives lectures. If you take this class please eat before you come because you will be in there drawing for hours with a short break. She is a very caring teacher and provided a lot of help but she is definitely a tough grader. She also gave quizzes that you couldnt study for.

The first day of class, she was just reading off all the pages that she printed out and gave to us. I found it very boring, and I almost dropped the class. The first project was truly hard too because I thought this class was easy. But I like the professor so much because she is very willing to help and encourages you. I have so far improved a lot.

Janet comes off as intimidating at first which made me hesitant to take the class as a non art major. I quickly realized how personable and encouraging she is. She will push you to do your best work, but also take your skill level into account. If you are interested in drawing I would recommend this class for you. Youll see improvements at the end
Such a wonderful lady! She makes you work your grade but if you put in the effort she will definitely take that into consideration. Absolutely wants to see her class succeed and grow.

Janet is a great woman. She's not an easy grader, but she will push you to do your best, most creative work. She also truly cares about her students and is fully willing to work with you if you're struggling.

Janet is a wonderful human-being. She enjoys life and helping others and her class proves this. I learned many techniques in drawing, however, her directions are sometimes hard to understand. All around fun class for majors and non-majors.

Great professor. this class i thought would be easier but its actually pretty difficult (if youre not artistic) otherwise i had A LOT of fun. shes always getting you to expand your mind and to try new techniques with artworks. very good about gradding, i highly recomend this class and this professor
Good teacher. Projects were pretty in depth, but she was very lenient as long as you were willing to work with her.

I took this class for a gen ed and it turned out to be wayy too much work. Projects seemed to be made for advanced art students and she never explained what we had to do until we were like halfway done with a project. Had multiple articles to read and response papers and had to do  work on projects outside of class. I do not recommend this class.

Very disrespectful to students - refused to change an error she made, using a students dead name publicly, which directly went against the university's equity policies. Learned mostly through textbook/ readings.

She has very unclear instructions. She'll claim that you earned a low grade because you didn't meet certain criteria, but that criteria was never specified. She follows TurnItIn to the extreme, meaning that if it deems your last name as plagiarism, she will grade it as such. She is short with students and has no understanding for small mistakes.
Wow, that's all I'm gonna say… wow 3/10
This professor waited until the last minute to grade everything in which in her syllabus says otherwise, and the assignments were confusing.

tags: ['Tough grader', 'Get ready to read', 'Lots of homework']
comment: Grading and assignments were confusing, especially during the end. So much reading, with little discussion on how it ties into the profession.

I would definitely recommend if you can taking a class with Dr. Shema. She is such a caring professor and wants to see you succeed. Her class assignments are long but gives you a good amount of time to complete them. So Sweet. Always willing to help and is easy to contact.

I took 730, which wasn't an option. I really didn't always do my best in this course, but that's not the professor's fault. She was really awesome, but she expects punctuality with assignments, which I really struggle with. But if you do your work, you will get a good grade.

Dr.Shema lacked major qualities it takes to be a teacher. Grading criteria was never clear and assignments were confusing and were often worded weirdly which caused confusion. Lectures were often 3 hours of her talking with only a 5 min break. Organization and knowledge of technology lacked to great extent.
Great course with Doctor Shema.  Gave the course the benefit of all her knowledge.

Great professor with a passion for teaching. Had some of the most thought-provoking discussions in her class. Participation feels natural. No tests, assessments are done throughout the course in other ways. You know she really cares about you & your learning. Amazing!!!!!
Teacher is terrible. Does not care about students learning

This class was supposed to support me while I was at my internship, but it gave me more to worry about. All assignments are due at noon. Honestly, you have no one to help you in this class besides your classmates, because she is unreachable outside of the biweekly class. If you do have an issue at your internship, don't expect support from her.

Not accessible outside class& info is repetitive.I didnt learn anything & wish my time was utilized better. students didnt feel supported by her& staff during internship.some classmates had issues at their internship/site supervisor &the professor would not advocate for students.we felt unheard/anxious bc the people in authority did not stand by us

I do not recommend taking her if you can avoid it. She is not easily accessible outside of class if you need help and assignments do not have clear instructions. Some assignments are worth no points but you are still required to do them. This class was supposed to give me support for my internship but it made me even more stressed out.
Very helpful. Tells you exactly what she wants and what is on the tests. She makes hilarious statements, often without trying to be funny. I would definitely recommend taking this class with her.

The BEST spanish teacher by far from what I've heard of the others in the spanish department. She's nice and friendly and is a lot of help if you just ask. She gives you great study guides and tells you exactly what to study. Participation is key in her class.
a really funny, really good teacher. she's really helpful and will actually let you know what questions will be on the test. i definately recommend taking spanish with her
Took her Beg Spanish course over the summer. Very intense but she is very helpful. Tells you what is on the exam. Very understandable professor. Very kind too. Take her for Spanish!

HIGHLY RECCOMENDED!! She is a wonderful teacher. I got an A in her class. Everything is crystal clear. She even tells you what to study for the exams. She may add a couple extras but if you studied and payed attention in class you will know what to do. FYI-If you have an A toward end of class, she will exempt you from the final.
The best spanish professor out there. She actually teaches the stuff to you and does not assign a lot of online homework. Tells you exactly what is on the exams and what you need to know.

She is a very nice lady, and very concerned with students learning spanish. She has a hard time speaking english so sometimes she doesn't understand the questions you are asking. She gives all her notes on line and her tests aren't bad. She gives you study guides for everything. Just pay attention and ask for help if you need it!
tough but fair. Ready to take on the working world
she has an accent but she knows her stuff. I really learned a lot and she prepared me for the working world too.

She is a great professor. She really wants you to learn and will slow down to make sure you do. Her English was a little hard to understand, but over time became easier. She loves to make you laugh. You must take Spanish with her!

Professor Rojas was truly a great professor.  She is fairly strict and expects a lot from students; however, being a 300 level class, you should expect that. Love this class. No textbook but lots of reading and participation counts alot. Strong and confident professor who knows her stuff! Never boring and teaches in the moment.

Mike is a nice guy, but has no idea how to teach. The 3-hour night class was deathly boring as he would stand there for 3 hours reading from his PPT printouts that were taken directly from info in the textbook. There was no class discussion, rarely a break, and he always went to the bitter end of the class time.

Maybe it was the time of this class (6-9:15 pm every Monday) or the fact that it was statistics, but I really disliked this class. Mike is a good guy, but he over-relied on the online homeworks to teach for him and wasted everyone's time in class. Since stats is a nursing pre-rec, I dropped the course so it didn't hurt my chances.

I highly recommend this class and professor to fill the statistics requirement for psychology majors.  Professor Maniaci is extremely understanding and helpful, and honestly cares about the success of his students.  He never hesitates to elaborate on difficult material.  Although lengthy, weekly Aplia homeworks help a lot and are easy A's.

Despite the professor's passion for his subject, this was a very difficult class. Intro is a misnomer. Students with no prior math experience were expected to learn advanced statistical techniques. The professor routinely took the class past the 9:15pm end time, forcing me (a commuter and full-time worker) to chose between the lecture and sleep.

very nice man. loves the material he teaches and makes concepts easier to understand. he makes jokes through out the class that makes class more enjoyable. there were online assignment that were extremly helpful and only two tests. i would recomend this class to any one who needs to satisfy a statistics course

I really liked this professor! I feel that a lot of his students, especially in my class this semester, were very stubborn to wanting to put any effort into their studies. He seems like a nice guy and definitely knows his stuff. I really enjoyed this class overall.

While he was a nice enough gut, his teaching style was horrible. He talks in circles, and over explains every thing which just confuses you more. I learned more on my own by doing the homework. Not really sure about the text on line, I don't have access to internet at work, but i loved Aplia for the homework.

Awesome! I thought this professor was great he always got back to emails and was kind and considerate of his students. His explanations were exceptional, and all the information was very neatly prepared. He made math enjoyable, and had an enthusiasm for it. I LOVED Aplia and it made life so much easier. I loved him as a teacher.
He is such a great teacher. I have never been one for math, but his explanations made is very simple and fun!

I had the worst time paying attention to and following his lecture.  Thank goodness attendance wasn't required!  Our homeworks were done on-line as was out textbook reading which although I started of really disliking I ended up appreciating.  I leared SO much through the textbook and assignments but not so much through the lecture.

May be the worst teacher I ever had...only talked about statistics in a class where stats was not a prereq.  Showed up late for the 3 hour night class almost always, didn't give us a break until a few weeks into the semester when people started complaining to the department, and kept us until the last second. It was his first semester and it shows.
I cant believe this course 300 level and Im fully convinced college is a scam after taking her course. Also don't bother sending her emails she will not respond.

CIS classes with Kamal are miserable. They are boring, most of the subject material does not matter and if it does it's things that are obvious. I would avoid all CIS classes but also any classes that require being with her in person are tough. Her lectures are very dry.

Her class was not too difficult, only issue i ever had was there were some papers due and i got points of for not properly following the format but there was no clear format outlined in the assignment description, other than that ive had a great experience with Dr.Kamal

CSC 356 is one of those classes you just need to get through. Taking it online with Kamal was easy and did not absorb all of my time. The term paper will take a little time, and the online presentation is rough but most of the class is pretty straightforward and will be pretty easy. Do your work weekly and you will get a good grade.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Respected', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: Kamal is by far hands down one of the best professor at SUNY Brockport, I am a below average student and I could care less about school. But Kamal's class is interesting and makes you want to work. Her classes are actually informative and will help you out in the real world. Great teacher, always willing to help.

Her lectures are very dry, she just reads from the slides. Make sure to have the textbook to be able to get a more in depth look at the information. There isn't a lot of work in the class, and she doesn't take attendance. Her explanations if you ask a question are very shallow, she just repeats what she said the first time. Not horrible, not great.

Took professor for computer information systems. Would publicly critique group work during the presentation, hold class until someone answered basic questions, class was boring because she was emotionless.  Cited Comcast as an example of customer intimacy, even though they are #1 worst company in 2014 by Consumerist.  Many other reasons as well.
Super helpful, very cute!
She loves presentations and group projects, which might turn people away. Strict on the project/presentations, but fairly lenient on exams and labs. Can be very helpful.

Such a sweet teacher! She is very kind, and a very good professor.  She keeps things simple and easy, we did not have a single test all year.  Just assignments to do, and term paper + final exam.  The information you learn is relevant, loved the class.
Not only does this class cover your woman's study requirement, it's actually quite interesting since it covers extremely current events in terms of technology.
Easy step by step A. And she's gorgeous!
Super easy class. Just do the step by step assignments and you're set. Easy A. Dr. Kamal is very friendly and always willing to help, not that you will need it for this material.

He truly knows about what he is teaching, cares about student feedback and lets you know what is needed to attain a certain grade so that you will not be surprised. Good professor, not a hard grader and has a great personality. 10/10

Really funny, enjoyable classes. The textbook was more confusing so I never read it. Lectures were important but not mandatory, when I missed class it was hard to catch up. Some units were super easy and others more challenging. Too much math for my taste but overall very interesting.

Komdat is one of my favorite professors so far! He's such a funny dude and his lectures are always very insightful with lots of room for open discussion. Just be sure to read the case studies in the textbook as you will often be asked about them during class

Amazing professor! He always appreciates good class discussion, and he leads such discussion very well. Do the textbook readings before class (if anything, just read the cases) because they will be talked about in class. Very minimal graded assignments, but he always wants to help people get a good grade. So funny, definitely take a class with him!

comment: There are readings to be done before EVERY class that WILL be discussed. Graded by few things during the semester so try your best. Funny professor sometimes.
-Lots of textbook ready -He makes it easier to understand the difficult topics in philosophy - Funny

comment: This teacher was my least favorite of last year she let student talk over her and we were supposed to have Tuesday off but never did because we never got through the lectures.
You will have to read to past the exams.

The assignments given in her online class do not make any sense in relating it to the class material taught, the assignment instructions relating to content is vague in how I am relating this to the content learned. I hated the lecture style. No powerpoints just "fill in the blank" style made the pace of the class SO slow. She does not post her powerpoints btw. Memorization heavy, and no guidance on what will be on exam. Monotone and boring class in my opinion. Felt like I was doing her job.

tags: ['Tough grader', 'Get ready to read', 'Lots of homework']
comment: NEVER taking a class with this professor again. Horrible professor. Accuses students of using AI by using AI herself while checking assignments. Very harsh grader. I would not even recommend this professor to my worst enemy. If you do take any course with her I would advise to be careful and be ready for the worst.

NOT GOOD!! Lecture is just straight copy and paste from the textbook, you have to memorize things from lecture, activities in lecture, the textbook, and another book you are required to read. She does not give help when asked. She gives bonus points but it is 1 point each. Very tough grader.

Research Methods is an extremely challenging class, but Dr. Ratcliff made it more manageable. The research project has a lot of work leading up to the final paper, so do not slack off. The APA manual book is also helpful to have so your paper is the way that professor Ratcliff wants your papers.

Her lectures were following a power point and filling in the blanks. The test was pretty much common sense but that is because I have an insight on crime itself. If you pay attention in class then you will do fine. There is extra credit which helps you in the long run. The textbook is really only used if you need extra clarification.

PSH and Law is a challenging class. Harsh grader. Powerpoint and lecture heavy. No study guidance when it comes to exams. You must memorize everything and pray that you are studying what she might put on the exam. She throws in random things from the textbook so.. read the textbook too. This class is was a leap of faith for me.
I will NEVER take another class with this professor. Please avoid her at all cost. Does not care about anything but deadlines.
Excellent.

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Lecture heavy']
comment: Her class is very run of the mill and lecture heavy. She occasionally throws in an interesting clip but other than that, you can expect to sit through PowerPoint slides. Overall the course is somewhat unclear. She doesnt post the slides or a study guide so you have to take a leap of faith with every exam. Even the syllabus is an unorganized mess.

I love her! She made a scary class into a much easier class. Notes are lecture style and she provides fill in the blank. It is sometimes difficult to explain your questions but she is really helpful/nice. Lots of easy extra credit opportunities. She really focuses on making sure you learn and your grade will reflect your effort. Would take again!

Dr. Ratliff was not my favorite. She gave chances for extra credit but she makes you work for it. Make sure to know how to write a research paper in APA style before class starts. Once you pick a topic for your research paper, make sure u know what is happening. My group got screwed because we didnt know what we were doing

she does not post notes online, therefore if you miss a day you are screwed. she took 5 points off of my paper for it being more than 2 pages. had a family issue and she still penalized me, although my two other psych professors allowed me time with my family. She is not understanding, very soft spoken and a hard grader. tests are hard.

I have had Ratcliff for Social Psych, Psych and Law, Research Methods, and have also been a research assistant for her. There is a reason I keep going back to her. She is fantastic teacher and when asked, she will do her best to make sure everyone understands. He tests are straight forward. If you want an A I recommend reading the textbook.

Dr. Ratcliff is really very nice and her class is pretty clear. Attendance isn't mandatory but it's better that you go. The tests are very textbook heavy so you have to read the whole thing carefully and closely. Offers lots of bonus points!

Ratcliff is a very sweet lady and she cares about your grade! she gives lots of extra credit. she gives a list of what will be on each test so make sure you study that as you go along and you should be able to get an a or b! i also didnt touch my textbook so i wouldnt recommend you buy it ! everything you need to know is in her notes, save the $120

Research Methods is a scary class. It was a class I was afraid to take since I started college. Ratcliff did all she could to help ease the pain of a difficult class. The lab assignments really help so do well on those and chose a topic you are interested in. I would recommend her if you had to take a Research Methods class.
Overall a good professor. Very strict about deadlines though, so beware. Lecture is pretty dry, so study your notes as opposed to focusing on in-class topics.

You get graded on 4 tests, 1 paper (2 halves), 10 labs (easy), and a presentation. Specifically, your paper is your own experiment you choose to conduct in your class. You make your own measures and questionnaires, submit and analyze your own data, present your findings to the class, and write a manuscript (in parts). It's like scholars day!

I took research methods with her this semester and she was very helpful. The breaks down the class so you can gain back points if you do poorly on the exams. She also is very clear about assingments and what she expects out of them.
Took Social Psych as a summer course and I'm glad I did. The amount of work wasn't overwhelming and the grading was fair. I felt engaged, not overloaded.

Have taken a few classes with her.Very sweet, nice, and cares about her students.Will give you extra help.Classes are easy,are people really that lazy?You have to write well to do good on papers.Shes okay at lecturing,not bad at all.Shes just soft spoken.Powerpoint can get kinda boring,but she is a good prof. overall.Read for better understanding.
Very helpful professor who cares about her students success.

I took PSH332 MOD1 summer course which was a two week course Monday through Friday 1p to 5p, it was an awful course, you had to cram information and read the text for little pieces of information for her tests. She was an awful teacher, I would not take her class if you do not have too.
Lots of papers. Learned nothing. I do not recommend.
Easy on the eyes. Pretty boring class, as you just follow notes. She seemed to give a good deal of busy work. Overall not horrible, but not my favorite.
very helpful, wants to be sure students understand what it being taught. good professor and quite intelligent

Loved this Professor. She's such a sweet lady and teaches very well. She uses powerpoints n has it ready b4 class starts-- so u can follow along. Good review sessions-- games. I am taking her again next semester for another class. Easy class just really had to go over powerpoints-- i rarely even used my book.

I took research methods and social psych with her. Loved her in research methods, not so much in social. The notes don't match up with what we read, so I'm a bit confused, but she is dedicated to making sure we all do well and advance our careers. She is a very sweet lady.

She is very helpful and her main concern is helping you out, both in her class and after her class has ended. She's the only professor I know who handed back a final paper so we could use them as references in the future for manuscript writing. Her tests are fair if you study. Questions from the book are only in sections not in the notes, just fyi

VERY GOOD PROFESSOR. SHE MADE IT VERY EASY TO UNDERSTAND THE MATERIAL. IT WAS NEVER ABOUT THE GRADE, BUT RATHER HOW MUCH OF THE MATERIAL YOU RETAINED. SHE HELPS US USE OURSELVES WHEN DOING CASE STUDIES. OVERALL IT WAS A WONDERFUL CLASS.

Nice lady, but really is never positive on her answers. Class often had to correct her or she needed to go "look it up". Overall, easy class but focused heavily on the textbook. It seemed to get better as the class progressed and lots of funny and interesting video clips, which helped often. Just needs some time to settle into Brockport.

She may be very intelligent, but she cannot teach. She teaches about 25% of what is on the test, and the rest, from the book and who knows where else...but it's ridiculous. I studied for the tests and got horrible grades on all of them. She did give a lot of bonus, but this class was a waste of time. If you can get another professor, do so.
Well educated professor.  Notes are very helpful as well as examples of the product we're learning.  Gives out a lot of bonus points which are beneficial!!
Really good professor. She knows what she's doing and her notes are really helpful. Good sense of humor and amazing review games just make this class awesome!

Logan wasn't a bad professor but she tried to make an already hard class even harder. I understand that there is a lot to cover, but she rushed through the material and I had to teach myself a lot. There were quizzes every week and the tests were very hard with class averages <60. But she wanted us to succeed and was happy to provide extra help.

Dr. Logan does a good job of making sure people understand things before moving on. She sometimes gets a little bit too deep into the theory and doesn't do enough examples, but always makes sure there are practice problems and mastering problems to help study for exams. Also tries to incorporate some humor into lecture which is nice.

Dr. Logan is a great person but she is a tough grader. In class she is no help at all. She reads directly off the powerpoint and never stops for questions. She assumes that you're already an expert chemist. She openly says that she does not care if you pass or fail, she gets paid either way. Be prepared to self teach and find a tutor.

This class is really hard, but Dr Logan is an excellent professor. She is knowledgable, she is very helpful both in and out of class, and she is actually a very nice woman once you get to know her. Anyone who blames her for their bad grade is at fault. Chemistry will never be easy no matter who teaches it - you have to study.

Super nice and smart lady. All class notes are online. Mastering Chemistry provides MORE THAN ENOUGH practice problems that are more difficult than the exam questions. Does clicker questions in class so that you can apply what you just learned and is very flexible outside of class. I skipped 15-18 classes straight and still did well on the test.

comment: Logan is so smart that it is hard to understand what she is saying. she does not start off with the basics  You will need to read the book and doing the masterings to understand.

Very hard class. If you don't put the work in you won't pass. All she did was read off of powerpoints and did not go into large detail how to work the problems. Its too much of a lesson for a 55 min class and you will have to stay for every min of it. Also I hated how the 3 exams during the course were such huge points of your grade. Didnt help.
I loved  her. Her lectures are usually not boring and the tests are pretty easy. She is easily accessible outside of class and is willing to work with you to improve your grade.
The material was there for the most part. Tests were a bit awkward. Powerpoints are straightforward and on Blackboard so if you're good at Chem don't bother going to every class

i don't even have words for how awful she was. she would ask if everyone understands and when the entire lecture (300 students) said no she laughed and continued on. reads right off the powerpoint, very scatter-brained, spends 15 mins of class talking about office hours and what we are going to learn instead of teaching it. long and boring lectures

She explains everything in a really haphazard way. Her math skills are garbage too. She once did a problem with a calculator and people in the lecture had to argue with her. decent professor for such a difficult course (organic chem).  helpful if you seek her out, but there is a lot of work and a lot of it is very hard.  excellent instructor in lab.

Fair, knowledgeable, and always informs you one what she expects and upcoming due dates.  Easily one of the best professors I've ever had.  Organic Chemistry is hard, but she makes it simple if you're willing to put in the work. Also a great pre-med adviser.  I highly recommend.

I HATE ORGO. DR LOGAN IS A NICE LADY BUT THAT DOES NOT MEAN THAT SHE IS A GOOD TEACHER. PAYED ATTENTION TO STUDENTS WHO KNEW WHAT THEY WERE DOING BUT WAS NOT HELPFUL FOR STUDENTS WHO WERE LOST. I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND THIS CLASS.

Dr. Logan is great.  She is very motherly and will take you under her wing (not a bad deal considering this is OCHEM) She knows her stuff and is a great teacher.  She also is an incredible resource when it comes to anything pre-med. I love you dr. logan!

Chemistry profs generally suck; she doesn't. Friendly, maybe the most accessible prof I've had, esp. out of office hours. Class has a high workload. Grading is consistent... and grades are low. Do ALL the reading and MANY problems, you'll be fine. Loved the class.
Dr. Logan is great! She remembers everyone's name and has a passion for chemistry. If you don't like her, it's actuallybecause you dislike chemistry. She is very helpful.

In MY rich fantasy life, I would avoid Maggie Logan and her god awful iPad. She is however an extremely intelligent woman and more than willing to help when needed. Like any other TRUE science course, you need to put in the time to be successful and can't expect to squeak by like in other courses.

Nice person, Horrible teacher. Rushed through everything, really boring. Quizzes and tests were hard. I changed my major because of this course. Harsh grader with no curves and OWL homeworks are insanely tidious.

It is always amazing to me what Dr. Logan knows and can remember (including everyone's name). Very enthusiastic teacher with much experience. She knows everyone's name and is understanding/encouraging because she knows that Gen Chem and Organic are required for many majors.

I took organic 1 with Dr. Logan and she was great. she is passionate and will help whenever you need it. its a lot of work, but its organic! it should be a lot of work! Her grading system gives you plenty of room to boost your grade. she gives a bunch of bonus hw too. she is extremely fair. If you do the work, your grade will reflect it!

First off, she's awesome! You can tell she's really passionate about the subject and she brings that passion to the class room. Very Nice but not the best at explaining things. Lots of work.
Nice enough person but gives outrageous amounts of work. It is very easy to fall behind and once you do your toast. Very hard to follow what is going on in class.
She's a very nice person, but impossible to get help from.

she remembers almost 80% of the students names throughout the year. not bad considering how she always makes fun of how old she is. Do your OWLS!! she tells you whats going to be on the exams, the hard part is studying and putting in the hours.

She's very cute in a geeky chem major sort of way. She's extremely intelligent, but it's hard for her to teach her skills to students, and she usually makes you figure it out by yourself. Keep up with the online homework which usually teaches you most of the concepts. Unless your major requires it, I don't recommend taking one of her classes.

You can tell she loves the subject and she really cares about her students. You just have to be willing to ask for help outside of class. The homework is a little annoying but they get the point across and you learn how to compute things. And she is always cracking jokes in class as well.

Class is necessary for a lot of majors, but if you don't have to take it then I wouldn't recommend it. Logan is very enthusiastic about her subject, but she is horrible at explaining things. Great teacher, goes out of her way to help students. For someone who has been teaching for a long time she hasn't lost her sense of humor or love of chemistry. Shes not an old fart professor who just wants to collect paychecks, she really does care.

Chemistry is chemistry.  If you don't do the work, you will fall behind and end up with a bad grade.  However, Dr. Logan tries her *best* to help you succeed.  If you don't do well on the exams, there are plenty of extra points available from clickers and online homework (OWL)

Professor Logan has to be the worst teacher ever. Class lectures are confusing and choppie, most of the time she doesnt even know what she is talking about. If your not one of her pets, dont bother trying to ask a question, she gives lots of attitude and is some what hostile. Compared to other teachers i have heard about, she is the worst.

Logan goes extremely fast really hates it if she runs out of time or doesnt cover something.  If she doesn't have time to cover it in class, she expects you to learn it on your own.  There isn't any explanations of anything, it's more about examples from the book and thats about it.  The book and the owl hw taught me more than she ever did.

She's really nice, but definitely not the best professor to learn chemistry from (if you hate chemistry like me). I feel like I have narcolepsy in her class. It's very boring, but if you don't understand something, Logan will be glad to help you.

I can't say I was too pleased with the year. Dr. Logan is the best teacher I ever had! It is absolutely impossible to take her class and not fall in love with Chem. Make sure keep up with Owl homework, study in adcance for tests, and make it a point to do well in lab. Other than that, the class is a breeze!

Logan is a good professor, however much of her notes are examples rather than explanations.  Definetely recommend seeing the tutor.  Also, studying DOES pay off, but you have to do it ahead of time for it to work.

Dr. Logan is an amazing professor!! I just finished general chemistry for the fall semester and I'm looking forward to take the second half next semester. She really isn't that hard... general chemistry was basically the same as high school chem,  she is very very helpful and she is great lab professor also! One of the best I've had!!Def Recommend!
She is a really good teacher if you really have a vested interest in chemistry...if not it sucks

Dr logan is a very nice teacher, she means well and if you need help she'll give you time. The class itself I found to be pretty hard and I don't like chemistry. Her tests are pretty hard studying before hand  for like a week or 2 would be a good idea

Dr. Logan is a brilliant teacher!!! I love the way she makes her lectures really interesting with demonstrations, and simplifies chemistry making it really straightforward to grasp. About 5 or 6 exams, and clicker questions in class. Definitely recommended: take her classes if you can...
She is Great but CHEM IS RIDICULOUS!!!

I am going to miss her! This spring semester for organic chemistry 2 was her last semester teaching it. She was pretty sad that she was leaving us because we were a fun class! She's teaching General Chemistry. She would make an excellent teacher though. She's helpful, sweet, a genius, and makes chemistry comprehensible and fun!

She's an excellent teacher! I was shocked this semester she only had 2 A's and majority of people failed with D's and C-'s. I like her!

Great teacher

Great Professor, amazing wealth of knowledge. Best teacher I've met in Brockport so far.
Dr. Logan is a great professor and person. She is one of the few professors that makes me glad I chose SUNY Brockport (makes you wish more professors followed her lead)!

everybody luvs maggie

Dr. Hiabach is the best Professor. She is extremely helpful and truely loves and cares about what she does. She is absolutely beautiful, smart, funny, sophisticated and classy. The best Professor hands down.

Very nice. Easy tests and simple assignments. Highly recommended.

Kam is a very nice professor. Guitar ensemble is a really fun course and can be taken for credit multiple times. Extremely formal- wants students to raise hands, not be late, not get up during class, calls you out during presentations. lets class out really early. Disorganized. Blames students for his errors. Pros: wkly assignments are easy, gives "no hw" weeks at times, gives extensions if you ask, only 1 textbook- has lots of good info if you need it, slides are clear

Cons: he (& his book) r the only source of knowledge, assignments have 1-4 questions-it's best you get the right answer, he is looking for HIS answer, he needs to add a discussion board

This class I felt was all over the place. Assignments were weekly and easy to understand. Lectures were confusing most times, it felt as if he was just going off on tangents instead of lecturing. He's very funny and easy to listen to, so if you don't love sitting through lectures you might like him. The class is pretty easy if you have some general history knowledge. The only grades are a midterm, presentation/paper and the final so be careful and study.

Not a great professor. The class is VERY test heavy. 1 midterm 1 final and 1 final paper. You have 3 shots to pass the class, just 3 the whole year. Dr. Kachiga is so funny, some of the simplest things he says will get you to laugh. lets us out of class early all the time. not very accessible except for office hours. the actual class is very interactive but also interesting when you talk about different topics and hear others' POV. If you don't pass at least you will laugh!

A classic pseudo-academic with almost nothing to teach. Bring a good humor or you'll be frustrated quickly. But he is very easy to please. He uses himself as his main source for 'facts', so good luck trying to figure out his questions

Not bad professor but little bit crazy. Very old school, which mean students are not allowed to go to restroom if someone does go to restroom he will concerned as insult to himself. Some of his information is misleading and off the topic.

comment: Dr. Kachiga is an overall nice person who makes his lectures interesting and engaging. Dr. Kachiga is really a great guy. I'm a sophomore this semester and he is overall my favorite professor yet. 10 pages of essay is tough, but lecture and exam are approachable. He is generally nice man.

comment: Professor Kachiga is, for the most part, a nice man. Do not show up late to his class!! He will call you out on it and he gets very upset when people interrupt his teaching. He only gave a midterm exam, a final exam, and a final essay, making it vital to show up to his classes.

Kachiga rambles on endlessly and makes very simple concepts more confusing in his explanations. He gets angry and makes comments any time a student comes in late or goes to the bathroom which causes more distraction than the student did. He is the absolute worst poli sci professor at Brockport, avoid at all costs.

Not at all what I thought this class was going to be.  You don't really go over global issues, is more about gender, environment, health issues that affect the world.  There are only two tests, the mid-term and the final.  With a final paper due at the end of the semester.  Not worth your time.

Nice guy but just an uninteresting class to me. His accent can be a little confusing at times but you get used to it. 3, 10 question short answer tests and an 8 page paper for the final. If you don't show up to class you WILL NOT do well because he doesn't post lectures online. Must put in the effort for a good grade.

He's a pretty good teacher, sometimes gets confused on what he's trying to get across. Tests are not too bad, but grades them a little harder than expected. Goes by slides and doesn't post them so if you miss class you will fail. Not an easy A if that's what your looking for. His review sheet for tests is garbage, doesn't help prepare at all.

This class wasn't terrible. I did the readings about 85% into the semester. Attendance is a big deal for him, as well as participation. Just make sure to raise your hand every now and then or he'll pick someone off his attendance sheet. There are three exams and an essay. He gives a review sheet. I wouldn't stress about the class, he's pretty cool.

This guy is pretty cool, his accent takes some getting use to but it isn't hard to understand. He jokes about American culture which makes lectures more enjoyable. Kachiga is my favorite teacher!! Every class you'll laugh and he grades fairly easy. He is seriously a teacher that you enjoy going to his office hours because it's just fun to chat! I have taken about 4 of his classes, but he does assign a lengthy paper that is due at the end of the semester which could greatly help if you need to boost your grade
Very informative and detailed in every class. Nice guy and funny at times. Takes attendance only certain days but overall a very awesome class

Kachiga's lectures are fairly straightforward, he explains things very thoroughly and gives good examples. He only has three short answer tests throughout the semester. My Global Issues class was fairly easy. Kachiga is a really great professor, he sometimes has trouble describing things because hes English is not the best (not horrible). always gives a study guide which is what the test is exactly on.

Kachiga was great, although a bit hard to understand sometimes. You really need to listen to what he says. His powerpoints are just outlines, he always expands upon them, which you must listen to. Overall, though, I thought he was fantastic.
Long and boring lectures but he tries to be funny. Only a few tests and a presentation. He is a little unorganized and only uses the books for tests.

My favorite professor so far! We actually learn a lot, and he's hilarious. just study and you will do fine!

Professor is such an amazing teacher she really cares about your grade and wants you to do well. Barely any homework just have to really study for tests. She gives you test study and gives you exactly what is going to on them. Highly recommend!!

Priyam never truly gave homework. For a previous class, all we had was a group project and thats all. But for this class, we had one assignment outside of our tests and quizzes. You have to do good on tests in order to pass. She truly wants everyone to pass her class and will always be available fo help. Knows what she's talking about.

Not very good communication outside of class. Makes sure you know what is going on and when everything is due. Doesn't give homework but there are a few tests and quizzes which she makes very aware. Goes kinda fast but if you ask to slow down she will. Very nice person who genuinely wants her students to do good in class.

Prof Prim is literally the worst professor I've ever had. She doesn't grade anything on time and does not communicate with her students at all. If there is anyone else offering this class when you take it, please choose them. Ive never had so many issues with a professor before. You teach yourself the material. She is literally useless.

Not a fan of how she gives test. For the online course she gives you 1 hour and 10 minutes to complete 30 multiple choice questions, 3 short answer questions and 1 long answer question. As someone who likes to thoroughly think answers through I find this time limit ridiculous. Also, once you answer the question you cant do back.

She cares about her students but also kind of doesn't at times bc she hammers students with an assignment after another when you have an exam coming really soon and have other classes to worry about. I have her for both BUS 435 and 441 and isn't hard it's just that she isn't the most organized and assigns everything that is due for 1-2 whole weeks

She became disorganized and pushed back due dates to three major projects back because she wasn't completing in-class discussion on the projects in time. Making us do three time-consuming projects and an exam all the same week.

Dr. Rangan is okay, not the worst but not the best. Her tests are online if you take the Hybrid class and aren't bad. Here and there she got annoyed at me just for asking questions when she wasn't very clear. At some point she becomes pretty disorganized and sometimes ignores emails or forgets them. Marketing is interesting though.

tags: ['Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: Love this professor. Her class is tough however in a good way. Participation and attendance are necessary and the quizzes and case studies can be challenging. Smart and knows what shes doing, actually learned a lot from her adomo class. Would recommend to get on her good side.

Very easy class to pass. She was more than happy to explain things as many times as the students needed. I hated the group project but that's because one of my group partners was a total bum, which isn't her fault. I brought this up to her and she did contact said bum which helped.

Her exams are specific to her lecture notes however there are way too many questions about 70-80 for exams and 25 for quizzes. May sound nice but is actually snobby. She's quite rude and I don't like her. You'll need a great group for the group project. You can pass the class if you study all her power points review sections
SO RUDE and SO MANY TESTS/QUIZZES. TERRIBLE
Professor is an excellent teacher he is very easy going! recommend him !

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: Prof. McGowan is a nice guy but I learned nothing in this class. Bus. Career Seminar is supposed to be about learning job, interview, and resume skills but instead he talked about sports, his non-business related life and gave meaningless assignments. If you want to walk away with some knowledge or job getting tips take it with someone else.

While homework can be lengthy and take a solid amount of time, you are able to actually learn material that will help you to teach English as a whole. You can tell she enjoys her job and takes pride in how and what she teaches. Overall a great teacher who has engaging classes, I would definitely take this class again if I could.

I love this teacher. She is super nice. The assignments are lengthy and they take a decent amount of time to do each week. She didnt grade one thing all semester. I did not know where I stood the whole semester. However, she is not the hardest grader.

Professor Olmstead is outstanding. I can honestly say I have learned things in her class that I will use throughout my teaching career. She is incredibly kind and genuinely wants her students to succeed. She's one of the best.

Kathy was always very understanding and easy to communicate and work with. I took this class as an online course, but would have loved it if it was a hybrid course. I truly feel like I gained a lot of knowledge about how to work with young children as they develop their literacy skills.

Pretty easy class. Does not take attendance but just a kindof boring class. Reads from her notebook and gives you all info needed. There is only 3 grades 2 exams and a final paper. Good class to do homework in and don't buy the textbook you don't use it at all.

Long lecture but she has a lot of experience which keeps it interesting, she tells you exactly what's on the exam the week before so take good notes then! The term paper is long too but she gives more than enough time to finish it and it's on a topic of your choice. Easy grader
such an easy course.  she tells you exactly whats going to be on the exam the week before.  the term paper is long but easy and she grades very easily.  very knowledgable with a lot of experience.

Great class. Norma has a lot to offer, as she is very knowledgeable about Env Law.  Tests and essays are designed to make you think, and she tells you EXACTLY what to study.  The paper is easy, and gives you good insight as to how the legal system works.  She doesn't spread her political opinions, she just states the facts.

I love Norma! She knows her stuff and contributes great examples and stories to the class. She is reasonable and approachable. I appreciate her dedication to the health of our environment and ethical practices regarding it.

Teacher was very knowledgable in Environmental Law and has a strong background in the court system. Her tests were relatively easy as long as you spend some time going over the text book. The text book was only $15 and was put together by her to be relevent to our class. Only issue is she tries to spread her political views to other students.

He is a great professor very engaging and class never feels boring. He gives out a fair amount of extra credit opportunities and is reasonable with tests. Grades are not given until the end of the semester which is a pain, and he is not the best at responding to emails. However, he makes a very tough class very engaging and easy to follow.

This class relies on exams heavily, so if you are not a good test taker be aware! There is a lot to know and reviewing every night was what is necessary. He is very funny and relatable but, will never know your name.

Kinesiology is a very difficult course, but Dr. Williams makes it as tolerable as possible. He gives very engaging lectures that helps the content stick and is just hilarious along the way. He in no way wants to make it difficult to succeed. There is a lot of assignments, but they all felt beneficial, and mostly didn't take too long.

He is one of the only professors I've met who designs his class so that students can learn the material without being put in serious jeopardy for struggling on exams. Labs are set up to take time and practice the material. Kines is hard but he wants you to succeed. Be sure to do the extra credit, and the practice exams.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Respected', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: This guy really lays the material out for you clearly. I have never had a better prof. His classes are very well designed and he definitely knows how to teach. He is also hilarious with a dry sense of humor that makes 8am class bearable. Extra credit is available and there are a lot of opportunities to earn points.

Only take this class if you need it. He's incredibly smart but if you don't understand the material, chances are he won't like you. I had to teach myself all of the material through the textbook and youtube videos before I took the final. Worst class I've ever taken.
Very challenging material but if you put the time in you'll succeed. Do all the extra credit! It adds up to half a letter grade at end...you'll need it when the final comes.
Great teacher, he is so damn smart, and he knows the material is very difficult but he will get you through the class if u just go to every class. Best teacher ive had at brockport.

I thought kinese was hard..until I took biomechanics..wow..williams in by far the smartest teacher at bport..his classes are hard..but if you are willing to work hard he will help you..he gives soo much extra credit u will pass his classes no matter what grades u get if u go to every class and get the extra credit..DONT take any classes with Dr.too
Genius...even though he doesn't look like it (I alwyas thought he was a janitor or something). Material is tough, but he gets you through it.
The best professor at Brockport by far (in Phys Ed dept).  Can always go to for help even if he's not your professor or advisor.  I've had him for three classes and each one has been awsome.
Will definetly do anything to help out students.  Gives out tons of extra credit opportunities!  Has a good sense of humor too!
Best teacher for Kines / Biomech.  He is a genius.  Can teach the material very well and gives a lot of extra credit opportunity.

Hardest subject matter Ive ever encountered. Extremely qualified, helpful, fair, and thorough as a teacher. The hardest A I ever worked for. GREAT GUY! Avoid the class if u can, but if u must he's the Prof to get.

absolutely one of the smartest men I have ever come into contact with. the class is hard, but he makes it interesting and uses drawings and explanations in ways that make it understandable. besides this, he is GORGEOUS! definitely makes you pay attention
hard class but he does whatever he can to help. better than Too.
One of the best at Brockport, comes in a close second with Dr. Petersen!
No Comments
hard class, but willing to help you as much as possible.
Kinesiology and Biomechanics have so far been my favorite courses. He is an awesome teacher and a great guy.
He makes this course fun and interesting.  He also gives lots of opportunities for extra credit.
No Comments
