Very intense teaching style.  Makes us learn our stuff.
Williams loves to teach. You can see that passion in him! He's one of the few!
Only had him 2 days so far, but, WOW, what an amazing teacher. Harvard material!
The best class and professor
This is an experience that I fiund exciting. I took Prof Herrmann's class last semester, and I miss not going to class. The discussions were GREAT!
I really enjoyed this class. The professor made the semester an enjoyable experience. He knows more than any other social work instructor.
Ken is fascinating. This was an incredible course.
Prof Hermann is what a professor should be. He not only talks the talk; he also walks the walk.

I have had herrman for 2 classes this semester.  For each we had to write 4 ten page papers each.  If you do the research and write ten pages and have sources then you will do fine.  His bark is bigger than his bite and he is a great teacher!

This is my fourth class with Prof Herrman. The semester is beginning, and I look forward to the course through the semester. This professor is incredible. He makes taking courses interesting, exciting and fun. What I learn is so important to my career.

He does care about what he is teaching and i learned very useful information and now have a growing interest in Social and Economic Justice. Ken is very opinionated and I found his use of colorful language and "don't care" attitude funny at the beginning of the semester but his attitude started to wear on me by the end. Easy A if you care about SW.
This online course was an exciting adventure. The professor was always available, fair, demanding, and knowledgible. I learned more from him than any other professor

He either likes you as a student or hates you and makes his opinions very clear.  I took his online class and would never take him as a teach in an actual classroom.  He is rude and condescending towards his students if he does not like them.  I recommend the course just for the subject matter bc it is very interesting but not for the Professor.
This professor is demanding and cares about what he teaches. Mostly online course provides much support and many resources. Learned lots more than in most courses.

go to all THREE of his classes ON TIME. youll lose valuable points if you dont. go online for the chats for 10 pts extra credit. 4 ten page papers make up your grade. do them early or throughout the sememster. not spending every saturday of the month of november writing like i did. he can be horribly mean to students in class but an easy A

If you open your ears to his stories and his points, you will learn so much about reality. Ken shows his students what the real world is and does not sugarcoat anything. I had him a couple semesters ago and he pushed me to be passoinate about social change...it still hasn't worn off. Thanks, Ken!

Herrmann is tough to get along with at times as his opinions are very strong, write strong persuasive papers that really show that you have some idea whats going on in the world relating to social and economic justice and you'll survive. ignore his abrasiveness, it wares off when you realize how much you've learned from the research.
Best prof. Best class. Learned more than I leared throughout my college career so far. This is a prof who REALLY cares.

Prof Herrmann grades based on 10 5pg papers throughout the semester. The entire class is a lecture. I learned a lot. I would suggest this class if you have strong writing skills. If not it could be frustrating.
This class makes learning come alive this year. I am fired up about social change like never before. What a Prof!

You will never have a better professor then Ken Herrmann.  I participated in his Vietnam program this past semester and it was the best experience of my life. His passion for social work is contagious and admirable.  DO NOT BE AFRAID OF HIM!!! otherwise his class will be a bad experience for you
Herrmann is the best instructor I have had in college. He made exciting what might have been boring if taught by the other instructors in this program.  His assignments are fair but challenging.
Not very clear on how we did on essays, and never gave feedback.
The best, simply the best. VERY interesting and helpful. I want him for all my college courses.

I was interested in social justice before I took Herrmann's class but I found out I really knew little. This class has opened my eyes and my mind. I learned more than I ever expected. It was exciting and challenging.
This man brings a clarity and energy to my favorite class ever in college.  Avoid the other profs and sign up for every class he teaches.

It has been a few years since Ken was my professor. A friend suggested this site to express my thanks to him for all he does.  His teaching demnds the best from students. He has made a great impact on my career and life. Thanks to him and SUNY Brockport. He told me to change the world. With his help, I will. He is a blessing.
I am in Ken's program in Viet Nam. This is the best decison I have ever made. What a wonderful program!!! Thank you, Ken. I hope more will come here to learn and help.
He is like an encyclopedia of information with a laugh. I love this class.
He is a very lazy Professor. He is his own biggest fan. Very vulgar and rude.
a knowledgible professor this semester. what an exciting experience. the only class i took that kept me totally awake. it opened my eyes to so much i needed to know.

this man was an experience. he is a fund of information about international social work and issues. learned more in his class than any other in college. i'll miss him but i will never forget his humor and how he made me think.
Learned lots in his class. Makes me want to do more to change things than I thought before the class.  Made me think and grow up.
It was a wild ride with this professor. I grew up thanks to him.
Interesting, challenging, funny instructor. VERY happy I took his course.

he is a great teacher as long as you understand what he is trying to do with his teachings.  He has the biggest potty mouth, but it adds to his humor.  He is a great teacher

This class was hard for me but Stefan as a teacher was great. You can tell he is passionate and he worked with me numerous times when i needed help, etc. In class you go over readings so its important to buy the books and actually do the work. It is hard to keep up if you slack off. You are graded by some tests and essays.
Was not a good professor. If your taking this class for a gen ed thinking itll be an easy A, dont!

I personally did not enjoy the content at all, but the work was doable. The few essays caused a lot of stress in the moment but they got done (the people at the writing tutoring center are very helpful). He's a good guy and occasionally funny.  The extra credit project at the end was fun and easy!

Discussion-based course; participation in class is important, but also made this class interesting. Lots of reading; it's possible to get by without it, but it's more rewarding and makes papers, especially the final, a lot easier. Friendly and caring professor, easy to access outside of class. He led interesting discussions and lectures in class.

comment: There were four books required for this course which ended up being a bit expensive. Reading is important and going to class is not mandatory, but lectures are interesting. He really cares about his students and teaching the subject. Only a few essays throughout the semester, classes are group conversation style. Very understanding of students.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Graded by few things', 'Accessible outside class']
comment: This class is can be easy if you show up and listen to the lectures with your camera on. He is very willing to meet or talk over email if there's a problem and is super relaxed on his grading style.

he is very good prof easy to reach outside of class. he really cares about his students he has helped me with a lot even not about the class but with my minor. very easy grader easy A just pay attention in class
Easy grader and very nice you can tell he just wants students to engage.

Professor Jurasinski is definitely one of my favorite professors i’ve had. He is very passionate about what he does and is always willing to help students if they reach out. He is extremely understanding of absences due to emergencies, etc, and is willing to help you catch up on all of the work missed while also being lenient.
he's nice, just a bit boring, and very tedious classes, the reading assignments are long to be honest

Great professor. Clearly wants to see his students succeed and is always available for extra guidance and help. An amazing professor who was clear with what was required. I would highly recommend him for any class.

Dr. Jurasinksi is the best professor at brockport. I have taken 4 of his classes and would take more if I could. His classes are in subjects I wouldn't have thought were interesting but he makes them interesting. Attendance is mandatory but he usually lets you out of class 10 minutes early. Easy grader and loves when students go above and beyond.
Interesting class, should take it. Only have 2 essays and an exam. Books are enjoyable as well

Attendance and participation really matter in this class. For essays, he provides a clear rubric of what he expects and also gives really good feedback on papers and tells you what to do to make the next essay better.

He is very fair and easy to get along with. He is intelligent and I enjoy his class much more than most. He is very good at explaining and analyzing pieces writing. Assignments are mildy challenging. Just put time into reading and a little more than average effort in for the assignments and easy A!

He is a great professor who I personally learned a lot from. He actually likes to teach you how to analyze information in a proper manner and never gives busy work. Every assignment that he gives is very beneficial. He chose very interesting books for us to read and discuss on. You are missing out if you don't read the books. They were fantastic!

The material was challenging but Jurasinski makes every effort to help students grasp it. He's a really good guy and wants his students to succeed. Take the class seriously, participate, ask for help when you need it, and you should do well.

Dr. J is very nice. Early Eng. Lyric was a struggle, but I participated a lot and that helped. Two short papers one longer paper are the major assignments. His classes are hard because he's specific about what he wants you to learn. This class was kind of boring, but I recommend him. He is my adviser and really helpful if you visit his office.
He is a very interested professor, but is completely unclear. Incredibly rough grader, and not a coherent lecturer at all. I like him as a person. He's just not a good teacher.

Very nice professor! Loves to talk. If you do the readings and contribute a couple times to class discussion you won't have a problem in this class. The papers are fairly simple and short, and he's willing to help with anything you need. I am taking another class with him next semester.

Dr. J is extremely helpful and super intelligent and passionate about his courses. He is quick with e-mails and willing to work with students individually if they need extra help; his door is always open. He's private university material within a public school, which is why we are so lucky to have him!

Jurasinski is the best professor I have ever had. I took as many classes with him as I could, and wish I had been able to take more. He is funny and deeply knowledgeable, and has excellent classroom manner. He also cares a great deal about his students.

His teaching methods are incredibly outdated. His quizzes can have a negative impact on your grade because of the unreasonable about of time given to finish them. Don't expect him to remember your name even if you participate in class. He talks about how our educational system has failed us, yet he fails as an educator himself. How ironic...

He's funny, but he's extremely bad at making it clear what he expects from you. He changed the syllabus a lot and expects you to print out everything. If you're not his favorite, you can forget him calling on you or even looking at you.

He might be one of the most intelligent people i've ever met.  The man has Chaucer seeping out his pores.  His dry sense of humor combined with his artistic ability is sure to give you a laugh.  Take a class with him, it's fun.

He's just awkward. He doesn't answer e-mails. He acts like he knows everything. He helps if you go to his office, but this doesn't promise any good grades. He tries to be a good professor, but just drove my classmates and I crazy. Don't talk with others in class. He loves class participation, but asks obscure questions. He clearly has his favorites

Oh sweet Lord. Where to start... He assumes you know more than you do. He goes at his own pace and does not slow down if you don't understand. Sometimes, it's like taking a foreign language class, it's so confusing. Read the textbook or you will not get by. He is too smart for his own good. He doesn't know how to teach  so others can understand.
funny, and interesting. he definitely loved what he was teaching. had a dry but funny sense of humor that always made an appearance. easy class, and interesting. give it a try!
Funny professor!!  Truly enjoys what he is doing and that shows.  He is very willing to help and always responds to questions.  Take classes with him, you won't be sorry.

Amazing professor, makes you interested in stuff that would normally be boring, you really learn a lot, has realistic expectations, really wants you to do well. I'm taking every class possible with him.

He is a good teacher. He knows what he is talking about, and doesn't give long readings. Essays as manageable. Makes himself available during his office hours. TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THEM! He will fix your whole paper and tell you what you need to fix, so on your final paper you won't get anything less than a B+. Great guy

Very good teacher.  Won't throw you any massive assignments without warning.  Tries to keep his views out of the discussion (he likes class participation, by the way).  Really makes you think about your preconcieved notions about issues.

Dr. Stratton's extremely caring and understanding. She's very personal and as long as you're honest with her she'll accommodate assignments if necessary. Her assignments for Academic Planning are easy and as long as you show up you'll get an easy pass.

Loved her as my advisor. I took her for my GEP class and could ask for a better teacher. She understood the pressure we were under as first years and tried to make it as easy as possible. We had pretty easy homework. Caring and understanding.

I loved Professor Cheema. I know some people here talked about her personality, but my experience with her was great. She was always understanding if I missed an assignment and allowed me to still do it. She is a somewhat tough grader, but she always gives great feedback.

comment: Great Professor. Very knowledgeable and gives great feedback. Would definitely take another class with Dr. Cheema!!
Dr. Cheema is an excellent professor. She pushes her students to challenge themselves and is always available for help. She goes above and beyond.
Amazing professor and very understanding. You will learn a lot. Class is hard sometimes but overall it will teach you a lot.

Dr. Cheema is a hard grader but you will learn a lot in her class. Her classes can be difficult but overall she grades you hard to make you a better student. Class is a mix of writing assignments and tests/ quizzes.
Dr Cheema is the worst

She is an awful teacher. She seems to be bipolar; sometimes she can be approachable however, when it comes to emails that's when her true form comes out. She is not lenient meaning that if there is an exam on Friday she will still assign a quiz, discussion boards and give you the study guide two day before the exam. Her notes make no sense.
Harsh grader and it's unfortunate as I like the course, would probably not recommend this instructor to others as I did not learn much from lectures.

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Tough grader']
comment: She is a tough woman. Email etiquette is a must. She can be understanding at times and sometimes not. She has a hot and cold personality and it shows in her grading at times. Harsh grader, and you must stay on top of your work. she does rely on quizzes too there are times where she comes across as lacking sympathy for her students, No late work.

She was an ok professor overall. I have had run into problems with her but the class itself was easy. I am still bad at public speaking and am still terrified of it but I guess there is nothing she could have done to help.
I took her happiness course this spring and she is one of the most supportive professors I've had, and she is a very positive and uplifting person.
Very sweet professor. 100% recommend any of her courses.

This is my second class I've taken with Dr. Gillespie. She is amazing! She has review guides for her tests, as well as practice exams (very helpful!) There are 5 exams and that is all that is graded. I went to class every day and did just fine in the class. You do need the textbook because she has you read assigned readings.

Amazing!! Dr. Gillespie is by far one of the most understanding and caring professors I've had so far during my five semesters at Brockport. She was incredibly accommodating for her students - myself included. For PSH 211, we had a few group quizzes, in/out of class HWs (to be completed at our own pace), and an oral presentation. Great class.
Fantastic professor all around, happy to help out whenever she can. Fair grader with engaging classes, highly qualified in her field.

very easy. lenient grader. submit assignments at own pace class. no exams or quizzes. 2 essays, 3 response discussions, few end of chapter questions. her content is actually quite interesting too. she will answer emails literally within an hour. she's a wonderful women, easy online class. I recommend anyone to take this class!

This class was mostly lectures every day that got long and boring. I stopped attending class for a while and still got through the class due to everything being uploaded on brightspace. Tests were a little off from the study guides and what I expected to be on them. The final paper treatment plan was great though as I'm a better writer.

Professor Gillespie is absolutely amazing! She has so much compassion and empathy for her students as she cares so much! Her study guides are absolutely amazing as they are the only reason, I would get 90-94's on her exams. There is no final exam but rather a treatment plan for a patient. I would highly recommend this course to anybody!

Dr. Gillespie is overall a great professor. You can tell she truly cares about her students and wants them to thrive. Gillespie's tests are VERY easy, along with her study guides, her tests are 40 questions but you can skip any 5 you want. As long as you use the study guides to prepare for the tests, this class should be at least an easy B.

This is by far the most disorganized class I've ever taken at Brockport. She wants you to study both the book and her slides but she barely covers the first. Lot's of unnecessary stories. The exams are based on very few portions of the slides and sometimes questions are very confusing. Gives practice tests with wrong answers.

Overall, a amazing professor with so much knowledge to share. Just listen to her lectures and you will be fine on the tests. Everyone in the world of Psych should experience a class with Dr. Gillespie.

Graded on only 5 tests. She is a great professor but I recommend listening to lectures and reading the few pages she assigns out of the book. Offers extra credit if you need and always is willing to help you. Attendance is an option after 2 weeks

Dr. Gillespie is my favorite professor I have had in my college career. Every class I have with her makes me want to learn and change my path in psychology. She is incredible and I would recommend taking every class you can with her!

Professor Gillespie is very nice and helpful in her emails! I wouldn't recommend the class for non-majors, but I defiantly found some of the material interesting. Overall, a positive experience with this professor.

Loved her, but clinical psych was the most boring class Ive ever taken. Should be a 1-hour info session for those interested in pursuing a degree in clinical psych only. I found myself saying " who t.f. cares?" throughout the entire class. Did I mention the class is boring?

I absolutely loved Dr. Gillespie's Clinical Psychology course. She is a very informative professor who cares deeply about her students and their success. She is always free to meet and will make time. I liked her so much I am now taking her Community Psychology course. Clinical was the first course I've ever received an A+ in.

Dr. Gillespie was such a sweet women. She truly cares about her students and wants them to succeed in her class. Her lectures are just her reading off the slides, but she makes it interesting. Her exams are based on study guides and you are allowed to skip 5. Although you are only graded on 5 exams the class is not too hard! Love her and the class!
Sweetest professor. Material is fairly easy and digestible and she is always open to answering questions. She says you need the textbook but you don't. Show up and you'll pass.

She is a great professor. Class had 5 tests and thats all. If you pay attention in class and listen to examples she gives you'll do fine on the test. She also gives very very detailed study guide for each test. You can only fail if you decide you want to.

I took clinical & community psych with her & they were very different. In clinical, your grade was based on all tests, but in community, there were 2 big tests (midterm/final), 3 small/easy papers, and a final term paper. Also, she took attendance in community and not in clinical. Her lectures can be boring but she is such a kind soul!

Dr. Gillespie is very caring which will be clear the second you walk in class. I had her for child and clinical. She relies on power points, and you will only get graded on tests (but they are super easy if you fill out the study guides). It also helps that she is knowledgeable and passionate on the topics. Sometimes class can get boring. Easy A.
Reads from the powerpoint for the most part. Has a lot of life experience and stories to offer- class is worthwhile. Half the class stopped coming about 3 weeks in.

Currently in her community psychology class . The class is very straightforward. 4 hw assignments, 2 test(not a final on finals week), & one project paper . Shes give a 24 hr grace period on papers so still able to receive up to 24/25 pts. Buttt class isnt necessary, everything can be learned from slides but attendance is mandatory. ugh.

Shes a kind caring woman with a lot of experience in the field of psychology. She doesnt take attendance, and she posts the lectures on blackboard. You can get by with just studying the PowerPoints for the tests, but listening to her lectures will richen your experience. I personally didnt but shes a respectable woman so word up

comment: Janet is a lovely person and really cares about making you understand her content, her lecture style just didn't work for me. Gives no useful feedback
You are on your own

Nishiyama grades in a way that is a mystery to all but him. He can be snarky when asked questions in class but often comes off as combative. Not the worst class I've ever taken, but he will definitely keep you on your toes. Overall, not a lot of classwork but attendance is mandatory and a group project counts for 30% of the grade.

he does have a few books that you WILL need for the calls but all available in the library or online you are graded by 3 in class writing all open note lowest will be dropped a mid term and a final group project in which you will be graded individualy you will need to go to class since nothing that he says is online and is mainly lectures.

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Participation matters']
comment: HST 385 I found very hard and difficult to keep up with. (Non-history major). This class was awful online after COVID-19. Very boring and non-interactivepdfs and videos embedded in them. This was very, very stressful and frustrating for me!!! Very nice prof though. Was HAPPY when it was finally done forever!!! Dont miss it at all!!

The material was understandable for non-majors.Readings are assigned a lot, but I read none. Attendance is mandatory since it is a lecture-heavy class.Graded off 2 exams and 3 writing assignments (lowest is dropped).The final is a group project, but he makes the groups and grading extremely fair. Strict on what he expects to see in assignments.

At the start of the semester, I almost dropped out of his class. You can't have any kind of technology, he is a harsh grader, there aren't many things to grade, you are only allowed 3 absences, and each class is a lecture. But if you keep an open mind and take time outside of class, it's easy to get an A. He's strict at first but he gets better.

Gave me my lowest grade ever. Found his assignments to be really abnormally structured and stressful. I wouldn't say 'avoid at all costs', but if you're looking for a history course try to pick another professor.
Dr. Nishiyama is a little strict on grading, but as long as you show up to class prepared, you'll be fine. He's very funny and has a lot of really interesting stories to tell.

I really enjoyed Nishiyama's class. He is a great guy that tries to make connections with his students. As long as you're nice to him and pay attention in class you will be more than fine. Class is simple, but the papers are a little difficult because he is super strict on criteria.

HST 202 felt like a high school class. Papers aren't really papers and don't allow for exploration of ideas or real research (felt more like answering short answer questions). My greatest qualm was his unclear and at times ridiculous grading policies, they left me with much unnecessary anxiety that could have been avoided if he had clarity.
Super nice guy!! Definitely recommend this course. Easy A. Allows you to retake the midterm and resubmit an essay. Only 1 test (midterm), the final is a group project. Attendance required.

tags: ['Tough Grader', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'GROUP PROJECTS']
comment: Very tough grading system. Is often not clear on requirements for projects. However, the content and information you need to learn for this class is very straight forward.

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: 1. He's fantastic. I don't know what he's doing at Brockport. Could definitely go Ivy League, I think. 2. He gives you everything you need to succeed. Do all the questions that go along with the readings on time and you're set. Trust me. It'll save you a lot of headaches. 3. Participation  show up + ask good questions. Seriously, do it.

tags: ['Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'EXTRA CREDIT']
comment: Professor Nishiyama is a fantastic professor. He really cares about his students and will help you if you're struggling. He assigns a lot of papers, but he drops the lowest one. Participation counts for 25% of your grade. As long as you show up to class, participate, and do the writing assignments you should do very well in his class.

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: Did not like Professor Nishiyama that much. He doesn't explain the content well, and grades like a 400 level course on a 200 level course. Super hard grader and would not recommend taking any classes with him.

Dr. Nishiyama is a wonderful professor! You'll definitely  have to put some effort in, but if you take good notes, participate, and do your papers then you can do well. Going to his office hours are very helpful. He's a professor that wants you to do well, and will do his best to help you succeed.

Dr. Nishiyama is not a good professor. There was no discussion about any topics or any historical events and it made the class difficult. The textbook is nothing but a book on how to cite in Chicago style and the entire time he made me feel like I didn't know how to write a research paper. Would definitely avoid.

Amazing professor, very intelligent. Really makes you think about the world around. I feel like I had a much more unique learning experience compared to most other professors. Really cares about his students. But, he is tough teacher but that is just because he expects the best of us.

Dr. Nishiyama is a great man, a great teacher, and a great scholar. He is incredibly particular in how he wants responses to questions in writing. Best advice, be prepared to work as hard as you can and talk to others who have taken his classes previously. Also, be ready to learn. This guy brings his A game. Bring yours as well, or you will fail.

One of the only real college professors at brock, Dr. Nishiyama is wasting his potential. He should be somewhere much more prestigious. You will become a better student by being in his class. He teaches you how to undertand and view history accurately. You will learn how to write a paper like a college undergrad should.

Main drawback here is that he is a draconian grader compared to other professors teaching at the same class level. Highly educated and gives engaging lectures, and you certainly come out of his classes stronger than you went in - but don't expect an easy time of it. Hope you like writing!
A hard grader but he is nice overall. I don't mind having him in a different history class later.

Teaches about Asian history in a non-American perspective which made the class interesting. A lot of work though and reading is an absolute key to success. Class time could also be spent better on going over readings, but course objectives are clear and Dr. Nishiyama makes the class interesting! Recommended if you're willing to work hard.

Pretty difficult grader, even for a 300 level course. Sometimes his grading just doesn't make sense as well and he  seems to expect way too much on the papers. Course itself isn't too difficult and he gives a lot of bonus points if you do the work. Course objectives pretty clear mostly. Take this class if you have to get that Asian requirement done

Nice Prof. but very difficult grader. He definitely does not treat the class like a 100 level class. Material is straight forward, but his level of grading is ridiculous. I had 400 level classes easier than this class. Good luck.

Even though I'm not a history major I really enjoyed taking this class. He has a very funny sense of humor. Extremely helpful and very clear. 5 quizzes, one group project and a final exam paper. I recommend taking this class to fufill civilizations requirement!
All is pretty straightforward. Study guides are a must to get 5 quizzes done. Many extra credits here and there in class, which is pretty good.

Overall he's a good professor. He gives out study guides with important points that will be on the quizzes. You need to read the text book in order to find certain information that will be on tests. He's got a good sense of humor also. He takes time and answers everyone's questions until there are no longer anymore questions. Very Straight forward.

he likes to give about 5 quizes in which he gives all the info but u will have to read the textbook it is key to passing the class.But he is very funny and extremly helpful. I really enjoyed his class he also loves anyone whom likes to participate alot so be ready for that. Overall i would give him a 4 out of 5 he is a great professor.

I think he is overall a good guy. Gives asisgned seats like we're still in highschool. Treats a 100 level course likes its a graduate course. Very hard, you have to pay attention, read the book A LOT and then add more to your notes. Quizzes seem easy but they're not at all.  Do not take this class with him.
Good professor. Extremely enjoying this class! recommend to anyone.

Don't listen to any of the comments that have knocked Dr. Nishiyama; he is a great teacher; one of the best ive had at B-Port! He lets you know exactly what to expect on quizes, exams, and papers! I will take my Asian history course with him next year and any other courses that he may teach that I need.

Great teacher! He is extremely organized and you will definatly know what to expect on all quizzes and exams. He gives out study guides before you even start going over the material in class and in the readings. My only knock is that the multiple choice part of the quizzes can sometimes be tricky. I will definatly take future courses with him.

He is very hard to understand, dosnt offer much help if you attend office hours, least favorite history prof at brockport. He does enjoy what he teaches but it comes off as being snotty. would never take a class with him again

This was a good and interesting class.  He is very funny and is extremely helpful if you contact him via email.  There is one blue book exam, 3 five page papers, and a final paper of 8-9 and another smaller final paper of 3-4 pages.  Overall a lot of writing, but well worth it.

He expects his students to work. If he doesn't like you, you probably said something stupid. To get A, visit him during office hours and carefully go over materials he covered during exam reviews. Oh, one more thing. He needs to smile more often.

A good teacher, but expect to write as much or more than a 400 level course.  He has one blue book test, and the rest are essay tests that must use all the texts and angel readings. He also grades pretty hard, meaning that you have to put a lot of work and *original* thought in the essay to get a B.

Be aware: he makes you work, which means he will get you out of your comfort zone. He knows what he is talking about and he is extremely helpful. I worked hard and got what I had paid for at Brockport.
He is hard to understand and difficult to please

The worst teacher in the world. Want to feel like your taking 5 classes in one.?.?.?.here is your guy! Makes you feel like an idiot even if you try. Monotone, rude, and boring. Expect to write a 20-30 page paper for a final. For a survey course it was way to difficult. So much reading/studying/work that you have very little time for anything else.
treats an intro level course like a graduate level, horrible!

U must read all course readings, attend every class & make multiple visits to Dr. Nishiyama's office to survive in this class. Hardest class I ever took! With that being said, this was a great class. He makes U work, but U get the grade U deserve. He has no problem telling U what he thinks, good and/or bad. If U R a serious student go for it!

He's a great guy. His lectures and notes are very straight forward and align with the tests very well. Though, a textbook is required but I don't believe you actually need it. I didn't open it once the whole semester.

tags: ['Amazing lectures', 'Clear grading criteria', 'Graded by few things']
comment: Dr.B is a great professor, he doesn't give much work, is really relaxed and understanding. Tests are spoke about in class and are right in his slideshows so there is minimal studying needed. You are "required" the textbook, but don't really need it. Personally, this class was towards my major, but I highly suggest the class to fill a requirement.

Mr. Branauskas is a chill teacher who does not give much work to do through semester. If you are needing to fill a requirement and do not want to overload yourself i suggest this class. You are required the textbook but in reality you do not need to buy it. All his PowerPoints are posted and tests are all on material he speaks about in class.

Yes yes Andrew yes. If you have the opportunity to take ANY of his classes you definitely should. I've taken 3 classes with him as my professor. He's the best. Assignments are easy, exams are easy and his study guides really help. He's such an awesome professor and person!

He is so nice. He gets to know his students names. His lectures and test were straight forward. He is more than willing to help with anything. He is one of my favorite professors at this school. You have a textbook but I did not use it once. Easy A.

I had him during the fall semester for Race and Crime. Tests were open note, and we had 3 papers plus a term paper. Dr. Baranauskas is awesome, the class was interesting and he was a really nice guy. Would definitely recommend.

AMAZING. i was nervous to take this 400 level class but it was so easy. the assignments arent hard at all as long as you pay attention. his tests for this class are short answer but he lets you bring a cheat sheet for every test and the final is not cumulative. i didnt use the textbook once and attendance is not required.

andrew is by far the best criminal justice professor at Brockport, he truly knows what he is talking about. a textbook is required but i didnt use it at all you just have to pay attention in lectures. his tests are easy and he doesnt try and trick you at all. attendance isnt required just pay attention and youll do fine.

tags: ['Clear grading criteria', 'Graded by few things', 'Accessible outside class']
comment: Andrew is a super chill teacher and he makes the class easy, He is a very easy grader and makes his test easy too. Attendance isn't mandatory and the class is very boring but worth going at least twice a week. My best advice to you is to take this class with DR.B and NOT THE OTHER GUY, HE IS TERRIBLE and very hard to understand.

He is an awesome teacher, extremely nice. syllabus claims we need a textbook but I did not open it once. You NEED to take notes in class if you want to know what is happening, but I was able to get a 90 in the class without taking notes. Content is pretty interesting, the 3 tests are very easy, the 2 papers are also very easy.

tags: ['Clear grading criteria', 'Lecture heavy', 'Graded by few things']
comment: This class was lecture heavy and most days were boring. But the course load and assignments were easy. Before each test was a review day where we got to ask questions and get feedback. This helped a lot and exams were pretty straightforward. I wish this professor taught more classes in the CRJ department.
Amazing professor, super easy grader and easy assignments

An easy A class. Dr. Baranauskas is very easy going and clearly wants his students to succeed. 3 tests in total and a couple papers, he is a very easy grader and will give you 100 on them if you show effort. His lectures can be boring, I found it hard to pay attention but he does a very good job at explaining what you need to know for the tests.

One of the best professors in the CRJ department, very interesting class. There's three tests, all short answer, but he lets you bring a cheat sheet and 3 short writing assignments; case brief, movie review, and current events paper. Attendance isn't mandatory but I highly recommend you go so you won't have to do all the readings
One of my all time favorite professors and an even better advisor!! Always willing to help and guide you towards success.

He is such a good professor and makes you want to learn about the subject because he is so passionate about the subject. Very easy class and there are only 2 papers and 3 exams which are all very easy. For exams, he uses the slides and no trick questions. He's also great outside of class as well.

tags: ['Lecture heavy', 'Beware of pop quizzes', 'Graded by few things']
comment: He is an actual kind person. But beware he talks a lot. He spends a lot of time talking, which for people who dont learn that way its hard. You are only graded by a few things and he barely gives extra credit. If he thinks the class doesnt understand he will give a random pop quiz. I never read the textbook and still passed.

I loved taking his classes. He does typically have any dry material, it was all pretty decent and I have taken many of his classes. The slides and what he says for them is the key to passing, write everything down for your note page. I highly suggest taking any of his classes. 10/10.

tags: ['Clear grading criteria', 'Gives good feedback', 'Accessible outside class']
comment: By far my favorite professor. He's also the best advisor. Gives great feedback and will answer questions best he can for the students.
Amazing professor! His lectures are super heavy, and spends a little too much time on each slide. But he does allow a cheat sheet for the exams!

Professor B is a good teacher but spends an excessive amount of time on one slide, then wonders why the class is behind. He is a really nice guy and respects students but the lecture is heavy in class. Tests are average, and his papers are easy (usually gives a good grade on papers, if you go into depth on the thesis of the paper).

Dr. B is a great professor. He is very easy to talk to outside of class. There are assigned readings for each class but he goes over them in class so reading them isn't always necessary. There are three exams, all short answer but you are allowed a cheat sheet that you can put anything on it. I would highly recommend this class (or any) with Dr. B!

tags: ['Accessible outside class', 'Get ready to read', 'Amazing lectures']
comment: Dr.B is a very good professor. he is very understandable and I really enjoyed taking criminology. He provides many assignment so if you fail a quiz or 2 they won't impact your grade very much. his test are short answers but it actually helps you retain the information and I prefer short answer test now.

Crime+Media is only 1 of 3 courses I've had with Dr. Baranauskas. He is a very easy going &cares about his students and if they understand the material. If you listen in class & write good notes (he posts slides), you'll do well in any of his classes. 3 short answer exams but can use single sht of notes to help. Only assignments are 2-3 short essay

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: Very well spoken and makes information very clear. It's a very easy class even if you don't do the readings and pay attention to lectures, but if you don't attend (it's not mandatory) the readings will give you all the information that's tested on. Short answer exams, but a cheat sheet is allowed, and they're rather straight forward questions.

The first few weeks he reads important notes to you as you write then when hes done with all the notes the 3rd week in you take an exam and then start producing a show. Its a weird class. It wasnt my favorite but I didnt dread going
His logic and reasoning are not clear  and does not seem to know what his objective for students is for each class, making it hard to know what he wants.
Do NOT take class with this professor EVER!

I took Children's Theatre with Dr. Cho and I love love love love him. He is so adorable and sweet that you cant help but to have a great time in his class. Dont get book... notes first couple weeks but after that... it was all great fun. Oh and a sidenote- when doing plays use local jokes!!ex. instead of saying land of far far away say land of roch
About two weeks of notes and then the rest of the semester is all out of your seats.  Very fun!
No Comments

To begin, this subject itself is pretty boring unless you like reading old plays and trying to interupt what they mean.  Dr. Cho is such a nice guy and he is always welcoming you, but he is SO hard to understand.  His accent is very heavy so once you realize you can't understand him you have already lost complete interest in the class.
Oh contrare Oh con Cho
Great Teacher, Can be hard on attendence even if all his classes seem to be around 8am.  Very good at what he teaches and would take any class if be taught it.
Dr. Cho is hot!! And he is the funniest guy I've ever known. Fantastic!

He is a great guy, and a brilliant mind, but his classes are dull and way too easy.  A lot of the information he provided was shallow and intuitive.  I love the guy, but I would never want to take a class from him again.
LUV CHO!!!!
Dr. Cho is a great professor, and very funny.
No Comments

Dr. Cho is just getting older by the minute.  Some days he can be a lot of fun, and others he can be extremely stubborn and frustrating.  He's a good guy with a lot of knowledge, but you feel like you are in a high school classroom.
No Comments
No Comments
No Comments

Very easy class but really boring. There was no final exam just weekly readings/quizzes, 3 news reviews, group presentation, and a research paper. If you take her I suggest doing the group presentation/paper in the beginning so you can coast through the rest of the semester.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Lots of homework', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: Dr. Orr is a good choice for PLS 303. I was scared because I'm not a math person but it was easy. Instead of one intense final, there were four mini research projects instead which made getting high grades easy but they were all at the end of the semester and it was difficult to stay on top of. But she was awesome about extensions and accessible.

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Participation matters']
comment: Class is lecture heavy. Really nice professor, class was just extremely boring. Lots of assignments and reading. Interesting topics and discussions.

PLS 335 itself will not be everyone's cup of tea, but I have to imagine Dr. Orr provides one of the better executions of it. A very kind and caring woman who wants only the best work out of her students, and will do everything in her power to get that out of them. Will push her own political stances at times, but never in an uncomfortable fashion.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read', 'Participation matters']
comment: I took an Honors course with Dr. Orr and loved it. It was discussion-heavy, and so those who didn't read the material were at a loss during most lectures. She was tough but fair in grading; make sure to spend time and write well.

She was the professor for the Brockport Internship Program. She seems nice but lovely, and IS an easy grader but for some reason she picks and chooses grudges. If she doesn't like you and uses you as a characture of someone she doesn't want to help, she will be sarcastic and condescending. I wanted to like her, but she truly turned out to be rude.

She's the bomb! Let's face it Research Methods is one of the most dreaded classes in the major. But she's the best to take it with. You are going to be doing a lot of homework the beginning third of the semester but after that it goes down dramatically. She loves what she does and the tests are easy!

There aren't too many assignments to complete, and she offers extra credit. It's not hard to do well in this class, but the lectures are not very interesting or engaging. Study hard for the tests - there are only 2 throughout the semester, and the study/reading guides are very helpful.

Professor Orr gives long boring lectures that can sometimes be  hard to understand. 2 tests a midterm and final. You will also participate in 1 debate, turn in a debate paper and take a "pop quiz" on the 20+ pg debate reading before each debate. You must also turn in 5 news articles with reviews that go along with the weeks topic (you choose topic)

Professor Orr is such a sweet woman but is too smart for her own good. She asks if we all understand and when nobody says anything moves on extremely quickly. Her quizzes were online for my class so there are a lot of points to make up. Overall would recommend her classes.

I recommend taking research methods with Dr.Orr. She's great! It's a difficult course but she is very good at explaining the material. I'm sad that I just graduated because she's one of the best professors at Brockport. I would have loved to take more classes with her!

Dr. Orr is one of the best and nicest professors at Brockport! Her classes are discussion based and she makes heavy use of essay based assessment. She is very understanding and provides awesome feedback on your writing. I definitely recommend taking her; she is absolutely brilliant and you will learn a ton in her class.
Didn't learn a ton, but the class was easy and not boring. Dr. Orr was very nice and tried to be very helpful. Would take more classes with her.

Such a sweet lady. And her accent is adorable. Really understanding; always doing things to boost your grade-- whether through your participation or attendance. I was supposed to get a B+ in the class, but she gave me an A- because I was there every day. But I also took the class in the summer, so, I think it was a bit easier then.
She's hot!  I love her!!
great professor. not an easy class, but definitely manageable and she is understanding so long as you show effort
I love Professor Orr! And, it probably helps that she's my advisor, lol.

All her tests are mulitple choice. She let's everyone share their opinon. She is clear what she wants and makes sure you understand. She cares about her students and their grades. She is nice and welcoming.

dr orr is a lovely woman  ilove her accent anyone concerned that she is going to be biased need not wory you can ceartainly see where she stands on issues but she welcomes all well thought out arguments and seems to enjoy a spirited debate extremly helpful and caring great teacher seriously take her classes

I absolutely love Professor Orr's classes! If she sees potential in you, she will push and challenge you on the things you say and write. She is downright one of the best professors I have ever had. Her accent is great and she is extremely approachable. She grades very fairly and expects you to put forth a good effort on every assignment. Take it!

Professor Orr has a wealth of information that she can not wait to share with ALL of her students. She treats EVERYONE fairly. She will let you know if she thinks you are a slacker. Lots of literature. Tests come directly from the litertature. Complete all of your assingments and you have and easy A. She is fun, energetic, compassionate .
No Comments

I love her accent!  She makes the class easy by posting the notes to be printed off.  The only issue is she doesn't allow class discussions to blow up as much as they could.  She even gives study guides for the tests.

Very good teacher, love her accent! Just read the chapters, take notes, and participate in the debates. Which includes downloading them! Very helpful when you need her, and also very caring. She made the class fun for me! Definately recommend taking this!

Dr. James is the best teacher that I have had here at Brockport.  She is very helpful in and outside of class. I go to her for everything. She is one of those teachers that truly cares how well her students do in class and in life.
She is a very nice, caring teacher who cares a lot about her students and is always willing to do whatever possible to help outa student. I love her!
Great professor - extremely knowledgeable and more than willing to help those that put in the effort.
Excellent teacher !

Take this guy, he knows his stuff so much. I took him last semester and I still remember everything that he taught us, and actually have used all the information he taught me in my intermediate accounting II, which has been a breeze because of him. Intermediate 2 requires a lot of finance knowledge, and he is the key to making  ur life easier!

Extremely smart lady. I found her to be a relatively tough grader, though the workload for this course was bearable. Only a few tests and quizzes, no homework, and attendance was not "necessary" (I would go). I did not purchase the book, and was fine. Lectures could get boring (she does a lot of powerpoint work). Overall I liked the course.

She's a pretty cool lady and has done some pretty awesome research/ work in Hawaii. You can tell she knows her stuff and makes you interested in the subject (ecology can be pretty boring). Attendance was pretty optional but she knew who went to class and who did not. Not a hard grader and her tests were pretty fair. Her PhD is also from Stanford.
Her classes are not too hard compared to some of the other teachers in the department. Study for her tests and you will do fine.

3-4 hours to do exams helped a lot. If you do not read his PowerPoints, read and work through the textbook problems, take notes on things he says in lecture, you wont do well on exams. Grades on class participation, 1 paper, homework submission & exams. He breaks material into understandable form. He's funny, nice, experienced, and knowledgeable.

Probably one of the best combinations of lecture and real world experience professors you'll get. He knows his stuff inside and out, and is willing to answer or expand on non textbook related issues or questions.

He is probably one of the best Accounting professors at Brockport. He knows his stuff, and he teaches it in the best way possible so that is broken down, and simple. There are 3 tests and a project. Very straight to the point professor, and cares about his students
Awesome professor and really knows his stuff.  Do the homework and read the text and you will do fine.  Down to earth.  I recommend him to any business student.
Great professor, definitely knows his stuff. Very nice and helpful, tests are hard but pretty straight forward.

He is the one to take intermediate I with. Homework that is collected but only graded on completeness. 3 tests though out the semester that are fair if you do the studying for them, usually 30 mc/tf and 4 problems. His lectures are right from the powerpoints so it makes it difficult to focus some days.

Harsh Grader. Not an easy A. May think you follow all her guidelines for assignments and only get a C. Two open book/online tests and 2 main projects and final paper are the main grades. Don't do well, there is no way to boost your grade.

Very harsh grader. Willing to answer questions but has strict guidelines. Even with revisions from the Student Learning Center for my papers couldn't do better than an 88%. Material is interesting but the way she teaches the class with lecture and power points is boring
2 group projects, 3 papers, 2 exams. I kind of liked the class. She's very willing to proof read papers.

She's like a mall cop that thinks they are a Federal NARC agent. Spent her time waiting for a students phone to go off so she could kick them out and cause a scene. Does not care how much work you put forth, just about her particular rules. Will spend class time reviewing citation methods rather than teaching useful material. Does not negotiate. EOTE
Requires too much from students when she doesn't teach. Class had the potential to be interesting but was incredibly boring.

Rough teacher. do not take this course for an easy A. you will work for it. Hard grader. you will think you did well on the projects or on papers but you end up failing. I studied for this course. 2 tests and projects are your main grade. Follow the outlines very carefully! Not an easy A like the other Ad and Consum with Donna. TAKE IT WITH DONNA.
Follow the syllabus to the letter. Word count is expected. Good luck.

This class is very difficult due to the course load and how much Dr. Price will make you do. However, that being said it is worthwhile and reflective especially to anyone in the education field. Take the course but be ready to work.

I don't know where to start. This guy is without pedagogy. Worst professor of my college career. Dropped this major simply because of this professor. Its a surprise more students don't complain. Maybe he will quit teaching, hes quite bad at it. Do not expect him to understand complex ideas, avoid any class with him that involves writing.

Assigns very long papers on things like Plato's Symposium. Asks you to write a 5000 word paper without discussing the Symposium directly which makes absolutely no sense. He has an overly inflated ego, you might as well call him Dr. Chris Ego. He has a very harsh way of dealing with students. Assignment instructions very vague at best.

Insane professor. Does not like to be asked questions and does not explain assignments. His grades fro each assignment are kept secret so if you do the work for a B he still gives you the grade he wants at the end. He is the most unfair and arrogant professor I have ever had. He is rude to his students and does not care about teaching you anything.

Requirements for papers are vague at best.  Makes it impossible to get an A.  Does not read your paper, just skims, and then makes comments that only make sense if you take into account that he did not read the paper fully.
Great guy, Class was well structured for a hybrid course. kept the class involved in relating issues.

Guy is lazy! He does a 15 min webcam class and then you don't show up for a week or two. Then when you do your the one that runs the class with presentations but he grades you off his perceptions of the readings which is confusing because you dont know if both of you see the same thing. Grades essays and presentations tough Glad this class is over!
He is a good guy. The material is interesting. The tests are fair.

Professor Price was able to simplify the material and make it very comprehensible and easy to understand. He is a great guy and is very helpful. Not only would I recommend the class as the matter is very interesting but would also recommend taking it with P. Price. It has been my best class yet!

She hands out personality tests for each unit that you can take and score yourself to turn in at the end of the semester. 10 tests  +10 points on FINAL GRADE. I went from an 84 to a 94.

The slides are available on blackboard so you could get away with skipping class. She doesnt take attendance. She gives 5 tests and drops your lowest score. She offers a lot of extra credit also.

A lot of people say some really negative things about Kelly, I didn't think she was that awful she's just not a great professor. If you want to do well on the test, I recommend using her slides and the textbook to teach yourself instead of going to class because her lectures are pointless and hard to follow. Not an awful class but not the greatest

comment: Dr. Brennan-Jones was the instructor in this course. The course was about topics. Exams were on the same topics. She is sufficiently adequate at presenting on those topics.

lectures are dry but not a hard class. if you are not a good test taker this probably isn't the class for you. 100+ slide notes for a 25 question test. also notes are very vague and test questions are very specific and hard. Offers plenty of extra credit. enough to improve at least 2 letter grades.

KBJ has been a nightmare. ive taken 2 classes with her but she has no regard for peoples feelings. I only took her capstone because i knew i could pass it but she drove everyone crazy. she has no soul, the work isnt awful but she does grade hard for the capstone. if you care if a teacher cares, then dont take her. KBJ does not care about you at all

Long dry lectures that hold no content. She gives practice packets so study those hard for the weekly quizzes. Homework is done online but uses much different terminology than she uses in class. You need to read to pass the homework. Grades are almost never posted.

She is an alright professor but her lecture powerpoints are useless. You can't learn math in words but by example. Class attendance is optional so thats good and she gives a lot of extra credit opportunities.

Only 5, 25 question tests. if you don't do well on those you won't do well in the class. she gives you such large amounts of extra credit to make up for it, which you'll have to do. Powerpoint notes don't help

I asked her a question & she made me feel like i was stupid for asking it. she was taken back that I'd even ask something so crazy. It's hard to follow her. I've had 3 classes with her so far & want to switch out.

Worst Psych professor I have ever had. Lectures were completely irrelevant to tests, extremely unfair grading on final paper and exam. Spent six weeks of class watching movies and talking about AIDS conspiracy. Went from an A to a B in the last week of school because of her unclear instructions. Avoid her at all costs.

Dr. B is a very smart person, but has trouble conveying her ideas to students. Power points are over 200 slides with only a 25 question multiple choice test. Hard to study but she does give review sheets and is willing to help if you ask for it. The extra credit is very easy and if all is done, it would be hard not to get a decent grade.

If the class wasn't so basic I would have struggled. No confidence or class control. Contradicts herself at least once every lecture and is unclear, while also moving very rapidly through lectures. Do the online HW and read if you want to do well. Lectures are more confusing than helpful

Brennan-Jones is the most narcissistic person I've ever met. she thinks the world revolves around her and her class. My friend was failing and she told her she could get anywhere from and E to a B-, and told her how to withdraw. She's very unclear in her instruction. She's crazy and told me I was desperate when I asked for help. avoid at all costs.
If you're not a good test taker she has an extra credit assignment. All you have to do is do a bunch of measures and questionnaires and write about your experiences.

Very interesting person- a little wacky, but very smart and well educated. Powerpoints are online which makes life easy but listening to her lectures is better than skipping. Tests are kinda tricky. Does not even touch the textbook.

The best professor I've experienced at SUNY Brockport. She helped me improve my writing skills in APA style, she provides helpful feedback. The content is really interesting. Dr B's fun personality really made the class enjoyable for me. Utilize the extra credit opportunities.

Tough grader but very helpful if you need help. Knows each student on a first name basis and is very personable. Genuinely wants everyone to pass. Lot of reading and a big paper but open book tests on a computer
Her lectures are kind of boring but she is a good person and will help with any questions you have.

Lots of class notes for personality. Tests aren't too bad either. She makes class optional but I recommend going due to movies and extra cred. Close relationships is a capstone course so the difficulty level was as expected. Love her as a person and a teacher.

This class goes by points. She gives quizzes every week worth about 10 points and homework worth around 3 points. The midterm and final are each worth 100 points so that is mostly what determines your grade. This is not an easy class, she moves very quickly and gives a lot of work. I had the book and taught most of it to myself.

DO NOT TAKE WITH HER unless you're good at multiple choice tests. Quizzes based off lecture notes so don't even buy the book. She's AWFUL. Powerpoints are 200 slides for only 25?s on a test. 5 quizzes she drops the lowest grade. Offers tons of extra credit to make up for the difficult tests.

I took Honors with her. A lot of reading but you can skim most of it because she just gives 2-page critiques to write every week on like 200 pages of reading. You just sit and talk about relationships and discuss issues, it's an easy A and she is a great teacher! Attendance is taken but you won't mind because it's a fun class.

Not a particularly hard class, but I wish the lectures had been more interesting. Quizzes are multiple choice format. An average professor, not bad, not great. Take the class if you're interested in the material as I was.

I feel like we didn't discuss personality until the very last few classes of the semester. Information is pretty repetitive from other psych courses so it helps if you have taken other classes. A lot of extra credit is offered, and class isn't mandatory. she posts the slides on angel and the tests are all off of the notes.

I had her for personality. Shes great. Theres alot of notes but theyre posted online iif you fall behind. Shes very lenient and accepting. We watch alot of educational movies and questions on test will be asked about them. She kinda strays off topic alot but the book is helpful. She is always willing to give help and offers extra credit.

I am taking her Honors 400 Level course and she is awesome. If you are having trouble she is willing to help and guide you to becoming better. She grades a little hard if she knows you have potential to do better but is fair. I love her course and plan on taking her again. People that complain tend not to read or participate in class

She's a terrible professor, contradicts herself way too much. Doesn't give clear directions. Her study guides don't follow what went on in lecture or book. Do not take any class with her if you want a good grade

She expects you to be in class and participate in her discussions. She will always help you if you ask and I love her teaching style. Take this class if you want to know more about close relationships!
I'm going to get mad, so I'll just say, easy class, absolutely awful teacher. Don't take anything with her.

Her personality class is taught in a large lecture. She is very nice if you talk to her and very helpful/insightful! Works very hard to help you out in any way. Also, a good advisor. Gives lots of extra cretit (30 pts) which helped me understand concepts more in depth, and GREATLY helped my grade. You are not required to attend class, but it helps

Mid-term and Final completely inappropriate for an Intro course. Had to rely on the book in order to understand the material since the Professor moved way too fast and didnt seem concerned that her pace was faster than most of the class. I will avoid at all costs taking another course with this Professor.

For personality; big lecture class with 6 tests of 20 mult. choice. She gives LOTS of extra credit, is very helpful if you have questions. Do not NEED to attend class but she often explains details of her outlined notes and sometimes shows videos/clips.

13 quizzes total, she drops the lowest 5. 13 homeworks total, she drops the lowest 2. If you want a good grade in her class, you have to come to class and take the time to not just get the work done, but UNDERSTAND it.  I'm a psych major and I've always been strong at math, so this class was pretty simple for me.  An A is very doable if you work.

I had two classes with her. She is very into one, she takes attendance and actually cares, in the other she couldnt care less. Doesn't take attendance or anything. If you want an easy A take personaility with her.
five tests, drops the lowest one. tons of extra credit. powerpoint notes that are posted on angel. really nice lady and is always willing to help. recommend to anyone interested or majoring in psych.
Doesn't take attendance. Quizzes and homework due every friday. she's really nice and is always willing to help anyone if they have a problem. Highly recommend her.

Ended up teaching myself most of the material towards the end of the semester as she moves rather quickly. First half of semester was a breeze, second half was more difficult. Easy midterm, very difficult final. Getting a good grade is not too difficult, though you must do the work, which is simply inapplicable to many people. Take it if required.

Bones is cool.  The only hard thing about her stats class is she makes you memorize the formula's.  final exam had 50, so if you are bad at that, take it with the other prof.  Otherwise she is a good teacher.  I actually understood this class.

Very easy course. You really only need to go to class to hand in homework and take quizzes, even though her notes are helpful. You have a quiz every week, but they're short and easy. Book work is easy. She is EXTREMELY nice and willing to help you out with ANYTHING. I would highly recommend this course to anyone. AWESOME teacher!
Personality- Boring lectures, watch a movie of monkeys doing it. Nice lady, good sense of humor, just very boring subject. Doesn't take attendance. Tests slightly hard if you don't do your work

She is very nice and helpful but the class is a little boring and repetitive at times. She goes over anything you need her to until you understand. The homework is very easy and the quizzes and tests go along with what was on the homework.

Sometimes the material covered in class doesn't make sense the way she teaches it, but she's always willing to go back and reexplain until everyone understands. Offers a lot of opportunities to get a good grade in the class. I'd highly recommend her for Stats

She is a very sweet lady.  You feel very comfortable talking to her about anything.  She is willing to help and give advice about something not even related to the class.  She is just not teaching material.  I don't know what she is talking about most of the time.  She is an awesome lady...but just not teaching material.

Dr. Brennan is an awesome lady. She keeps us awake during lectures with her jokes that all somehow relate back to personality. Her tests are challenging, but not unreasonable if you do the work. I would recommend Dr. B to anyone

This class is all lecture and multiple choice tests. There are 6 tests with 20 questions each and they are pretty tough. She drops one test and there is some extra credit. She is funny but unclear at times.

She makes Stats an easy class. Quizes every friday on each chapter and homework due every friday (like 1/4 of these are dropped). Then theres just a midterm and a final. A lot of easy grades and she offers lots of help with tutors outside of class. Attendence isn't mandatory and if u wanted u could only go fridays. I highly reccomend her for Stats

She makes Stats an easy class. Quizes every friday on each chapter and homework due every friday (like 1/4 of these are dropped). Then theres just a midterm and a final. A lot of easy grades and she offers lots of help with tutors outside of class. Attendence isn't mandatory and if u wanted u could only go fridays. I highly reccomend her for Stats!
Personality was a breeze and she gave a ton of extra credit options.

I take intro Stats with her and the class is easy because she drops your lowest 5 quizzes, 3 homeworks and give you extra credit at the end. Homeworks are easy and extremely helpful for you to learn all the equations. Tests are fair/easy. If you need help, go see a tutor. Overall, I get an easy A for the class.

Prof. Brennan-Jones is great.  The class isn't very interesting, but she adds some humor to the topic.  She goes through notes really fast, so sometimes you have to remind her to slow down.  She is great when it comes to helping students, and she provides a lot of tutors.  The text book is really helpful as well.  Minimal homework & easy tests.

Dont take her! Theres no attendance policy but the material is hard &so are the tests. My advisor stuck me w/ her only because the old easy professor wasnt teaching it anymore. I wish attendance counted so she could see I was there. Grade based on HW/tests only. Bad bad teacher. Notes not legible @ times.
wow this lady was one of the worse professors iever had the homework was easy and the work didnt seem that bad but the tests were killer thats the only reason y i did so poorly
Hard class but you will get a C- if you attend all classes, take all tests and quizes, do all hw and go for help when asked... if math isnt your strong point and just need a C- take this class.

She changed her grading policy, now she gives 6 tests and drops the lowest so the class is much easier than it used to be you only have to read 2 chapters at a time and then U get the test, she's actually very nice and I loved her b/c she's into politics too! She does go kinda fast through the notes but she post them on angel, read and u'll be fine

I was interested in taking this class, but I don't think she taught it very well.  I didn't understand half the info.  The only time you applied what you learned was during the midterm and the final, so you went for 2 months learning stuff without getting any grades on it.  Very tough.

ridiculous class... i was interested about the topic  and the content of the class, but she makes class unbearable.  no one gets higher than a C on her midterm/final, no matter how long or how hard you study... the only good thing is there is a no attendence policy... this class is a complete waste of time!
she is the worst teacher I have ever had.  All she talks about is sex in a personailty class, and I think I have heard her utter the words personality maybe once.

WORST DAMN TEACHER EVER. IF YOU'RE TOO LAZY TO GIVE MORE THAN A MIDTERM AND A FINAL FOR GRADES DONT BE A DAMN TEACHER.  SIMPLE AS THAT.  only two tests for a grade AND A COMPUTER GRADES THEM.  UGH@!$$!@!@$!$@#

I agree I dont know what everyone else is talking about.  She is a very hard professor. Absolutely terrible teacher. She didnt offer any extra credit and her notes looked like they were written 10 minutes before class. She doesnt explain anything and I find her to be quite rude. Also like mentioned no curve and way too much was expected for tests.

Looking at these comments, they are all from 2003, and currently she is not the same professor as she might have been in the past.  We were given only a mid-term and final for our grades and on the mid-term the class average was a 61 with no curve and the final was also just as hard.  Do not take a class with her!

I dont know what the other raters are talking about when they say she was an easy teacher. She is not, she gave us 2 tests for the the semester and this was our grade. The first test she only gave us a 1 page study guide for 8 weeks of material and the second test is based on the whole year. Avoid taking this class if you can.
the best teacher i ever had
Lots of class notes.  Class discussions need to focus on the material for the test.
Very nice, extremely intelligent, and willing to talk about problems youre having. Only downside is that she gives a LOT of notes, but she gives a lot of extra credit, and drops lowest test grade!

Wonderful Person! A lot of reading and writing, but she lets u know that before you even sign up.  Great content. Seminar class so it is all discussion, I had a lot of fun and learned a lot from her and other students.
No Comments
you can learn from her. she is a good advisor.
No Comments

Don't know what that other person rating this course was thinking, but it wasn't hard at all. Prof. Brennan is very clear in her expectations as well as her manner of passing on the relevant information. She's an excellent teacher w/ a great personality.
he gets off topic a lot but is fun and easy to understand. if you study his test are easy. he wants you to do well and is willing to help whenever necessary.
his lectures arent good i have to teach everything to myself tbh

Please do NOT take this class if you don't need it!! Every lecture he just read directly off of his slides and highlighted everything. He doesn't give anything to help with studying and says to just use ChatGPT which does not work. The exams were weighted way too much but the curves are helpful!
