comment: Love Dr. Shen as a person, but might be the worst professor I've ever had. He reads off the slides, exams are overall 70% of your grade, nothing makes sense, and he expects that you already took biochem/ aced the MCAT.

He was a really nice guy, but didn't exactly teach us. He just read off his powerpoints that get posted. That being said, EVERYTHING asked on exams is in a powerpoint- no surprises. It is very conceptual and has a lot of content, but do-able. Also HW is random, a lot harder than exams, and has almost nothing to do with the exam.

He's definitely a nice guy, just not the best at teaching. He goes through all of the info quickly, and there's a lot of info to learn in this class so it can be confusing. The homework questions are harder than the exam questions and not super helpful, but everything on the exams is in his slideshows somewhere so there's not really trick questions
He is knowledgeable but not great at teaching and time management for his classes. He is hard to understand. I would not recommend to take his classes unless you really have to.

all he does is read off of the slides and underlines everything it was horrible and I essentially had to teach it to myself afterwards. absolutely no one cares for the class and if attendance wasn't mandatory that lecture hall would be EMPTY. he will ask a question and it is dead silent. do not take a class with him.

he reads word for word off the slides, useless lectures but he'll drop you down half a letter grade if you miss more than three classes. it's the same for all his classes, homework and labs do not match up with the exams/quizzes AT ALL. also wonders why no one talks in his classes but will laugh if you ask him something. terrible prof

Like others have said, he reads the slides almost word for word. He is nice, likes to help and is really knowledgeable. One bothersome thing was how little the HW prepared you for exams. You can get 100s on the HW but be completely thrown off and bomb the exams. If he changed his teaching style, he could go from a 1 to a 4/5 easily.

doesn't speak the best english (not his fault), but speaks so fast you can't decipher a thing. He's my lab TA and would just read the answers to us fast so the 2hr lab ended up being 30mins, I would learn more if I stayed home and did it myself. He doesn't have us do the lab expirements and doesn't let us look at the diagrams around the room.

Awful exams. Expects you to know eveything and since it was combined with a graduate class it was 10x harder then it should be. Awful professor only reads off slides and you cant understand because he doesn't speak English well.

Only 4 exams for the entire class, no other assignments. He put different chapters that were supposed to be on the exam and then on the actual exams put more chapters on them without really notifying us beforehand. Would not recommend.

This professor is bad. He doesn't make his own questions. His exams are 60 questions in 60 minutes. The final was 100 questions as if he did a good job teaching. He only read the lecture slides that he posts on the blackboard as if you can't read them.

This class is by far the most mind boggling thing I have ever done. I thought I was understanding things up until the first of two quizzes and the first of two exams. I had no basis for my understanding of the content besides the homework. The homework barely tested knowledge. After midterms, it seemed hopeless and impossible to get back on track.

Very smart professor! He goes very fast but he has to because there is a lot of material to go over. He is a very reasonable and patient professor and will go out of  his way to help you as long as you ask. Definitely would take a class with him again! 10/10.

Cimbricz was one of the best instructors I have had at Brockport. She really made me think and dig deeper into concepts and techniques I can actually use in my future teaching career. She takes time with planning her class but will go the extra mile to clarify. She expects you to do the readings, the work, and be thoughtful and organized.

Dr.C was one of the most caring professors that I had. She pushed me to be my best, and a better version of myself. I would retake any course with her if I had a choice. Her classes taught me more than aby thing I had learned in any other education course. She is an amazing professor and an inspirational individual.

Dr. Cimbricz is a true gem to the education field. She cares about her students' success in and out of the classroom. She encourages you to think and develop your own style of teaching while meeting graded criteria. She is not just a lecturing professor, she creates a collaborative learning environment. Her classes taught me more than any other.

She is an amazing Professor that cares about her students. She loves to collaborate with her students encouraging them to think outside the box. She views her students as colleagues rather than just a group of college students. She will help you develop ideas to their full potential and encourage self-reflection to better develop your whole person.

BEST professor in the education department at brockport. I learned so much from this incredible woman about both edu, literacy, and what the actual classroom is like. She legitimately invests in every student. The first week you will think, what is she talking about? Then it will click and you will also be a literacy master... a true master prof

While the professor is very nice, her course was very confusing and at times, she was not very helpful. Definitely go to her for help, but you have to schedule an appointment, even DURING OFFICE HOURS. She is not very clear, even when meeting with her, what how to do the write ups for motivation stations.

Mr. Brady is great. You need to put time in outside of class. Do notes before class and use class as review, it will click. People just show up to college and expect to be babied, it's ridiculous. If you're struggling Mr. Brady is happy to help one on one. If you're late he'll call you out and same goes for texting/talking during class.
Professor Brady is the definition of someone in over their head. He means well but he goes way too fast in lectures and cannot fully explain all the topics in the class.
Daniel is an amazing professor. If you struggle with Algebra then this course may be difficult, but I believe that he is an excellent teacher and does well teaching the course.

I thought this class was supposed to be entry level, but personally it doesn't feel like it. He goes very fast in the lectures and I just feel too pressured too fast to know stuff we just learned. And he gives out way too many quizzes and homework. I should not be having to take a quiz one class and then the next is an exam with homework due.

Mr. Daniel Brady is a decent professor. Be ready for lots of notes! He lectures extremely fast, making it hard to write and absorb info at the same time. He is caring and wants students to succeed, but his speed is a major hindrance. Slowing down would help.

while having this professor i struggled academically. when you would not understand something he would call you out in the middle of the class or even raise his voice which could be intimidating while in lectures. also, he goes at a fast pace while teaching so if you have him you may want to sit up front and record your lectures.

Compared to how other first year classes can go (chemistry.) Dr. Brady is an amazing professor to have to help ease you into college math. Clear, concise lectures that help you understand the material, a good balance of homework, and a nice guy to chat with after class too. Loved having him as a professor.
The sweetest person you will ever meet. I can't think of a way to not get an A, just get your work in (accepts late work sometimes).

Omg I love her I'd take all her classes if I could 
Just put effort in and you'll get 100 on everything 
She just wants to see you enjoy the thing she loves
Show up to class and you will pass also she is very nice

The nicest lady! Super fun class. The sewing can be hard at times but she really is a good teacher. She can get a little impatient but who wouldn't with 20 kids doing the same thing at different paces. Her assistant is a bit odd but very helpful too. My favorite class.

Gail is the kind of professor that is willing to be like a mother to her students. If you are sick, dead tired, or generally not looking well, she'll send you home to get some rest. I worked with her on costumes for a show for extra credit, and she explained things so well. Was patient with my mistakes, and I'd 100% work with her again!

BEST class & professor EVER. Gail is so awesome and so helpful. Each unit has a graded assignement; where you complete your best makeup of that unit. Final is ANYTHING you want to put on your face. I highly recommend this course.

Very clear on what she wants and gives good comments towards your work. Knows what she is talking about and is open towards other ideas. She may seem tough at times, but if you work, there will be no problems.

This was one of the most interesting classes I've ever taken, and Gail makes it even more interesting! Costume History probably taught me more history than any other history class I've taken. The final's kinda rough, but the rest of the class is super easy and fun. Gail is freakishly smart, and just all-around awesome! TAKE THIS CLASS!!
SHE IS THE BEST TEACHER I EVER HAD. SHE IS ALWAYS WILLING TO HELP YOU.TAKE EVERY CLASS YOU CAN WITH HER!!!!!!!!!!!!! ESPECIALLY STAGE MAKEUP!

SHE WAS THE BEST TEACHER I EVER HA. I WAS ABSENT SO MANY TIMES FOR THIS CLASS, WHICH WAS STAGE MAKE UP AND IT DID NOT AFFECT MY GRADE. SHE IS ALWAYS WILLING TO HELP YOU IF YOU HAVE ANY PROBLEMS. TAKE EVEY CLASS YOU CAN WITH HER!!!!!!!!!!!!
One of the most talented and inspirational teachers ive ever had. She is brilliant and an amazing person and mentor.
the best class i have taken at brockport hands down. had so much fun and learned so much.. gail is AMAZING
she is one of the best teachers i've ever had.. with her, its not cramming facts or techniques.. it is genuinely a learning experience in her classes
the only reason I'd go back to SUNY Brockport. Best Stage Makeup and Costuming professor I've ever had. Very supportive and inspiring.
Stage Makeup was probably one of my favorite classes I have taken at Brockport. She made class fun and interesting, and encouraged creativity. She rocks!
Wonderful person and professor!  I can't recomend her highly enough!
She is soooo cool! awesome to work with and a great teacher.

Dr. Hietz is by far my favorite professor so far. He has "open-door" office hours and does want students to succeed - just make the effort. He can be very off-putting in class but don't let it stop you from stopping by his office, he's actually really great to talk to! If you want to do well, show up to lecture if you and make sure to read.

Dr. Heitz is a great guy and professor, he's extremely accessible outside (and inside) of class time. He wants students to succeed, but you have to put in the work & effort, that's his mentality. HW is a bit tedious and lengthy, around mid-semester, but manageable. Tests are straight forward and not bad, just study for them. Lab is an easy grade

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Lecture heavy']
comment: Honestly, I did not like him at first. Day one, he said we were already behind. On the first day of class! It got better and redeemed himself when the pandemic started and had a solid plan and made it work. Honestly, it worked so much better than the typical classroom setting.

The grading system is WHACK. Your final grade is based on the total number of accumulated points and if you get over 900, you get an A+. According to BlackBoard, I have 965 points and still received a C+. I AM SO UPSET. Why even put grades into BlackBoard?
ALWAYS willing to help. Very reasonable with grading and expectations are clearly conveyed. He made a difficult subject my absolute favorite of the semester!
just do what your assigned and everything will be fine. lab can be long and a little boring. can use notebooks on quizzes so that makes them much easier.
if you don't do well in this course, its totally on you. you have to work but hes always - yes always - willing to help.

A pretty good prof. Easy grader and overall very easygoing. The one annoying thing is the due dates. They don't exist until you check online and everything is suddenly due. Keep an eye out of for them and work ahead and you will be fine. Don't skip class. Its not mandatory, but you need to show up to pass.
you have to work hard.  but this is college now time to grow up.  what do you expect?  he's fair and always willing to help. you just go to his office and ask

Dr Heitz knows Chemistry and is very smart, but he does not know how to convey the subject to people at entry level.  He is also extremely disorganized and this can be distressing to incoming freshman because of the transition from high school to college.  I feel he is a better teacher for smaller higher level classes.

I've never struggled with any class in college more than this one. To be fair, he knew his stuff, and was great with office hours. But he had no communication with the lab instructor, his testsquizzes didn't follow the structure of the textbook, and class time was just not helpful. I put in a lot of effort, but I felt cheated out of a good grade.

Lectures- fast paced, he forgets that students don't know chemistry like he does and talks over your head.   Office hours- always in his office, tends to ramble off topic.  Will throughly explain answers to your questions, til you understand.  Expects that you will have read and have some working knowledge of topic before you ask questions.

Prof. Heitz is a very knowledgeable man but not a great teacher. His intimidating appearance and his "this is important, you should know it already, i'm not going to teach it" motto make him seem unapproachable. You HAVE to study the textbook because he is not always clear on a topic. Very helpful during office hours. LOTS of online h.w!

He was a pretty decent guy, was easy to talk to, actually cared about how you do despite his demeanor in class. If you talk to him and approach him for help, he'll be there for you. It's basically high school chem until near the end of the semester, read your book and you'll be fine. Mostly look at the examples in class. Go to class for clicker q's

Teaches fast, but is clear about what you need to learn. Difficult tests but if you go to classread he gives lots of examples of what tests will cover. May give off the impression that he doesn't care how you do, but if you actually go get help from him he'll spend as much time as necessary to help you, and genuinely cares. Friendly and funny guy

Think you were good at highschool chem? think again. Hetiz goes insanely fast and puts things on the tests that aren't even in the book. He's knowledgable but should stay in the lab and not be a teacher. I had to basically teach myself everything. Go yo class everyday for the clicker questions. You can fail all 3 tests and still pass.
