Never had a night class go by so fast! The atmosphere in the classroom is so relaxed/open. Don't get me wrong, Ray is also good, but I'd say Toni is the best professor for human sex. You have two exams and a final group project. Not a lot to grade off of, and there is no extra credit, but showing up and participating counts to your grade as well.

Do not reccomend this professor. I understand it's a night class but she does nothing but read off a piece of paper for 3 hours. Your grade consists only of a midterm which she cut in half because she was too lazy to grade  all 50 questions, a project and a final. Take with a different teacher.

Great night class. It's long but it goes by fast and she lets you out early. Definitely read the book though. The tests will be tough if you don't. Shes's hilarious also! Participating in the class is expected but really laid back and simple. Highly recommended!

Toni is awesome. You need to study for the tests, but if she gives you a study guide she is basically giving you the test. Actually enjoyed going to a night class for once and it flew by. She is hilarious and also extremely intelligent when it comes to human sexuality. You learn a lot, and you have fun doing it. Wants everyone to get an A as well

Very fun and easy class. She makes the topic even more interesting and entertaining. You will take a lot of notes and be there for the majority of the class time, but the exams are easy; there are two and she gives you a study guide. Only 2 exams and a group project. Rarely need book, just helps go in depth with class stuff.

I loved this classs!! I definately recomend to anyone to take class with Toni she is the best. I looked forward to going to this class every week, she gives review before tests and wants you to get an A. This class is extremely for helpful for everyone,not just majors!

She keeps u all 3 hours the 1st 1/2 of the semester. THe 1st test is all anatomy stuff which is dry and hard. The 2nd half you get out early b/c you have a project due so meet with the group members. ALOT of NOTES.  boring classes cause of the notes. 2nd test is easyer The speakers arent oo bad. tests are mult and T/F. Not as fun as you would think
Super fun class, easy.  One project/presentation and 2 tests.  Night class goes by very fast and has great speakers...I would definitely recommend this teacher!  Best night class ever.
Awesome teacher!!! Very fun class, interesting topics, never boring either. Definately take her class!!!
take Human sexuality with her! Shes the best teacher and it is the funnest class you will take!

Great professor. Very caring of students and really knows her stuff. Very informative lectures. There was one group project at the end of the semester that was not my favorite, I feel that the directions could have been clearer. Altogether enjoyed her class and would recommend to anyone trying to fill a credit.

Professor Mulvhille (I'm sorry if I misspelled her name) is by far the sweetest professor I have had. Super easy to talk to and very understanding. One day I was super sick and didn't have time to get a drs note because it came on suddenly and she was so understanding and didn't knock my grade down. Would 100% take another class with her.
She is so sweet people take advantage of her kindness but shes amazing she helps with papers so much! If you can take her class take her class

Professor Mulvihill is one of the best professors I have had during my time at Brockport. She really wants you to succeed, and gives great feedback. She offers a lot of opportunities for extra credit. She is very approachable, and understanding. I would definitely take her class again.

Professor Mulvihill was a fantastic comp professor. The class overall is a lot of writing but she scheduled personal meetings with each student to give us feedback on our papers which was very helpful. If you do the work and listen to her critiques, you'll pass the class no problem. She also offers lots of extra credit which is really helpful.

Professor Mulvihill is a nice professor. The good thing about College Comp is that there were no tests, and for professor Mulvihill, no textbook. There is A LOT of writing though. Lots of short papers for homework, some readings, and then 5 term papers on top of those that count towards your overall grade. She always makes time to help her students

Professor Mulvihill is newer to campus, but she is a great teacher. Her class was very straight forward and she is always willing to give feedback. She lets you know what she expects grading wise and is fair. Lots of extra credit opportunities. I recommend this class.

Great professor. He uses real examples that actually help you get the material. Tests are easy if you pay attention, and you can use a one-page cheat sheet. He takes attendance every day, but if you're sick and email him, he's cool about it. You have to buy the textbook, but you never end up using it. I couldn't recommend this professor enough.
Great and nice professor, tests are easy, and he lets you make a full one-page cheat sheet.

I really enjoyed this class. I took it for my Oral Communication Gen Ed class. His lectures are very informative and clear, and he always relates them to real-world examples. Very approachable and helpful if needed. Only has 3 exams with a cheat sheet and one quiz, one group project with a presentation, and no final exam, just a paper.

Group Projects in an online class all year long is a little inconvenient, but overall was a super easy course. My only criticism is the lack of direction he provided on some of these assignments, as they just aren't entirely explained well. But the understanding afterwards of why you got that grade better helps you understand. Super light workload.

Class was structured in a way in which students are free to work at their own pace. Students were not expected to come to class if they were caught up with their work. Classes are extremely boring, do the work so you do not have to go to class. Teacher will not help you with specific problems but offers plenty of tries and time to figure it out.

I had the best experience with Professor Ehrhart. She was easy to get ahold of and really cared about her students learning the material. Her online class has unlimited attempts on assignments, even exams!! Wonderful teacher

This woman did not teach me anything at all. We showed up to this class and all we did was watch videos that were online for us to watch if we needed help. This class was a waste of time and should be taken online.

Definitely take online. Multiple attempts on each assignment so pretty much 100s on everything because you learn from mistakes. NEED the textbooks to follow along with and reference. Only reached out to her for help once and she wasn't very helpful, got an A anyways. Nothing is timed, take all assignments at your own pace.
Class is online, 100% of work and learning is through my IT lab, teacher did not add anything to the course. Email her and she gives rude responses, don't think she is a very intelligent person.

Im currently taking CIS106 online. If you ever have a question, just email her and she will literally get back to you within the day. I have been having trouble opening some of the assignments on MyITLab and she has been doing everything she can to help, and plus the assignments are insanely easy!! The syllabus is kind of confusing though.
Great teacher!

Not sure why there's any negative reviews for this prof., she's amazing. Class is set up as a workshop so  I was able to complete class a month ahead of schedule.  There's lots of quizzes, 4 big tests, and research paper at end. As long as you use textbook, you'll do fine and once you complete everything you don't even have to show up anymore.
Work by yourself class. No need to buy a text book. She doesn't teach. homework/coursework takes a lot of time outside of class! Didn't like the course

EASIEST CLASS EVER! Mandatory attendence but all you have to do is go into class and type in the code. The homework is so easy and you get multiple chances to re-do it. Ehrhart says she wants to keep the class environment "calm," so you can literally leave the minute after you get there!

this lady is a terrible professor. does not teach anything. u go to class, sign in, and then u can do what you want. u MUST HAVE the book or u will fail. ALL the work is from the book. ATTENDANCE IS BS. MISS ONE CLASS AND U LOSE 2 PTS FRM OVRALL AVG!

Strict attendance policy (2 points off the final grade for each absence) but students have the ability to freely leave once the attendance PIN is entered in the tracker.  Extra credit available.  Once acclimated to the rhythm of her course, it is a breeze.

the work itself isn't bad, as long as you do everything right. however, she doesn't teach. you learn everything from the book. every time i tried to ask for help she would give me rude, condescending remarks, and tell me i'm wrong without helping me. she always seems to have an attitude that is rele, rele unnecessary.

Bad professor. Like someone said, she assumes you know what your doing. Asking her questions is terrible because she gets mad at you and gives you attitude for not understanding what she has taught. Don't go with her unless you want to take a hard course and get a C

She is very confusing and assumes you know what she is talking about. The class is easy but she makes it hard by answering questions wrong and putting the wrong name for homework in the syllabus with no page numbers. Never once knew what the homework was, neither did most kids in the class. Only class i ever dropped and I have a 3.5 average. She is
I can see how some non-computer people might have issues, but even though the clarity might not have been great (just as much subject matter's fault though), she is always willing to help.

OMG! This woman should not be teaching. She leaves class 15 minutes early while we are still working; there are so many computer mistakes on her exams that she doesn't fix because she doesn't want to put the effort into changing the grades; she takes 2 points off total grade for every class you miss (if have 95, miss 3 classes, 95-6=89 in class!)

She has a weird personality, shes kind of annoying, but deep down she seems to be a nice person.  Very knowledgeable about her field and computers, but the class does require alot of homework.  Take class if your ready to do work and learn.

Such a bad teacher. Made the CIS class one of my hardest classes of the semester when it should be the easiest. Takes the class way to serious when it should be really easy. Not clear on what is due and when, extremely annoying and just not a good teacher. take with someone else!!!!!
Weird teacher.  Makes the class really hard when it shouldn't be at all.  Tests are unbelievably hard.  tons of homework.  Avoid and take with another teacher no matter what.
WILL DROP YOUR GPA. She makes impossible what should be the easiest class. Hours of hw. Boring. DONT TAKE WITH HER.  Shes from a diff. planet.

BY FAR THE WORST teacher I have ever had on any level.Granted, she may know her stuff, but she is full of herself and doesn't care about the students.She cannot teach a lick, and honestly, she doesn't deserve to be a teacher she is so bad.No way should she have been a professor on the college level.
Very unhelpful and rude.  She doesn't care about her students and she always has lipstick on her teeth.
Worst teacher ever!  Doesn't teach you anything!

She is pretty boring on non-lab days, but overall she is very passionate about what she's taking about and helps you out as much as possible. If you take her class make sure to read the Hutchenson book for the quiz and make sure to study hard for her tests cus they are a little complicated.

Boring Boring Boring. If you don't have lab you are just sitting there watching her talk and make stupid jokes that are not funny. Homework and test are easy but the class is so boring. Only take it if you have too.
extremely boring, very tempted every second of that class to get up and walk out.  Days with no lab, get ready to sit and watch her play around with Word on the projector for 90 minutes.
busy woman who doesn't make it easy to make appontments one on one with her for extra help.  grading is fair though
Good for help in lab but extremly boring on days when thier is no lab
He's a nice guy. Lets you rewrite most things for higher grade.  Knows you might not be a great writer but grades fair and will help you.  Not a stickler on grammar. Loves imagination.

This class was is very aggravating. His grading is harsh and very hard to understand, he does not give rubrics for his assignments, just examples. He stresses the idea of idiosyncratic wording but never explains what that actually means so it feels like your trying your best to be creative but its just not working for his expectations.

The worst teacher that has nothing to do with being a strict. It has to do with lack of communication, no assignment rubric, just a few vauge sentences then providing feedback not related to requested coursework. saying he won't answer questions, giving a zero because he was emotional (literally). I wouldn't believe it if I didn't experience it.

Dr. Fellner is the most fastidious professor I have ever had. He started the class with the 'syllabus' and a list of all the things NOT to do in his class. It's intimidating. His assignments seem impossibly difficult to do, but if you make it idiosyncratic; unique, your grade will be fine. Just be ready to think more creatively than ever before!

If you can get over how full of himself he is you'll be okay. I loved showing up to class and the assignments were not hard at all even if you're a horrible writer he will still help you during office hours. just be prepared for some rude comments but this class is an easy A and very fun in my opinion.

Steve Fellner is a lot of things, he is a good professor at the end of the day but he is very harsh. If you want a good grade in the class you have to be able to take his criticism and make changes. He gives second chances on work and gives you the tools to get a 100, you just have to be okay with being bullied a bit.

I'll be real, I was not taking this class expecting to become a better writer, and I didn't become a better writer. In fact, I might have gotten worse. However, I did pass, so I'm happy. The easiest and dumbest class I've ever taken - Purdue/blog links in place of lecture and elementary-level writing prompts.

I have had Steve for two classes now, and I will admit that when I first walked into his classroom I was both frightened and excited. He is tough, he tells you what's on his mind truthfully. Don't take this class if you don't care about the art of writing, you won't get it. However, if you want to be a writer, Steve is the best prof to pick.

This professor is extremely rude, bully's and yells at the class. I am really surprised that he is still a professor because he would constantly tell us that certain things that we lacked educationally and then,  tell us it was below him to teach it to us. I would not take this class

Steve. I know you read these. I urge you to be a nicer person...

This professor is weird.  He's funny and critical and nice and you never know what he's really thinking even though he's blunt.  I didn't trust what he said.  When he praised you, it was like he was cutting you down and when he cut you down, it was like he was praising you. ]

tags: ['Tough grader', 'Get ready to read', 'Lots of homework']
comment: I would not recommend taking a course with this professor at all. He is degrading towards students, self-centered, and an adult bully. He gives the weirdest most unhelpful and unnecessary assignments and expects us to read his mind on what he wants. Some things that came out of his mouth were completely inappropriate and disturbing.

Professor Fellner gives clear direction and clear grading criteria. He grades promptly. Keep an open mind when reading the syllabus. It may seem overwhelming in the beginning but his assignments are fun and creative. He assigns writings that allow you to be creative.

As a writer, I really appreciated his class. He threw creative and challenging assignments at us that I loved. my favorite example is the one where we had to use only two lines of dialogue -no more, no less. He's a tough critic, which is needed for writing. He takes fresh take on creative writing that was very fun to play around with.

The professor can be hostile sometimes. That's the only way of putting it. It's his way or no way. The classes can be interesting and you can learn a lot, but expect rude comments. He states very often to not take anything he says personally, and it's true. It's one thing if he was talking about schoolwork, but he also comments on just students.

Please, for the sake of your mental health, do NOT take any of Fellner's classes. These reviews are accurate, he gives such complicated directions for what he Doesn't want in your poems that there's barely any room left for creativity. And don't expect any constructive feedback when he inevitably decides that your work is not good enough.
DO NOT TAKE A CLASS WITH FELLNER!!! He makes creative assignments so specific, that you can't be creative at all. Huge ego. He judges and gives rude critiques instead of constructive criticism.

Absolutely do not take a class with this professor. All of his homework is extremely biased as to what HE finds abstract, let alone his obsession with 'idiosyncratic nouns' which really means abstract nouns. He makes poetry not fun. I hate writing poems for this class. I'm not learning anything, except for being able to hold my tongue.

tags: ['Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Tough grader']
comment: Did not vibe with him. He plays mind games, contradicts himself constantly, huge ego, grades tough, pretends to be kind but really isnt, makes you speak in class to get attendance points. My experience did not match other reviews here.

Steve grades hard, but if you do the work ahead of time, he is more than willing to give AMAZING feedback. I definitely as a writer as a result of his course. 10/10 recommend taking if you have the opporunity.

He gives amazing criticism on your writing. Very inspirational. He is inventive and complex on his assignments which one should expect at this level. Crystal clear syllabus and specific grading criteria, if you follow it you will do well. I'll never forget "idiosyncratic nouns" for the rest of my life. He presses students to be better.

tags: ['Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Tough grader']
comment: Very all over the place, he doesn't know what he wants so it makes it very difficult to understand what he expects from you. Very unpredictable. Gets very upset over little things and will NOT be afraid to call you out on it! I wish I would have taken his hints and dropped. Don't miss class he will change the syllabus on the spot.
Hes very direct on what he wants from each assignment. Overall, the assignments arent too hard but you have to make sure your writing stands out and has peculiar nouns

I have learned nothing other than how to develop a hatred of poetry and obscure assignments. I have had to write an index, sing a song with 2 other people, and write poems that have such strict guidelines that you lose creativity. He makes it difficult to meet the criteria because he wants something very specific but is unclear in what he wants.
I loved Creative writing with Fellner. He challenges you and really helps you grow as a writer. Awesome class, great teacher!

tags: ['Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: In ways, he's a great professor. He gives a variety of projects however some didn't fit into the course. He gets mad if you're late even if you're a second late, he won't be happy. The amount of time you put into it outside of class takes away from your other classes. He tells you what not to do but never what to do. You never use the textbook.

Steve is a hard grader, but if you really put in the effort and work for it then he is always fair. He loves to try to intimidate people, but will never be disrespectful. He gives the best feedback and will tell you exactly what he is thinking. You never have to guess around him and it's really nice to know exactly where your writing stacks up.

tags: ['LOTS OF HOMEWORK', 'SO MANY PAPERS', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: As a prof he is not that bad. He will push you to become a better writer and try new styles of writing. I left the class with new techniques and a better feeling for my writing style. As a person, he is really hard to deal with. He always interrupts and is a PhD (as he likes to point out). Very clear grader though...

He has a lot to teach you because yes, he knows what he is talking about and yes, he is better at it than you are, that's why he is teaching the class. You could not ask for a more caring  and influential teacher. Be ready to listen to his opinions and be open-minded, he will do the same for you. He doesn't give out compliments, he tells the truth.
Just recommended him to a friend for Wintersession.  Let us rewrite almost all of our assignments if we wanted for a higher grade.
A weird guy, but I thought nice even though he has a strange sense of humor.  Is critical but still gives high grades.  Conference with him, he'll always give you the benefit of the doubt.
if your views do not match up with his do not even bother. He seemed as if he was too good to be teaching  this class. He made me not like english even more than i already did

Fellner is very rude and should learn some manners. I know he would probably chuckle at the mean reviews but honestly... he should take  a moment look down in his soul and make a change. If you want to be a teacher who makes students fearful of public humiliation that they have a difficult time learning KUDOS Steve your doing great!

I asked Steve to direct my thesis because I knew he would be fair and insightful. He was always available through email and we even talked on the phone when we were not able to meet. He gave me advice then that I still use today, and I wish that he and I had more time together as I wanted to continue learning from him. He is funny and caring also.
Always open to help you! Go to office hours if you need help
I took him or 210 on-line during Wintersession.  Didn't assign much work around holidays, always fair.

Very strange.  He's emotional, but it feels phony.  It feels like he doesn't care and he's always humoring you when he does.  He's funny in a mean way and he smiles so he can always claim he didn't mean what you knew he meant.  And then it's weird because in his office he was s good, nirmal guy.
Steve fails to foster creativity in his classes because he tears students apart. Never know what you are going to get. Made me cry on a regular basis.
Never boring.  Even if he is a little moody.  He acts tough.  but grades fairly.

Part of me really believes that Steve means well, and the other part of me believes that he doesn't want to teach. Depending on his mood, he can either help or hurt your overall goal in the class. While he is available, he often told me, "There's nothing I can do" or "That isn't my job." At times it was rough, and other times I felt appreciated.
Worst professor in my college life.

Steve is a great professor - felt very lucky to have him for College Composition. Compared to the other teachers he doesn't give nearly as much work and he focuses on the larger picture - really helps you to improve your overall writing. Can be sassy. Be real and don't be afraid to have an opinion in his class.

Steven is definitely an artist, and takes great pride in helping his students write like artists. He can be a harsh critic, and there are days when he will tear people's work apart, but you'll learn so much from him. Lots of creatively stimulating class activities. I took his class hybrid online, a lot of work done in forums, I would recommend.
Steve is very focused on individual success.  He will always make time to talk to a student.

Steve is an interesting man to have as a professor. He wants people to tap into their inner creative genius, and can get worked up when students suck at expressing themselves through writing. But if you ask him for help he will genuinely care about how terrible your writing is, take pity on you, and want to assist you.  Sometimes there's no hope.

Oh god, what is there to say about Steve? My first impression was great, then there was somewhat of a decline, but then it went right back up. He's tough and a little scary, but he's a fabulous prof. He cares if you do well, and he'll do his best to help you succeed. If you put effort in, you'll get a lot out of his class. Am I making myself clear?

Steve can be hot and cold. Sometimes, I felt I was doing very well and Steve gave me good comments. Other times, like my first workshop, I felt ripped apart. Workshop was tough for me, but it made me work harder on my final portfolio. Participation is key! I participated a lot and did well on my final portfolio, and I ended with A. Have to try!

Steve is the only professor at Brockport I've actually learned from.  He's insightful in ways that must be experienced.  I've taken two workshops with him (poetry&non-fiction), and only wish I could take more as a grad student. He is someone you will learn from, both in life and class. He will push you to be a better writer. Oh captain, my captain.

This is not what you expect from college.  I found out that he had a PhD and was surprised.  You never know what he will say next; my friends take notes of the things he said and we made a found poem of them.  Fair grader but do not be late and if you are dont talk back, he threw a student out of class for talking back.  the student deserved it.

I'll keep this brief. Fellner is brilliant!  He truly cares about his students and he forces them to work hard.  If you apply yourself you will get a good grade!  This being said, he is very unreliable. No real syllabus, lack of assignment clarity, and several un-read and un-graded assignments.  Very organic teaching, enjoyable, yet a pain for many

Very fun guy and very smart.  A little weird.  He never read his own creative writing to our class even though we asked.  All he said was there are at least 1,000,000,000 people you should read instead.  Workload is medium, don't blow off what he does assign: he can tell and he'll say so.
Probably the most controversial performance in the department.  You either love him or hate him.  I thought he was OK.

I'm taking the horror film with him this summer.  I took his creative course last semester.  He did ask for things.  Not a blow off.  But supernice guy.  On the last day of class, he said he was going to give us all an A.  And he did.  (He said we all were trying the most we could.)
We had a lot of fun, although attendance is usually pretty lax you will want to show up or you will miss things
One tough professor, but worth taking the torture!

If you're thinking of taking Creative Writing because it sounds relaxing then wait until somebody else is teaching it. Steve is really, really hard on students. Though he's harsh he's generally right, everything he says is really helpful if you can just put your ego aside long enough to listen. His class is brutal, but definitely well worth it.

I heard that even other profs think he's weird.  Which he is--he throws little fits in class if u dont do what he says, but what he says is always sorta right.  He acts more like a writer than a teacher--its sort of a problem, but hes nice and funny.

Steve is AMAZING. He can be super intimidating, but he's a really sweet guy who GENUINELY cares about his students. He is so honest and more than willing to help you. He's strange and quirky, but that definitely makes his classes WAY more fun. Best professor here, I've taken a bunch of classes with him. JUST DON'T BE LATE!

Weird guy.  He goes too far, but at least he's entertaining.  He thinks odd thoughts, and it's not because he's openly gay.  It's because he's him.  Some students hated his class. Others like me loved it but still am not sure why.

"Am I  making myself clear?" he says this all the time.  He comes across as very intimidating but if u pay attention, u can tell he has very low self esteem & likes to make people feel bad about their writing because it makes him feel better about his own. NEVER be late for his class because he will yell at u in front of everyone. Participate!!!

i dont know how to describe this experience...sometimes he seems like a character from the twilight zone, sometimes you can tell he wants to rip you apart but pretends to act nice, a lot like dr. austin busch....

He's very, very strange.  He doesn't give normal opinions.  He twists your poems to mean things they couldnt possible mean and then looks shocked.  Very nice guy one-on-one totally different tho in class--you don't know what he'll say next.

I'm not sure what I like more about Dr. Fellner, his sense of humor or his wicked intellect. This was the best class I've taken. Challenging yet rewarding. It was like chocolate, wrapped in bacon, with chocolate sauce. Delicious and perplexing.

If your not going to go to class everyday NO NOT take this class.  Make sure you staple your papers very very neatly or he will yell at you infront of everyone.  BUT he is one the greatest professors I have ever had! loved the class!

you cant not be entertained by this guy...not smart in the way most profs are smart...he looks at everything at in an odd way that its a little freaky...but he knows a lot about people...donn't ask him what he thinks of you he might tell u
SUCH AN AWESOME TEACHER

Steve is amazing, he lets you know exactly what he wants on the first day. Participation and attendance are really important to him. Theres two portfolios throughout the course which are 8-10 pages but its really not that bad, he is critical but a fair grader. He has the most interesting things to say and recommend I would definitely suggest him.
Steve is AMAZING! Totally blunt with his criticism, but absolutely invested in every single one of his students.  If you want to be a writer, you NEED to take his class.

Steve is the best teacher I have ever had. He is so nice and is willing to do whatever it takes for you to understand. I have take 2 classes with him and I wish to take all my English classes with him. He has the best heart ever and i love him. If there is one teacher who had an impact on my life and writing...its Steve.
hardest creative writng teacher here: he actually puts grades on your assignments; but your writing does improve even though he can be ruthless and a little too tough

Steve is funny, and his class is interesting, but the work for the two portfolio's is hard, he is very picky, and rips your first couple pieces that you write apart- if you can take strong critisism then i recommend this class

He puts way too much personal opinion into his critiquing, if you're a good writer he will bash you, if you're a terrible writer he'll let you off easy, he has a bad attitude, he's stuck up, rude and he holds personal grudges for no reason. He has been known to bring people to tears in front of the class when you're being critiqued on your writing!

I loved being in Steve's poetry workshop. If it weren't for him, I'd still be writing crappy poetry. Steve likes to push his students to write well, and that is very admirable. I'm glad I was able to be in one of his classes.
I dont like poety and steve was aware that most students arent and let us complain and yet he forced us to resepct it too
No Comments

very eccentric, funny and weird, unclear about what he's looking for in poetry, always tells you to come see you in his office but only spent 5 minutes when i went in there, doesnt ask for a lot of work but pretty much grades poetry on personal preference
No Comments

Steve in awesome professor and guy.  He is very smart and you will definately learn a great deal from his teaching along with have a great time in his class.His sense of humor and bluntness is a great even balance for a great learning experience! I love him somuch i'm taking 2 classes with him again

steve is a good guy, a little odd and fairly intense, and if you don't like negative feedback stay away. it can be a tough class but it definitely pushes you and you will be a better poet for it, absolutely.
Steve Fellner is Hot!
very dramatic guy, sometimes over he top, never boring, odd
Clear on what he wants. Do your work and you should do well. Overall, down-to-earth cool guy.

Steve was an awesome teacher and Creative Writing was my favorite class this semester. He makes class fun with cool videos poems and stories. At the end of the course your writing skills will have improved more than you can imagine. He also really does care about his students and is honest with them
Very strict about what he wants in your papers, but is very helpful in making sure you improve. He promotes some creativity, but it feels like he takes over if it's "not creative enough".
Dr. fellner inserts too much of his own opinion into the text, but has a good heart-I think

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Test heavy', 'Graded by few things']
comment: She is a nice person but not a good teacher. We were rushed through the last 2 Austen books for the semester and she is an incredibly slow grader. I'm stuck wondering if I've failed the entire semester. It's very frustrating at times. She is slow to reply to emails, best to talk to her in person. It wasn't awful but wasn't good.

Online class- took forever to grade assignments including  when the she told us not to submit part 2 before receiving her feedback and grade on part 1… but we didn't get the grades from part 1 until way after part 2 was due. She didn't even change the class page from previous semesters so due dates were off, too. Totally disconnected all semester

One of the worst teachers at Brockport. There's almost no structure to the course leading students to assume the assignment meets the requirements. No feedback is given, points are docked arbitrarily, and nothing is graded until the last minute. I would avoid this teacher at all costs. Good Luck

Professor Kerfoot is one of the nicest people I have ever met, but she's not a good teacher. She's super unorganized, bad at communication, and has way too high expectations of her students. It's just not possible to read and comprehend an entire Jane Auste novel in two days. She spends a good chunk of each class fangirling about Jane Austen.

She's unorganized, lacks professionalism, and showed up to our class twice (after missing multiple classes in between) with bronchitis and pneumonia. This class was so boring, the online textbook didn't work and was expensive, and she is an unnecessarily difficult grader for some reason? Which is bold coming from a professor who barely shows up.

As of today, she has graded ONE assignment since the beginning of the semester (of like 7). She does not take attendance and cancels fairly often. Classes are entirely discussion, which is very redundant and feels optional after a while. She is so sweet though. ENG 303 is a pretty easy class. These other ratings are very dramatic, you'll be ok.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Lots of homework']
comment: Professor Kerfoot is a nice lady and will accommodate your needs however, she gives out an extreme amount of homework that just isn't reasonable. Some of the assignments seem pointless and she will take a long time to grade your work. Also in class, she is a little all over the place and it's not the most productive.

I had to drop this course because of how difficult she made it. She cancelled class once a week, never communicated, and our assigned textbook was a grammar book that we had to answer questions about. There were always 7-10 questions, and I would have over 3 pages of writing just for homeworks. Incredibly boring and a harsh grader.

I have never had a worse professor than Kerfoot. She graded everything late. Posted things late. Didnt answer questions. When I told the upperclassmen that I had Kerfoot in the beginning of the semester they warned me of all of this, however it was a mandatory course. My roommates teacher was completely different and makes me wish I had him.

I took Dr. Kerfoot for Brit Lit and she was the best. She is very understanding and will help you if you come to her with problems. I will say though, the class is INCREDIBLY reading intensive and classes are entirely discussion based. She also has us take a formal final exam. As much as I like her, I don't think I could take another class with her
She is very kind and knows what she is talking about. If she knows that you try, she will not give up on you. She is also active on the campus too, which is refreshing!

Great professor! Take advantage of the rough drafts (if offered). They are really helpful and she gives amazing feedback. My class was all conversation based, no lectures which was cool. Her class was a lot of work, but I learned so much and enjoyed it. Do not take her class if you don't like writing or reading.

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Get ready to read', 'ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS']
comment: Dr. Kerfoot is one of the sweetest women in the English department, which is saying something considering most of the professors are so awesome. If you're the type of student who is having a rough go of things, can't always make it physically into class, is bad with deadlines, etc., Dr. Kerfoot is ALWAYS extremely accommodating.

If you email her she answers you with exactly what is in the syllabus or just answers your question with yes. It doesn't matter what the question is, it could need a long lengthy response and the answer you'll receive is yes.
She was very nice and very passionate about what she teaches. She does grade a little tough but if she knows you try you won't fail.

She is extremely kind and thoughtful idk what most people on here are talking about. Yes she grades a little tough and can get off but COMMUNICATE or use office hrs and you'll improve your papers. Read interesting texts. Participate in class discussion it goes along way to helping understand material although yes discussions tend to get off topic.

Definitely avoid this "professor" if you can. She was all over the place and I never had a clue what she was talking about. Absolutely 0 help when I was lost and her tests were over stuff we never talked about. Hated her class.
Even though I thought the class was boring, I didn't think she was that bad. She was very nice and helpful but a harsh grader. If you work really hard you will do pretty decent.
Kerfoot is a complete b word. Don't take a class with her.

Alicia really was a nice professor with a lot of knowledge on her field of study. A plus is, she is very open to helping her students. I liked her a lot.                                  That being said, I found her grading to be little hard and found myself having some clarity issues with her class.

I would never recommend this professor to anyone. This class had so much potential to be interesting and exciting but she is incredibly unorganized and unclear. She is a tough grader and is very repetetive. A lot of people in our class struggled, including the "A" students. I can't say I really learned anything from this class.

Definitely the worst professor I've ever had. There were only a few assignments throughout the semester, all papers, and she graded them very hard. If you don't agree with her, regardless of whether it's an opinion paper, she'll give you a bad grade. The class was also uninteresting and very unorganized.

Kerfoot was the worst professor I EVER had. She's unclear in her instruction & is very unfair in her grading. She didnt teach us how to do the basics in what she expected& her instruction was horrible. She is a very nit-picky grader and if you dont have the same opinion as her than youre wrong!Dont take her class unless you want to get a C or lower

The only nice thing was that attendance was not mandatory. I would often skip if I could. She's a really harsh grader with high expectations. Expect to do a lot of work for a few points. She never tested on whether or not you did the readings but it pays to actually do them for the close readings for the midterm and final.
I most definitely would not recommend taking any class taught by Kerfoot. She grades with a ridiculously nitpicky rubric and is under the impression that only her opinion is the correct one.

She has unreasonable expectations for her classes. This is supposed to be an introduction class, but she teaches it like a 400 level. She gives very low marks and loves deducting points for minor things, so don't expect to get an A even if you're in class every day taking notes. The class average was a C. Don't take a class with her.
He makes it hard to take notes, and his lectures are based on his political opinion. Don't take this class.

tags: ['So many papers', 'Lecture heavy', 'Graded by few things']
comment: Lectures are enjoyable, just kinda long and every single class. Majority of your grade is based on essays, 3 major unit essays (in place of unit tests) and 4 smaller source essays, weekly quizzes on the textbook but you can get by without reading it. If you hate writing essays, run away fast and far.

Makes the textbook next to impossible to use and then doesn't care when you ask for help regarding said textbook. Also makes you pay for his own book. He owns the rights, he wrote it, why am I and the other 20 students, paying $80 each?

other than that, very good at teaching. tries to get classes involved.

Offers many extra credit opportunities-nice guy, 3 writing tests and there is also 3 papers, encourages reading the textbook but I did fine never doing any reading, doesnt cold call, overall good teacher hes funny and smart
While there are quite a few papers, he is a very fair grader and the lectures are posted online and are clear to understand. Lectures are interesting and he knows a lot about what the subject.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Clear grading criteria', 'So many papers']
comment: This class was a hell storm. Too many papers and readings. Over 12 quizzes this semester! He was a decent guy and teacher.But, he is a very hard grader and is very precise. This class is just not a 200 level course or is just not treated this way. I think Dr. Davila could have a lot of improvement to his class. Avoid if you can but if not good luck

The class consists mostly of lectures. Grading consisted of weekly quizzes, 3 exams and 4 papers. There is extra credit in the class if needed. Recommended a textbook, but it isn't needed to pass the class.

Really great professor, he's extremely knowledgeable on what he teaches and makes lectures interesting. Doesn't really respond to emails though and the essay lengths are a bit excessive for a 100 level course. Don't take if you're looking for an easy class to fill space, but it's interesting

Fun and kind professor. Class is HEAVY on writing but as long as you put in the effort and have a general understanding you will do decently. Overall a nice guy and decent class. Super interesting guy.. he seems incredibly knowledgeable.
a literal saint and so understanding. a lot of reading and lectures weren't very easy to listen to

I wish I could give this man more credit but it was horrible. he played favorites and did not help at all. he was flexible but the papers were never clear and then he would fail you for them. honestly, I was about to drop his class but it was too late.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Lecture heavy', 'So many papers']
comment: Terrible teacher. Worst class ever. There were too many useless papers for a gen ed and he seemed like he didn't care about his students at all.
Dr Davila was a truly great professor,very clear presentations in class,i enjoyed going to his class,just make sure you read any related readings

Attendance isn't graded so it is not mandatory, but there wasn't a day I didn't want to go to his class. The only problem was the lecture was straight from powerpoints but he gave outlines for notes that could be used directly on the exams, which was so helpful. He is so funny, makes a lot of jokes but also takes his job very seriously.

Davila is a pretty nice and passionate professor. He cares a lot about history and makes it known through lecture's . Show up to class or give friend your iclicker, fill out the outlines every week because they're on the test, don't bother reading textbook just read primary documents, do all of the primary essay's, and rack up points on quiz day's.

Gives weekly outlines of what you ill be learning. Class is composed of 3 unit tests and 4 papers with weekly 4 question quizzes. Attend class and you will do fine on everything. Tests come exactly from the outlines. Lectures a lot but is hilarious and keeps everyone engaged. Really passionate about history and accessible outside of class.

Dr. Davila is a great guy. Lectures are super engaging and he gets the class going with his hilarious jokes. He's so passionate about history and is willing to help. There are 3 unit tests and 4 papers that you use readings for, so not hard at all. He gives outlines of notes and he gives a lot of extra credit opportunities. Overall, great teacher.

This cat is authentic! The real deal! Scholarly? Check! Commanding? Youbetcha! Eccentric? In spades, my friend! Funny? To be sure! Reasonable? But of course! Fair? I'll say! Passionate about the subject matter? Like, for sure! Engaging? Say no more! Presidential? Let's not get carried away....

Dr. Davila really prepared for this class and it showed. The Silk Roads were presented like an epic story with a beginning, middle, and end. Very engaging classes. Lots of reading on various books and provided excerpts; no textbook. Quizzes every week on readings. Changed up grading criteria twice, but did so with consent and a class vote.

Although his class was not the hardest, he put my final quiz grades in wrong. The only problem I've had with his class is how he has handled this situation, and that is very poorly. My final grade went from a B- to a D- because he didn't change my grade and submitted it as my final. This has been my only problem with him as a professor though.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS', 'LECTURE HEAVY']
comment: Extremely rude and disrespectful when asking for help and is never clear on expectations for writing assignments.  Tests are essays and fill in the blank for a gen ed class.  Takes weeks to get grades back and never posts outlines on time.  Very careless and doesn't care about your knowledge or performance in the class.

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read']
comment: I took Gender in Islamic Culture with him - twice weekly evening class. He's an awesome guy - brilliant and eccentric in the best way. Read. READ. READ! The readings were the basis of the essays and tests. Tests are difficult. We had to present on a reading section, and they are hard, scholarly works. He will help you when you get stuck. Great guy!

Davila's a very cool guy. He's very funny, and if you agree with his political beliefs you'll get along with him very easily. Kind of crazy, but in a good way. The course itself was very challenging. Having taken several 300 level history classes, I've never been challenged like how I was in his class. LOTS of readings and assignments.

He can seem crazy at some points but is very down to earth and realistic about topics.  He keeps things interesting in lectures with sarcastic comments.  Lots of essays and reading but not too hard of a grader.  Good teacher overall.

He is a brilliant scholar, yet still manages to stay personable. His lectures are very funny, interesting and engaging. I'm never bored. That said, you will have to work hard to pass. BUT if you meet the challenge, you will learn much more than in the average classroom. Warning: There are a lot of readings and you MUST read to pass!

Great professor. He lectures every class, and the lectures are the basis to the essays you write in class. He is eccentric, in a good way, and keeps class interesting. He is a bit of a hard grader, but his rationale on the grades he gives is clear. He is always willing to help students. I would definitely recommend him.

I took his Honors History 101. He is an extremely intelligent man and most of his classes are non stop lectures. Take good notes! He never uses handouts and rarely uses powerpoints. The tests are quite hard. If you want to do good in this class - you need to come to class and study! There is no way to get around it. You cannot BS your way through i

Very good professor. Explains things very clearly. Almost all of class is lecture. Take good notes, cause what he says in lecture is almost exactly what is on the tests. Fairly easy tests though. Only three tests, a power point presentation and an essay so a fairly easy work load.  Puts emphasis on different things and makes it interesting.

Okay, this dude is a brilliant man and teaches you a lot but when it comes to taking tests and doing papers, he asks the most obscure questions on the most irrelevant stuff.  I mean who cares about the meaning of Abbasid poetry, I thought we should know what they were known for, etc. etc. Just focuses on the least important****.

Decent professor. His teaching method is straight forward; listen to his one hour lecture and take notes. The only way to run into problems in this class is if you don't read the book. Tests focus a lot on what's in the text. Overall: Take him if you already know a little about History, if not it can be a little fast paced.
No Comments

Great teacher.  Lectures alot, so attendence not mandatory, but tests are based on lecture.  Only 3 tests, a presentation, and a  writing assignment.  no homework beside this, tests are kinda tough, no multiple choice only short answer and essay.  Cool guy
No Comments

This class was by far the best I've take so far. Even though it was online, I really got a lot out of it. The videos and discussions were relevant to the course and he really cared about the responses to the questions. Though there were 3 projects (i think 3) they were actually super fun and graded fairly.

Claims its not the typical class and that the grade is entirely up to you, but there are strict guidelines for this class that he does not really make clear at all. VERY interesting class, but at times you will find yourself second and third guessing your work beucase you don't know what he really wants to see. Keep an open mind, very important.

This is the most bizarre and amusing class you will ever take at Brockport, everyone should experience it! Dan is an awesome professor. He is loud, soulful, down to earth, and allows you to live the course without any tests or hardwork. Confusing at times, just pay attention and ask him when stuff is due. You will never have more fun in a class!!

Sad to say I was a bit disappointed in the class. Don't get me wrong it's a unique class and I loved what I learned but I took it as an elective and I found myself  sacrificing time from my major classes to complete assignments from this class most of the semester. Also for such a "chill" class I found the instructions vague and the grading harsh.

This class was my least favorite class. According to the teacher this semester they changed it up, but the class was horrible. It had more work than any of my other classes, and he was very vague about what we needed to do. What's more is that Dan only tells you what you need to do to get an 85%, so I had to do a buttload more stuff to  get an A.

Class was interesting but you must have an open mind. Dan is very chill to the point of unclear sometimes. Everything is open to interpretation. You basically grade yourself.  There are some assignments like journal entries and reflection papers and one large group project at the end.

Dan's the man!!! I loved this class, the only class at Brockport that doesnt feel like a class. It's really interesting and he doesnt give exams, which is great. Online discussion fourums a couple of weeks, reflection papers, journals and a group presentation. Overall, great class. loved it

The class itself was alright, but dates are always changing and instructions are vague. Dan is a very difficult grader for someone who tells us to be open minded and "let go of your ego". I felt he was over critical on personal thoughts. On the bright side, class was always something different encompassing games and activities
TAKE this class! It is easy, and very useful for anyone.
SO EASY!! Take it with Mykins! He's the man!!
SO easy it's almost too easy. Fun and interesting class.
taking this class for fun, not even in my major. if you're not opened mind don't take this class...I love it

Keep an open mind. Fun class but you will be there until 9. Every week is something new which is cool. Two tests and a group presentation. Gives you all the test questions to study from before the test. Nice guy.
Worst professor ever!

Rehnuma is a really nice person, but kind of boring professor. Her class isn't too hard - take notes and you'll do fine.  Tests are open book. Projects are pretty easy. She just takes a long time to get to the point.
She does not speak English very well and has a hard time explaining things. She was very nice and an easy class but you dont get your stuff back and she takes a while to grade stuff

Dr. Karim's class is not the most interesting, but she does well with the content. As the tests are open notes and book, it can span a great deal of information. Not an easy A but well earned. TAKE NOTES! You will find she writes her own tests. Lots of videos to explain the course content, very helpful. The assignments were fairly graded.
This professor is a strict grader with confusing instructions on the assignments.  All of the tests and quizzes are open book which is very nice.

Rehnuma is a little bit hard to understand at times but she does her best to make herself understandable to everyone. If you need her to clarify, ask her and she will do so. She's very nice and makes all of the class information relevant and interesting. She's great!
She helps us to relate the topics with real life. Assignments allows you to undestand the topic better. Need to covercontents and maybe that is why the contents could be borng at 8am :)
really boring class. hard to stay awake for the 8 am class. easy if you do all in class assignments and homework. tests are open note open book.
Interesting person but not an interesting teacher. Same thing everyday! Not clear about due dates or expectations. She is very understanding though.

Helpful. Listens and generate discussions on the topics. She includes examples and youtube video which are very helpful to understand the content. The one minute papers are helpful to reflect on what we learned that day.
I enjoyed the class and learned alot about whats going on in the rest of the world. Her examples make things easy to understand.
She is very understanding when you approach her but her classes can be a little boring. Open book tests. You cannot make up work that you missed in class. You need to be able to do group work.
He reads from the powerpoint, he always tried to cover a lot of chapters in 1 test.

Prof. Eldridge gives a real world view of law and tells it like it is. He was also great in connecting me with an awesome internship.  The book is dense, but he helps you cut through the junk and makes it enjoyable. Participation is mandatory, and the exams are take out. Would definitely take again.

Does not actually teach, just watch videos and podcasts. Only way to learn the material is if you do all the reading and do what ever you have to do to learn it. I myself will not take him again. Boring class and does not actually teach you anything, that's it.

She was really nice and sweet and was easy to talk to for help with work outside of class. You had to do speaking tasks with a partner at the end of the semester but she gave you the lay out and was always at class before so you could ask questions. Her work was easy. Would recommend!!
Very good professor.
Ida was a tough grader. She gave way to much home work. She was very aggressive and class always went to the last second possible.
Prof is great. She is like a mother to us
This woman is my savior. she is the best teacher I have ever had in my entire life and so insparational. She is so helpful with assignments and is a very funny woman.
i loved her

She is very nice and will work with you if you put in the effort 
BUT
She gives random assignments throughout the week but everything is by word of mouth
She doesn't post about them or put them on bright space period. If she told you during class you better hope you wrote it down somewhere.

Ms. Wilder is a nice lady but for a 111 course you simply need for credit she is rough.  Tons of homework.  Also isn't very clear what is HW and what isn't due to brightspace being very disorganized.  Literally take any other language and if none are available wait until one is.  Don't take this class, save yourself.

She is a very tough grader especially on tests. If you participate and know Italian she will like you, if you don't know what your'e doing your'e going to have a really hard time. She rushes through class, has very little note taking opportunities, and overall hard to get a good grasp on the language. But she's a cute old lady with good intentions.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS', 'TEST HEAVY']
comment: I had a lot going on when I took this class and he worked with me every step of the way. If you're clearly making an effort to learn and do the work he will help you in every way he can. Show up every day. Attendance is taken randomly and gets you extra credit. This was a lot of material that he explains very well and can always answer questions.

I am grateful that I was able to take a&p II with Doctor Murphy. This was a summer course and although it was intense, I never felt too overwhelmed. His exams closely followed his lecture slides (I only used the book for lab) and were garded/posted immediately. Hes young and fairly laid back. Take him if you can. One of the best in the department!
he gives you the direction to receive a good grade. He gives you multiple opportunities for points as well. Great instructor overall

He is a funny guy, and tries to make the class fun. If you don't put in the work you wont pass. Its easy to get a good grade in this class if you show up and do the work. As long as you give him attention and respect he will give it back to you.

This is a very difficult class if you don't attend or really work at it. The homeworks are very helpful for studying for tests. Dr. Murphy was a really good lecturer, but has little respect for people who don't take the class seriously. Says he is a tough grader but he offers a lot of extra credit opportunities which help boost grades.
He reaches a grad level sport marketing class, but doesnt even work in the industry. He brought in guest speakers that had nothing to do with sport marketing as well. Not a good time.
Excellent teacher. Works individually if you ask. Tests were pretty easy and he's very helpful. A must have teacher before you graduate!
find someone else
avoid at all cost
Great teacher and role model!  Dan Raimondo is easily the greatest teacher I have ever had.  Awesome guy.
My favorite teacher ever Mr. Raimondo is awesome

Pr. Meeuf is one of the best professors I've ever had! He's a great teacher and he's hilarious. He genuinely cares about his students. However, he's leaving after this semester so no one else will have him.

Dr. Heavey knows her stuff. Shes an amazing professor. Do the work and youll understand Stastics by the end of the semester. Lectures are great, the text book is great. Clear and concise. Lots of work and worth it.
She is very organized .  Expects a lot from her students but supplies you with the knowledge to be prepared and do well in her class..
Took Epi and Stats. She is very thorough and very nice.  One of the best instructors at Brockport.
Interesting, lots of good application activities, understands adult learners, would take ANY class she teaches in a heart beat!

She's a sweet professor. Gets VERY behind on grading. Quizzes from beginning of semester still not graded and we are going into May now. Quiz every week. The material is HARD , so your best effort will need to be put in. Lab is also a lot of work.

Lecture wont make sense if you just attend and take notes. You need to put in time outside of class or you absolutely will not pass. Don't expect to get anything back graded on time. From mid-semester break until the end of the semester she did not upload ANY grades, and tests took a long time to get back graded.

Great professor. Explains topics and answers questions VERY clearly. Very approachable. Funny in class. TERRIBLY disorganized. Late to every lecture and she doesn't update blackboard fast enough. But her lectures are interesting and definitely easy to retain information the way she teaches.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS', 'LECTURE HEAVY']
comment: Smith is a very nice and caring person. The class material is not easy but it is manageable if you study and pay attention. She knows how to explain things well and answers questions when asked. Only bad thing would be that she is unorganized and took very long time to grade things and hand them back to us.

Professor Smith is always super kind and very helpful. It was difficult material, but she explained it very well and boosted my confidence in learning chemistry. I'm not sure where the negative reviews are coming from; the tests and quizzes where fair and she was always available to meet.

Very nice person & great Lab Prof. Doesn't teach well during lectures, and has given class the wrong info on multiple occasions. Short quizzes and tests impact grade a lot. MUST buy the homework access, but the text isn't needed.
Few tests. Can't teach, can't answer questions, can't stay organized. Not a good professor. Homework is extremely difficult.

She's extremely disorganized, odds are if you set up an appointment with her she won't show, and will NOT respond to your emails for at least a week. The class is based off of a few tests and quizzes (we didn't even get to take all the quizzes we were supposed to) and her online homework is unreasonably difficult. She is very nice, but a bad prof.

Dr. Smith is very unorganized. She fails to respond to many emails from and takes weeks to respond to ones that she does. She does not answer questions when people ask in class. The lecture grades are mostly based on four tests and a few quizzes which are short so getting one question wrong can ruin you. If possible avoid her class.

The class in challenging and the exams are extremely short so if you get one or two questions wrong your grade will suffer by a lot. Her teaching stile is not too bad and she does give online homework and quizzes per chapter, and clicker questions in class.
Dr. Smith is the best chemistry professor I've had. She explains things clear and simply. She really cares if students do well and is so easy to talk to. Never makes you feel dumb.

Prof. Smith is a good teacher. The content was not hard to understand and as long as you stay on top of your work you'll be fine. You also do not need the textbook. Fair warning, she is a bit unorganized so do not expect quick feedback. There are four exams, a few quizzes (none of which are hard), and homework.

Super disorganized. Didn't put a single grade on blackboard so it was super hard to track your grade.  Her quizzes and tests are really short so if you miss more than 2 questions you're screwed. Her lectures are fast and non descriptive, her homeworks are on sapling and are all unreasonably hard.
Her tests are very short and tough. If you go for her to help she will give you the help you need and the feedback you need.
She is an awesome Professor and I would highly suggest her to anyone that needs to take a chem.
Grades are still not up. Her final was the Monday of finals week and after a week and 3 days grades are still not up. She is ridiculously unorganized and inconsiderate when it comes to our grades.

Dr. Smith is that Professor thats there for you, if you make use of her office hours and talk to her after lab she'll help you indefinintly. shes a young professor and can relate to you nd your problems. shes funny and just overall really nice.

As an exchange student Is not My easy to America , but Jessica has helped me much . This class is very hard , but you will reap the rewards of Learning this difficult material . Jessica is a great teacher and really Caring students of . I have never seen a greater invested by the teacher in her pupils . It is truly inspiring .

Dr. Smith is a nice person but not the best professor. At times you will leave the class feeling like you understand the material but then get to the homework and be completely confused. The examples used in class are a level 1 in difficulty while the exams are level 10. Also you never know where you stand in the class, she gives nothing back.

Dr. Smith is a wonderful professor. I came into this course thinking that I would hate it, but she makes it enjoyable to learn. It's not an easy course, but you learn so much! My only issue is that grades are not updated very often. Other than that, I have no complaints!

Dr. Smith is by far one of the best professors I've ever had. She makes Organic Chemistry relatable, while still challenging. She's always there if you need her. This course was extremely challenging regardless, but thank God Dr. Smith was hired. Be prepared though, tests are hard, but you do get a clear study guide of what is on them.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read']
comment: Professor Turkkan was overall a super nice person, but she gives a lot of unnecessary homework, discussion posts, and super long reading assignments that are graded so you have to do. She gives good feedback and the class wasn't hard, just the amount of useless and tedious assignments were annoying.

She do not have give me any feedback for homework. You need to read and write everyday. More work than online course. She will ask you what the best course is. However, she will not accept that. If you give her advices, she will advice you to drop the course. If you want to learn something, please do not choose her.

If you are looking for a professor that is going to make you feel good about being up until 3 in the morning reading a theoretical piece, she's the one. She's a very nice professor who knows her stuff and likes to ramble on about personal experience. She gives awesome feedback on writing assignments!
The best person I have ever encountered in my life.  I got a B in the course because of my own fault. I won't blame her at all. Highly Recommended !!!
The best professor one can ever have.  You rather be lucky if she's your professor.

Turkkan is a professor who needs to remember that the students she teaches do not have the same knowledge that she does. Often, she wanted me to see the same themes and metaphors in our novels that she did. If I did not, she seemed confused and disappointed. "How could you not see this?" I felt like her class was way above my comprehension level.

Dr. Turkkan is a true gem. She most certainly knows her stuff! Very hard working, intelligent, and inspirational. Many students do not give her the credit she deserves. She holds her students to very high standards, but it is SO worth it in the end. Dedicate yourself, bare through the work, and you'll see what I mean. She taught me to have a voice.

She is an incredibly tough grader.  Especially for a 100 level class.  I get the sense that she doesn't seem to care very much about her students as people outside her classroom.  I would absolutely never take a class with her again.

She is amazing! Had her for eng 220 early world literature. Her lectures were easy to follow and has group work. Read the passages and participate and you'll be fine. Her papers are easy and she will give you feedback on those. Very helpful and adorable. Always smiles and makes the class refreshing.

One of the hardest teachers I have ever had but it's totally worth it.  I have learned more in this class than any of my others.  She's tough but you won't regret it, but be ready for a really heavy work load

She is a hard grader when it comes to papers.  You read about a book a week or a book in 2 days depends on her mood.  She expects you to do a lot of work besides reading and while reading and doing assignments she will give you a paper that is due like a week later.  She is confusing at times, and makes you feel stupid.  Didn't like it.

Sevinc Turkkan  represents everything I hate about school.  She does not care about you as a person.  Her entire life is devoted to reading and writing and she has no patience for someone who's not like that.  If you're life's passion is reading and writing this class should be fine for you.  If not, this class will make you hate college

I absolutely loved her class!! I went it thinking it was going to be a long semester and left her class feeling sad it was over. One of the best professors at Brockport. She has high standards although, she is an easy grader. A very passionate woman, really knows her stuff.

Sevinc is my favorite Lit professor! She's awesome. I was surprised that I loved the novels she picked. Great variety and the class was interesting. Really read. Watched 3 of the movies, too! Two essays combined are 50% of grade, but if you follow the assignment and are specific, you should do well. I don't think she's a hard grader. Recommended!

SHe is very hard to understand. she gets off topic sometimes and i cant focus in the class at all. rarely any written homework and only 2 major papers. as long as you do the readings you can easily get an A
great!
The best looking professor in Brockport handsdown.  As far as the class, she's very passionate about the material which makes it easier to understand.  Great course!

One of the best professors in the dept! Her class is so refreshing and is more like a friendly conversation than a class. Some people thought she was really strict or condescending...not at all. She just expects college students to be able to read directions and post an essay on ANGEL without having issues. If you're mature, you'll love her

Sevinc is by far my favorite teacher thus far, she is fantastic and i would easily recommend her to anyone. She grades very nicely and as long as you hand in a rough draft for essays, she will give you clear corrective notes, fix what needs to be fixed and you will get a perfect grade :) I hope to have her again. She is a lot of fun and hilarious!
can't really understand what she is saying, directions are not clear. make sure you stay on her good side!

Pretty good teacher and pretty interesting lectures, she's clearly pretty passionate about her course. I'd be a little bit weary to take the class again, because although the midterm and final are MCQ and matching, they can be kind of difficult. Weekly quizzes are easy (and online).

Tober for online sociology was awesome! Learned a lot and didnt have an overwhleming amount of tests. She is clearly passionate about her work and subject matter is very interesting. Truly cares about her students.

I loved Tober. Although the class wasn't easy, she made it way easier/bearable for me. I enjoyed her lectures and her snarky sense of humor. She's not afraid to call someone out and she's very blunt. She can seem very intimidating but she's very accessible to her students and helpful if you need it. Hard class but she makes it better!!

I really enjoyed tober's class, even though there was a lot of homework "journal" assignments she was a very fair grader and really cares about her student's. She is also hilarious which makes class fun.. the class is not easy at all but she makes it a bit easier to understand.

Dr. Tober was one of my favorite professors I've had at Brockport. She makes her lectures intriguing and fully keeps the students' attention. No tests, just weekly quizzes that are not bad if you do the reading. Very valuable information as well.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Hilarious', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS']
comment: I thought Dr. Tober was great I think she is very clear on expectations. Not only that but her lectures are easy and she's funny. Grading was totally reasonable, if anything she gave better grades then deserved. Would take a class with her any day! She does have a lot of readings, but they are interesting and she doesn't grill you on them.
Love this woman, seriously great professor.

Tara Tober is a highly respected professor. She is very passionate about what she teaches and makes learning interesting. I took SOC 100 this semester as a freshman and because she's made me so interested in sociology I will be taking her SOC 306 class next semester. If you read the chapters you'll do well. Quizes are ok & she post the slides!!
Amazing professor. She makes class for most of the time and the topics are always interesting. We don't have a lot of homework, but we have online quizzes every week which are fairly easy.

I would take any class by Dr. Tober. By far my favorite in Brockports Socioloy department. Do your work, study, and you'll do fine. Her assignments are clear cut and doable. She is extremely intelligent and passionate about what she does. Always willing to help. A+ rating for Tara.
I really enjoyed Tara's class. I learned a lot from her. She is very passionate about what she teaches which helps a lot.

Do not take Professor Tober. Save your self the heartache. Shes very boring and just always seems mad. She is by far the worst professor I have had at Brockport and would rather take Ford over her any day! She seems to not care about her students and is always talking about how things aren't her problem. Her is  some advice stop complaining Tober
Dr Tober was one of the best professor I had
Tara is so straight forward. She's realistic and clear. Lectures can sometimes be boring depending on your interest in the topic but she's very passionate about what she teaches.

She makes the material seem interesting, and she's good at explaining topics. Yes, there were weekly tests but you get credit just for doing them, even if you fail. The only problem was the groups. You work with them way too much for things that would be better off doing alone. Lectures are interesting and projects are relatively easy.
Grades way too hard for a 100 level class. Weekly homework is reading a chapter in the book and taking an online quiz. She's funny and nice.

Very moody. When she's in a bad mood, its evident.  Makes the class way to difficult for a 100 lever course.  Group works are hard, and the midterm and final are impossible.  Reading quizzes every week and you HAVE to do the reading in order to pass.
Easy class, but long lectures and attendance is based on group work which happens on either of the days you have class so must go everytime.

Best teacher I ever had in college. She knows her stuff and is passionate about the material she teaches. She's young so she is able to make a better connection with students and help them understand the relevance of the material on their own lives. I would take any class she is teaching again. You will not regret it!
Group assignments and reading quizzes are tough.  Easy papers, midterm, and final.  Awesome professor.

take advantage of the extra help she offers if you don't understand a concept covered in class. She will help you when you need it the most. That being said, respect her as a Dr. (she knows what she's talking about) and don't disrespect individual student'sprofessor's opinions by challenging them with the intent to cause a negative driven debate.

Love her. Makes sociology seem really easy and always brings up current events. Only a couple tests and most are online quizzes which you get a 50% for just taking. Very nice and funny, and makes everything interesting. Really great teacher!

This was the first Soc class I've ever taken, and as a Freshman in a level 300 class is was not difficult.  She is very understanding and personable, definitely puts an effort into her lecture and very helpful.  The only tests are the midterm and the non-cumulative final, midterm was 18 short answer questions but she awards ALOT of partial credit.
Great Teacher, class was fun!
Great academic advisor! Very helpful!
very fun and extremely knowledgable
Such a nice teacher - very understanding, and really helps you become a better teacher yourself
COACH CARRON ROCKS!!!!!!
Amazing teacher. Wonderful. Always puts the students first!
Coach Carron was an awesome teacher.  Had her for Women in Sport and Adv. Racquetball, she was great.  I always looked forward to going to class, and her material was always well presented.  TAKE!!

Loved her class, looked foward to going to it. Gives answers to tests and gets paper and projects over with in the beginning of the semester. Never was bored, her class is fun and she has a great sense of humor. Definatly take her clas!!
Kickass teacher, so easy on grading

First off, He is an awesome guy and even better teacher. I learned a lot from his class. A few papers to write and some simple quiz's and it's all really manageable. I would take his class again in a heartbeat. Easy grader, you just have to do the work he assigns.

Joe is the best professor! Very helpful to anyone who has questions and is easy to understand in class.  Easy A as long as you try and he's not hard grader.  Great guy I recommend him to anyone/everyone.
He's a great teacher, very helpful and understanding. I recommend him to anyone!

Dr. Cruz is an amazing person! Her passion for teaching, deep knowledge of the subject, and genuine care for students made this class one of the best I've ever taken. She created a supportive and engaging learning environment where everyone felt heard and encouraged to grow. I'm so grateful to have learned from her!

Just got to know those powerpoints front to back

Great professor! In IT TOOLS you will use the textbook every class and need to be a self-learner, but Kad is always willing to help. He personally goes over with each student their tests and explains where they messed up or lost points, very helpful!

Good professor, however pretty boring. He explains stuff well and makes sure you understand before moving on. Only an assignment every couple of weeks, a couple quizzes and 4 tests. Don't bother buying the book, just go to class and your notes will be all you need. Overall not a bad class.

A really good teacher. His accent is not that bad at all and never affected my ability to understand him. He is an AMAZING teacher! I love him. He's so cute. Definitely take him. He will basically give you the answers if you make the effort to come visit him in office hours. Great guy! He only gave us 1 assignment for every 2 or 3 weeks. I encourage anyone to take his class!
