This class was a step above CIS106. It was easy enough to get through this person's lectures on one day and having lab time the next class. I enjoyed class with him and I would take another class with him.
excellent teacher.
hard to understand. once you get his speaking its ok but he is very biased towards certain people and doesnt care about students much. not a very good teacher.
He was definatly an awesome teacher.  He helped me learn a lot.

very well educated professor that was obviouly hired based on his degrees and not his ability to teach. His tests are definatly to long for the alotted time and also have questions that are rediculously hard compared to the examples that are given in class.
he sucks man he need to leave bp so new blood can come in

Great advisor, he really cares about the courses I'm doing and how I'm progressing. I've never been in a class with him, though, thank goodness as I've heard lots of things about him when he teaches. He thinks I should do more challenging courses as well.

Good professor, good advisor

She knows what she is talking about. She makes the class fun because she interacts with the students. If you are confused you can go to her for help and she will help you and make sure you understand. Teacher is very nice but doesn't seem to know what she's talking about all the time. Class is all powerpoints and extremely boring and unhelpful. I taught myself the entire course. Don't recommend her

This class was way too hard for an intro to accounting class. You basically have to teach it to yourself because she expects everyone to know everything already somehow. The class is laidback which is nice but she doesn't explain the notes and she flies through the powerpoint that she didn't even make. Rough if you have no accounting background.

comment: This is a relatively straight forward "statistics" class geared toward ESC majors. Usually HW every class, but takes at most 30 mins to complete. Notes are all online. Prof. Little is very helpful via email & office hours. Tests are a little long, but not difficult. Having a solid Excel & MINITAB background is very helpful.

Professor Little was very attentive to this online class and overall it was an easy A. It seems like a lot to do at first but once you get into a routine with it, it really isn't. I spent about an hour, sometimes two, on this class per week.
This 4 credit class was super easy! Dr. Little is an awesome professor and I definitely recommend taking this class with him.

He's a great guy but in his advanced softball class (not pep 351) he was handing out pretty low scores for “skill evaluation”. Like cut some of us a break we aren't mlb players were hustling, trying and having fun together. A lot of the people I talked to were pretty good for never playing the sport ever.
Great guy, okay professor. Easy class to pass if you pay attention. Even if you don't pay attention, you should get by fine. Can be veryyy boring and other times can be interesting and funny.
Nice guy, all of the assignments are 1-2 page papers about coaching methods and such, not too difficult. Class, HW and tests are straightforward.

Dense class but you will learn. Lectures are a lot so come in on time and be ready to take good notes. If you just take good notes and pay good attention, you can do good and he'll respect you. If you have questions, and know what u need help with, he'll move mountains to help you, but if you don't know what u need… good luck, figure it out.

Exams are mostly fill in the blank with nothing but your memory to go off of. There's a TON of information to learn and its a challenge to regurgitate it the way he wants you to, but... its a good class, with good information and I like him as a teacher, I think he just expects a lot.

It was actually ENV 466, but that wasnt an option here. Dont take this class unless required, he makes a 3 credit class way too hard. He is incredibly fickle on assignments, terrible feedback (suppossing you can even read his handwriting), and overall just not a class I looked forward to going to.

comment: So. Much. Material. Very tough grader. If you take his class prepare to dedicate your whole life to it. You have to study HARD. You will fail if you miss lecture. Labs were great and educational. Learned a lot but tough class. Does offer extra credit.

His class is HEAVY in material. Lectures are about 120 slides each. I appreciate that he makes his own slides, adds youtube songs to lectures, and makes jokes in class. He expects you to keep up with material and WILL pick on you in class to answers Qs. Gets sassy when you do not know the answer/move slow. Stay ahead of the game and you'll survive

The book will be become your best friend. I liked his lectures, learned a lot. Labs were awful though. My best advice is to ignore his little tantrums and take your time. It is his temper and attitude that make his class kind of miserable. Study the questions and pictures from the book.

comment: As a Freshman, I took Bio of Organisms with Rinchard and got a C. As a Senior, I took Fish Biology with him and got a B+. His classes are incredibly challenging and will consume all of your time. However, you leave the semester with a tremendous amount of knowledge. I'm grateful he cut me no slack and pushed me to succeed. Study, study, study!

Dr. Rinchard is a good professor, he will test your dedication to college and act as a "gate keeper" to who gets through and who doesn't as an Environmental Science major. Study very hard for his class because he covers a lot and many different areas. One day lecture will be on primate evolution the next about laboratory procedure. A lot of tests.

Hands down my favorite teacher I've ever had. Yes, he is a hard grader but if you take the time to study you will do fine. He is always available after class and clearly answers any questions you have. If you put in the effort you will get the grade you want.

This was the hardest teacher I have ever taken a class with. I took his class as an elective and it was awful. He gives an immense amount of work for a 200 level class. I went to him for extra help and he was never willing to tell me more than he did in class. He has an accent which some people have a hard time understanding but it was fine for me.
If you're not an ENV major, don't make my mistake and take this class as an elective. Rinchard is actually very nice but the class is tough.

He is an expert in his field. Extremely smart and clearly cares about the performance of his students. He is a very tough grader, expects a lot out of his students and strives for excellence. He can be funny and upbeat in class but if you get on his bad side he can be short tempered.

Dr. Rinchard is the man.  His expectations are high, as they should be in the sciences.  If you demonstrate sufficient evidence of effort, he is very helpful, insightful, and caring.  Demonstrate sloth and beware!  He has a wicked wit and puts lazy students in their rightful place!

His comic attitude and thick accent make the class entertaining to a biology enthusiast. A very harsh grader! Will take off points for the most ridiculous things such as improper capitalization. Certain questions are absurd; "Bromelain is a protease enzyme found in..." With the answer being "Pineapples." Nowhere in the notes will you find that.

Professor Rinchard is from Belgium and his heavy french accent is sometimes hard to understand. He is very upbeat and willing to answer questions posed by students, but he sometimes cannot understand the questions you are asking. He expects a lot to be memorized and study HARD for tests. Always helpful with homework questions too.

Nice guy but doesn't really teach, just does everything on the board and expects you to get it. He answers questions but gets so into the proofy notation stuff that it makes the class way more difficult than it needs to be.

Professor Yin is a great professor! His lectures are structured and very easy to follow with in class examples. However, financial math is a very hard class so you should be prepared to study each week to keep up with the material. Weekly quizzes, 2 exams, 1 final.

The worst professor I have taken a class with. He rarely faces the class as he keeps writing on the board while explaining you will find it very hard to follow. He doesn't explain clearly and assumes you understands some concepts that were taught in other classes and won't take the time to review them. AVIOD HIM IF YOU WANT TO PASS.

comment: Would not recommend! If you have the chance to take which ever class with any other math professor, I would recommend going that route. Really difficult tests, easy quizzes, however the test questions aren't even totally related to what you study.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK', 'LECTURE HEAVY']
comment: Lectures are bland and not fun at all, quizzes are weekly and tough but if you have a lenient grader then you may do well on them. Tests can be tough but they consist of questions from homework or notes, and finally the final is insane, you will fail, but he curves it thank god.

comment: Dr. Yin is an excellent teacher. His lectures are very procedural and repetitive (read: easy to follow). Easily one of the best professors in the department.
He is really good . weekly quizzes are exactly from class notes and book examples. He is very helpful office hours. He give homework every week. His exam are fair. I really liked him.

He is  a really good professor. if you study his notes you will definitely get a good grade. The weekly quizzes pretty easy ,its straight from class notes and book examples . He is very helpful office hours . overall good professor.

I really like Dr. Yin as a professor. The only reason the class is hard is because of the material, not him. The homework is usually harder than the tests are, and he gives examples straight from class and from the textbook on the exams. The weekly quizzes are pretty difficult, but again straight from the textbook/notes. Overall a good professor.

Easy class. Weekly quizzes are examples from notes and the textbooks exactly. Tests are the same but with homework problems too. Easy to get an A. Attendance is mandatory. The final is ridiculously hard. Don't even bother studying. You will fail the final but it doesn't matter.

Extremely nice guy. I think people get thrown off by his accent a bit, but he is very concerned with students learning. Very helpful in office hours. quizzes are based off classwork, tests are a mixture of class, HW, and book problems. Be prepared to put in a fair amount of time, but none of the material is insanely difficult.

Useless as a teacher. Cannot understand a word he says.  He is beyond unapproachable because any time you ask him a question, all he does is tell you exactly what was confusing you in the first place. After the first week of class, it went from 30+ students down to 12 and out of those remaining, only about half even passed the class.

Rushes through notes from beginning to end of class. If you ask him a question on the homework, he will not tell you if your answer is correct even if you have shown all of the work.  Quiz and test questions are usually examples from notes and book, tend to be proofs.  Notes do not help with homework and homework does not correlate with tests.

Dr. Yin is a great professor and an overall genuine man. If you do poorly in his class, it is because you do not put in enough effort. No doubt, the exams are difficult - but that is part of the fun challenge with math classes. Expectations are clear and he is available often for help. Cares about student success.

I;m not going to lie, this class is a lot of work. As long as you take advantage of the office hours and put in the effort you'll be fine. Not the worst class that I've ever take. All around a nice guy too. Very helpful and organized.

He writes notes from the beginning to end of class. When a question is asked he simply re-writes what he has already written. Gives out at least 20 to 30 questions for homework but his grader randomly chooses 10 to grade. The notes given are very unhelpful with homework. class test average: 69  Class final average:43 Be prepared to go to the tutor.
you cannot understand this guy. he hinks you have all the time in the world. if you ask a question he goes around in a circle and doesnt even answer it. interesting cass just not with him!!
Knows what he is talking about, but very difficult to understand. Mostly a language barrier issue.

You can tell that he loves the subject, but the language barrier gets in the way a lot. He doesn't understand your question, so he won't answer it correctly. He's slowly getting better, but not by much. He's still a ridiculously hard teacher.

Accent is difficult to understand at first but it's not impossible. Lots of HW and short quizzes every Monday based on HW. Is obviously interested in the material he's teaching. Always asks if there are any questions as he writes notes on board.
quizzes every monday when homework is due. hard to understand

Dr. Zhou is a great lady, however very hard to understand. Class used Mindtap (cengage) for hw, & quizzes + tests were online & VERY difficult. Tests not like hw. Provided powerpoint notes but not helpful in completing hw. Attendance not mandatory so I stopped going & found it easier to teach myself the material. Hard class, wouldn't recommend.

Professor Zhou provides a lot of opportunities to get extra credit. Before the final I distributed my extra credit to every assignment and I still had 30 points to add to my final. If you pay attention and do your work, this class should be a breeze. She is really nice, but her accent is heavy so you have to pay attention.

This was not an easy course for me. But it was very good, I learned a lot and the professor was excellent. She certainly knew and loved what she was talking about. Her enthusiam made you wanna be as skilled as she appeared to be. She was always accessable, smiling, and willing to talk about your school and professional career.

Professor Zhou is an awesome professor. Attendance is optional and she will occasionally give extra credit to students who come to class. All hw, tests, quizzes, and project are online, and you have to buy the textbook on Pearson. She makes an effort to help students understand and you can easily get a good grade if you put in a little effort.
She is hard to understand but you can learn most of the material on your own when doing the homework. Extremely nice lady and will do her best to help you learn.

Professor Zhou is extremely nice and there to help you in every step. I truly learned a lot in the class and she were always available for help if I needed it. Slight language barrier, but did gave lots of examples with clear logical explanations in class. I would definitely take her course again!

Has a VERY heavy accent and talks extremely quickly. Quiz/Exam days there was no class bc its online. Will curve a TON. Bonus pts for attendance participation cut project work. I passed with an A by studying 5 hours a week but you can pass with min amt of work due to how much she curves I guess. Wouldn't recommend unless if there's no other choice
Very rude, mean.... AVOID AT ALL COSTS

comment: Dr. C is a pretty good teacher if you like to be actively engaged. There is a good size Midterm and Final Paper, but if you're one who can stay organized and ask questions, you'll be fine. Don't be too discouraged if she gives harsh feedback, she does it to everyone.

Probably the worst part about this class is that she does a lot of powerpoint lecture and there's no real connection between the book, the lecture, and how you get graded on the paper. The paper it's not clear how you are supposed to write it and then you think you're okay but she gives you a low grade with no feedback. Lectures are boring.

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Tough grader']
comment: I really love her as a professor. She is extremely knowledgeable on social justice issues and social work in general. I always leave class feeling like I've learned many new things. There is a lot of reading, but it really does help on the tests.

Dr.C is amazing and very knowledgeable about what she does and teaches. I highly recommend choosing her as a professor if you want someone who has real world examples on top of a fun yet educational class.

IF YOU TAKE THE CHAPTER QUIZZES AND STUDY THEM YOU WILL PASS THE TEST! Dr. C has an awesome personality and is very fair. Be on time and do not miss a class unless you have a note. 10/10 would take her as a prof again. She is a woman to look up to.

Dr. C is fair, challenging, and funny. If you don't like to read, you will struggle. Don't wait until the last minute to read or study. I needed to be fully engaged with the materiel to earn my grade.

Dr. C is the best professor I have had at Brockport. She is an excellent model of social work ethics and really cares about the material that she is presenting. She does make you work for the grade, but she is always available during office hours for assistance. I cannot wait to take more classes with her!

Dr C is an asset to the profession and to the college at Brockport.  She challenges students to exceed their individual level and offers support and assistance every step of the way.  She models social work ethics, if your looking for easy, go  find another professor.  It your looking for competence in the field this is the professor you want.

Very rude, refuses to help students with questions about the assignment. You don't know if your going to pass the class or not, how she grades you isn't clear. All she does is stand and talk at you the whole time.

Dr. C does her best to make sure her students are learning the material. She sticks to the rubrics when it comes to papers. She informs her students of worldly issues and is an exemplary social worker.
Dr. C was so helping in the adjustment into college. I can not wait to have her a social work prof. In the upcoming years!
Dr. Moe was very disorganized and the class was confusing.
If this class wasn't required I wouldn't have taken it. Moe is all over the place. The class was always lost and we were way behind. His assignments were confusing and his lectures made no sense.

Dr. Moe is an incredible professor. His class is a nice mix of lecture and interactive learning. I took his Theories of Mass Comm class, and he'd relate the topics to current issues/topics to keep us engaged. The workload is manageable, and he really cares about his students. He even stayed 30 min. after class to help me register for fall classes.

This class has a lot of easy assignments & Dr. Moe is an easy grader. I am taking the class online & the class does not receive much attention. I haven't received an updated grade since midterms which makes it difficult to determine final grade. Drop boxes for submitting work are not available until the last minute, same with assignment directions.
This class was horrible. We were required to read PowerPoint slides before class and then he would just read the slides in class. I learned nothing. It's an easy A, but it's painful.

This class was awful. Doctor Moe completely bailed out of the class and failed to provide any information. Assignments were confusing and deadlines were missing. This class was a waste of time and money.

HON380. Dr. Moe is a very patient and understanding professor! He wants us to learn and participate but doesn't force us. He shares interesting and funny stories that aren't offensive, he listens when we talk. We didn't do any meaningless work, and I feel like I learned so much! Dr. Moe is kind, respectful, and hilarious. I loved the class!

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Clear grading criteria', 'Accessible outside class']
comment: I took JRB 467: Theories of mass communication with Dr. Moe but I couldn't select it from the list. Makes me wonder why. Anyhow, perhaps the most remarkable thing about Dr. Moe is that he goes beyond the traditional bounds of teaching and provides inspiration for life and he made me realize things about myself and the world as it applies to media.

I have read some previous reviews which may have misunderstood his teaching style, but I found him to be an exceptional teacher who truly cares about his students. He is incredibly smart, and I found myself learning things about the world that I never would have imagined.

I recently took HON 380: Disinformation with Dr. Moe, and I have to say that it was an incredibly enlightening and fulfilling experience. Unfortunately, I was unable to select the course on the RateMyProfessor website, which is a shame because Dr. Moe truly deserves recognition for his outstanding work.

tags: ['Clear grading criteria', 'So many papers', 'Graded by few things']
comment: I feel like the online class is forgotten about... Sometimes I forget about it because we hardly hear from him. He doesn't answer emails, he doesn't update grades. At least the class is easy and he's a pretty easy grader. I don't think he's terrible, just with he was more engaged with the online class.

There are some very harsh reviews here and I don't think he deserves them. One mentioned the syllabus was outdated, which does seem to be true. But he is a very easy professor and the workload is very manageable. I will say it does sort of seem like he forgets about this online course, as grades are not kept up on, but he still reaches out.

I love Dr. Moe. He is one of the most understanding and compassionate professors I've ever had. If you do your work you will be successful. A lot of students think that they should be successful just based on his lectures and do not do any work out of class, but then blame that on Moe. He is a really great prof

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'So many papers']
comment: Professor Moe was all over the place this semester. The class was not organized at all. Syllabus was outdated so none of the dates were accurate. Then all of a sudden you would have a paper in two days, but it was never assigned. He is so hard to reach outside of class, but his assignments are pretty easy. Class content is interesting. Bad prof.

I'm taking this class online, and it really feels like he forgets us half the time. Weeks pass without any input from him - no grades, no updates, no nothing. I'm actually doing this rating right now instead of taking an exam in his class like I sat down to do, because he said it would be opening two hours ago, and he STILL hasn't unlocked it.

tags: ['Participation matters', 'Graded by few things', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: Professor Moe is a very good professor. He's also very understanding so he will excuse you, if you have other important in school things to attend to. There's not too many assigments for the year, but when there is, he's a pretty easy grader. There's only two tests, the mid term and final exam. Study the material he provides and you'll be fine.
Dr. Moe is a funny guy and makes his classes and discussions interesting. His tests can be a bit hard. Not a lot of graded assignments. Big group project for grade at end of course.

Professor Lewis is the type of teacher I hope to be in the future, the kind to be truthful at all times, the kind to work with you in the classroom and outside of it. Honestly an inspiration, I enjoyed class a lot. This class felt more personal than others, because of Professor Lewis but also the subject and the way it was taught. 10/10 recommend.

I took two classes with Meredith, and I understand that her teaching style might not be what works for everyone, but it worked well for me. Lots of energy, really made the class feel the weight of importance that it has. Extremely friendly, willing to help if you ask for help with specific sections, and pushes you to dig deeper for the answers.

LAZY! An online class with her consists of many readings, doing assignments based upon them, and completing a culminating assignment you're given zero direction on. Your assignments will sit ungraded for the whole semester and never be looked over. Final grades were always late, too. She puts no effort into anything and obviously does not care.

Absolutely useless. Does not provide timely responses to students, check in during the semester, or give feedback on assignments. Professors should be doing all of those in online courses. Her final grades were always late and she submitted them without grading specific assignments. You don't learn much because she makes no effort to teach you.

You do a lot of busywork, including Google Classroom assignments. The assignments aren't difficult, but you don't learn much. The lesson plans are mostly done on your own with input from other students, rather than the professor. The class is very involved with politics but not much actual history is covered.
Daisuke is a chill and funny professor that keeps students engaged. If you show up to class, you will have no problem getting an A.

tags: ['Tough grader', 'Get ready to read', 'Lots of homework']
comment: Good course , it's required for the geology major. I learned quite a bit but the professor is very harsh at times and your grade in the course will entirely depend on how often you can come into office hours alone since noone in the classroom apart from him will understand what to do on the homework. If you're a commuter goodluck.

4 exams, attendance + labs make up the grades. Classtime is exclusively lectures. Uses Top Hat (a paid service) for exams and attendance. Lectures are kinda boring and I found it hard to retain information. Gives questions for exams to study. Not a bad class, but not recommended if not interested in science. Friendly and kind professor overall

Super easy class. Grading consists of attendance and quizzes. Every class is a lecture that he just reads off of. He gives you the possible quiz questions a week before the quiz, so you know most of the answers before you start it. Sometimes it's hard to understand him, but the majority of the time his English was good.

Very annoying that I had to pay for an online service in order to participate in lectures in class, and he did not offer any alternatives. We also took all lecture exams on this service and it was really inconvenient at the beginning of the semester. Other than that, the class is easy enough if you show up and take notes.

He's a great guy & really tries to help you learn, for most concepts he has a visual aid or an analogy to help you understand like bringing in a lava lamp to explain hotspots. Uses tophat which you have to pay for but no textbook. Study guides are literally the test questions, easy labs and will help you if you need it. Good guy, good yellow crocs

tags: ['Graded by few things', 'Clear grading criteria', 'Lecture heavy']
comment: Class is pretty straight forward. Watch the lecture videos, take notes, take a 1 question quiz (which is a easy 100 with 2 try's as well). 4 exams, all with study guides that are EXACT questions that will be on the test. Take notes and use the online textbook and you will have every answer. Very clear on due dates, etc. Class is fun and an easy A.

I wish I had a better time in his class. not only did i struggle but the test questions were confusing and not in our area. there were several questions that we did NOT learn. he was so sweet honestly, just not a great teacher.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Lots of homework', 'Accessible outside class']
comment: Amazing guy. So dedicated to his students. Available almost 24/7. So funny. One of my favorite professors of all time.

One of the laziest professors I have ever had, and I have multiple degrees. Lectrures one thing but tests on material that is completely different. Expects you to teach yourself the lab material. When it comes time for your lab practical, more than half the students bomb it with a 65 or below.

Hes the best professor ever, hes really understanding, easy lectures only time class is mandatory is for group work, you have 3 chances with quiz, if you dont get an A in this class its probably cause you aint look at the slides he posted he always posts the slides! No excuses! Hes hilarious and trys his hardest to make class interesting and funny
Daisuke. Kobayashi. What a man. Would rate higher if I only could.
Great professor, and very laid back. Participation through TopHat is crucial, and there is extra credit through the final project. Quizzes were online and open book. Easy A if you apply yourself.

Casey is one of the easiest, laid-back Professors I have had. He uses TopHat, where you do not actually have to be in the classroom to get the participation points for the day if you do not want to go. Try to go once or twice a week and you'll be fine. Quizzes are not super easy. Study for those. He is super nice and cares about content!!
Great teacher

This is the second class ive taken from Casey, love this dude, so understanding, willing to work with you when you're having trouble, always responds to emails quickly 10/10 would recommend taking his classes
You cannot fail his class unless you're trying to, so understanding of personal situations and always willing to help students out

tags: ['Accessible outside class', 'Participation matters', 'Graded by few things']
comment: He's a great teacher, very easy class and it's quite interesting at least to me. I would highly recommend for easy credit.

Casey is the best professor I ever had at Brockport. He knows his stuff and is very passionate about it. I'll always appreciate what he has done for the students and I, especially when the program seemed to be dying. When my research project seemed to have met dead ends, he always went above and beyond to cater to my needs and give motivation!

Dr. Griffin is a great addition to Brockport meteorology and brings a new revitalization to the department, and has great experience with weather software, coding, and researching. The labs are very fun and useful, and teaches us coding, data collection and analyzing of weather data. It is good experience for real world applications.

Dr. Keating is a kind prof who cares about his students. However there is no engagement with the classes and he just lectures. There were two essays throughout the semester. Lots of extra credit op. YOU DO NOT NEED THE TEXTBOOK, he provides an online one. Easy A for sure just show up to class for the grade.

Prof Keating is a nice man, but his classes are the same lecture heavy slides every time. When I emailed him I did not get a response, and he is not very tech savvy either. Saying that, he does care about his job and loves anthropolgy, but I personally did not love the class.

prof keating is a pretty average professor, its clear hes very passionate about anthropology and i like his personality his class was just kind of boring. but the tests were all online and everything, only 2 papers

He talks a lot but he is really passionate so if you like the topic you will like the class. I don't recommend classes that are over 50 minutes though because it is very lecture heavy and can get boring as the semester goes on.
doesn't know how to use technology whatsoever

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Tough grader']
comment: Get ready to read long books :D I can barely understand what the author is saying most of the time

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read', 'Tough grader']
comment: I loved his class. He gave clear understandings about what we were going through and I found this class very interesting. You will need to keep up either through the text book or the slides.

He is an insanely chill guy. Cannot respond to an email to save his life, but in class, he is always ready to discuss and is never rude/mean. People complain he is biased in his opinions, but many of them never challenged him to see how he would respond. Pretty easy class, just some tests/quizzes and a couple papers that you always have time for.

Dr. Keating is a great Professor. This class challenges you to think about recent global human rights issues. It requires dense reading and writing, so be prepared for a couple 10 page exams and a 10+ page research paper. Lectures can be a bit boring, but attendance is mandatory. Part of the grade is participation - so show up.

tags: ['LECTURE HEAVY', 'SO MANY PAPERS', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS']
comment: Happens to share opinion frequently-clear political bias and the lectures are horribly boring. Monotone voice over disinteresting topics. Wouldnt take this class.

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LECTURE HEAVY']
comment: Hes a nice guy but he doesnt teach anything you cant learn on your own. He tells you to read a chapter then goes over the chapter in class and thats how every single class is. Tests are hard but grades essays lightly.

This is a great course if you're interested in the content that the professor is teaching. Professor Keating is really dedicated to his work which may cause him to discuss topics that differ from the readings he assigns but he always attempts to find a distinct connection between the two. Lots of dry readings but overall, interesting lectures.

For being the head of the department he is very unorganized and does not manage his time well. Be prepared to be kept in class five+ minutes after the class time is supposed to be over. He can make any topic that is interesting into a boring topic.

He means well but the class was terrible. Boring lectures and really hard tests. Long boring readings for very class, everyone in the class struggles hard.  I took for a humanities credit to bring up my GPA and it was the worst decision I have ever made. not recommended.

He's a miserable teacher.  He doesn't know how to teach. The course could have been great but rather he spent 90% of the time talking about current events and not give us any background on any of the movements or what human rights even are. I feel I went into the class with more knowledge then he had. I would avoid him at all costs.

Dr. Keating fails completely at guiding his student through his course. the class time is often spent speaking about current events or some contemporary matter, and the text he assigns is absolutely god awful, at least for his human rights course. No in class explanation of the reading, and over 200pg of reading are assigned for the final exam.
This theory class is very difficult and not very clear in objective or material. Extremely smart professor though.

Dr. Keating has a real passion for his material, and is very devoted to his work outside of the class as well. Brings his experiences to class, ample time for open discussion on the topics in class. Political ecology course has been great as it covers current issues. Relaxed, but very focused. Highly recommend to anyone serious abt his topics.

I would rather funnel a bottle of liquor then take this class again. He means so well but he just cant teach. Lectures are boring, tests are impossible unless you stay up all night studying because he doesn't give out the study guide in enough time. Just absolutely awful. Never again... NO

Dr. Keating seems to care deeply about his students and his courses. He makes a real effort to enhance the scholarship of his students, which is especially pronounced when you go to him for assistance. I have taken several classes with him and I've always appreciated that he respected my ideas and drive to explore questions in a creative manner.

He is  good looking, cool personality too and that makes the class really pleasant. Can't stress enough how important it is to read the assigned reading... If you're not planning to read the course material, you probably will score poorly in this class.

Pretty boring guy, fairly easy class. Gives 3 papers, only 2 main tests (midterm & final) and a good amount of extra credit. He posts his notes before some classes which includes the clicker questions so you could look up the answers in the book. Online quizzes were fairly easy. Walked out with a B+

The material covered is challenging, but nothing to worry about if you take smart notes when doing the readings before class. He offers opportunity for a healthy amount of discussion...An easy prof. to communicate with. I have always enjoyed his classes. A strong effort is required to do fairly well (A,B),but you will learn your stuff.
His class wasn't too bad. Offers extra credit, and is helpful if you email him. Online quizzes were kind of difficult even after reading the textbook. But, overall the class wasn't too horrible.

NEVER TAKE A CLASS WITH HIM. IF YOU ARE FORCED 2 YOU NEED TO BACK OUT NOW! YOU LEARN NOTHING AND HE TESTS ON THINGS YOU'VE NEVER TALKED ABOUT. EVEN THE MOST DEVOTED STUDENTS HATED HIS CLASS. YOU WILL LITERALLY WANT TO GET HIT BY A CAR BY THE END OF ONE OF HIS LECTURES.

His class is actually not all that difficult. It's a real class, wow...don't get too many of those. I often feel that undergrad classes are too easy. He's a good teacher, and he helped me out a lot when I went to office hours for research help. I  liked his personality. He's a cool guy, very real and intelligent.
Makes interesting topics worse then going to the dentist. I will never again take a class with this man
Good guy, knows his stuff. You just have to read the book before the class and you will understand his lectures. He actually challenges you to think for yourself. I learned a lot from his class.

This is the THIRD class I have taken with this man; 2 undergrad and this grad class.I've just failed the last two, based on the SAME subject matter. After three years, I still cannot keep up with him. He is a brilliant scholar and is knowledge unimpeachable. Granted, I have my academic difficulties. Unless you can devote 100% to the class, don't.
Do not take this class. It was far too difficult for a 100 level course and the research paper was awful. He didn't clarify a thing and gave very vague instructions. He is a hard grader too.
He gives lectures every class unless syllabus says group work. But even then it is basically all him talking based on chapter by chapter.  You have to read the chapter or your lost.

Hard Teacher. Avoid him if you want a good grade. He knows his stuff and is really mellow but he just can't teach at an undergrad level. He tries but he just can't teach. He's more for graduate students not undergrad. Avoid!

This class was something I took just to fill a humanities gen ed. and it turned out to be my most difficult.  The readings were boring the tests impossible and it is guaranteed to bring down your gpa.  Nice guy, but needs to seriously rethink the meaning of a 100 class
No Comments

Avoid this class at all costs. Research paper was horrible, he didn't clarify or explain anything. Tests on things he mentioned for a few seconds in class if any. Way too much work for a 100 level class.

He knows his stuff.  But by the end of the semester, he's still the only one who knows his stuff.  His reaching style is awful, bland powerpoints that dont help you at all.  The reading is dry and boring.  His test questions come right out of the book from random sentences.  You only have 2 exams and a research project for grades.  Unfair.

I loved this class with Dan. He truly cares about the well-being of his students. I took this class as a night class, and we were only there for about an hour and a half. He really wants his students to learn about their own mental health. Put in effort into the assignments and you get a good grade.

He is absolutely amazing. He always tries his best to help other students despite being busy all the time which I appreciate immensely. Easy class just show up for attendance and do all the required work for the class and you will get an A.

Dan is probably the best professor I've had. He is hilarious and understands that college is stressful. Always willing to help, helped me out with my other classes as well. Always emails back fast. Doesn't make you waste money on books. Actually cares about his students, goes the extra mile to help out. Definitely would recommend taking his class.

This is probably the best professor ive ever had, you cant fail unless you dont do the assignments or quizzes, but they arent difficult if you pay attention to him in class which isnr difficult because he makes class fun and hilarious! Need more teachers like him!

One of the nicest professors youll ever meet. Actually cares about what you have to say and is really knowledgeable about what he teaches. Super funny, always is making jokes about his bummy appearance. Attendence isnt really mandatory, but youll come to enjoy going to his class

Awesome Professor, you actually learn the important things of the field and not information that is unnecessary. He understands that you have more to life than being dragged down with tons of work that you won't even remember. I wish I could take all my classes with him!

Kandris is AWESOME!!! His class is sooooo easy and its a lot of fun! He is also a really easy grader and cares more about his students trying rather then grading based off of right/wrong answers. In this class, your opinion cant be wrong. As long as you show up to class, complete your assignments and attend the counseling sessions, you'll get an A
Just really a great teacher. Funny and down to earth. Least stressful class you'll ever take.

Dan is an awesome teacher! There is no textbook, he gives you all the powerpoints at the beginning of the semester and he goes over those in class. You never have to take notes. All the quizzes are extremely easy, all directly out of the notes. He is so wise and has such a positive outlook on life, take this class!!! Easy A, and he's hilarious!

one of my favorite teachers I have ever had. His quizes are right from the notes he gives. you dont need to buy the book. the group project is super easy. the final paper is super easy. He just grades you on doing the work and the work is not hard. he cares about his students and his students future. Take his class if you can, hes great!

Dan is an awesome guy! The class is more of a class about life than just about counseling. He's super helpful with anything, even things unrelated to the class - loves to help resumes and interviews. The mandatory counseling sessions are also good life experience. Also a VERY easy A.

Dan is amazing in more ways than one. Even if counseling is not your field of interest, I highly suggest taking this class. You grow both personally and professionally by attending counseling sessions, which are required by the class. Dan is open to helping his students in anyway they need, including looking over resumes and writing letters of rec.
I had Dan for my first semester of college and he is just an overall great person. Even if you're not in a health science major, I recommend taking Intro to Counseling with him. He's amazing.

class is well prepared and thought out. He encourages participation and is easy to approach when help is needed. His quizzes and test are fair. Would definitely take his class again and recommend it to others!

Great professor I have taken two classes with him so far and will be taking more. Lectures can be quite interesting and humorous as well. I have a Spanish minor and a STEM major and he's very gracious with making compromises to accommodate my conflicting schedules. Its very obvious that he cares the most about the success of his students
Amazing professor. Really cares and wants you to learn, you just have to participate and do the work. If he knows you are putting in the effort he will work with you and you will do well.
Has a decently thick accent which is tough to decipher on occasion but he is a good professor and is understanding.

This class is a glorified book club. You'll pass the class easily if you read, and speak in his class but he is extremely opinionated, he will be off putting and ignore any further discussion you give off. His dislike for what he disagrees with is very clear. I'm in the major and he's difficult to deal with. Avoid if you don't need his courses.

Professor Souto had great communication throughout the course.  Responds to questions quickly and thoroughly.  I took the class during the summer term.  Class was challenging, and everything was done online.  It was a lot to learn in a short time.  Would have liked to have a textbook to refer to.

Attendance isn't strict, but participation is crucial. He heavily grades on speaking, so you can attend every class and still fail if you don't contribute. Classes feel repetitive, like a discussion-based book club. Despite being the Spanish advisor, there's little focus on actually improving Spanish skills.
Professor didn't teach much, only had online modules each week. Modules were easy but ineffective at teaching, especially for material on the final.

This class was so hard for me and I'm a Spanish speaker, but he was so helpful. Not the best at responding to emails, but literally will work with you in every way. He really cares and just wants you to learn. He doesn't care about grades or tests, he just wants you to do the work, participate, study, and leave the rest to him. Likes to joke!
This was supposed to be a beginner Spanish class but he assumed everyone in the class had taken Spanish in High School. Do not recommend class unless you have experience with Spanish.

He is an amazing man and teacher. He is very experienced with teaching and will give you help, extensions, and slack if you ask. He expects you to study on your own and know grammar pretty well so be sure you are able to articulate your thoughts so he can evaluate just your writing. Great class!

Ismael is one of my favorite professors. He has a great sense of humor and above all wants his students to succeed. He makes you work for your grade, but he is always encouraging and available to help. In SPN 350, you'll debate controversial topics. Don't hide your feelings- Ismael is great at respecting everyone's views and opinions.

I had him for GEP100. The class was boring yet helpful. He did make it better with his accent no gonna lie. It's just very soothing to listen to for 50 mins. I have no idea what he's like when teaching Spanish but he definitely seems pretty cool.
If you can't take the heat, don't take the class! Ismael speaks his mind and isn't afraid to get snippy. He's a native Spanish speaker so he does grade rather harshly on grammar.

He is a really good professor. He really cares about his students learning and will help anyone who asks for help. Make sure to  do the practice exams, they come in handy.( some questions may pop up on the tests from the practice exams)
He is a great professor who even has humor. He is always willing to help and truly does care about his students understanding the material.

The class itself is easy. The material in class learned is very easy to understand, but his tests are very difficult. He also grades harshly for presentations and speeches, but he offers extra credit opportunities throughout the semester. You have to work very hard to get an A in this class.

Dan Harber took his own Chapyer 6 pre-test in one of our classes because he'd received feedback from the 50% of the class who DIDN'T withdraw that we wanted to do more hands on learning. He spent 75% of class doing it as we watched only to receive a 37% on the test. He then spent the remainder of the class explaining why he was right.

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Lecture heavy']
comment: Constant uncertainty of due dates. Syllabus wasnt given until half way through the semester, which had zero test, homework, or project due dates. Time was not managed well and was unable to cover all of the material in class. I personally believe there is too much content that is expected to be memorized, making this class a little ridiculous.
Great professor, super nice and helpful.

For intro to accounting, he's not the worst but one thing that I liked was he gave out review forms for students to rate him and give advice on what he can do as a professor to help the class out. That helped a TON and as for the excel assignments he goes over all of them so make sure you come to class as 75% of the class usually didn't.

Honestly, this professor was terrible. All he did was read straight from the e-book txt (that you need to purchase w/ the online homework). Very dull, and boring. Attendance is not mandatory, but on Fridays he usually went over the homework before its due so I would try to go. If you have the option to take this class with someone else. Do it.

Horribly designed lectures, uses an online version of textbook to "teach", no power points or notes given, bounces all over the place and students can barley hear him sitting in the front row. Gives outrageous excel assignments that he never takes the time to explain how to complete, but has no problem giving out a bad grade for lack of teaching.

This professor is awful. He expects everyone to know what he is talking about right from the start (even though this is an INTRO course). He assigns ridiculous excel HW assignments but does not explain how to do them. He argued with a student and gave them a zero because they did not know how to do the assignment. Try to avoid at all costs!

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: He genuinely cares about his students although he isn't good at explaining the material well.  All of his tests are like the HW and although the HW is often difficult it is possible to do by reading the text on it.  I've taken two classes with him and gotten A's both times but most people do not do very well.  A lot of people give up too early.

assigns a project and a test during the last week of class. is planning on teaching 3 chapters of information and testing us on it in 2 weeks when it took the entire semester to learn only 6 chapters. reads off the textbook the entire class. goes over how to do the HW after it is due (so helpful??). next to no practice problems during class. AWFUL.

All of the homework and quizzes are online and he doesn't understand technology all that well. He talks very quiet so sometimes it's hard to follow along. The textbook doesn't matter, but you will need the online code. There are 3 tests and the final as well as a project. The project is not bad, but the tests are brutal. Go to his office hours.

Literally the worst professor I've ever had. He doesn't teach, he just reads from the textbook. He doesn't give notes. Homeworks and quizzes save you, even though they are hard to understand because, again, he doesn't teach. Seriously, if someone else is teaching this class, take it with them. I can't imagine anyone being worse than he is.

Attendance was optional but necessary in order to find out when exams would be scheduled. Attending lecture is pointless if you don't bring your laptop. I found this class really difficult solely because I had to teach myself all of the material. Homework and project grades will save you.
Worst Teacher! Does not teach. He throws the class in a computer lab and expects you to know how to do the online work. Pretty much an online class atmosphere. You don't need to attend class.

This professor was the worst one I've ever had. He never taught one thing and just sat up in the front of the room and didn't say a word. He grades extremely hard and he doesn't even teach. I learned nothing from him this semester, and he is very unwilling to teach or help. Get out of his class if you have him.

Shows up 5-10 mins late every class and then silently uses the computer for about 15 mins. So our 50 min class is now cut in half. He then struggles to use the online program and mutters to himself while quickly taking some of the quizzes (without explaining). Doesn't even get the answers correct. And he crap talks us. Basically an all online class

I learned NOTHING from this teacher. His thought process was 1. Give lecture 2. Assign homework 3. Collect homework 4. Explain how to do homework 5. Fail you. He never explained how to do anything and you had to teach yourself everything. He once chastised us for not googling how to do a problem. Horrible teacher.

All we ever did in this class was go over the homework.  We basically had to teach ourselves how to do everything.  I do not recommend taking any accounting courses with him if that is your major because you will not learn the material.  However, his tests were always pretty simple!
