tags: ['Graded by few things', 'Beware of pop quizzes', 'Get ready to read']
comment: One of the worst professors I have ever had. Expects you to memorize PowerPoints, textbook, and 30 blackboard readings for each exam. Shows outdated nutrition videos from 30 years ago. Rambles and goes off on tangents every class. Majority of class fails quizzes and does poorly on exams. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Graded by few things', 'Test heavy']
comment: Keeps class for entire session but spends roughly 15-20% of class time rambling about random things that usually center around 1 of 2 things. His self proclaimed great intellect and the good old days. Test questions are inconsistent and encourage memorization rather than learning. Most supplemental materials are wildly outdated and innacurate.
Great class. Lots of stuff to think about that is in our environment. Had some laughs with some of the topics. Held my interest and would recommend.
Great class, great teacher. Very knowledgeable and will help you whenever you ask. Don't use your phone during class.

Gives 3 short answer pop quizzes that almost everybody fails. The class is very unorganized and he expects you to memorize power point, textbook readings, and 30 articles for each exam. He can be rude at times and will keep you in night class until 9:15 exactly. And he doesn't believe in climate change so don't expect to learn anything about that.

tags: ['Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS']
comment: He was a tad obscure sometimes but it was kind of endearing. 3 exams, 3 pop quizzes, & a 2 pg paper. Always took attendance at the end of class. Exams were 100+ MC questions each but followed closely with his PowerPoints and "additional readings." Definitely write down what he stresses in lecture. I got the book but I don't think it was necessary.
Great professor. In the group here at the college that knows his subject and how to teach. Will help you anytime you ask. Wants me to be successful here and in life. Highly recommended.
Great professor. Learned more in this class that most other ones taken. Shares real life experience in public health and food which makes it interesting and more valuable.

This guy knows nutrition. Brings personal stories and experiences into the lecture. Keeps it interesting and relatable. The best nutrition professor at Brockport. Participate, ask questions and read assignments and you will do well.
Great class & professor!  Knows what he's talking about. Sets up tutors if you need them. Great stories & examples. Need more like Zielinski.
Great professor & class. Want to learn about nutrition, this class is a must!
Great professor and class. Wish they had more like him. Includes real life experiences to help with understanding.

Zielinski is a good professor - lots of material covered but he goes over it all. Nice handouts. Show up to class because he does take attendance and it's hard to keep up otherwise. Funny stories. He loves chlorine bleach!
Very hard exams, pop quizzes, attendance is mandatory and needed to pass, very friendly.  Hard grader.

A great class and professor. Learned more than I ever could have imagined and that chemicals are what make us, us and life go on. Chemicals are not our enemy!  Talking about food and nutrition every class made me hungry.

Great professor. Lazy students don't like him because they have to work for their grade.  He knows a lot and if there is something he can't answer, he will get back to you with it.  There is more to nutrition than just food, its about chemistry.
He expects you to know a lot coming into the course and can be condescending at times. Attendance is mandatory but there are no assignments. Only 3 exams, 3 pop quizzes and attendance is graded.

Environmental health that looks at much more than just pollution and weather. Opened up my eyes to many topics that I never really ever thought about. Brings on hands experience from working in environmental health.
Study, read and take part in class discussion. You will do well if you do. Really knows his stuff and takes an interest in your learning and success.

Great teacher. Likes what he is doing and has an interest in us students. Knows his material really well. In the rare instance he can't answer a question, he will find the answer and let you know. Must read and study to do well!

An excellent class if you are there to learn. Real world experience. Not any questions he can't answer. Need extra help with material, see him and he will help if you ask. More to nutrition than I ever imagined. Great profesor!

Great class! You have an opportunity to learn as much as you want. Really knows nutrition and foods... not really anything he can't answer. Learned more in this class than most others. Read your book and online articles to be successful.

A great class if you want to learn. Lots of world/life experience to share. This enhances his knowledge and value. Really knows his stuff!Must read and study to do well. Did I say must read & study to do well?
Easy to get a good grade if effort is put in quizes are really easy but tests are kinda hard.
Very good professor. Knows subject extremely well. Don't take him if you are lazy and think you will get an easy grade; you won't. You can earn an excellent grade by working in this class.

Great professor... knows the material well. Real world work experience in local health department. If you wanna learn, take the class. If you are not interested in studying & reading, don't take this class.
Must go to his class or he will fail you even if you have an A.
Great professor. Really fair and nice. Highly recommend him!
The guy defineatly knows his stuff, but make sure you read, read, and read some more to study for the tests because they are challenging.  Overall a pretty good class.
he is horrible. never take a class with him. enough said
has a lot of knowledge about this field, but hard class. tests you really gotta know the stuff

It helps that he works in the health science field, in the Monroe County Department of Health, everyday, and just teaches on the side. This enables him to bring a lot of experience and knowledge to the class.
Good class & professor.  Lots of different topics. Don't want to get behind. If you put effort into the class you will do fine.
Knows his stuff. I learned a lot... but you have to read and study.  If you do... you will do well!
Not bad if your not a dumb a**
The class is kinda hard.  There is a lot of material, and he tries to do all of it.  The Tests are extremely hard, if I were you I would read each chapter, 3 times!!!
I would not reccomend this class or any of his classes. He is boring and long winded. He has an attendance grade so you have to show up and he is awful and unintelligent. Avoid at all costs.

This guy seriously doesn't know what he's talking about... If you have to take this class take it with Lynne Gardner.... Zielinski himself said if you get above an 80 on his test your deserve a pat on the back.

He is a great professor, although a lot of note, he will give u time to come down all of them.  you will enjoy his class if u really wanna learn about nutrition.  Yes, make sure you study well for his exams.
Good teacher, talks forever during his night class, though, hard tests, make sure you read

Dr.Perez is in my top 5 best teachers ever! I'm so glad to have been her student before she retired. She will be missed at Brockport, for sure. She is a wonderful soul and made me that much more enthusiastic about teaching. Fabulous teacher! Absolutely hilarious too! I had so much fun in her class :)

She is one of the better professors in the EDI department. She is the best one that I had. The things you learn from her are things you will probably use in the field. She could be a little more clear on assignments, but all in all a good teacher.

Dr. Perez is one of the most intelligent people I have ever met. She gives a heavy work load but is very helpful if you have questions or concerns. She is really crazy, loud and laughs A LOT. It makes a 3 hour class go by fast.

If you need a freaking tiny little anything from her (more time WITH AN ACCEPTABLE REASON, extra help, more on a topic, personal help) ask! People in my class, by far, hated her, it was unreasonable. She?ll ask a lot of you but she does really care about YOU. Even if you have a problem specifically with her, let her know, she?ll lay off.
Best education professor that Brockport has. It's too bad that she only teaches this one class. She is so much fun and makes an otherwise boring curriculum into something you'll never forget.

One of the nicest professors I've taken. She is always available for questions on assignments and has great experience in the field. Once again, it was a pleasure to take a class with such a kind person.
June was excellent. She has so much practical knowledge in the field and it relates to my interest a great deal.

Easy class. Professor Weltzer is a great teacher who is nice and willing to listen to students. She has a few quzzies and papers but she is an easy grader. Would definitely take another class with her.

I took leisure and aging with June last semester and it was honestly one of the best classes i have ever had.  She has been in the field many years and is very knowledgeable.  If you get below an A in this class its because you cant read or write.
No Comments

Dr. Daniel, taught decades ago that economic and social habits were no excuse for poor food choices. Expensive junk food addictions, insulin resistance, obesity, and type-2 diabetes will always be important interrelated topics. A vegetarian agenda, learned early on in class, practically guarantees longevity (I'm 67). Very grateful!

Following 1 dorm and 3 academic expulsions from SUNY Brockport, I re-enrolled in 1985. Few, if any professors got through to me, but Dr. Daniels did. Her Nutrition 102 class (elective) has brought me outstanding health numbers for life. It was a distinct honor and a privilege to have been a former student.

This class was very writing-heavy (~15 pages a module), and I even like writing.  Feedback was minimal and in no way constructive or helpful in terms of learning what was wrong and how to improve on future assignments.  No option to re-write assignments for a higher grade.  Responses to emails were minimal and mostly not helpful.

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Graded by few things', 'Tough grader']
comment: I signed up for a class about nutrition, not obesity and diabetes. 95% of the assignments centered discussion on obesity or diabetes, and 100% of them related to them in some way. She fails to acknowledge the socioeconomic factors that drive diet related illness. Also she pushes a vegetarian agenda early on. Not a good learning experience.
rude.

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Get ready to read', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS']
comment: Her instructions for assignments are vague, most of the quizzes she gives are multiple choice but if you miss one question then you're down 10% of that grade. Her feedback is also incredible short and not helpful whatsoever.
The teacher is a provost. How I can not imagine. She cannot even spell or work software for the computer. What a joke this one...

All you have to do for this class is one research paper.  You have the entire semester to do that and that's not difficult at all. Dr. Daniel seems very helpful and is not that tough on grading, she actually has encouraged me during this process. Her comments to me are always positive one. She does not pick you apart the way some professors do.

its GEP biggest waste of my time. she was absolutely no help. my entire class was unhappy with her. making my spring schedule was a nightmare. she changed every class i picked and I had to fight with her about what classes to take for my major. AVOID AVOID AVOID. if it is at all possible find a new adviser asap

The lecture notes were good but the tasks within the class did not encourage growth and the support structure was weak. considering that she is an officer at the college you would expect her classes to be more exciting. The feedback is useless and it's all about a silly point system, don't expect to grow mentally.
This teacher has issues that are not appropriate in a school setting. Use your imagination. students beware.
Extremely well organized; knows the material; responds quickly to emails.
Tough, hard & boring. Need I say more.

I really liked Dr. Daniel and her nutrition class. She was a tough grader, but the class was very informative and I learned a lot from it! Very helpful in office hours and knowledgeable about the subject. I'd enthusiastically recommend her for this course.
Assumes everyone in the class is a Health Science major...
Very knowledgable, firm, and difficult grader
I was very disappointed by this teacher. I found her to be a bit gruff and sharp when students had questions.
Ok class.
i loved her classes~ challenging but she knows her  stuff!!
she knows all! very knowledgable,interesting,a class that has real life apllications. I would recommend her class.
Dr. Daniel's Environmental Health class is awesome. She is such a good teacher. Tests are hard, but class is good overall.
No Comments
Very informational...love the class!
very nice!!!!
I enjoyed the class very much.

Assignments are unlcear, and very broad so it is hard to be confident in your work. He is kinda all over the place, and wants to help but sometimes doesn't. He has a good attitude towards teaching, and I learned a lot, but his methods are not typical. He isn't a very fair teacher and favors people.
He gives unclear assignments just to waste time.  Shows boring videos of his kids (no one cares!!)

The class is a little dry, but Jeremy does a good job trying to relate it to us. He was a nice guy, class was fairly easy, and he was much more realistic about what education is really about than most professors at Brockport.

The class itself is so straight forward. There are 4 quizzes and one final paper. You do a lot of group work but she also lectures a lot. The 4 quizzes are only 10 questions each. She is very strict with her final paper and the way she wants things to go. Attendance is important.

Felt as though the class was relatively unorganized. The lectures were heavy and difficult to follow, even on my own. Personally, I don't recommend taking it unless required. Lots of papers, and the format of how much each assignment is worth for your final grade doesn't make much sense.
We covered a lot of subject matter, she took attendance sporadically throughout the semester, a lot of reading but assignments were easy.

I have no idea how this professor has any positive reviews on here. She's condescending, gets behind on the syllabus and is incredibly unorganized. Incoherent + boring lectures that consume the entire classtime. Frequently gives inaccurate information. Hard to reach outside of class. Awful communication. Bad at posting assignments. Easy class tho

tags: ['So many papers', 'Lecture heavy', 'Graded by few things']
comment: She gets so behind in class. Most times you won't even know where you should be in the syllabus. She will say that she is grading your papers and then you won't get a grade for weeks or months. We have a paper due this week and she still hasn't graded a paper we turned in over two months ago. If you can avoid taking her classes I would do so.

She will call out students for talking during class despite her having a conversation not related to class with the front row for half of class. She goes off on very long unrelated tangents. She didn't even grade the very first essay we had until the last week. She'll often forget to post readings or assignments and blames us for not notifying her.

Dr. Walter is a terrible professor. Not only is she rude but she is extremely unhelpful. Papers every other week in her class and does not grade papers until finals week. Instruction is always unclear. It is so ridiculous, avoid her at all costs.

I would never recommend a non history major take any of Dr. Clark's classes because of their complexity & the amount of work that she expects from her students. However, she is extremely considerate and gives good feedback. She is always willing to help, and if you love history definitely take one of her classes; she is a real gem of a professor.

Dr. Clark is a nice person. However, she did not grade our midterm until finals week. She lectured for the entire class time after the first few weeks. Her lectures can be hard to follow but hw is generally easy and she gives good feedback. The class itself is not too difficult. She gets easily distracted by students talking and calls them out.
Dr. Clarks ancient world history class I just one long sentence of her non stop talking. Its so boring but not too hard of a class. You are graded on attendance, short essays and 2 tests.

Did not respond to one of my emails throughout the entire semester. Not professional whatsoever. She even canceled class during the middle of the lecture just because someone was talking. I literally thought she was about to cry. Very immature. Every class is the exact same and she just rambles on and on, she makes the topics very uninteresting

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK', 'LECTURE HEAVY']
comment: Shes honestly pretty rude. Ive tried to give her my best effort for her class. After I got really sick this past year I missed a class and emailed the dean who said shed take care of it and then my teacher yelled at me.

Very lecture heavy. Writings almost every week, but very late with grading. Cannot get by without the books or assigned readings for essays. Handed out attendance sheets maybe 3 times during the semester, but it's a small class.

Dr. Clark is very disorganized.  Her powerpoints are word-for-word, and impossible to take notes on.  She also can be very disrespectful towards her students, especially if they ask too many questions.

I took this class thinking it would be an easy gen-ed and ending up hating every second of it. She is a very rude professor and often confusing. She assigns reading every day and gives writings every week on them. Midterm and Final are both composed of 3 essays. I received an A- in the class but honestly one of the worst professors I've ever had

Professor Clark is one of the worst professors I've had. She is rude and will snap at you if she even hears you say one word while she's talking and also treats you like you're in high school. Once kept us 10 minutes over because people were zipping there backpacks before class was over. Expects you to read way too much. Avoid at all costs.

Professor Clark is an amazing professor and an amazing person. Anyone one who says otherwise is lazy and shouldn't be in college. She gives quizes on the readings every Thursday but she goes over the readings in class so just pay attention, and she drops the three lowest quiz scores. If you put in the work and get help from her an A-A is likely.
Worst professor I've ever had. Prepare to sit through her ridiculous tangents and terrible word for word powerpoint presentations. Do yourself a favor and don't take this class.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! expects you to read a 40 page passage multiple times in order to understand it. Then take a "quiz" every class asking very specific questions. BORING lecture. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS

Dr. Clark is the worst teachers I have had.  Constantly rambles on about meaningless topics that have nothing to do with what we are doing in class.  Acts like a child if she does not get what she wants.  Gives the most vague directions on the WEEKLY quizzes.  Read approx. 40 pages per night.  Ridiculous amount of work for a 100 level course.

Worst teacher I've ever had. She is so unclear and assigns way too much reading for a 100 level class and a survey class. She is all of the place with her lectures and makes zero sense. Assigns readings of around 30 pages each class and they are the most confusing essays to read. I would never recommend her as a professor nor this class to anyone.

Dr. Clark is awesome, very knowledgeable about European history and the Black Death.  Lectures were fascinating and she wasn't afraid to sidebar if students had questions that were a little off topic.  A lot of writing, no tests, and she's encouraging and provides excellent feedback.  Made me a better writer, and I will take more course with her.

Dr. Clark is a wonderful professor! She is very willing to help if needed before exams, and I enjoyed her class. Textbooks were necessary, readings were short and interesting. She makes class easy to pay attention in   with her presentations. Definitely recommend.

Very helpful teacher, very funny and very fair. She may be a little unclear at times but she is always willing and available to help. Her class is not at all difficult even if you don't o the readings. She always gives plenty of information and as long as your not sleeping you will learn in this class.

Not sure why she has so much negative feedback. The class was slightly difficult, but she was helpful and nice. I have had her for another class, and she is my adviser and is very helpful. My recommendation though: If you're not a history major, take a survey level class (if you can) not this one.
If you care about your GPA stay away from her. you have been fairly warned... class started with 20 ended with 8 or 9. A ton of writing and reading. Stay away.

Absolute worst teacher i've ever had. very disorganized and rambles on about the most minute and unnecessary details. AVOID HER AT ALL COSTS. some of her slides will say one thing, and later she will show you a slide that contradicts the other one. I used to love history but she made me hate it very much.
Elaborates A LOT about what's on the slides. Doesn't look at the class while talking. But exams are fair. She's helpful and available to students.

There are many things I can say about Dr. Clark. She is not very clear on anything she says and she talks very fast. She is all over the place with lessons ex. one day china next day greece. She is passionate about history but honestly not the best. My recommendation is to AVOID AT ALL COSTS!

Heavy use of the textbooks, and a lot of readings off angel. Getting all the readings done takes a few hours, but if you put in the effort it's an easy class. The essay's and the midterm were a breeze. She's a good teacher, nerdy and a bit sarcastic, but funny. You get two free skips, too. I recommend her to anyone interested in the subject matter.

She definitely knows her stuff, but still needs help delivering it. Can be moody and very sarcastic. Lots of reading and textbooks, but interesting at times. A few papers that came all at once, and did not return the midterms until the second last week of classes.

She's very smart, and if you stay on top of the work you'll have no issues, but I have seen her get a bit sarcastic with some people before. She assigns more writing than other professors at the same class level, and about the same amount of reading. If you like medieval history, give her a chance: she certainly knows her stuff..

I had her for two classes and she was really helpful. She taught me how to write a good research paper.  She's friendly, insightful, and she is willing to listen to the students' opinions.  Not bad looking either.

I love history but she made me hate the class. Way too much work and reading for the amount of non majors in the class. Very moody and makes smug passive aggressive comments to people who aren't paying attention. Her notes don't help prepare you for tests at all.Hated the class and the professor just annoyed me with everything she did

All of the review that rate her well are not for the 100 level course. Very moody sometimes is nice but will turn fast if noone raises their hand. Way too much work for a 100 level thinks her class is most important thing ever. the museum project is a huge pain and a waste of time shes very unclear when she gives directions on things like due dates

Pretty disappointed from this class with her to be honest. Reading some ancient literature but not studying the actual history too much. She was late quite a few times. I took it my first semester in college and did not very good... especially for a 100 level course. I do not recommend her at all.
Dr. Clark is great. I would definately recommend her! Yes, alot of reading...but that is expected in upper division courses. Honestly...one of the best professors in the dept!
Have taken multiple classes with Dr. Clark, very knowledgeable, extremely helpful, and funny. Highly recommend.

Clark deserves a chance. I did not get her at first...but she grew on me. Encourages class participation, always willing to help, flexible, and knows her stuff. I learned more than research..alot on medieval hstory...so I got more than i bargained for. Talk to her if you have a problem...she is a rels person.Do the readings...helps you in discussio

If you want to learn then do not take clark classes.  She has her student pets and openly shows it in class.  If you are not one of her pets then do not expect to get anything other then B-'s in the class.  Oh and did i mention that one will not learn anything??  Clark = Horrible.

An outstanding teacher.  I really enjoyed the class on The Roman Empire.  Dr. Clark was well prepared, engaged, witty, knowledgeable, passionate and willing to help students.  Yes, there's a lot of work.  So?  It's an upper-division course - more reading and writing is expected.  If you're not prepared for class, it will show in your grade.

Great in a seminar setting.  I'm not a big Medieval person, but the class has been pretty fun and interesting none the less.   Quite a bit of reading, middle amount of writing.  She's fun, in a quirky history-loving kind of way.

Shes terrible.  avoid at all costs.  If you do take her dont expect to get anything above a C+/B- tests are so indepth its rediculas. Terrible lecturer very disorgainzed.  Late to class several times, by as much as 5 minutes.  Changed final the day before we were to take it.  Way too much work for a 100 level class.  Worst class I have taken!!!!!!!
Not #1 on my list of classes. Way too much work for a 101 level course. Test are Essays and lectures are boring. Don't take it if you don't need it

Professor is late about every day. class is taught more about ancient philosophy and religion than anything. DO NOT take this course if you want an easy 100 level. Students are forced to study a lot outside of class for tests b/c Clark does not address most test topics in class.

Nice lady...but class was boring, her essay tests have VERY little to do w. what is covered in the text/power pts...must do hours of outside preparing for the essays, which usually involves finding most things on the internet..she will usually attempt to help you if you come for extra help, but..overall, a frustrating class

Class lectures/power points don't have much of anything to do with her essay tests.  So once she gives you sample essay questions prepare to look everything up and teach yourself.  Even still, shes a hard grader on the essays, so the time and effort you put into studying/teaching yourself may never be worth it.  Thought it was a very poor class.

Dr. Clark is a joy to have class with.  She really knows her stuff, and class isn't boring.  For this course, keep in mind that it does focus on women in medieval europe, and that there is no avoiding extensive discussions of religion when discussing medieval europe.  Problem?  Don't take it.  Great course.
She is a really nice person, and very helpful.  However, she covers way too much information for a 100 level course.  Would be a great teacher for an upper devision course.  Hard Grader!

She is a nice teacher, but doesn't really teach you anything that is needed for the tests.  She does tell you what is going to be on the essay tests, but then you must do all of the research yourself and no matter how thorough your answer is she will find enough things that you left out to rarely give you an A.  Mostly just rambles during class.
No Comments

she assigns way to much reading and has all essay tests where you pretty much have to know everything there ever was to know about the subject.  Overall is was way too much work for a 100 level class.

A very nice lady, a good sense of humor. She tries to relate ancient history to modern times which I like. However she treats the course like a 300 level. I found this course to be quite challening for 101. I didn't feel like she always answered questions clearly. Prepare to do a lot of reading and study her review sheets!

She's a nice prof and is helpful.  The tests and exams are essay style but she does give you possible essay questions before hand.  There's also a paper and a group project.  Its a lot of work but if you do the readings and write the practice essays b4 the test, then you should pass

She is a great professor. She is very understanding, and willing to work with students. She comes across as very smart, but a not know it all. I would recommend her classes even to none history students.
Horrible teacher, shows favoritism to other students and treats a 100 level course as a higher level one. She could be different in he other classes but don't take ancient world with her.
Awesome teacher. Don't listen to the jackasses who say she only asks questions, I've been going to college for 4 years and shes up there with the best of them. Top notch, I recommend her to anyone.

An amazing lady.  Very passionate about Medieval History, completely furthered my own interest.  Willing to give copious amounts of help on assignments, good sense of humor.  Demanding course load, but totally worthwhile.  She made me a better student.
Awesome class atmosphere. Dr Clark was a fun teacher and challenged us with lots of work, but if you do the work you'll get a good grade.

Its kind of a boring class butits possible to get a good grade in this class. For every test she gives you a review sheet with all the questions on it. If you study you can do well. Every class is boring but it can be a little fun if you get off topic. I thought she was really cute in a dorky way.

She's cute, in a dorky sort of way.  She needs to organize her lectures a lot better.  She tends to jump around in odd ways and focus too much on women...they are only half the population but 3/4 of the course!  NOT condesending...she's just a head-in-the-sand intellectual.  Rarely takes attendance.
lots of reading/hard work, but she's reasonable if you try to be nice to her
A very nice teacher. She grades easy even though the reading is overwhelming. Lectures often get off topic, but if you do the work, you can learn a lot from her.

Great as long as you are a female interested in opressed women throughout the Ancient World.  Clark lectures gender roles in every Civilization we've studied.  That is great for a women's studies class, but irrelavent to an entry level history course.  her grading is unjustifiably harsh.

Regularly at least 5 minutes late for class.  Irrelevant lectures, doesnt teach just asks questions.  Posts notes on Angel after being seen in class, allows no chance to add in additional information.

Very condescending in her attitude, doesn't communicate well. Her lectures are usually irrelevant and unrelated to the test material. She is rude and doesn't tell us what we need to know for the tests until its too late - even then its almost impossible to learn everything two days before the exam.
Very unhelpful and rude. She asks a lot of questions but never provides any clear answers.

Ive taken as many of Norments classes as possible. Very respectable prof who cares tremendously about each students educational experience. Lots of work but 100% worth the effort with the knowledge you take away. Also very helpful as an advisor and in job searching.

I've tried to take as many classes as possible with this guy (Ornithology, Herpetology, and Wildlife Ecology). In my view he has the most educational classes in the department, and has reasonable expectations of his students. Amongst students he is generally regarded as having the most entertaining lectures, as well. I recommend him highly.
Dr. Norment is da boss!
Loved the class, and he's a great guy! but lecture can be confusing if you don't keep up with what is going on.  Test are pretty hard, too.
Unlike everyone else Im not going to kiss this guy's ass. He does have a good reputation, but I just didn't see it. He's one of those guys that believes his class should be the most important.
Awsome!!!
Norment is definately the best teacher in the department.
If you have a chance to take one of Norment's classes, TAKE IT! (AMG - 2004)
awesome professor! very intersting class!
Dr. Norment is such a wonderful person--I thought his class was hard-but still I could have tried harder-he is so much fun!

Norment is really the best teacher out there.  He always brings a little something extra to the lecutres/labs to really connect studies with the real world.  If your up for an intellectual challange, Norments your guy!
Good guy at heart, some what intimidating and stand-offish at times though. His classes are worth taking.
if anxiety production were a gem, this man is a diamond.  I found him to be very scattered in his presentations, and to be ambiguous.  However, he is hopping full of energy and leads a good hike.
Cool Dude

I've never felt more discouraged to not dance then from Vanessa. It's like she wants to push some people out of the dance department. I ended up not finishing my dance degree because she's so negative to some people.

Vanessa is so nice and definitely the best professor out of the Sound, Stage and Surface Class. The class is extremely easy with only 2 papers, she will even proofread/edit your drafts! You are given some longer articles to read but they are manageable. The most annoying part is attending all the different performances, but some of them were fun.

Not at all helpful. She uses certain books to compare to yourself and write short essays. She can be nice sometimes but she is not understanding whatsoever. Felt strongly discouraged, I've heard similar things from other students.

Class is incredibly difficult. Assignments are unclear and she is very unwilling to help. Probably would be easier for dance majors, I wouldn't recommend it if you are not. She is very critical and a hard grader.
Class material was great if you are interested in dance. Thought provoking discussion, and well thought out progression.

Honestly, this class was really annoying. I thought it was going to be an easy elective, but they required a lot of time consuming readings and like 3 concert attendances and we had to observe a dance class. We had some 1 page response papers & a final research paper on a topic related to dance. The class was extremely east just super annoying!!!!

Sarah is very sweet and a good teacher. make sure you're taking thorough notes on the slides and the art pieces she shows. she does a few vocab quizzes that were pretty easy. I would like it if I was more interested in the topics but it was okay

She is an awesome person, enthusiastic about her field, and very knowledgeable. If it wasn't for her personality, the content would be very boring. I love her style of teaching. She lost steam half way through semester due to understable personal reasons which made the class a little less interesting and interactive. But overall, she was great!

I loveeeed Sarah. Her Art & Artists class was the easiest class I've ever taken. As easy as it is, its really really boring. The notes are always posted online so you have easy access to them, and the papers/assignments are easy as well. She is the sweetest ever and is passionate about her field! Easy A class!

I like the professor as a person, she is very nice however, as someone who loves the art the class is ungodly boring. Mainly a class about buildings and the renaissance period. Not really about the artists lives and backgrounds or their paintings.

Professor Ballard is a good teacher. She goes over the material thoroughly. Must listen and pay attention when she is talking because she only puts the names of the art/architecture on the slides and talks very fastly. Does note checks once in awhile. Usually the work she assigns involves notes taken in class. Does not answer emails frequently.

Professor Ballard was really just an awesome person all around. Her lectures were very engaging, and captivating unlike a lot of other lecture classes. She's not a hard grader at all, just do the assignments and you'll be fine. The only complaint I have is that she would add random assignments throughout the semester that were not on the syllabus.

Sarah was a great professor and I really enjoyed her class and lectures. The one thing I didn't love was the amount of papers, and how the unit quiz and vocab quiz are basically the same thing so it makes it a little difficult but she's an easy grader. As long as you take good notes and pay attention you'll be fine :)
A lot of papers but easy grader
Does not respond to emails. Nitpicks everything. The worst!

tags: ['Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LECTURE HEAVY']
comment: I got a 89 on the final and and 92 on the final essay. I got a D. How? Because I'm shy and don't like to talk in class so she failed me for not participating.

I was dreading World Art II because I am not a history person at all, however, Sarah made the class easy and enjoyable. We had 1 page papers due almost every week but if you took good notes in class, or used the textbook they were a breeze. She is more than happy to help you improve your writing style and in turn raise your grades.

Sarah is very passionate about art but isn't very inspiring herself. She expects you to read chapters before class and remember all the information for lecture. If you didn't understand the textbook prepare to be lost in class cause it's all discussion, no real teaching. And the workload is a little too extensive for a 200 level course.

Extremely nice, well articulated. She does have you write quite a few papers, at least one a week, but they are mostly only one page long and are easy to do. Always gives good feedback on your writing, though some of her assignments were vague, and could have used some more clarity. Overall, great professor, great class.

Sarah makes lectures interesting and easier to understand. Unlike most teachers, she assigns mostly writing assignments. There's usually a weekly one page paper and longer papers throughout the year, but I'd take that over long memory based tests any day. As long as you put in a little effort, it's hard not to get a good grade in this class.

Professor at Genesee Comunity College. She requires 3 pages every week (oh yeah in 10 font) along with discussion, quiz , and final paper of 5 pages. Clearly she has no life. Only take her if you love to write about art. She unfare if you so much work but takes forever to grade back your work.

Sarah is AMAZING. She is super personable and easy to talk to. Her grading criteria is clearly laid out in rubric form for every assignment and she gives ample time to get work done. Don't skip class because its lecture, online ppt and textbook focused and she takes off points but overall great class and great teacher!
Ballard is very understanding, she is very clear on what she's teaching about. A lot of useful information and the load of the work is dry bearable.

Lectures are engaging, informative and I looked forward to going to class. There are a few writing assignments, but read the online powerpoints and pay attention in class and you'll do fine. Extra credit opportunities too!! Also don't buy the textbook, I didn't open it and only read the powerpoints and did fine! She's an amazing professor!

Professor Ballard makes me very interested in Art History. The classes are lecture but she does it well. I have learned a lot and the class is not over yet. A few papers, easy quizzes, and online group discussion. Attendance is a must, but it helps you learn to do better. Overall, I would recommend Professor Ballard for people who want to do well.

I took this as a Gen Ed and I really loved it. She is passionate about what she does and her enthusiasm makes the lectures worth while.  Yes expect a lot of writing but it is very doable because everything you need is in the notes. There is a research project but she breaks it into parts so it is manageable. Definitely don't buy the textbook.
There are no tests, only 3 vocab quizzes and 3 short papers. She made lectures interesting- she is very nice and knowledgable. I would 100% recommend.

LOVED her. Very nice lady, responds to e-mails fast. I'm a BIO major, and was forced to take this class, and I'm glad I took it with her. She made the lectures very interesting! You have to take your own notes. Four vocab quizzes, from the lectures, couple papers, & one final group project. She gives many extra credit opportunities. Enjoyed going!
Why would I pay for a general MA professor when I paid for  PhD lead class.  Way too much ego for someone with average credentials.

She requires a lot from her students but if you apply yourself you will be fine.  Definitely attend class, use of the textbook makes papers easier.  She's a fair grader, knowledgeable and willing to help students.

I've had Sarah for both World art I & II, and honestly she is becoming a much better teacher as she progresses in her career. There is work required out of class and tests are all memorization, but it's doable. Very easy to approach and accepts criticism about her teaching graciously so she can improve for the future.

Professor really knows her art history. There is A LOT of writing in this class, seven 3 page papers. Grades papers really hard. Her tests are all memorization and its a lot to memorize. Only take this if you are a good writer and don't mind memorizing works of art, their artist, date and renaissance.
Highly recommend for a capstone course. I wish this website would let me write an actual review.

Dr Lipko Speed is super passionate about what she teaches, and truly cares for her students.  Textbook is mandatory, homework assignments are in it, but if you pay attention in class you can do well in class without reading.  Homeworks (daily) and papers (2) are graded very fair.  3 unit tests and a cumulative final.

Offers extra credit and is understanding of students. Very accessible outside of class, takes time to explain assignments. A few short papers but mostly tests, seeing a tutor is helpful. Lectures are thorough and interesting. Easy to talk to and very kind, passionate about teaching her students. Keep up with material and do not fall behind!

She was a good professor overall! I really enjoyed the class. My only issue is that she only briefly mentioned Freud in her intro to psych class, which may be fine for psych majors staying at brockport but I transferred to a different school and I feel like Im missing a lot of the foundation of the major.

Great professor, very knowledgeable. Most information is translated through her in person lectures, and missing a class might cost a few points on the exam. Exams are fair, and somewhat difficult, but if you study you'll do well. Reading the textbook could help, but also it gets somewhat confusing. Great professor though and very passionate.

Very easy grader. Tests were easy for me and based on lecture slides. HW and writing assignments were also easy. She has a policy that you can turn anything in late once with no penalty. She cares about her students and goes deeper than a typical intro class to help you learn. Clearly knows a lot about psychology and the topics she discusses.

She is a super nice person and a great teacher, however for this specific class she wasn't amazing. I'm finding that as I progress through the psych major and I talk to other people who have taken intro to psych, I'm missing a lot of info because she just didn't teach it.

I only had her for my GEP100 class but I can tell she is a wonderful professor. She is always willing to help with any issue and gives amazing feedback. She listens to students and tries to help anyway she can. I hope to have her as a psych teacher in the future, if you can take her class do it.

She's a very good professor, i definitely recommend taking a class with her and i hope to take more with her. she's understanding and very good with explanations. she has no problems explaining material in different ways and also uses her own life experiences to help you understand. We had 4 tests non cumulative including the final.

Professor Lipko-Speed is such an amazing professor and person! She genuinely cares about you and how you are doing in class and outside as well. She keeps you engaged and eager to learn! I looked forward to going to her class all day and wished i could continue and take more classes with her!

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Respected', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: Professor Lipko-Speed is amazing! She genuinely cares and is a fantastic teacher. Going to class is essential and write down the examples! Studying is a must and do the homework for easy points towards your grade. I am definitely going to try to take another class with her. Overall, great professor and person!
Professor Lipko-Speed is very knowledgeable. She explains information in a clear way with many examples, diagrams and videos. Studying is essential, but if you do you will pass.

Dr. Lipko-Speed was the professor for my first Psychology class and she made presented the material in a way that makes it relevant and applicable in everyday life. She has a subtle yet commanding control of the class, and consistently keeps everyone engaged through demonstrations and discussion. I highly recommend taking a course with her.

Dr. Lipko is one of the best professors I had. Her lectures are easy and clear to understand, if you pay attention you will learn something new in every lecture. Her exams are not hard, just make sure to study. The in-class assignments are an easy way to get many points towards your final grade. I would recommend taking any class with her.

As long as you go to class and pay attention, you'll have no problem passing her class. The tests are easy and straight forward as long as you study your notes. Highly recommend taking any class she teaches!

Come to class and pay attention and you will do fine. She is very straight forward and fair however the first few assignments may be lower grades than your used to because she grades harshly to teach you how to be better at writing for psychology. Best capstone class!!!
She taught well, did use great examples, and was helpful when I need additional explanation. I'd recommend taking a class with her.

Super easy class and amazing lady.  Minimal amounts of studying and work and she keeps class interesting with many examples. She's always willing to go out of her way to help students.  I would recommend any class with her.

Awesome class, awesome professor.  She offers insane amounts of extra credit.  Her exams completely follow class notes and study guides.  If you pay attention in class the textbook is unnecessary.  She gives plenty of time for assignments.  On a side note, her powerpoints are seriously impressive.

Hands down the best professor I have ever had. Uses examples, very clear requirements, realistic assignments and requirements, not too much to physically hand in. Tells you what will be on the test. You do not need the book if you take notes, her handwriting is really easy to read and with the pp slides you don't need a book. Stickler about texting

one of the best professors ive had. very clear objectives, very helpful. lectures are concise, and at times she makes associations or gives examples which make things very clear to understand. definitely a great professor. cares about her students. mandatory attendance
Textbook wasn't necessary if you took notes in class. All of the exams were multiple choice. The lectures themselves were pretty dull, so the hardest part might be staying awake.
Very interesting class, she uses great examples that help with concepts. Best teacher for psychology.

After I had her for Intro I made sure I had her again for Child Psych... she is very good at explaining things. I also do research with her and I definitely recommend trying to become an RA for her lab... she is very helpful, personable, and she makes it a great experience! After going here for 3 years I can easily say she is my favorite professor.
This class was interesting and easy. As long as you pay attention and go to class, you should get an A.
She is very sweet and really great at explaining things. Go to her open office hours- she is extremely helpful! Best professor I've had so far!

Dr. Lipko is great. I've had her for two classes, and being a psych major she definately keeps me interested. Her tests are completely fair, you just need to study and pay attention in class. Try to avoid missing any classes. When you go into her class expect to know alot of new interesting material coming out. I learned alot from her!
She teaches very clearly and tests on application. Make sure you write down her examples and use the review sheets. I go to her open office hours and it helps a lot.
This lady knows her stuff and is able to teach very effectively. Can get grouchy really quickly if people talk in her class.

I loved Dr. Lipko.  You do need to try in this course but she is honestly the best psychology teacher.  She is crystal clear with her guidelines/dates/directions/etc.  Wasn't expecting to learn so much since I took the class as an elective but I ended up loving it.  I recommend taking any class with Dr. Lipko!

Absolutely fantastic! She is so loud and clear and always answers your questions. She is very nice and truly cares about her students. Pay attention, go to class and take the notes and keep up on the textbook and you will do great!

She is an excellent professor. As long as you take down her notes and know how to apply it to examples (she gives many during class) you will pass easily! She doesn't give that much work. Great class and she makes it very interesting! She is also very knowledgable.

She is a great teacher. All the material is covered in her lectures. She also offers a ton of extra credit. All the notes are posted as powerpoints on Angel so if you have to miss class keep up with those. Overall great teacher.

Took both Intro and Child Psych with her... she is great! You don't need the book for either, but definitely make sure you go to every class -- all the exam material is presented during lecture. No attendance in Child Psych though. As long as you pay attention, take good notes, and study, both classes are an easy A.

Prof. Lipko is a VERY good teacher. Her classes are interesting and well worth while. She presents information in a way that is very easy to understand and is very clear. Tests are not hard if ou study for them. Great professor

Dr.Lipko is a great professor! I recommend taking any class with her. This is the only class I actually want to go to. Ive taken two classes with her and have dont great in both. She is really nice, helpful and very clear on all her topics. You can definitely tell she loves what she does!

Lipko is a great professor. I didnt own the textbook and you dont need to buy it. (I never buy textbooks anymore for any class). 4 exams non cumulative mix of mc, t/f, fill in blnk. Keeps class interesting with powerpoint and visuals/movie clips. Alot of knowledge, highly recommend. I suggest attending all classes though. not a chore.

She is probably to best professor I've had at Brockport thus far! The way she presents concepts and her organization is fantastic. You want to do your work and show up just out of respect because she's so great

Dr. Lipko is my favorite prof at Brockport thus far. She's super nice and great at making concepts clear. She usually shows a couple of helpful videos  in class too. Attendance is a lot of your grade, so make sure to go. Tests are difficult and definitely require studying. I recommend taking Intro with Lipko. (:
Prof Lipko is great at explaining concepts and she teaches at a slow pace throughout the class. The book is only necessary for studying before tests, which do require studying.

She is a good professor and it is clear what you need to do to pass the course. There are few tests, but if you take notes in class you'll be fine. Two short papers and research studies are required also. Lipko makes the class generally interesting and is very nice and understanding.

I did not want to take PSH110 but was required to. Dr. Lipko is the professor to take it with! As long as you study you will do fine. Extremely clear expectations, you only have yourself to blame if you do poorly. She is very helpful and is always well prepared for class. Relates very well to students, highly recommended!

Extremely easy class. A few tests, a midterm, and a final, but no papers except the Application Assignment, which is easy. You don't really need the book except for studying. Attendance is mandatory because she sends around an attendance sheet every class. She is REALLY nice and she makes it easy to understand the material.
Really, really good teacher. Very clear, organized, and fair. I will definitely be taking another psych class with her before I graduate.
great professor. she definitely made class interesting, although she just lectures so it may be boring. showed videos and gave great examples. no hw, only one paper. recommend to everyone!

Lipko is a GREAT professor Took this class as a prereq for nursing. Loved it! Myers Psych Book is not needed. Her tests are fair and all based on her notes in class. Did not use book once, don't waste $$. Total of 3 tests, one paper and then a final. Shows videos and power points in class.Take her class if interested or if you are a Nursing student
Great professor. Very clear and gives many examples.  Book is not even needed! Take principles of psych with her if you can.

Dr. Lipko is a great professor. Not long out of being in college herself, she still understands what it is like to be a student. Although she only lectures, which can be a little boring, she's very clear. All her tests are straight from the notes..no textbook needed!! Tests can be tricky with a lot of detail, but extra help is ALWAYS available.

She is great! Her tests were super straight forward and easy if you looked at the material. She seems really interested in what she is teaching and gives tons of examples to clarify- I never read the book and got an A. Take child psych with her.
This class is very easy if you go to class and study for tests. Assigns one paper and will read & comment on your paper and a pretty easy grader. Easy Extra credit is offered.

Loved this teacher! Class is interesting, extra credit is offered, tests are not hard if you study notes and read book, a general study guide is given. One 4 page paper is assigned where you pick a toy to write about. Great overall class if you're willing to put some effort into it.

Great teacher, class is very interesting..test are tricky but if you study in detail you will do fine. Her material is straight forward and out of the book so you don't have to read the book, but the book is not bad to read. There is no attendance but you don't want to miss class because she gives excellent notes
I love this lady! She makes class so fun and gives you extra credit for going to class on certain days! A lot of extra credit, 4 tests and one paper. If you want to take Child Psych take it with her!

Sometimes it's hard to understand him, but if you let him know, he will re-explain it for you. He will allow the use of AI if you sight it and post your before and after AI work. Very reliable inside and outside of class.

comment: Ken is great! I've enjoyed my time taking classes with him. He's far and away the best professor the Counseling Ed department has to offer. Thoughtful, responds to emails promptly, gives great lectures, and always provides good amounts of helpful feedback when returning assignments. Also just a cool guy to talk to and ask questions after class

Ken was a good professor that cared about adding breadth to CACREP curriculum. The conversations in class were good, however, Ken isn't as assertive with properly leading a forum based discussion. Sometimes class discussions took time away from the lecture. He is also very forgiving with due dates. Overall good professor and culturally enriching.

The nicest woman around. Funny and adorable. Class may be frustrating however, as it is mainly the notes read aloud and information you already know. Too easy. A few HW assignments, a paper, and only 3 tests. The book was not really needed.

Susan is a very nice lady! I like having her as a professor because of that but her class is painfully boring. Reads directly of lecture slides which she provides to you, so its easy to feel like attending class is useless besides the attendance sheet which she passes out before each class. Exams online. No homework but an occasional assignment.

Mr. Georger is one of the best people ever! He is super caring and I find reasons to go see him and just talk. He wants the best for everyone and is just amazing, I don't really know what else to say without repeating myself! He is THE BEST!!!! : (didn't know which class to put because I've had so many with him!)
Jim is extremely helpful. He will bend over backwards to help in any way he can. He's always there if you have a question, want to talk or just need a hug! He's a sweetheart and he truly cares.
extremely helpful; students are his #1 priority; will work to clarify any confusion and deal with any problems students are having
Awesome!
Jim is great he is sooo easy to talk to and very down to earth. He will always go out of his way to help his students if they deserve it being one of his students was great, he is a great professor

Jim is an awesome teacher and he always wanted a hotness rating.  So here you go Jim!!!  He also helps out a lot with scheduling and during class time as well.  He is one of my favorite professors here at Brockport.
Jim is great.  He helps out all he can, he really likes to get to know you and to get you situated the best he can for the college life.
I find Jim Georger to be extremely helpful when selecting your courses, he teaches a period of DCC 200 great guy very personable
very helpful. will go out of his way for anyone. always motivating.

Jim is an absolute pleasure to work with. He is a kind and funny guy. He's always open to talk and is very understanding. He's open-minded, down to earth and fair. Jim is a great guy to get to know and has been very helpful. :)

Jim's half of this class starts out rough but then becomes better as classes progress. He will tell you at the beginning that you're here to learn and if it was easy then there would be no point. However, he does help you through it. Jim is the best and makes DELTA worth it completely.
great guy. great professor. one of the best things about delta

Jim is one of the most amazing advisors ever. He cares more than most, and he is a totally great person. He's there to listen to you when you're confused, and there to help you when you don't know what to do. Being a first year Delta, I was a bit apprehensive, but Jim helped so much.
Jim is amazing. Talking with him is a large part of why I am a part of Delta. He's always helpful and happy to answer questions. No complaints about him at all.

Jim is more than just a good professor, he's an amazing advisor, a helpful guy for advice, and an overall good friend if you get to know him.  He's always there to help you when you need it and he really knows his stuff.  He gets you ready for life, and you'll be prepared if you have Jim.  I can't imagine having another advisor
Jimmy G. is awesome.
Jim is a great teacher. To top everything off, He is there to help with advisement. I'm SURE he's one of the best advisors on campus.
great teacher
jim is great! he really cares about his students and can have fun with them too.
The best.
Jim rules and hes awesum at guitar.... some classes are interesting and sum arent but he makes it fun, and cares a lot.... he's a great advisor as well
Really nice guy. Will help you with anything you need.  He tries to make his classes enjoyable, but they're alright.
No Comments
Soo glad Jim's going full-time in Delta next year!  No one could ever ask for a better professor or advisor.  He completely deserved getting nominated for an outstanding advisor award.
Jim is AWESOME!
one of the best teachers, and nicest guys you can imagine. take his classes, and enjoy...
Jim's just the best!  He's the kinda guy you want to hug every time you see him.  He's so helpful and really knows his business!  So nice too, he's one of the best parts about Delta!
He's a "master mentor", gives great career advice, and really cares about the students.  class can be a little dry, but it's worth getting to know him.
does not answer emails or texts. nice guy and I respect him. Always late to class. love his slides though, use his vocab for the quizzes

Dr. Richards is a great professor and incredibly understanding of personal situations. I was sick just about my entire semester in his class and he let me take quizzes late and turn in homework assignments without taking off any points. This man sucks he is no help
dude was painfully boring and not a great teacher. he wont remember your name so dont try
Very nice and helpful

I had the privilege of taking ESC 364 with professor Richards in the spring 2022 term. He is a great teacher and always willing to provide help when necessary. He gave 1 exam in my class and the rest was just discussion board and group projects. If you get to know him and form a connection, the class will be easy.

Dr. Richards is one of the worst professors I've had at Brockport and that is saying a lot. He takes days to respond to emails or doesn't bother responding at all. Almost always posts the lectures a day late. His grammar is consistently poor in assignment directions and half of the time his sentences don't even make sense. Stay away!!

(ONLINE CLASS) -Dr. Richards is straight-forward with his teaching, but lacks basic organization and time-management, like uploading lectures a day late consistently, and is slow at emailing and communicating in a timely fashion. Mandatory attendance on Blackboard.

Professor Richards is a hack. He is completely oblivious. The lectures and homework dont match up. He gave us a vocab sheet and repeated terms on it multiple times, not because he really wanted to ensure we knew the word, but because he is that dumb. Sitting through his class is nauseating. Only take class with him if you have to!!!!!

Geography quizzes each week that usually don't line up with the practice sheets. He puts very little effort into his class, and is a very dry lecturer. Take if you want an easy A, not if you want to learn.

Though professor Richards has a way to him that you would think would make geography enjoyable, he does not. You have a map quiz on something new every Wednesday and there are always error between the maps and the list of things to label. Also the things he teaches in lectures are very dry and he often contradicts his PowerPoints.

Richards at the beginning doesn't seem too bad but boy, he made a basic class feel like hell. Lot's of map quizzes & some of the most difficult tests I've taken for a 100 lvl course. He whips through his ppt's so fast you can't even get good notes. Lecture's were super boring & tests were all short answer & no study guides till the final.

With Professor Richards lectures are awful and long. You get a new map quiz every week with an impossible amount to study. There are only 2 exams and a final which are packed with information he hardly covers.  He contradicts everything he says verbally by whats online. He doesn't respond to emails in time or sometimes at all.

Dr. Richards made this class extremely dry. His lectures are very boring and long. He gives you a map quiz every week but his maps are terrible quality and it can make things very difficult. There are only 2 exams along with a final. I wouldn't recommend this class to anyone.

Richards is a very nice guy, who is very passionate about what he teaches. The problem is that this class was among the most boring I've ever taken. The content was just not even slightly interesting. If you have to take this class, he's a nice guy who does his best to make it slightly enjoyable, though he ultimately fails.
Dr. Richards is a casual kind of professor, but he is passionate about the things he teaches, and very knowledgeable. He also works hard to help students get involved with research.

Dr. Richards ran my labs this spring. He is very easy going and laid back. He doesn't care if things are late and lets you redo labs and quizes. His lectures can be long and boring but it is extremly easy to get an A in his class.

Honestly the worst professor I've ever had as harsh as that sounds. He was never clear with course objectives, never answered questions in class and NEVER responded to student e-mails. Course was disorganized and he lied saying that the exam and final paper were explained in his syllabus (neither assignment were on the syllabus). In short, just bad

He is HORRIBLE!!!! He never explains anything. He goes over the topics way to fast while standing in front of the projector. He is less than helpful when you ask him questions. Plus he has the  most annoying voice ever !!
He is never prepared, cannot explain any concepts, and bores you to sleep.  Luckily he taught the class like he was teaching 4th graders math.  Avoid at all costs
He was unclear about objectives and expectations. His exams were ridiculously difficult. he was unorganized and unprepared for class every day.

DONT TAKE IT IN THE SPRING. This guy has terrible teaching skills! Plus his exams were poorly written (multiple choice exams where you have to choose more than 1 answer)! The lab instructor (Dr Periera) was awesome and very knowledgeable, and I thinkg he teaches this course in the Fall. Take it with him and dont waste ur time with this guy.
have him for writing in earth sciences. I seriously wonder how some people get phd's. But it was an easy A and I would recommend taking him for writing or comp methods
Annoying class in itself, Academic Planning.  He's just an odd guy and he never responds to emails or anything or keeps you updated on due dates.  Dont think he even cares!

Objectives were very vague, especially b.c he expects so much from you.  overall he's a nice guy.  The material is BORING, so be careful. He is very willing to meet with you outside of class, as long as he remembers to show up. Did not try to even learn our names, for DELTA that's unacceptable and disappointing
Easy class, not that bad on work, but always unclear with the objectives. I do give him some slack though cause he has never taught the class before.

Very kind, caring professor. Easy to talk to. She takes the time to make sure her students are doing okay and will often insert relaxation/breathing exercises into class. I didn't love having to get up early for the class, particularly a public speaking class, but she made it easy. To get a good grade, just show up and do the work.

I have not even finished the first 5 weeks with this professor and my grades have seen numbers I have never seen to be so low. This is a class I thought I would strive in but with this class it was impossible. The assignments had little to no explanation, all online assignments never said how to complete anything and feedback was never given.

comment: Andrea Newman is one of the Best Professors I have had. Her best interest is in the students success. She gives easy extra credit to raise your grade. As long as you show up to every and give effort on assignments and participate in discussions in class , you will get a very good grade.

I really like her. She is so sweet and kind and you have many opportunities to bump your grade up. The final is just a group project, which is not difficult at all. Any class with her would be enjoyable. Totally recommend.
Super nice and funny, allows you to take quizzes a second time with your notes and classmates, easy presentation as final, overall easy A, definitely recommend taking this class
Motherly figure. So sweet.

If you are a lazy student, don't take one of her classes. I liked her a lot better for Psych of aging than cognitive, I think she works better with smaller classes. This class was very difficult. She gives you packets and packets of lectures that don't make any sense and are not helpful for studying. The class was horrible to sit through. I don't recommend this class.
Dr. Margolin was always good with clarifying material and worked well with all students issues and was very pleasant. Her tests were challenging but never misleading. I retained alot of information.

Seems like an easy class till you do the writing assignments and tests. She expects you to write down exact definitions or she doesn't understand what you are saying. This was one of the hardest psych classes i've taken. I only recommend this class if you are into biopsych type classes. Not a very effective teacher. I really didn't like her style at all. I don't recommend this class.

For a Cognitive Psych professor, she does a poor job at effective ways of getting material into Long Term Memory. Each class was miserable. Her teaching methods seem to assume that we have some background in Cognitive Psych. Maybe she would do better teaching in a Ph.D. program for Cognitive Psych. NOT UNDERGRADUATE

I DO NOT recommend Conitive Psychology unless you are in a Master's program or have a high interest level. Powerpoints were vary vague, and the book did not fully backup the Powerpoints and ovrall wasnt helpfull. For how specific the tests were, she was very vague with the lecture..I love Psychology, but this class put a bad taste in my mouth.

Class is composed of 4 multiple choice tests, 4 written assignments, 10 attendance quizzes, and a review project. Her tests are very detail specific, you need to know things inside and out. do NOT take this professor. she grades things way too hard, i got a B in the class when i am usually an A student. When she talks she is hard to understand and talks to us like we are 5. Ridiculously detail-specific class. Had I known how the class would pan out, I wouldn't have taken it. Powerpoints are long and rushed through in order to get all of the information crammed in. Tests are fair as long as you study your butt off.

HORRIBLE Teacher!! VERY BORING... I fell asleep in class more than once. She stops a lot in between what she is saying and never gets her point across. Only good thing about her is that she is a nice person when you personally get to know her. TERRIBLE CLASS

Easiest course I've ever taken in my life and I'm a senior in college. Not only that but she even offered a 10 point extra credit assignment!!!! As long as you do the work it's impossible to get a bad grade!

Professor Smith is simply amazing. She cares about her students and you have a lot of time to complete what she assigns. Plus, it's all very interesting. She's a really easy grader so you just have to try to get a good grade.

THE sweetest professor on campus. She feels so passionately about the environment and her class. She shows lots of documentaries but all related to the class and all of them very good. this was beyond the most best and easiest class you can take. One of my favorite teachers

comment: Easily my favorite professor at Brockport. He is the smartest man I have ever met and he really cares about his students. There is a lot of work for this class but I truly feel like I get what I pay for. Don't take it if all you want is an easy A. He really wants to help better you as a student, so don't be afraid to ask for help. I love this man.

Dr. Ireland is a very nice guy and truly cares about how you are doing in the class. You do a couple of essays, abstracts, and have a midterm and final exam. The material is mostly straightforward, but the Benjamin Franklin book is kind of dry. He likes to joke around a lot, take him if possible!

oh eddie rocks...but watch out for the weeks he quits smoking! haha...seriously though, its a kick ass class that everyone should take!
