Crazy teacher, funny at times. But it is a lot of counsling material. It is ALL memorization. He gives the questions and answers to the test but they consist of "list 30..."  SO GO TO CLASS. there are about twenty questions like that. there is only a mid term, final and little presentation. so dont fail anything or you will fail the class

Unless you want to be a drug counselor, don't take this class with this professor. It's like going to rehab once a week. I'm a nursing/biology major, and I'm so bored because he waters the science part down so much. Also, he repeats himself so much that you can tell he's used to only speaking to people on drugs. Tests are hard, all memorization.

Best class ever!  He is extremely helpful and tells you the actual questions on the midterm and exam--which are the only exams in the class. All questions are short answer/essay but if you have a good memory, you will be fine!  GREAT PROFESSOR!  Highly recommend him.

He is awesome!! I would recommend to anyone!! I love his class and I wish he taught more health classes on campus! Gives you the questions on the tests with the answers. Just take notes, go to class and you will pass.

Good and interesting class will do very well if you take notes in lecture. only a midterm and final and they are all short answer, basically memorize info and you will do really well, he is very nice and understanding. You could take this class just to get good grade
Very clear on what will be on midterm and final, easy if you study, recommend taking this class if you are good at memorization because that is all you will need for the class

Attendance is worth almost nothing in the class, and it makes it way easier to skip when I'm sick without feeling bad. If you do go to class, be prepared to talk a lot. She doesn't call on people by name but she'll wait until people participate during discussions. There's always lots of discussion, it's not very lecture heavy.

She's my advisor and when I needed help and she didn't know the answer, she walked across campus and back with me so we could find an ASC person to fix something on my schedule. I don't know if any of my other teachers would've ever gone out of their way for me like that and it was really cool to see she cared so much.

She is incredibly nice! If you care, she cares. Attendance is not mandatory but it is encouraged. She appreciates feedback from her students and in return likes students to actively engage. I took social media literacy and I 10/10 recommend.

She was great. She met with me outside of class all the time and even on weekends when I needed help so I could pass the class. I felt like she put a lot of effort into her classes and they were the most fun lectures i'd had. I wish she graded homework faster though.
She has way too many in class assignmentss, but she was nice and her class was usually fun. We get out early a lot too

She doesn't answer emails at all. Emailed her so many times and doesn't respond. She's nice but these classes are writing and research heavy. Don't know why I took the class but it is easy but alot of work.
Laura seems to really care about us. When I needed extra accommodations, she met with me outside of class for hours to help me get caught up so I wouldn't fall behind.
I loved her. She runs the social media minor and convinced me to switch because I like her classes so much. She grades fairly, and her lectures are a little unorganized but veeerrryyy fun.

This class has a lot of discussions and if the class doesn't read she lectures the class about it. She is aggressively against AI and will fail you for using it to write your papers. If you write your papers then you'll do fine, she's an easy grader and leaves a lot of feedback.

She's so much fun!! She really cares and uses slang. She feels like someone I'd be friends with and I've learned a lot from her. You have to read her assignment instructions carefully because she hides important details in them.

She was great!! She did a LOT of in-class group activities, like almost every day.  If you don't like that, you'll hate this, but it makes learning in the class way easier because you get to learn from each other all the time.

She is nice and very understanding when it comes to Dr appointments or absences but her class is just so boring. All she does is have us watch documentaries. She also frequently talks down on most religions and any opinion that she doesn't agree with. She also definitely doesn't read anything you submit.
pretty cool

Her class is mainly discussions but it's rlly not bad at all, exams are take home and open notes which is really nice, her class is pretty easy i mean you can't really fall def recommend, and don't buy the textbook
He gives great feedback on writing, is a fair grader and personable.

Jim is so sweet. Very accessible via email. His classes are entirely discussion-based, and incredibly constructive. I really enjoyed this class and learning how to critique others' writing while hearing critiques for my own work. His feedback is very helpful. Wonderful, wonderful class. Light-hearted and never stressful.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Gives good feedback']
comment: great teacher would absolutely take any of his classes again. his expection are very clear and as long as you participate you will do good.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Caring', 'Graded by few things']
comment: Jim is an amazing professor; so nice and understanding. Helpful via email if necessary. I would take ENG495 every semester if I could.  The class is mostly discussion, and the papers are review-style as opposed to analytical or research. I like it! Very mechanical each week, easy to enjoy if you like reading.

By far the best English professor I have encountered on the Brockport campus. Class sizes are often small which makes workshops more thorough. I left class a better writer. He is also very kind. It was always a night class I took with him and I always parked in a further lot from everyone else and he always offered to walk me to my car afterwards
He wants you to read and write better each assignment. Writing workshops > Lectures and tests everyday.

Dr. Wharton is a very sweet person. However, his classes are so simple that they are boring. If you want an easy class I recommend taking his class. However, he loves group projects and getting opinions from others. Not the best classes.

Jim is the saving grace of Brockport and I should have had him direct my thesis. He is available in his office, listens to students' opinions and concerns, and his true goal is to make students better writers. I had many discussions with him regarding life, writing, and education, and I will always remember them. He is the most personable professor

Jim is awesome! He is very helpful in class and in his office. A lot of the short stories we had us read were pretty good and it was nice that we got to workshop two stories, not only one. Group discussion is pretty interesting. Good class for writers, English majors, or anyone interested.

Jim is a great professor and a very helpful person to talk to for advice, especially about writing. His classes are all very discussion based, but it's not hard to comment on something you've read. I also liked that he graded assignments based off form and writing style, rather than what you chose to write about. TAKE HIM!!!

My GPA is 3.20. Whorton is a very personable prof. He loves to help, if asked. Classes are boring, but he has been my favorite prof. Easy class that you can get an A without doing much, besides writing countless critiques and 3 papers. I would take more classes with him.

Great guy, intelligent professor. hands down, he is the most personable professor in the english dept. THe work isn't easy but he will walk you through it.He's not infatuated by the sound of his own voice. Lecture is thoughtful, meaningful and with purpose.Too bad he didn't teach any of the lit. courses.

I loved Jim. I was a bit nervous to read my own writing out loud and have it critiqued but he forms a kind of family environment within the classroom so you don't feel intimidated at all. He is very understanding and kind. I didn't know this at the time but he is also an author! Check the library and read his stuff!

Horrible class to say the very least. If you are in this class as a non English major be prepared to get mediocre grades as a result. Wasn't a English major and still received average grades even after consulting other professors opinions. Incredibly bias and unfair. Even as a Gen Ed is isnt a class worth taking or a burden worth having.
Fun class, Jim is a great professor. Very laid back, and gives good feedback on your work. Would def recommend taking fiction workshop with him.

I had professor Whorton for creative writing. He is an amazing person and a great professor. He gives constructive criticism and never makes you feel stupid. Class discussion is really important and helpful in critiquing your work. This is the only class I've ever looked forward to going to. Definitely take creative writing with him!!
Jim is a great teacher! He's very supportive and encouaging about his students' works. His critiques are useful and he gives good feedback. He's a fair grader.
Jim is a great teacher! He is very encouraging about student's work and extremely helpful in the critiquing process. He's a fair grader and gives useful feedback about your work.

His classes are easy. We didnt have a midterm! Four writing assignments all semester! He didnt teach much..but he is a nice guy. He is an extremely hard grader. He doesb't hold it against you if you miss class. If you take his class, make sure your paper is maticulous! He will take points off for every misused/mispelled thing... 6 mistakes=D+!

Dr. Zollweg was a pretty good professor, the class was super easy, you do have to do a quiz at the end of every class, but they are short and for the most part the answers are in the lectures. The only major assignment was creating a map, nothing too bad. But overall, easy class with not much work outside of it.

This class was for lab credit, so there was a lot of homework every week. The homework isn't extremely hard, but it is time-consuming. Zollweg talks during class time about the lab exercises and any upcoming assignments. The only problem I had with Zollweg is that he didn't answer some of my emails. Besides that easy class and a nice professor.

He did not grade anything all semester. Did not take attendance. Did not respond to emails. Says he's a neutral professor but then went on for half of a class period about how CNN is not a biased news source.

This guy talks like molasses. The class is insanely easy, but by the time hes done with his 15 minute recorded lecture, I have to go back and watch it 3 more times because he takes so long to get to the point, that its easy to get distracted... or fall asleep.

He is hilarious. ESC195 is an easy A. It could be a lot of work at times, but it is manageable. He talks a lot and no one asks questions during his lecture because he just loves to express himself. You have to pay for TopHat. There are no required textbooks. Attendance is recorded on TopHat. His lectures can be boring at times. You will not fail.

He's very easy going and will answer any question he's given. The class is honestly fairly easy as long as you study the questions throughout the slideshow and make sure to go over them for the final too.

Prof. Zollweg is an outstanding professor. He is very responsive to students' questions and is willing to help out students as much as he can. The class is online and very easy to pass, just do the weekly assignments and you're good. He is very accessible outside of class and responds well to emails. Highly recommended for an easy 'A'

I am not crazy about science but found this course somewhat cool. However, he was an okay professor but his tests are just unethical. He gives choices a-h instead of a-d which makes it easy to get most questions wrong. He also had pic questions and some other pics were not clear at all If you want an A do every extra credit opportunity offered.

The class is really easy but it is super boring. Don't be tempted to skip though because he does keep track of attendance. He dosen't really care what you do in class though. Also you are allowed to use notes on the midterm and final. You literally should not get a grade less than an A it is the easiest class ever.
absolute worst professor I've had in my life, don't recommend to anyone at all. Horribly boring class, with tests that don't correlate with what he taught.

I highly recommend not taking this class, he makes it come across as a very simple course however he makes it very hard to get a decent grade and although he says attendance isnt mandatory he does little things to make sure you are there randomly and if youre not your grade drops immediately
Cool dude. Don't be dumb and show up for class

Dr. Zollweg is a fair and easy-going guy.  His passion for natural disasters is actually hilarious.  The course itself was the easiest course I have ever taken and I don't know how you could get less than an A if you tried.

The Final and Midterm have ridiculous questions on them that don't relate to the class. BUT he reuses many of the questions from the quizzes given out, so when you create a note sheet it is recommended you write down the previous quiz and test questions with the answers because you'll be going into the test with half the questions already answered.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES', 'LECTURE HEAVY']
comment: If you are considering taking a class with him don't. Especially ESC 195. He teaches it like a 400 level class and is one of the worst professors I've ever had. The final exam consisted of things that most of us never saw before. Avoid him and this class at all costs

This class satisfies the natural science with lab credit. Go to class and write down the quiz questions - they make the quizzes and tests really easy. If you do well enough in the class you MAY be exempt from taking the final exam. The labs are really short and straightforward (less than a half hour for most). He makes it really easy to get an A.

If you are planning on taking this class for honors, don't. We had to give a presentation at scholars day, but Zollweg has no idea how to lead a team. We never had any idea what was going on and had to spend a lot of time outside of class to understand what he wanted from us. He waited until last minute to put the presentation together  stressful

Is not helpful at all- doesn't answer emails or even question asked directly to his face. Pop quizzes and labs are easy but final is impossibly hard- not an easy A. Journal and paper won't bring your grade up.

Far from an easy A. Labs are pretty easy and pop quizzes are not too bad. You have to put in a lot of work into your natural disasters journals to get a good grade. His final crushes your grade, went from an A- to a B- just because of it. Says its a lot of questions from previous quizzes but its not, only about 8 of 50 were from previous quizzes.
Don't bother trying to email him or talk to him because he does not reply. Huge year long project due at the end of the semester. Open note quizzes.

Super easy going guy.  Randomly gives out extra points to people who come. Labs are easy and the instructor gives you answers. Pop quizzes randomly. He has a very monotone voice so you'll catch yourself nodding off. Multiple choice final with a few pics you have to describe. Easy A if you actually show up. Stay on top of the disaster journal!!!!

Natural disasters is almost a joke. He gets easily confused and seems like he doesnt know what is going on half of the time, but it is definitely worth it. This class is so ridiculously easy. He gives you most of the test questions and does the lab for you. easy A, definitely take, especially if youre in honors!
He was my lab instructor for honors. Super funny, really laid back and just gave us the answers to the labs. Definitely recommend!

Overall a really easy class. The only thing I would say that I don't like about him is that he NEVER answers your emails. It's really frustrating when you have a question about the course and he doesn't answer you. But overall, an easy A.

Attendance not mandatory- though if you go there are bonus quizzes, and points go on your average. Quizzes are all with a cheat sheet. If you have a good enough grade you don't have to take the final. And a simple 1 hr lab. Easy A.

Good teacher and makes class easy and fun for the students. He is laid back and realizes we have other classes too. He's generous when grading and I'm sure he would help if you had trouble with something. He made labs SIMPLE (if you had him). Lots of helpful videos, and you get out early a lot. You learn material and important things stay.
This guy is sooo nice and helpful!!! Tests are easy & you can even bring in a cheat sheet...very easy A...take his class!!

Natural disaster class with him is extremely easy. All tests are 40 multiple choice and are allowed to bring one big cheat sheet with you for tests. So final is just they same questions over and allowed to bring 5 cheats sheets with you. Dont even have to come to class and still get good grades.

This guy's a gem.  Class discussion pertinent to doing well. He is a proponent of critical reasoning and discussion- something any univ. grad. should be versed in.  Enjoyed his attitude and approach to learning- that the students should learn, apply, and discuss topics.

Zollweg is a very interesting guy.  He's quite eccentric, but it made the class amusing.  It's very obvious that he is a very passionate man, although he sometimes has some trouble conveying his passion and knowledge.  He bent over backwards to appease the students, even going so far as to give out test questions beforehand.  Funny guy.

I took more than one class with this guy, but he never really struck me as a great teacher. Really odd and just hard to communicate with. Always seems disappointed (could it be me maybe?) and zoned out of reality. Classes aren't that hard if you take good notes and are a good test taker, because they are generally open notebook.
GREAT teacher. Really nice, personable, funny guy. He doesn't act like your typical college professor. I really liked ESC364 and would def recommend it.

Oh man this guy has a little ADD going on. He is a riot when you watch him and his little ticks. Examples come from somewhere in left field. Class is a tad boring, but it was a computer course, so that might explain it. He is a great guy and very helpful.

The workload for an online course was hefty, which wouldn't be so bad if you weren't working full time. There is little communication and don't bother asking for an extension because you won't get one. You can have 24 hours to turn in a late assignment, but it's 20% off; basically failing for a grad course This is a mental health class, ridiculous.

Difficult to communicate with 
Unfair grader

Dr. Rhodes is an incredible professor. Yes, her class is difficult, but students often forget this is a 410 level class, it's not going to be easy. She is not a tough grader, she just expects students to do their work and contact her when you aren't understanding something. She wants to see her students put in effort, just try your best!

You do have to actually work but it is worth it and you feel accomplished. You learn so much from her assignments, and she is always willing to help. USE HER FOR HELP, SHE IS SO HELPFUL. Love her so much, and she connects very well with students. She makes you want to actually try.

As hard as this class is, this professor truly cares for her students. This class involves a lot of studying but do not be afraid because she is extremely accommodating and will work with you. I recommend taking this class with less classes and to study!
Dr. Rhodes is a great professor. She is willing to help but the issue is that she makes her class so unbelievably unnecessarily difficult.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Tough grader', 'So many papers']
comment: For an online class there was a lot of work load. I recommend taking less classes for the semester you take a class with her. You have to give more attention to her courses. Many chapters to read and many papers to write

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Test heavy']
comment: Hardest online class I've ever taken. She did the most! Way too many assignments due each week. You had to wait at the beginning of each week for her to open up the new module so you couldn't prepare ahead of time. Way too many textbook chapters assigned each week. Had to make a website for a group project. I'm not a slacker but the class stress

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read']
comment: Dr. Rhodes is a great professor. With that being said, make sure you complete all work she asks of you. This class is based on the readings and powerpoints so make sure to pay attention to everything. She has a great sense of humor, although it could come off as insulting, she means no harm. I would recommend her to anyone!

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Tough grader']
comment: She is the worst professor I have ever throughout my whole education career. I took a online class over the summer, and it was just terrible. We were expected to read 4 chapters of a book, 4 powerpoints, and a handful of videos each "module" and then take a 15 question quiz within 15 minutes. Many of the questions were specific and hard to find.

I wish I had something good to say about her but I just don't. It's not that the material is hard, it's that she is just looking for you to slip up in the smallest way so she can dock points. Was not friendly and does not care about student success. Not helpful at all. I care about my grades and I tried, but she was bent on giving me less than an A

Very tough grader. Large amounts of work due. The type of professor that feels their class takes precedent. Weekly quizzes on readings (40ish pages). You will leave this class with more knowledge than you started with. Most people struggle, some people switch majors due to this class.

Dr. Rhodes is the reason I decided to major in Public Health. She is an amazing professor. Her tests are difficult if you don't study, but if you go back through her slides all the information you need is there. I would take all my classes with Dr. Rhodes if I could.

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Get ready to read', 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: The worst teacher I have ever had. She did not do anything except being very critical. She offered no help and did not give clear directions. So sad that she teaches mental health. This class has a great potential to be very interesting but the professor just ruined it with times exams that had no sense and many meaningless homework assignements.

Very poorly organized. The professor did not engage at all. She did not even bother to make her own power points, lectures or notes. She assigned on average 4 chapters per exam (per week) and would ask very specific questions that you could answer only if you memorized it all. And the exams were times so you have only one minute per question. Sad

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Get ready to read', 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: Took an online class with her and it was a nightmare. EXTENSIVE amount of work given each week. Extremely difficult grader. You think you followed the rubric and then she'll always get you for something that you apparently left out. Mental health class and she legitimately made me want to jump off a cliff.

Avoid taking if possible. Tests are all short answers. Tough grading. Group project is not explained well and expects you to figure it out on your own. She has an idea of the right answer for her assignments but if you can't read her mind on what she wants you will have a hard time with this class.

She gives you way too much to do for how much credit the course is worth (3 hours). All of her tests you have to basically memorize 4 chapters of textbook info an regurgitate the information word-for-word; no multiple choice. She may be enthusiastic but she's one of those teachers who thinks her class is the only one you have.
This class is way too easy for a graduate class. Basically answers to exam questions are handed out to you before the exam. Study them and get an easy great grade.
There is something about Dr. Rhodes that is special. Her enthusiasm and passion shines brighter then the entire HLS department put together. She is by far the best professor in the department.

Professor Rhodes is very energetic. Doesn't really give homework but she gives pop quizes from the readings. Lots of group projects and assignments due at the end of the semester. Her test are short answers with some matching questions. Only take if you really need to. Can't miss class. Takes of points for grammar mistakes. Makes class hard.
She is amazing, one of best and most enthusiastic professors at Brockport! She grades tough, but she is fair! Study hard for everything and prepare to learn to public speak and present perfectly :)
Still one of my favorite teachers. Be able to apply what you learned for the tests. READ the readings. there WILL be pop quizzes. entertaining and will definatly learn something.

LOVE her! My favorite professor out of my 4 years of college. she has the great sense of humor. she is a hard teacher, but the class is not that hard. the test questions come right off the study guides, so just memorize those. a lot of group projects and strict when it comes to grammar mistakes, but overall great class!

Had her for Mental Health and Foundations same semester. She is really funny and really challenging. She sets her standards high but you actually learn from her. I enjoyed going to her class as most of them were interesting. Lots of group projects suck but SHE IS A GREAT professor, just don't be lazy

She keeps you going the whole class. She comes off as a high school like teacher but is always willing to help! Her tests are all critical thinking but if you know your material and how to apply it, they are fairly simple. Highly recommend her!
Dr Rhodes is fun and makes class interesting. The tests can be hard and pop quizes suck but otherwise its a good class and a good professor.

Took his class in 1993.  Best class and instructor I've ever had.  He is no longer with us, but has made a huge impression on so many.  Incredibly smart, master of interpersonal relationships, and a true humble person.  We all knew him for different trademarks.  During my time, he investigated the stochastic nature of "The Gizmo".  Doc is missed.

Fantastic teacher, really knows his physics, funny and passionate about his subject. Tough class though, "Physics in toys" and "101" are misleading. I've taken reagents physics in highschool and it's basically the same material, but the way he does it is on a higher level conceptually and much harder.
Very helpful as an advisor

By far the best prefessor I have ever had!! He didn't care if I knew the material, he made sure I understood it! He allowed me to love physics. He truely cares about physics and his students, and it shows! Wonderful guy! love ya doc!

He is by far the best prof at Brockport! The material is hard by nature but Doc is the most approachable person I've ever met! He helped me be successful in my dream of getting to vet school, and not by letting me slide through but by forcing me to work my tail off. This also helped to prepare me for what I am facing now at Vet school and it is just amazing! I loved Docs class and respect him more than I thought I could any person! He'll be missed if he ever leaves Bport for good. Take anything he teaches!
I only had him for advisement but he was super helpful and is such a nice guy.  I would definately reccomend taking a class with him.
physics without a calculator? ABSURD
Words can't begin to describe what an awesome teacher Doc is! He cares about the students and he truely loves physics and teaching.  Very laid back and easy to talk to. Smart guy too!
No Comments
Doc rocks the house!!  Great professor and great guy!!!  He will definately be missed!!

I've never had a class with Dr. Mancuso, but I had the opportunity to profile him for The Stylus. He's an amazing person with a lot of experiences. He's very witty also. A friend of mine has him for physics II and loves it. Everyone in the Smith Hall lounge (rm 127) loves him too. Great guy.
Hard class, nice guy

He is a great guy but expects 110% out of students, which is impossible if you are taking any other classes that take up time.  He flys through the material.  Be prepared to do a lot of work outside of class, and to spend a lot of time in his office.

Dr. Mancuso is an awesome guy. I have never actually had a class with him, but I've gotten to know him and his teaching style through a friend of mine who is taking physics. Great guy, I would recommend taking one of his classes.
Will do anything to help you
He is super physics guy
awsome

He is an awesome teacher.  He is enthusiastic about his work, and is willing to spend so much of his free time helping those who don't understand.  Of course, if you don't understand, you are expected to see him, he will not find you.
No Comments
This teacher is awesome, if you don't udnerstand, he will take as much time as you need until you get it.  The Physics is very interesting. He is a great guy, get to know him on a personal level.

He expects you to meet for several hours outside of class every week just to be able to completely understand the assignment.  He is a prof who does not care that you have 16 other credits to tend to as well
Best Physics professor there is

Professor Gursslin is great! She got back to all my emails very fast and was always very helpful. She made taking a course online a breeze. She is very clear on what is expected and does give students a chance for extra credit. I would highly recommend this course with Professor Gursslin.
If you are international students, you must choose her.
Dr. Yang is very nice, funny and knowledgable. Always willing to help students. Have a passion for accounting. Pay more attention to what she said before tests, you can do well.

Worst Professor I've ever had. Expects us to learn from powerpoints and that's it. Horrible, horrible, horrible professor. I've taken her class numerous times, only because she is the only one to teach the class and she shouldn't be teaching the course at all. So disappointed.

Very nice lady and class isn't too bad considering the material is very difficult. She has an accent, but is understandable. My only problem with her is that she relies on the PowerPoint a little too much. Tests are like quizzes and homework problems. She gives a lot of partial credit on exams. I would take a class with her again.

She is a sweetheart, and definitely knows her stuff. The course is hard itself because the materials are hard but not because of her. Pay attention to anything she says prior to a quiz, because she is basically telling you the answers to the quiz. Too bad she is leaving Brockport, she is good.
Sorry that she is leaving, one of the best accounting professors at Brockport.

Does have a accent but after awhile will become use to it. One of the most helpful professors at brockport (you need to seek it out though). The class its self is tough but not because of professor yang. Recommended professor
nicest teacher i have had at brockport.  knows what she is talking about, just go to class and pay attention.

Yang is very hard to understand. She has a thick Asian accent although she knows what she's talking about. I learned more from the tutor. Book is required. Attendance is mandatory. Weekly quiz. Test every 3 chapters. In order to understand her, you should know these beforehand: "messurd"= method; "yurly"= usually; "mockteeng"= marketing.
This teacher is good and very helpful.  I took this class last semester and I enjoyed it very much. The projects are easy but time consuming. The test are faily easy.  I recommend her.
Really good teacher, prepares you well for tests.
Best accounting prof., but have to work harder ...
very bad prof

I was nervous after reading these reviews, but I'm taking accounting with her this semester and I love her! She's very patient person and a very good teacher. Yes, her accent gets in the way sometimes, but she repeats  herself alot so you will understand. Do the homework-the test problems are exactly the same. I wish she taught ACC282!
Very sweet teacher however she is difficult to understand at times.
She is a very knowledgeable,  patient and understanding teacher. She will do everything to contribute to your academic success. If you need to take accounting class, take it with her.
Very hard to understand her because of her accent. Makes it hard to understand what she is talking about. Make sure that it is your only hard class because it needs your full attention!
Wonderful teaching Style!

Great teacher!  A little hard to understand at times because of her accent, but she is very accessible to students when they need extra help.  She goes above and beyond.  I highly recommend Dr. Yang for anyone who is an accounting major.
While she may not be very clear, she is a good teacher, always willing to help.
Great teacher!

She is a good teacher. Her English is hard to understand. Her teaching style is great!  I enjoy taking this course.  I did not pass the first time at MCC, but I passed here at Brockport.  I don't recommend taking her if there is another teacher available! If not, she is a great teacher, you just need to develop some patience!

Yea she is a nice lady but you just can't understand her. It is so hard to figure out what she is saying that it makes it hard to take the class with her. I had to pretty much teach myself the class through the textbook. If you can take it with someone else.

tags: ['Clear grading criteria', 'Gives good feedback', 'Graded by few things']
comment: great lectures that help prepare you for papers. readings assigned outside of class are also used in papers. papers were graded fairly and received good feedback. only downside was the grades were based off of papers and reading quizzes only

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Graded by few things', 'So many papers']
comment: Professor Moyer knows his subject. My course focused on Salem and it was by far the most interesting course I've ever taken. The primary focus was producing a research paper, but he breaks it down with deadlines so it's not overwhelming. If you attend class and participate, it'll pay off when you need extensions later. He's a solid choice.
I love Dr. Moyer! He thoroughly explains all assignments, you never have to question what he wants. He lectures great and makes sure all students are heard.

Great professor. Lectures are really well organized and easy to follow. Discussion days you are expected to have done the readings and participate. There are 5 min. quizzes in the beginning of discussion days. These consist of no more than 3 questions. There are no exams just unit essays and a final paper. If you do the work you'll enjoy his class.

He's very smart, witty, and an enjoyable lecturer, and classes are fairly casual and fun.  Tough  paper grader, and VERY tough presentation grader no matter how good yours is. (Everyone in my class suffered there.)  You'll learn a lot in his class and he'll make you a better writer, but expect to lose half a letter grade just from the presentation.

Best professor I've had at Brockport so far! I've taken a couple of his classes and plan to continue to do so. Class is very structured and he is a tough grader but you learn a lot and it's not hard as long as you put in a little effort.
One of my favorite professors at Brockport. Lays out exactly what he wants and if you follow directions for papers and do readings you will do well in both of these classes

Prof. Moyer is the best. He's funny, and he really knows his stuff. He just has a great personality. He doesn't require a textbook, but he has readings online that we have to do. DO THE READINGS. It's college. Readings should be expected. Beyond that I genuinely have nothing negative to say about Moyer. Can't wait to take another class with him!
Really nice, funny guy.  Lectures are interesting.  Very tough grading, but is willing to help, if you miss class you're screwed
I have faculty access to his grades. No one gets an A. Period. He's a nice guy who is willing to work with you. His class is professional and well-structured and you will learn a lot.

Dr. Moyer is very friendly and outgoing. Class is mostly reading articles and then discussing them. 3 integrative essays and 2 book reports due throughout the semester. Consistent participation in class is required.

Nice guy, very friendly. Class consists of 2 short 5-6 page essays and an 18-25 page research paper, with a 10 min class presentation on your paper. For the most part the class is reading articles and discussing them. High participation is required. He is very demanding. Marks up papers for grammatical errors more than English professors do.
Very demanding professor. Required five essays. Has a strict attendance policy. Was not very responsive to requests for help.
He's a really nice guy.  The class wasn't too hard.  It was just essays and he was more than willing to look over drafts and give you tips for improvement.
Awesome teacher, enthusiastic, requires you to read for class discussions, not too much though. No test or quizzes, just 4 essays throughout the semester. Great class

Fantastic. One of the best professors i have come across. As everyone else has said, he is very demanding. I mean this in a good way though because even though his classes were a lot of work, you get so much out of them and really get a feel for the subject.

I have heard bad things about Dr. Moyer. I am glad they turned out to be untrue. Class was mostly discussions with little lecture. No tests, just a couple papers and a final research paper. Very willing to help outside of class and guide you in the right direction.
He is very, very knowledgeable.  Class consisted of reading and taking quizzes then 4 papers throughout the year.  Did not have to purchase any books which was a plus.
Interesting lectures. Funny/understanding guy, I definitely wouldn't mind a class with him as my professor again!
One of my favorite professors at Brockport.

Awesome class! Very structured. No text book to buy. A lot of article readings. No exams or quizzes. 3 response papers & 2 integrative essay papers.  Class participation is a must.  Dr. Moyer is a great prof with a good personality and does a good job of making class fun. Hes a tough grader but allows you to submit rough drafts. Highly recommended

One of Brockport's finest. Funny, down to earth, and cares for his students. One might also say he is a bit quirky, but that can be good. I never had a more structured class, which was extremely conducive to learning. Taking his class added a level of sophistication to my writing. Great classes, great teacher, great guy.
If you can't write essays good don't take this class that's just about all it is. Class participation counted as 15% of total grade and had random pop quizzes. He is a nice guy though.
Very informative class very well tought. Grading can be tough but it is definitally fair. I would recomend taking any class of his.
He's and awesome teacher. He's very funny, and very clear about what he wants from students.

My opinion has changed about Dr. Moyer; he's settled down a lot and he's not such a hard grader anymore. He's improved as a teacher and an advisor. I took Native American History with him as an undergrad, and Early America Seminary with him as a grad, and I noticed a marked difference in the quality of his teaching; he's more effective than before.

Hes a real nice guy. Presents the information in a manner that is clear and easy to follow. Lots of reading, but for the most part its interesting reading that will really help you on papers and in lectures. Likes students to talk, A LOT! Def take him if you can.
No Comments

Dr. Moyer has a great sense of humor and a strong command of his subject.  I learned a great wealth of information about American Indians in his class.  If you're unsure about your writing quality, turn in a draft.
He knows what he's teaching and has a good personality.  He gives alot of work, but you will learn the material more than any other course if you put in a little effort.
Good class, great teacher

Do not take this class. Dr. Moyer is the such a hard teacher. I feel like he thinks I'm getting my PhD. Needs to relax a little on his expectations. This class stressed me out so much that it ruined most of my semester.

EXAMS ARE ESSAYS IN EARLY AMERICA... TEACHES STUDENTS LIKE THEY ARE MAJORS!! GOOD LECTURER BUT YOU GET NOTHING OUT OF LECTURE TO WRITE THE PAPER... DO NOT TAKE 211 WITH HIM, I SUGGEST SOMEONE EASIER BECAUSE IT SHOULD BE AN EASY COURSE WHEN YOU ARE NOT A HISTORY MAJOR!!! GOOD LUCK WITH 6 ESSAYS IF YOU DONT TAKE MY ADVICE
Lots of reading, pop quizzes, and boring lectures.  Stickler when it comes to grading papers.

Clear, concise lecturer, but difficult. No slacking off in his classes! Do the reading! Very hepful, always in his office to help with papers. Not an easy grader, you definately earn it. Well worth taking.
Dr. Moyer totally ruined my passion for history. His grading is crazy and just adds stress to college life. Do not recommend him for anyone and would not take a class with him in the future

Real nice guy, tries to get to know you, do the readings, there is alot of small ones, if you pay attention somewhat, and do the 2 essays, and know the study guide for the tests, its an easy A, also participate from time to time, he likes that
Dr. Moyer is a wonderful professor.  He is very knowledgeable and helpful, but make sure you proofread your papers, he's serious about grammer.
Professor Moyer is a very good teacher who is always willing to take the time to help students who are struggling.  He makes you work, but he also makes things interesting.

prof moyer is a great professor- i dont like history and i really enjoyed his class. do the work and participate in class a little and you will do well, and its not too hard beacuse he makes it truely interesting. plus he really knows his stuff!
i think we are going to have a pop quiz today...smile smile smile...****

Professor Moyer is one cool dude.  He takes pride in his knowledge and teaches at the students' level.  The readings are frequent but they and manageable.  He grades fair and gives you a bangin' study guide.  Definetly recommended for anyone.
Interesting course, incredibly tough grader.
Fair teacher....must read for every class, but is fair and expects class participation. Tough but worth it!

Professor Moyer was an amazing teacher...I HATE history studies, and he makes it interesting, and he is always willing to help you on tests, and essays, and tell you what you need and what is missing!  Thanx professor Moyer!
pretty cool guy, is cool to talk to in office hours too
The class is not hard at all if you do the readings and study for his tests. He is very intelligent and helpful.

MUST READ AMERICA'S HISTORY, good explination, gives cram sheets for exams, lots of pop quizzes but only in america's history, some video more twards the end, nice teacher, made up own writing style, essay tests, not easy but fun class
Professor Moyer is awesome!  His class is structured so its easier to follow history for non-majors.  Theres alot of reading but its broken down into small portions so its very manageable.
Good teacher!
I loved this class, and learned a lot! Now I want to be a History teacher. Yes, he is a tough grader, but I think he's fair. A lot of work, but you get a lot out of it. Great class!
No Comments
he's tough because he expects you to learn and take class seriously--something most b-port students have trouble with.  he's very nice though and cool. great guy. good historian.
No Comments
Very cool! Demanding but you are there to learn are'nt you? Knows everything. Always willing to help. Fun, especially on Civil War.
No Comments
No Comments

He is very clear on what he wants but he is a tough grader. He rips papers apart worse than an english teacher. He is takes attendance everyday and gives homework everynight. The class itself is not hard but you have to be willing to work.
He is a tough grader, although he says there's no blind regurgitation of facts he expects you to know EVERYTHING about a topic!!

Those who can't do, teach. Those who can't teach, assign a boatload of out of class work to make up for their deficiencies. I'm not sure why the worst professor is teaching the hardest courses. Dr. Blose is far more qualified and a much better instructor.

Saputo is great with lecture. She gives lots of resources to help you succeeded in lecture. The lecture content is not hard, you just have to try. However, she is a below average lab professor. Try not to take a lab with her. Her lab grading is really inconsistent. Multiple dry labs given to help improve your grade just for her to grade harshly.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Test heavy', 'Graded by few things']
comment: TA's and students are frustrated that Dr Saputo isn't able to dumb down the material or answer questions to make lecture and lab easier. I needed to withdraw and take the lecture and lab through SUNY Empire so that I could have a chance at passing and understanding the material for ORGO 1. Awful lab prof. she flaunts her research in your face during office hours and doesn't care to answer your questions. will take off pts in anything and everything. I dread going to lab with her. she is very smart but she makes you feel dumb. she doesn't care if you fail. she is kind of funny with corny chm jokes but I don't recommend this prof.

Very tough grader, not great with communication let's you do everything you after explaining picky about how lab notebook is setup will be told to leave the room and do it again missing quizzes. Points docked  forgetting lab glasses and need to borrow a pair or if your not dressed to her lab standards you'll be made to leave change then come back.
Clearly a very intelligent person but is very out of touch with students. Doesn't behave professionally. Needs to be "in charge". Not a good fit for an educator.

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Tough grader']
comment: Dr Saputo's a nice person but is out of touch with her students. She's a very harsh grader, lots of homework, office hours aren't very helpful, and isn't easily accessible to communicate with. She's intelligent and makes tests so difficult I know classmates who cheated on each test in person and online. Sucks to end up with an honest but soso grade

This man will put you to sleep. I thought this class had the potential to be interesting. He will put in a CD ROM and in a monotone voice repeat back to you what the CD has already said. Quizzes are difficult, and you wont learn half of what is asked on them. Do yourself a favor and avoid at all costs

worst teacher ever. so boring and monotone, not helpful at all very unorganized. smart guy but can't teach. you never know when the quizes will be or what will be on them. i would take the class if you need it but not with him.
Awful teacher
Not a very exciting person, but knows his material.  Thought his grading policies were rather strange - pop quizes counted the same as a test, etc.  Make sure you aren't tired when you come to class.

Class can be quite boring. He is a nice guy; he tries to help people boost their grades because the quizzes can be tough. I recommend taking notes (even though I didn't) and trying to stay awake. Also, pay attention to his overhead things--he has a lot of them--they usually show up on tests. In a paper, focus on details rather than writing style.
The guy is super nice but the class is kind of boring.  there isnt a final or midterm, theyre papers instead and he grades them super easy.  quizzes are hard.

His lectures are very boring but don't skip! Stick it out- do the work and don't miss in class work that counts for quiz grade and you'll do fine. I didn't think I was doing well but got an A-. Just do the work and he does help for papers. I handed in drafts for both and got A's. Make sure it's done right. Recommend if you like work + A's.

Very easily the worst professor I have ever had!  He is rude, unclear, stuck up, he can't teach for anything, he can't explain for anything, he has nothing to back up his grades.  I have always had VERY good writing and VERY good grades on my papers, and h
Gives 4 page papers instead of a midterm and final test which is nice and easy. Tests are hard but there are 9 so one bad grade wont kill your average. You can get away easily w/o the book.
Very boring and unfair..he let those who got D's on a paper because they forgot a bib page(plagerisim) redo theirs but those who used MLA instead of AMS he said no way.
very unclear. extremely dry presentation. if you like to sleep....go here. But does give decent notes--but tests are crazy confusing and puts forth extreme details to unnecessary questions.

Fairly rude, unclear about paper, the majority of the class got c's because we did not use the American Meteorological Society's formatting style, which was not mentioned. includes unclear questions in quizzes and only covered 1/2 of material intended

Awful. Will not help you outside of class even if you ask. He believes his class is more important than all others and will not bump you from a c- to a C even if you need it to graduate. Absolutely obsessed with himself. Take it with another professor.... you have been warned.

Took this online, I love her formatting and how it's clear what needs to be completed each week. She responds to emails and there are some movies you need to watch for the class, but they are interesting and free on YouTube. Overall, easy A if you do the work each week.

Very easy class, definitely take if you're a senior and need an easy credit. The assignments were: Current events research, questions about a movie, interview a healthcare professional, a short paper, a book review, and a short research paper, 7 really easy little assignments, and discussion boards. There was a midterm and no final exam.
A good class to take. Loved the format she posts the assignments in and any questions asked, she answers quickly
Doesn't give any guidelines for assignments and also doesn't give feedback on papers just a grade. How are we supposed to learn if we don't even know what we did wrong?
She cares about her students and she really cares about the content that she is teaching but she is unorganized and doesn't follow her syllabus.

In her classes, there isn't much work. But to understand the information in class its better to read the information. Her power-points are very long, and talks the entire class time. If you ever ask a question, she usually jumps from topic to topic, not clearly answering your question; same goes for the notes; not very clear. Not many grades.

Professor Wilson is such a great teacher. She really cares about making sure you learn. She gives quizzes that are fairly easy, but make sure you study. She cancelled class sometimes because she would travel out of town and in place of that, you'd do an online short assignment. Definitely take any class with her that you can!!
I took Economics 100 with Professor Brazill. It was an easy course, if youre on top of it, then you will pass and get a good grade. You can definitely tell she takes this very serious.

Economics is probably one of the hardest college classes to take but she doesn't make it any easier. I recommend taking Micro first and for Macro DON'T take it with her. We were supposed to meet M W but only met on M. She does practice in class when like none of the material is covered and makes it even more confusing. A lot of the work is online.

tags: ['LOTS OF HOMEWORK', 'BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES', 'Amazing lectures']
comment: Professor Brazill knows her material well. She provides lengthy explanations and shows interesting videos that relate to the class discussion. Ample opportunities are provided for extra credit. Make sure you do all the homework or you definitely will not pass. She may seem condescending as some students have insisted but it's just her demeanor.

Blanding is the best! Most classes discussion based. You group up to answer questions based on the chpt that was assigned then discuss with class. 5-6 pg paper at end of semester and small presentation on something youre passionate about that is relevant. Do not worry about workload, VERY VERY manageable. Learned SO MUCH, enjoyed every minute!

After one day of class, i knew i had to drop it. On the first day of class we did calculus problems. This class does not have a calc. prerequisite, so i knew this guy was not the teacher for me. Besides that, his english was horrific. Even if no calc was used i still would have dropped it because i could barely understand this guys spoken english

His English is really bad. He does not come up with good examples, does not know a good way to explain things. He is a smart guy but has not business to be a college professor. I went to see him during his office hours and he was angry and hostile, did not want to help me. Do not take his course if you really want to know your stuff.
Knows his stuff. Very helpful in office hours. Will try to explain whatever you need in class. For those complaining about calculus, get over it. Calc is a prerequisite in the department.

Had him as a night class and kept us till 9:15 on the dot. he doesnt take attendance but if you miss a class your screwed for the quizzes that are every other week. had us buy two book and didnt touch either one. curves like crazy though, had like a 60 something and left with an A-

Very difficult to understand. His english is very bad imo and with a difficult class makes it even worse. You need to have a good base in calculus for this class because even on the first day, you are going over formulas that you will need to apply to the problems in the book.

This guy is SUPER hard, but he's also very helpful if you go to his office hours.  He doesn't use the textbook, and writes everything on the board.  He really does care that students learn, but the material is just so hard.  He is a gifted young professor, though.

He's hard to understand but he's not really a horrible teacher. His tests are absurdly easy if you do the practice tests and just read the book. He's not super helpful after class and doesn't know what's in the book, but he knows the material well.

He definitely knows what he's talking about. He does have an accent but you get used to it. He will repeat himself to try to clarify and will always try to answer any question you have in class. He tends to race out of class the second it's dismissed so good luck trying to catch him after class. If you pay attention, you'll definitely learn.

Does not know how to teach at all. I think he is an adjunt for Brockport. Needs to learn to speak english. Class is useless. He assumes you took calculus and aced Stats 1. Do not explain anything fully. Gets side track on problems unrelated to class
He is a very easy going professor. Assignment instructions are very straightforward and he always responds to emails quickly

Great professor that adds humor to the course content during the lectures. You absolutely have to read the textbook and take notes if you plan to do well in his class. He's very reasonable with the exams and additional work required for the class.
Honestly a really cool dude who means no harm. Expects you yo go to class which you should. Grades pretty tough but sometimes goes off on tangents.

comment: He is the man! Many students don't like him because they don't  have interest in the subject and/or expect to have grades handed to them.
Doesn't post lectures or PowerPoints, so read from the text.  Takes a long time to grade.

Professor Mihalakas is one of the best professors I had so far at Brockport! The class itself is very tough due to the heavy content, but as long as you read the textbook/take notes in class you'll pass. He purposely makes his exams tough to make sure that you understand what is being taught; he also gives extra credit throughout the semester.

nope, just walk away now.  He is the kind of person who needs to be right, even when you are giving an opinion.  He makes the first two tests hard on purpose in order to get rid of students.  this came from his own mouth.  Way too passionate about what he teaches, to the point he gets annoyed if you don't agree with him.

A very good professor, not easy but you learn and have to work. Regarding low reviews, chances are students were expecting to be given an A and were surprised that they actually needed to do something.

Only took his course because he's the only one who teaches it and I need to graduate. Seems to have straightforward expectations up front but make changes without informing class. Assigns groups for papers and presentations so there's a good chance you'll have incompetent group members. Feedback is lacking and/or vague
He teaches you what to think and not HOW to think. A very damaging way to teach a college course that is about you finding out what's important to you for when you enter the business world.

Class -Need to read Textbook -4 tests (30 questions each) Avg:C- -3 papers (group papers) 4-5 pages each Avg: 7.510 Professor: He studied law in Washington but brought nothing from his experience in the real world to the classroom. I enjoyed being in Professor Mihalakas' class. You definitely have to read the book to do well on his tests, but his lectures are entertaining and helpful. I like his dry, and sometimes goofy, sense of humor. I recommend this professor, although I have heard less positive opinions from fellow students. I guess it depends on the person.

He was interesting and funny and I liked it when he was mean to people. I did not find his teaching style to be that terrible. I only got a C- but thats all I needed. If I can pass a class that is only graded on 4 tests and a final, without doing any of the reading and allowing about an hour study time before the test, then its an easy class.

Avoid!  Although his tests and assignments are fairly easy and it's not by any means impossible to get a good grade; he is not a very understanding guy.  He thinks his class is your only class.  Rude and harsh personality wise.  Good teacher but not worth it.

Very strict professor! Does not wait for you to take notes from the powerpoint slides and scolds those who ask him to slow down so they can finish writing. The only homework was reading assignments. One 30 page group project due before the final. He can be rude at times with little patience for anyone who challenges his views. Not recommended.
Very difficult professor, does not post notes on angel, must read the textbook to pass the exams, no homework assignment, one group project, grades strictly. Would not recommend.

AVOID AVOID AVOID! This guy is fairly new and I feel that he has no sense on how to structure a lecture. He is ruthless without a care and it's a huge disappointment. His tests are extremely hard to prepare for since he tell you to study EVERYTHING and then test you on a fraction of it. Unless you're taking just his class, forget it!
Not a good teacher. Just looks good. Her knowledge is very shallow. Exams are way easy... probably don't need to come to class.

Simple and a lot of common sense. Need to study a little for final b/c it can be trickier than you think it would be. The paper is intimidating but i ended up getting my first 100 in 3 years of college on a paper.
Highly recommended, very nice, helpful and material is mostly common sense.
I took public saefty with her it was a a great class. She  really is a good teacher. Her tests are easy if you study the night before. She is hot as hell too.
Really nice and helpful. Good at teaching

I am going to have to retake this class due to him
Really good professor, lectures seem to go on for a while but i have an hour and fifteen minute class with him. Solid teacher, just not a whole lot of things to be graded on.

I have no idea how he has gotten such good ratings so far. im a junior and he is 10/10 the worst professor I've ever had. his reads directly off of a piece of paper, goes so fast through lecture, and doesn't give good lecture or resources to be successful. he is so unorganized and old fashion in his teaching methods. try not to take him if you can

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'TEST HEAVY', 'LECTURE HEAVY']
comment: Good teacher. Tests are difficult even though they are open note, you still have to know the material because the tests are very lengthy. He writes and talks fast so keep up. I got a D+ in the class and I will probably retake it with him. Its more about how you take notes and being organized for his class. Can be a rude but I think its funny.
not a bad teacher, but do expect to pay attention and show up for every class.  the test are hard and include trick questions, so you have to learn the material.
Tests are the same as the hw. just print the answers and bring them to exams

Hes a nice a guy I would take his class again but things you should know, he goes so fast you have to keep up and listen because you will get lost, but he does go over the same type of problems several time. It is open note which is really great !!! not all professors allow that, but you still need to know the material and prepared for the test.
Great guy!  Easy class, everything is open note and tests are straight from review problems done in class.  Take good notes and pay attention and you'll get a good grade without much effort.

one of my favorite professors. he truly wants to see everyone succeed. he is extremely helpful and will go really slowly through the material if you need him to. he's an understanding guy and has a fun personality that makes a class like stats interesting. open note tests but still a difficult class. quizzes used as attendance. i recommend.

Good Professor. All tests are open notes! All the notes/PPTs and answers to the homework are put on ANGEL. There are small quizzes given after you go over homework. As long as you come to class, pay attention and takes notes you will do well in this class.

Great professor. He's good at expalining the material and all homework and class work are posted on angel along with the answers. I strongly recommend printing those out becaues all of his test are open book.

All the tests are open notes, but don't let that fool you. He asks questions that are the opposite of what we learned in class so you have to learn how to flip the problem. He is a nice guy, but the class is really hard!

Great Teacher. I had taken this class before and didn't understand anything. Ask questions- he is super helpful! Get out early everyday, but make sure you don't miss a class because he gives random quizzes!

Doesn't take attendance, though you need to come to class every day to understand material. Take good notes because every test and quiz is open notebook. Doesn't use textbook, puts all problems online. I would recommend taking this course with him.

I don't know how anyone could complain about Gluckman. Everything is open notes/book. His quiz ?s are so easy that its like xtra credit. he's terrible

comment: I took this course during the summer session which required the book (did not use) and purchase of the online code to complete assignments and exams. Naomi was the best professor I've ever had. She is organized and a very interesting teacher. Unlike most professors she actually cares for her students & will do whatever she can to help. Amazing woman!
Naomi is a really awesome professor who really cares for her students.

This is an extremely boring class. He just lectures the whole time and you basically have to teach yourself in order to do good. There is tons of quizzes, there's a project done in steps, so stupid, and there is a few exams. I don't recommend this class unless you're willing to teach yourself anthropology.

nice guy, but he is a master of talking for hours about anything not related to class-we didnt have ANY grades until after midterm, and he assigned three (3) essays on the last day of class, no joke. last day as in we wont be seeing him again since there is no final.  other than that nice guy though.  but honestly will try to avoid classes with him
He was SUPER boring...just rambled on all class.  Not funny  but tries to be. I couldn't stay awake for his NOON class! that's an issue.
if youre looking for a gen. ed for a science it might as well be this one.  curves the hell out of the tests
i've had chuck for several classes and he's hysterical and super nice, anyone who doesn't love this man is heartless!

Very cool guy, who really knows his stuff! You'll learn a lot if you actually pay attention and *gasp* do the work!

Too hard for a 100 level class, you can bring a cheat sheet to the tests though.

The ideal teacher, mixed lecture with visual and even added in some comic relief. Perfectly clear on what he expected of students and completely fair when it came to grading. I definitely recommend this class and prof.

Don't take this if all you need is a science. Very hard material, and a big bore to me. Definitely knows his stuff though. Too big of a class hurt his effectiveness I think.

Great teacher, you can tell he knows his stuff and has been doing it for a while. Read the chapters, come to class and do the project and you'll get at least a B. Also has a good sense of humor. Watch for the ape walk!
Dr. Edwards is a good teacher...he's very enthusiastic about the class, and I would definitely take another class with him.

Edwards is a big dork.  He tries to be funny and his tests are alright.  The project is bogus and the material is bland.  He doesn't get in touch with students because of the large size.  Don't take this if you care about getting a good grade - you won't.
his class is interesting. his papers are hard and meaningless. but the content of the class was good. the tests are made into movie script so they are easy to understand.
Intelligent. Interesting. Fun. Very consistent. A great scholar. Amazing person willing to help you improve. Encouraging and motivating. Cool!
A lively Professor, and different in his approach. His jokes are funny and different. Love his primate inpressions: walk and vocals. Very helpful and very, very knowledgeable.
Awesome teacher, tests are very fair, overall great guy..highly recommend him to anyone remotely interested in human evolution!
Dr.Edwards' class I found a bit challenging but it was so interesting and fun that it was worth it. I got a lot from that class and I just took it as an elective to fill a core.

great teacher, easy class, he's leniant with attendance.  take as many classes with him as possible!!!!!!

wonderful person, with strong enthusiasm and interesting stories and examples. willing to share his personal experiences with his classes. and the ape walk is DEF priceless!!!!!!!!

comment: I really REALLY struggle with math, and Daly made it possible for me to pass and even enjoy the subject! Attendance is really important and I still had to study, but he made the material accessible. Tip: This is a better class than any other stats class, so if you need it for any other major, take this one! It transfers!
He was awesome, open book exams, simple homework, easy A class if you put in the work. I can't imagine people not getting an A, A- in the course. Plus he's funny!

Daly!!! He is an amazing professor that gives very clear lectures and tries his best to help students who don't understand and he does it in the nicest possible way. Homework online is from the textbook. He gives lots of handouts so if you forget  can just refer to those. He reviews until everyone understands!! Multiple extra credit chances.
Awesome professor! Makes stats so much easier to understand by giving real world examples. Literally one of the best professors I've had. Also resembles Jason Segel.

hes an awesome teacher! I hated statistics i failed it the first time and didnt want to take it again but he seriously made statistics one of the classes in psychology I knew I wasnt going to fail! hes seriously the best math teacher I have ever had throughout my education if you can take him for psych statistics DO IT!!!! hes amazing

Dr. Daly is a great professor, he lets you use your notes for your midterm and final. He has a good sense of humor and cares about his students! I would highly suggest this class even if you are bad at math, he makes it easy!
OMG--TOP Professor ever to be with

Took stats with Mulvaney a couple years ago. Big mistake. Re-took it with Daly and couldn't be happier. I learned more, I was more engaged, and my grade was way better. If you're going to take stats, take it with Daly!

What a great teacher! I took stats with him, and was sure I was going to fail because I am so terrible at math. He made it relate-able and it really helped me learn. I wish he taught every math class! Also, he is quite attractive.

Professor Murphy is a very goofy man. He is very knowledgeable in dance, and I learned a lot from his class. He cracks lots of jokes. It was very easy overall, just try your best and you will earn an A!
Very sweet professor, I enjoyed every class. I definitely would recommend for anyone who needs a fine art credit or just an elective credit. Very easy, just participate.

This class was very fun. I was nervous about it at first, but Professor Murphy made us feel comfortable. You have to participate. This class is not stressful and he will always help you if you don't understand a part of the dance.

Nice guy, bad at responding to emails, takes attendance for a grade, put in effort and get an A, some group dances, must go to dance performances for a grade, very few and easy out of class assignments.

This teacher is my favorite teacher I've had and I am not a school person. He makes every class fun and is the sweetest. The assignments are easy and the class is fun but you also learn a lot in the process. Not overcomplicated!

Took this course with no previous dance experience and loved it. He will work with your level. I haven't received my grade yet but last I checked it was an A. comment: Fun class, really need to practice your dancing if you want a good grade. Doesn't care if you're bad as long as you try. Always cracking  corny jokes ;)
Eddie is amazing. the class is hard but he is a great teacher

Great Class. You must show up but its a lot of fun and Eddie is great. Practice the dancing on your own and he'll see that you at least try. Don't **** to him that its too hard cause he doesn't care at all.

I do not recommend Lerong He, unless she is your only option. I took this class online for Summer. Requirements each week, discussion,test,summary. I would say Dr. He is a decent professor. Her classes are just PowerPoint lectures, boring, but she does know her material. For assignments, she assigns weekly quizzes on Blackboard that require Lockdown Browser and she has group projects and individual written assignments. She's a moderate grader. I recommend this class if it's for your major.

Professor He is very knowledgeable in the content she teaches, and is very energetic and passionate with what she does. However be prepared for many assignments, quizzes, homework, and a big group project. If you pay attention to lectures (mostly powerpoint presentations), then you will be golden.
taking an online class, it's hard to rate the professor herself, but her class has a lot of work and she never, ever, responds to emails

Worst teacher I ever had. There are two tests worth 50% of your grade, 9 chapters each. No study guide. Homeworks are worth 3 points but she is such a tough grader and makes them pages long. Online quizzes with 10 questions but only gives you 10 minutes to do them, half the time I could never finish. She refuses to give you more time. Do not take!!

She's so nice and helpful when you make it clear you need it, but it's hard to understand her sometimes. Quizzes are all online, midterm and final are hardcopy. The group project sucks and is a lot of pressure. She works with you and tries to be helpful. Don't underestimate the class's difficulty.

She is very highly energetic. English isn't her first language so it can be difficult to understand her. There are only 2 tests (midterm & final), for teach test, you need to study the slides for 9 chapters. Dr. He is adorable, and spunky but do not take get for granted, although her class seems like cake at first, it is pretty complex stuff and it will creep up on you. She grades fairly but STRICTLY so if you think she'll let you make something up forget it about it. The tests are tough so study hard, one group project, she's always happy to help

Lerong is seriously one of the nicest, most genuine professors at Brockport. She truly cares about her students and is energetic and enthusiastic about teaching. She is very humorous and is really clear about what she expects. She is ALWAYS willing to help and is just such a sweet person. I have nothing but good things to say about her. :)

If you read the text it helps significantly, but she does give you all the information that you need for the test in  the lecture. Ends with a group presentation and paper but she does an excellent job working with you and grading is fair.

Simply put, Dr. He is Brockport's finest business professor.  She's super smart (Wharton School, just like Donald Trump), and she's also an excellent teacher.  Unlike some, she actually puts something into her lectures, and she's always well-prepared and willing to help.  I hope she stays around for a long time!
Super nice professor with an Ivy League education.  Clear here?

Still taking the class, but so far, so good.  She seems very enthusiastic and helpful.
