This is my second time having her, she's so funny and her assignments are really easy but sometimes they're confusing and you need to ask for clarification because sometimes she forgets what she says and you have to remind her. The quizzes were so easy, as long as you read the material before class. She really engages her students with everything.
She is very caring, a fair grader, and gives helpful feedback
Dr Panning cares about her students and gets excited for their writing skills. She is inspirational, motivational and I respect her feedback very much

I have had Panning for ENG210 and now ENG304. I love her classes. She gives such valuable feedback and wants everyone to be a better writer. I have improved as a writer because of her criticisms. She has never once answered an email though, so there's that. But she is an amazing teacher.
She is the reason, or a pretty good part of the reason, why I switched my major to English. She is quirky but very engaging. Try your best and you will do well!

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Lots of homework']
comment: She demands equal participation between all students, even those reluctant to even speak. You are only allowed to ask one question a day and she will only answer it if she feels like it. Her feedback is very light and non-specific for a fiction class. She doesn't let you check the time during class without calling you out for being distracting.
Very enthusiastic but sometimes disorienting, and you work in groups for almost every major project.

She can be a bit all over the place sometimes but it is clear she loves what she is doing and is passionate for the course material. It is a writing class so be prepared to write almost every class session.

Professor Panning is a fun professor. She's very caring and flexible, so just communicate with her if you have an issue. It's very easy to get a good grade in creative writing as long as you show up prepared and have a good attitude.

She knows what she is talking about, and I did learn some useful information to become a better writer. However, she can have a condescending attitude and I dont appreciate the way she talks to students when she is annoyed. Not a bad person, but she should learn to be more understanding.

Panning is a very kind and understanding professor. There is 4 main papers throughout the semester and we do class activities to help us prepare for them. Homework load is not bad at all. Can sometimes be confusing when giving assignment directions. Does not allow phones out in class & is very strict about enforcing it. Overall good professor.
She is very caring and an easy grader.

Dr. Panning isn't my cup of tea, but I know lots of people that enjoy her classes. She is a pretty fair grader, if you try, and make sure to read the books if she is giving a quiz on them or you won't pass. But, she also comes off very pretentious at times and loves to her herself talk. Sometimes her classes feel more like "The Anne Panning Show."

Dr. Panning is a genuinely kind, caring and gifted professor. I decided to take her class on a whim Fall '15 and it was the best decision I've made in years. She cares about participation and requires that everyone contribute. As a result technology is banned, but this helps to foster more engaging classroom discussion. Highly recommended prof.

I found it hypocritical that Anne gives students the freedom to write what they wish until critique time. Many students felt I was misogynistic or hate-filled because I created villainous narrators & characters. When I talked to Anne, she pushed the feminist narrative on me, seeing all women as victims.  After this I wrote pieces to avoid problems.

Anne is a great professor that any and every English student should learn from at some point during their time at this school. She loves engaging in classroom discussions and is never unclear about what she expects from her students. She makes the classroom fun and is always looking for feedback from her students. She is a great professor!

She is a great teacher! Fantastic woman, and pretty easy grader. She is very very down to Earth, and if you don't like what you got on your essay, she let's you re-write it and hand it in a again. If you go to her office hours, she will go through your essay with you and tell you exactly what you need to do to get a better great. TAKE HER!
She is very open and loves the class to interact and discuss. She may seem a tad weird, but she is a brilliant writing teacher.

Anne is one of the best professors at Brockport.  If you get a chance, TAKE A CLASS WITH HER.  She expects a lot, but you will learn so much from her that it's definitely worth it.  She definitely pushes you to be a better writer.
One of my favorite professors -- great class.  She expects a lot, but is not unreasonable.

I thought Panning was funny and kind throughout the semester.  She isn't afraid to tell you what she thinks about your writing, but all in all, I had a lot of fun in the class.  She's a good teacher, as long as you are never late and you remember to turn your cell phone OFF before class begins...

I do not care for her. She is an extremely tough grader and she rips apart peoples writing. We are there to learn, not to be expert writers, and besides is only a level 200 class. I would not take another class with her. She is a nice lady, but way too critical when it comes to her class.
Anne's great!!! Her class is so comfortable and fun. Workshop classes are great with Anne. Shes very intelligent and I learned a lot.

Hate to rain on parade. Panning is all about Panning. Oh, and Liberalism, of course. Look at me, I write books. Whee golly. Prevalent attitude in Bkpt Eng Dept. They only teach to afford to be writers, which indicates the quality and sales potential of their books. Blah.

I love Dr Panning. She's funny and really helpful. I learned a lot from her and fiction wrkshp was a great experience for me. She gives good, honest feedback. I like Dr. Panning. She's soo easy to talk to about my writing and such. She's very nice and approachable, but also has her limits...push the wrong buttons and she will ream you out. And don't ever be late to class.
Great professor.  Makes challenging subjects interesting, and is always happy to help her students.  Good sense of humor, and very laid back.

Dr. Panning was very invested in her students, and took the time and care to evaluate and give constructive criticism on our work. I learned a great deal from her. She was challenging, yet knew how to make a 3 hour workshop fun and interesting.
Excellent writing prof. Grad workshops were super high quality--makes you work, but in a good way. Very approachable prof.
Great classes.
I had her her first year and she was great. Definitely made a lasting impression. I am now teaching english and still love writing and teaching creative nonfiction!
Makes sure the night class doesn't get boring. She's fun & interesting.  Very fair grader & with the amount of assignments.
She is so great.  She really pushes you to write your best.  I love her.  Take her classes.
She's so pleasant and comforting. Don't go through English without taking one of her classes.

weekly quizzes based on textbook readings. a few short papers, assignments, and discussion posts. final group project. overall i liked the set up of the class and the content. professors is very clear on expectations.

This teacher sucks big time. She does not try to help students. Bottom line, If she likes you, she passes you. awesome

The best teacher I've ever had. He's willing to help you with anything at anytime. Has good study techniques. Truly cares about his student's grades. Goes out of his way to make understanding chemistry easier. Great guy. Should be teaching lecture as well. He makes learning very fun and he's hilarious!

Dr Kelley is the best teacher I've ever had. Although I didn't need much help in this class, he always made things easier to understand. He should teach the lecture

Dr. Kelley is an incredible teacher! I was seriously struggling in Chemistry 205, and I was next to failing. I decided to get help and Dr. Kelley was my lab instructor. Dr. Kelley is an amazing teacher! Chemistry is very hard and it has a lot of tedious work involved.  If you are unsure of anything, go and get help that day or as soon as possible. Go to Dr. Kelley, he will help you to the best of his advantage and he will even set up one on one time if you need additional help! GREAT TEACHER

Dr. Kelley is the reason I passed Chemistry. He is always willing to meet with students, he'll work problems with you and give you study techniques that will help in ALL of your classes. He is also a really funny guy :) I HIGHLY recommend him!

Dr Young is a one of a kind professor. He will challenge you, but in ways that make you stronger in both reason and conviction. If you have a chance to take a course of his, do so!

I had a great experience with Dr. Young. I see some people gave negative reviews already and I have to say that's probably someone that had a one off bad experience. This man lives in a fantasy world. His class is absolute garbage. He reads from a book and does not like to be challenged by anyone but himself. Do not recommend wasting your money. Very dysfunctional and unorganized.

This guy is just intolerable and thinks he's better than you. Personality is horrible and loves to pick on students and call them out. Unnecessarily harsh to students in front of the whole class. Class was horribly boring taught by him. Brags about his teaching award but didn't deserve it IMO.

This man is the best professor at Brockport. Great teacher.

Awesome class. Take it with Mike!

comment: Took this course Spring 2020. Great professor who really cares about his students understanding the course material. 4 papers and one group project. Due to Covid we didn't have to do a group project but had to do an individual project. Overall a fun class with interesting discussions.

Only negatives: the group project is essentially graded by the class (but he has a very high minimum grade) and attendance effects your grade. Overall great professor, I learned a lot. Read the coursework before class, write a few notes based on his questions and be prepared to think about business and ethics from multiple angles. A gem.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Group projects', 'So many papers']

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Graded by few things']
comment: This was his first semester, but you wouldn't have known if he didn't tell you. His course load is super easy - do the readings, go to class, participate. No tests or quizzes but papers are based on readings. If you aren't good at reading then take it with someone else.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Amazing lectures']
comment: Dr. Schwert is knowledgeable and organized. I learned more about psychology from her class in creativity than I have in many other classes. Professor Mary Anne is really sweet. She helps students if they need it and to this day she helps me review my resume and stuff. If you finish your assignments on time you will do very well.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Accessible outside class', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: Professor Donovan is doing online learning 100% right. She lays everyhting out week by week and is VERY accessible outside of class. Hands down the best professor I've had at Brockport. She is so caring and wants to see you succeed. She is always willing to help and is very understanding of circumstances that may arise. Very friendly prof who goes out of her way to help her students.  She also adjusts her grading scale to meet the different levels of everyone in the class.  Loved working with her and look forward to working with her in the future.
Great professor. Knows what she is talking about and is very helpful. The final projects seemed overwhelming, but when it came down to it, there isn't much to it. If you need this class take her.

An all around amazing person, so sad to see him go.

One of the smartest women at Brockport college, however she knows it. Tough grader unless you make a very strong argument. Class is informative but confusing.

If you like reading 300 pages a week for one class on top of a research paper, than this class is for you. Torre's lectures are often unorganized and he assigns questions from the reading that can't be answered thoroughly in less than 5 pages and if you answer the questions unthoroughly, your grade will be impacted.

Torre is an excellent professor. He is very knowledgable and really knows how to make the class fun and enjoyable. Not boring at all. Make sure you really take notes in his class for the exams bc he does not offer powerpoints.

Amazing teacher! If you love history and love his teaching methods then be sure that you will learn loads from him. He has a lot of work and treats us like grad students but he never stops believing in you. My favorite teacher so far.
This man was amazing.

Great guy, not the best teacher. Impossible to take notes during lectures hes all over the place and draws to many weird diagrams. Treats the class like an upper level. Was actaully my worst class. Tests are hard with 25 Identifiers and 4 posisble essay choices plus remembering all of the dates and stuff. Not a bad class but be prepared to work.

Testing is very unclear and unfair. 25 ID terms with mandatory names and dates plus 2 essays. Lectures are impossible to take notes of while he draws pictures instead of making sure something is clear. Teaches as if you have a background in the subject. This is a 200 level class and it was my hardest class this semester. Would not suggest this prof

Dr. Torre is a fun teacher who does all he can to make the subject as understandable/tolerable as possible.  Every now-and-then his Canadian accent gets a little in the way, but I would absolutely recommend him and his class to anyone needing History credits.  Very interesting and easy to work with and happy to help.
Great teacher and really nice and good to look at!
Great teacher. It was easy to understand things. He expected alot on the actual work done, especially for those who aren't going to be history majors.
Torre is DOPE. He makes the class a lot of fun and he gets people interested. Also, he's so painfully goodlooking.
Professor Torre is a great teacher.  You can tell he's really into what he's teaching and he wants you to learn. I'd recomend taking any class with him you can.
During my college career at RWC and Brockport, best lecture professor I have ever had.  Lectures are informative and interesting.  Paper and exam expectations are clear.
Dr. Torre was a great professor.  You learn a lot in his class and are mainly graded on your papers and tests.  He is a very nice guy and is very helpful, especially if you go to his office hours.

He is a great professor. He makes the topics so interesting, even for people who are not majoring in history. He takes topics that seem boring and makes them easy to understand and he's really funny. Take the class from him!You will enjoy this class

3 papers and a final presentation, along with short writings for text comprehension.  No tests, so most of the work is reading and writing papers.  Grading on papers is fair, ask for feedback. Class can sometimes get unorganized, but it will be clarified if you ask.

This professor is one of the most unorganized I have ever had. I have sent out multiple emails and have never gotten a response. This class is lecture heavy and she definitely has favorites in class. Posts assignments late and good luck getting your grades back.  Also talks nonsense in class and gets far behind.

This professor grades based on feelings and opinions. Everything in your paper could be factual, but she will give you a bad grade if the content doesn't adhere to her views. She also will not answer emails, so don't even attempt to email her.

Boring, boring, and did I mention...BORING. she is so friendly and sweet but this class is B O R I N G. I also felt like I had to have prior knowledge to the material and I did not so I felt stupid most of the time

Why so much hate?!--if you don't like this professor, there are other people who teach this course and it is offered every semester. She expects you to show up, follow the syllabus, have good faith, and do the work. She knows her stuff but doesn't pretend to know everything.  She is caring and is open to student concerns.
Love her!
Late with grades but is nice and easy grader
Boring lectures. But easy class. Nice professor.
She is a very busy person so can take awhile to grade papers. But the fact that she is extremely caring and smart makes up for it. Gives good feedback as well.

I have no idea how this professor has any positive reviews on here. She's condescending, gets behind on the syllabus and is incredibly unorganized. Incoherent + boring lectures that consume the entire classtime. Frequently gives inaccurate information. Hard to reach outside of class. Awful communication. Bad at posting assignments. Easy class tho
Nice person. A lot of reading and group discussions.
Love Prof. Walter! Smart, sweet, and caring.

Do NOT listen to the negative reviews. Dr Walter is the kindest and most caring person you will ever meet. The people that come on here to write negative things are just lazy and inconsiderate. She cares about her students, gives great feedback on papers, and is a fair grader. She is also very knowledgeable on medieval history. Highly recommend.
A wonderful, sweet, brilliant professor and person. She cares tremendously about her students and goes above and beyond both in and outside of the classroom.

Very boring and not a good teacher. Lots of aimless talking rather than actually trying to see if the content is being understood by students. Class is fairly easy but she makes it hard to care about the class. Takes a very long time to grade assignments, could take her almost a month to grade her weekly discussion boards.

comment: Do not take her class. She gives incorrect information and is very opinionated about what she's teaching. She also gets very offended if you call her out on stuff or ask about your grade and her feedback. Gets extremely behind in her lectures and grading. Her grading is not fair and she takes unnecessary points off.

tags: ['So many papers', 'Lecture heavy', 'Graded by few things']
comment: She gets so behind in class. Most times you won't even know where you should be in the syllabus. She will say that she is grading your papers and then you won't get a grade for weeks or months. We have a paper due this week and she still hasn't graded a paper we turned in over two months ago. If you can avoid taking her classes I would do so.

tags: ['Tough grader', 'Lots of homework', 'Graded by few things']
comment: She never responds to emails in a timely fashion. She doesn't seem to care about her students. She falls behind in class quite frequently. She doesn't return grades on time (aka, 2 months late)

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Lecture heavy', 'Graded by few things']
comment: Doesn't answer emails. Teaches things that are historically incorrect. Quite rude to students. Constantly behind in teachings but expects you to already know. Wouldn't take again.

Never seen a teacher who jumps in with materials, making students feel lost & miserable like Katherine A. Walter. Her grading is difficult, gave me 5/10 on the 1st "easy" assignment for no valid reason. I'm a history person but hate her class. She confuses students and makes the class hard even though it should not be that way.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Gives good feedback', 'Accessible outside class']
comment: Katherine is a wonderful person and I truly enjoyed her class. Get ready to read if you take Roman Empire with her. So so so much reading. She's willing to change due dates based on class feelings and really cares about students opinions. I didn't really read the assigned readings much, so as long as you're good at writing and faking it you're fine

Mario does a great job at making everyone feel welcomed in his classroom, and you can tell he genuinely cares about his students both inside and outside of the classroom. He is also very entertaining and clearly loves teaching the material in class.

Mario is a great person, and an excellent teacher for peer relationships. He admittedly falls behind in the class every semester, reuses in-updated slides, and derails conversations. Not a ton of HW mainly due to "catch-up" which is readings for pop-quizzes. 3 big tests that aren't too bad if you study, a paper/project, and lots of group work.

I did take the class over the summer & online, so I am sure it was a little different than taking the class with him in person. It took to week 4 to get a grade back on my first week assignments. That being said I thankfully did well but to do well on the tests you really need to watch every lecture, documentary and reading  he assigns to do well.
Super nice guy, his class is very enjoyable.

Mario in general is a nice person but his class is super disorganized, he uses the same slides for ever other class he teaches. Also be aware that he will bring his own opinions on a topics he really is not credible on. Overall if you want a class that is not much grading take his class. You really do not learn anything in class.

I wish I could take every class with him. Very personable and funny. The content is actually interesting too, my favorite class I took yet at Brockport. I am a PSH major but absolutely loved this class. If you need credit, take any classes with Mario!!!

Great professor, funny, knowledgeable, among other qualities. Isn't afraid to call you out but only because he wants you to do well. Don't be intimidated the first week. Easy quizzes every week if you did the reading/homework. Study for tests. Not easy to reach outside of class, but should be willing to help fix your grade if you're respectful.

Mario is a great guy. His fun and no filter personality makes his teaching enjoyable and entertaining. He is also very passionate about his fiedl, especially Sport Psychology. He cares about his students, and once in awhile he brings in his dog Izzy to class! Good professor to have if you want to have fun in class.

One of the best professors at Brockport. Great lectures that tie in lots of real world stories and application. Makes his classes fun, expect lots of jokes and in class participation. Very honest and open about any questions you have. Absolutely take Mario over any other professor!
Great Professor, loves his students I actually don't know how his rating is so low on here it should be a 5.
Mario is an amazing person and great professor. Loved coming to his class and makes the class fun and interesting. Definitely would recommend taking this class.

Great guy very down to earth but gets behind on grading a lot and there are a lot of quizzes based on reading that he sometimes doesn't tell you about, so you just always have to be prepared. There are 2 big papers that he assigns and 4 tests.

He's funny, down to earth and pretty easy going. He understands you cannot make it to class sometimes, but do not miss Fridays. Do the reading and attend friday quizzes and you will be just fine Midterm was pretty easy. He doesn't grade very fast but honestly it doesn't matter to me.

Ran into a predicament at the end of the semester, reached out to Mario, he helped me out tremendously. Wants his students to succeed and thrive in his class. Makes an emphasis of making mental health his top priority. Would definitely recommend

Mario is a great professor but tends to get behind on grading papers and assignment. The quizzes are easy as long as you read the articles he assigns. We dont have a textbook but he assigns articles and chapters out of the two books required for class. Overall hes a great guy that just wants to help everyone learn and do the best they can.

Thanksgiving is over and done 11/27 and yet here I am not knowing my grade for EXAM 1, the semester is technically over within 3 weeks yet this guy hasnt even graded the first exam given in September, the only thing actually in the gradebook is attendance and a very vaguely graded first essay of 3, wonder how i can improve not knowing how I did...

This class was alright. He is clear about what he is looking for, show up for class, put in the work but you NEED to be very specific. The lectures are long, but you need to take notes for the midterm and final. The one thing that I was slightly disappointed about is that your answer needs to be exactly what is said in class in his own words.
Hes fun to listen to and he seems like an awesome guy but the amount of reading in this class is annoying and if you dont read you will fail.

He doesn't believe in textbooks, but assigns multiple long articles to read each week, and on top of that large chunks of books. Its almost as if he thinks his class is the only one we have to read and prepare for. Hes not bad person at all, I'm sure some people can work with his style, but the amount of reading is unbearable taking a full schedule

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read', 'Participation matters']
comment: This isn't a hard class, but if you don't read everything required you absolutely will fail and won't know what's going on. The best way to do well in class is to participate. He's more willing to work with students that at least give the impression they're making an effort. If you sit there quietly and don't contribute to anything you'll regret it

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS']
comment: This course covers everything in the KSSPE department. The mid-term/final was open answer, but common sense if you paid attention. Mario hates textbooks and understands they can be helpful, but they're expensive and unnecessary. Read anything he assigns. It will always be brought up, and that content will be related to the exam questions.

tags: ['Participation matters', 'ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS']
comment: A lot of people take issue with Mario's lack of grading. It didn't really bother me. A lot of profs at Brockport take a long time to grade or don't at all. He gives good lectures and he cares about whether or not you learned. Participate. Contribute. It helps in the long run. Read EVERYTHING. There will be quizzes for grades.

Mario is by FAR the worst professor I have had. He frequently came to class late, was completely disorganized often amending changes to the syllabus and expected coursework off the cuff during lecture and proceeding to re-amend assignments the next class on the spot. He never graded any papers on blackboard and provided 0 diagnostic feedback.

Professor Byrne is a great professor who is passionate about the material. She cares about helping her students when needed, but she sometimes comes off as judgmental when you don't understand certain parts of the material or need extra help on something.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Graded by few things', 'Accessible outside class']
comment: Byrne is a great professor. She is willing to help you in any means possible. The class PES 335 is particularly easy if you put the effort into it and ask a lot of questions for clarification. Byrne was willing to meet before and after class for those students that were struggling. If you work hard and make connections this class will be easy.
Cares on a personal level and very knowledgable. Highly recommend

Her lectures can be a little dry at times but if you pay attention and are interested in the content her class is very good and she presents the content in an accessible way. Her class is mainly graded by the 3 lecture exams and the final so make sure to do well on those.

Heidi is the best. Writing a whole research manuscript is a huge task but she makes it as tolerable and enjoyable as possible. s\She is incredibly helpful throughout the whole process and is very reasonable in feedback and grading. I was rarely stressed about this class.

Nice, funny, and very knowledgeable about what she is teaching. She always has stories for every topic which I like. Not the most engaging lectures, but not bad. There is one big group project, but she gives plenty of time to work on it in lab. Her class felt like a nice intro to the exercise science major
Super helpful and really interested in students learning. She makes review sheets that go along with the exam and gives students every opportunity to learn. A lot of "take home" labs.

Dr. Byrne is one of the nicest and most helpful professors you will come across at Brockport. The book was never used, but her notes were helpful. If you go to her review sessions shes holds before every test, you will do really good on the tests.

Heidi Byrne is an amazing teacher! By far one of the best I've ever had. She is very kind, fair, and cares about her students. Her courses are usually on the difficult side, but she is a fantastic teacher and really breaks the material down so you can understand it. Her tests and grading are very fair. Take any and every class you can with her!
She is a fantastic teacher and adviser! She's kind, and I also found her to be motherly (which I didn't consider a bad thing).
She is very helpful and really cares about her students!

Dr. Byrne is an excellent teacher, one of the best at Brockport.  Both she and Dr. Mattern are great professors and there should be no trouble in understand the course material.  It is obvious that she wants the students to learn and understand the class.

Dr. Bryne is an amazing professor, one of the best at SUNY Brockport.  She is always willing to clear up any questions and is dedicated to her students.  The classes are not difficult as long as you're willing to put in a little effort to studying.  I would reccommend taking any class with her or Dr. Mattern.
She is an awesome teacher willing to hep clear anything up at anytime.

Exersise Physiology students, she is tough, but very fair and friendly. no extra credit and no curves, but I think I would still take her class over Vogt's.

The class is pretty easy. He contradicts himself often, which is very frustrating. You do an outline for a report, then the next day he changes it up, adds something or takes something out. However, he does allow you to revise your work for an increased grade. Go to class, act interest, make many drafts full of revisions and you should get an A/A-.

Easy teacher as long as you show up to class and occasionally pay attention to him. He uses the text book in class. Few quizzes and a few major assignments, with really easy homework once in a while. He loves what he does. As long as you do your work you can get at least a B, if not an A

He's really awkward and tries to be funny, gets off topic easily, but really easy class and really nice guy. Make sure you go to class though. I missed a ton, enough to fail. He must have liked me though because he gave me a C. As long as you do the readings and answer his questions in class, it's an easy A.
Really easy class! He's a good guy. Just show up and do the really easy assignments and you'll be fine. He grades realy easily. He's awkwardly funny and always cheery
Nice guy
good teacher, pay attention and answer his questions so he knows you are not just surfing the internet during class
attend class, do assignments, show interest by making changes throughout each draft, good teacher

This is one of the easiest classes I took and actually learned from. My writing improved and he's a ridiculously fair grader. He tries to be funny too which is amusing. I highly suggest taking this or any class with him.

Good class. I think John is the best teacher to take this class with. He cares about what he's teaching and granted sometimes he can be annoying he is really nice and helpful. Make sure to study your commas and sentence structure for this class though. That was the difference between my A and A-.

He's a good guy. Come to class, do the work, and homework. He says hes a tough grader but if you do the work and put a little time in, you can get an A. Few quizzes, no tests, minor and a few major assignments. You do a resume and cover letter as well. Overall if u have to take enl 308, take it with him.
take this class with curry. it's easy. his voice is really annoying and might put you to sleep but he's an easy grader. no tests. few quizes. minimal assignments. not a bad class

I know John through SSSP, and he's been a life saver. I love that I can go to SSSP for help, or just to hang out and study. There was a semester I thought I was going to flunk out, and John helped me get my grades back up. He's awesome!
really easy course. nice guy, doesn't really explain a whole lot unless you poke and prod.

John is a very nice guy and a fine teacher!  He is very intelligent and really knows English.  He will do anything to help you, and unlike some professors, you feel comfortable talking to him because he doesn't make you feel like an idiot!  I really enjoyed his class and would highly recommend him!

john is a very easy going guy when it comes to classroom lectures...good sense of humor and find classroom atmoshpere to be very comfortable...stories are kind of boring and the amount of stories should be shortened, but other then that, he is a good teacher...good class to get an easy grade...  you
Dumbed down, boring class.  If you truly enjoy literature I would advise against this course/professor.  However, for those who need it for a GE requirement, it is an easy grade.
John is very helpful.

She is a very good professor, this class specifically is pretty lecture heavy and it can get a little boring but she does these "POP ICE" assignments in the middle of class which count for your attendance grade, which are nice because it keeps you engaged and actually thinking about the material you just learned. She is very nice and helpful.
Gives a lot of in class assignments, use her office hours for help

Cleo was my favorite professor this semester, she truly wants you to pass and succeed any way possible. There are only a few assignments, with readings for homework that are up to you to do if you have time. She is really leaniant with deadlines and a super nice grader! As long as you show up to class there is no way you can fail

This class is SO easy, it's all online work and you only need to go to class if you want help. I finished the class in October because the work was so easy. She is very helpful if you need here. I would definitely take this class with her!
Always willing to help when I had questions. Attendance is not mandatory. Easy class

Michele is an AWESOME instructor and I would highly recommend everyone take her classes. She is very knowledgeable, helpful and truly cares about students success. She is flexible on attendance so long as you show progress in assignments that have deadlines. She's fair in grading, lets you know what is required and loves teaching! Thanks, Michele!

Disorganized "hybrid" course.  Deadlines would be random such as Tuesday by noon, Friday by noon or 3 pm, Wednesday by 3 pm or noon . . . and on and on like that.  Assignments were a bit more vague and she kept changing her format week by week.  I definitely would not recommend taking a course from her.
Useless as a teacher, unhelpful, unclear with direction, does not tell when assignments are due until the day of. If you want to be stressed and confused take this class

Never take her. Accidentally took down our online final from ANGEL for a week before the end of class and refused to take accountability for it...we had to complain to the dept chair and did not get a response from her until the chair talked to her. she lies about what directions are too if you call her out on something she did wrong. Just awful...

Wow. This class was ridiculous. I took it for fun and it ended up lowering my GPA.  She wasn't very understanding in "life-happens" situations.  There was more work than my 400 level classes.  And the material online was never organized in a logical fashion (it was a hybrid class).
At first I didn't really like her teaching. But, she puts up study questions online that appear on the test. She takes twenty minutes talking about nothing at the beginning of class.
She is very unorganized. There was 1 midterm, a presentation and homework assignments weekly. The assignments were informative. she grades so easilly, i got an A and did poorly on a lot of the work.

She often times does not go over the powerpoints that are going to be on the test. She talks to the class as if we are children. We have a group project that counts for a big chunk of our grade. Test questions often come randomly from the book and powerpoints. There is an assignment due each class. There is so much work for this 100 level course.
She has no order. Talks to the students like children and have no idea what we are doing. Goes on random tangents and doesn't get to the point. Wastes time in class on nothing. She needs to retire.

This woman Is the most unorganized soul on Earth. There is no syllabus for the course, she does not know what she is talking about and she treats her students like children assigning seats and all! Hands out bs grades and has no control over her classes. Needs to retire. Often confused. Cannot explain anything coherantly
She is very sweet and understanding. But don't push her too far. Attend the mandatory dance performances, homework is effortless and slack when she isn't looking.
I question the real reason she is here. It's embarrassing really. It just proves..it's not who you know, it's who you... Next time save these positions for those with real talent.

Professor Clifton is absolutely incredible! This has been my favorite course since transferring to Brockport. Professor Clifton does an amazing job with outlining expectations, promoting engagement and communicating. Its been such a pleasure working with her this semester - I hope she offers more courses in the future. Great job Professor Clifton!

Understanding and supportive, especially during a semester that felt overwhelming at times. Not every professor takes the time to really think about what their students might be facing, but she did. She created a learning environment where I felt comfortable, respected, and encouraged. She allowed us to turn assignments in at end of module need be

Professor Clifton is extremely passive aggressive in her lectures and emails. I had to reach out to her at the beginning of the semester, because she never included a tentative schedule in the syllabus until I requested it. She also had me resubmit assignments after giving positive feedback upon my completion. I do not recommend a course with her.

350 characters isn't enough to properly articulate how amazing and caring Professor Clifton is. Her expectations aren't outlandish, but they might seem high because she knows that her students are capable of effective writing, and she pushes you toward that. She will give you honest feedback that is never rude but always educational and uplifting.

I have Professor Clifton for children's LIT, and she is very kind and understanding. I needed an extension due to medical emergencies, and she was very patient with me and my late work. She has very clear weekly communication (I hate fully online classes) but she makes expectations very easy to follow!

Professor Clifton was an amazing professor even through the online setting which can be challenging. She always went above & beyond to ensure that we understood what was expected out of us with each of the assignments and her instructions were always very clear. She provides great feedback & she is very kind as well :) Definitely recommend :)

Prof. Clifton has high expectations especially for someone who is not an english major. She is very rude in her feedback with passive aggressive comments on papers which makes you not want to ask for help. 0/10 would not take a course with her again.

English is one of my favorite subjects and this professor is making me lose the love I have for this subject. Extremely condescending when we didn't follow the vague directions to a project given to us. When she reaches out she will always point out a flaw in your work and not in a constructive way but in a way that makes you feel less intelligent

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'So many papers']
comment: Often vague directions are given, then when you do not do it correctly, she will become passive-aggressive and re-do your work for you and then when you apply corrections, she will give you a bad grade. When a project is done, the weekend before if she does not like it, she will make you re-do it. beware of the passive-aggressive emails

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read', 'Tough grader']
comment: I loved taking Childrens Literature with Prof Clifton. Shes really nice and definitely shows she cares about her students. Some of her assignments do require a lot of in depth analysis and lots of reading in this class .

It felt more like a book club than an actual literature class. You will spend more time worrying about what not to do in your than you will about the actual content of your writing. Beware, she wears a smile and tries to make communications seem light, but she come off as being really condescending.

Professor Clifton is a great professor who is an asset to SUNY Brockport with her real-world background. Participation and attendance are important. Not a particularly tough grader, but you have to do what is asked. You will get better as a writer and student if you take her classes.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: She is tough, but boy is it worth it in the end. There is a lot of reading, but the books are enjoyable. Sometimes it felt confusing and overwhelming, but otherwise worth it. Do not be afraid to ask her questions and reach out outside of class. Especially on papers

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: She is the best!! You do need to work for you grate, but I really enjoyed the class. Even though I hate English with a passion, I can  honestly say she made me a better writer.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Caring']
comment: Don't sleep on Barbi. She is a very nice teacher, who is often understanding and will care for her students. She gives plenty of extra credit opportunities and will demand participation in her class. She is a decent grade, she just expects a lot when students do not care very much. If you slack off in her class, you WILL fail. Overall, a good prof.

She's amazing. It's ridiculously hard to get an A on all her papers. Participation is very important in her class and she gives a few quizzes which are not hard. No final exam and gives lots of extra credit opportunities.

Prof. Clifton is one of my favorite professors at Brockport. She is big on participation and attendance. You have to write 4 papers and there are like (5) 20 question quizzes. She offers a lot of extra credit which helps. Not a hard grader. No final exam, the last paper is a research paper for your final. I would definitely recommend.

Constantly reminds you that you're in a 300-level college course then proceeds to babysit you through work. Often moody. Demands high levels of participation. Extremely high expectations with often vague direction. Repetitive. Not a very creative instructor. Seems like she'd be better teaching high schoolers.

John Ragone is hands down the worst professor I have ever had. He is rude, insensitive, and overall unprofessional. He also picked on specific students the whole semester. He highly favored the men in our class. He also couldn't tell the only three black men in class apart despite them looking nothing alike and having completely different names.

John's class I learned nothing but how to do things his way, & if it wasn't it's wrong. His personality itself is stuck up & insensitive. Don't miss class or he will send you an email talking about you failing [EVEN IF IT'S EXCUSED OR WHEN YOU'RE KEEPING UP IN CLASS]. Talked bad about me to my classmates for "skipping" when I was in the hospital.

tags: ['Lots of homework', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Tough grader']
comment: He is very egotistical, he will always compare projects to his own work and brag about his experiences. He is very judgmental and open about his opinions, even if it is very offensive to you. He is never clear and concise about projects. He'll constantly change what is expected for them. He never takes blame even when he's wrong. Insane workload.

He requires you to do a ton of work and prefers that most of it be book sources. He constantly changes his mind on what he like versus what he does not. His instructions tend to be very vague or you could interprete them in multiple ways. He is also an extremely tough grader. He does not like when people ask him questions.

tags: ['Tough Grader', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: He will tell you that your design is great during class, then will email you later saying you need to change your entire design or you won't pass. Is very harsh during critiques and presentations. If you ask him questions he will take it as you questioning his credibility and dock you points. His instructions are vague and often hard to follow.
Very understanding, like when you think outside the box, enjoys hearing multiple sides, a fan of doing debated and when doing so picking something the claim that may not be ordinary

I have know him for over 4 years.  Greatest teacher I have had.  Class is fun and extremely easy.  He will talk not just about the subject but about student life and helps for the real world.  The tests are given to you before hand so you can ace it.
THE MAN. Plain and simple. This guy makes class fun, interesting, engaging and thoughtful. Too bad this is his last semester, we need more Professor's like him.

Great guy. Really fun and enthusiastic. Loves his job. Fun to argue with. Makes Ethics interesting, and is pretty easy. Tells you what is on the test before you take them. Pay attention in class and you'll ace every test.

Mandrick is the best! Coming in as a freshman, I was dreading this class that I was forced to take. He is seriously the best professor, really funny and really laid back. really funny, really fun.  good class. if your gonna take it, take it with him

comment: I took this class over the summer of 2017. One of the hardest class I took. A lot covered in a month. comment: Took  class over summer. Learned a lot. Given the vastness of this course, he makes it tailor made so that you know what to study for the exam. Exams a tough but fair. all he does is argue when a students asks a question and is a stickler for what he believes. class is really boring

comment: If you put in the work, you will absolutely be successful. Dr. Busch is a genius. He knows what he is talking about even when others don't understand. The material is a bit dry, but practical to your understanding of the world as it is now. tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Would take again']
comment: I took two courses with Dr. Busch. He is very passionate and knowledgeable about his field of study. Read the required readings, do the writing assignments, and participate in class. comment: Nice person to work with. The assignments are interesting but not too hard, and she checks in to make sure students are doing okay.

comment: If you put forth effort, follow instructions, and don't repeat mistakes... You're good. She's pretty strict on attendance and participation. I'm a better writer after taking her class - she gave detailed feedback on all formal papers. Basic curriculum. Entertaining enough.

One big complaint I would have is she took off massive point for little things. If format was wrong, she took off a whole point which dropped the final grade a full letter which I think is unfair. Other than that, as long as you show up and occasionally participate, you're good. One other thing is she likes to call on random people.

I've had multiple classes with Dr. Dobmeier and he is a caring professor who tries to understand your perspective and challenges you to go outside your comfort zone. He can be dry sometimes so I recommend getting some coffee before going to class. He responds to emails very late at night. One of the few professors in the program that I respected.

Bob doesn't properly express the diagnostic steps required for accurate clinical diagnosis. He expects DSM symptoms to be "checked off" despite the book stating not to do so. He hardly covers treatment planning. He injects his bias into the course, making it difficult to actually learn how to diagnose. If he doesn't like you, prepare to get a B-.
Professor Varrenti is a great professor. He enjoys teaching us different topics and likes it when the class participates. Participation is key!

Dr. varrenti helps each student with any situation they might be facing. He personally helped me catch up tp the classwork after i was absent for a month for military reasons. He loves seeing his students succeed.
Knows what he is talking about, very interesting to hear someone with experience. Overall great course, and great professor.

His classes were very informative and very good. He was able to make classes much more enjoyable. Each class we got to the point and never talked about anything that wasn't important. Daniel Varrenti was the best Criminal justice Professor in the college of brockport. If you see his name, take the class you wont regret it.

Professor Varrenti's class is hands down the best class I've ever taken and that is all thanks to his character. It is so clear that he cares about each and every student and his dedication to the teaching of investigations is outstanding. His lectures are inspirationaI. I have so much respect for him and his law enforcement service 10/10 recommend
Passionate about what he speaks on. Does a great job of applying his career experiences to material that's learned in class.

I genuinely look forward to class with Professor Varrenti because he is unbiased and meaningful in everything he says. The course is extremely beneficial for my future career path and it's really useful when you have someone teaching you who is just as invested in your success as you are. He's motivating and helpful! 100% recommend this course

Chief Varrenti is an amazing professor who brings a lot of knowledge from his experience as a police chief. He uses and relates a lot of class discussions to his personal experiences which keeps it super interesting. It's wise to go to class because he doesn't use PowerPoints, however, he gives extra credit opportunities and is understanding.

If you want to learn about investigations, take it with Professor Varrenti ! He is a retired police chief that knows what he is talking about. Even if the class is mandatory you will enjoy learning in this class !

A really nice professor. Discusses what you need to know for the class rather going over everything. Only thing I would ask differently is if he did partial credit for extra credit on exams.. if you get part of it wrong you get the whole question wrong :/

Chief is the best professor Ive ever had. He cares about his students and wants each of us to do the best we can. Hes also very understanding and flexible when it comes to making alternate arrangements for exams. 10/10 would recommend

Professor Varrenti engages his students from the first lecture to the last. He makes his classes enjoyable and fun. The tests are fair and tests your ability to focus during class and read the materials outside the classroom. He makes it clear that he wants his students to learn and clears about every students path.

He really is a great guy and wants you to succeed not only in his class but also after college as well. You need to go to class because he constantly goes over and over the materials on the test. He does not use powerpoint which some might find difficult. I write down the important things he says over and over. He really is a great guy all around.

He cares very much about making sure his students understand the material and are able to use it. He also is very invested in making sure that his students succeed and do well in the class and in life. Great teacher!

Professor Verrenti is one of the best professors Ive had at Brockport. He implements personal stories to teach his lectures. This makes the class more interesting, easier to learn and keeps me coming back. Professor Verrenti has a passion for this class which makes it fun to learn from him.

I enjoyed this course with Varenti. Many of his personal experiences were extremely interesting and helped you understand the course better. He does not use powerpoint which means you have to pay attention and read the book. Testing was fairly easy as he went over the test before hand and made sure we were comfortable.

Id love to take another class with Professor Varrenti. He has a lot of personal experiences that he uses to help teach the lessons, and he keeps everyone involved so youre always learning. No powerpoints, which I personally prefer because having to write more just makes it easier to remember. No homework, but the exams are so easy. Easy A

This professor has great methods of teaching material not only for the course, but for life. He includes a vast variety of personal experiences which makes class more memorable, engaging, and easily understood from multiple perspectives. This class is certainly enjoyable and very informative, even for non-majors.
Chief Varrenti is amazing! Love his class!

Wants you to really understand the material that is given. Will explain things and use real life examples, cares about the student's and use of a good academic experience. Wants you to succeed in life and is willing to help. It can be challenging but it is a good challenge. Be sure to have a deeper understanding of the material.

This professor in my opinion is great professor. His class is not to hard by it also is not easy. You need to come to class and know his style of teaching and take notes. You are only graded on test which kinda sucks because you could be a bad test taker but know the material. I overall would recommend taking this class and or this professor!

Chief Varrenti is a great professor. He genuinely cares about his students and how well they are doing in the class. He is there for the right reasons, unlike some of the other professors who take the job for granted. I love his class because he makes us think outside of the box and gives us real-life scenarios, which are always interesting.

A fantastic guy who loves to crack a few jokes to keep a positive work environment. He does not give himself enough credit, for he wants nothing but the best for his students. He also has a ton of work experience, and through storytelling, this professor keeps the class interesting, engaging, and informative. This helps many retain valuable info.

I adore him as a teacher, at first i was nervous because there where no power points. Being a visual learner this was a downfall. But as his class continued, he made sure we wrote down what was needed and if you didn't understand something he would go over it again. I would highly recommend to take his class if given the opportunity.

Hands down! this guy is amazing. He teaches from real-world experiences and I personally look for that when choosing a course. He is hilarious. The class is an easy class if you pay attention and go to lectures. His lectures are a bit heavy but they are interesting. He also gives good feedback and wants his students to not only pass but to learn!

Dan Varrenti uses his past experiences and connects it to the topic at hand, which provides a fun, interactive lecture. However, he does not provide students with a powerpoint to follow along with so if you dont go to class or pay attention you miss important information.

I didn't think I would do well in this class because he doesn't do PowerPoint lectures, but I actually like his interactive teaching style. His experience as a retired police chief helps my understanding of the material because he gives real life examples. He makes sure you know exactly what to expect on his exams and so it is very easy to get an A

Sick of professors who can't teach? Sick of professors who are researchers? Well Chief Varrenti is outstanding. He is able to connect his many years in the criminal justice field into the classroom. I have learned more in his class than I have in two years in the criminal justice program at SUNY Brockport. He is the real deal.
Great Professor. His teaching is effective and he makes class interesting by using relatable and interesting examples. Would highly recommend.
He bring in his real life experience in the classroom and uses them as example for what you are talking about.
If your going into the CRJ field you need to take one of his classes. He is very experienced unlike most of the other professors at Brockport.

Truly cares about his students and their success. He will do whatever he can to help you get to where you want to be in a career. He doesn't just teach by lecture, he incorporates his own personal experiences and stories to help you to learn what he is talking about. Quizzes aren't difficult and the tests are very fair. Highly recommended!
Outstanding professor with a great deal of knowledge on policing being a former police chief. Would highly recommend!

10/10 would recommend. He used to be the chief in the Brockport PD and his personal stories are unforgettable. He doesn't lecture, he just tells you what you need. I wish I could've taken every CRJ class with him. Take his class, you'll definitely enjoy it. Also don't buy the text book he gives you all the answers to his quizzes and tests.
Has great stories to tell for example to tell during lectures.
This guy is the man! If you have the opportunity to take his class do it he wont let you down, he makes class a great time.
One of my favorite teachers Ive had, cared that you are actually learning the content. Highly recommend his class.
Great professor!!! His class was amazing.

Best professor the CRJ department has. I wish he would teach more classes. Barely uses the textbook but you learn things based off of his experiences as being a police officer. Couple quizzes here and there but he basically goes over each question with you. One big group project but its fun and you learn a lot. 10/10 would recommend

One of my favorite professors at Brockport. Show up to class and do the assignments and you'll get a good grade. He teaches well and relies heavily on personal experience and stories that relate to what is being learned. His lectures are extremely engaging and you'd be surprised how quickly a two hour and thirty minute class can go by

Hands down the best CJ teacher at Brockport. He knows what he's talking about. He only covers what he feels is important not only for the class but for your future career in Law Enforcement. Covers whats going to be on the quizzes and test in depth.
Great professor. One of my favorite classes.
He's a great professor and is hilarious. He makes class very interesting and he actually knows what he's talking about..

Chief Dan Varrenti is THE "GOAT" among the criminal justice professors here at Brockport. It doesn't get better than him. He skims through the chapters & tells you only what he believes is important to know. So his lectures are never long/ boring. He's a great professor who cares about his students & wants you to do well. Love his stories & humor!
Great guy with great story's. One of my favorite teachers at Brockport. Learned more in his class than most of the CRJ classes I've taken in the past 3 years.

comment: I enjoyed this class a lot. He cares about everyone and wants us to achieve. He made me open my eyes to alot of different scenarios.

Chief Varrenti is simply the best professor that I have ever had at Brockport. He makes classes fun and I actually felt like I learned something. I like how he lectures because he doesn't read off of powerpoints or from a textbook. Highly recommended course and professor.
Uses real life examples to make good connections the material
Great professor, shares real life experiences. Makes lectures really fun, and interesting. Overall amazing guy
I would go over all the information and repeat it so that all the information is re-covered .

My main critique getting ready for tests and quizzes is difficult because he does not touch on all the material in class. He does an overview for the test but then pulls random facts from the book to stump you. The central piece of the class is a group project which all teachers love but students all hate. Guy to talk to about becoming a cop.

Really enjoy this class. Taught by a great professor. He gives great information and experiences. It helps when you actually like your teachers and can keep focused, and professor Varenti is a great example of my ideal favorite professor. You won't regret taking a class with Dan Varenti.

Chief Varrenti's passion for his career has inspired me as a person, and as an individual entering the criminal justice field. Also, many life lessons he lectures in his class is outstanding to apply them to the outside world. He is a fantastic role model.

Best professor I have ever had. Utilizes time and is passionate about helping his students succeed in and out of class. He helped me solidify my career choice and provided pertinent information and resources to accomplish career goals. Only professor I have had that makes classroom material applicable to the real world. Truly inspiring and caring.

His class is my favorite, not because of the subject but because of having him as a professor. The education I receive from his class goes above and beyond the book and his personal experiences that he uses to solidify the lesson create a better understanding of the field. This man is more than a college professor, he is someone I inspire to be.

Chief Varrenti is one of the better professors here at Brockport. He's lectures are full of stories from his experience in law enforcement, which makes a 3 hour lecture much more enjoyable than reading off power point slides. He really cares about his job and helping us as students and that is so important in my eyes.
Great guy, the best teacher I've  had at brockport!!

One of the best professors I've ever had. He talks about real life application of the things we learn and shares personal experiences that parts in to our ciriculum. You have the opportunity to go out and learn about the things we learn in practice projects such as a security assessment and Monroe county sheirfs training center. Best class so far.

One of the best professors I've ever had. He really cares for his students and wants them to succeed. Being an actual law enforcement officer, he brings and teaches through many interesting stories/real life experiences. Never a dull moment in his class & you're usually out early. He's an overall great guy and his class is highly recommended!

Professor/ Chief Varrenti is one of the best professors I have had thus far. In my opinion he is so much better than any full time professor at Bport. His knowledge and experience I feel is much more helpful when comparing him to a full time professor who just has their Doctoral degree. He is a honest man who truly cares about his students success.

Chief Varrenti is one of the greatest professor that I have ever had the chance to have! I highly recommend taking any and all classes with him. He is the type of teacher that cares about his students, he wants you to pass and wants you to succeed in life. He brings his own experience in to class which you cant find with most teachers. AMAZING!!!!!

Professor Varrenti is an amazing professor. By far the best class I've taken at Brockport. You know his class is amazing, when you don't mind going to a 3 hour lecture (which he lets you out early). If you like reading textbooks don't join the class. He teaches all from real world experience and tells amazing stories.

Can't say enough good things about Chief Varrenti. His class is 3 hours long but you always get out early and it goes by quick. One of the best professors I've ever had. He applies topics to real world examples he has personally experienced which gives a genuine learning engagement. Tests are clear and covers things you need to know. Best Professor

Chief/Professor Varrenti is an actually sworn officer of the law and teaches a night class once a week. This is the greatest class I have ever taken. You will learn a lot as long as you pay attention, get involved and ask questions. You might learn more in this class than your whole college career.

I think he is a phenomenal professor. He is very passionate about the topics being taught in class and uses real life experiences as examples to help better explain information. I encourage anyone who enjoys criminal justice related classes to take his because it is never dull or a burden to go to.

This Class I do find to be easy, not going to complain about this for a couple reasons though. One, everyone likes easy classes. Two, more importantly its not the text book I learn the most from its Varrenti himself.  He will engage you and make you want to come to class unlike any other teacher. Varrenti is a professor worth your time.

Great professor! Need to be in class to pass. Great time! Always makes class fun. Don't usually stay the whole time. Tells you what you need to know for exams. Definitely a great professor. Would take the class again!!! Best class this semester.

Very respectable and personable. Cares about the well- being and future of his students. Wants to make sure that you leave class with an understanding other than the textbook information and that is actually relevant  to a future career in the field. Has a lot of knowledge and experience in law enforcement, and is very logical and practical.
This class is great! He actually gives you real life scenarios and stories that will get you thinking!  Truly cares about his students and you will never regret taking this class.
just an all around good dude, Chief of police that has tons of real world experience.

comment: Chief Varrenti is an exceptional teacher, and an even better story teller. You will learn many things about policing and security as he bring scenarios from the world right into the class room. He is up front with his students and leaves out all the BS. The class is graded on 3 Exams and group project, none are to extremely difficult. A must 4 CRJs
Keeps the class engaged and teaches based on personal experince rather than out of the textbook, something most professors do not do in today's education system.
This guy is one of the few professors that truly cares about his students.  Other professors should learn from this guy.

By far the most Knowledgeable about the field of policing and criminal justice.  He doesn't read you the textbook, nor expect you to know what the textbook says.  He teaches you real world policing and security.  If you want a good, honest dose of reality, from a real world profession that is well respected, take his class. If not, move on..

A really good professor with a lot of knowledge in the criminal justice field . Lectures are interesting and interactive with a lot of good stories mixed in. The only minor problem I have with the class is that it often goes off topic from security to police work.  I was hoping to gain a little more information on private security.
This class is interesting and you don't even realize that it's a 3 hour class. Great, great guy. TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!!!!

I only took security administration for the credit, I wasn't entirely sure what the class entailed before taking it but I would gladly take it again because of the professor.  Varrenti is funny, has real world experience and genuinely cares for his students.  I'm not one to really speak up in class and he doesn't require that of you which I like.
Varrenti is awesome, you will learn more from his stories than a textbook. He's a great teacher and knows how to get his students to enjoy his class. Definitely one of my favorite professors

I think we should have more professors who have real life experience, who can incorporate those into the class and lectures to provide more insight on what we should expect in the real world. I enjoy that professor Varrenti doesn't " sugar coat" he's straight to the point.

Taking his class was extremely refreshing in comparison to the majority of the other CRJ professors here. He has abundant real life experience and is more than happy to share it with you, including it in all of his lectures rather than just droning on from a powerpoint. I normally disliked night classes but he made me want to attend.
He has real world experience which makes the class way better than any teacher without it could do. He makes the material fun and  the way he teaches it really makes it stick.
Excellent teacher, very knowledgeable about the subject, has real world experience which makes it a better environment to learn.
Great overall class, he is very engaging and brings a lot of real world experience to the table which is a nice change of pace.  Also very helpful and willing to work with you if need be.

One of the best professors I have had here. Talks about experiences and discusses topics instead of just reading off of a powerpoint for 3 hours. Also lets you know what to expect on tests instead of letting you go in blind.
The guy is the only professor I've ever taken that tells it like it is.  He doesn't just talk from a book but from experience.

Excellent teacher and person. He is very knowledgable and uses personal experiences while teaching which helps with understanding the material. He wants you to succeed in and out of the classroom. Can't say anything negative about him or the class! Wish all teachers had his knowledge and experiences. Definitely recommend for anyone interested!

Didn't take attendance, but attendance is needed for a good grade.  Don't necessarily need the book, but it helps to have. Quizzes and Tests were easy. The classes were never boring, always entertaining with stories of the Chief's experience as an officer.  He's really personable, funny, and cares about his students' success. Definitely recommend!
Style of teaching he brings to the table by sharing experiences and teaching through them instead of using the book the whole time helped me grasp concepts better.
Take this class if you need an elective credit for CRJ. enjoyed every minute of class, gives you real life experiences to learn from.
Teaches the practical usage not the theoretical

Very clear teacher. Great guy, cares about well being of students and is the most realistic professor u will have. Teaches on a practical learning. Things that apply to u today. Doesn't care about history of the subject. Not a theoretical teacher.
Probably the easiest class I've ever taken. Be on time every class and listen to some cool stories.
Such a great professor. Always looked forward to going to class because of his humor and his experiences that he shared. Wish that I could take other classes with him!

Best professor by far at Brockport.  Chief  Varrenti wants to see students succeed.  Will do whatever he can to help you both in and out of the classroom. Uses real life situations to help students better understand the material. Wish he taught full time.  Show up for class, pay attention and you will pass with out any problems.
Great professor. The only professor that I actually learned valuable information from.  Knows his stuff. Tells great stories that you will love. Highly recommend this class.
Chief Varrenti is a great teacher and is always willing to help. usually a night class is a pain but i look forward to it every class. lots of fun and great discussions.

GREAT PROFESSOR wish i could take all my classes with him. Uses real life Scenarios, puts the class on the spot a lot. I wish this class was more than once a week I would attend all of them! Very Easy class if you go to class and pay attention. HIGHLY SUGGEST THIS PROFESSOR i never bought a book for the class
He is a great teacher and uses real life situations to help explain the topics. You must read the book on your own though. Also it is a fun class, only really lectures, guest speakers though.
I find this class very helpful, and the activities that are done in class are a great learning experience.
This is the only class I've taken that's taught by someone who has done the job.  We need more professors like him.
good teacher
Three short quizzes ten tf One midterm and final Final group project is fun.
best teacher Ive ever had
This guy should teach ever course the college offers. Best teacher I have ever had.

Since he is the chief of police, he knows everything there is to know. Best teacher I have had during college. He explains everything very clearly. He teaches with a lot of stories so it is very easy to understand. Extremely personable! I could honestly not say one bad thing about him!!!
Great teacher!
Best professor I've had in my four years at Brockport

I see a character limit.Sadly, because i could go on at length! Dr Norcia is an wonderful professor. I had failed the course twice before with a different professor. I was ready to give up. She never made my ADHD the only thing that defined me. Kind,caring,i got a B+.Excellent feedback.Enjoyed coming. She believed in me always.A true gem.
