comment: took her at FGCU for humanities shes a kind lady at first glance but she's not on your side. waits till last minute to put in grades so you could go through the entire class with a 40 and there's nothing you can do. unqualified for the job, no communication, deceitful grading. I DO NOT RECOMMEND!
She puts in so much effort to give good feedback that you can't help but feel important.

Professor Norcia is all around a great person as well as a great professor. You do have to read alot and do discussions often. There are three big papers but she assigns a proposal for each before the big essays are due and she provides great feedback. If you listen to the corrections she gives you then you will do well.
She's very enthusiastic. Took her class for a one credit thesis practicuum and she was great. Very funny and caring. Very straightforward. Got a passing grade. Would take her again for another class.

Dr. Norcia is AMAZING! She's kind, funny, & BRILLIANT! She leaves amazing feedback on all assignments & recognizes potential in each of her students. The material is so interesting & she is very inclusive of different backgrounds through the works she chooses. She makes you think but it's what helps you grow! I absolutely love Dr. Norcia! Take her!
Great professor that gives clear and helpful feedback. Also funny and cares about how the students do in class. Good at responding to emails, too.
The best part of the class was the discussions. Not only do you learn about the books, but you  learn from your peers. Her classes are never boring. She is a professor who truly knows how to teach!
This class was awesome! Definitely recommend taking it with Dr. Norcia!

Wonderful professor and human being all around. Will go completely out of her way for any student, flexible with deadlines, and understands that we have lives outside of her class. Definitely take a class with Dr. Norcia! p.s. her political views do not have any effect on your grade, she only cares that you are a decent classmate
Awesome class. I would take it again

Many of the class discussions regarding race divided the class where one side was victimized and the other was blamed. I often left Norcia's classes wondering how students could possibly get along with one another after such discussions. I believe her goal was division among students rather than cohesion, assigning projects about racial-relations.

Norcia is a nice person, but she ignores emails and if your political and feminist views do not match hers you'll get a bad grade. If you don't go along with the majority of the class opinion, she will ignore you for the rest of the semester. Most of our textbooks were anti-white and flat out offensive. I wish I had taken a different class.
Dr. Norcia is an awesome teacher, she is so exciting and keeps everything interesting. I cant wait to take more classes with her!!

Great class, and i would recommend Dr. Norcia to anyone looking to take an English class. Super interesting and keeps class engaged for the entire night class. Requires a good amount of reading, but classwork is mostly discussion

I took an online class w/ her and she was phenomenol! I absolutely loved her class and her personality. She's open to all opinions, and highlights ones in the weekly report that she feels are different/interesting. I missed an assignment & she e-mailed me about it, saying she hoped I just forgot & let me hand it in late!! Who does that!!?! :)

Such an enthusiastic professor, I loved this class. Maintained class discussion well and I loved her clever, witty comments in class and on paper grades. Reminds me of Ms. Frizzle. Loved the way she read the picture books to us and always quick with help and emails. Would definitely take more classes with her if I could

She is a nice woman, but the worst grader there is.  She has high expectations that are not clearly stated.  It is as if she grades based on who is her favorite student of that class.  She should clearly state what her grading rubric is, instead of being random.

Although normally enthusiastically ebullient, her sunny demeanor can change in a flash. Class is crammed with EDI students :/ I?ve earned A?s in the hardest Enl classes - not this one. I doubt she liked me lol. My xtra book presentation was equal or better than the grad. students' yet I received little to no partic. credit...whatever.

If there is one word to describe Dr. Norcia, it is enthusiastic. Reading a book a week on top of other classes can sometimes be overwhelming. Angel discussion board posts are required. If you are the person who sits in the back, she will find you. No one gets excluded from class discussions. The books are usually pretty good though. That's a plus.

Dr. Norcia is a great professor. At first I hated taking this because it was a night class, but now I enjoy going to class. She has you read about a book per week but it's childrens book so it's easy. There are two papers. I got an A- on my first one so she's a fair grader. She wants her students to learn and succeed.

You can definitely tell that she loves what she does and her passion for literature is contagious. The in-class discussions are colourful and they just suck you in. She's not especially hard on her students - she has more of a nurturing/good friend quality to her.

She is an awesome professor and a great person. The books she chooses are like nothing you'll read in another class. She loves what she does and gives her passion to her students. The papers are creative and actually fun to write. She is open to anyones' opinion. Take her class!

Norica is a great professor.  She's really nice, and understanding.  There's a lot of reading, but that's expected of 400 level English course.  I loved the class.  It wasn't too hard, but not so easy.  Norcia is really helpful and a fair grader, too.

she's a great teacher. SUPER enthusiastic. but, a hard grader. it's not an easy A. you have to work, (and read) a LOT. but, i took this as a night class and out of 13 or so classes you are allowed 3 absences unexcused!!

Good teacher, has a lot of feedback for students.  She is extremely enthusiastic about her lessons.  Her instructions could use some additional clarification, and her comments are almost always positive, but that doesn't mean you will get a good grade.

you read a children's book (sometimes a few hundred pages) a week. deal with hard literature like plato. a lot of work, but doesn't test. interesting essays/finals! i'd recommend for childhood ed majors. very helpful, and some definitely interesting discussions. pretty good lit choices too.
You have to read a book once a week- and some of them were just not interesting at all- she is very into what she teaches...and also helpful, but i probably wouldn't take another class with her
I loved her! Great professor, very helpful and cheerful all the time! Highly recommend her as well!

Meg is an amazing professor. She loves the material she teaches and three hour night classes FLY by. She requires weekly discussion board postings and a few easy [and almost fun!] papers; she also allows a generous # of absences from night class! I have taken two courses with her and love her! Highly Recommended!

Meg is a wonderful teacher, one of the best I have had. She is extremely helpful and always responds promptly to e-mailed questions.  Grading isn't bad at all and she always wants you to learn and improve. The online posts just see if you read the texts, I think they are useful. The reading is really fun!  Highly recommend!
One of the best teachers that i have ever had. have to do some oneline posts and 2 papers!!! she is very into the books!

Sorry to say, but he is retiring at the end of this semester, or I would recommend him to others! He is a great teacher because he cares about his students & explains assignments well. He is also an easy grader, which never hurts! The only negative I can come up with is that it always took forever to get an email back. I wish him well as he retires

Jutzin is an amazing professor, and I'm sad to say he is retiring after this semester. This is my first class with him, and I don't regret taking it one bit. He is super funny when he is not even trying, and he is a fairly easy grader. He goes over the assignments in class very well, so as long as you show up and do the homework it's super easy!!

One of my favorite professors! This is my second class with him. He explains things in depth along with the assignments. He truly cares about students and is very helpful when it comes to homework. I don't recall having any tests, just hw. His class can be kind of boring, but again it is a 3 hour class so that expected.
Sarah is a great professor, assignments sometimes unclear, but if you made an effort to ask, she would help you out.

I took this class because i needed a language credit. Thinking intro to ASL wouldn't be too difficult. Guess again. She is the hardest grader, very confusing and doesn't make assignments clear. I barely passed when i did a great job and hard work on all my assignments.
She doesn't give extra credit or really any guidelines for her assignments. There are three cultural essays that she gives no direction for but grades really harshly. Don't recommend.

He is a good professor, I have never met him seeing as my course was only online but he responds to emails fairly quickly. His work was easy and the research paper wasn't too bad, you choose your topic from a list provided and write 3000 words so about 12 pages. a"instructional Design"classand oneofthe main points is "keeping clear with instructions" for your students; This is something she expects teachers to do but yet she cannot make her instructions any more difficult. comment: Prof. Singh taught the hardest class I have ever taken at brockport. I expect to get a B- in the class and for the amount of work I had to do just for that makes me sick. Be prepared for a lot of work for a less than worthy grade.

Worst professor at SUNY Brockport. Terrible class, you can barely understand him. Don't take his class!

Unapproachable. Rude. Grading system not strict but traditional standards...simply not fair, his grading system should be evaluated by the college or another professor and corrected. he has a temper, he is rude to the majority of his students, and dont exept a lot of feed back from him. if you are answer a question wrong in class he will make fun of you for it and make you feel like an idiot. he's a tough grader ad he said that the average grade on his final was a 60... comment: Lectures are helpful to go to get some basic information about what you are doing. You will need to teach yourself or attend office hours to learn how to do more difficult problems. just reads off power points, ignores your questions, doesnt respond to emails, if you go see him he will belittle you for not knowing the material. he makes you feel like he's wasting his time. he is a good prof the material is very hard. if you are good at math you will be good at CHM 206. he cares about his students however get tutoring outside of class. he is funny outside of class and is available during his office hours. he is down to earth but his tests are very hard. he wants you to know the chemistry and to ask questions on HW
Many things on tests/homework are not in notes, expects students to teach themselves, belittles students that ask for help \
He taught right off the slide and was very confusing. There was so much homework for this course, and he did not provide any practice exams.

Nice guy, and unfortunately the best teacher in the department. However, his lectures are not engaging at all, and he reads already completed math problems off the screen. So boring. Exams are heavily based on mastering chemistry and practice problems from the PowerPoint, so it is not too hard to study. Available during his office hours.
I think it's the nature of Chemistry to be boring, but his teaching style also made me zone out a lot. I skip lecture a lot cause it's not worth it.

Dr Blose is the best. He cares about his students learning and is very open to working with his students individually. Don't be afraid to tell him if you're struggling. He's very helpful and communicates well with his students.
He made class enjoyable. Powerpoints were informative and organized. Tests were easy, straight from the powerpoints. Answers emails in a timely manner. Extra credit every test. Only one paper.

He is the best advisor i have ever had. He is an extremely nice man and always willing to help.

comment: I took SOC 412 and hes a great guy and funny but i ended up not liking the class. he tends to get off topic and makes the topics more confusing than they are. he tries to make things understandable but youre only graded on about 3-4 things.

comment: This is the stats class to take if you're terrified of math like me. Weininger presents information clearly and makes sure you understand the material before he moves on. She is a great professor, great lecture she talks with her hands and makes it all fun. The assignments were easy and challenging at the same time. Easy understanding the material. Had awesome lectures and was really knowledgeable about the topic. Went through notes very fast.
does lectures but gives out the power points

she is a great professor and she is very far from a tough grader. By far the best professor that I have ever had. Easy to talk to, class are fun and interesting. She really cares about the areas that she teaches and her students. Wonderful mentor and person. The midterm was difficult. Studying is key in that class though. Make sure to do the research paper throughout the semester, the due date creeps up on you quickly. Pretty simple besides that, she answers emails on time , and will give you help if you need it.
Her midterms was pretty tricky, but you just need to look over the lecture material. and she gives extra credit. she makes the lectures interesting enough, one of my favorite classes this semester

Keeps the class intriguing even for students who aren't part of the major.
Dr. Rawlings is very passionate about her subject, which I admired. The workload was light; I found the textbook helpful but not always necessary. She was very thorough in her explanations of things.

Dr. Rawlings is great. Her teaching style is very clear and she really cares that her students understand. Even if you don't love anthro, she makes it fun, and the final was easy enough. This teacher was very off topic and inserted her own comments and completely unrelated experiences. She gets very inappropriate during the reproductive evolutonary chapter. I took this class as my first anthropology course and I did really well in it. The class is easy if you do your work. The book is pointless, but interesting! Her exams have very little to do with what she teaches. Overall she's okay i guess.

This class was boring, not very difficult if you showed up and took notes. Only had to take a midterm and final and complete five short homework assignments, but sitting through class was horrible but you had to go to class since part of your grade is based on attendance.

A midterm and a final in the course plus a few homework assignments. She teaches based off of a powerpoint and her tests can be very difficult. This is my second class I have taken with Dr. Rawlings. Classes consist of lectures. Interesting class and good to take if you have a minor in forensics.

Very boring, i took an anothropology class before this but it didn't count when i transferred in. Rawlings made it boring and added new material. But, does give curves!

The test is complete bull, gave a study guide of over 100 things and asks 40 multiple choice and surprise short answers. Best professor at Brockport! She is always there, and willing to help.  She knows her stuff, and includes details she thinks students will enjoy.  She is funny, and always make the lectures interesting.  She is also my advisor, and is always willing to help me out with anything.  Absolutely LOVE her!

Professor Rawlings is very nice. She has a lot of experience and relates it well to class material, but can go on tangents once in a while. Best professor Ive ever had. Very organized, only professor that knows how to use Angel. Everything is labeled, in order, and up to date. Put all grades, even homework, on Angel. Lots of extra credit too! Shes awsome, professional professor. Wish they were all like her!

She is by far my favorite professor in the Ant. dept. She's always willing to help. Print the slides she puts up, she talks quickly and adds things that aren't on the slides to the test so its easier to catch those things.

Best professor I've ever had at Brockport!!  She covers a lot of info in lecture (so download those slides).  She was always willing to help when I had problems.  She is very funny and really knows her stuff! I am changing my major to Anthropology because of her class.
She's really nice, and super understanding. Just make sure to print out lecture notes and take up ALL of the extra credit options - she gives a ton. Oh and her hair is always fantastic.
Make sure to print off lecture notes, she talks quickly and its easier to have the notes pre-written.
Awesome lecturer. Very smart in HR and really knows his stuff. Gives great feedback on assignments and really listens to his students. One of the best.

I loved this class; Hogan is a great professor, and I learned a lot from the class. I would definitely take it again even with it being at 8am.
Best professor I have ever had. Truly cares about his students success. Very quick grader and gives positive reinforcement when you do well. Take his class if you can

Coach Hogan is awesome! There is a lot of material but he is willing to help however he can.  If you do the work, you will earn an easy A. One of the nicest and most knowledgeable professors I've ever had
was a successful coach and is a great teacher.

I wish I could put into words how amazing this course was. I genuinely wish I could take it again. He is the BEST professor I have ever had. I took this course 2.5 years ago and still think its the best course offered at Brockport. Wish he taught more courses. Recommended him for a faculty award.

Easy class, online, a lot of time to do a decent amount of work but its all easy and shes an easy grader. Listening examples are hard so make sure you have the CD with the textbook.

class was so boring! just watched youtube videos everyday. i signed in and left almost every class. the tests are manageable. i'd say it's an easy b if you put in average effort.

Do the papers and youll pass. The man has a clear bias and it felt like he spent the entire semester trying to convert us all to islam. Too many after school assignments. Midterms and Final was pretty straight forward. Five multiple choice questions, but his grading process doesnt make sense.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Lecture heavy', 'So many papers']
comment: I began the class earning 100s on each of my papers. Although I received perfect scores he offered constructive criticism which I took to heart and applied. Once I began incorporating his feedback my grades began dropping. I ended the class 1.10 pts away from an A. His assignments are uninspired and vague and he rambled for the entire hour.

Don't expect to pass without reading the textbooks, and even then it's not guaranteed. Lectures are long, boring, and difficult to follow. Material is not well explained, simple concepts often feel like rocket science. Not well-adapted for an online or hybrid method. Good man, not such a great teacher. Too hard for a 100 level PEQ course.

Professor Shafiq was very nice and a easy going man. The problem I had with him as a professor is that he seems too confident in his teaching abilities. Hes very unclear, says things that are flat out contradicted by the course material (and common sense). He does have an accent which may account to some misunderstandings but not all.

I had Shafiq during covid, it was a hybrid experience and he did not adapt well. If you email or ask a DIRECT question in class, he often times gives a completely different answer and strays from the question. He also is very specific about how he likes things, he is also super strict about attendance and when people had covid he did not understand

Dr. Shafiq needs more credit given, his class was not awful. He requires you to attend 3 religious programs, which you have to write summaries about. You also must write a summary on each religion. Midterm/final are both 5 short answer questions, which he gives study guides for. It will not be easy, but if you put in the work, you will get an A.

This class was way too much work for a PEQ. He spends the whole hour and 20 minutes on one topic or one PowerPoint slide. His lectures are so confusing and dont make any sense. He expects you to know information before you learn it that isnt even in the textbook. Expects you to read 50+ pages on each chapter and write a full 3 page essay on them.

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Lecture heavy']
comment: The only reason I didnt give a 1 was because if you actually do the work he basically gives you a 100 on everything. However he is SO boring. The class I dreaded the most this semester. Around 8 papers you will have to write, read 70 pgs each chapter, and you have to go to events outside of class. WAY too much work for a PEQ.

This class wasn't too hard, but it was sooooo boring. The lectures seemed to go on for hours. Made criteria unclear then took off points if you didn't write what he wanted. No quizzes or tests except for the midterm and final, which are 5 ish short answer questions. Lots of papers. He's a nice guy and knows his stuff, but I wouldn't recommend.

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Get ready to read', 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: Funny guy and very smart. Lectures go on for what seems like 5 hours. Very boring, just keeps going on and on and on. Hard to understand. Expects you to read every chapter of both books and write essays on each religion according to the book. MidTerm was 5 different essays but study guide had 20 possible questions he could have asked. Very hard!!!

Generally a really nice and funny older man, but not a very good teacher. Lectures do not make sense, lack of organization, unclear grading criteria, and expects you to read every chapter of both books

This man is a true gem and is so funny I would just show up to listen to him make jokes about religion. Since religion is mandatory at Naz, you might as well take it with Shafiq cause he doesn't make it as painful and you don't have to work really hard to get a good grade.

Is difficult to understand and be ready to be a mind reader. He does not give out specific guidelines but will except things done just as he wants them done. One of the most boring and frustrating classes I have taken I do not recommend.

I skipped this class several times because I couldn't understand him and wasn't clear with directions. I figured I would do the work outside of class since most assignments were online. Hes a good teacher as he'll help you and is an easy grader but I hated the class.

Interfaith class - I hated it, it was boring and we didn't get into any other material than how to speak nicely to each other - which, amazingly enough, took THREE BOOKS. He's a wonderful man, and AMAZING when it comes to actual public lectures - wish I could've seen that more in class.
Very tough to understand him, he is not clear about what he wants, which drives the whole class insane but all you need to do is show up and pass the mid-term and final.
Very easy class, all you do is sleep in it and you're still guaranteed to pass. Plus, his midterm is 5 questions only and our final was a take home test.

Nice fellow, tough to understand with his thick accent. He is willing to help his students and has a lot of office hours. Shows some favoritism, but its not too bad. Study hard for the midterm and final and you will be all set.
Difficulty in language barrier, but more than willing to work with those who want to succeed

He is a very nice guy, but the class is boring. I took it @ 8am, and I could barely stay awake. He is also sometimes hard to understand due to his accent. But as long as you do well on the midterm and the final, your almost gauranteed an A.

Really cares about students, always willing to help, difficult to understand, teaching style very bland and traditional, difficult to be attentive in morning class, very qualified but just needs new teaching approach
jsut do well on the midterm and final and you're set
He's enthusiastic, and even though he has an accent, he's easy to understand. Overall, I went into this class dreading it and now I sort of enjoy it. And thats saying a lot at 8am.

I have taken two classes with Dr. Shafiq. He is a very calm and peaceful man who cares deeply for all of his students. He is incredibly understanding and will take his time to help you when you need it. Great professor, awesome person.

Dr. Shafiq is a cool guy.  I don't reccomend taking his class earlier in the morning, cos it's hard enough to stay awake in his class.  If you do all the work and but SOME effort into the class, then you should be fine.  He takes attendance too, and works that into final grading..so showing up to cl

He is hard to understand sometimes, and the class is boring, but if you do the work, the tests should be easy. Not much homework besides reading, and he is very fair and understanding in terms of the tests and homework. He gives extra credit too, which is always a plus!

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Beware of pop quizzes']
comment: He's a nice guy and class is actually not bad if you're willing to put the work in and participate. Just know he gives out pop quizzes but they arnt that hard if you just do the readings every night.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'EXTRA CREDIT', 'Beware of pop quizzes']
comment: Arellano is a good professor who wants to see his student succeed.  In order to make sure his students do the reading he will randomly assign pop quizzes.  Relatively easy to follow his lectures.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Beware of pop quizzes', 'Lecture heavy']
comment: He is super sweet and understanding, and as long as he sees that you put an effort into his class you will be in good standing with him. He is big on participation so definitely make sure that you have an idea what the readings are about and you should be good. The quizzes and tests are fair and he is not a tough grader.
If you do the reading this class is easy and really informative, the professor is caring and understanding

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Beware of pop quizzes', 'Lecture heavy']
comment: Nice guy. Long and boring lectures but if you pay attention it all makes sense. Lots of quizzes but if you read you should be fine. Easy hw and tests. Tough subject but you can do it.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Beware of pop quizzes', 'Lecture heavy']
comment: I felt this class was insufferable and confusing. I thought Prof. Arellano was very monotone and made it really hard to focus. He did have his occasional funny one-liners though. Threatens a pop-quiz every class. Perfect stereotype of a college professor.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Clear grading criteria', 'Lecture heavy']
comment: He's a pretty easygoing guy. Just get your work done and do the readings and homework assigned outside of class. And don't fall asleep in class! Or try not to. The lectures are helpful and there are practice problems done in class that you wont want to miss.

Philosophy is just confusing, so it wasn't his fault I hated the class. Adrian did his best to make lectures bearable and was fast with grading assignments. I would say pay as good attention as possible and take decent notes to look back on. Didn't give quizzes so your grade is mainly based on homework assignments, where there were plenty of.

He's really not as bad as the other reviews say, but his lectures are boring and he can be insensitive. His tests are pretty hard as well, and often the questions aren't relevant to what was discussed in class.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: He was a very passionate professor and knew what he was talking about. However, I was just not as interested in the topic. I still did well in the class though just make sure you do the readings and homework and you will do fine.

I loved my class with Adrian! He made class during COVID the most accessible and easy to follow out of all of my professors this semester. He did such a good job of teaching remotely as well. 10/10 would recommend.

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Beware of pop quizzes', 'Tough grader']
comment: He wasn't the worst, but he wasn't the best. The content is overwhelming and the textbook required is a bit confusing. There are alot of things to read for this class before the next class.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Beware of pop quizzes', 'Lecture heavy']
comment: Do the readings and you'll be fine. Everything is discussed in class via powerpoint and lecture so even if you don't fully get it, you will. Don't skip because he gives in-class writing a lot to make sure you did the reading. Typically the powerpoints are posted before and most of the answers are on there.

Classes are lecture heavy, he just reads directly from powerpoint slides. Don't really learn anything from his teachings. Show up to class because he gives frequent pop quizzes. Easy to do good on midterm and final if you do the reading and study. Would definitely not recommend him.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK', 'LECTURE HEAVY']
comment: Presentation heavy. Plain white screen power point with black words. Overall this class is very easy if you do the work and ask questions. One quiz every week and homework every night you have this class. Overall he is a good professor. No unit tests just midterm, final and quizzes.
This class was so boring. The professor usually just talked the whole time and went through powerpoints or wrote on the chalkboard. Usually one pop quiz every class - be sure to do the readings.
Pretty average, not hard not totally easy there is a decent amount of hw, but it's pretty simple.
I would suggest taking this class. Professor Arellano is not a tough grader. His lectures are long and kind of boring at times, but overall a very easy class.

Adrian was a great philosophy teacher! I had him for my Logic & Inquiry class, and he made abstract concepts easy to understand. He was pretty easy in grading too. I will totally take another class with him.

Obviously its going to be confusing, its philosophy...Ask questions via email or his office hours and you'll do fine.  Very fair in terms of grading. No unit tests, just midterm & final + quizzes (in which he drops 2 lowest).  Attendance isn't mandatory but it helps understand the assigned reading for that class

Took his class over at the University of Rochester in the summer. Very chill, laid back guy. Definitely knew what he was talking about. No powerpoints so you have to take notes, but what he says are directly on tests. HW assignments easy but read your book! Otherwise you'll be lost in class.
If you do the work, you'll get an A. Go to class, if you miss you're screwed

I didn't really start enjoying this class till over halfway through the semester, and it wasn't because of the teacher. He certainly knows a lot about the subject manor, he just doesn't seem to do the best job of convaying it to others. He spends a lot of time repeating himself and when asked questions his answers are usually confusing.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Gives good feedback', 'Graded by few things']
comment: History of Psych was a such a fun course to take with Dr. Gallagher. The course content was interesting and the class environment was relaxed and fun. We laughed so often in class. Although I didn't do the best in this class, I would still highly recommend taking any course with Dr. Gallagher!!

Social psych 228 requires discussion forums.  He gives relatable scenarios that helps material stick!! Clear assignment directions.  Some of his personal vocabulary is high and confusing for a UG student.  Overall, very funny and open!
Inquizatives are very annoying. Be very careful with AI use, always run your work through an AI generator because he will run it through and fail you if anything shows up. Hes a funny guy though.

"Quests" are on online. Very lecture heavy. Class isn't mandatory but you take easy participation quizzes for classes you go to. Final paper at the end of the semester. Inquizitives were frustrating. Overall, easy class for peq

Very easy class for peq , he made it fun and engaging , the slides did have lots of information on them but if you dont get anything you can go to his office hours ! Very kind professor  , for this not being in my major it was easy you just have to be on top of assignments !!!

He is a kind/passionate professor. Tries to make lectures entertaining but can go fast at times.Inquizatives for hw were annoying but can find the answers in quizlets. There are tests every 2-3 weeks where you have to apply terms rather than definitions so you have to know the terms well enough. But are all multiple choice. Also emails back fast.

Dr Gallagher is nice and very passionate about psychology. IT is very lecture heavy with a test or "Quest" every two weeks that you have to apply the info you learned so its way more than learning definitions so I struggled with that. You don't need the textbook but you do need inquizzitve- a lot of busy work bc answers can be found online.

tags: ['Tough grader', 'Clear grading criteria', 'Beware of pop quizzes']
comment: She doesn't really know how to teach students with learning disabilities and she is really really tough on students and she will single you out !

Dr. Choi is a wonderful professor, but she can be brutally honest. I love her class and everything, but she tends to go a bit fast with content at times. She is so funny and great at teaching my piano class. It moves a little slow for my liking, but it is a class for people who have never touched a piano before and I've been playing 7 years. tags: ['Participation matters', 'Clear grading criteria', 'Beware of pop quizzes']

Bonnie is one of the best Professors you can have. If she sees you struggling she will help you individually. tags: ['Respected', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Beware of pop quizzes']

tags: ['Hilarious', 'Gives good feedback', "Skip class? You won't pass."]

The best teacher I've ever met!!!!!
Bonnie is the best; probably the best teacher I've had here at Naz. She is tough but always is there to help and make you laugh when needed. This is super hard but, totally worth my mornings.

Bonnie is a great teacher. She flies through material, but explains things pretty well. She doesn't baby you, she expects you to practice for the class as you should. She is great! And she is soo cute, and funny. Makes me laugh almost every class.
Bonnie Choi is awesome
Bonnie is a hoot. She makes lessons worth going to even if you didn't practice.

hilarious

She's a really funny teacher, and is such a gossiper.
sometimes confusing, but a fun teacher
She gives out a lot of time to work on assignments in class!

comment: Greatest Prof I ever had
A requirement all students have to take but Martha made it fun. She gave interesting topics, is an interactive lecturer, and was always ready to have an open discussion.

Prof. Majsak was great for ENGW 102! She made sure to always bring up the energy and spoke to us on our level and not like she was above us, which is important to me. Her advice for papers sometimes directly contradicted things that have been drilled in my head since middle school, and she made me think harder about my writing, which I loved.
Martha is AMAZING!!!! I absolutely adored her. She is so kind, caring, and passionate about what she does. Definitely one of the best English Professors that Nazareth has.

I think she was really good! Very passionate, knowledgeable, and funny! Class participation and attendance was not necessary. I honestly thought this class was really easy and boring at times, but it was required and an easy A so I'm not complaining. Basically everything I had learned in high school, but it's whatever. Would recommend!!

Professor Majsak is unlike any professor I've had- she has a very outgoing personality, but knows what she's talking about. She is very passionate about the topics we cover, and always willing to help students when we need help for papers. There isn't a lot of homework and the class is very manageable(a bit boring sometimes, but no big deal.)
Professor Majsak has a very eccentric personality. The class is extremely boring, but she has clear guidelines for assignments and walks you through the steps of each essay, which is nice.

She is a really good professor. She clearly is passionate about what she teaches and does a good job explaining topics during class. The class feels a bit long but she keeps you engaged and you'll understand the concepts. Laptops and phones aren't used in class, and you take notes in your notebook. Tests are open note.

I got a bad grade on my "Sociology of Love" thesis, and it changed my heart and soul. Later, I earned a master's degree from another local college during the pandemic, proving one grade wasn't the end. Dr. McGann does wonderful things in the community. Signing out—no more academics. Time to sing, dance, and keep making a positive difference.
Dr. McGann's teaching style is very straightforward and she explains sociology concepts well. She's kind of hard to get a hold of outside of class, though; she never answered any emails!

Have to write this review rn before I forget to. She out loud stated to some students including myself that queer relationships "just have to be extra so everyone pays attention to them" when talking about marriage customs and weddings

Dr. McGann is very funny and keeps the class engaged. She makes the material easy to understand and gives many great analogies! However, she wasn't always clear on reading assignments. Fun and engaging content, there are often readings but not super long. In SOC Sex Marriage and Families, McGann would sometimes conduct "2 minute talks." Really easy assignment to get a good grade on, just show up prepared to talk for two minutes.

I have learned absolutely nothing that I didn't already know going into this class. It was common sense and she was very disorganized. There is 1 hr 30 min to answer 30 mc and 2 medium response with 2 detailed quotes from 3 sources.
GUYS I LOVE PROF MCGANN SM!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! if anyone needs to take soc., take it with her!!

Professor McGann is very good at lecturing and getting students to understand the material. She assigns readings almost every class, it's super important to do the readings as they are the basis of most tests. All tests are open book/note. I find her classes really fun and engaging. She can be a bit disorganized but other than that I love her.

This class was genuinely painful to take, the professor is very rude. tags: ['Tough grader', 'Get ready to read', 'Lots of homework']
comment: Tons of reading to be done, and getting a good grade on writing work means you write in a way that appeals to her, very hilarious person but you can very clearly see her biases in her teaching. A very nice person but a very tough teacher

tags: ['Tough grader', 'Get ready to read', 'Graded by few things']
comment: McGann is a very sweet person however she is a very tough grader when it comes to tests and the reading questions. If it doesn't fit the exact idea for an answer you'll get it wrong. Readings were interesting and well planned through class however she doesn't respond to emails and once your grade is below your ideal it is very hard to get it back

Literally lover her. I'm a sociology major so I've taken many classes with her and I love her teaching style. She is super nice and is always writing down any important notes. The reading questions are basically the exams so do the readings!! Overall, great teacher and would definitely recommend!

Tests were sometimes weird and used content not fully discussed in class and there were LOTS of readings, but overall good professor. How does it feel to get a D? Sorry.
I still remember this as the worst course I've ever taken roughly 10 years ago. -Anonymous

This class was hard for a PEQ; Dr. McGann is very nice and funny but could be a bit all over the place at times and it was hard to follow some lectures. Lots of readings and tests could be pretty hard. Dr. McGann doesn't give great feedback and can come off as cold one-on-one, but is overall a decent professor if you like the subject matter.
i LOVED class w professor mcgann. shes so funny, and clearly knows what shes talking about. honestly might just change my major so i can keep taking her classes.

mcgann is funny and makes lectures interesting. participation in class is important and definitely don't try and go on your phone during class. there are a lot of reading assignments that are discussed every class and tests have some tricky questions. there is a lot of info from the readings on the tests , but they're open note and timed.

Dr. McGann is so smart and is absolutely hilarious. I've never had a professor who actually made me laugh out loud more times than she did during the semester. The homework that she assigns is both interesting and manageable, and I actually feel that I can apply the concepts I learned in this class to other courses and real-life situations.

Do not take a class with this professor, very close minded and believes her views are the only ones that matter. If she doesn't like you, you will not do well. Only good thing is there is no required textbook for Mass Media and Pop Culture.

She's one of those professors who have favorites in her classes. If your not a favorite you won't get an A even if you do well in the class. She can be a "hater" in the sense that if you don't kiss up to her she most likely doesn't like you. If she doesn't like you then the highest grade you'll get is a b-

HORRIBLE PROFESSOR! She isn't clear about what you need to know for the tests and relies on participation and attendance way too much. Just for missing one class, even if it's excused, you automatically get a 90% on your participation (which counts for 20% of the class). If you approach her with questions she won't help you at all. Don't take her!!

Overall a nice professor but her humor can sometimes come off as arrogance. She keeps class interesting but make sure you don't miss class activities because they count in your grade. There's no assigned textbook for the class but DO THE READINGS even if it's the night before the test or you won't do well on the tests. Overall an easy class.

She makes a really interesting lecture and the hw is straight forward. You should do absolutely fine as long as you keep up with the hw. She doesn't give too much reading to handle. She may seem a little off when you see her more one-on-one and it can be quite uncomfortable, but don't worry about it, she definitely cares about her students.
Makes class interesting! She is an amazing teacher and uses real life examples to make the material clear. I would recommend for students to take her classes.

Awful professor, no real clarity on what you need to know for tests, need to know all of the readings for the tests, even the minor details. Before taking the class i was thinking of a picking up a sociology minor, I quickly dropped that idea after the first few classes, she does not make class enjoyable and she is not funny at all.

There is no textbook, only articles that she assigns. I HIGHLY suggest you do the reading, as the tests are closely linked to the reading. Also, pay attention in her lectures (she is so funny, so its easy to pay attention). You will definitely have fun in this class, regardless of your major.
She has a great personality! She mad an intro class a lot of fun.  She is very funny which makes her lectures interesting. Take a class with her if you can
McGann is old enough to be my mother, but acts like she's in her 20's. She is very loud and loathsome and her class is dry.

Prof. McGann is fantastic! She is very clear as to what she wants, has a great personality which makes every class fun and interesting, and is always there to lend a helping hand. Does require quite a bit of writing, but is always there to help you with each step. Awesome professor!

Just got hired this year (2007). She's very enthusiastic and helpful. There's a lot of writing though. We have to write a reaction chapter to everything we read. It's been three weeks and we've had to write 7 papers already. Relates the class to current events, I would recommend her to anyone.
His attitude towards students makes the experience very unpleasant. He degrades students to prove he is right.

Professor Tisdale was handsdown the WORST professor (if you can even call him that) I've had. He is very sexist and it showed during discussion. Due to this class having been smaller he would get up in our faces if we said ANYTHING he didn't agree with. The content overall was easy and informative but his "teaching" was not.

He is genuinly the worst professor I have ever had. He does not teach. He makes groups present the homework and if you don't every single answer to the questions he asks you he will make you stand in front of the class as long as it takes and offer no solutions and not attempt to teach anybody. He should not even have a job as a professor.

Dr. Stearns is very supportive towards his students. He genuinely wants to see them succeed. He will help you in anyway he can. The exams can be difficult, but he does try his best to prepare his students for them and is willing to meet one on one in his office to help them understand what they are struggling on! I would 100% recommend taking him:)

Stearns is a great professor! His class is lecture heavy, so be ready to take notes. There are minimal assignments graded so the tests are very important. He was always helpful during office hours but not as accessible through email. Very sweet man who always has the best interest for his students at heart. Also bonus questions on tests!

Dr. Stearns is a great professor. Biology is not my strongest subject, but he explained things very well and gave review questions for every chapter. He also gives test corrections, so you can succeed as long as you put in the work. He is a super sweet guy, loves his job. He goes fast in lectures, I recommend just downloading the slides to write on

LOVE HIM SO MUCH!! He's such an amazing teacher. So helpful with studying tips and doing well on tests. We only had three test and almost no homework. Most of the work is extra credit and not required. A couple group projects but you pick your own groups and project topics. He also brings breakfast/food to class sometimes!

IF YOU HAVE TO TAKE ANATOMY YOU NEED STEARNS, don't settle for another professor. It is a very lecture heavy- dense class but he does everything he can to help his students. All of the anatomy prof use the same exams and slideshows but he will go out of his way to help you understand and give back as much extra credit as possible. Most exams curved

Professor Stearns was the most caring professor I've ever had. He really wants you to succeed and makes that pretty clear.  Anatomy lab and lecture are pretty difficult courses, but he was able to help everyone be successful. Professor Stearns will do anything in his power to help you pass the course. Overall, best educator I've ever had.

I took BIO 210 lecture with Sterns. He is the best option for anatomy lecture. I find his lectures a little boring, but as long as you study for the test they are very straight forward. His power points have an overwhelming amount of content, but if you ask to meet with him he will slim down test content for you.
His lectures are so fun was always looking forward to attending class would highly suggest taking him as a lab professor is so passionate about his lectures.

Very nice and really helped understand the material. Hard lab but definitely recommend taking it with him. He goes above and beyond to help you succeed (very flexible) Tests are hard but they are the same as all the other lab sections so you can study with friends. Study guides help. Homework takes time, but same for all A&P labs.

Professor Forth does not show support towards her students. The exams are difficult and the whole class grade is based on the exams. She constantly doubts her students and discourages them if they don't do good on the exams. She didn't seem to care to help the students do well on the exams, her questions were much more difficult than the practice.

Amazing, hilarious, very knowledgeable professor. A lot of work required but if you painstakingly perfect your drug cards, you are set. Love Professor Forth and would love to take another course with her. Important to learn critical thinking skills for tests.
Do every single drug card, study her power points, and practice NCLEX questions. Be ready to write a few long papers!  They are however, interesting and helpful. Great professor!
Very difficult class but she made it worth it. Material is tough and so are tests, but she is willing to help you however she can. Gives good feedback. MAKE DRUG CARDS!!!
She's a hard ass, but she's fair. Worship her powerpoints and DO THE DRUG CARDS. She's very helpful and wants you to succeed.
Awesome professor. Material is hard but she breaks it down for you. Be sure to do your drug cards!!!
