One of the BEST & most genuine people at Naz! Definitely makes you work hard for your grade but she's available pretty much everyday and willing to help any student with anything (go to office hours!). She makes everything clear & easy to understand. These people just don't like having to put in work for grades. But all her assignments are helpful!
Way too many papers And assignments I felt like I was drowning. Encourages students to come after class and then still gives bad grades.

I do not understand what all these bad ratings are. The reason people do not like LaPlant's classes are because they are hard and you need to put some work in. However, she is always available outside of class and will go far above to help you if you ask for it. She is super nice and her tests have always been fair.

Makes a hard class bearable and easy. Cares about each of her students and will do anything she can for them. She makes you put in the work if you want a good grade but she is always available for help. Tests are always fair and never have any surprises. Not to mention she has a degree in college teaching. Take class with her if you can she's great

First off, her class is extremely boring. You will catch yourself dozing off because she is the only one that cares about the content she is teaching. She is just odd. She also somehow finds joy in giving her students terrible grades on their papers (which you have to write a paper for basically every class). Do not take this class.

Might possibly be the worst professor I have ever had. She has no concern for the grades she gives to her students and will easily fail you on any of the numerous papers she assigns with no real reasoning behind it. Also, on top of her being a horrific grade, she is also extremely strange. I would not recommend if you care about your GPA.

I found the lectures to be long and boring. Laplant is boring and acts a bit strange. Participation matters and there are so many papers, youd think with kids shed understand how hard it is with new papers every week. Would not take this again.

Dr. Laplant is very understanding if you have to miss class for a legitimate reason however she assigns no tests and all assignments. Too many in my opinion. Be prepared to have 2-3 papers every two weeks on top of group assignments. Too much work for a 200 level class.

She's a great professor and loves her job and does a great job remembering her students. She gives more homework than a lot of other professors I've had. Be prepared for at least one assignment per week. Participation (including showing up to class) counts toward your grade. She has a master's in teaching so she actually knows what she's doing.
She is the best teacher! Very caring, supportive, and truly loves her job and students.
She's really passionate about stats and will go the extra mile to help you understand if that's what you need. Not too many homework assignments and not too many tests. Very understanding.
I loved Dr. LaPlant!! She was amazing! Her lectures were very useful and interesting!

Dr. LaPlant is a wonderful professor and loves what she is doing, which makes class enjoyable.  She always gives great real life examples to make things clear and it makes lessons interesting.  I took the class because I had her previously and she's great at what she does.  No test, just little assignments here and there.  Would recommend.

Dr. LaPlant is one of the best professors I have ever worked with. She's extremely knowledgable in her field and loves to teach.  If you have a question, she is more than willing to give you a clear answer. Several of my classmates took this class just because she was teaching it. There is no final cumulative test. I would highly recommend her!!

Wonderful teacher.  She is someone that makes class more enjoyable by explaining things with examples and is very laid back.  The test are simple and she drops the lowest grade.  All you have to do is take the notes she gives and you'll be golden.

She is an excellent professor. The atmosphere in the classroom is very relaxed. There are 4 tests and she drops the lowest grade; make sure to look in the textbook because the multiple choice questions often come from the book. There is one group presentation that is fairly easy. Overall, I really liked her and she knew what she was teaching about.

tags: ['Tough grader', 'Get ready to read', 'Lots of homework']
comment: Do not take this professor, you will regret it. So tough to keep up with all the readings to the point his classes should be worth 5 credits. Your essays will look like a christmas tree with all the red ink as did mine even when I would get around 95's still. Too much effort for this kind of class.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Graded by few things']
comment: In class discussions didn't feel necessary, attendance only really mattered on peer review days. Not a lot of feedback, but grading wasn't too harsh. Go in knowing how to write an essay, there's not much help with that in class. Essay topics and books were interesting enough. Not a great class, but not awful. If you can write, you'll do well.

Professor Madigan (Thats all you can refer to him by) is very proper. You must write in a similar sense to him or you will fail every paper that he makes you write. Mark likes to hear himself speak so much that you cannot get a word in, and you will get a horrible participation grade because of that. Also no technology allowed. Avoid at all costs

Professor Madigan may intimidating at first, but he's an excellent professor. He cares deeply about what he teaches, and does his best to choose books that students will enjoy. There are quizzes on each book, but as long as you read and pay attention you'll be fine. He is a bit of a tough grader, but he gives great feedback on each paper.

Going into this class I was a bit intimidated from what I've heard about Prof Madigan. Thankfully, I was proven wrong. He created an awesome environment and picked some of the best books I've ever read for this course. The quizzes are quite specific but if you read the book, you have nothing to worry about. Highly, highly recommend.

Dr. Madigan loves what he does and is extremely passionate. There is SO MUCH READING to do so be ready to read. He grades toughly on papers. There are quizzes after books, so reading is mandatory. As long as you read and participate you will pass.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Graded by few things']
comment: Mark has high expectations that can appear daunting, but his passion for what he is teaching is evident. Reading is necessary and the essays require thought and effort. If you pay attention in class and take some notes while reading the quizzes are not as bad. I enjoyed the selection of literature and the supplemental resources shown in class.

He's a nice person, there was a lot of reading but the books he chose were interesting and good reads. There are quizzes after every book so you do have to read and there were 3 papers, no tests or final. You can tell he cares about the subject, but class was sometimes boring, he does grade on participation.

Dr. Madigan is the BEST. This class was a wonderful way to end my senior year at Nazareth. Through this class I discovered several books and short stories that are now my favorites. His reading assignments are split up the perfect length, so I dont feel as if Im rushing to finish. Hes a fair grader and gives a ton of feedback on papers.

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Tough grader']
comment: Quizzes are difficult and specific, make sure to study at least 30 mins before taking one. No midterm, just a large comparative essay. I got an 88 on it and it was marked up like I had received a 40. Final was 2 essays we had to write in 2 1/2 hours, it was exhausting. All of the books were interesting, and he is a nice guy, just hard to get an A.

Dr. Madigan is so passionate about this subject area, and it really shows. This class was a lot of fun. We wrote one paper towards the beginning of the semester and wrote journals and took quizzes on everything we read. Really great class and professor!
Dear professor, your quizzes are extremely difficult . Im someone with a very high iq , and struggle with the quizzes . Would of got an A If it wasnt for the stupid quizzes.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: He is very scary at first , but then he was very nice as the semester went on . I dont think he grades hard at all on papers ?

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: The professors quizzes are hard as hell . Theyre odd questions on the quiz for sure.

Arrogant professor. Does not tolerate laptops, cell phones, anyone talking but him, or writing anything on paper that isn't for his class. Does not take feedback well and does not accommodate students' needs.

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Tough grader']
comment: Overall a nice guy but kind of scary at first. Gives ridiculously hard reading quizzes on every book and grades papers very harshly.

I had a 4.0 in high school honestly , but always felt stupid when I was in class . I think he is great professor , but dont bomb the quizzes cuz they lower your grade a lot . Also , dont miss one day of class ! He really cares about participation and attendance

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: I thought he was very nice . His class was hard and boring and made me sleepy. He graded reasonable though for the most point .literate is not my best subject so thats why I struggled with the class ...

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS']
comment: Love Madigan. His class can be a little boring but if you actually do the readings (or can finesse your way through a book on SparkNotes) you'll do fine in this course. He does care a lot about participation because if you don't participate, it's just him talking the entire time. Really nice professor overall.

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Get ready to read', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS']
comment: The class was dedicated to discussing books from the reading assignments. We also only had one paper but it was such a high percentage of the grade and he graded harshly on it. He is a good guy though.
Great guy, great professor. Learned a lot and read a lot of good books. Very passionate and graded fairly.

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Get ready to read', 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: This professor was great - the class was very interesting, as were his discussions with the class. He picks great books that you will learn a lot from. The class is a lot of work - usually 50 pages minimum reading and a journal entry due the next class. Even though it's a lot of work, the class is great and worth taking.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: He gives clear instructions on what assignments and expectations are for the class. However, there is a lot of reading and he assigns something every single class. Class discussions are encouraged, and he tries to keep things interesting and funny. Overall, I enjoy his class. Just be prepared to do the homework and read a lot of pretty good books!

I absolutely loved this class. It wasn't themed like many of the other ones. We read some articles and things from the book which helped us write a total of 4 papers. No exams or quizzes. He was straight forward. There is peer editing before every paper is due which really helps. You get to revise whatever paper you want for your final.
He picks great books and explains them very well. He also recognizes that most people aren't majoring in Lit in the 101 class so its not too intensive or demanding. Overall really enjoyed it.
Best. Professor. Ever.

To be honest, I found Madigan to be quite a jerk. I knew of other students who loved him, but I could not stand him. He always seemed to be very rude and not at all compassionate. As an English major, taking this intro course to him was disheartening. He seems to only use teaching as a crutch, not caring about the students at all.
Definitely not a hand holder, but if you do the work, you will do well in his classes.  He knows a lot about a lot of things. Good sense of humor too. Overall, one of the best professors at Naz.

I read for every single class and could not get higher than a 70 on any of his reading quizzes, he is condescending, pompous, and so uncompassionate.  Everything I learned from him I could have learned from wikipedia. Awful.

This class was pretty fun, despite it being at 8am. Madigan put some humor in his classes and always mixed up each activity. It seemed that we were on the topic of going green and global warming which I found interesting. We had to write 4 papers, of two we could pick one to rewrite.

This class was pretty fun, despite it being at 8am. Madigan put some humor in his classes and always mixed up each activity. It seemed that we were on the topic of going green and global warming which I found interesting. We had to write 4 papers, of two we could pick one to rewrite.
Nice guy, easy class.  The books he chose for us to read were actually enjoyable.  He always came to class well prepared, though the class could get a wee bit boring.
My third class with him and I still love it. Great professor...EXTREMELY smart!
very intelligent, brilliant and interesting man

He is a good professor. I really like how he teaches and uses class participation to the extreme.  He doesn't require that much writing, even in writing intensive courses like rhetoric...this is my third class with him and I find him very intelligent and informative. He will also let you share your opinions, even if he doesn't agree with them.
Quite honestly, I could not stand this man.  I thought he was kind of a jerk.  Not to mention, he wore the same pants every day.....?
def. challenges you, you have to take his class serious tho, not a goof off class or easy prof. learned a lot tho.

He is a very intelligent man.  The class was challenging, but worth taking.  The books were interesting and some of the best I've ever read.  Oh ya, I don't remember having any trouble getting A's.  Maybe you just can't write?

he may not be the greatest professor ever but he is smart and usually has a good sense of humor...just don't catch him on a bad day. he expects mature college students and doesn't require a lot of work. this is bad b.c you don't know what he wants sometimes but i highly recommend this class
The lessons get repetitive, but overall he's a fine english teacher to have.  It is very hard to write a solid A paper for him as he gives low 90's consistantly
He's an okay teacher...although i hate it when he does group work
good guy--taking classes with him in his areas of interest (african american lit, american lit) would be better than areas that he is not interested in.
I was excited to take this class until I fell asleep mentally every time the class met. Not good at keeping you interested, having done the reading or not. Try at your own risk!

Amazing teacher, makes student think for themselves, rather than just recite information back. Strong sense of the 20th century and pop culture writings, and this is reflected his open discussions on such topics as racism, diversity, and multiculturalism.
Couldn't disagree more.  I don't know about his writing, but he is a GREAT teacher.
is obviously a teacher because he can´t make a living as a writer. Those are typically the worst kind of teachers. Take note: teaching is a profession not a crutch.
Awesome teacher.
it is so hard to get over an 89 with him on papers...hardly anyone in my class got over a B
The BEST Naz has to offer.  Doesn't like laziness or dummies
Thought he really was one of the worst naz has to offer!!
not a nice guy, at all
nice guy, decent class
No Comments

She's very caring. She does tend to go past her class time talking though. Weekly online quizzes help boost your grade, so make sure to do good on those. She really does try to make sure everyone passes. She posts her notes from class, but not her slides. I recommend taking notes on the computer because there's a lot. There's also a lot of reading.

Professor Cordova can be very sweet but she speaks very fast and you barely have time to take down notes, the lectures are not posted so you need to take heavy notes in class. Study guides are nothing like the exams and there are a lot of readings that are very boring and bland.
Not the nicest. Can have a bit of a condescending attitude. Very tough and lacks sympathy for students. There are other professors in the department that have a more diverse view.

As a history major, I may be bias, but Dr. Cordova is great! Her lectures are heavily dependent on PowerPoint presentations and does not post them online after class. All the readings are posted online and there is homework after every class, varying in amount per week (30 pages a week AT MOST)
Dr. Cordova can be nice but she is tough. Personally, I dislike her and her class.

Dr. Cordova is clear with expectations and is very helpful if you see her outside of class. Most classes are lectures from a slideshow. They can sometimes be long and a bit dry, but she keeps the energy up and asks for participation. Take good notes because you only get the info once, and the midterm and final combine for about half of your grade.

It is clear that Dr. Cordova cares about her students and the courses she teaches from the very first class.  She regularly checks in on everyone to see how they are doing overall, not just in her class.  The course is very reliant on the assigned readings, and discussions are usually based on those readings, so if you do them you'll do well!

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Amazing lectures', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: Professor Cordova is amazing and she really made me feel confident in myself during my first semester :)

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Group projects', 'Accessible outside class']
comment: Professor Cordova is very nice and cares about her students. There is a lot of homework, but it isn't too bad. I enjoyed the class. There is one paper, which can be difficult if it's your first historical paper, but the instructions are clearly explained. Overall if you pay attention in class and work hard, you will be fine.

Dr. Cordova is very old school and I disliked her lectures (which were beyond boring and made me sleepy).  I don't recall a single thing I learned this year.  You don't have to read because there is no quiz on the text and all she does is talk.  She is not understanding whatsoever to any difficulties you may have.  This class was a waste of money.

If you are a visual learner, don't take this class. She leaves her powerpoints very vague and expects you to listen to her for your notes (which she does not post online). She speaks very vaguely but then her exams are very specific. Lots of reading, and I find it hard to learn from her. She is very old school and is just not good.

Not that great. She speaks to you like you are stupid and don't have a clue in the world, and has pointless conversations about "how to present" and "how to write footnotes" etc, which just wastes class time. Lots of reading, and then gets verbally upset at the class when they don't participate. She grades harshly and is very old school.

Don't take if you're a student athlete. She's a really great professor, and I did enjoy her class for the most part, but if you're going to have to miss class for things outside your control, she's not very understanding, and is not the professor you want.

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: She is very kind and has a very engaging class. I valued the discussions that she has in class and they really expanded my learning of the material. It was probably one of the most fun I've ever had in a college class and made some friends along the way. If you need History credits, take her class!
She is very nice and fun in class, she relies on class discussion a lot. She can be a picky grader on papers and gives long homework but gives you the whole week to do it.
She was very nice and her lectures were easy to understand and take notes on. The textbook reading was a bit boring and extensive at times, but the class in all was not bad.

Dr. Cordova is an amazing professor who cares about each and every student. Her lectures are easy to understand and she is great at facilitating class discussions. She is more than understanding when you need an extension. She is willing to help students.

Good class. For papers she pays attention to the quality of your ideas. Guidelines are vague, gives leway, but bad if you want clear direction. Being woke in your writing helps. She chose a variety of readings that cover a breadth of complex topics. The syllabus + grading rubric were confusing and poorly formatted, and there is a LOT of busywork.

I liked Professor Cordova. I would highly recommended this class for getting a history peq over with and out of the way. Very easy class. Only two tests, one paper, and one presentation that you do in your group. There is reading but you do not have to read since she goes over it in class. Very nice and easily accessible.
Tough grader on papers. lectures not overall that helpful or interesting. History major and the only teacher I would not take again.

Professor Cordova was an astounding professor! I would definitely take a course with her again - however, the PEQ course she taught was one of the toughest I have ever taken! A bit too tough on grading but overall, she makes class enjoyable! I hated history before I met her, really a great choice! :)
I'm not interested in history, but she made it interesting and genuinely cares about her students.
SHE COOL

She is one of the most helpful profs I know.  Great person, great teacher! She is open minded and bends over backwards for her students. Some of the comments posted on here sound crazy.  Not the prof I know.
Easy class. Dr. Cordova is nice and knows what she is talking about. Requires a lot of reading from the textbook.

Took an entry level class. She wasn't always the easiest to get along with, but she had a very clear teaching style and expectations from students as far as assignments. Learned more in this class than any other class I've taken at Naz.
Does not listen to students well
As long as you do your work and pay attention, you'll do fine!

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Gives good feedback', 'Lots of homework']
comment: Love her! Textbook optional. Go to class - lectures are posted, but leave important info out. Homework assignments are tedious, but important for class. Really good feedback on all HW assignments. Not a tough grader; she looks for effort and basic understanding. Study guides are posted for all quizzes and exams - very helpful and relevant.

Professor Dempsey was a fantastic teacher who is clearly so passionate about what she does. She has a lot of lectures, but they are easy to follow if you pay attention. A few of the quizzes were a little difficult, but if you study the vocab well you will do fine. She is a fair grader and boosts test scores if too many students missed a question/s

She is very fun and positive with teaching and learning and really cares about her students. She is also very knowledgeable. She was an easy grader and although the class had hw assignments frequently, they required minimal work. She can get distracted and go off on a tangent, but they are fun! Also, sometimes fast paced but still very manageable.

First of all Corinne is a great person and very personable. But throughout the entire semester I was struggling to keep up in class she moves through presentations fairly fast and goes on unnecessary paths of information sometimes. I also felt that her study guides for the tests and quizzes were unhelpful But, if you put time into it outside its ok

Going to class is crucial as this is a lecture-heavy course and notes aren't posted online. Corinne is one of the most caring and genuine professors I've had and is always understanding about missing class, mental health, and late work. I absolutely want to take another class from her. Couldn't recommend Dempsey more.

Corinne was such a great professor, especially as a first year student. Depending on your interest an previous knowledge of religion as a whole, this class could be difficult and a bit much on the homework end. Overall, the knowledge I learned in her class was really helpful . After her class, I decided to pick up a minor in Religious Studies.

I loved Dr. Dempsey so much. I didn't want to take religion at all, but she made religion so fun and interesting, and if you give 100% you will do fine in the class. She will remember you if you participate. She is so flexible and understanding, and I cannot wait to take a class with her again.

She's very passionate about religion and that makes it easier and more fun. There are only 4 or 5 Quizs and then a midterm and a final. She hands out a study guide with all the terms you need to know for each. The way she teaches and writes down her notes it is very easy to understand. Definitely recommend!!!
Fantastic teacher. I declared a minor in religious studies after taking her class. I'd recommend her to anyone who needs RES credit.
shes the best.  literally so fun and interesting. She makes you like what youre learning about

What a great lady, she loves the material. She's very passionate about religion and that makes it easier and more fun. Take religion with her, her course made me want to take another religion course. A beautiful human being.

Corinne is one of the most helpful, caring, spirited, and eloquent professors I've met. Her essays can be complex, but she is very fair and thorough in grading and answering questions. Her passion for the subject is very evident, which makes discussion lively and interesting. I highly recommend this course.

This class was so interesting and mind opening. Corinne is one of the nicest most caring people I have ever met. Everyone should take this class as long as you have an open mind toward religious experience.

Corinne is one of the most open-minded, passionate, and hard working professors. She grades papers and assignments fully annotated within the next class and responds to emails quickly. Sometimes her essay questions are a bit heavy but she's fair by allowing outlines. During class, it's obvious that there is an exchange of learning.

She is a great teacher. Always very helpful and understanding.  She responds to emails very quickly.  It's not that she was scatter brained, she just has so much information she wants to give us, and there was not enough time, so she had to decide what to use and pick out the most important things.  She helps to draw connections which is important.

i was never a big fan of religion classes to begin with. if it wasn't required, i wouldn't have taken it. i found dempsey to be extremely scatterbrained. she frequently lost track of what she was saying and often had to correct the information she was giving us. the tests however were extremely easy and she often gave good grades.
Professor Mitchell is amazing.  She wants to see her students succeed and is always willing to meet with her students when they need.

I didn't know what to expect for Audio Storytelling! It was a very interesting class - podcasts and written responses due each week on Friday. Two other papers on a podcast of your choice. Final project where you can write a paper or create a podcast! I probably had to go into the classroom 3 times throughout the semester.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Graded by few things']
comment: Only three major papers are graded, but there is plenty of time for their completion and she gives well informed feedback. The books she's chosen are all fantastic/"newish" and she is respectful of students voices when we have class discussions. Overall a very well educated professor who shows a great interest in the wellbeing of her students.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Graded by few things', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: Only graded on the 3 papers for the class. Very nice introspective prof. Class not mandatory/hybrid course.

Unexpectedly loved this class. Podcasts are newish to me but I have really enjoyed writing about them and its a nice break from long books. I actually love research so this course gave me a chance to choose informative podcasts and scholarly articles that I actually wanted to learn.

Dr. Mitchell is one of the sweetest and most caring professors you will ever have. She is very accommodating and responds to emails fast. She made the class very interesting and allows you to choose your topics for your research paper. I would recommend her class to anyone who has a large workload because she doesn't assign a lot of work.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Accessible outside class', 'Get ready to read']
comment: Having Dr. Mitchell for Intro Lit Studies in this calamity of a semester (Fall 2020) was pretty awesome! She did an excellent job translating the course into the online format. She was also very responsive to questions/emails, which was great. My ONLY complaint: she did not upload our grades consistently, which was a bit anxiety inducing for me.

Dr. Mitchell is a gem. Shes incredibly intelligent and is able to convey her knowledge so well. She recognized how difficult this semester was and adjusted the course accordingly which was really appreciated! Just a really great person all around, I learned so much from her.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Accessible outside class', 'Get ready to read']
comment: Dr. Mitchell is WONDERFUL. She is without a doubt the most intelligent yet down to earth person I have ever had the privilege of learning from. This class was so interesting and I discovered a love for graphic novels through it. 2 papers, 5 fun page analyses, a presentation, and a final!

College Writing isn't the most exciting thing in the world but Dr. Mitchell knows that and tries to make it interesting and useful. Wasn't thrilled by the readings but the focused lessons on things like intros and conclusions and research databases were directly helpful to me in my major. Not an easy A. I got a B- and had to work for it. Worth it.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Clear grading criteria', 'LECTURE HEAVY']
comment: She is super nice. There are 3 papers the whole semester. The lecture and class itself are super boring but an easy A if you don't miss more than 3 classes. However, this class really taught me how to write proper college essays. If you struggle with essays this is the class to take!

Dr. Mitchell is the best professor in the English Department. She is clear and consise in her assignments, helpful in her individual meetings, and informative in her lectures. She is truly great at her job and really cares for her students. All other professors should take notes from Dr. Mitchell.

This course is during Student Teaching and Dr. Mitchell is the English Content Supervisor that observes and evaluates you during your placement. She is THE BEST. Amazing feedback, always highlights your strengths, and takes the time to help you figure out where you can improve and still grow as a teacher. She is the perfect role model. Love her!

This is the Adolescence English Methods course if you are pursuing a degree in English Adolescent Education Grades 7-12. This class prepares you for Student Teaching. Always a small class size because it's an upper level course, requires presentations, readings, multiple papers, and drawn out unit plan for 1 month and lessons within it. Worth it!

I took ENGL 348 with Dr. Mitchell and it's an American Lit. class called Environmental Humanities, which studies literature focusing on nature. She is so passionate about this topic and it shows in her teaching and it was an amazing experience to take with her and I'm so glad I did! She does assign a lot of reading for homework, but she's worth it!

Dr. Mitchell is the gem of the English Department here at Nazareth, and if you have an opportunity to take a class with her, TAKE IT! She's amazing and genuinely is interested in her content and her students and will always be there if you need any help. I've taken 5 classes with her now and I wish I could've taken more with her! She's the best!

I love Dr. Mitchell, she is so passionate when she teaches and will always go out of her way to make sure you understand the material she is teaching and is always available for help! You may have to work for your grade in her classes, but you really do learn a lot from her and it's worth it!!

I have had multiple classes with Dr. Mitchell (3) and she is, by far, my favorite professor at Naz.  She gets that literature is everywhere and that you can study everything from poems about paintings and web series  (my PEQ Transmedia) to comics to  nonfiction.  Amazing readings, and she teaches you theories too.  Take anything she teaches!
Super nice! Always available for help!! Gives great feedback. Gives you class time to work on assignments. Very understanding. I enjoyed the class.
Dr. Mitchell is a great teacher. She is very helpful and she tells you what she expects of you. Sort of a tough grader, but if you really put in effort you will get a good grade.
I loved Adrielle! She made class very interesting and I even enjoyed the material! I would recommend her to anyone in a minute!

Women in Literature was an eye-opening class.  We started way back with medieval writers and Virginia Woolf and made our way all the way to amazing writers like the Nigerian Chimanda Adichie (wow!) and Persepolis.  I love that we found common themes from Ancient Greece to now, including online blogging. Dr. Mitchell is my favorite English prof.

Dr. Mitchell is easily one of the most brilliant professors I've had while studying at Nazareth. I loved her class, though she did expect a lot of us. I thought the course was a bit heavy with the readings, but honestly, I feel like I got so much out of it. She was very flexible with extensions too, which is nice.

This was the class I dreaded taking the most because English is not my friend and as a Bio major who cares anyway.  But it's actually my most useful class this semester and I think because we practiced incorporating evidence paraphrasing so early in the semester it paid off in my PEQ classes already.  Plus she changes it up so it doesn't drag.
Smart.  Fair.  Never boring.

This course was called Transmedia Adaptations which I didn't understand at first but then really enjoyed it.  It's a combined literature and media class and we read and watched all kinds of things and then talked abuot social media theory for the second half of the class.  Hard sometimes, but really interesting.  Wonderful professor.
She is very open-minded. She doesn't do anything that makes you feel uncomfortable! I enjoyed in particular when she focused linguistics during her classes!

I wish Dr. Mitchell were teaching more classes.  Now that she is chair of the department I keep looking for more classes from her and they're not there.  I know she is very busy but she's an amazing professor.

I just finished the final exam for Creative Non-fiction and even if I get a C in this class which I probably will, I think it was the most valuable class I've ever taken.  Strange new books, all different, like nothing i've ever read and podcasts that make you question the difference between fiction and fact.  Smart professor knows her stuff.
More than willing to work with those who want to succeed, but tough on grading.

One of the most brilliant professors and phenomenal people I have ever met.  She'll teach you how to question and how to think.  You'll walk away from her class a better, more open-minded human being.  Can't ask for more than that!
One of the best professors I have ever had.  I reccommend her for everyone.  She teaches the way all professors should.  You learn and have fun at the same time.
I think Dr. Mitchell is one of the few professors at Nazareth who actually make you actually think.  That's what I thought college was for.

Dr. Mitchell is an interesting professor.  I am not an English major and sometimes I felt that the work was too hard for a PII, but it was a challenge.  I got better at writing and reading hard books by the end of the semester.  Participate in discussion cause she gets jazzed up when people do and she can really respond and take it to a new level.

WHATEVER YOU DO YOU MUST TAKE GRAPHIC NARRATIVE!  IT'S THE MOST AMAZING CLASS EVER.  I DIDN'T EVEN KNOW THERE WERE BOOKS LIKE THIS AND THAT YOU COULD SAY SO MANY DIFFERENT THINGS ABOUT THEM.  NOW I WISH I MAJORED IN ART OR ENGLISH.
Sometimes I would think man where is she going with this and then it would all make sense.  Not the most linear of profs, but there wasn't a day I didn't learn something from her.

This is a good course for learning about writing better.  I didn't really want to have more english course but then when I did this teacher she make it very worth while.  I do better on my papers everywhere now, for two years, and I know how to revise.  She is a very good teacher.
Smokin and brilliant.
Dr. Mitchell is one of my favorite professor at Naz.  I like the readings although there were alot of them, and I felt challenged to think.  She is really clear and sometimes very interesting.
Dr. Mitchell is brilliant!  I am in awe.

I took two courses with Dr. Mitchell when I was a student at Nazareth and have to say she was one of my best professors there (and I wasn't even an English major).  Take a class with her if you get a chance; doesn't matter which one cause she makes it all really interesting and relevant.  She's not easy, but she really helps you think and write.

I am in Young Adult Literature too, and I think it is a great class.  The books are all so different, and we talk about things about society that are really important but that nobody talks about.   And about what the person before me said-- I think the paper assignments are fair and just challenging and that she gives enough time.

I took YA lit with her, and it's pretty tricky sometimes because she doesn't explain what she wants on papers very well and she doesn't hand out instructions until like a week before they're due.  The books were very interesting, though, and she is really nice as a person, just kind of confusing about papers.  Class is interesting.

This is a great class.  I wasn't even so sure I wanted to take it but I'm really glad I did.  We are reading all kinds of books, and it isn't only focused on women's issues.  It's really all about literature and life and art and pretty interesting things.  Don't be scared off by the title women's literature.

She is an excellent professor that certainly guided me on the right direction for my writing. She leaves her assignments open-ended so you can decide how to do them. 102 was a lot better though because we did a semester-long paper that was broken up nicely. I thought she was an amazing professor.
Love this professor. Makes more sense than most and isn't bad to look at, either.

Dr. Mitchell has become my favorite professor. She is intelligent and well-versed in both english and education topics. She teaches with ease, and takes an interest in her students. I wish I had the opportunity to take many more classes with her. It would be worth your while to take a class with her

I really like Dr. Mitchell.  She can be really funny, even when the material is suppposed to be dry and boring.  Too much reading maybe but that's always how it is in English.  Go see her on office hours, she really talks to you about whatever you need help with and she tells the truth.

This course has a lot of work (maybe too much for intro to women's studies) but it's great!  The best part is that Dr. Mitchell is not a feminazi AT ALL.  She shows you how theres a feminist theory for everything you could possibly think about.

She was very VERY nice during class and genuinely likes her students. She is willing to let anyone talk at anytime and loves to meet with students about papers. She even remembers your name 3 years after her class... :)
Very approachable.. Very nice, tried very hard to make it interesting

TAKE THIS CLASS!(Modern Poetry)  I was terrified of poetry coming into the class, but Dr. Mitchell made it interesting and exciting.  Tough (but fair) tests, interesting projects/papers.  One of the best courses i took at Naz.
Not too much work, kind of interesting, not so bad

I do not recommend taking a class with Dr. Stachowski if you don't have to.  Her testes are completely different from all the exams and practices tests she give you.  She seems to briefly touch on large topics and go into large detail of the things that don't matter much on the quizzes/exams/

She rushes through lectures and expects you to know things from gen chem that was never discussed. Her practice quizzes/ tests are also much easier than the real thing making it close to impossible to prepare for.

Professor Stachowski is very knowledgeable in her field. Her lectures are dense in information and are incredibly important to pay attention to as there's no homework and little outside practice to solidify information. Chem 221 is a challenging class but if you show up, pay attention, and put time in outside of class, you will get a good grade.
90 percent of grade was tests and quizzes. Does nothing else to help students improve grade besides doing super well on the original exams

We were initially told at the beginning of the class that CHM221 was an introductory class and would be easy, we soon found out it was not. 90% of your grade is based on your exams and quizzes, 10% is based on participation. You do not have the opportunity to do test corrections or improve your grade.

Chem 221 is an incredibly difficult course and needs lots of attention outside of the classroom. This is organic 1, 2 and bio chem 1 in one semester. Dr. S knows exactly what she is talking about so the best thing you can do is ask questions. Show her that you care about the class and make an effort and it will absolutely pay off in the end.
Did not want to help students succeed at all
Only has Tests and Quizzes worth 90% of grade. No extra credit or corrections allowed. Also says no curve to help students. Very helpful but does not allow anything to improve grade

I think its tough to grade a professor when the material is really hard. Dr. S. was so kind, caring and flexible. I really felt like she cared about my progress in the class. She frequently checked in to be sure we were understanding complex concepts and regularly reviewed material for us if we were unsure. You can tell she is really passionate.

I really liked Dr. S's teaching style. She provided 2 years of practice exams (+quizzes) which was very helpful for studying. I found the textbook to be useful but more complex than the lectures, making class attendance vital. Overall she's a good professor and gives good feedback and partial credit wherever possible. Lots of extra credit on exams.

Lectures were slides posted online. Lots of practice problems with answer keys. Quizzes every other week graded by 25% increments, but makeups every 3. ALEKS was a nightmare but helpful. Frequency of quizzes and online assignments forced me to study. Kind of boring and slow paced if you understood the content, fast and terrifying if you struggled.

Loved her! Quizzes and HW every week forced me to study and practice. She posts online lectures which are helpful for review. The class is hard in nature (I had a tutor), but she is always willing to meet if I need extra help. Textbook is online for free, but not even necessary in my opinion. Her teaching style works well for me I would take again!

Worst teacher I have ever had. Does not care about actually teaching, anytime you ask her something she looks pissed off. Such a lazy teacher does not even try to put effort in reviewing lecture slides. Goes the speed of light while teaching. Would not take her again and do not recommend to anyone. If you don't like to teach then do something else.

Left lecture confused on what was taught. She complicated simple things. Did not go through how to go through questions but would state it rather than explaining it. Quizzes were graded either 100% 50% or 0% based on mistakes made rather than questions correct. Homework did not correlate to the types of questions on quizzes.

I loved her as a professor. She's super sweet and also open to helping you. The way she explained things in class was also super clear and she made the material easy to learn. There was usually about one quiz a week, but they were really short and easy as long as you studied, and you had a chance to retake each quiz if you wanted.
Professor Banfield is amazing.  She wants to see her students succeed and as long as you follow her lectures and grading criteria you will do just that.
She is a great teacher. Lecture heavy but uses real life examples to make the topic to help stick better!

Prof. Banfield is a lovely person. You can tell she is very passionate about what she teaches and is great at explaining complex material. She makes it very clear about assignments and expectations in her class. Would recommend to anyone with lots of heavy course work for an easy understanding of abnormal psychology.

Banfield is super chill. Class only meets once a week and there isn't a lot of work. Pretty lecture heavy on the days you have class but not terrible. Lots of opportunities for extra credit, she really wants you to pass and do well.

I really enjoyed this class. Only met once a week and did not have much to do outside of class. Towards the end of the semester, we had an opportunity for extra credit which was nice. Really good class and professor to take if you have a heavy schedule. Only thing was I wish I received feedback on my grade for the papers.

I was shocked to see that Elise had such a low rating. She is BY FAR the best professor I have ever had, a doll! Only one class a week and all online exams. If you take good notes and read the exam questions carefully, you will do well. Her lectures are very interesting and I love her style of teaching/ assigments. Lots of options and extra credit.

This professor taught online, however she never communicated with us as to what we were supposed to be learning, and failed to provide any knowledge on the course. When we would ask questions she took days to respond and for our final paper she forgot to respond to our questions about it. The essay quizzes are easy but the exams can be challenging.

Easy asynchronous class, very easy grader on all papers and writing assignments. It can be kind of annoying reading the textbook every week to find the answers and prepare for tests, as she provides almost no video lectures.

Professor Banfield seems to lack skills in communicating with her students and providing details for her assignments. She gives very little detail to her assignments and makes her students work to figure out what they even have to do. Would not recommend the Infancy and Childhood course with her.

Professor Banfield has been one of my favorite professors. She loves to tie in her own clinical experience in psychology to the lectures as well as let people share their own personal experiences with the material. She always encourages people to participate and is very interested in material and gives very clear and fun lectures.

comment: If I could travel back in time, I would drop out. Once I saw the syllabus I knew it would be a lot but it was ridiculous. The amount you have to read without knowing the students homework load is ridiculous. I thought the few that dropped out was ridiculous, but now after finishing the class and finally away. Safe to say that those few were smart.

I love this professor, but he is such a tough grader for essay assignments. He also had a mostly-history, partly-literature test for the Brit Lit class that didn't make much sense at all which was quite annoying.
Dr. Foran is INCREDIBLE. I am not someone who typically enjoys English classes, however his classes are very fun and engaging. I recommend everyone to take a class with him :)

Took my writing to the next level! Yes, we are graded on few things, but it gives students time to put in their best effort. When Dr. Foran sees you are genuinely putting in effort (especially to the 3 papers that opt you out of exam if you choose this which you should), scheduling meetings, and making revisions, you will excel!

tags: ['Tough grader', 'Gives good feedback', 'Graded by few things']
comment: Foran is a really understanding professor but his assignments are absurd. Only having 3 grades all semester weighs them heavily and the essay prompts are insane. Never in my life have I struggled with writing an essay until his class.

Super nice guy, gives lots of great advice. Probably learned more in this class than any other class. He really pushes you to try and do the best that you can. As long as you try your best you will get a good grade

Professor Foran is one of the kindest professors I've ever had. He goes above and beyond to make sure you succeed. He's a tough grader but pushes you to be the best writer and credits you when he knows you worked hard. He's the best!

Taking my first college English course with Professor Foran was a delight. He picked interesting content, allowed for retries on assignments and was very lenient with deadlines in certain circumstances. An awesome guy, super funny, would take again.

This is my 2nd time having Dr. Foran for an ENGL class and he remains a wonderful professor. For our COVID Fall, he awesomely prepared its modified, online version. It's a lot of reading, but that's expected with a Lit class; he picked some great books for it! If you have any concerns, he is very accommodating and will help you as best as he can.

Dr. Foran is one of the most nice/kind people Ive ever met. His lectures were always interesting and he is really good at helping you during office hours as well. Hes a little bit of a tough grader at first, but he will let you revise/resubmit for a better grade! He also makes Shakespeare so much more enjoyable!

Dr. Foran is awesome! I really looked forward to attending this class. His lectures are funny and relevant, and you can tell he genuinely enjoys teaching and his subject area. He is a fair grader and allows you to revise or even re-revise your work.

Dr. Foran is the best professor I've ever had. He's hilarious and his lectures are always interesting. He's very knowledgeable and though he grades rather harshly, he always gives you an opportunity to revise (and re-revise) on your own time. If you put in the effort, it's not difficult to succeed. Love this guy!

comment: Nice guy. Tough grader and it sucks because theres only 3 projects the whole year but he does let you resubmit it. He makes the class more interesting than it should be but overall makes it harder than it should be.

One of my favorite professors I have had. He cares about his students. There are three major projects that are pass/fail. Complete and pass 2 gives you a B. Complete and pass all 3 gives you an A. Overall I did not like the course only because I am a freshman and this course was chosen for me. The professor got me through this course.

This is a British Literature course. Dr. Foran is a great person, however this class has only 3 papers, all of which you must pass by SPECs Grading, you must pass each check to recieve a passing grade. I find this unfair as what could be a B paper fails completely in SPECs. The final exam only adds a +- to your overall grade.
Fantastic professor. Hard grader, but is available for help. He strives to make you better and shows genuine concern.

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Get ready to read', 'BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES']
comment: This is a British Literature Class and is very hard. A lot of reading and hard texts, and only 3 MAJOR writing assignments and TONS of reading quizzes. This class is graded by Specs Grading, which is needing every aspect of his grading rubric to reach the level of 'A' work, if one part does not, the entire assignment fails. Love him, but STRESSED!

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Get ready to read', 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: This class is Shakespearean Comedies and Histories and thankfully wasn't graded like he has in past through Specs Grading. He assigns a short 1.5-2 page paper for each play you read, but he is a really tough grader. He also assigns reading quizzes, so even if you read, they'll still kick you ass. Very tough grader, but I love this class and him!

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Get ready to read', 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: This class is Shakespearean Tragedies and was very intense. This class is graded by Specs Grading which is horrible, so basically you have to receive an 'A' on every aspect of the rubric to pass, if one thing is not considered 'A' level work, then you fail the entire assignment. If you're lucky, he'll let you re-do it once. Love him though!

Dr. Foran is the best professor I've ever encountered. He is extremely invested in his students and genuinely cares about helping you receive the best grade possible. He is a tough grader but very fair. He is always available outside of class for help on papers. He is a professor who has actually helped me gain immense improvement in my writing.

Foran is such a great teacher and even though sometimes he seems like he's talking in circles, you usually do get something out of it. He's also really funny and is fun to listen, watch, and talk to. This guy definitely knows what he's talking about!

I took this class as I was considering a double major. Best course with the best professor at this tiny college. Tough but fair, really cares about you & and your development & really made me a better writer. Gave me a great recommendation- I transferred but the hardest part of leaving was not being able to take more courses with him.
He is my favorite professor in the English department. He is incredibly respectful and runs class well. He makes you work very hard, but will help you the whole way for you to achieve your goals.

Foran is an amazing English teacher. Everything was made extremely clear and the one on one paper conferences helped you improve your essays tremendously. All my questions about writing were answered throughout the semester. He's overall a great teacher and person.

LOVE LOVE LOVED him. There are no test, your grade is based off of the papers you write. No final exam, just a final paper that was pretty much putting together everything you learned over the year. Has conferences so that he can give you the best feedback. Great class I would take it again in a heartbeat.

Professor Foran is incredible. By far the best English course I have taken - he is genuinely interested in his students and their opinions in controversial topics!!! I wish he taught Engl 102 so I could have him two semesters in a row - absolutely amazing. No complaints by any means!

I graduated soon after I took this class last year but I still remember everything that we learned and would come back to school to take senior sem with Dr. Foran. He made sure that you understood the concepts of the lectures. He made students feel comfortable enough to participate (even those who usually avoided doing so).

Although a lot of people will tell you the class is difficult, I thought that the expectations were clear and very fair. Class discussions are interesting and worth while. You will have homework basically every night, however it is short and as long as you give mindful answers, it is not graded difficulty. Dr. Foran is definitely a great teacher!

Dr. Foran, is a gifted literature Professor. He is a rare Professor that you cannot help but learn and in an intelligent interesting way. He cracks that nut open that many English Professors are not able to do. He makes you write a lot but isn't that what a good literary student wants. You also learn literature in a deep meaningful way. A kind man.

Dr. Foran, is a gifted literature Professor if you desire to really get literature deep and close reading analyzing so you can really enjoy literature to the fullest he cracks that nut open that many Professors can't do He's a gifted Professor and to further compliment his God given teaching talent he is compassionate, fair and wants you to succeed
Professor is nice as a person but as a professor he's not very effective in teaching atleast in my opinion.

Quite possibly the best college professor I've encountered in my whole educational experience. He will do anything to ensure his students success. Every semester I make sure to take a class with him, even if I don't have to. Definitely take his class!

He is amazing and incredibly brilliant. His doctorate was on Shakespeare (the class taken) and he forces us to think several steps higher about the material than normal. It's a lot of reading but worth it. He grades hard on papers but always offers a rewrite and helps to get to a higher grade. His comments are clear and helpful. Take this class!

This professor is extremely nice and laid back. But he is a really hard grader even if you ask him for help and rewrite your papers. Not to mention you have to wait forever to actually find out that you did terrible on your papers because he grades so slowly. Don't bother talking in class either because participation got me nowhere.

Professor Jay was great! He was readily available outside of class and was helpful during the labs. The labs did typically take the full time, which was kind of annoying but then we had no work outside of the lab. He does take a long time to explain procedures and set up the labs sometimes.

Cappon is a great professor and I would absolutely reccomend! His lectures are amusing and he is always willing to answer questions. His lab reports are very straight forward, and as long as you attend class, you will pass very easily.
Best lab section professor, straight forward and willing to work with you.

The worst thing about taking this class besides the fact it's required and has nothing to do with my major is that Cappon will drag it on making you be there longer than you have to be. If you need things explained to you in through detail Cappon will do that every class. He is a little old, will call on you at random to answer a question.
Professor Cappon is wonderful. His labs are engaging and light-hearted. He always finds a way to make things funny. I really enjoyed his labs!
The best lab teacher ever, makes lots of jokes. Does not give eye contact.
does not give eye contact

Best man ever! He won't look you in the eye but this man has the charisma of a stand up comedian. He will tell stories of how lab used to be 3 years ago and will make dark humor while dissecting an animal. He will make use of the textbook unlike other professors. A true gem at this terrible school
