Doesn't know what week we're in, doesn't know what assignments are coming up, doesn't know what class he's in even. Okay dude, bad prof.

He does not email back; and he does not know when assignments are due, he actually asks the class when things are due. He does not explain assignments in depth, and students often have to collaborate to understand assignments. He does not grade work until the end of the semester, leaving little room to make change. It's also often hard to hear him

He is so vague and it is so difficult to write the papers based on the lack of information and resources that we are given. He is passionate about his work however there is almost no structure and he often becomes frustrated if you do not understand what he is saying or trying to teach. Also so bad at returning emails

Primus is a knowledgeable individual of the field of social work. But, Primus is not a good teacher. I do not think teaching is for everyone. I would not recommend taking this class unless it's required by your major. This class has the potential for you to learn a wide variety of things, however, we barely learned anything. He also grades slow!

I really enjoy taking classes with Primus. He's passionate about what he teaches and is clearly super knowledgeable and experienced. He's kind, patient and has an overall calming demeanor. Information is presented in a way that's easy to understand and he's flexible about things like pausing for a bit so the class can discuss.

Primus is an amazing teacher and I absolutely loved his class. Interesting content and engaging discussions that I love to participate and listen to. Fantastic teacher and class, would highly suggest taking class with him.

The presentation of material is a little jumbled, and did not necessarily seem to connect with the reading or the rest of the class. There were some issues regarding the syllabus. I personally ended up dropping from an A to an A- simply because of participation despite speaking in every class and getting As on all of the assignments.

tags: ['Clear grading criteria', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS', 'LECTURE HEAVY']
comment: This professor is pathetic. He doesnt create his syllabus or due dates so he isnt aware when stuff is due. He takes nearly over a month to grade reflections. He doesnt teach anything at all he reads off PowerPoints. Its near the end of the semester and he only graded one thing we arent going to get to all the quizzes because of the time, avoid!!!!

I had Primus last semester and was not a fan. Got the impression that he really didn't want to be there (I think he was sick?) This semester, it is like night and day. His classes are funny and interesting and you can tell he really enjoys his job. Participation really matters, as does making the effort to meet with him outside of class.
Awful. Avoid if at all possible. Rushes through everything. Assignments unclear. Grades assignments weeks after due date. Not helpful outside of class.

This class does offer some good lessons, but not from the professor. His lectures are long, confusing, and quiet. Make sure to sit in the front row.  Some assignments require changes due to his feedback, however don't expect it till the day before (or even morning of) the due date. Requires transportation as well.

Dr. Primus has many goals in the beginning of the semester, but ends up getting so behind on grading that he'll eventually drop assignments by the end of the semester. He'll end up giving you 95%'s on assignments for completing them because he's trying to meet the deadline for grades. He gives open-book online quizzes as well. No cumulative test.

The class itself isn't bad.  Do your reading, go to the events, do the work and you will get an easy A.  So why such a low rating you ask... because I don't understand where he came from.  He barely teaches the class and relies on his guest speakers and community visits to teach for him.  When he does lecture, he just rambles for hours.  Bizarre.

Primus is a great teacher, even though he spends majority of the time talking in front of the class, the information usually sticks.  I learned a lot of information from him that I have applied for my internships.

I just wonder where they found this guy. He does not grade any of your papers or give you feedback. you have no idea how you are doing in the class. Maybe his personal goals of becoming a doctor of social work are getting in the way.... If you want feedback, don't take any classes from him. It's really frustrating that he gets away with it!
This guy is useless! don't take any classes from him. He teaches nothing and stands in front of the class asking any questions anybody, anybody a hundred times... Guy is an idiot!

Does not give feedback or grade assignment until the last week of class. Does not respond to emails. You will have no way of knowing how to improve in his class because of his lack of grading. Very poor teacher.

This class appears easy from the syllabus, but he doesn't actually teach his content. He reads off lecture notes that he provides but there is no homework so you must memorize 14 chapters for 4 tests the entire semester

Oh, Dr. Doyle. This man is SO out of it, he never had any clue what was going on. This was a new class this year so lab instructors had weekly meetings to plan the next week's lab, this man NEVER went. And you could tell. All things aside, this man is very kind and cares about his students, and really did try to help you out if you needed it.

Does not actually teach you anything, just reads off his 30+ page of notes per chapter. Highlights everything as well on them, therefore there is too much info to learn per chapter. Takes 10 points off the nutrition log if you don't put your name on every page (my name was listed plenty of times other places). Gives simple hw to up your grade.
Sometimes lectures and notes didn't match test questions. Lectures were long and the professor seemed uninterested in teaching.

The content isn't difficult if you're a health related major. (I am not) But he has a lazy attitude and teaching style. He grades lazily and doesn't update his content if he changes the tests. Extremely frustrating, made things hard due to lack of planning.

I crammed and ended up being fine but I know a lot of people didn't so STUDY! He's really specific about everything you hand in being formatted perfectly and everything being on time. Do not buy the textbook, he'll even tell you not to, but he doesn't put in the effort to remove it from his "required materials." That mindset extends to everything.

I am taking his class for nutrition, and he just reads off of his board. He doesn't have office hours, we have to go to him for office hours either before or after class. I did like the article presentation every other week, it was 2-3 minute long presentation. Not heavy on homework but heavy on exams.

Compared to the other A&P professors I really like Doyle. Some people might not like his notes/lecture style but I found it helpful because taking notes can be rushed/sloppy but he gives you all the info. When asked questions for to explain something he is very knowledgable. Compared to the professor I had for A&P 2 Doyle is beyond better.

He wants us to succeed and pass his class. I enjoyed his lecture notes because they provided all the info you needed. They aren't typical lecture slides but I found them really helpful. If you can get Doyle for bio or A&P courses definitely do it.

I am taking Doyle for Anatomy and Physiology I during the Summer A semester, and I am doing well in the class, but I do not recommend him as a professor. He reads all the notes off of a word document and does not explain anything or show knowledge of the subject. I have had to work so hard to teach myself this whole class, and I don't recommend him

Professor Doyle was not the best teacher. He read notes off of one long word document which personally isn't my learning style. These notes were also from a previous professor who no longer works at Naz. He doesn't make his own lecture tests. Good luck getting a response when you email him. He also had classes on zoom when it was in person only.

The lectures are just him talking for a straight hour which doesn't help. The lecture notes are way too long and states the important stuff is highlighted in red, but the whole damn page is red. His tests contain stuff we don't even cover. And for after the tests he doesn't even give us our tests back to see what we did wrong. Do not take Doyle!

Dr. Doyle is the worst professor I have had at Naz. He does not answer emails, or want to meet with students. Class started late and/or ended early too many times in the semester. Tests would have material on them that was either not covered in class soley because he reads off a word doc. DO NOT take a class with Dr. Doyle.

Doesn't teach. Doesn't make powerpoints, notes, or tests. NO extra credit. Tests you on stuff you haven't learned or had the ability to learn. Adds random tests online and doesn't acknowledge them. Does not respond to emails. Completely unhelpful, and should not be a teacher.

The absolute WORST professor I have EVER had. He is rude to his students and will not make accommodations for those that need it. All of his "lectures" consisted of him just reading off of a word document verbatim. He refuses to give extra help and course materials in order to prepare for his tests. For your sanity, DO NOT TAKE A CLASS WITH HIM.

For a class full of non-science majors, this professor dives way too deep into course material. He reads straight from the notes during lectures and says to study everything in red on the notes but the whole page is red. No possible way he can fit all this material from multiple chapters on to one test. His dogs will not stop barking on zoom. DNR.

Dr. Doyle is one of the best professors to have for anatomy lab. Compared to other professors in this department he grades very fairly which can help your grade since anatomy is so hard.  Although he does not make the tests, he does try hard to tell you what has been on them in the past, and what might be asked.

I personally believe that he is more of a review professor. He reads straight from his notes and you could miss class and read the notes and not miss a thing. I'm not saying he doesn't know the content, he does, but I would not take this class with this professor if you are learning anatomy for the first time. Again, this is  my personal opinion...

People often say that he doesn't know enough about the subject, but to be a teacher in a subject with this much material, he definitely knows a lot! Don't complain, because you don't want the teacher who knows everything. Their being more prepared makes their class harder. He understands that he should focus on the basics and not overwhelm us.
She was a great professor. This was a hybrid course so we only had class Monday and Wednesday. A lot of team projects but nothing super hard or strenuous.

Dr. Hair is super kind and cares about her students, there is a lot of group work but it's very easy. It's a lot of lectures but they're all posted and not super important. Some homework assigned but it's mostly personality quizzes and very self explanatory.

Overall a super chill class and Dr. Hair is a really sweet lady. As a business minor, I found the course rather dull; the lectures are quite boring. There's barely any homework or assignments. Most of your grade is a team presentation at the end of the semester, and I did well on it despite my group not contributing much at all.

She is one of the best professors that I've ever had! I had some health issues half way through the course, which made me miss some of the class, but she was extremely understanding and willing to help. Dr. Hair's class had some project work, but it was pretty easy as long as your group did what they were supposed to do. Would totally recommend!

Ignore every other rating on Dr Hair. Obviously it depends on what class you are taking, but I was in her teamwork and collab class and we did not even have a single assignment until 6 weeks into the semester. The only real assignment we were given was a 3 page essay on teamwork lol. If you want free credits, take a class with her.
Rose Hair is a wonderful professor. She allows students to be creative and work in groups. I love her slide memes. I would recommend this class for any business majors.

You may die of boredom. Excessive group work to compensate for lack of actual teaching. When there are lectures they are done from textbook ppt's. Get ready to hand in assignments daily on god knows what. Btw you'll never get graded on most of those. Good luck.
She's awesome!

Dr. Hair is a nice person to deal with.  Very understanding and willing to help you.  That being said, this class is awful.  Death by PowerPoint, everything is taught in a list. Mandatory attendance to have textbook publisher slides read to you, nearly verbatim. The amount of work assigned does not correlate to the importance of the material. AVOID

This professor has given us the exact quiz material, word for word, a week before the actual quiz every single time. If you pay attention and take notes in class you are pretty much guaranteed to get at least an A-.  It is listed that you need text books for this class but with that said I read the first 2-3 homework and never did another one.

Dr. Samz is very knowledgeable and I LOVED her methods of teaching. Her lectures were very easy to follow and take notes on. There were weekly quizzes and exact quiz questions were given in advance. Quizzes/tests align perfectly with lectures. Class has a midterm, final, and a final presentation.

Dr. Samz is an angel - so so sweet. Phl-391 was so easy if you pay attention, take notes, met with her, and study. You get the exam questions a week in advance, she walks you through the material - you dont need to ready. Clear on what is import. Lowkey made me like ethics

Dr. Samz is an amazing professor. She always goes over everything in great detail in a way you can understand without using big words that no one knows. Although she tells you to read you honestly don't need to since she goes over it all in class. Although she is quiz heavy she gives you the questions in advance.

She is one of my favorite professors at Naz. She tells you to read outside of class but she goes over the readings all on the board where everyone takes notes. She is a great professor. I rarely had to study outside of class, and if I did it would only take me 10 minutes. I definitely recommend her to anyone taking philosophy.

Professor Samz is very knowledgeable and caring, for her class its typically a lecture everyday and sometimes has you participate at the end and do a couple exercises from the book. The only bad thing was you take 6 quizzes and a final and then theres nothing to boost your grade if quizzes arent your strong suit. It felt like you either pass or not

Dr. Samz is a very kind and helpful professor- answers emails quickly. QUIZZES/TESTS ARE ALL MEMORIZATION! Notes gone over in class can be put directly onto study guides (she gives the exact questions that will be on tests/quizzes). Show up to class and take notes, bullet out answers while studying, and do the practice logic exercises she provides!

Samz's grades relies heavily on lectures and quizzes. In fact, 90% of the grades are from quizzes. But she posts all of the questions a week in advance so it's easy to get 100 if you study. But she doesn't post the grades ever (only on paper) so it's hard to keep track of where you are. But she clearly knows her stuff and answers questions easily.

Dr. Samz is a great professor, she explains the textbook better than the actual book.  Lectures are content heavy, missing class has a lot of making up to do. She is also quiz heavy, however she gives you the questions the week before. So you can study them for the following week. She does this also with the midterm and the final. Highly recommend

I struggled with philosophy but Samz made it so much easier! She's always available outside of class, is very consistent with grading, and will tell you exactly what is on quizzes/tests/written assignments. The class covers a lot of content and there are weekly quizzes so if your having trouble tell her and she will gladly help.

Really good professor. Explained everything in lecture very well when the textbook doesn't. The class is quiz heavy but if you look over your notes and study off of that and doing some of the practice questions you should do well.

She is an amazing professor and I
loved all of her lectures. There is a
textbook needed, but you definitely do
not need to read all the material she
assigns (she goes over everything in
class) but do need it for class. She is
caring and office hours can be very
helpful when needed. She will also tell
you exactly what's on her tests and
auizzes.

Dr. Samz is so nice and caring, she truly wants you to pass. Her class is all lecture so attendance is mandatory and a textbook is needed. There is a quiz almost every Wednesday but Samz tells you exactly what is on it. If you go to her office hours, she will tell you exactly what she wants.

tags: ['Accessible outside class', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Lecture heavy']
comment: Professor Samz is one of those teachers that you are very lucky to get if you don't like homework or doing much out of class. The effort that you put in class will transfer over to the weekly quizzes (which are no longer take-home as previous reviews have said). Simply take notes during each lecture and review once before each quiz, you'll be fine!

Dr. Samz is kind and truly cares about her work! Classes were generally lectures (I liked them, but understand if others didn't), but as long as you took notes you were fine. There was reading from multiple works, but it wasn't "necessary". Lots of quizzes/tests, but all take home and you can use notes, so it really wasn't hard. She is a gem!

Dr. Samz is a great woman who wants you to succeed. Her lecture style does not click with me, as I prefer to hand write notes but am never able to leave enough space due to the fact that her thought process is written all over the board. The weekly quizzes have been alright so far, you definitely should look over your notes the night before.

As long as you pay attention during lecture and take notes you'll be fine. Quizzes and tests are all take home, including the midterm and final. I never did any of the reading outside of class, I just listened to what she said or looked over the handout and was fine to write the final paper

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Clear grading criteria', 'Lecture heavy']
comment: Samz is the most straight forward teacher. All you have to do is show up and write everything she puts on the board as that it what the quiz and mid-term will be on. Literally word for word just write everything down. This isn't a hard class but if you don't show up you will probably get an F unless someone can give u the notes. Overall easy class.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Lecture heavy', 'Tough grader']
comment: Very opinionated and sometimes hard to understand logic concepts. She gives good notes, but are very specific and she gives examples that are hard to comprehend. Weekly quizzes. Doesn't use grade book so its hard to keep track of grade.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Graded by few things', 'Lecture heavy']
comment: Professor Samz, is a very nice person, but her teaching style isn't for me. Often times I would find myself super confused about her lecture content, and even more confused if I asked questions. She is better explaining things 1 on 1

Very straight forward. Only lectures about what you need to know for tests and quizzes. Show up to lectures, take good notes, put a minimal effort into studying and you will get an A. She is pretty nice and understanding as well.
Show up and take notes and you'll be fine. Exams are a little wordy but pay attention and they'll be easy.

tags: ['Accessible outside class', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Graded by few things']
comment: Professor Samz is a really nice woman. She gives weekly quizzes, which aren't hard because she tells you exactly what will be on them. There's no graded homework either, so basically the grade you get is from the quizzes, midterm and final. She's really approachable and genuinely wants to see you succeed.

Professor Samz is great. There are weekly quizzes based on the textbook and lectures and as long as you pay attention and read, you're good to go. She's very approachable and always takes time to answer questions and gives out amazing study guides for midterm and final exams.

If you're going to select a Philosophy class at Nazareth, you should pick Dr. Samz's. There are weekly quizzes on the textbook chapters, but if you do the exercises and pay attention/take good notes at her lectures, you should easily pass. Sometimes she's a little picky on her grading. Also just a really cute and kind lady! She's pretty great.

He is awesome! one of the most enthusiastic and educated professors in my four years at nazareth. His lectures are pretty entertaining as he has a lot of interactive slides. I would totally take another class with him.

Absolutely amazing professor. Knows what he's talking about and makes lectures fun. Super enthusiastic and answers in class questions very well. Doesn't reopen quizzes so you can see questions/answers but grades quickly. Only grades are weekly online quizzes and forums

Good prof for infancy - you can tell he knows his stuff. Textbook required but I didn't use it, lol. Group project was confusing but office hours helped. My main issue is that he talks about controversial stuff (politics, social issues) and I don't have the same views as him, which made me feel unsafe at times. Wouldn't take again for this reason.

His lectures are interesting. If you are taking PSY 221, you should take him. As long as you attend lecture and pay attention the quizzes are easy. I never studied for a quiz and got A's. One group project (no presentation), bi-weekly quizzes, and weekly discussion forums.

Gutheil is amazing. His lectures are funny and he is very clear in what he wants and when he wants it turned in. Big group project but option to work alone if desired. A quiz every other weekend which are hard if you don't go to class. If you read textbook/go to class you'll do fine. I'll definitely take more classes with him in the future.

He is a really great guy. The class is fairly easy and not a lot of work. Weekly forums that really only take 10 minutes to do, 2 papers, and bi weekly quizzes that are open note and on Moodle. He is a great lecturer and a very funny guy. I genuinely looked forward to going to this class every week and you can tell he cares about students
He is very funny in class as he teaches. He is real and down to the point but not mean. I would definitely take more classes with him.

A sweet lady but does not know how to teach. She is constantly being corrected by students and always changes her words or answers. Just writes and says what she writes but does not actually go in depth and teach us. Had to teach myself outside of class. Would not take her again as it was very confusing and overwhelming in her class.
Overall, I had a good time in this class. It was pretty boring at times but Sikora is pretty good with answering questions and working one on one.

Not as bad as the rest of these reviews, super nice. She does make some mistakes sometimes but someone in the class always catches it and she always fixes them. I personally would take her again. The quizzes are not that hard, but if you struggle with math then get a tutor.

She doesn't even know how to teach it, she constantly says she is confused. Random assessments with little notice. She cannot even explain anything so nothing makes sense. If you get more than two problems wrong on a test you will fail. Definitely do not take this class.

This professor was very nice, I like her as a person. However as a teacher she's terrible. I was constantly correcting her and telling her the right way to do it and was often hearing "see you guys know more than me" or "you should be teaching this class". This makes it hard to feel confident in what she is teaching.

Do not take any class with this professor. She explains the information very vaguely and gives you homework that in no way correlates with classwork. If you get 3 questions wrong on a test she gives you a failing grade. If you get one question wrong on homework, she gives you a 0. Very unclear and very tough grader.

This might have been the worst class I have ever taken. She was confused everyday and had no idea how to do basic calc. She consistently said "you guys are smarter than me maybe you should teach", "I have no idea what I'm doing", "I'm about 50% sure thats right". As a professor these words should never be said. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.
Just show up do the work and you'll be fine it's nothing too hard. Prof is really nice and is always available to help you with anything.
Like this teacher and this class a lot so far. This class takes a lot of patience and problem solving skills!
Great instructor overall and creates a very low-stress class environment, also a really easy grader

We were supposed to analyze all assigned readings but were only assigned one to talk about. Everyone had to talk and this would take all class, leaving the class feeling slightly anxious while waiting their turn or bored after speaking depending on when they spoke. He was also not very responsive over email. I did not learn anything about writing.

Islam is one of my favorite professors. What you have to read before every class is laid out in the syllabus and it is very important you read everything. Only three papers that are graded along with attendance and participation in class.

Professor Islam was one of my favorite professors this semester. He assigns readings that are due before class, but he'll usually show a YouTube video on the reading that was assigned. He does call on people randomly to give their input, but if you didn't read you can always comment on the videos that he shows in class. 100% would take again.
He is the easiest teacher ever, a lot of participation is needed because he will just call on you randomly, but if you say something random, it works for him. Great guy and teacher.
He is super chill and wants you to succeed.

It's a very easy English class. Mr. Islam likes to make his lectures engaging so he's not just standing up at the front. He asks for class discussions where you can discuss your viewpoint with no judgement. I'd 100% take the class again and again if I could. The texts he has us read go along with real world problems in today's time.
Very kind and helpful professor, easy grader, would definitely take his class again.

Professor Islam is so very kind. Ultimately, he just wants his students to engage in his class and enjoy what they're learning about. If you show up to his class, read the assigned readings, and participate, you will get a good grade. We had like 2 essays throughout the year. He was super sweet and always cared about his students.
The professor is a light grader

I don't know how Suhail doesn't have 5 stars out of 5. This guy is genuinely so nice and just wants to hear your thoughts on the things you read/watch outside and inside the class. He remembers your names quick. Don't be scared to talk and please write a good review on him after your class is done because I promise he is the greatest of all time.

Professor Islam is great. He's very personable and even though the class can be kind of boring, his humor and comments always lightens the mood. It's just basic reading for homework (poems, short stories) and we discuss them during class. There are a few papers, but he's an extremely easy grader. Very sweet guy.

I love Suhail. He is adorable. All you have to do is read the short poems or stories assigned for homework, and then come to class to share with your table, and then with the class. There were weekly journals that you could write anything about what you read for the week and 3 essays.

Dr. Islam is a very kind and caring professor. The class and the readings are quite boring, but you need to read because its entirely discussion based. Very few lectures. Only 3 essays, which you are given plenty of time to complete and is a fair grader. He does take very long to grade assignments though.

All we do every class is have a discussion about the readings from the night before and occasionally we would watch videos. It was very easy and we just had to write a reflection every week and a few papers throughout the semester. He is a very sweet professor and you can tell that he cares about his students and loves what he does.

Absolute sweetheart.  He's so nice, but sometimes too nice.  a few people in my class like to ramble on about things that aren't related and he's too nice to stop them.  I would rather hear him talking than what the other students did the other day.  He is a slow grader, but nonetheless he does care.  Lots of reading & talking in class so be aware.
this man is literally so nice he's like a dad and although i didnt always like the class he made it better :) he is a very slow grader though, only con. BUT HES SO NICE
He's so nice he's like a dad. The class I took was boring and it can be hard to understand him but he's so nice.

Be prepared to read but besides that this course is so laid back. sometimes there were journals at the end of the week other times we didnt have them. 3 papers total and he cancelled our final presentation cause we were stressed. you really dont even have to read you can just bs a response when he calls on you and you will be fine

Professor Islam is the best!! There are readings but you don't really have to do them you can make them up as you go. There are always class discussions but they are really laid back don't stress it. He canceled our oral presentations and pushed back the final paper due date because of how stressed we are. There are only 3 papers.
He is a pretty laid back teacher. He may not be the best, but he is very caring and understanding. Would do anything for his students.

He is so caring, he cancelled our final paper because so many people told him that they were stressed out. I never read the reading before class and was able to write journals and the 2 papers just off of class discussion. Participate to the discussion once per class and you'll be fine. He also cancelled class quite a bit which was nice.

Dr. Islam cares SO much about his students. He is incredibly understanding about difficulties that can sometimes get in the way of academia (i.e. a global pandemic) and he doesnt dock grades for it. The readings can be long, but they are very interesting. 3 papers and the last you can expand on one or both of your previous papers. Very fair grader

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Participation matters', 'Graded by few things']
comment: Dr. Islam is a very kind man and he makes it hard to not dread this class. He wants to see his students succeed. The books are incredibly boring. You write 3 papers, no final exam. This class is about the environment, even though it doesn't say anything about the environment, that's all you will talk about.

Dr. Islam is one of the kindest and most interesting people I have ever met. This class genuinely changed my view of the world and also opened me up to some incredible books. We had 3 papers that were easy so long as you did the readings, but other than that it was all really interesting class discussions. Was truly sad when this class ended.

Tip: get ahead on the readings while you can. They aren't hard and as long as you can talk about what you read, you're fine. Mostly small group discussions and three papers through the year. Just do the work and readings on time and the papers will be easy for you.
Loved Him

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'SO MANY PAPERS', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS']
comment: Class was supposed to be about writing research papers properly, but this teacher only covered the material we were writing the papers about. The few times we discussed writing technique, he did not seem to know what he was talking about. When giving assignments, they were often sprung on us suddenly. Poor communicator. Avoid taking at all costs.
He is my boy. Great dude

Dr. Islam means well. The class is disorganized at best. Regularly assigns at least 40 pages of reading due each class, and the syllabus is never set. Does not respond to emails, notifies students of presentations 12 hours before they must present (even after saying the presentation was cancelled). And the English Department doesn't care at all.

Great professor!! There is a lot of reading and journals for every class, but most of the reading is actually pretty interesting. Discussion based class with two papers and a group presentation. Very funny and caring guy who cares about student success and values diversity. Definitely recommend!

Dr. Islam is seriously one of the most incredible professors that I have ever had. He made me feel that I have true potential within my major and truly cares about the well-being of his students. He is such an inspirational person and genuinely wants his students to obtain knowledge, tolerance, and understanding within his classroom.

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: He makes us write journals for each class

Dr. Islam is such an amazing guy, he is hilarious and genuinely cares about the students and the topics we cover in class. We only write 2 papers in this class and the final paper you are allowed to expand on one of the first two. This class is the easiest English class I have ever taken, we either have conversations about books or watch a movie.

Majority of classes are spent doing group discussion so be prepared to talk. Never gives above a B+ on essays no matter how hard you work on them. Bad at replying to emails and scheduling office visits so if you need to talk outside of class you're out of luck. Very nice man, passionate about his job.

Always too many readings assigned for homework and he never actually reads his student's papers and everyone always just gets a B or a B+. Basically impossible to get above a B+ because he rarely gives out A's.

He is a very nice man and the class is easy to slack in. That's about it.  He is confusing and doesn't know what he wants from us.  I heard he gave everyone a B+, which is unfair, because I know I did much more work than some of those people and feel I deserved higher.  He also gave everyone the same essay feedback - "use more examples"
Easiest professor I've ever had.  If you go to class and write the two essays that he assigns, you will get an A. Great GPA booster.
He is a REALLY NICE GUY and down to earth! The class is easy..just participate in class discussions and you will get an A!

Terrible. Probably the worst professor I have had at Nazareth. He is extremely disorganized and clueless. He will give you a syllabus, but won't follow it after the first few weeks. You don't have to do any work to get by in the class, which is extremely annoying because we're paying thousands of dollars to go here. Big thumbs down for this guy.
Passionate & engaging.  If you have interest & are actually looking to learn something interesting this is the guy.  If you are not he probably won't mind.

he is a very nice guy and a very easy grader. but i feel like i've been gipped out of an actual class. he did not give us a full schedule at the beginning of the class or at all for that matter. So the next book you end up reading is a surprise until he emails you sunday night with it and the 100 page reading is due on tuesday.
Really relaxed, easy grader, and very funny.
Easiest A ever. He does not even notice what you do at all. You don't have to do any work. As long as you occasionally say something in class its fine.
Dr. Islam is very passionate about his work, he is an easy grader and loves when you participate, even if it is off topic! Great Guy.
I loved class with Dr. Islam. The class I took with him was a night class, so that made it a little hard to take. If I had it with any other prof., I most likely would have fallen asleep though.
Great Teacher...Definitely recommend him for any class.  He grades very easy and is willing to change the silibus if something happens.
Dr. Islam is awesome. he is super nice andreally cares about his students
The above comments are all totally valid and accurate; Dr. Islam is a fantastic professor and he knows a lot. He truly cares about his students

He rocks! I am trying to get him as my professor next semester. I recommend him to everyone. He is funny, practical, and really truly cares how you are doing in his class whether you have a C+ or an A.
Interesting teacher, cares a lot about how you do in his class.  Not necessarily the grade you are getting, but how much you are learning.  Very cultured.  i recommend taking any class with him
This man is so interesting and knowledgable.  He has a great heart and is so peaceful and adorable.  Good sense of humor, very insightful.  Great class but a lot of writing.  It is worth it though.

Entire course was group work projects; I got stuck with a bad group (luck of the draw). Thankfully projects were easy and so were tests. Amazing at lecture, very interactive, great feedback on presentations. Let me crochet while he lectured so that was nice. Overall great guy, funny, and enjoyable professor.

I had Professor Adams for four different marketing classes. He makes every class interesting and ties in real world marketing events. Everything I learned in his classes helped me in higher level marketing classes. He's really funny too. If you show up and put in the work, you will gain invaluable knowledge from him and have a great time!

At the top of the semester Prof Adams seemed super kind and respectful, and I was ready for his class. However, as the semester continued, he let his true colors show. He became very smug and honestly disrespectful at times. I saw another review on here using the word 'Bully' to describe him, and I 100% agree.
Great professor! Career focused and helpful. At times, holds us to accountability, but never disrepectful. Group work is a must.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Lots of homework', 'Accessible outside class']
comment: Professor Adams is a great teacher and is very knowledgeable about class content. However, he can be very rude to the class and comes off as a bully sometimes. He can be hard to work with and acts cocky. I really liked the projects and presentations, but his demeanor and attitude ultimately ruined my experience in the class. Class isn't too hard.

Bryan is a great professor. He is very knowledgeable and gives a lot of valuable information. I love how a lot of his projects reflect what the real world of marketing is like. He really likes doing group projects, which can be rough if someone is not pulling their weight. He is always available outside of class and is very understanding

Had him for Drawing 2! Always gave good feedback. We did 5 projects which is a lot, but the final project we had a ton of creative freedom. You likely WILL have to come in outside of class to finish the still lifes. Learned colored pencils, pastels & figure drawing. Very well rounded course and taught us a lot about proportions & color theory!

Stefan is amazing at what he does, gives amazing feedback and cares about his students. Always has great artistic advice and an overall kind guy. Gives out other hw assignments(not too many) so the 3-4 drawing projects are not the only thing graded. Grading was a little unclear, but if you put the time and effort into your craft, you'll be fine!

I would give my left kidney to Stephan. He was absolutely incredible, always giving feedback to help us improve, but never making us feel bad about our work. We could always resubmit a piece if we didn't like the grade we got at critique. He was also very funny to be around and understanding and kind.
grading is hard, but split in projects, attendance, and exercises. the final project you get to pick which is nice. This is my 2nd with zoller, and I like him. good painter.

Explaining how he is going to grade something is almost never talked about and he also grades so unfairly. He literally grades practice exercises and if your proportions aren't perfect, good luck on even getting a 90. Only 100s (2) I ever received in his ART class were on projects that were graded based on participation/inclusion of all parts.

Shelly is one of the best professors I've had in my entire VCD degree. She gives interesting projects, good feedback, and is open to all styles of design. She will really push you to do your best, but it will prepare you for the professional design world. Projects are for the most part interesting but may require lots of work outside of class.

Made my life easier in VCD. Helps students who are not tech savvy become tech savvy, simple instructions and great curriculum that slowly builds on your skills.

A kind, caring, and inspirational professor and designer who wants to see your unique art style.

Shelly is a great professor. She knows her stuff and helped each student one on one to work out their projects. For type 1, we had a font of the week and then a quiz about them all at the end, but if you kept up it was easy. All the things she said were helpful to design in general, and she was really fun as a person.

She's super nice and chill, she calls you out if you're being disruptive which I enjoyed. Her assignments are easy and are usually opinion based writing. She likes in class conversations and discussions, and does a few hands on activities

Professor Pritchard was easily my favorite professor all semester! She is easy going & truly cares about her students well being. The class was extremely easy, & she always gave great feedback to all assignments. Assignments were fun & not too difficult. She's so kind & genuine, and will help you with anything you need! Wonderful teacher & person!!

Such a caring and helpful teacher! Her lectures are easy to follow and she teaches english very well. There are assignments due every class but they are usually pretty easy if you just stay on top of it.
She is so sweet and always makes sure students understand what is expected of them. Her class moves fast and doesn't drag, with many chances to raise your grade if needed.

Norah Pritchard is the sweetest human. I would 10000% reccommend her to anyone taking ENG101 or 102. There is little homework and she's very flexible. There are three "big" papers (only about three pages each) but she walks you through every step and you always get time to work on it in class! Loved, loved, loved this class!!!

One of the best teachers I have ever had. Decent amount of reading of short articles or speeches that will be used for future writing assignments but nothing absurd. She is super helpful and understanding. Assignments build on each and feed your confidence throughout the semester. Do your work, show up and participate you will love her class.

Norah is great! She is very clear about her expectations for assignments. Homework dies down over the semester starting at maybe once a week. Essays are short, at most 3 pages. She does writer workshop days before essays are due, allowing students to work and she offers 1 on 1 conferencing for any questions or help on the essay.

She treats all of her students like they're her children, genuinely a kind and loving person. She makes you feel like your thoughts and ideas matter, and she ensures your voice is heard. I wish I could take all of my classes with her. Definitely take her class, it's a breeze and a fun time.
Great Professor, nice class discussions and goes over the homework, no tests but it takes a while to get grades back

Try not to walk into this class taking things personally. She is really sweet, but will absolutely demolish you with no mercy when assessing your counterpoint in front of the entire class. For the same reason, avoid angering her. Otherwise, she's pretty cool. A lot of people really like her. I think she's alright.

I love this woman. She will come help you specifically if she knows if you are struggling and is constantly open to explaining things. She understands how hard Music Theory is and she takes you through every step of the way. As long as you show up, you should do fine in this class.

Holmquest manages to make theory, something terrifying to me, easy. She explains everything in a simple and straightforward way and provides resources to help you get a better grip on the challenging parts of the course. The class can get a bit boring at times... just a bit. The worksheets are pass/fail, so just complete it and you'll get an A!!

tags: ['Hilarious', 'Lots of homework', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: Worksheets for each class but not often graded. Very nice and very knowledgeable. Not the most interesting class or attention-grabbing lectures.

This professor is incredibly passionate about what she teaches and enjoys sharing that passion with her students. She is fun and energetic, and is always engaging with the students. I certainly developed a lot of musical skill in her class. I'm definitely taking her again as much as possible.
Professor is great! The course material is just difficult, I recommend tutoring!

Reef gets mixed reviews, but honestly, he is the best theory teacher I've ever had. Theory does not come easy to me- and Reef has always been available to help me if I have a question. The class is only hard if you allow it to be, meaning, if you don't ask for help when you need it. Also, he is freaking hilarious.

I just finished my second semester of Music Theory of 4 and I can not wait for it to be over. I always end up just passing the course and it makes me miserable having to go into that room twice a week. Prof. Reef is a very good professor but I believe he is way to smart to be teaching first-year students.
I really really liked Dr. Reef. I am AWFUL at music theory, but he always helped me and was understanding. His dog is the cutest and comes to theory review. One of my fav professors at Naz so far.
Dr. Reef has the best dog ever. Will bring to review sessions if you plead. Makes theory more fun, he designs exquisite quizzes and at one point he canceled our final exam because he was in China.
He's just a kind silly guy, super chill

Genuinely ones of my favorite professors of all time. Love this man. Really wants you to learn and succeed, is so funny, indulges us in our gossip but gets us on track and ready to learn. If me or my classmates had any money we'd make him an end-of-year gift basket.

Professor Klumpp is so fun and is a great energy especially for my early class. He is a great guitar player and teacher and the pace he teaches the course at is great. He covers a great range of skills and is super chill when it comes to grading. I recommend taking this class if you want to learn some guitar basics, be able to read sheet music.

Django is a really flexible and knowledgeable professor. He is great at teaching because he will adapt his lessons in the direction of the student's interests and allows room for creativity, while still making sure that you develop a strong foundational skillset. Easy 10/10 professor.
He is really nice! Everyone should take his classes!

Nancy is a very nice lady and makes class VERY entertaining- you will never be bored. She will call on people and ask questions. Class was very easy and had minimal work outside of class, other than the 3 essays.

absolute sweetheart! can be misconstrued as rude, but please take the time to get to know her. such an easy class overall. she WILL call on you for open discussions. if you're nice to her, she's nice to you!

Dr. O'Donnell is absolutely amazing!! I took two classes with her ENGW 101 and 102. She is one of the kindest person I've ever met, super helpful and only wants the best for her students.  ALWAYS participate in class discussions, ask questions, do your homework and don't use electronics and she will be happy with you.

She does tend to get very paranoid and discusses uncomfortable topics in class, she is very inclusive in class discussions even when students feel uncomfortable. And is willing to also learn from her students.
Nancy is very helpful and is a professor who is easy to understand as well as being there for students when they need help, is clear with instructions and what needs to be done for all the essays.
I LOVEE HER! I am taking her class for second semester thats how much I love her and her class. She makes learning fun. If you can't take sarcasm and you get offended easily, don't take her class.
Shes pretty disorganized but is extremely biased. Only gives you essay assignments on extremely liberal topics. She will be on your butt about phones and laptop usage but she is caring.
She was wonderful! By having everyone participate, it was easy to stay attentive. She grades on the harder end but you are able to make corrections in your essay! Her feedback is great.

Professor O'Donnell is a pretty solid choice. She is extremely understanding and is willing to extend deadlines and work with her students, but can be disorganized at times. She provides excellent feedback on papers and makes herself easily accessible for help. I highly recommend taking a class with her.

Couldn't have asked for a better professor for this course. It is hard, but his method of explaining simplifies complex subjects. Even if you don't get it in lecture or miss parts of lecture, he has lecture videos. Always checks on everyone to make sure they understand the concepts, and goes out of his way to help if you let him know you need it.
He is the GOAT. Physics at 6pm sucks… he knows that all to well. He is a high school teacher so he actually can teach really well. If you need physics and or a peq or an easy A, take it with Baker.
He's so amazing

I love Baker! He makes physics so easy made a 6-8pm class enjoyable. Pretty easy grader overall and generous with partial credit. Also so understanding and kind. If you can get him for physics - DO IT.

Such a great professor. He cares about his students and wants to see them succeed. Always available for students to ask questions. Made a 2 hour physics lecture fun and engaging. Highly recommend taking physics with him!
Really fun guy that made 2 hour classes enjoyable and worth going to. I like his style of teaching. Really kind and works with students.

Honestly the best to take BIO210L and 211L with. He gives a bunch of extra credit where it is due and is a very fair grader. He is a light grader on the lab assignments and will always help you with labeling in class if youre unsure about something on the lab assignment. Always accessible by email even tho he is an adjunct and not on campus alot

Mack is a really nice guy and a good professor. Vonica makes the tests and quizzes, but Mack reads over them and will take anything out that he think's is unreasonable. He's a very generous grader and will try to get you the most points that he can. Lectures are boring, but the class is really just memorization. Hard course made easier by Mack!

He was okay. I felt like he could have been more knowledgeable on things. He wasn't a tough grader which was good when it came to lab assignments. Lectures were really boring and not helpful because he would just stand in front of the smartboard and read off the slides. I think taking lab with Vonica is best since he makes all of the tests.

he's an adjunct so doesn't always know what's going on, teaches the material without knowing what will actually be on the test (created by a different prof), does try to give extra help if he thinks the test isn't fair, came in a couple of times for extra help in the lab, nice guy, maybe not the most knowledgeable ever but he does fine.

Do not expect for him to give you a 100. Meeting the criteria he gives will often result in a 90, and you kinda just have to guess what to do for that last 10%. If you are someone who cannot learn on their own from a textbook then this professor is not for you since his classes usually require you to already know the materials.

tags: ['Group projects', 'Gives good feedback', 'Graded by few things']
comment: Professor Gerald Zappia was a great professor. This course was pretty easy, as long as you communicate accordingly with your group. I definitely recommend taking this course with Gerald Zappia. You learn a lot and it is a pretty relaxed course.

Zappia ive learned so much from and if you have questions about the marketing field def ask him! His classes are a little hard but if you pay attention it gets easier. He likes his group projects for sure and a pretty funny guy.
Zappia is a really cool guy, he has you write papers mostly and a few tests here and there. He's been at Naz for a while and earned it. You'll definitely learn something from him.

Hope you like pediatrics because that's the only setting that exists here. Adult rehab? Never heard of her! Ask a question and get a sigh, a riddle, or a stare making you regret your question. Feedback is vague, grading is brutal, and clarity is a myth. Quizzes are typically 7-10 long answer questions with 10-15 minutes to do them!

Nice lady but bad at teaching. You can tell everyone was struggling and she still didn't do anything to change the way she was teaching to help the students. Quizzes were not the same as the work or homework we would have. The website we used to do the homework on called smart work was very hard to use.

tags: ['Tough grader', 'Lots of homework', 'Graded by few things']
comment: Professor Craig does not show an appropriate understanding of the course content. As a lab professor, she will change your final project experiment, not tell you, and then not explain how to do it. She will expect you to already know everything before entering the class.

She gives out weekly quizzes and the time limit for them is between 10-15 minutes, which is not a lot of time depending on the severity of the questions. There are quiz retakes every couple of weeks that can make up for it. She teaches like you already know what is going on. If you have a question, she does not give a straight forward answer.

When I attend her office hours, I often feel talked down to. Her tone can come across as dismissive and condescending, which makes it uncomfortable to ask questions or seek help. I've gone to her for support, but I usually get more out of teaching myself.

She wants everyone to exceed and is very available outside of class. There's quizzes every week but it'll help you with the final (which is all multiple choice). The aleks homeworks are annoying but just go see her for help. You have to do the worksheets/go to workshops since she puts some of the same questions from those on the quizzes.

I think Dr. Hutchinson is passionate about science, BUT this class is unnecessarily difficult for a PEQ. Almost weekly quizzes, which were hard. The lab was built into the class, which was nice.  Getting a good grade is hard. I found myself working harder for this 100-level science class than I did for my history classes.

This course was taken as a PEQ. It was good in the respect that there was not a separate lab class however the workload for this course was a lot. Most of the work is busy work and did not add to my learning. There are quiz retakes. The textbook is optional but it is not made clear on the syllabus.

I think Dr. Hutchinson-Anderson is a lovely lady and a great teacher, but I was not too fond of the class because it was too much work for a PEQ. There were extremely difficult quizzes almost every week. I found myself working harder in this 101 class than I do in my three-hundred-level history classes.

Dr. Hutchinson-Anderson tries her best. She has a flipped classroom which I am not a big fan of, but really does make herself available to meet for extra help. There's a quiz almost every class and the grading is really whack, but she uses most questions from in-class worksheets.

tags: ['Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Test heavy']
comment: Dr. Hutchinson is very nice and loves science but she seems like she would be a better elementary teacher. She walks around and looks over your shoulder when you're working/taking a test and babies you. She puts up dividers between people like you're in 1st grade when taking a test and it's a little frustrating being treated like a kid in college.

This is the hardest/heaviest work load of a 101 level course I've ever taken and it's so stressful. I love her as a teacher/person, but she just assigns WAY TOO MUCH WORK! So many labs and discoveries, tests are once a week and they're hard, you have a midterm, final, have to present at CARS, have to do multiple final projects and service learning!

I loved her she made it really easy to pass. she goes out of her way to help you better understand something and will usually hold review sessions for tests if you ask. Also i know workshop isn't worth any credits but you have to go and its most of the time worth it
Tries to be sarcastic as if i didnt notice. I dropped this class. I had no idea what i was doing hopefully i dont have to get her the next time i take it.
Great professor. Class is 3 hours long but it flew by. Easily my favorite professor of this semester.
She can come off a bit strict, but she is very helpful. Class is 3 hours long,but it flies by. Very nice, and the homework isnt bad at all

This class was very engaging and we used up the whole time. She would go over most days but that's only because it is a one day a week class. Did not give a chance for revision of an assignment but she graded fair. Class could have been shorter like the others.
Pretty good teacher, She really helped me through a lot of labs and even the final. She can come off as very strict though!
Easily the best education professor I had yet- class is almost 3 hours long and it flies by. Very engaging. She asks thought provoking questions and makes the matterial matter. Great professor.

Extremely mean professor (Dr).  Her tests are way too long for 50 minutes and she has no respect for her students.  She emphasizes group work and does not help with the group dynamics.  She is just a miserable rude person and should not be teaching.

I had her for Math & Fiber Arts and unless your a girl or gay, she will be rude and unhelpful with anything you ask her. There's quizzes every Thursday and you only get 10 minutes no matter the length. Prepare yourself for hours of homework every week due to the weavings and studying for the quizzes. She sounds nice but it's fake.

LOVED Dr. Lewis. The math in this class was very easy and the projects were super fun. You do not have to come in with any knowledge of fiber arts as she will take time in and out of class to demonstrate until you get it.

I absolutely adore Professor Lewis. Ive never liked math or been that good at it but she made it at lest fun for me. I knew how to knit and crochet before this class so that was easy but I can tell she's not a tough grader as I did make a few mistakes but still got 100s. As well if your having trouble she's more then happy to help!
She is not the worst but not the best. You do not learn anything in class, everything is learned outside the class. She is not a tough grader, definitely is a little sexist.

106 is the fiber arts math class, and I honestly would recommend it if you hate math. You barely have to study for the weekly quizzes or the 2 exams. The actual fiber arts suck and you learn everything from videos. I turned in some REALLY bad pieces and got at least an 80 every time. Shes super enthusiastic which is hard at 9am but is really sweet!

tags: ['Tough grader', 'Lots of homework', 'Graded by few things']
comment: My morning class was a total nightmare. Some call her energetic, but I say she's way overboard, acting like a childish kid—super annoying. Math's tough enough, then we get silly dance sessions to start. Homework's insane, and she doesn't teach a thing. Expects us to self-learn it all and arrive ready. So frustrating—no guidance whatsoever, my god!!

Lots of short assignments which helped prep you for the multi part final project. Only two tests, but weekly quizzes (but four dropped!). She was always willing to explain when someone asked a question, and I know many people who made good use of her office hours. I liked stats with her and thought she was good at explaining difficult concepts.

I love Heather for calc. It is homework-based which can be confusing (you learn math alone, basically), but she is always willing (I only needed help a few times). Then you go over HW in class and can ask questions. Weekly quizzes and exams are pretty easy if you study for at least 30 mins. I loved her joyful spirit and enthusiasm for math!

Heather is very knowledgeable and makes the course content easier to digest. She is always available to answer questions both in and out of class and wants everyone to succeed. The course can be difficult as the lectures are spent completing problems and there is no real lecture material.
This professor makes you teach yourself out of a packet. Calculus is already hard and she made it worse. Wouldn't recommend.
The professor did not teach, she hands you a packet of questions and assigns you then each class

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Lots of homework', 'Accessible outside class']
comment: Always available outside of class. Show up and go to office hours and you will for sure have an A. She is super nice and helpful.

She is very nice but can be a tough grader sometimes. Exams are tough but if you do the homework you can pass. She is very approachable and will help you with anything but she can be a bit confusing when she explains things.

Be prepared to teach yourself the entirety of the material. Have to do textbook problems before class, and then you go over them in class as if you are already expected to know what is going on. She is willing to help and has many office hours, but I still found tests extremely difficult and barely related to the review sheet

Calculus can be difficult and I don't think I would have gotten through with anyone else. Dr. Lewis has an open door. The flipped classroom is frustrating but effective. Would do a class with Dr. Lewis again! She is passionate and 100% there for her students. Grading can be tough on exams and hw but fair and participation weighs heavily.

tags: ['Accessible outside class', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Lecture heavy']
comment: This class is boring no matter who you take it with. Lewis is always able to work with you and help you on the material. Just wish homework wasn't graded so harshly so that it could bump up my grade.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: I had Heather for structures which was very challenging material. Heather really knows her stuff and has an inspirational love of math. She will answer whatever questions you have in class, and during her office hours, she is also reasonably decent at answering emails. Study for the tests by reviewing old HWs and book problems and you'll do fine.
If you studied for quizzes you'll do good in the class

She is a fairly good professor. Her exams are fair and they are not too difficult. There are two projects for the class that take up a lot of time. She is not always clear when she explains things and she's a little too peppy for 8 a.m.
She may not have always been the most clear, but she was always available for outside help and encouraged it. All things considered, she is a fantastic teacher.

Had Heather for Calc II, and she was great! She explained everything with great depth and clarity, and answered all questions posed. She extends homework deadlines if we aren't able to cover everything. Heather is always in her office during her posted hours and is available through email to answer any questions. I recommend her class highly!
Not very helpful on work. She is nice and offers helpful, but doesnot committ

i absolutely adore professor lewis. she is always so energetic and enthusiastic about teaching. she never fails to have a smile on her face. her teaching is basic enough for anyone to understand and she will do anything to make sure everyone understands what she's saying. she also offers extremely easy extra credit! (ISN'T THAT AWESOME)
She's very energetic, at all times of the day! She teaches the material well and will gladly help in any way that she can.
She is a fantastic teacher! A bit crazy, but makes the class fun and interesting. She is very helpful and wants all her students to do well.

She is a great professor who tries really hard to help everyone succeed in her classes.  She shows an interest in student's lives and will put as much effort into your education as you put in.  If you try in her class, she will bend over backwards to help you succeed.

Extremely enthusiastic (ISN'T THIS GREAT!?!) and helpful however she focuses a lot on keeping on schedule and she's not about to slow down. Assigns a lot of homework, all math teachers do. Index cards and study guides for tests

Rather crazy at times, teaches barefoot often, and is VERY enthusiastic about math....highly entertaining.  Her stats course was incredibly easy, and obviously thought that as we were not math majors we were horrible at math - let's just say she "taught" us the formula for a line...y=mx+b...i think I learned that in 7th grade.

Great professor! She explains everything in great detail to make sure everyone fully understands concepts. Very approachable and always willing to answer questions even if you think they are stupid ones.
She thoroughly explains everything and never tries to trick you on tests. She is full of energy and tries to make class as fun as possible.
interesting lady. not very helpful. harder class than it seems
very enthusiastic, nice, and willing to help you out, makes me laugh because she is so dorky
She maeks this class fun and is always enthusiastic

She is always interesting to listen to and will often share bits and pieces of background on things you are learning about that you would have never known. She is very enthusiastic and is a great teacher. She'll help you at the snap of a finger. Awesome professor!
Kinda crazy, and VERY enthusiastic about math. Helpful, and very nice. Class was easy.
She is a little different, but she shows enthusiasm for the subject that actually makes the class somewhat entertaining. She is very helpful and willing to go out of her way to help students.
She explains things so that everyone can understand it pretty well...She goes really slow..which gets boring...butyou know what's goin on!
At the start of every class she says  Happy ___day , as in  happy monday   happy tuesday   happy wednesday . So annoying!
Very friendly. He talks a lot but is getting better at not being boring. Workload is also very easy

Professor Ray Martino is a good professor. He gets his points across pretty well and is very lenient on grading. Overall, he is a wonderful person and the class is pretty easy. Overall, I enjoyed his class and he is a very funny man.

Ray is the cutest old man imaginable. You can tell he's passionate about teaching and having students take something away from the course. He did a good job of getting to know everyone in the class, which made the speeches easier. Classes were interesting, but would've been better if the class participated more, but he tried his best.

Ray is great, I really enjoyed his class. He always ended early (it was a once a week night class). Very heavy on the discussions, so as long as you participate you're good. He is super engaging and fun to talk to, as long as you communicate with him you will be fine.
My favorite professor makes lectures so interesting!

Dr Forbes is my favorite professor ever!!! So funny and really cares about her students. The class is info-heavy and the textbook is definitely necessary but she makes it fun and there are study guides before every exam. There's also only one final paper! The only thing is she literally never answers emails but she's accessible during office hours!

I LOVE DR FORBES! This is my second class with her she is the best prof I have had at Naz and abnormal is my favorite class in my psych minor. Main thing you're graded on is exams, so make sure you study but she gives study guides which are SO helpful. There was a textbook but I barely read it so don't worry. Cannot recommend Dr Forbes enough.

I learned so much in this class and Dr. Forbes is not only kind but also very knowledgeable. She shared many personal examples of class content from her time as a therapist, which helped make the class interesting and related the material to real life. I'm not a psychology major but took abnormal psych for fun and had a great time. Highly recommend

Keep class very entertaining and made it go by quickly. Material was fun in her class. Her tests are very fair and she gives a study guide which helps a lot. No homework outside of class except for reading the textbook. However you don't really need the textbook for anything else, it is helpful for the quizzes. I suggest taking a class with her!

Loves her so much! She made psychology fun and easy to understand. I would definitely recommend the textbook because some thing on the tests are not in the lectures. She's very understanding and available for help or to proofread a paper before turning it in. 10/10 high recommend, would love to take again.

ABSOLUTELY AMAZING, the best professor I've ever had! I would recommend every single class she teaches. She does take a long time to grade, especially with papers. Dr. Forbes is an angel on earth. She is someone who I want to sit down and have therapy with even though I am mentally not required to receive therapy. Her lessons were interesting, her personality is great, and she is a very fair grader. I had a great time in her class.
Professor Forbes is the nicest professor ever. She gives assignments that help you understand the material and her study guides are PERFECT for the exams. Take her classes!!!!
sweet prof. and very caring and understanding, lover her

Love Dr. Forbes!!! She is so helpful when it comes to class content, or any other topic you want to talk about with her! 3 tests and 1 final but she tells you everything you need to know. Would definitely take another class with her :)

Prof Forbes is an AMAZING professor. If she taught every PSY class at Naz, I'd take it with her. AWESOME psych professor. Her study guides tell you exactly what is on the tests. The papers are easy and have clear grading criteria. Also offers extra credit and gives awesome lectures. HIGHLY recommend.

Dr. Forbes is the best professor I've had at Naz. She brings her own personal experience into the classroom, and is always available for both academic and personal needs. Would highly recommend taking a class with her! Tests can be a bit difficult, but she will tell you what you need to know.

She is the BEST professor at Naz by far! If you have an opportunity to take any class she teaches FULL SEND IT!!! Forbes is an incredible professor! She gives great lectures that you remember for the tests, her powerpoints are clear and helpful, and she ties in her past clinical experience a lot. Honestly the BEST professor you'll have. She comes across as demanding during syllabus week, but don't be fooled by the tough professor facade. LOVE LOVE LOVE Dr Forbes!! Definitely my favorite professor. Her lectures are very clear, thorough, and helpful. Courtney is one of the absolute best professors at Naz. She uses much of her own clinical experience to help relate concepts to the real world. This was for her SWK 383 junior internship class. Gem is very kind and well intentioned but her grading is by far the toughest in the social work department. Gem is a Gem! She is the sweetest human ever and truly cares for her students. She will always hear you out and make sure you understand the material. I recommend her to everyone!!!!!

lori is so sweet. she is very good at returning emails and communicating with you. she also formats the class so you get lots of feedback on your essay before submitting it. the feedback she gives is constructive and helpful. she is an amazing professor.

Prof Huth is a very nice lady but is unclear of what she is looking for in your essays. A lot of group and peer editing is done in class along with learning a few key writing characteristics but none of it is helpful. she explains the purpose of the essay but when you write your draft she'll say none of it is correct and you are doing it wrong lol

Bill is an incredible professor. I learned so much in his Vocal Tech class, especially about both vocal technique and the business side of the arts. I gained a lot of new singing repertoire and truly loved the class. During the first semester, he typically doesn't give A's, so don't be discouraged if you earn a B.

He truly cares about his students. There are reading quizzes and a presentation. Both the midterm and final are hand written. No technology is allowed in class but he keeps his lectures interesting. I always looked forward to going to his class!

Professor Karna is easily my favorite teacher I have ever had. He genuinely cares for his students and will take time to help you in his class. He also is very understanding with the fact we have outside lives and sometimes school can get difficult. I'd recommend him to anyone.

Bishal is genuinely one of the best teachers ive ever had. hes very understanding and accommodating when it comes to students and a simple conversation with him goes a long way in the long run! he preps you for every exam, gives you the questions beforehand and everything is extremely straightforward.

Bishal is the best. Take notes and you will have no issues. I just skimmed most of the readings right before class. He gives you the exam questions beforehand. Prep for each question and you'll be fine. If you're having a hard time understanding a concept just reach out to him, he wants his students to succeed.

I struggled throughout this semester so bad and even missed half of classes (excused absences) He is the most caring prof I've ever met and actually wanted to work with me to get better- health wise and school. I would give him a big hug if I could. All quizzes are online and in the readings. Assignment's are straightforward and easily get a 100
Bishal is a cool guy, but I was often lost in his class. It is all lecture, and we weren't allowed to use technology to take notes. The way he let us prep for exams was great though.

I love Bishal so much. Spiritual care changed my life. Readings were long, but SO worth it and interesting. He is so passionate about his work and extremely caring. As long as you put in effort, he is an easy grader. Reading, lecture, writing, and discussion assignments. Cannot recommend enough, really.
Teaching style is great, a lot of busy work, but his grading isn't too harsh.

comment: nice guy cares what hes teaching but theres a quiz before every class and u should read the book.

Great guy, went hiking once and saw him out on the trail. Gives a lot of homework. VERY lecture heavy. He's the only reason I'm doing homework during finals week. Also incredibly kind and understanding.

Professor Karna is really open to class discussions and what your option or thoughts are on the subject, which makes class that much better. Bishal is a very friendly and funny professor, but does assign a decent amount of papers. He takes some time to reply to emails. It's a lot of writing. Idk how I feel about Bishal. If you don't go to class your screwed. He's very nice but a harsh grader in my experience.

He is a super caring guy who is always willing to help his students. The quizzes were all open note and super easy. He likes to look more at the philosophical side of religion sometimes, so I was kinda confused what he was talking about at times. But overall a really easy class

comment: Bishal is really nice, but there are reading quizzes every week (usually around 5-10 pages). One thing bad is that he doesn't allow electronics at all in his class. Every single class is a lecture, but he has a very clam voice so it's not the worst. There's a lot of overlapping assignments and there are lots of lectures. Also he's from Ohio :(

Professor Karna was awesome. His test were reasonable and as long as you do the work it is not difficult to get a good grade.  His class is a little lecture heavy, but his personality is wholesome which does not make the class unbearable.

Extremely boring class but Bishal is the sweetest. All quizzes and tests including the midterm were take home and open note. Quizzes due before every class but they were straight from the textbook (literally fill in the missing word in the sentence from textbook). Extremely understanding and willing to work with you.

Bishal is an amazing professor who truly cares about his students. I enjoyed every second of his class and wish I could take it again. I will be taking more courses with him and can proudly say that this course has changed my entire life.

Professor Karna is very nice. I took his Religion 101 class for my religion PEQ. I didn't care for the topic, but I like him as a person and a professor. His grading methods were clear and the class was fairly easy.  The tests are open book, which is awesome.

Bishal was great. Very passionate about religion and did his best to make class interesting. The "textbook" was the book Tales of Wonder which I actually enjoyed reading. Not too many assignments so definitely a good class/professor to take if you have a heavy schedule.

Bishal... the man, the myth, the absolute legend. Not only is he fine as I don't know what but he is a wonderful person. I highly recommend taking his class. This man is so fine, he makes religion worth paying attention to just so you can see him stand on his tippy toes. 10/10 recommended sitting through this class and tallying how many times he says does that make sense? Bishal was a pleasure and I will miss his class

I have had a few classes with Dr. Karna and every time my life is changed for good. The classes have changed the way I see the world and his passion for the content is evident. Highly recommend taking this course with this professor. He makes the material interesting and engaging. Bishal is a very kind and caring professor. Professor Karna was the most amazing Professor Ive ever had. Hes extremely kindhearted and accommodating. His quizzes and tests are not hard as long as you attend the lectures and study a little bit. Bishal just has an amazing sense of calm about him. You can definitely tell he is a Religious studies professor. He explains assignments clearly and grades fairly. He seems to just know a lot about life.

Bishal is the kindest soul at Nazareth. Took this class as an elective and wasn't particularly excited but I left each class feeling a little more enlightened and more interested in the subject. Bishal does not give that much homework. We did four quizzes that were relatively easy if you completed the study guide. Heavy studying was not necessary. The lectures were very interesting. Dr. Karna is so knowledgeable and made this such an interesting class. He hands out study guides before each section so you can keep your notes in order!
