Super nice guy but not a great professor. He makes his tests very difficult and short answer heavy. He's also not afraid to destroy your essays if they are not word for word what he said in class. He will use every last second (and more) of class every day.

Other than that great class and great teacher
Dr. Tanaka is an amazing professor. I had him for both Aural Skills I and Rudiments and he was so patient and caring in both classes. I wish I had him again next semester.
He's the best ever, I would recommend him for any class.

Tanaka is a fantastic professor that really cares about the students. He's very good at keeping everyone on the same track regardless of knowledge going into the class. Show up, pay attention, participate, and you'll do really well in his class! A+ Professor
He's a sweet guy, and he really wants you to succeed. Show up and pay attention, and you'll do just fine.

Dr. Tanaka is a very easy going professor. Dictation and sight reading is very easy, and you end up improving so much by the end of the semester. If you show up, put forth effort, this class is a really easy A.

You get out of this class what you give. It is a lot of tough information to digest, and it seems extremely overwhelming, but completely doable. Participation and being mentally present in lecture will be your best friends. Lots of bonus points opportunities, and one on one help is definitely helpful for topics covered.

Dr. Vonica is a very understanding professor, especially if you have a lot of curiosity in biology and medical things since he is actually a Physician (MD). He is one of the few professors I've had at Naz,who truly cares about his students and makes effort for the students who genuinely care. anatomy is SO hard but Vonica adds his own anecdotes and explanations which helps you better understand. he gives quizzes, participation points, case studies, mastering for points in addition to tests which really helps. he's funny, sometimes a little too smart and has a hard time dumbing it down, but overall a really good choice for the class.
Funny guy that relates part of his life story to the class! Lab is really just memorization. He is pretty clear on what is expected.

Dr. Vonica is a perfect mix of goofy and incredibly caring! The material itself is tough but he is very thorough in explaining things and will throw in funny tangents as needed. He's a fair grader and again just truly cares that his students learn and do well!

This professor was great - easy grader, funny, and willing to help students. The class was usually very disorganized; he goes on lots of rants and gets easily distracted, which sometimes made it hard to get things done. However, would definitely take one of his classes again, given the option.

Was a great lab teacher to have. Made the class laugh and was always willing to help if we were confused or didn't understand the material. As long as you do the work, he will always give a good grade. Overall, he cares about his students and wants to see them do well in lab.

This class is tough and you need to study to do well. Dr. Vonica is very helpful and is always there to set up a time to meet. Dr. Vonica really is a great guy. The lectures do go fast, but if you do the mastering biology ahead of time it helps. The 3 tests  have a lot of bonus questions which is helpful too. I dont know if Tajc is human he knows pretty much anything you ask him. Great guy, can seem scary but meet with one on one and is so chill. Great story teller. Amazing Prf!

comment: I did not think I was going to do well in this class, however, he really does make the material easy to understand. He is willing to help you if you need it and the workshops are a necessity if you want to do well in the class.

Dr Tajc has turned Chem 140- the universal class from hell- into something that is somewhat bearable. The tests and quizzes are hard, yes, but he does anything he can to make sure that you succeed. Dr. Tajc is the man. He is a great teacher and really caring. I had a tough time in this class at the beginning but Dr. Tajc was more than willing to help. Would definitely take a class with this professor again.

Tajc wants to see you do well, and will help you to make sure you do. He is patient, and explains things well in class, and even better in exam reviews. Organic is tough, but Tajc helps.

Dr. Tajc is a very, very good professor. He really cares about all his students and really wants them all to succeed. He is always available to talk to during his office hours. Awesome Prof. very clear in his explanations and will go over something until you get it.  it you pay attention in class you will do well on the quizzes.  Don't bother buying the textbook unless you'll honestly read it.  Hard subject, but he makes it easier!

Peter is great, very understanding and respectful. Great professor to have my first semester of college.
Peter is an amazing professor. He creates a very safe and respectful environment. Peter truly cares about his students and their success, he truly helped me grow as a public speaker!
I loved Peter. He is so kinds and genuinely care about all of his students. he is extremely encouraging and does his best to make everyone feel comfortable speaking in front of the group
understanding and respectful, gives good feedback on speeches in order to improve for next time

tags: ['Gives good feedback', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Graded by few things']
comment: Peter (what he prefers to be addressed as) is an incredible professor! He is very knowledgeable in this content area. Gives weekly homework assignments, however, collects them periodically and grades a portion of them at once- WILL give you sufficient time to make sure they're completed. Lenient grader and will adapt curriculum to students' needs.

3 speeches. Each speech gets more difficult and for the last one you arent suppose to bring anything with you. While that can seem intimidating, he makes you feel extremely prepared, comfortable, and is willing to adjust or talk with you through any of your concerns. One of the nicest professors Ive had!
The class is pretty boring but the professor herself is very kind and cares about her students.

tags: ['Clear grading criteria', 'Gives good feedback', 'Graded by few things']
comment: I had her class last year. It was pretty easy, but the class was pretty boring. It is just to get you into a rhythm and to help you know where to find resources for help. It's not awful, just kind of boring. She is a very kind and understanding person. Definitely an easy A if you do the assignments, which are all VERY EASY!!

She comes to class so energized and excited. Hw is not bad at all, syllabus says 6-9 hrs, not nearly this long. All tests are open note, untimed, + unlimited corrections for full credit. She's lenient with late work, grades fast, responds fast to emails, and will meet with you whenever is best for you. I always had fun and learned so much.

I took this class as my math PEQ and it was my most difficult and heavy course all semester. Lots of homework, mandatory group work, and no time to breathe in between assignments. She is a lovely person and so passionate about her job, but dear god the amount of work she assigned caused lots of stress and made the semester overall unbearable

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read', 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']
comment: Although Nicole Juersivich gives a lot of homework, and most of it seems to be busy work. I can appreciate her enthusiasm and excitement for teaching. The class will be a lot of work, but her attitude everyday of class is quite nice.

The homework is graded on accuracy not effort, so make sure you're putting forth your best effort. The homework and weekly online quizzes are a lot more difficult than the tests. For the tests, there are clear reviews that are set up just like the test so there's no reason to fail, and you get to bring a 3x5 cheat sheet with you

tags: ['Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS']
comment: Not the most effective class I have been to. Could use improvement on teaching methods. Fun teacher though, and a great personality
Does the flipped classroom method, but doesn't do it correctly. She offers little to no help and really makes you work for everything.
Super helpful outside of class, always available during office hours & super willing to make appointments!
Awful. Just Awful. If you have anything to do with her: avoid her.

Every other review is lying. Dr. Alam was my freshman year biology lab professor and I LOVE HER. She comes across as mean but she was so funny and all you have to do is talk to her like a real human being. The only problem is the pre lab quiz can be a little confusing sometimes. Truly a hidden gem at Nazareth once you get to know her.

DO NOT TAKE LAB WITH DR ALAM!! Doesnt know what shes doing, rude, will not answer questions, no feedback, and doesnt not explain the labs just to get mad when you dont understand. Im sorry in advance if you get her...

She was very different with every single student in my lab. But if you are lucky enough to be one of her favorites the class will be very doable, if not you will have to rely on classmates and outside reading to get through lab. If she sees that you are interested in the material she will go above and beyond to help you and get you more interested.

She is the absolute worst, I am so sorry if you have her. She has the worst attitude I've ever seen in a professor and just no respect for students at all. If you ask her a question, 9/10 times she will roll her eyes at you and mummer something under her breath. One called me "stupid white girl" for asking a question.

Not very kind when students ask clarifying questions, she rolled her eyes at a classmate. Didn't start grading until late October which made it difficult to keep submitting work with no feedback to change errors.

Extremely hard labs that were confusing for everyone in the class. Everyone was confused and when asked for help Alam was very passive aggressive. Maybe if it weren't for COVID this class and professor would have been better, but I'm not convinced.

In the class, you will have 3 long papers (Essays), 2 of which are on any topic of your choice, and the other paper is on a biography of an author of your choice. The grading criteria? Nowhere to be seen. For most classes, you'll need to read a short passage and write a 25-50-word reflection on it.

Free class, most is class discussion about the homework that takes 5-20 mins. He doesn't really teach you how to write better papers. His handwriting is awful, and you can't read feedback he gives. No clear grading criteria but is an easy grader overall on the 3 papers and oral presentation.

Professor Naparsteck is such a sweet man. You write three papers and do small assignments for each class, very light work load. He expects everyone to participate in class discussions every class. Overall this was a very easy course to take and I enjoyed Professor Naparstecks wisdom, humor, and advice.

Martin Naparsteck is a great professor. There is homework for every class but they are short and simple. The topics for homework research as based on his interests and enjoy seeing him get excited about students talking about his areas of interest.He isn't a strict grader, only three papers over the semester, and he really wants students to do well

Dr. Naparsteck is a good teacher. In his class you have homework assignments every class, they don't take long at all, maybe 5-10 minutes. You talk about the homework, he calls on everyone, but will take almost anything as credit. Just say what you wrote. You are only graded on the 3 papers you write, and you get to pick what to write about.

Very easy class. 3 papers total. 2 about whatever you want and 1 about a book. All short and easy and easily graded. Lectures are SO boring and you have to participate once each class. Nice guy but class is beyond boring.

At the start, I was a bit confused with the curriculum, but after a week I got the hang of it. We had short 50-100 wrd papers to write for each class correlating with the assignments on the syllabus. Make sure you print these out and hand them in so you don't end up behind. If you show up and complete homework/papers you will do well in this class.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'So many papers', 'Graded by few things']
comment: Very easy and laid back class, class is entirely discussion based and pretty boring. courseload isnt bad at all, usually assigned readings and come to class to discuss. he calls on everyone but its an easy credit. one presentation and 3 papers total.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Lots of homework', 'Accessible outside class']
comment: Professor Naparsteck has been by far my favorite professor. You don't need a textbook or to show up every class as long as you turn in your work eventually. You get assignments every class for homework but they are super easy and only take about 5-10 minutes. I would recommend his 101 and 102 class to anyone.

Easiest class I have ever taken. You have about a 50 word paper every class but they take 10 minutes to research and complete. The class itself is extremely boring so it's hard to want to go. He doesn't grade on attendance, but he does grade on participation. Only 3 long essays which if you do, he basically gives you an A.
Very wise, teaches many lessons outside of class material, daily papers of around 50 words and 3 long papers of topics of your choice was all required for this class. Caring and respectful!

BEST PROFESSOR EVER!!! TAKE WRITING WITH HIM. He is the nicest teacher I have ever had. You can write 3 papers on anything you want. Go have him read your paper before it's due and you are guaranteed an A. I hate English but I LOVED this class.

AMAZING teacher. He is so sweet and cares about everyone. The class is relatively easy and he will read your paper during office hours before it is due and tell you the grade he would give you. Perfect for people who don't love English.

He is the sweetest professor in ALL of Nazareth College. I am a science major so I usually hate English and think it is a huge waste of time, but not in this class! He only assigned 3 papers the whole semester... any topic you want, as short or as long as you want, with as many or as few sources as you want. So easy, no stress. TAKE HIS CLASS!!!!!!
Best English class ever. Professor Naparsteck is one of the most genuine people I have ever met and his class is so easy. I would definitely take this class again.

easiest A i've ever gotten, and he's the kindest professor i've had at naz. He doesn't grade on attendance but he grades on participation, so if you aren't there you can't participate. he lets you write papers on whatever subject you want. the one thing is that his classes are fairly pointless, so it's hard to motivate yourself to go

Mr Caroselli is a really easy professor and super nice! At the end of the semester, we have a final paper, but if you email him and ask him to look over it, he will tell you exactly what you need to do to get a 100. Such a nice guy and his pretty engaging in class too, even tho it can be boring.

The Professor was extremely friendly and open-minded. His Intro to World Music class was so much fun. He kept it very entertaining and made it hands on. It was fun learning about the unique instruments from different countries. Very easy class. Highly recommend!
I love this Professor he is very nice and a great music teacher. Even if you dont know a lot about music he understands and makes class fun.

As a performer, Caroselli is very talented, but as a teacher of world music, I feel like he is not the best person for the job. There have been multiple instances in which he was a bit misinformative about certain cultures (languages, traditions, etc,) and I wish he could have provided more resources representative of those cultures. Not the best.

As long as you show up you'll be fine. We had one quiz the entire semester, and any homework only took 5 minutes to do. The hardest thing is the final paper, but 4 pages really is not that bad in the long run. Easiest music pEQ I've heard of, and playing the ukelele makes it fun. Only thing is he never answers emails

I had to take SWK as an outside of my major class and Professor Banister is amazing. She's super knowledgable and her class is very lowkey and easy. What she teaches is informative and I would recommend her class to anyone. She mostly lectures and we do presentations and some light reading.

Prof B is really nice and genuinely sweet. She loves social work and really understands it. Most of the time you had to show up and on time but she's very understanding. Like most social work classes not a single quiz but mostly presentations or forums.

Jamie is awesome! His ACS section is very discussion based, so make so you do the (extremely minimal) homework so you know what to talk about! He does a very good job at getting new students acclimated to Naz, he's easily the best ACS instructor there is!
Jamie lets the class be mostly discussion based, so be prepared to actually contribute.

Such an amazing teacher. He does not give very much homework, it is just a lot of class discussion. He is a really great person overall and just wants to see his students succeed. I would definitely recommend taking ACS with him!!!

One of the best ACS professors. We used the Enneagram book which I thought was fun to learn about yourself. He cares a lot about his students and would help with any issues, whether related to class or not. A little reading but not that much. He gave out candy each class and made a required class less boring. This class is based on participation.

Gives us candy at the beginning of every class and has even brought in pizza. Very kind and understanding, easy to talk with. Would recommend for anyone needing to take ACS. He does have a lot of class participation activities. Assignments are generally pretty easy.

Best teacher ever. He just teaches the ACS class for freshman and is the Catholic Chaplin and lambda advisor at Naz. If ou ever have any problems dont hesitate to talk to him. So caring and understanding.

Jamie Fazio teaches the freshman fall seminar ACS class. He is very kind and funny, even people who hated the class loved him. He makes students feel at home and you can always go to him to talk about anything on your mind. He is also the Catholic Chaplain and the head of Lambda (LGBTQ+ club). Really great guy!!
BEST MAN EVER

He's not an actual prof. He's the Catholic Chaplin here, but I wish he taught something! this man is spectacular - he is always willing to help you with anything he can. His enthusiasm and spirit are contagious!
nice guy, funny and easy to talk to.

Ron is actually the best! He's funny and engaging and is always trying to push students to be the best they can be. Is very good at coming up with ideas to improve your work and gives very kind and constructive feedback.
Gives great artist advice. Demonstrations are easy to follow along. Sometimes the professor will leave the room for somewhat long and inconsistent periods of time to take a walk.

Ron was one of the best Professors I have ever had. He is caring, intelligent and very descriptive in his explanations and lectures. High understanding of high art verse low art and expects You to be intelligent and dedicated. Loved his class!

Ron’s more laidback approach is a nice balance between some of the more technical art professors. Perhaps his classes are best after you’ve taken a few intro art courses. If you are passionate, and if you are competent in the arts, then you’ll get the most out of his class. I’m excited to take more classes with him in the future.
Best teacher in the WOOOOORRRRRLLLLDDDDD
He changed my views on art forever and I am extremely grateful... I hope to encounter him again...
enjoyable class.
The greatest teacher ever.
Very cool and smart and funny. Also very helpful and kind. His prints are beautiful. A great experience just to be in his class.
I took his art issues class. He is such a cool guy, I couldn't believe his name wasn't on this list.

She is knowledgeable at teaching, and a native German speaker, so overall she's good at teaching German. As long as you show up to class, and give an effort, she will go out of her way to help you increase your grade. She gives a massive of homework, but the homework is extremely easy if you show up to class, there's just a lot of it.

If you show up to class you will do well. She is very accessible and very knowledgeable. If you have a question she will go to length to try to answer it, she ensures that we all know what we are meant to be doing and what she expects from us.
Professor Deir is a great teacher, and is very understanding when it comes to accepting late work. She's very nice and will work with you to make sure you understand what is being taught.
very hard to reach outside of class. Never answers emails

I had her for my Spanish 221 lab. Not her fault, but the lab is extremely pointless. It was just working on Rosetta Stone which I can complete in my dorm room. Birgit Deir herself is a kind lady though. Never talked to her much in class because she does not teach Spanish, but always seemed very cheerful and happy to be there.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Lots of homework', 'Accessible outside class']
comment: I really loved Prof Deir. She is super understanding and kind-hearted. She offered so many opportunities for extra culture learning. She expects a lot out of you, such as many speaking-related activities that can be difficult sometimes. But, she has regular online office hours that are very helpful, and she encourages using the on-campus tutors.

Is extremely boring to listen to and is somehow pro - AI ?  Despite how much he speaks, he doesn't explain things very well.  What he says in class does not match what he posts in Moodle.  Could be nice, but I couldn't lock in enough to find out.

The first two weeks of this class was a little rough. As an art student, I'm a visual learner, so lecturing me on art principles for 2 hours is not very engaging. BUT! He definitely got better as the semester went on, shortening lectures and allowing more time for work. Overall, he's pleased by most projects and is not very strict on due dates.

I appreciated his passion for the field and desire to teach us things that the university didn't prioritize. He teaches in a way that is engaging for our age group. Lectures are long and sometimes repetitive, but the point he is trying to get across is worth it.

I personally did not vibe with James. Some people say they like him but his class was always a drag for me. He would say we were going to have mostly work time but then lecture on nothing for over half of the class. And critiques took several full 2.5 hour classes.

Getting an A is easy, just show up to class and performances on time, and know the music. He is hilarious, and engaging. He's also blunt, and will correct mistakes. Overall he is a good professor, but he is unintentionally rude at times.

SLP is so sweet, but her lectures are heavy and she over complicates the slides. You do have opportunities to do test corrections and many on the quizzes are online. This semester she dropped half of them (5). Labs and discovery work you will get good grades on, and she is very flexible and will help you make work up if missed or forgotten about!

Dr. SLP is a very caring person, but learning in her class is on your own. Her lectures seem more complex than what the actual material is. I leave class more confused than i was initially. She is great with corrections and make up work, so there is lots of room to make your grade higher. Go to her office and talk to her, she is very supportive.
Gives test corrections for the exams, but they don't help if she doesn't teach anything properly in general. Hoping I don't have to take another class with her.

Take Baker if you don't want to spend hours learning material just to receive the bare minimum of understanding. It gets tiring not having a proper formula sheet, or not having the content properly explained. I can't stress how miserable this class has made me. The practice for quizzes and exams do the bare minimum of benefiting one.

She is a nice person in general, but her teaching style is poor. Lecture doesn't show how to use equations, and leaves little time for labs. Workshop and practices are not beneficial, confusing you more because she does not explain how or why the answer is what it is. This makes it hard to enjoy physics and keep one sane. All I can say is goodluck.

She likes to talk a lot and can get sidetracked easily, but it is so clear that she wants everyone to succeed and does everything she can to make that happen. The class is grades on a lot of things, so even if you don't do well on tests you can succeed. Gives so much practice and offers extra zoom for practice problems to help everyone.

I took this during Covid restrictions. She adapted well. We had prerecorded lectures and in person lecture. Hitting the information twice made the class easy. She gave excessive amounts of optional practice with keys which made studying for exams very clear. We would also go over harder problems in class. Information was conveyed well.

Professor Bedard's class in held in person one a month, the rest of the work you need to do is sent out at the beginning of each week. For homework you answer questions from the textbook or sometimes write a discussion post. Online quizzes every one to two weeks. Final exam is online and you have about a week to submit. Overall a good class!

I love Misti, she is so patient and understanding. She is very accessible after class or via email and is always happy to help clear up any confusion. She makes class fun and a lot less scary than it seems on the syllabus.

I loveeeee misti !!! Very caring and understanding , she will go over asl signs if you dont know just ask and speak up. She corrects you in a kind way and never made me feel embarrassed. Her leture was very long , test were easy if you go to every class.

ASL 1 is a very fun class especially with Misti. If you practice in/outside of class you will succeed. She is very easy to learn from and makes the class easier. She is very kind and will easily repeat signs if you need it. She also gives good feedback to make sure you are doing the correct signing.
Very engaging and caring professor at the UofR now. Practice makes perfect, pay attention in class.

Misti is an AMAZING professor. I learned so much from her and she was so kind and relaxed. I took ASL I and II with Misti. Take a class with her if you have the chance! By its nature, you need to be present to learn ASL, so you can't skip class. However, Misti is super understanding if you need to miss class and will do anything she can to help you

Made very questionable jokes, i felt like she mocked my religion, her lectures were fast and only unimportant info was an her slides. quizzes and test questions were not like what we studied on review sheets. i would not take one of her classes again.

Dempsey made me like religion again:) She is amazingly caring and understanding of her students. She doesn't ask much of students other than participating in class discussions and doing the required assignments. The class isn't hard to pass as long as you do what you are asked to do. If you communicate an issue with her, she will help!

Dr.Corrine Dempsey was one of the best professors I've ever had. She chunks out her content into manageable sections and she structures this course in a very routine way. Every different religion has the same assignments and same structure of 2 days of notes,2 days of online assignments then a quiz. She is super fun and encouraging !
Did not like her at all, was not good at answering questions if you had them and did not give feed back. Would not take a class with her again.

She is such an amazing professor! I really love the way she teaches and find her class very interesting. Her quizzes are kind of hard, but she gives you a lot of other assignments so it does not affect your grade too much. You definitely want to study and put your time in, but she is a great person overall.
Toothe was a great professor! Very engaging professor and even though lecture heavy, kept things interesting. Recently changed her exams to mostly multiple choice exams, and some short responces.
Toothe is a great professor for art history. She is funny, interesting, friendly, relatable and makes her classes/lectures very very fun. Attendance is mandatory - as it is art history.

Professor Viggiani is a great SW professor, I really enjoyed the policy class. She did a great job bringing it to life and tying relevancy into current situations. In a class where some of the information can be difficult to take in, she does a great job with delivery. Totally recommend.
Knowledgable and personable

Pam is  a professor for all the right reasons. At times she can become wrapped up in the ideal world of policy, but overall she is honest and sees the world in its true light. She understands that you won't read if you had a paper due the night before and allows you to bring your laptop to "refresh your memory".
very helpful, down to earth, honest and clear about expectations. great at leading discussions. reasonable about schedules.

Dr. Chacon is a caring and funny person! Class itself is difficult with her, as we are assigned tons of hw that feels like busy work that we never go over in class. She's disorganized -we barely get to any of the material planned. You have to be on top of things to succeed in the class since she cold calls on people to answer questions in Spanish.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Lots of homework']
comment: Lots of homework was assigned for outside of class to go over in class. However, so much was assigned that we really never got around to going over most of it. She's very nice and is invested in her students' learning, but what we actually learned in class could have been managed better.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Lots of homework']
comment: Professor Chacon assigns a lot of homework which would be fine if it was actually covered in class. Most of the time, we don't get through even half of the assigned work so it just feels like pointless busy work. She asks you to translate readings line by line which is the worst. She is kind of intimidating even though she is probably a nice person

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Lots of homework', 'Accessible outside class']
comment: Chacon was very invested in her teaching but it wasn't straightforward. All of your assignments are online and the class feels pointless because she doesn't teach much. The lab for this class is you working online the whole time. I feel like I didn't learn much either.

She appears kind in the beginning and acts as if she cares about you and your well being but if you are going through something or need to miss class for any reason she will give you a 0 for that week. She belittles students who don't know everything about Spanish even though a computer program is teaching us. SO rude and makes no accommodations.

She doesnt really give any helpful feedback, nor is she compassionate. She doesnt give people extra accommodations even when they have learning disabilities. She doesnt like hearing feedback from her students. And she called me by my last name most of the first semester I had her.

Hilda is the only full time spanish prof, so you get stuck with her, she uses popsicle sticks to call on ppl so you have to pay attention, the tests are actually kinda hard especially considering we don't really learn anything. If you ask her for clarification she's extremely bad at explaining in different words... super sweet lady tho.

Kind lady who actually cares about her students' health and wellbeing. Class is very grammar heavy, so be prepared. Wish Portales 2 was not so expensive but all the homework is on it :( I thought I wanted to minor in Spanish but I decided not to after this class. Your grammar has to be spot on to do well.

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: I went into Naz as a Spanish major but quickly realized that I could not stand prof Chacon. She is so standoffish and not personable at all. She was initially so rude to us in class and in emails and thinks that just because she is busy means we are not. I really thought about transferring bc of her, but just ended up switching departments.

Is not humble at all, and thus likes to remind you of how smart she is all of the time. This makes it very hard to learn from her as she does not seem to care about you, and she loves to take jobs at everything, a byproduct of her background in journalism. Thinks she is fighting a holy mission and exposing the system when she is just a professor

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Tough grader']
comment: She assigns a ton of readings in every class. She is a really harsh grader on everything and has very high standards. Classes tend to be very repetitive. She has rules for everything all listed in her 20-page syllabus. She also can be really passive-aggressive and unprofessional. But she thinks very highly of herself and makes that well known.

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Beware of pop quizzes']
comment: I have known Dr. Chacon for most of my time at Nazareth. I thought that she was an amazing professor until it was time for me to take my senior comp class. She assigns readings on top of writing the Comp essay. She also canceled class multiple times throughout the semester (atleast 3 weeks worth)

Very unclear criteria in general. The syllabus constantly changes and isnt always available. She is disorganized & unclear but expects students to understand, which is frustrating. She tests on things not covered in class. However, she is kind and respectful and cares for her students. Lovely person, not an effective teacher. I was stressed.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Beware of pop quizzes', 'Tough grader']
comment: She is by far the most hypocritical professor I have had in my undergraduate career. She personally attacks students on their work and participation, which is always unprovoked. She does not take responsibility for her actions when she tells us to be responsible for our own. I did not receive a syllabus until the end of week 4 of this class. Awful

Dr. Chacon is one of the kindest people I know and cares about her students so deeply. At first, I found her a bit intimidating but quickly realized she has a heart of gold. There is a lot of work assigned but, it is doable and will really help with your Spanish. Just avoid putting all of the work off until the last minute

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Participation matters']
comment: I will never take a class with her again. She assigns too much homework and in class we do not have time to cover all, even when asked to lessen it she wont. She is a harsh grader and wants things to be in-line with her own beliefs. Reading comprehension quiz everyday that is pass or fail with no comments. She is harsh, combative, and doesnt care.

I had SPN102 and SPN221 with her. Got an A in 102, F in 221. My suggestion is: If you are taking this for your foreign language req. (and you need a sequence of two), take a sequence that is within the same level. i.e. SPN101/SPN102 OR SPN221/SPN222. This class will take up a lot of your outside time, especially if you are non-native speaker.

She is very knowledgable in the subject, but she explains everything in Spanish. She can be rude at times and expects more from you even if you aren't very good at Spanish. Quizzes and tests are hard if you don't study, and the Aventuras homework is the most annoying thing ever. Don't take it with her unless you know what you're doing. Even for 101
She's likes things her way or no way. Her syllabus does not provide a clear representation of the course. No note taking just lecturing. You do the same exact thing each day, nothing changes.

Many group projects in this class. Participation is a must! She makes an extreme effort to help everyone and does not make you feel stupid if you are wrong! So don't be nervous about talking in class.

She truly cares about her students, makes herself available and is a very easy-going professor. Completing homework is crucial to succeeding in this class, especially studying the vocabulary. She offers extra credit a few times per semester, usually for attending a Spanish club event. 10/10 recommend. Possibly the easiest SPN 102 of them all.

HARD!! Quizzes impossible. Midterm Easy. Class time feels pointless. She's a nice teacher don't get me wrong she absolutely loves her students and actually cares which is nice. She is tough grader though and within my class we had 4 kids drop out.

Dr. Chacon is a wonderful person, an extremely intelligent woman and an amazing professor. She loves her job, she cares about her students and she motivates  them with super interesting lessons. On top of this, I love her sense of humor. She is definitely my role model as a woman as well as a professor. In short: Dr. Chacón es la reina de los prof!
STUDY! The quizzes are impossible to pass if you don't.

Dr. Hilda Chacon was an astonishing example of professor. She would help you if you need. She would always joke around in class but never pass the limit. She presents extremely interesting topics and students are required to work with books as well as with videos, songs, documentaries, pictures and if lucky, even live performances.
She is amazing because she does her job with passion, as a result classes are fun and you learn the language! She is very clear when she explains things.
She will do anything for her students and always has your back. I was really scared to take her class at first because she is difficult but I learned a lot of valuable things.
Dr. Chacon is an amazing professor. She's so nice, and really cares about her students. She is also really helpful if you talk to her. I always had a lot of fun in her class, and learned a lot.

She is one of the best teachers I have ever had. She cares about her students and challenges their ideals. Not because she hates america guys! but because she wants to put things into perspective. Get you to think really think about WHY? you think the way you think. She can be tough and if she likes you she is even worse. Expecting the best from u.
disorganized.

I personally love Dr. Chacon. I think she is extremely intelligent and has a lot of good things to say. Her class is tought, if you don't know spanish! If you are in a spanish course, you should know enought spanish to be able to understand a conversation. I love her!
No Comments

I had this professor a few years ago.  She's AMAZING!  To those of you that hate her and call her evil, why don't you start thinking instead of just digesting what the American media teaches you.  She doesn't hate the United States, she just knows the value of CRITICAL THINKING, something you should do if you plan to attend grad school.
as a professor, very strict and very hard. but she is always willing to help you. as a woman, one of the nicest, kindest, most compassionate and loving people i have ever met in my life.

In class we do practice problems on the board, nothing major. Homework occasionally and 3 test

Very helpful during office hours. His accent is strong but you grow to understand and adapt to it. He gives a week to do homework which is great. Clear grading expectations in the syallbus as well. He does pass back work but he dont calculate grades in moodle, I suggest using an online converter. If you dont understand just go see him, it helps.

He is a great person, his accent isn't that bad and he uses excel to teach math. Excel is a big ugh but being a business type major, it helps me greatly to learn for the future. I am also not a big math person so this is helpful. He lets you bring in math notes for quizzes and theyre just like the homework.

The professor has an accent, but other than that, he's a thrill to learn from. His class is straight-forward. As long as you do the homework and pay attention to his lectures, it is a breeze. It helps that the professor is also humorous and takes everything in great stride.

Seriously such a solid professor. I've never enjoyed math or the process of learning anything in the STEM fields really, but this class was genuinely fun and very painless. Daniel is a wildly interesting person and he adds great content to the class. Anyone who bashes his accent is being blatantly racist and ethnocentric. I recommend this class.

Extremely easy class, uses Excel to solve real world math problems. It's true that he has a heavy accent, but you get used to it quickly. Great professor overall, will take the time to learn your name even if you don't talk much. Just do the homework on time and it's an easy A!

has a very heavy accent, you get used to it but its very hard to understand. He also doesn't grade his own homework. His tests are difficult because the questions are nothing like you do in class. But if you practice on your own and keep practicing you will be ok. IF YOU DONT GET ABOVE A 50 ON THE FINAL YOU FAIL THE CLASS*****
Great professor, cares about his students success!!!!!!!! Class is useful and not very difficult if you do the homework and go to class.

Easier than my 10th grade geometry class. He uses Excel to teach the lessons and teaches you how to solve the problems using Excel... love that to be able to put "efficient in Excel" on my resume! Homework is so easy, common for him to give you 1.5 weeks for a 6 question homework. The subjects are easy, but relate-able to life.

He is an amazing professor. He is NOT HARD TO UNDERSTAND!! Accent is totally fine and he is fun - he really helped me when I opened up to him about some learning disabilities I have and did EVERYTHING he could to help:) I would jump at the chance to take his class again!!!
Terrible. The final was impossible, don't let him trick you that "the final will bring your grade up."it is cumulative and you MUST get a 50 or you automatically fail. And many do fail.

Terrible accent, very confusing. Teaches by book. Luckily, the book is amazing. Three tests worth the bulk of your grade. Must get a 50% on final or you automatically fail. Lame. I recommend you choose someone else, but it's not like you have a choice..

He's funny and definitely knows calculus, however, when it comes to teaching it he wasn't the best for our class. He moves fast and assumes you know it.  Even if you do, once you get to the homework, questions are not like what's done in class and you'll have to figure it out on your own. But use homework to study and the tests are very similar!

He is funny, brilliant and a great guy, however, he is not a great teacher. He is easily distracted and only does problems directly from the book.  Calc III is a tough course anywhere but I recommend taking the course with a different teacher if possible.

He is a wonderful man. Heavy accent but not hard to understand after the 1st class. He noticed I was struggling and offered help and then personally walked me to the tutoring center and set me up with someone he  knew who could help me. He is a fun guy who tells stories and plays music videos. He is a fair grader. If you need a math class take his.
I felt like I taught this class to myself. It is not very difficult if you do the reading. But his accent is very strong and he is very hard to understand.
He is really smart and funas a teacher, but I have a lot of trouble understanding his accent.

Easier to understand after the first few classes, extremely nice and has a great sense of humor... makes references to his friend Yoda and plays music videos.  Class is quite easy except for the 20 page final paper.  Knows his students' names, even if you don't talk much!
A god among men.  Should be working at NASA.  Definitely the funniest teacher ever and his classes are super easy and informative.
It was the most frustrating and hard to understand class I have ever taken at Nazareth and I am a senior. I felt like the expectations/grading was not at all clear.

At first, he was difficult to understand but he worked on his pronunciation if we did not understand him.  Overall, he is willing to help any student if they have trouble undrstanding the info of the course.

Dr. Birmajer is really funny and interesting, but he grades difficulty and expects students to really like and understand math. If you're expecting an A, don't take class with him.. but if you want an interesting class with an engaging professor, it will be worth it.
Awesome class
He is very funny. Makes the class enjoyable.

he is very hard to understand because of his accent, and he does not explain things well.  the highest grade he ever gives on anything is a C because he thinks C is good and B and A are far above average.  I would not reccommend taking a class with him at all.

he doesn't believe in giving out A's. C is the usual grade he gives out to his students. i had to fight to get a B, when i know i deserved an A. if you are stuck with him, GO TO HIM FOR HELP. I had meetings with him about papers and other assignments and i got better grades because he wants you to show interest.
SUCH a hard grader, WOW, he never gives A's, it's kind of upsetting.  The math part of the class is pretty easy but he is way too picky on the papers
Daniel's a good teacher. Sometimes, though, you need to have him repeat things. He seems willing enough sometimes to help, but I've also heard that he isn't so nice sometimes.
I took thinking mathematically with him. He was wonderful and really challenged us to, well, think mathematically.
Strong accent, but a very strong teacher.  Only prof to teach Calc 2
No Comments
awesome teacher.his accent is still strong but he makes the material easy to understand once you understand him.best math teacher i hav ever had

Funny man who needs to get a little better with his English.

Nicknamed "Packet Paul" because he is old school, hands out a lot of papers/packets. Somewhat tough/nitpicky grades but he has been in photography for a LONG TIME and know what he is talking about. Goes the extra mile to help students who may be struggling in film photography.

Lectures are very boring, you should take a few notes but he'll give you test reviews with all the important info before each test (3 total). Tests are a little tricky if you don't study, it's really just a lot of memorization. He's really nice, not tech savvy, doesn't really answer emails, but you can tell he cares about the subject.
nice guy can be kinda boring if you ask he'll let you leave class and he's understanding about problems. try to take a class he likes and it'll be more interesting i.e. photography

Paul as a person, he is a great and caring human being. But you have to sit and listen to him throughout the whole class. if you are not good at taking notes, you will fail his tests. Assignments are easy, but they aren't heavy on your grade, he weights the test grade.
Paul is an amazing person don't get me wrong, however, this class is like one giant study hall. Very very test heavy and little room for wiggle room. All and all, id recommend taking a different peq.

I had Paul for two of my classes, and hes my favorite professor Ive had! Hes such a funny guy, and cares about all of his students. Lectures arent boring if youre actually interested and engage in them, and he gives little to no homework. Three big tests, study for them and youll be fine! I hope to have Paul again in the future.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Test heavy', 'Lecture heavy']
comment: This class has no homework besides a short research presentation. There are three unit tests all semester but no cumulative midterm or final exam. Tests are weighed very heavily on the final grade, but if you study they're easy. Although some lectures got a little boring, Paul is a great guy with a lot of knowledge and passion for photography.

By far the easiest class I took this semester. Lectures are not as boring as people say, he kept my attention, due to the love he has for the material. We rarely had homework besides a presentation and taking a few photos. Otherwise, we only had 3 tests, and our final was our last unit test, not cumulative. Best choice for PEQ art class!

Paul is such a nice guy. He's a bit of a mess, but I didn't mind. His lectures are super interesting and the tests really aren't hard, but you do need to study. I thought that this class was really interesting and he's a great professor!

The class is an hour and fifteen minutes of lecture. He does give good detail during the lecture. He tends to go on tangents but they are funny. The class isn't hard at all if you do the work and study for the three tests and the final. Tests consist of 15 pictures that you have to write three things about and then some multiple choice questions

The class is very boring and it's going to be difficult to pay attention to the lectures since that's all the class is. He tends to go on tangents a lot and isn't very organized. But the class isn't hard if you do the work and study for the few tests. He's a super nice guy that clearly cares about his students and knows a lot about the content.
Best Class I took this semester. Not too difficult, only 3 tests and a final, but I only studied about an hour for each and got an A in the class
Paul is seriously the best and I would highly recommend taking his photography as activism course for your visual arts PEQ. Not only is it an easy A, but it's pretty interesting!! Paul is awesome!

Paul is fantastic. I absolutely loved his class. His lectures are great and he goes into great detail on everything. He was always able to keep my attention and I found the subject material very interesting. Luckily no reading material and the tests and assignments were super easy. I would definitely take another course with Paul!!

Paul is a pretty cool guy. He is very knowledgable about photography as well. His class, however, can and will get very boring, and you will end up texting or listening to your ipod the whole time. His tests are just memorization so not too bad. Have fun!

Paul is a great professor. His classes are really laid-back and he gives you plenty of artistic freedom to try a lot of different things. As a photo student, i learned quite a lot from him. If you've never tried photography, i highly recommend taking a class with him.

Do NOT take this class. Painful boring lectures ALL class--in the dark. He is off in his own little world anddoesn't even notice or care what the students are doing (sleeping). Drone Drone Drone. He knows better because he apologizes for being boring. Tests don’t come back forever. I hear he is a good Photo teacher but he shouldn't teach P1s.
One of the nicest professors I've had. Dry in his lectures but he knows it. Amazingly helpful and relentless in his efforts. Open minded
i miss paul

Very nice, helpful, understanding.  Would always go out of his way to help, seemed to put in more hours at Naz than any other professor I know! Always made sure photochemicals were fresh even on weekends.  Gave good, thorough feedback for critiques- Great Teacher!!
Excellent teacher! I really understand photography now thanks to Paul! He's the best art teacher I've had at Nazareth!

Honestly she's crazy but I enjoy the class discussions she facilitates. Definitely go to class, and definitely KNOW WHAT YOURE TALKING ABOUT. She will learn your name and call on you randomly during class.
Genuinely the most confusing professor I have ever known. I did not learn a single thing in her class.

Dr. Maher is one of my favorite professors. Her class is very interesting, and if you read the text book and answer the questions, you will have a good foundation of the coursework. There are community service events and naz events you need to attend, but this all includes aspects of public health! This class is a great introduction course!!!

INTRO TO POP HEALTH - first year nursing class. 

so easy do not worry at all. easy note taking assignments, one essay, a midterm and final. You can use cheatsheets for tests so write down definitions and her exact words from slides!
The class was generally easy however the mid term and final were completely different from what was said to be on it which was frusterating.

Almost all of what you need to know is from the textbook and the classwork that is done in class, when she isn't talking, does not yield anything new. So much reading, toughest grader Ive ever seen. Hardest finals and midterms. Would never recommend.

Dr. Maher is amazing and pretty much has built the Public Health Department from the ground up. You will learn a lot from her. She is incredible but YOU WILL NOT PASS IF YOU DO NOT READ THE TEXTBOOK. Her lectures are somewhat all over the board but she is an intensely busy woman. one of my favorite profs
Dr. Maher is hands down one of the best professors at Naz. She is not easy, but she is brilliant!

If you're not interested in maternity, this course will be hard and a ton of work (several hours of busy work every week). Quizzes are nearly impossible. Her maternity course is very difficult because she just expects you to know all of the material prior to her teaching it. She is a nice woman, and willing to help you if need be. I suggest you rely on yourself for learning the material and not her class time. However her Intro to Trans-cultural Nsg class is easy and fun.
She is all over the place. But if you look back you truly learned a lot from her. I didnt realize how much I learned until i look the NSG 337 HESI. One of the BEST Nursing teachers at Nazareth.

She shows favoritism, you never learn anything from her class because she tends to go all over the place with her lectures. Also, she lies about her actions. Shame on her for ruining others lives, she shows no compassion.
Best Teacher EVER

comment: Stein is a chill guy. He gives many papers, but they are pretty straightforward. He goes off on tangents, and doesn't allow technology in his class. Get yourself a hobby that isn't phone/tech and your set. Do the explorations and show up to class and you will get an A
Great professor. Makes class interesting by using real-world cases and having you connect your own experiences to what you're learning. Overall easy, but participation and attendance matter.
Very knowledgeable professor but the most boring hour and 20 minutes everytime you step into class. Doesn't let you use laptops. Very nice person but the most gruesome class to sit through

He is a great guy, he makes learning about management subjects easy. For this class, there are two papers due each week in the beginning but after awhile it's just one. This was an online class for me because of COVID but it was still great, he put us into teams to discuss our papers and that was it. Only gave him a 2 because of how many papers.

Professor Stein is an extremely intelligent guy who really loves what he does. I took Management Ethics with him. There was a lot of group discussion, but all assignments are individual, no tests just papers. Sometimes he would ramble which would get boring after a while. Roy grades with a strict eye on formal papers, but is very reasonable.
Roy is a really good teacher,really nice person

Definitely one of my favorite teachers at Nazareth! He kept the content interesting and interactive, letting students discuss material in each class. I learned about information that is relevant and useful in the world and I really enjoyed taking this class. I would highly recommend this teacher and class!
Dr. Stein is a fantastic teacher who enjoys talking with each of his students. He's great at answering questions and is a very interesting person.
Roy Stein ROCKS!!!

mr stein is awesome.  no textbook anymore.  this class gave me some interest in being a lawyer and i had my mind set on opening a business as soon as possible after college.  one of my favorite teachers.
Thought I was gonna hate his class after the first day of listening to him....after a while, found out he was a really cool guy, and a really fair and informative teacher.  Good prof.
by far the best teacher at naz.  a great advisor to.
Roy is the greatest. He has a great mind, and has really prepared for this class. He's also an interesting individual, and fun as well.

Digital illustration involved fun assignments like creating posters for music artists and movies, as well as practical graphic design tasks. David checks in at the beginning and end of class, and wants to see progress. Very caring and accepting of all art styles.

David is a super cool guy, and his artwork is amazing. In his class I didn't feel judged for my skill level and he was open to many different styles of illustration and appreciated them all. He would come around to check on our projects every class and even if we were doing something else he would still ask questions about it because he cared.

comment: My class was once a week so you absolutely had to go. His assignments are all ones he's had from clients. Plenty of time to finish work. However I wish he didn't allow extra work time on the day the assignment is due because students who met the deadline had to wait for everyone else. Great prof, artist, person. Would have again.
Enjoyed the class throughly and the assignments too! If you aren't into Illustration, the class may be troubling to understand the assignments.
Great professor, gets to know all of her students!
Genuinely one of the worst people I've ever met. Super condescending. Glad he's leaving.

Professor Bons is the type of professor that calls her students "friends." It was overall an easy class, just super boring as I had already learned all of the stuff. Due dates are odd, like at 12 noon, so beware to make sure you don't miss deadlines. You basically just have to do a reading reflection and a podcast as your homeworks for the semester

Professor Wiltse was a great person, but his class was super discussion heavy and most of the time it was only him talking. Probably the most reading I've done for any class ever. After the readings, you are expected to write a 20 min reflection on your opinions on the story. Very tedious but honestly not that hard.

Taking this class was the worst way to start out my college experience. Wiltse is very discussion heavy, and expects the class to know everything. There were some topics he had us discuss which made everyone very uncomfortable. He also accused me of plagiarizing my final paper (I did not btw). TONS AND TONS OF READINGGGG!!!!!

professor wiltse is genuinely the best professor i have ever had. I feel honored that i was able to take his class. he is such a caring man that truly wants all of his students to do well. I am considering taking another course with him not even for credit but just to be in his welcoming presence. id encourage anyone to take a class with wiltse

Ed is an extremely caring professor and prioritizes his students. He makes sure when we discuss short stories with triggering topics, other assignments are available to do instead. He looks to have participation in class, but the conversation is always interesting.

Dr. Wiltse is probably one of the best English teachers I've had thus far. He is very understanding of everyone and fosters a healthy and caring classroom environment. The only thing I will mention is that there is a lot of reading that must be done (sometimes 100 pages a week!), but the readings allow for important class discussions.

Ed is easily the best instructor I've had for an English course because he is very welcoming and genuinely cares about how each student is doing both in and out of his class. For the research papers, you can choose literally any topic you want which makes the class much more bearable. Read and participate. I can't recommend Ed enough!

Dr. Wiltse is awesome! This class unfortunately isnt meeting at Groveland because of covid, but hes done an incredible job of creating a meaningful class anyways. The books are so good and really relevant. Hes so understanding of the stress everyone is experiencing right now and his assignments reflect that. Really just a great guy all around.

Ed is a great professor and a great person. He makes his lessons simple and personable. The short story into film class is really enjoyable and very easy. I recommend taking this class and I recommend Ed as a professor.

I love Ed. He's very sweet & will talk about any sensitive subject. He makes his classroom an open space for anyone to talk to & picks good books. In my class, there were only 6 of us bc of COVID but he made the best of it. Response paper every week, not bad, & journal. Highly recommended to take this class. You can go to the jail as well& read.

I loved Ed as a teacher. He's dorky when it comes to his presentation and jokes and keeps the class pretty entertaining. He takes whatever we had to read for hw and discusses it in the whole next class which I really like because then I can get a better understanding of the passage. He's very understanding and has a positive vibe to him overall.
Love him, he's a great professor and really helped me through out the semester. Easy class and totally understanding of things.
Wiltse is really nice teacher. He cares a lot about the students who got a hard time on his class. All the stories are fun, and exam is not hard.

Worst English Professor I have ever had at Nazareth. This class is the English Senior Seminar and it is awful with him. Too much reading, too much work, horrible and long lectures, and just the same old thing class after class. Very boring and not a very nice professor when it comes down to actually having a class discussion. It's his way only.

Professor Wiltse is a fantastic teacher. The text and material he chose to cover was really interesting and kept the whole class attentive all semester. He's hilarious and makes the lectures fun and interesting. He's super helpful and always there to chat or help out on a paper. Great guy and I will definitely take another class with him.

This course has a lot of reading, but don't let that scare you away.  Wiltse really cares for people and his students, always making you think.  You will be a different person after this course, especially if you take the opportunity and do the jail project.  It is definitely worth the work!  Good luck :)

I'm a science major and I still loved Wiltse... extremely funny and very interested in his students.  Very helpful when it comes to preparing for a presentation or writing an essay and is always willing to meet with his students for one-on-one advice! Very fair grader.  Going to class is mandatory since class consists of groups discussions.

I love this class! Professor Wiltse is awesome and he's convincing me to become a English Literature major because I'm a lit junky. The class, Short Story and Film, is awesome for a Freshman Seminar. I thoroughly recommend this class and this professor! He's a really nice guy and always wants to b helpful with any problem a student might bring 2him

I took detective fiction with him and this guy is great! He comes across as a nerdy at first but loves talking about the reading and likes getting to know his students. He doesn't require that you participate in class, but its awkward if you don't do the reading. I would recommend that everyone do the jail project too, it was a good experience.

Ed Wiltse is the man! Nicest guy, so helpful, cares about what he is doing, and brings his A game to every class. Short Story was really interesting and I enjoyed the readings. He's really open to helping you outside of class on your papers. Great guy, great professor.
I really liked the books we read in this class. If you don't participate in the discussion you will be very bored. Also, make sure you keep up with your journal!

Great =] I hate English and novels and what not but he made it fun and interesting. He is so helpful, and his jail project was awesome! I would take another class with this professor in a heartbeat if it had anything to do with my major!

Absolutely horrible. I learned nothing in his class. He never taught us anything and then he graded us as if he assumed we knew the material. I payed money to be graded unfairly in a class I learned nothing in.
Amazing professor, very enthusiastic, very intelligent, very helpful. Loved this class and our conversations outside of class. He is absolutely available to help who ever wants his help. Love him!

Very enthusiastic in what he does, does not always clarify expectations, very critical with presentations and asks many questions, hyper active but always willing to help, enjoys class dicussions and debating, overall not a bad guy
He was such a great freshman seminar prof!  He really cared about the students and reall tried to make everyone feel welcome at Naz and in Rochester.  He'll even give you some cool, free music!

Sometimes Freshman Seminar with Dr. Wiltse seemed too much like another English class, but it was totally worth it.  He was sooo enthusiastic about EVERYTHING.  And he always was making sure that you were ok...the perfect trait for Freshman Seminar.

crime and detective fiction is awesome.  i liked most of the books we read.  only 2 tests and they are open notebook.  do the jail project.  it is really fun and isnt that much work at all.  definitely better than writing a paper.

Wha said he doesn't give out A's? This man genuinely cares about your improvement as a writer as well as what you have to say. He is open to new opinions but knows his facts so it might feel like he is shooting you down. I will always remember his classes.

such a sincere and genuine person!! so incredibly smart but not arrogant at all. he really cares about you as an individual. his discussions are really interesting, so you dont have to force yourself to get involved.

This was by far the best course I've ever taken in my life, and that is really saying something.  Dr. Wiltse is an intelligent, compassionate man and he is a remarkable teacher.  There should be more professors out there like him! (Naz kids...if you take this class DO the jail project!)

He's a good man. Very interesting and open. One of the best english professors that is available. Showed interest in everything I had ever written and is willing to put a lot of extra time in with students.
I love this class, but I think the man needs a new walk, or a new bag...yea, I think he should try a backpack and shuffle his feet instead of the goofy hallway trot.

I took Mystery Fiction with him. A great professor. Expects a lot, but if you do your work, you'll be fine. Unlike some other comment, I did not think he showed favorites at all. Very interesting class and very open to other opinions.
A great course taught by a mediocre teacher. He's very opinionated and a hard grader, however the content was interesting. It was worth taking the course.
The Jail Project is awesome.  Do it!
I got an A in 101, and have 2 A-s so far this sem. And your 1 ratings are way too harsh. Give the guy a break!

Loved this class!

slightly arrogant. Self indulgent. sort of clowny.
great class
I agree with the other statements, he can be two-faced, and definetely prefers some people to others.  Though I think he is a good teacher, I don't like him very much.

comment: I had Dr. Donahue for PTU101, she is a great person but not a good professor. Everything is learned online from videos and she talks a lot in class about stuff that isn't helpful at all. Dr. D is so sweet! Loved this class - great overview of PT profession. Weekly discussions due, and either lecture or panels during class. You do have to do kind of a lot of observations, though, so plan those early. Can't wait to have her for future PTR classes, hopefully! Do the work, and show that you care and you'll do great!
Billinson is a wonderful professor and all around great person!!
Live Love Jennifer Billinson
Easily became someone i really look up to, awesome lady with a great music taste. everyone needs to meet her.

Dr. Billinson is great! Her class is only lectures with conversations. She keeps them super interesting and keeps up with the times. There is never any homework and her tests are open note as well. As long as you pay attention and participate you will be fine.
Dr. Billinson is great. She is very up to date on trends and incorporates these into the lessons. Incredibly easy class. No homework ever. All tests are online and open note. Highly recommend.

This man is the reason I had to take a leave of absence. Instructions on assignments were vague, and when you tried to get clarification, he was equally ambiguous. One of the greatest professors. Classes are discussion based, if you've done the work, it's easy. He will go above and beyond for you, even when you don't have him.  Access to him is not be the easiest, but he owns it. He also owns that he is not tech savvy. If you actually want to learn something and have constructive conversations, he's the one.

Professor Bobadilla is very passionate about social work and teaching. I wanted to give up on my masters degree in social work, until I took a class he taught. He really cares about the learning,  he cares about the students and he shares his real life experiences working in Social Work. I wish he taught more classes!!!

An important class and having Dr. B made all the difference. It was taught over the summer and was condensed into 6 weeks so there was a lot to cover quickly. He broke it down so it was understandable & took student feedback into consideration. He has a lot of experience and shares experience to connect to diagnoses. Learned so much in this class.

Dr. Bobadilla is extremely caring. He takes the time to go out of his way to know his students and support them throughout their class experience. He advocates for students and encourages class discussions to amplify marginalized community voices. He is very understanding and wants his students to succeed. Great class, would take him again.

Guarantee an A but will be confused, lost during every class. Gave 100 on everything even if submitted late &only had a total of 5 things in the gradebook.Disorganized, NEVER answered emails. Easy A but hated going to 4hour lecture, classes VERY discussion heavy but he would call them "superficial". Had to read novel then discuss in front of class.
He cares about his students and will work with you to get better grades and re do assignments

Dr. Rup is such a sweet professor. He provides many study materials to make sure you succeed in his class. While the course is difficult and full of content, he does his best to break it down and answer everyone's questions.

HE IS THE BEST! He really is the nicest guy and wants everyone to do their best. He understands that this is a hard course, so he gives Kahoots before exams, holds review sessions and gives you a study guide. His exams are mostly multiple choice with some fill in the blanks and short answers at the end. He does take a while to grade the tests tho.

Dr. Rup is a very nice guy. The class is difficult and content-heavy, but that's to be expected. He's very approachable if you have a concern or a question. I would recommend. He does take a LONG time to grade tests though, which are the majority of your grade.

This course was a graded on a combination of participation in classwork, exams (including a cumulative final), papers, and a presentation, which I found to be helpful as doing poorly in one area did not completely ruin your grade. Dr. Rup is very knowledgeable and it is clear that he cares about the success of his students. Would recommend!
Dear fellow students, I can only recommend Octavio Vazquez! He is the most inspirational and most brilliant professor I've ever had. You can learn a lot from him!

*NOT ONLINE* Dr. Vazquez is a fantastic professor. He's extremely funny, an absolute genius, and a blast to talk to both in terms of academics and casual conversation. This is my first class with Dr. Gutheil as a second semester senior and I am honestly sad it is my last. Cognition with him is super interesting, engaging, and he really helps you connect the material to real life examples. Has great humor, keeps the course engaging. Makes a great effort for all students to feel comfortable and safe in his class.

Good prof for infancy - you can tell he knows his stuff. Textbook required but I didn't use it, lol. Group project was confusing but office hours helped. My main issue is that he talks about controversial stuff (politics, social issues) and I don't have the same views as him, which made me feel unsafe at times. Wouldn't take again for this reason.

Gutheil is the best professor I have had at Naz. Even though attendance isn't mandatory, his humor and the way he presents the material make me want to attend every lecture. There are bi-weekly quizzes that are open note and online, and weekly discussion forums. Quizzes are fair and all information is in the lecture ppt.

Dr. Gutheil is an excellent professor, he gives a lot of notes, but they are all super helpful. He provides examples of concepts we discuss in class that are relevant/easy to understand. He also encourages students to ask questions + add to the discussion. Coursework was very light, + only consisted of 2 papers, discussion forums + online quizzes.

I love professor Gutheil, he is my favorite professor at Nazareth. He is funny, kind, and engaging. He is not an easy professor, but is fair and open to discussing grades. I had an amazing semester with him and would want to have every class with him

Genuine professor and makes you smile / laugh. He is understanding and will do anything he can to help you out. He does make you work for it but it is becuase he wants you to be prepared for 202, and harder PSY classes. Printing PPT. slides before class and just adding his side notes, and then going back and putting it together is the best way.

I love this man. he makes lectures interesting and doesn't care abut explaining something over and over again until you understand - he really does care about students and only want to see them succeed. concepts and exams can be tricky sometimes, but he is always available and willing to help. I would take any and every class with him

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Lecture heavy', 'Tough grader']
comment: I am generally an above average student but this guy is still tough. He asks between 8-10 short answer questions and they're always about something specific that he DOESN'T put in his lecture notes. He is a good professor in terms of caring about what he teaches and he's funny and relatable whatever but it's not worth it.

Gutheil gets a bad wrap for his tests, but they are 100% doable! Take good, detailed notes, go to class, & STUDY- read the book (he will drop hints of what you need to read during lecture).. You're practically guaranteed an A on his exams if YOU EARN IT! He is a tough grader for essays, but the exams aren't as bad as people make them out to be!

Love this guy. Enthusiastic about what he teaches and makes you ask questions. He has solid power points and lectures but READ THE BOOK. It's super tedious but really helpful for the exams. Kind of a picky grader on Case Study Papers but gives rubrics for everything.

I found this course to be very interesting and definitely my favorite class of the semester. Though attendance is not mandatory, it's important to be there and listen to the lectures while taking your own notes. There are 2 quizzes that prepare you well for the test. The final is not cumulative and he is very passionate about the material

I would say he is slightly above average as a teacher. He is very passionate and definitely  loves to teach about psychology. The only complaint I have is that for me his tests were impossible, he will give you a false confidence like he prepared you well, but he didn't. Studied a ton for the tests and still never got higher than  a B-

I've had Dr. Gutheil for multiple classes. He is very passionate about teaching and is willing to help his students. He presents lively lectures that will definitely make you laugh. If you have a question, he is more than willing to answer clearly. He gave no tests for this course, but gave about 7 straightforward quizzes. Would highly recommend!

Best professor I've ever had. I failed Stats in high school, and he helped me through a really long semester retaking it. He truly cares about his students and really gets excited when they succeed. I'm taking 2 classes with him right now, and I actually want to listen in class every day! He's a great person and an even better professor!

He is so freakin' funny & makes class so interesting! Take all the notes in class, you will need them for the exam. Usually he tells you what notes from the ppts would make good short answer/essay questions on the exams. You gotta read the textbook to be well prepared for the exams. Not an easy class-do the reading!

Gutheil is fantastic.  I learned so much from him in a subject that I otherwise would've been completely hopeless at.  He is absolutely hysterical, and still makes himself perfectly clear.  His tests are hard, but fair.  Definitely take a class with him if you can!  Fun fact - he has a lazy eye that switches when he takes off his glasses!

This class was ok. If you can take it elsewhere I would recommend it. The tests were unreasonable and overall I think that ruined my experience. There is no reason that the material needed to be tested that way and it seemed like he made the tests difficult because of spite.

Gutheil is a fantastic teacher.  He's fun, interesting and highly intelligent, yet is still very approachable and helpful.His tests are extremely fair, there are never any major surprises.  Also attendance is not required, although I went to every one because he made them so interesting.
Really good professor. He is funny and his class is really easy. Not a lot of homework and he only gives a few tests. I loved his class!

This professor is the best! He funny, intellectual and is NOT afraid to hold back. The material is easy, but because there is a lot of it, the tests are generally difficult. As long as you go to class and study you'll do just fine.

My absolute favorite psychology professor at Nazareth! I took 3-4 classes with this professor and loved them all. He explains difficult material clearly and raises interest in the content. I would highly recommend Dr. Gutheil for any PSY class - ESPECIALLY stats! He helped make stats MAKE SENSE!

While the material isn't hard and he basically tells you all you need to know in the powerpoints, his tests are unreasonable. I'm a 4.0 student who struggled through this class bcs. of his tests.

Dr. Gutheil was one of the worst teachers I have ever had. His tests were extremely unreasonable. His grading was totally unfair. He made NO effort to learn his students names.
