Great professor and great class! You definitely learn a lot in each lecture!
I love him! He's one of the most interesting and entertaining professors I've had. He knows how to make things funny and but yet still communicate the material very well. I highly recommend him.
Funny guy, pretty structured with powerpoints, explains things well and enthusiastically, material isn't bad, just have to do well on tests.

awesome guy.  can be confusing at times, a little scatter brained but he makes the class interesting.  He is extremely nice and always asks stops to make sure nobody has any questions unanswered during lecture.  DEFINITELY TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN
I absolutely loved this class. It was always so exciting and interesting. He is a pretty fun teacher too. Not much homework. Tests are easy if you go to class.. everything is in the powerpoints.
hmmmmm
very good teacher! He makes stats interesting by providing a lot of real life examples in class. The material is presented in a clear way and he is always willing to help students.
my all time favorite psy professor at naz. makes material very clear.
I think he's an awesome teacher. He is always available to help and amazingly make topics like statistics bearable. :-) His real life examples make understanding class concepts easier.
I think he's an awesome teacher. He is always available to help and amazingly make topics like statistics bearable. :-) His real life examples make understanding class concepts easier.
EXCELLENT professor - peaks interest and definately knows how to keep you motivated.  Sincere and wants to see his class succeed.  Would take him for any class.

Laurie Keough started out with my respect for her on the floor, so it was hard to come back from that. comment: She's definitely a sweet person and wants us to do well, but she's so overwhelmed with the rest of her work that she doesn't have time to be a teacher. She really shouldn't teach and they should hire an adjunct to fill her position.

Quinn is such a great guy! He is there to help every single one of his students and let them enjoy art while still learning a lot.  Please let him teach more classes, Naz!

Don't take him for granted. He's too precious for that nonsense. Pretty straight forward with what he's looking for in projects. LOTS of artistic freedom. Awesome class for both majors and non majors.
Absolutely love this teacher. Great man and teacher, he looks out for and cares for all of his students and always aims to help everyone succeed. Probably the reason I didn't transfer from Naz.

Quinn is probably on my favorite professors so far at Naz. He is very talented,down to earth, doesn't discourage your ideas,focuses on the positives in art instead of the negatives, and most of all and challenges you to do your best. He truly has inspires me to be a better artist.

He's back! And boy was I lucky to get him. Not only is he a genuinely wonderful human being, but a mad artist and amazing professor as well. Ask him anything and he will jump through hoops to help you out. We as art students are lucky to have him sharing his wisdom!
great teacher, really encourages students and is always willing to help. does not put you down challenges you:)
I Love Quinn, super cool and listens to really good music!

Awesome guy, great personality, and easy going. Wide variety of projects and you really learn a lot. Helps you develop your own personaly style, and allows for creative freedom. Puts on really strange music in class but ask anybody and they'll tell you he's the man!

This professor would rather have students show up sick instead of being accessible and working with them to not miss class. Instead of responding to our emails about being unable to attend she ignores them and then tells the rest of the class that she is not going to work with us on this.

Emily Genovese runs her program like a carnival funhouse: a wild ride full of unprofessionalism, disregard for guidelines, bias, and disappearing grades.  Students beware: it's a horror show with a creepy twist, you never know which funhouse mirror version of Emily Genovese that shows up.

Dr. Leigh is amazing! She cares so much about her students and is always there for them. Her ethics class requires a lot of participation and there are some group projects. Knowledge of course is extraordinary and loves trying to get students involved. Very tough on grading but gives good feedback. If you don't do what she wants you to do, you're likely to not get a good grade.
Jennifer grades you everyday out of 3 on participation. Teamwork is huge and there are many many readings and papers. Avoid at all costs.

comment: Not an easy class but awesome instructor.
One of my favorite classes at Naz.

Dr. Zamule is one of the greatest teachers I have ever had! She is very personable and and genuinely cares about her students. I urge anyone thinking about taking a class of hers to not do so. She is the worst teacher Ive ever had and constantly put me down and talked down to me.

Dr. Zamule is a very sweet woman no doubt, but she shouldn't be teaching this course. I feel like the information I have learned in this course is only what I taught myself. Her tests are hard. comment: She's a nice person overall and tries to include group work during class, but she reads off the slides and it's very general information. She is a terrible teacher. Shes unavailable to meet outside of class. You can't talk to her because shes sarcastic and almost demeaning the way she talks to you. Shes the chair of the department and there's no way she deserves to be. Class is all lecture and all she does is read off the slides. Material is very dry and she offers no explanation

A wonderful professor who cares about her students, is always reaching out to them and encouraging them to ask questions.  She's always available outside of class and responds to e-mails promptly.  She's really not that difficult of a grader and also doesn't assign that much homework for classes.  I would definitely take a course with her again.

the worst teacher i've ever had.. she doesn't make her own tests, power points or homework's she gets them all from the book.. she reads WORD FOR WORD from the slides and doesn't explain anything. absolutely terrible.

Dr. Zamule was the reason I became a Toxicology Major. Her main focus is trying to make sure that everyone is comfortable with the material, and tries to be flexible when it is possible. All of the information for her tests are in the powerpoints, sometimes indirectly. The woman is fantastic. She expects you to care and try.

Zamule understands that this course is so intense, she condenses the information in powerpoints and only focuses on the most broadest of concepts instead of meaningless specifics. Worst teacher I've ever had
Isn't helpful. Grades hard

Dr. Zamule was an amazing professor and was willing to help me with any problem I had. Her attendance is mandatory but you will get a lot out of the class. She is also a great lab teacher. Drops your lowest exam grade

I'm finishing up the semester with Dr. Zamule, and I feel completely confident in saying that she is unbelievable. She has made me feel so confident, and helped me through all my struggles. I can only hope that I have Dr. Zamule again, she's amazing.
Really nice and easy going.work is not too hard

Truly the best teacher I've ever had. They're so down to earth, funny, and respectful. The assignments are easy, straightforward, and actually help you learn. The lectures are engaging and keeps me interested and understanding even if it's not that interesting to me. Any positive aspect you can think of for a teacher, she has.

She's the best teacher I ever had. The four classes I took w/ her during my first two semesters of college shaped who I am academically and as a person. Not only was she the most educated, thoughtful, and passionate teacher I ever had, she was also the kindest and most compassionate towards her students. If you are reading this, thank you Good Dr.

Pretty interesting lecture that's partially just listening to/watching movie scores. Homework is a weekly lecture reflection and a weekly movie reflection, 500 words each. He gives you a few options for the movie but also didn't care when I chose movies that weren't preapproved. Gave me an excuse to watch movies with friends. Enjoyed his feedback!

He is an amazing teacher and the course is extremely easy. You only have to write a small journal entry each week and watch a movie to write about. Attendance isn't mandatory, so having friends in the class that can give you notes for the course makes it crazy easy. He's a great guy and the lectures are really interesting. Best class I've taken!
Such an easy class. Only homework is weekly journals. Very interesting films discussed. Definitely take this class as your art PEQ if you are able.

Ryan is an amazing professor. He is a wonderful musician who will help you learn so much, and doesn't give much work out, but grades very fairly. This class is the best class I've taken here before ever

This is the easiest music class ever. You literally only do 3 things for it, and you just write about the music you listened to that week. You can also only go once a week because you don't really have to hear the sam genre of music twice to write about it. Easy A
Dr. Hardcastle is the best for your music/art PEQ. Highly recommend.

Hardcastle is one of those teachers that make you wonder, "why doesn't every teacher teach like him?" The classroom environment is laid-back, but still productive so that you will actually learn something. You will get an instant A as long as you put forth an obvious effort in class and speak up if you are ever confused!
As long as you show up, participate, and do the quizzes; you'll get an A. Hardcastle thinks traditional grading is a poor system and therefore doesn't actually grade. Really fun and funny class.

I took HIS 352 with Dr. Prokopvych. She is a bad teacher because she didn't communicate well. I was constantly confused as to when things were due and when class was being held. She is a terrible communicator and is not available outside of class. I'm not too fond of her teaching style because we have a quiz on our readings and then a lecture based on the readings. she never grades anything in a timely manner. We did a group project around midterms and she still hasn't graded it about three weeks later. I don't recommend.

This professor was awful. She didn't grade one assignment the entire semester, leaving every student blind to what their grade would be. She also made students feel bad if they didn't now the answer to something. She is extremely disorganized and would take off class all the time. Take sociology PEQ instead of this one. She needs to be let go.

She's extremely kind and caring for her students. I love her as a person, however for this class she tended to go off topic at times. I learned a lot, but it was difficult to follow at times. As long as you read the articles and take notes, the tests are super easy. There are few assignments except for tests and some projects.

I LOVE Dr. Prokopovych. She cares so much for her students and does a great job at communicating the topic of the class. Super accessible outside of class, literally gives her phone number out on the syllabus. Her lectures are intense but in a good way. You'll definitely come out of the class having learned something.

She never answers her email, doesn't talk about anything during class that has anything to do with the tests, she's messed up nearly every test we've taken by marking correct answers as wrong, is rude towards people who don't agree with her opinion, and grades based on whether not not she agrees with you. Awful professor.

I love her so much. She is so sweet, always brought us treats. I wish her lectures were a little bit easier to understand. There was only 2 tests and just passing them was a struggle, but the project at the end of the class was easy and engaging! She genuinely cares about her students and their college experience and thats important.

Dr. Prokopovych is an amazing professor. She gives clear assignments and grades clearly. However, I wish that she would have lectured more. I learn best from lectures, but most of the class was just watching documentaries or discussing readings.

Great course, learned a lot. Master's level excludes the quizzes and busywork which is nice, but you get a really heavy duty paper instead. Writing heavy, exams are written essays. high key funny ,great teacher, have gotten nothing less than a b with this women. love her.

Dr.P is one of my favorite professor's at Naz because she makes daunting subjects relevant, fun, and most of all you really learn.

Nice lady, makes Polisci interesting, I actually looked forward to going to class on most days. She made lessons so funny, my friend and I made a quote book. Take as many classes as you can with Proko. You will not be sorry.
decent teacher

Good professor, makes physics more fun than I expected it to be.

If you have a chance to take a class with Dr. Lampa-Pastirk: DO IT! She is genuinely one of the first professors ever that allowed me to come out of my shell and participate/actively engage in class. comment: She is undoubtedly the smartest person at Nazareth however as a teacher she has a hard time getting the important points across and I struggled in her class. Really great professor!!! I have learned a lot.
She takes out time to meet specifically with students.

I loved having Sanela as a lab professor! She's always willing to help you and answer questions, and she's not too strict. Just make sure to come to lab every time -- it's extremely hard to make up the class!

This was my 3rd semester taking a lecture class with Dr. G. He is very kind, but will also really start to push you once you get into his upper level class (take it if you want to challenge yourself!). I attended his office hours nearly every week and he was always willing to help (despite me interrupting him eating lunch several times lol).

Dr. Ardon is a great professor, he is very helpful and understand when you don't understand the topic. There is a quiz every week, but you can always retake them on reassessment days.There are warm-up quizzes every week before the actual quiz so you understand what is on the quiz. There is only one test and it is the final.

Utilize office hours- Dr. Ardon can schedule another meeting time if his regular office hours don't work. It can be slightly difficult to understand him at times, but overall I think he does a good job of making orgo material easier to understand. I am unsure of how he compares to Dr. Tajc. Be very careful of the weekly quizzes- go to workshop!
Weekly quizzes but you are given the equations. Is always available for help

The class was difficult for me because I didn't have the lecture that pertained to the lab until the next day but the professor was very good at explaining the concepts and was understanding of the fact that some people haven't learned what the lab is about.

He was very knowledgeable and always had an answer for any question that someone asked. Very relaxed and easy to talk to. Kind of wish he was faster with grading. I had Dance at a weird time I think, but her class was a little unorganized and I often had no idea what was happening both in class and for assignments.

Professor Dance was the least trauma-informed person in the classroom. Which is alarming, seeing shes a therapist. There was a lecture opened with a public shaming of certain students. You need to read the book, shes a therapist so pretty easy to get along with, but really confrontational. Our class had an online test that she considered mass plagiarized and we talked about that for 45 minutes, it was a lot.
She is so nice. She’s a therapist and shares her experiences to help you learn. Tests are fairly easy just come to class and take notes and you should be good.

Professor David is amazing! She cares about her students and she is there during or outside of class as a good support if you need help, have questions, or any concerns about internship. She talked me through tough situations I went through while interning. She is understanding and is an easy grader. I would definitely recommend prof David!!

Professor David is very sweet and cares about her job about. Prof. David also really cares about her students and wants to make sure you are reaching your full potential. Not really any work for any of her social work classes.
Prof David was one of the best professors that I had the pleasure of taking a course from! I recommend taking a class with her!!

Professor David is one the best educators I've had.  She truly cares about her students and their success.  I learned a lot in this class and I wish she was offering more classes that I could take.  No tests, no  quizzes.  A lot of group work and hands on learning.  She's outstanding in my book.  She definitely understand what teaching means. A+!

Holland is amazing. Her projects were difficult, but as long as you really put in the work you would get a good grade. After every project she did one on one meetings to discuss the grade you got and why you got it which I found super helpful. I recommend her 100%
I LOVE HOLLAND the class work is hard but worth it and she's an amazing resource

Dr. Schoell's specialty is CLS, but he has a great amount of expertise. He did a great job explaining the material. Biochemistry is known to be hard, but this class was manageable, as long as you put in lots of effort. His office hours didn't fit my schedule but you can schedule appointments with him as needed. He gave good feedback on assignments.

Dr. Schoell is the best professor I have ever had. He is amazing at lecturing and letting us know his expectations. He is heavy on tests and quizzes, but they really help you learn the material. He is always available outside of class and is more than happy to help. He is an expert in this field and cares greatly about his students.

Zach is super funny and explains his assignments very well. All of the work made sense as to why we were doing it and each thing led into the next. When a problem or question arose he would come help and if he didn't know the answer we would work together to figure it out.

The professor herself was nice but this course was overwhelming for a 1 credit. Professor Walker is a good guy, but he has a huge lecture pretty much every class that seems to never end. Easy A if you do all the assignments.

PROFESSOR WALKER IS A HORRIBLE PROFESSOR. His feedback is a mixture of big words, and compliments, and is written in a way that is almost impossible to understand. He also lectures in a way that is primarily rambling about things that are unimportant and irrelevant to the course.

Professor Walker's History class is interesting for everyone interest in American History. The book provided is really long but good, and as long as you read it, you'll be fine.

The worst professor I have had yet at Nazareth. Lectures are boring, and all he does is talk. The most monotone voice I have ever heard. Does not have clear grading criteria at all. If you have a choice not to take a class with him, do it.

all this man does is speak. he never asks questions in class there is never activities it is just him speaking for over an hour every class day. he is the most boring professor ever. also he never returns assignments and is insanely disorganized.

Matt is very clear with his directions, however his grading is questionable and his feedback almost never makes sense. If you are willing to spend 20 hours on a history class every week and get judged by every assignment you turned in, go ahead and take his class. I don't know how he is still teaching (not fired)... In short, he gives too much work for a PEQ. He makes us read 2 separate books along with multiple other work. He also never meets with us and he's bad at clarifying information. Definitely the most tedious and irritating PEQ I have taken at Naz. Mediocre at best.
WORST PROFESSOR EVER! If you want to remain sane, do not take a class with him. Nothing is ever good enough for him and he grades so harshly. Never gives positive feedback. Super negative person.

comment: You can email and ask questions but he rarely clarifies. His grading makes no sense and seems to depend on his mood. Requires more work than he should for an online class. Awesome to have loved his lectures, find away to keep everyone engaged even in an 8 am class

PUTS YOU TO SLEEP! 8am classes are hard enough, he makes them much worse. Everything he covers was taught in the 8th grade. For History 206 he skipped from the year 1619 to 1870s in one class. PUTS YOU TO SLEEP! So boring! He jumps around between years and doesn't really have a clear path. A LOT of reading, and everything is done with a "Critical Eye" and while examining primary sources. Albert is a nice guy, my mom actually had him when she went to Naz in the 90's. He is a very hard grader and when presenting he took off MANY points due to us looking at the board. I took Organizational Behavior with Al. Super amazing guy and would highly recommend his class! He's very big on group work and there is a textbook but you don't use it. Al is such a sweet professor. Honestly such a sweet man, and a genius when it comes to business. He does care about if you participate in class, to the point where your grade depends on your attendance a little, but its because he wants you to succeed. Al is very accessible and helpful, and sends weekly class updates that help you keep up

For this class, there's a textbook but you don't really need it. I used it twice, everything from the textbook is in the powerpoints he puts up. Super boring, it's like first year seminar but business version. Its super easy, papers are straight forward as long as you answer the questions you will get an A or B. Work in groups too.

Professor Cabral really really REALLY loves what he does. He is extremely knowledgeable about all things management and communication. He loves students who show passion for these areas (but he doesn't show favoritism, he's very kind to everyone). He allows you to rewrite papers you get bad grades on. There was more content than I expected for an intro music class. I didnt know I needed a ukulele until I showed up for the first day. We didnt play that much but you still need one (buy or borrow) I struggled a little on the quizzes but he gives good feedback and grades easy on your final ukulele performance.
Professor Kam was so understanding and kind. I would definitely recommend taking a class with him.
He was a very nice professor. Thought he taught the class very well and did a good job. Overall thought the class was good and would recommend for a music peq

Incredible professor. He is so understanding and really cares about helping us learn. He is so funny in his own way. He does everything he can to make sure we pass (within reason of course) and I always look forward to class. Prof. Kam is the best and I look forward to the classes I have with him next semester.

Professor Kam made this class a breeze. He is very passionate about the course content and makes the content accessible to both musicians and non-musicians. The course's workload was not very heavy, and he was always available to help when needed. I definitely recommend Professor Kam if you need to take an Intro to World Music class.

Prof Kam seemed to enjoy teaching this course and made this clear to his students. He made sure everyone understood the material before moving onto the next section of the course. While the quizzes were a healthy challenge, he provided study guides to prepare students for what was going to be on the quiz. Wonderful professor!

He goes over subjects very fast and doesn't like repeating himself. It is also quite difficult to try to meet with him to ask for help. Overall he is a very nice guy and knows what he is talking about, but I personally found his class to be very difficult.

Take this class with a different professor. This is supposed to be a simple but also interesting course and he does not care about the success of his students. Everything you would have needed to know from the textbook he shows you on the power point in class but if you are going to miss class then you should get the book. His tests were straightforward.

This class was the most unorganized class I have ever taken

I LOVED this class and wished I could take other SWK classes with him!
Sleeps on the job, resting sad face, but randomly gives people kisses? She has favorites, this is because of treat bribery.

Professor Orion is wonderful. As long as you feed her, you'll do great in her class. However participation does matter a lot. If you don't give her treats, this class will not be fun. Make sure you give her all the love and praise she deserves!!

Professor Orion is very sweet and cares deeply about her students. She is a little temperamental if you do not give her her treats when she deserves them or you if you do not do so fast enough. She will look at you judgmentally but it is not always her fault, gravity is hard for her.
very unprofessional gave me kisses
She wants to be in the pool at all times. She does not need to be in the pool at all times. She will get her hair messed up and have to brush it. But she is so soft and loving and loves friends.
doesn't grade any of your work, she just eats it.

Will only talk about one topic the whole class, nothing is relevant, no study guide for final

Bockes is a nice guy, but his teaching style was awful, it was aways lectures which to me half the information he talked about during the lecture was never even on the tests. Only lectures during class and does not get to know you or even your name. All tests and quizzes are online except for the final, but some subject matter is not clearly covered during class. Is an easy grader for written assignments. Overall his teaching style wasn't for me, if you like a more lecture type class this is for you.

His class is not hard, but his math is of teaching makes it hard. His lectures contain information that is not tested on, the test often times has into that we have never heard before. Everything, including tests and quizzes is online until the final which is setting students up for failure I feel. Worst professer at naz would never take again EVER

He is very boring to listen to and lectures a lot. His quizzes are easy and most of the questions are asked from previous quizzes or tests. His tests are mainly from the textbook. The written response questions, he has 4 of them, are graded really heavily. He's a bad communicator and won't get to know you.
Dr. Bockes is a good professor, he is very lecture heavy. He tends to ramble on about stuff that we aren't learning about. Test heavy and quiz heavy, however everything is online during the semester.

This professor is one of the most difficult people I have ever met. I admit I am not the best student, but he does not give me any sort of motivation to want to do better. Non-psych major here and this class was fair. Assignments were tough, go to office and ask for clarification.

make it pass / fail that's all i got.

He is a very good professor and knows what he talks about. If you take lots of notes then the exams are pretty easy. Sometimes he does put ambiguous questions on the exams and that is what makes them tricky. Class often does get boring but he does add funny tidbits at times.
Very clear, very smart, and very engaged in his subject: a great professor!

love him.
least fav psych professor

The professor is great. He has so much humor and because of that it keeps you on your toes throughout the entire class. You won't exactly do real well if you don't do the reading, but  the class is fun.
needs to incorporate more media into the class.
good teacher, gives you a lot of info. If you want to take PSY 101, take it with Dr. Bockes

Lectures are very boring, too much information all at once

Don't take a class with him. He does not teach and you will fall asleep in class. No one pay attention and he just reads off the slides he makes. You will never receive any feedback on any assignment you turn in, he will just randomly put in grades and you will most likely get like a 65%

best teacher ever little work, easyy quizs

He canceled class more than half the times

Chuck is a nice guy. When I took him for intro, I liked that he had us take many field trips-that being said, he didn't teach very much at all. This is fine because he let other people come in and present and do the talking. He's easy, and is easy to reach.

Chuck is the BEST. He has so much experience that he truly brings to the classroom in an informative way. He's a great great GREAT resource to have outside the classroom as well.

Omg I love Lisa! she was amazing. She knows that this is a Bio class for non Bio majors and it was by far one of the easiest classes I took. comment: She's not as bad as everyone is saying. Very understanding and has clear grading criteria. A lot of group assignments which personally I am not a fan of. Only 2 exams and she offers corrections for both. Not a very difficult class. I would recommend Dr. Danish.

tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'So many papers', 'Tough grader']

comment: Never available outside of class, Bio 109 is a non major class and we were expected to come into the class with the knowledge of a Bio major. Her tests were hard for science majors

class is the biggest load of bull. While a nice person, Prof Danish does NOT specify what is going to be on her ridiculously long, paragraph-per-question exams. I wish there was a button that could describe this professor as incompetent. Dr. Sommers was extremely rude and passive aggressive towards students. This professor is in the education department and it is discouraging that she represents the status quo for teachers at Nazareth. She is extremely unclear and unkind when asked for clarification.

This is one of the worst professors, I have had in my college career. She assigns way too much work, and the assignments and grading expectations are unclear. Whenever you ask her a question, she always tells you to refer to the syllabus, yet the syallbus provides no clear help. Avoid this teacher!

Dr. Sommers can be intimidating at first yet she makes a conscious effort to get to know each student. Tough grader on a few exams, but I would recommend.

What an awful nit-picky teacher. Self-righteous to the max. Avoid her at all costs. I feel really bad for her next class. She is not meant to be a teacher with her sassy attitude, unclear grading expectations, attitude and inconsistency with the syllabus. Don't take her. Not worth the money.

comment: A certain mode of thinking to do well in her class, think like her, do well. Amazing professor, great discussions took place in this class. She was really caring and easy to talk to.
This was such a great course. All tests are open note and Dr. Sommers is open and accessible and really nice. I loved this professor

Professor was horrible. Graded papers very easily but tests very hard. Very snappy towards some students and very sarcastic. tags: ['Tough grader', 'Get ready to read', 'Lots of homework']
comment: I absolutely would not take this class with her again. While she does assign a LOT of work, this can make it easier to drown out other bad grades you may have gotten. Often I would get an A- on an assignment with just "ok." as feedback with no other information on how to improve.

Her guidelines for work are confusing and her grading isn't consistent. To get a good grade on the homework she assigned I had to excessively annotate and write almost a page of notes on top of that. She takes a long time to reply to emails but is a fast grader. Overall she seems to care about her students but her requirements don't add up.

MIdge was the rudest professor ever. I would email her, and she either wouldn't email me back, or it would help if she did. Her grading criteria was based on how she was feeling that day. No clear guidelines. If she didn't like you, you would know it. This class will tank your GPA so say goodbye to your 4.0.

She is the most lovely person I have ever met. She is so sweet and caring and so understanding if you are ever going through something personal. She isnt a hard grader and if you do the work you will easily get a B even if you arent the best writer. Some classes are a bit of a yawn but besides that I cant complain. The work load is decent but easy.

Midge is a great teacher. Some classes aren't really necessary but I think she is a really laid back teacher and having her early in the morning isn't the worst thing because the class is chill. She loves doing group work so it's not too bad. She assigns 3 essays (same with the 101 class) but they are not difficult at all. She isn't a tough grader.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'EXTRA CREDIT', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: I had Professor Anselmo for Power of Narrative. He is a very chill teacher, you do have a quiz every week for the books, movies, or comics you read. You will be taking a lot of notes for his class. He gives you the midterm study guide. He allows 6 absences in his class before your attendance matters. Highly recommend for Power of Narrative.

Not a difficult professor by any means, but gives a lot of assignments. It's mostly just repetitive busy work that culminates in a group research paper. He also spends a ton of class time talking about the most random things and it's a huge waste of time. I learned nothing except how to 'fluff' a paper. Nice guy, but I would recommend someone else.

Prof Anselmo is very smart and is extremely passionate about what he teaches. He is always open to constructive criticism about his class. He seemed to talk a lot and sometimes it seemed pointless. The class is easy until all of a sudden you have a big research paper due. I liked the teacher, just not the class.

He's definitely a very intelligent guy, but in class it usually felt like he was just talking to talk and there didn't seem to be too much of a point. Also a lot of the work we did felt like busy and wasn't too helpful. Overall the class wasn't too hard though, it was just all working towards one big group research paper.

He's a nice guy, but a lot of the time he talks just to talk. He will talk the entire class, but doesn't ever say much, ya know? His assignments aren't always clear but as long as you ask questions and make sure you understand, you'll be fine.

American Lit was interesting. Prof. Anselmo can sometimes be a bit lofty in his lectures, but he is a nice prof overall. Class is reading journals, small 3 question quizzes, final essay, and a final exam. Its not too hard to achieve an A, he seems to be a reasonable grader. I also loved how he was always open to hearing students interpretations.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Clear grading criteria', 'Amazing lectures']
comment: Prof. Anselmo was an awesome professor! He is very knowledgeable of American Lit and his lectures are super interesting. The readings can sometimes be long and difficult, but he breaks them down in class with lectures/class discussion. There were writing journals for every reading, one short paper, and a final exam. Easy A if you do the work!

Professor Horst's class was one of my most fun to attend! He always incoporated a good blend of relevant and serious class material with engaging silliness and a bit of humor. I had to take his course again and he helped me even more the second time, working with me each class and individually at times to ensure I got better grades.

Horst is a great teacher who is very knowledgeable about what he is teaching. Attendance isn't mandatory but be careful because if you miss a few classes you may not understand what is going on. He also understood that most of his students most likely won't use stats in the future. I probably would take a class with him again.

Professor Horst is a great math teacher. Horst understands that math is hard for students and he tries to make class as painless as possible. For this class the main benefit is he does not give a final exam. The other benefit is he assigns projects instead of only tests, so by doing well on projects it makes up for your testing. Ask many questions

Very nice guy and understanding. This class was interesting, but make sure you pay attention in class and read the textbook (that's where online test questions are from). There are a few short homework assignments and papers on topics of your choice. He also gives you built in days off. Overall a pretty good class.
Sweetest guy ever!!! Please be nice to him.  Do the work and you will succeed.

Professor Donlin-Smith was an amazing religion professor. He posted everything in the syllabus on the very first day, meaning it was possible to get ahead. He also had video lectures for every unit, so even if you miss class you can still understand the material. There are a lot of readings, papers, and videos but they aren't difficult.

He is one of the most understanding, caring professors you'll have. He tries to make class interesting and loves conversing with students. He has a very clear guideline for assignments and none of them are that difficult. Make sure to pay attention in lectures and do the study guides for quizzes and you'll be fine.

Extremely kind, caring, and willing to help you/answer questions. The best part is that he's one of the most organized professors you can have. From Day 1, you know exactly what's due and when for the whole semester. 6 papers, but 5/6 are short, easy, and mostly opinion-based. Class is very lecture and discussion-based. Also gives some Fridays off.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Lots of homework', 'So many papers']
comment: If you are not extremely interested in religion or ethics, avoid this class. You have to watch around 2 hours of lecture videos each week, on top of 2 page papers and quizzes, and mandatory lectures. He is a nice guy, and the work is easy, just time consuming and a lot of work that seems unnecessary.
He is a really amazing professor and is great to have simple conversations with.
He is a very sweet professor overall. He is clearly passionate about his studies and is willing to get into debates.

One of the most incompetent professor I have ever had, her lectures are terrible. She is all over the place when she expains or assigns things. She doesn't prepare you well for the tests. And when you go to her office hours it feels like she doesn't to help.

comment: Mr. Zugelder is really great at what he does! He pushes students to be the best that they can be without placing too much pressure on them. He keeps things really informal, but make sure that you do your fair share of work inside and outside of class.

One of the best professors I've had and well known for being one of the best anatomy professors. Class is just him lecturing but he makes it interesting. Dr. Dodge is a great guy. He really knows what he's talking about. He's super busy (being a professor, doctor, and father) so there's no excuse for you not to read and go to class. Dodge is a great professor who really wants his students to succeed. He is very energetic about all of his lectures and reviews at the beginning of each class to ensure clarity. The course is difficult but if you read the book and devote time to it you will succeed.
Fabulous professor. You can tell that he really knows what he is talking about and is super interested in it. He is very helpful and he is all around one of the best professors I have ever had.
Easily the best professor at Nazareth College. Talk about someone who loves their job and who really inspires his students to learn. Lectures go by very quickly and he makes them very interesting.

Dodge is a great professor and really knows his stuff. Very fast talker and difficult class.

He is truly the best professor I have had. He is so helpful and made my time in Anatomy enjoyable. Take him at all costs!

Dr. Dodge is an amazing teacher. He is always energetic and uses many examples to help you learn the material. I am never bored in his class and look forward to going to class. The work is really challenging but if you read the textbook and pay attention, you will be fine.

He was an awesome teacher. Very helpful and made class interesting, I never looked at the clock while in his class. He takes very complicated topics and explains them in a way people can understand. His tests are fair and he is always willing to help.
really great teacher! always willing to answer questions and very enthusiastic about teaching. He makes class interesting and really knows what he is talking about

I enjoy A&P so much more the second half because of this teacher. He makes the difficult material easier to learn and is really enthusiastic about teaching. Probably the best teacher at Nazareth college! He is extremely enthusiastic about the material which makes it easier to learn! A&p is a difficult class but he makes it as enjoyable as possible and hea great look at! Red hot chilie pepper is definitely deserved

By far the best professor Nazareth has to offer.  He is the most helpful and informative professor I've ever had.  He makes extremely difficult material easy to understand. About to Graduate and everything I will need to pass my boards I got from the Fantastic foundation built by Dr. Dodge!
Dodge is excellent! A&P is a killer course but if you work hard it's possible to get an A. Definetely take it with dodge, I'd recommend him to anyone

SOOOOOO good i loved his course.. tests can be hard but overall his class is worth wile to take

TAKE THIS GUY FOR ANATOMY! A&P is hard but he is deff the best at Naz.  If you have to take A&P take dodge.  He will do his best so you understand the hard material and makes you actually like anatomy.

Dr. Kisiara is a really great professor and I wish I paid attention more. He made the class really interesting and interactive. He's a very knowledgeable man. If given the opportunity I think everyone should take him at least once.

Loved classes with Kisiara!
Great classes with him!

Love of my life.

about as relaxed as they come. great teacher with a wonderful sense of humor and a great amount of knowledge. he is very approachable and friendly too

Professor Fessler has is a very good lecturer and I love the class time I have with her. She is knowledgeable and kind and is willing to help you in any way she can. Her tests are difficult, but the papers that she has are very easy. Do not skip the lectures if you want a good grade.

Dr. Fessler was an awesome senior sem professor. She is well-equipped to teach this course and every class was engaging and interesting. Dr. Fessler is a great teacher. Great class! She is wonderful at lecturing, just make sure to take notes in class because her PowerPoints are heavy on pictures. She is approachable and always ready to help.

Fessler is amazing! She clearly cares about the subject and her students. Very fair when it comes to grading, deadlines, and tests. She is very understandable. She makes sure you understand the material.

Great guy. Take any class you can with him.

Thad is a very fun guy but a very tough grader! def take advantage of his re-write policy on anything below a B or B+...and for god's sake...USE THE WRITING CENTER! enjoy the class and participate in the class discussions! dont be afraid to voice your opinion even if you are the only one who thinks taht way, the class will thank you later (QAIs) :)
Thad is unclear and very unhelpful. I don't think he actually likes teaching and that is very apparent. Don't take his classes if you can help it.

Thad is a rockin' dude. He dislikes Rochester and I like that.  Oh and if you see this Thad, it's from your Favorite new B&N employee
Thad, Did you write that last comment yourself? If not, student you nailed him. But dude, I only know like one person who actually likes Naz, so what's the big deal if he hates Crochester?

Acts like he's mad he has to be here to teach and would rather be anyplace else.  Tries to intimidate students on the first day.  He could accomplish the same objectives by being tough but friendly.  He's tough and pissed off.
Thad is a pretty cool guy... but he makes you work, and you learn if you do the work... if not, you won't get anything out of him or the class...

I definately learned alot from Thad.  He was very tough, especially with grading, but he did it all to teach you how to write.  I never had a problem with Thad, but some people didn't get along with him, but as long as you try, you'll do fine.  I would take another writing class from him

He's not easy, but who really wants that in the end.  If you put something into your work, he'll support you.  He pushes you, and sometimes that can be hard, but it makes you a better writer.  I felt like I learned something.  He's cool.  Kinda hot too.
Thaddeus Camp should not teach english. Why does he have to grade so hard?

Thad is definitely hard and expects a lot from students. He is somewhat helpful is you keep bugging him for help. Hes not trying to make you fail, but if you dont try, you will fail. Hes overall a nice guy but definitely a hard teacher

I thought thad was a great teacher... I don't get why everyone thinks he so hard a grader... I get B+s on just about everything and I was never a strong writer in High School, you just have to pay attention and have some common sense. I loved his class
It takes him forever to grade papers and he is a very tough grader. His expectations are outrageous and his assignments are unclear or dumb.
I got assigned randomly to Camp, but I learned a lot. You just have to realize that he doesn't hate you. He just tries to make us better writers.
Definitely a tough grader, but he wants you to learn the stuff and will help you to do it.  I am a much better writer because of his class.

He is awful. I ended up going to the head of the english department to get out of his class. He doesn't make any sense, and grades ridiculously hard. He expects so much out of you, but doesn't teach you anything!!!
Cool guy- it's hard stuff, but try, practice, and ask q's; he'll answer them. Funny and friendly
A little out there and really hard.

He is very unclear and not always prepared.  It has taken me about 20 papers into the year to break the c range, and this is somone who got a 4 on AP english.  He's very cool outside of class, but in the classroom he not good at all.
Not the best teacher around. Unclear and confusing. You never know what he wants until after the assignment is handed in. Not recommended.

Her class at the time was very discussion-heavy and required that you read a lot of printed out material. That material would later translate to you comparing 2 printed out articles (of her choosing). Her class can be very difficult if you're not paying enough attention to minor details. I would definitely recommend someone else.

She s very passionate about the material. The tests are very long in writing and there are several papers throughout the semester based on mandatory events you have to attend and one where you relate the info to topics in class. There are no outlined notes, so it's a little bit all over the place and it can be difficult to sit in for so long.

comment: Couldn't stand this class. Very tough grader and she can't keep her political views out of lectures. Get ready to participate. If you disagree with her and you want to keep your mouth shut in order to avoid conflict, expect an F for your participation grade. Take this class with another professor.

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Get ready to read', 'SO MANY PAPERS']
comment: She is not a horrible professor but she is very frustrating. She rambles and gets very upset when people say they have no idea what she's talking about. She assigns a TON of reading EVERY NIGHT and is a stickler about papers. You have to just wing it in her class honestly, pretend to care and you might pass.

She is just awesome! Very personable and has interesting class discussions. The readings aren't boring and actually help explain the content. If you want to talk outside of class with Prof. Bochen she is very inviting and kind. I would and will take more classes with her.

Love her! She totally gave me the Merton bug and I love the conversation her and I have in class. I just wish students would participate more. READ AND DISCUSS PEOPLE! It's college you're expected to do your work.
Awful. Boring.

Had her for two classes. Very boring, little to nothing learned in her classes. The topics she talks about in class are irrelevant. Her classes drag on. Like someone said prior, likes to hear herself talk and talk about "feelings." Learned hardly anything. Felt like I was a child in sunday school.

This is a professor who loves to hear herself talk... She will ramble on for the entire class talking about material that has little to no relevance to the course. We spend the entire class discussing our "feelings" rather than topics that are important for exams.
EXCELLENT. SUPERB! Someone I Love!
EXCELLENT. SUPERB
Brilliant, clear, and inspiring.  Has changed my life - a beautiful person!
I will never take another class from her again. NO WAY! I leaned absolutley nothing.
Dr. Bochen is the most cacaring prof I have had at Naz!  Her classes are great if you enter into them fully.  She helps you discover more about yourself -  she is the BEST!

no reading or studying needed to ace this class

she as a person is amazing and fabulous, but her class is a joke. i never went and still got an A, so basically i taught myself. glad i paid 5 grand for what could have cost me 100 in books at barnes and nobles.
I like her as a person, but I feel as though I'm not learning in the class. Most of the reading she gives us isn't exactly excessive, but much of it seems so irrelevant to what she wants us to learn.

Simply a beautiful person - I love her!! She is so sweet and caring!

Nice lady, very kind and thoughtful. Too much reading and the class period seems to drag itself out. One of the only excitements during class was watching her hand gestures. She is very helpful, however.

Very kind, caring teacher who gets very excited about the course material! Interesting approach to teaching, not one that I'm used to.Students float on their own.Not much work needs to be done out of class to pass/do well.Just come & try to pay attention.

SHE IS AN AMAZING TEACHER THAT WOULD DO ANYTHING FOR ANYONE! PEOPLE SHOULD FEEL LUCKY TO HAVE HER. GRANTED SHE MIGHT NOT GIVE STRAIGHT FACTS, BUT YOU ARE IN COLLEGE NOW - SHE MAKES YOU THINK AND DOESN'T SPOON FEED YOU THE MATERIAL!!!

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Get ready to read', 'SO MANY PAPERS']
comment: Grades papers very hard. Although if you meet with him with questions he will sometimes raise your grade half a letter grade. Make sure you read the books there's always pop quizes on them. Also fill out your Daily Entry slips because he will collect them at the end of the semester.

Professor pestino is a great guy - good conversation along with class participation (DO participate in his class!). BUT I received some rather rude comments on my papers - I had to talk to my advisor about them at one point. Does not give much guidance when asked for help, but class is helpful!! Find a study buddy

By far the most amazing English professor I've had. It's a lot of reading, however, the class discussions are worth it. The papers are fairly easy. I would take this class, or any class, with him again. Dr. Pestino is always interested in what students have to say. If you get the chance to take any course with him, do it. You won't regret it.

He was not a very good teacher and i would NOT take another one of his classes ever again. He wrote rude comments on my assignments and is never clear with what he wants you to do and when. He is also VERY unorganized.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!! He is extremely unorganized, extremely confusing and the course work does not make any sense. He is not a great help and gets very snobby when you try asking questions. The course makes no sense and is a horrible GPA ruiner. Save yourself and DO NOT take his vice and virtue class. I would NOT take another class with him.

He is exceptionally rude and shows no interest in the progression of the student. When I reached out for help I was attacked. I would not recommend anyone take Vice and Virtue with him, I dont know a single person taking it that enjoyed it.

Pestino seems like such a nice old man but his class is terrible!  He is all over the place and very close minded, his way is the only way.  I had high hopes for this class and they were crushed.  His grading is unfair and he gives you a crazy amount of work, as if his class is your only.  Do not recommend Vice virtue.  Take a different lit class!

i was not a fan of this class. i found dr. pestino to be very unorganized. he w never stuck to what was on the syllabus and never handed back papers until a few weeks or months later. i also found him to show bias and favoritism in the classroom and that reflected in the grading.overall, i found him to be extremely rude and arrogant.

Dr. Pestino is a very nice old man, his grading can be tough when it comes to papers but there isn't much homework for this class.  He's a bit helpful when you bring papers to him (this is mandatory for each paper) but he sometimes contradicts himself after the second time seeing it.
if you miss one over the allowed absences, he will flip out. he gets really angry over nothing and he takes his class wayyyyyy too seriously.
He is a great professor and his conferences are very helpful and he points out the mistakes in a respectful yet helpful matter and tells you how to improve your papers not just what is wrong
Really helpful and knows what he is doing. Also really nice and funny. Great professor

He is such a cute old man! I am a terrible writer but he did help me improve. For the most part he lets you choose your own topic for papers which helps when you're writing about something that interests you. He is helpful and a very nice guy.

Dr. Pestino is such a great man! He helped me improve my writing so much during my first semester. His classes are very laid back and very straightforward. He's not like other professors who try to trick you with language. Just watch out - if you don't like to participate this isn't the class for you!
HOT HOT HOT!!!

Joe Pa is a good guy. He is very in-tune with the world today and talks about current events along with the material he covers. Nothing more than a 5 page paper with plenty of time to do it. Will get angry if you disrupt his class though, so watch out.
Good guy Mr. Magoo like. He gets upset if the class does not participate, but very laid back and will help aid in class discussion.
Just don't , no energy  and hard to understand. Though he is a fantastic person
Good teacher, had a fun time in class, too bad class was just waaaay too long...
Excellent class, I learned a lot and truly enjoyed his style.  He encouraged cross-disciplinary connections and really brought out the potential in his students.  Be prepared to discuss a lot!!
boring boring boring as a night class
never thought of that ben stien thing...but yeah...sorta boring but he knows his stuff

tags: ['Tough Grader', 'Gives good feedback', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: Her class is definitely hard at first, but over time, your writing gets better because you actually learn something in her class. I ended up with a C+ for my first paper with her, then a B, then an A+. Her system works great because the papers near the end account for the majority of your grades. Definitely a hard grader, but gives good feedback.
Comes off strong at first, but after the first couple weeks, it's fine

Mignacca was a very helpful professor and would provide students with MLA citation format for each paper.  In this class, many of the books can be listened to on Youtube and will have an essay assigned for them. Mignacca gives beneficial feedback on essays and promotes pair work on one of the papers based off of your own personal writing level.

As soon as you understand Dr. Mignaccas' sarcasm you will understand she is great professor. I really enjoyed this class and will have her again. She is amazing because she grades your papers will a lot of feedback, lets you revise them and you hand it in again so you can get a good grade. Also, the papers are only 2 pages long.

tags: ['Tough Grader', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: Tough graders when it comes to your papers.

Dr. Mignacca seemed tough at first, but I ended up loving her at the end of the semester! She's a tough grader but I've learned more about punctuation than any high school teacher ever taught me. I definitely learned a lot from her. She is always there if I need help. I highly recommend taking a class with her.
She is amazing. She is always there for you if you want to talk. She's tough but fair. She wants to see students do well. Just show up and pay attention in class and you should be fine.

Mignacca is a very interesting teacher.  She does seem really tough at first and the class seems pointless and going nowhere, but after a while it'll get better and she is actually a really nice teacher.  She jokes around a lot which makes the class better.  Just listen to her tips and you will get good grades on the papers.

I would recommend to not take a class with this teacher if you aren't up for being confused during the whole lecture.  Her teaching style is all over the place and it is hard to try to understand.  Also, if you don't like being treated like a 5th grader, don't take a class with her.  However, she will try to help you if you need it.

Sometimes she is really interesting and funny. She says some things that really leave me thinking and I like that a lot. I enjoy the material. The papers are hard to understand though, I was extremely lost when she gave out the prompt paper. She is a hard grader but I think it's for a reason. It is kind of disorganized though

At first, I was not a fan.  But, by the end of the semester I realized that Dr. Mignacca was by far my favorite professor! She has a sense of humor and if you acknowledge that she has a reason behind her actions you will get the most out of her classes! I hope to take another class from her.
This teacher was very demanding and wanted a research paper in 4 days. She sounds like a very hard grader but her attiude made me so stressed that I had to drop.

Dr. Mignacca's class was great. Although she is very opinionated and can come off as demanding, she has a great sense of humor and is very understanding. If you are good at grammar, the class is a breeze. Little to no homework

Do not take her class! She is an unfair grader, can never remember what her criteria is for assignments, and refuses to see another person's point of view. She is very inconsistent. She also doesn't understand the rules of punctuation or grammar, and will mark off for things she "feels" are wrong, even if the text for the class states otherwise.

She is very unclear, and she makes things up as she goes. She likes grammar quizzes and made us do a group essay (epic fail). I found that her grading was hard, and her class was frustrating! I wouldn't recommend her to anyone.
She's the best. Love her.

I love Maureen. She's crazy but such a great teacher if you really listen and want to learn. Also, always get to class early, I find it that most days you learn the most by listening to her talk about random things before class starts.
Amazing, lover her to death. Be ready to learn!

Maureen is an extremely genuine and straight up teacher. She won't tell you something is good when it's not, her criticism can be harsh, don't take it to heart, she's honestly just making you a better artist. While taking this class you should have little to no social life outside of the studio. NOT FOR NON-MAJORS!!!

If you come into her class thinking you are amazing, think again. She will make you work your butt off, & when you think you're done, you'll work more. I admit that I was scared crapless of her & had some anxiety, but over time she became nicer & now I love her! If you show progress, she will let loose. Also, note taking is a must! BE PREPARED!!!

She is tough, but fair. If you slack off, she lets you know it. But when you try, and show work, she will help. She believes in self direction. meaning you are the teacher, she will just guide. Her stories are amazing and what you learn works and will stay with you, whether you want it to or not.

Why would someone who's had "master's" courses be taking "ART 101"?  Sounds like somebody is just upset because perhaps they were told the truth about their performance in class.  Will "shy" even cut it in the art world? See previous comment.

She was my most difficult professor of all my college career (undergrad and masters).  I found her rough to deal with as our personalities did not mesh. A Previous Poster mentioned her playing favorites.  I higly suggest getting on her good side and sucking up.  She does not care for the quiet students.  Speak up in her class DO NOT be shy.
She's HOT!

Scared the hell out of me at first, telling us the best way to bite a kneaded eraser and talking about discussions she had with a canadian squirrel, however after a short time I've learned so much. I can honestly say I detest the class but I respect it and value it because I am learning so much.

First semester with Maureen can be tough, she's very strict, but everything she says is knowledgable, and good information. Listen to what she says, do what she says, and life will be good. Don't expect this to be like high school. Must be willing to relearn everything. Don't take criticism on art personally, learn from it and make your art better

The best studio professor I ever had after highschool. She is bunt and opinionated, but hell, if you can't take criticism on your artwork and you think she is way too difficult than you have no place being an art major.In respect to favorites-the ones that she may favor (and I can't think of any) EARNED that spot by impressing her high standards!

The people who think that she is too hard are the lazy people who think they are too good to be taught.  They should just take their work home and hang it on their mother's refrigerator. Don't go if you are not ready to work and swallow your false pride.

Has her pets... is obnoxious...if you aren't one of her favorites WATCH OUT... she is a bit nasty w/ words and very harsh grader- especially if you aren't on her buddy list... I wasn't and it was my ONLY B in four years
takes her anger out on you, if she's having a bad day you will know it! does teach good skills. she plays favorites. good at being honest.
Maureen is amazing.  She will be able to give you the skills and confidence to be successful.  Also, her stories are fantastic.
Learned more from this crazy woman than I ever learned from any other teacher.

She is and amazing professor. I learned more from her than any other art teacher I have ever had.  Great sense of humor, loves to joke around but has high standards for students to meet and don't ever be late..  Class with her is a once in a lifetime experience. I wish she wasn't leaving :(
Great Woman. Taking her class is a valuable experience. Once in a lifetime.
She's one crazy lady... lol.  She'll make you work hard and don't ever be late!

She is awesome!!

Dr. Davio was the worst lab professor I have ever had. In the beginning of the semester he seemed like a nice guy and then completely changed the way he graded - he became a harsh grader with absolutely no reason backing up the poor grades. He is very disagreeable and disconnected from college grading and expectations. Do not take a lab with him.

A good thing about a course with Morris is he grades by few things so you have an opportunity to focus on your other courses. He has a great sense of humor.. he is always joking around. He is a little intimidating at times but its just the strictness older adults convey. I think he generally wants students to do well. I recommend asking questions

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Hilarious', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS']
comment: Pretty funny guy but somewhat of a harsh grader. You don't get many opportunities for an A. The main grades are the two papers and the group project. For the project, after presenting he roasts your entire presentation so he prepared for some harsh criticism.

I took history with Morris, and I learned a ton from him. I will be grateful for the rest of my life for the presentation skills that he taught our class. He is intimidating, but very kind and funny. He treats and talks to his students like real adults.  Nothing but respect for him.

Morris had a good appeal to me because i liked history, but I really hated the fact that the curriculum was based on reading numerous books. On top of that essays were assigned about every week. Hint to the college life!

I loved this class and Mr. Morris! As long as you put in solid effort you will get atleast a B, and if you have any questions or need help with an assignment he will pull great information out of you. I cant wait to take another Morris class! Would recommend to anyone not just history majors.

Loved him so much! Amazing teacher, and would take classes with him over and over again! Very helpful and always has the students best interest in mind. Can't say enough about how much I loved him as a professor!
He is awesome! He is so funny and makes talking to him and class fun. I love his jokes, and is quick to return papers. Can be confusing at times, but is most lenient in the department.
It is as if he grades arbitrarily.

Is this the same Paul Morris that once worked as a History teacher at Wagner Junior High School in New York City during the late 1970's, I had him for History!  Ancient history and he was short, blond, blue eyes and I had a huge crush on him, same guy?

If I had a history class it was with him... he is the most interesting man.  Full of stories and a font of knowledge... I suggest taking the class- he let me write papers based on my OWN major when in was realted to history... it was so interesting... love his classes... five star rating from me... he is a tough cookie though- work hard

You'd better be prepared to work hard. The class is great, some of the books are painful but it's worth the work. He says we could eat Ivy Leaguers for breakfast and after this class I believe him. He can be unclear about some things. That's just to make sure you have to work hard and think about what you're doing. He's not going to spoon feed you.

He seems REALLY intimidating, but once you get to know him, and the culture of the department, it's not bad. Quirky, eccentric sense of humor... insists on being called "Commissar" (Soviet military position) lol... Do the work, try in his class, and laugh at his jokes, you'll be ok.
he's intimidating but its an act because he's a really nice guy and is pretty funny. expects a lot from students but is a fair grader. chooses interesting texts.

Great teacher...can be kind of intimidating at first, but as long as your honest, and try hard in the class...you'll get a lot out of it.  Definitely learned a lot from him.. good sense of humor, knows his stuff.  Readings for class were challenging, class work takes effort, and definitely GO TO CLASS!
He thinks a 12-15 page paper is short.  There ya go lol.  Otherwise, he's really smart and will help any way he can.

VERY boring.  Class was boring, reading was boring, assignments were boring.  He is slightly funny at times, but not worth taking an entire class for.  If you are only taking it for a PI or PII, don't take it with him!

Ok he is rough, hard grader, and a lot of work, but I feel like I am actually learning something. He definately can work on his clarity of what he wants in a paper though. As for being difficult- at least he is fair and equally difficult accross the board
No Comments

He can be a bit harsh at times, but mostly, he is a great guy.  Whether you like him or not, you will admit he is a great teacher, he makes you think about history in a way you never have before.  He praises good work, but makes it VERY clear when you do bad in the class.  He is hilarious!  If you cant handle jokes made about you though, you better toughen up, because he may strike at any time without warning.... watch out.
I loved this class, you'll have to do work to earn your grade but it's worth it, he knows about some much stuff, even if the conversation seems like its getting side tracked he'll have a point

At first I was a bit scared by Paul Morris's bombing and anthrax talks, but then you get used to it.  What was impressive to me is that he remembered my name after the first day of class. He is very witty but knows his stuff. If you can't take a joke- don't take his class

The first day I met him, he came off as a grumpy old man, but he definitely grows on you. You come to learn his sense of humor and ways of teaching. I've heard that he's better for History, but he was okay for Freshman Seminar. He is definitely the hardest Fresh Sem teacher, though.

I can see how he can come off as a jerk, but he's really an excellent proffesor and a cool guy. He doesn't use textbooks much, and is a great lecturer. Helpful, but won't kiss your ass. Above all, he's extremely intelligent.

Funny guy, very sarcastic. He definitely knows his stuff. He has the class decide a couple of your major grades, true, but it helps keep away the bias and so that you don't only have to impress him...that's important in real life.

I'll admit i did not like him at the beginning but Paul is one of the best all-around people i have ever known. Very down to earth, helpful, and understanding. I can't wait to take another class with him!
He sometimes doesn't know how to treat students well.

I cannot tolerate this man. CANNOT. I am able to handle sarcasm and constructive critism. But when he publicly attacks a single student for something that we all are guilty of, I will NOT stand for it. He is the epitome of all that is unjust.
Best all around. Funny as hell, and he's Irish!
This guy is a complete jerk. Are you serious with the happy faces???
HE is one of my favorite history teachers, I have taken two classes with him already and am taking another one next semester!!! He is great... he jokes all the time!!

He lets one of your major grades in the class be decided by a class vote. It totally screwed up my GPA. I would have a had a 4.0, and I did a good project, but the class didn't like the rest of our group. He gave me an A on it, but the class gave me a B.
very creative and interesting. i didnt like his style of teaching as much but still an okay teacher.
He is an excellent professor as long as you can keep up with his pace.  Sarcastic and witty, always gets a chuckle out of the class.
No Comments
awesome
Very sarcastic and funny but knows his stuff; killer work in some classes
terrible
He is a great teacher, he knows his stuff and relates it to modern ideas.

tags: ['Tough Grader', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'EXTRA CREDIT']
comment: Dr. Brown is very scattered during her lectures and is not always helpful when answering questions. She often leaves you very confused especially when she tries to lecture 60+ powerpoint slides in a 50 minute lecture class. Would not recommend this professor unless you are willing to read the textbooks and learn on your own.

tags: ['Tough Grader', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'TEST HEAVY']
comment: This teacher is disrespectful towards students asking questions. She loses her train of thought and will leave your questions unanswered and when she does answer then, the answers are not specific at all. The material does not match up to anything in the textbook and the learning objectives are not accurate.

Long story short, expect the unexpected. The tests aren't necessarily hard they just don't contain much of the information presented in class or on the study guides - read carefully. She is very enthusiastic and wants her students to learn. If you ever have questions she's always there to answer them, even if her answers don't make sense. Good luck

Worst teacher ever. I never learned anything during class. Even if we learned stuff in class you never knew what was on the tests. The only thing that helped me pass her class is that I went to the bio tutoring sessions (highly recommend). If you have a chance to switch out of er class do it!!

Hardest class of my life, the course itself is a total waste of time. She didn't grade anything yet (1week til end of classes). She is technologically challenged and should not be a teacher at this institution. I cant say anything good about this "Teacher." Oh, the quizzes? Try google because it is on a different spectrum than what we "learned".

Dr. Brown is  friendly and passionate about plants! She goes through lectures quickly and they aren't very useful. The textbook is a better source of information. I would recommend using the textbook to study for her exams rather than her powerpoints and lectures. She also gives long assignments. Be prepared to spend a lot of time on this class!

Worst teacher I've ever had. Has no idea what she is teaching and tests are never on what we learn in class. If you want to do semi-decent you need to completely read the whole text book. If you value education and don't want to hate biology DO NOT take a class with her.

Worst Professor ever!!! Assignments are made up on the spot, as are tests. Nothing is made clear. Coming from a Bio major if you really value your education DO NOT TAKE A CLASS WITH THIS WOMAN!!! Take it somewhere else and transfer it in.

If you read the chapters and do the learning objectives you will do FINE! Its common sense but you have to know your stuff. She is picky on the tests. This year she cut a lot of things out, so I think it is easy just a lot of work. She is nice just sometimes doesnt know what shes talking about and can be crazy. Its only one semester for bio.
Her way of teaching is crazy.  Doesn't make sense at all.  Switched out of her class cause I could not stand it.  If you want to learn, don't get this teacher!
Not a bio major anymore, at least she forced me to find a good major--> COME TO THE HISTORY SIDE ALL YE DISGRUNTLED AND DISENCHANTED BIO MAJORS!! :)
She's very flexible and willing to listen.  She truly cares about her students.

Worst professor at naz. Doesn't know what she is talking about, unfair grader. Doesn't help when you ask for it. Some students are campaigning to get her fired. Don't take a class with this woman. She is terrible. She'll mark things wrong on your paper and give other people points for the same answer. She'll make you hate biology.

I liked him. Sometimes his lectures seem boring, but very easy class for an LC. Most work it simply looking things up online and participating in discussions.

He gives extra credit, but if you are a working student, you won't get any of it. His first quiz makes you feel like you can pass the class, then he rips you into pieces for the midterm. The grade for that midterm is conveniently posted AFTER you can drop  with a W- you're stuck. He will use pop quizzes to get the class because no one reads.

This class isn't the best, but it's super easy. Have had Dunbar in other classes and they are better. Just not a fan of religion, but again, a very easy class if you do the readings. He's the best professor on campus.

Definitely take him! He's a cool guy, super laid back,. Tests can be pretty hard, but there are opportunities for extra credit if you go to events. His lectures can be short, some long. He's very helpful, passionate about what he teaches. Never was a fan of religion courses before, he made them worthwhile.
Love him. Hands down the best professor here at Fisher that I've had. Always willing to help. Understanding, and funny. Take his class.

Very boring lecture and you have to go to class and participate. 4 mini quizzes but very easy. Take home midterm and final. Very little homework (not really mandatory since he doesn't collect it). Takes about 4 weeks to grade assignments if not more. Very easy class, easy A.

His lecture follows along with the textbook and he points out exactly what is important. So come to class and pay attention and you'll get an A. When he plays a movie, come to class. It WILL be on a quiz... But, He's awesome. Take his class, bottom line.
Highly recommend taking this P2 core with Dunbar. Very boring lecture ever class, but one of the easiest A's you can get. 4 quizzes, open book midterm and open book final.

Loved this class and professor! Class was interesting, exams were fair, projects were helpful and made me realize about some changes I needed to make in my life. I liked all the activities we did in class too. I'm hoping to take more classes with her!
She's a nice professor but very boring in her lectures. She also takes forever to grade things. Her class is very lecture heavy. Her test are also heavily graded.
Overall pretty easy class, but you can't miss any classes or your grade might drop. Doesn't really respect sick days. Very nice professor and very clear and fair grader, enjoyed the class.

This is my favorite class I've taken. McB set the class up so that you actually do real things that matter instead of always sitting through lecture. I learned a lot that I didn't realize before and the project made me feel like I'd really made a difference. Love this professor and will take a class with her again any chance I get.

McB is the best. This was a class I actually looked forward to. You can tell she cares a lot about her students and is excited about what she teaches. She gives a lot of examples and explains things if you don't get it right away. I liked the kindness project we did. Not exams so much but at least we could drop one and the questions were fair.
Love this class and professor. Class was always interesting and fun and I actually looked forward to it! Id take another class from her again in a heartbeat.

I was nervous because I'm not a math person but I ended up actually liking the class and doing better than I thought. McB is the best and you can tell she really cares about her students. She explained things in a clear way and was always willing to help me and didn't make me feel stupid. Yes a lot of homework in this class but tbh it did help.

I love her! She really cares about her students and makes it easy to do well if you just put in the work. She gives lots of chances to do well even if you dont do as well the first time on things or if you miss something. I also learned so much and have been using things I learned to improve different parts of my life. Highly recommend!
Not flexible at all with deadlines even though she claims to be accommodating

a pretty decent professor but not my favorite the worst part about the class is the amount of google forms she will make you fill out every class however she is a really nice person and is willing to help with and go over material if you dont understand it

I'm so surprised McB has a 2.0 on here. She has the most prepared, well structured, and clear lectures out of almost all professors that I have had. The expectations for tests and assignments could not be clearer. She is very approachable outside of class, and very willing to adjust course material based on student interest. She's awesome.
