Dr. Lowe is an amazing professor! I really enjoyed taking her class. She is very strict about due dates.

I love Dr. Lowe. She will give you a lot of assignments, but they are mostly small assignments so it is generally manageable. She is fun to be around, thoughtful with her words, and always smiling. If I needed another elective course I would take another class of hers in a heartbeat (I'm not a Phil major, I had one of her classes as a core filler)

I was missing an assignment due to medical reasons, and she made me sit and wouldn't let me leave until I had done so. It was annoying that she wouldn't take my word for it, even though I had everything else turned in. She's okay, I wouldn't take it again.

Dr. Lowe gives an insane amount of work for a class that is meant to improve your grade. She is insanely passive aggressive and rude, but only to particular students. She either loves you or she hates you. I would never take a class with her again.

comment: While this class wasn't particularly difficult, boy was it time consuming. There were group assignments, discussion boards, and write ups constantly. The week before and leading up to your presentation, this better be your main focus because there is a lot to do. Nice professor, but a lot of out of class work and group coordination.

Class of 09. The fact that I am still thinking about Dr. Lowes Philosophy of Identity class, 11 years later, says something in and of itself. Dr. Lowe is brilliantly intelligent, incredibly warm, and so gentle with everyone. She has a tender and open heart. Her class awakened me to the nuances of race, class, language, religion, + humanity itself

Very discussion based class. Great professor and passionate about the work. Takes a while to receive feedback but she is easy to talk to and cares about your opinions and well-being. Tests are easy if you study. A bit too much work if you ask me but survivable
Barb is amazing. She may get a little disorganized but has a heart if gold. One the most caring professors you could ask for. Course is not too bad, just submit your work on time.

comment: Get ready to do homework. Every class there are multiple different assignments due. She can also get a bit frazzled and disoriented at times which gets a little confusing. had her for my LC. Lots of reading and her lectures were pretty boring. Don't really need to buy the books.

Very nice professor. She will help if asked. Her class was straight forward, and she made it easy to understand the assignments and readings. Her class will get you thinking, and she always explains things so that everything makes sense.

I loved Dr. Lowe's class. She is an amazing person. Smart. Kind. If I was majoring in philosophy, I'd take another class with her! She expects you to work. Do the work, and you will be fine.

Very confusing about assignments and what she expected. Does not believe in giving A's (says they are for outstanding). Nice and a little spacey but overall I would not recommend taking a class with her unless you want to see your GPA drop.
Really, really nice lady but classes can be pretty dry.  Tests are fair and the one group project you do (which was a film based project) was pretty easy. I would recommend her.
Random quizzes on assigned readings, three exams over important readings, and a final group presentation.  If you keep up with your readings and participate in class, you should do fine.
She is a great professor. Willing to go above and beyond to help students in any way possible. Can be a hard gradeder at times but overall I loved her as a professor! Take a class with her :)
Very easy to understand, she is also very helpful. I also enjoyed the open discussions!

not a bad class. if you do the readings and pay attention you will be fine. she is willing to listen to your ideas and takes the time to explain hers if you dont understand. she can be very humorous at times! laugh with her!
Excellent teacher--makes a challenging subject matter interesting. Activities and group work add a lot to class.

One of the laziest professors ever. Likes kids to teach themselves. One could take a self learing program from home for a lot less money. Lets not forget the $3000 it cost to sit in the hell that is her class.
She's sweet, helpful, and caring. Fresh Sem is a non-class but be glad if you have her. Classes are laid-back - easy A.

Least favorite teacher at Fisher so far. Many people (guys) disliked her because she is very unfair and unclear about grades. She is not open to ideas and very ****...no joke.  I would rate her an S- (thats her grading system which is still unclear at the end of the semester).
Seems kind of a pushover

Readings assigned for class were very diffucult to read, but she explains them in class which is very helpful. Theres not a whole lot of work and she offers lots of advice. Overall i would defintely say you should take her class.

No Comments
She makes boring topics easy to understand. She also grades fair. There is a lot of reading though and it is kind of difficult. She keeps class interesting though. The time passes quickly
Blowe's readings are hard I thought I was reading another language. You have to participate in class and attendence does count.

Barb grades hard for an intro course and grades how much students speak out in class on a daily basis. Thinks kids want to take the class but they only show to pass their religion/philosophy requirement.

Very good teacher...kept class interesting and let us have a say in the matter.  Lots of group work, hardly any lecture.  Makes boring subject fun! highly recommend
Awesome class..took a boring subject (Plato, Aristotle..) and made it not so bad.  Highly Recommended!
Very open classroom.  We have good discussions almost every class.

I really like professor Lowe's class, it was the only class at Fisher where students could speak their minds. All other classes here we just sit and listen, she lets us interact. The grading system is a little off, but otherwise was a fun class.

Good professor and clearly knowledgeable, enjoys chemistry. I don't know if he understands how far less knowledgable we are than him. I think he is one of the best professors I have had. He knows what he is talking about and he will make time for you outside of class if you need help. The work is so easy and all you really need to do is participate. The HW is so easy as you get multiple attempts and the tests aren't hard either as he prepares you well. Highly recommend.

The absolute worst professor Ive ever had. Explains Unrelated things things when asked a question and as a student, you dont have a clue whats going on. Dr. I does not have good people skills and does not know how to teach. He is very knowledgeable but expects us to know all of the material already. Beware of taking quizzes and tests because they'll be on stuff that he didn't even mention at times.

Worst professor I've ever had. He's terrible at explaining anything and he expects you to know everything already. Quizzes and tests are unfair because he tests you on material that he has never even talked about. Terrible. Do not take organic chemistry with him.

Do the work after class and you will see he's actually a good professor.
Worst professor Ive ever had. Cant explain anything and expects you to know everything already. Quizzes and tests are unfair. Terrible. Do not take organic chemistry with this man.

Dr. Bonner is a great professor who really cares about her students. She is always available to help and provides great study guides to help prepare for her exams. It's a tough course, but you get what you put in. I would highly recommend taking a class with her!

I think that Jane was a good professor and I would take classes with her again. Not a great lecture style when it comes to presentations but is relatively understanding and provides interesting class discussions.

It was a fun class with a few guest speakers. The work load was not bad considering the layout of the course. I would recommend her, however, not for this course because she repeatedly told us that she grades honors students harder than her typical students. She would also take course feedback personally so it was hard to do opinion assignments.
Amazing professor, super excited to take more classes with her!
She is truly intelligent. She is knowledegable in more subjects at Fisher than I expected one single teacher to be, which she teaches many of as well!

Jane is the sweetest professor I've ever met, she really cares about your grades and will get to know you personally. Law of Investigations was a great course with her. She kept class interesting with guest speakers, movies, and class discussion. LOTS of class discussion, but it really helped. She responds quickly to emails. Love her.

I would recommend Mrs. Snyder to anyone taking an anatomy class. She truly cares about her students and you can tell she wants you to succeed. It's hard to do badly in her class if you utilize the TONS of resources she gives you. She hands out homework/take-home quizzes and study guides that make up a great portion of her tests. Super sweet as well

Jane Snyder is so reasonable and nice! I loved her class. She does give out a lot of random, short papers/assignments, but easy to complete. Only two tests all year and very easy and fair (10 short answer questions). Really cares about her students and wants them to do well. I would definitely take one of her classes again.
Dr. Snyder is a peach. Will get to know you personally. Easy grader. Very interesting and fun lectures/class discussions. Brought in food often. Easy midterm and final.
this was my learning community class and I absolutely loved it. Jane Snyder is AMAZING and I cannot wait to take classes with her in the future!!
If you attend every class, you receive 5 points on your overall average

Took her two semesters in a row because I love her! By far the most influential teacher I have ever had in my educational career. Couldn't say enough good things about her, and she really cares about each individual. If you want an easy good grade while learning something with an awesome professor take Snyder you will never regret it
I LOVE HER. So cute and funny.

I LOVE HER! She is one of the best professors I have ever had. She really cares about her students and is always there to help. She works her hardest for you to really understand the material so she isn't just teaching to teach. Participate in her class, you'll get a lot out of it! I recommend her to anyone who can take her class!
such a sweetheart. came over for dinner. best teacher ever. easy as hell too
Awesome teacher! She is very understanding and willing to help. I would recommend her to anyone that is thinking about taking a class from her. Great teacher!
Great professor. Loved her class and her personality.

Jane is the best teacher I have ever had. She always believes in her students and is so helpful. After you take her class you are bonded with her because she really wants the best for her students and she will often communicate with her past students. She is the most incredible teacher.
Awesome, just awesome

Awesome professor, very helpful, very nice, and very explanatory. She goes over everything before the midterm and final basically telling you what to study. Do the reading for this class and your guaranteed an A easily. There are no wrong answers as long as you can explain your reasoning in her class. Take this if you can.
Not bad of a professor.
She's nice and I can tell she means well. She never grades on time but does give thorough feedback. Almost no instructions either. Never got my in person midterm back
I enjoy classes with Professor Bianco. She is fun to banter with and she does her best to make the class exciting. Even if its about terrorism or genocide
She was ok but not very clear on grading at all so it is hard to know how well you are doing throughout the semester. She gives good information and class discussions but the grading is a big issue.

Dr. Laz is an amazing professor. I took his Art History course that is offered for the Honors program, and it was a good time. He always came to class ready to go, and was always in a good mood, leaving others inspired to learn. He also gives great feedback, and is willing to help you with just about anything. Would highly recommend him.
Every class is just a lecture but he is clearly passionate about what he is teaching. I hope I can take another class with him!

He had no idea what our class would be doing, he wanted us to come up with pretty much everything on our own. Then he gives us basically zero concrete expectations for anything but grades us harshly for not doing things the way that he wants us to.

Dr. Laz is funny but try to avoid 3 hr classes with him at all costs. 2nd half of the semester he let us out early, but 1st half was rough. He's a nice guy & just wanted us to learn something by the end. He talks in circles and wants you to parrot back his points. Sometimes looks for answers that seem obvious. Not awful but not my favorite.
I enjoyed my political science class with him! Super friendly and advocates for all his students. I recommend!

*Prof L. is pretty nice but he also likes shock value/being difficult. You might be able to get an A (I did) but it also might be a bit of a gamble as he's hard to read. If you do take his class, run your essay ideas by him so you can tailor to his advice. Being a good negotiator/friendly helps you answer his questions/soften him.*

Dr. Laz is a great guy who really knows his stuff. Taking a political science class I was nervous he would be very pushing when it came to political beliefs, but he is not. Dr. Laz loves when you heavily participate in class and is a very fair grader. If you can, definitely take a class with him!
Dr Laz is the best. He cares about his students and wants to make sure they succeed in his class and outside. If you work with him and put in some effort you will be sure to do well.

tags: ['Participation matters', 'ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS']
comment: A very interactive professor in the classroom. I went to him for help in better understanding the material and he sat with me and talked through the material for more time than I think most professors would. He genuinely cares about the success of his students and really makes it a fun, enjoyable class that's very engaging.
Such a good class. And that accent is adorable.

Dr. Laz is great, he has "pop" quizzes which he tells you about. He engages the students along with making jokes and really makes the class worth going to. He has no "tests" instead its a paper and a verbal conversation that the majority of grade is is made up with.

Awesome professor. Very entertaining and engaging. When he talks fast, his accent gets hard to understand, but you get the general idea. He keeps this interesting while still teaching a lot. Very willing to meet during his office hours. Throughout the semester you have 7 quizzes based on notes & reading but you never know when you'll have them.

Very Very helpful!! Exams were hard, however she listens to class and can curve grades if necessary. She brought home made cookies and cakes most of the times in class. Overall she is very sweet and kind lady who will be there for you if asked for help!!

Prof. Copeland seems to be overworked and struggles to dedicate enough time to her students. She has other students do her grading so if you have a question about what you did wrong on a test she has no idea how to respond. She is a really nice person but is very disorganized and for this reason I would not take another class with her.
Awesome. Best Accounting Teacher at SJFC.
One of the most beneficial classes. Teacher really cared. Hard but worth it.
Take her! Cares about her students, and is willing to spend time to make sure you understand concepts.
Excellent Teachers. Very helpful. Hard class, but learned a lot
Excellent Teachers. One of the best I have had. Very helpful. Hard class, but learned a lot

This professor is the best that Ive ever had in all my years of school! She is beyond helpful and very willing to answer questions, meet during office hours and after class. I would recommend this professor. Take 101 with her!

The hardest class I have taken at Fisher so far. She goes on tangents during class and rarely gets a problem right in class when she does it herself. Students have to constantly correct her. Test are impossible to pass. She is extremely friendly but overall useless, you teach yourself all the material out of the text book. Hw is irrelevent to test.
Very Helpful. Spends a lot of time outside of class helping students.

She is a very nice lady, but goes on tangents during class and rarely goes over real world examples.  The quizzes and tests are almost impossible to pass and homework is almost useless because it’s irrelevant to what you’re tested on.  Buckle up and brace yourself.  The Fisher accounting program sucks - period.

Accounting is not a fun topic in my opinion. The equations, theories, and concepts, are at times, rather difficult to understand.  Prof. Copeland is eager to provide assistance when you need it and she is great at getting back to you via email & phone. However, this class was hard, time consuming, and considerably difficult to get a good grade in.

Professor Gantner is good for data. He's really engaging and def makes sure every student gets the help they need. You do get a lot of work but you get a good amount done in class, like pretty much every assignment you get time to do work. Make sure to pay attention because if you fall behind it's almost impossible to pick back up without help.

He is honestly the best professor in the math department. He seriously cares about his students and teaches in a way that is so helpful for students. I could not possibly recommend this professor enough!!
Gantner is so good as a professor. He is so funny and he makes class so fun and engaging. Would definitely take his class again.

Although he gives lots of homework he gives you lots of time in class to do it. You might only have to do like 30 minutes of work outside of class. He's a funny guy and tries to engage the class. Pretty good at explaining things and shows you step by step how to complete assignments.
He is amazing and has a great personality. I would take any of his classes again in a heartbeat!!

I loved Gantner,i had him for predicting the future. He was funny and made class fun and interesting! He was always will to help outside of class and he cares. There are a lot of assignments but most you do in class so dont skip! There is lots of hw to but its a doable class. He does talk pretty fast when teaching but you can always ask questions

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Lots of homework', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: One of the best, if not the best in the math department. Always willing to help students get where they need to go. If you do all of the classwork and homework, then it is much easier to understand. Lots of group work for classwork. Grading scale really odd at first, but takes a lot of pressure off tests and quizzes.

Very inclusive in his classroom. He always wants what is best for his students, even if that means that he will have to push them when they don't want to be pushed. Dr. Gantner will help anyone to the best of his ability, but you need to put in the work on your end in order to understand the material.
Big fan of his. Very good teacher who cares a lot. Cares that students understand what he is teaching.

Dr. Gantner was awesome! I had him for Calc 2 and he is super energetic and is clearly interested in what he's teaching ... the tests are difficult, but do the assigned homework and study and you'll be fine. I wish I could take all of my math classes with him.

I didn't appreciate it while I was taking the class, but the inverted class structure actually helps you become a better learner and problem solver. He gives you a good grade for the amount of effort you put in and is extremely helpful and kind. I definitely recommend class with him.

He is super enthusiastic about math, but a little all over the place. Did not like the "flipped" structure of the class, we got a short lecture then had to read the book to teach ourselves. Did not always get the follow up lecture and more difficult problems as planned. Ended up watching videos online. He is very helpful if you go to office hours.
Dr gantner is the best professor in the math department...take as many classes with him as possible
Had him for Calc II, good teacher, not too easy though.  Would recommend as a good teacher although not the best.  When taking his class pay attention and study and you can get an A.

Dr. Gantner is an awesome professor. Highly energetic and truly loves to teach. He is very flexible and reasonable with assignment due dates and is very clear on material for tests. I would take every one of my Math classes with him if I could.

Dr. Gantner is a cool person. He's energetic, loves to teach, and will help you any time you ask. There's not much homework; occasional online assignments. The tests are challenging, though. I highly recommend taking calc 2 with him, especially if you have a hard time understanding the topic.
Great prof.  would recommend to anyone taking a math class.  good teaching style and more than willing to help anyone outside of class.

I had him for Calc 1 and 2, he is an amazing professor. Just pay attention in class, and study those notes for Calc 1 and it's and easy A. Calc2 has topic mastery where you just have to "attempt" your homework by a certain date but you can re-do it as many times as you want, as well as the quizzes for full credit, very easy to do well in.
Amazing teacher, extremely nice. Made the class fun and easier to understand. If u have to take a math class, take it with him

She's def really caring and wants you to do well. You get cheat sheets on all exams which is very helpful. The classes are boring and it's just her doing the notes. She's not good at explaining but the course is easy to do well in. Don't be afraid to get a tutor to explain materials. Overall I would take another class with her.

She gave cheat sheets on every exam, even final and midterms. Often talks about the same thing many times and waste time on lectures she already did. Open for help and questions. Great and easy course.
Dr. Chang is not a great professor. The lectures are boring with no interaction with the class. In addition, things are not explained very well.

Professor Chang is a very nice professor and cares about her students. Her classes are extremely boring, though and she isn't always the most interactive in class. I had her for microeconomics, and overall, the class was very easy, just super boring. She allows cheat sheets on midterms and finals, which is nice. Easy class but very boring.

Chang is a kind and caring professor, but she often seems unsure of the material and is very hard to understand due to her quiet voice and limited English. Classes mostly consist of her reading slides for 55 minutes with minimal clarification or engagement. If you take economics with her, expect to teach yourself most of the content outside class.

Chang is super sweet and really cares about her students. The coursework is super easy and as long as you use the allowed cheatsheet for the tests then you will be fine. Her lectures can be a bit boring but it's defientely worth it to take classes with her!

Fix is def really caring and loves what she does. I took the night class with her. It was super easy, you get 3 projects which are all honestly fun and 2 exams which are take home. She's not very good at lecturing and classes can be boring but honestly if you just show up and do the assignments you will pass. You also do a mock trial at the end.

Took her late night class and we got out early every time. Had two exams, both take home, and 3 projects that were easy and fun. She try to make it fun, but its mostly just lectures. You could pass and never listen to a thing she says. Very Sweet lady!

Super nice, only 3 projects the entire semester and the midterm and final were take home. The classes do get a little boring and theyre very powerpoint heavy and kind of unorganized, but overall I would take her again

She is a great professor! I would highly recommend her if she is an option for any course. She is very knowledgable and she is very understanding with students. She does not overwhelm you with assignments and is very fun to be around. I learned a lot in her course.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Group projects', 'Beware of pop quizzes']
comment: Mcjury was a great professor. You do have to read from the textbook a lot but if you do well on all the reading checks (pop quizzes) you'll be fine. You do a lot of group work and projects which are fun. Participation and attendance is absolutely mandatory. Overall I enjoyed the content, she's very engaging and I thought the course was fun.
Honestly if you know anything about sports you're fine. She's very nice and genuinely does care for you if you have any problems/questions

Professor McJury is amazing. The course is set up and planned well and all assignments add to the value of the course. All her tests are open note, and she is an easy grader so it is easy to do well in her class.

Stay away from this teacher! She's the worst. Thinks she knows everything about sports and flips out over every little thing, like checking your phone if your mom texts you or if something serious happens. And if you're sick or have surgery, you can't miss more than two days. Seriously avoid her classes if you want to sleep peacefully at night

Professor Harter is really great. She's a great resource for anything you may have questions on while navigating your freshman year. She's super understanding and kind. The course wasn't very difficult, very engaging and entertaining and she will make an effort to always help you and make sure you do well. I loved her.

Professor Harter is the best professor I have ever had. I seriously could not have made it this far without her. She is so nice and actually cares about her students. Hands-down the best professor I have ever had and I would take any class she taught in a heartbeat.
She is amazing! She is really easy to talk to and super understanding. Also not a harsh grader at all, and is looking for the best out of you.
Amazing, is very involved

The professor was pretty chill when I had him. He assigned a paper to write each week with a few free passes due to his error in the syllabus. He is pretty flexible with deadlines. It was strange that he allowed us to use ChatGPT roughly halfway into the semester, but it just made the class much easier. I guess he wanted to see the utility of it.

Professor Kunsch is one of the most well-rounded instructors I have ever been taught by, he truly understands what he is teaching and has a passion for sharing his knowledge. However, beware of the online tests, they are meant for grad students and are very hard. Weekly papers are easy if you put in a good effort and come prepared to participate.
Professor Kunsch is a nice guy just his tests are brutal his tests are over what is read not what he talks about in class and I read the book and I still didnt understand a lot of the tests
Tests over what was read and not the class discussion which made up the majority of the class. Group projects which aren't really fair if you have a bad group. ok class.

The class was all discussion based besides 2 classes of lecture. The lectures and the book are what the tests are on so make sure you read. The final project was a group project and you have a good amount of time in class to work on it.

Great teacher and very laid back guy.  The simulation is a lot of fun and his lectures only last half a class, the other half you work on the simulation or can leave. Tests are hard but if you read and study practice questions you will be fine.  Also curves every test and assignment to make sure you get a good grade.

The material is not easy at all but he curves all grades and makes the grading fair. If you study his exams are not bad and final is optional. You will have group presentations and a simulation. Which is not easy but grades are curved.

Best professor at Fisher! He is extremely intelligent and makes the material both comprehensible and enjoyable.  Laid back and easy to talk to converse with.  His vast experience and knowledge add that personal touch to the class and make the material relevant in both his undergrad and graduate level courses... Tough tests though!
He is an interesting professor and makes lectures enjoyable and interactive. He is laid back and makes it easy to participate during class even if you have trouble speaking in front of people.

Kunsch is one of my favorite people of all time. Unlike many professors, he will never put his views on you and he actively encourages everyone to share their views - he is an exceptional man for this reason. His #1 priority is that you comprehend and can apply the material. If you have the opportunity, take a class with him - you won't regret it.
Great professor, make sure to read the cases before class!

Cool guy. The stuff he teaches you will actually help you in other classes (especially graduate classes) and in real life. I still remember a lot of what I studied for in this class. The class has a good variety in it too, straying away from pure lecture. Grading is a little complicated but there's a curve.
One of my favorite professors at Fisher. Cool guy and very helpful if you go and see him. Tests are difficult but they're curved.
Best MGMT Professor ever! Content was boring but he made it more interesting with his stories. Extra credit was available if you went to class and tests were hard but curved.
Great professor...very approachable and very well prepared for class...lots of industry experience.
Amazing was very considerate
She's very chill and easy going but also cares about your success.
She's chill. I decided to have her again. Her classes are easy and she doesn't assign a lot of work
Gotta be the best professor ive had, didnt do any more than 30 minutes of work outside of class and got an A+.

Very understanding. She likes to talk a lot but she's very enthusiastic. We didn't have too much homework, only every once in a while. Lots of group projects since this was an LC but they were easy. Be ready to give presentations.
His 300 level class is very easy. It's mostly just lectures slides, no homework and at the end of the semester, you just have a group project to do

Really nice and understanding, doesn't assign much work besides weekly readings. Goes on tangents but they're always interesting and at least somewhat connected to the class topic. He does talk about his views a bit but will pull up sources to back up what he's saying.

He was a very nice and easy professor just was very disorganized. Would come late every day to class. Would go on tangents about his hatred for Trump and Elon. The class was basically him talking about his views.

I've taken him all three semesters I've been at Fisher. Personally I find him very funny, he is really passionate about criminology and will answer just about any question you ask him. He can be a bit all over the place and doesn't alway follow the syllabus, so if you are someone who needs a very structured class he may not be for you.
Very monotone, and the class is boring. Had lots of quizzes, debates and essays to do but they're easy! He literally tells u to use chat gpt.

tags: ['Clear grading criteria', 'Lecture heavy', 'Graded by few things']
comment: Monotone lecturer, very easy to fall asleep in his classes. Although his criteria for grading is very easy. Two lectures every week, with a quiz, then after every 3 quizzes there's an exam on them. No final and he also drops your lowest quiz grade for you.

This class was fully online, so I will be rating him as an online professor (obviously). Slideshows and recorded lectures were quite hefty, some more than others. One very easy homework assignment a week as well as one quiz a week which difficulty depends. He frequently reached out via email to give updates. Easy online class but material is hefty

Dry humor, but an awesome professor. I loved this class because of how interesting it is. You are put into groups at the beginning of the semester and remain in that group for the duration of the class (Pick your groups wisely because you do 3-5 group projects with them). Professor Baranov grades on a gpa scale.
horrible professor. super boring and not engaging. messed up my whole year because of unclear advise

no tests quizzes or exams, a paper a week needed to be about 8 pages for and A.  not too hard to write the papers they are on vary easy topics, i.e. death penalty, gay marriage. he may be boring but the class is easy

Took this as a Wednesday afternoon class (3 hours), and it was so bad after the first three classes that I dropped it. He would lecture for an hour and things would make a tad bit of sense, even though he's completely monotone and goes off on random tangents. Movie after. He expected a 10 page paper afterwords. I thought my papers were great: NOPE.

I like him, & his humor. He assigns readings every week & then makes you write an essay on it. It's a lot of writing & reading especially because the papers have to be long. I'd write 3-5 pages and get a C. I have to write 8 or 9 for an A. It's possible to get a good grade in the class, but you must work for it. Not a class you can breeze through.
No tests or quizzes just a weekly paper, not too hard to write and a group debate are the only grades, he's a good dude

His class is an easy A if you do the weekly assignment, and do the two debates. Dry sense of humor; however, I thought he was funny. For those saying their grades didn't improve, you must not have done anything, because I asked him what I could do to improve and within two weeks I went from receiving B- to an A each week. I would recommend him.

An odd guy but cool. Dry sense of humor. A weekly writing assignment, 3-4 pages long. Two team debates. Very hard grader. It seemed like our grades never changed from week to week, which is odd. No matter what, I got the same grade on my papers every week and so didn't my teammates and others I spoke to. I'd still recommend him though.
LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE :) dry humor but THE MAN! alot of work but isnt a hard grader. looooove! :)
All i have to say it ausome teacher, willing to help you out if needed. One assignment a week, no test quizes or anything. And hes funny and sarcastic
He took off crazy points for stupid things, like formatting. The class itsself was pleasant and easy to follow, but his grading of the assignments was ridiculous
No Comments
Way too much work for a sociology elective. Sociological power. There's a 10 page paper in 11 point font, and you have to read four books. He is a decent instructor but is in no way outstanding

Great teacher.  His classes are discussion based.  Funny and knowledgeable.  Almost too cool to be a professor.  Breaks the stereotypes of professors that are boring and not interested in working with the students.  He cares about the students.

So I actually took her immigration cultural experience class and absolutely loved it. She's an amazing professor, very caring and wants u to do well in class. Participating in class matters and there is a lot of reading. Only had to do 2 major group projects and an essay but they were easy. You can easily get an A in the class

never interacted with her in real life since it was an online class so can't give any info about that. so many assignments, tests, and a few partner chats but that's because it was online. i emailed her a few times and she never answered, but always answered a friend of mine so i don't know. overall yea she's fine.
Very nice and explains topics very well.

She was very helpful considering speaking in Spanish is difficult for me. The group projects were just coming together as a group and creating a dialogue that used concepts in class. This was very fun, despite the difficult meeting with groups outside of class. I would take again if I had the chance!

Great professor! So helpful and great at explaining tough concepts. I learned more in her class than I have in any other Spanish class I have taken. Her tests are fair, and the extra credit for every test is pretty nice too. I would definitely take a class with her again!

She is one of the nicest professors I have encountered at Fisher. She's always open to help you, all you need to do is ask! Yes there are packets and questions online, but they were so helpful when it came to practicing, if you do the work and understand it you will do well! She is understanding, helpful and seems to truly care about her students!

This class was such a headache for an elective. A 25+ page packet is assigned for every chapter (that you get no grade for doing), over a hundred online questions for each chapter, in class essays, quizzes, text book assignments, exams, and group work. I hated it and felt constantly lost. I never felt like I could ask her for help either.

I've always struggled with chemistry, so I knew coming into the class I would struggle and I did; but professor Eaton was very understanding. He provides hours office A LOT and is willing to sit down with you and really break down a topic. He is a hard grader but you can retake every exam besides the final. If you try your best you'll make it.

Professor Eaton is the worst professor I have ever had. Don't get me wrong he is a nice guy, but nice guys do not always make good teachers. The flipped classroom does not work for an introductory course. Never once did a lecture explain what we actually did in the classroom. He walks away before even fully answering the question.

Although I finished CHEM120 with an A, I would highly recommend taking this class through your local community college. It's ridiculous how much time and effort you have to spend on this class when most students have several other classes to focus on. His office hours are always bombarded with 5-10 students because he is such a bad professor.

Although there is a web assign and quiz for every class, it does help you with learning the content. He isn't as bad as a teacher as everyone says. I retook every exam and ended up with an A+. He always has office hours to get help and the group work in class is helpful as you work with others! Don't worry about taking his class, it will be okay.

If you are an incoming student reading these reviews about this Lafayette Eaton please don't let them scare you into taking the class. Yes, there is a lot of work outside of class, unnecessary assignments and a lot of partner work... but, all of the tests allow a retake which is not common with professors and he has office hours every weekday

He doesn't teach at all, you have to teach everything to yourself. He assigns so much work which is difficult to balance on top of teaching the content to yourself. Go to office hours after every exam, he made a mistake when grading every single one of my exams. When you ask questions he doesn't answer, he just tells you to look in the textbook.

He doesn't teach anything, you have to learn it yourself. Everyone I know had to get a tutor and the school even ran out of tutors to give. He often makes mistakes when grading your exam so you have to go to office hours to see if he graded it right. When you ask question he doesnt' answer, he tells you to re-read the book. Super unhelpful.

Professor Eaton is a nice person and I think he does try to help students (extra credit on homework, lots of office hours availability, exam retakes). Most of the teaching is done by assigned reading and learning through group work activities. The molecule project is graded super meticulously and feels more like an english assignment w heavy weight
He's a nice guy but it's very flipped classroom. Be prepared to read the textbook a lot and get a tutor.

He runs a flipped classroom and the lectures don't help at all. The amount of homework and busy work he gives is unbearable, 6 assignments weekly between the very long hw and online quizzes. 4 exams and if you don't do good on them it tanks your grade, he gives retakes tho. plz run! u need a tutor asap. also when you ask questions he will not help!

don't take this class. i recommend taking it at a community college over summer if you can. he doesn't answer questions in class he'll say “look at the book” or just ignores you. he gives lots of homework and you have to teach yourself everything. each exam does have a retake which is nice. i would get a tutor asap

Professor Eaton runs a flip classroom which I was hesitant about at first, but if you apply yourself in and out of class, you'll do fine. He allows exam retakes with full credit back and extra credit on all homework assignments. Just do the work and it won't be as difficult.

Introduction to chemistry should not be run as a "flipped classroom", the work load is ridiculous you have to teach yourself everything. Don't get me wrong the professor is very nice and makes it pretty easy to pass but in the classroom he is not much help.

Professor Eaton really is a great guy. He is super nice and loves to see his students succeed. With that being said, his class will be tough if you don't apply yourself. It's hard to teach yourself things, but he is more than happy to help if you email him or take advantage of his office hours. Overall, you get out of it what you put into it.

Lord help anyone who takes this man. He is quite the tough grader. You can put your heart into something and he wont care. Does NOT teach AT ALL. I mean at alland not to mention his stupid project he makes you do which is useless and he barely mentions at all. Then he expects the highest quality. Huge workload, all busy work and useless in class.

comment: Ridiculous amount of busy work and quite the tough grader. You can retake exams which is fair but he does not teach at all. You basically teach yourself and if you cantgood luck. Flipped classroom and all the in class work is group work so you depend on your group for a grade as well. He also does not make eye contact and is socially awkward

tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Participation matters']
comment: Eaton does a flipped classroom so you will be gracing your self. and when you are in class its all group work and he barely teaches. be read to read outside a lot. lectures are outside of class and fairly short. homework arent horrible and he is pretty good about answering emails. best advice is go to office hours whenever you can

tags: ['Lots of homework', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: As long as you show up to class, you'll be fine but no one likes Eaton. He mumbles his words, uses a flipped classroom teaching style, and never gives you a direct answer when you ask a question. The work is easy, but long so be prepared to spend a lot of time on class. The molecule project is a waste of time as well. At least he is a fast grader.

Professor Eaton is very knowledgeable and nice to all of the students. I would not recommend taking his class though if you don't have self-discipline. Even though he is very nice, you will be teaching yourself the course from the textbook. He lets you do test corrections so that you understand the material but doesn't teach it.

Professor Eaton is the best lab professor Ive ever had. He is always available both inside and outside of lab if you need help on ANY assignment, not just the one you are doing that day. He is very clear about how he wants his lab notebooks/reports done and always gives a chance to redo them. He also congratulates you on great work which is nice :)

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Accessible outside class', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: Professor Eaton was one of my favorite professors this year. He was very accessible outside of class and he helped a lot for the homework and quizzes. He helped every student who came to him with questions and is very easy to talk too. Never got annoyed or made a student feel like they couldn't pass or understand the material. I highly recommend.

The first 2 exams were really easy, but after that they got ridiculously hard. Plus the molecule project is really useless and time consuming because the odds of you ever looking at that molecule again are slim to none. Overall not a good professor.

Tests were very easy ad you are able to retake all of them. There is hw and quizzes for each topic but they are fairly simple. Some of the hw questions are not covered in class but you get 5 tries per question and extra credit if finished early. He is very nice and available often for office hours.

he is very antisocial but is a supper nice man. He barley talks and then lets you work in groups to get the work done! It is a difficult class so it can be tough at times but if you put the work in you will do fine. Very helpful during office hours and you can retake every test within a week.

His grading policy for lab is a lot harder than the other lab professors. He takes off many little points for grammar, appearance, and how you write in the 3rd passive tense. He suggests you go to the writing center to get help then see  him, but its better to just go to him for help and not the writing center because he will change everything

Professor Eaton should not be teaching at SJF. During lab periods all he does is sit on his computer and does not interact with students. He has very poor communication skills. He is never available during office hours. The class is not hard, but he is very picky about lab reports. Poor representation of the rest of the SJF staff. Do not reccomend.

He is an awful professor and switch out ASAP! He grades based on your grammar and not whether you understand the lab or not. I have an A in actual Chemistry (said to be the hardest class) and a D- in the lab. Not helpful.
A very smart man but not much help when you ask for it. You can go to him for help on a lab and still get a C. Ask for help multiple times and you will finally get what you want.

He was a great professor, but not the best teacher. He struggled to post homework and quizzes on time so we often had a lot thrown at us all at once. He gave out large extra credit assignments and was ALWAYS willing to help. Overall great person, but I didn't learn well from his teaching style.

Although night class with him can get boring, his practice multiple choice questions and answers really help you succeed in the class. You will probably come out of the class learning something as well. Very friendly guy.

Real good guy. Took this class over the summer and got an 'A.' Some people struggled in this class and I believe it really determines if accounting and finance is for you. Read all you can in the textbook, because you will need it, his tests are tough. Gives bonus points cause he asks CPA style questions. Held review class which was helpful.
Recommed highly.
Great instructor.  Willing to assist any student, whether an Accounting Major or not.  Held review classes and responded quickly to e-mails.

He made a required class, in the evening, interesting and I was able to comprehend the material.  Each exam was an accurate and fair representation of the course content.  Overall a very fair and concerned for his students professor.

Really nice guy BUT not a good professor.  Made mistakes on a regular basis. students would call him out on it and he'd have no comeback so we would never know the actual answer.  Sure enough the problems he screws up are the one on the test so....yeah.  Wouldn't recommend him.  If you do take him, go to his review classes.
Good guy, made class interesting

Kevin is a really really nice guy. The class is a night class which is very boring. The tests and quizes he gives are tough becuase no one payed attention in class because it's a night class and everyone just wants to leave. Usually keeps you the whole time.
excellent teacher.  This man is very fair.  night class never went beyond 9.  You rock Maier.
Very good teacher that is effective at teaching dificult concepts. Hard to reach because he is not full-time, slow email responces. Good experience overall.

A really good professor. knows what h is talking about. easy on handing in assignments. likes excel worksheets alot.Will help teh student alot if asked for help. Always in a good mood in calss. very easy midterms.
Does a decent job, but wants things done his way. Hope you like staying in your night class until 9:20pm.
A very experienced accountant who is working full time and teaching part time.  He's a very nice guy and will go the extra mile to help a student who shows an interest in doing well.
Awesome professor, makes class fun. Only allows you to miss class once.

tags: ['Accessible outside class', 'Graded by few things', 'Lecture heavy']
comment: Lecture heavy. Only graded on 5 papers (1 book review, 1 film review, 3 midterm papers). He posts all the notes from class and what we talk about so you don't really even have to take notes. I showed up to class and just listened while I did other things like other HW. Write the papers and submit on time and you will be fine. Easy A and a good guy.

Great guy, great teacher. Keeps focused on subject, mixes up how he teaches it, tell you about an assignment a month early and remind you every class. I have had many great teachers, and he is just as good as any of them. Plus he is my advisor, and he does that great too

Dr. Griffin is the greatest guy ever and I wish I could take all my History classes with him! He lectures but they are very entertaining and I learned so much from him!. The great thing about him is that you don't have to read the textbook to get an A in the class, I just used it to get quotes for the paper. I used my notes to write all the papers.
definitely take him if you can. He's funny and his class was easy. we just had to write 3 papers, a book review, and a film review. and he gives study guides before each paper you write.
Alot of reading but if you do the work you will get a good grade. He's a super good guy and really funny
Wonderful professor; amazing sense of humor
Best professor I have ever had, class is not going to be fun but you will learn. One of the the smartest people i have ever met as well

Griffin is really smart and very articulate. Loves anything Star Wars, especially Yoda. Will read and edit essays if you make appointment with him ahead of time. Class is a bit boring and repetitive, especially because it is a night class. Can definitely get away with using Sparknotes or the like

I've taken 5 classes with him. He is a very funny guy and his grading is hard but if you electronically email him rough drafts he will read and grade however many of them you need and he will respond quickly

Super intelligent guy. Has a dorky sense of humor that keeps students engaged. Strict grader, but it's easy once you understand what he is looking for. Very helpful and will revise your drafts up until the day they are due. I would definitely take another class with him.

5 papers and a presentation for the whole semester. He lets you hand in roughdrafts even the day they're due. He's strict about sentence construction and active/passive voice but he'll correct it in the draft. Don't generally have to read the books if you don't have time. Super smart guy and made the class fun.

This class was very easy. The in-class notes are good but you need to know the textbook topics to do well on the 4 essays, they are the only assignments all semester and there is no extra credit. Griffin is a fun teacher and he keeps the class energized with his dorky jokes. Great prof, easy class, take it if you can.

Dr. Griffin is hilarious. Incredibly intelligent & knowledgeable, and will always entertain questions. Does show lots of movies, and use the same ones for multiple classes. Had I known, I'd have skipped this one a couple of times. Take notes. My very minimal effort = B.
Nice guy but grades way too strictly. The only thing you should write in your paper is the pionts he writes on the board does not care about orginal thoughts at all.

Dr. Griffin is very funny. Loves Star Wars and everything WWII. Each paper/essay is worth 20 points. Generally, he will read your rought draft. TAKE ADVANTAGE. This is the only way to ensure an A. Chat with him, take time to be his friend. I barely read any of the honors class readers. Spark notes are enough along with teh discussion guide (use it)

Griffin is a fun guy who really knows the subject. You will have four midterms and a Final Exam. All are essay format that can be done at home, sourcing is not required. Also he grades these papers based on content not grammer so as long as you mention as much about the subject as you can, you get an A.
He is very smart and loves star wars!
This guy is the man.... just the man great teacher

Whoever made the comment about Morpheus from the Matrix is dead on. I didnt know anyones voice could sound like that.  If you write your papers straight from what is in the book you'll get a good grade

Retarded grading system.  Grammer, comprehensiveness, writing skill, spelling, grasp of subject -- none of that matters.  He has a mental list of what he wants to see and if you don't explicitly mention that particular concept, he takes points off.  Might as well hand in a list.

Tough grader - everything is papers.  Score starts at 20, every thing you miss or fail to elaborate on is -1.  Get to 15 and you might as well write off the paper.  No chance to resubmit, no chance to discuss grade.  However - knowledgible as heck, entertaining in lecture and intimidates you into learning (out of sheer defense if nothing else).

Good body of knowledge but he just wants you to regurgitate it both in class and on papers.  Class is interesting but he speaks so loudly, if he's standing right over me it gives me an adrenalin rush.  Avoid the front row.
uses too many big words but knows wat hes talkin bout. his essays are easy cauz u outline em in class.
This guy is INTENSE!!  If you've never had him he reminds me of Morpheus from the Matrix.  He makes lectures fun by an incredibly dry sense of humor.  Take his class and become a paduan learner.
Hard to understand him with big vocabulary but fun to listen to and has an imense knowledge of his subject matter.
Great professor. Strong, projecting voice, sarcastic, dry sense of humor. High level of mastery of subject material, easily conveys this to the student. Highly recommended.
Hilarious. Long lectures made tolerable by his humor and impressions of Marvin the Martian. Lots of facts, incredible amounts of knowledge. Weird habits, but a great guy.
Awesome teacher.  Incredibley knowledgable and clear.  The only real grades in his class come from essays, which are outlined in class and in the reading.  His class was a highlight of my week.

Clear, good speaker. The work is easy if you know the material which is also easy if you are concious in the class. Which can be hard some mornings. Funny, should look into buying longer pants though.
Professor Griffin is a very intelligent man thats classes aren't anything special except for the humor and wit he creates while discussing history
The Jedi Master is indeed a tough teacher...you have to work to get even a "B" in his classes.  And he has a sense for a disturbance in the force.....
Loooong lectures, but makes jokes. Hard grader, but gives time to prepare essay questions and tests. Very helpful, tho slightly intimidating

prof abbott is great. this was an online class, but she was always on top of making things available and grading relatively on time. she also checked in a lot which was great. assignments and quizzes weren't too difficult which i appreciated.

She is a very caring and understanding professor. She is always willing to help on any assignments . There is always class time to work on homework as well , as she does not give much work to have homework. Highly recommend

Professor Abbott's class is simple, just listen and pay attention, don't bother writing notes in because their are no tests but assignments which she will go through how to complete. She is always available for assistance if needed. Most assignments a

I am not someone to usually like a professor but oh my gosh I couldn't rave about her enough. Sweetest woman you will ever meet, most helpful professor ever, she gives so much feedback on your assignments, responds to emails within the same day, gives extensions when needed, her lectures are a little boring but oh my god she's the best professor.
This was a great class. She's knowledgable and tests and assignments were pretty easy.

overall she was good. she definitely lectures a lot, which can get boring fast. gives clear feedback on assignments and is always willing to help. however, i can't say that she's easy to reach outside of class, as she not only never replied to my emails but also to some of my classmates as well. it's 50/50 when it comes to that.
Overall very nice and caring professor. The class topic was interesting which helped but she wasn't super engaging. Not too much outside work at all and easy grader so I would take a class again.
She's very nice and knowledgeable, it's just she so boring. Her class for data analysis is too long but easy and she reads of slide the whole time.

Professor Abbott is extremely kind and helpful. I had her for Data Analysis. She will help you understand anything you are confused about until you fully understand it. Her class was pretty simple as long as you pay attention most of the time. I would recommend her for data analysis.
Professor Abbott is beyond kind and flexible towards her students. She explains things very throughly which was helpful.

you get a front and back sheet of paper for every test. drops lowest test grade- if you get 90 and above on first 2 you don't have to take the final. lectures were all on slides and I barely listened and her reviews sheets and almost everything on the test. would take again. is also flexible with deadlines!

Classes are very lecture based and she just reads off the PP. Lectures are boring. Other than that, she is very respectful and is open to staying after class to help anyone with questions. Not a lot of homework and quizzes are outside out class and open-notes. Not a harsh grader at all, very easy to get an A.
She is good if you want an easy pass, but isn't the most knowledgeable
Great professor! Kind of test heavy but drops your lowest one and gives extra credit, I didn't bother to read the book and I'm still getting an A.

This professor is very nice, but this is the only psych 100 class that had to take exams and sit through boring lectures every single class. This class was also at 8:00am and she was putting me to sleep every time. When I would ask her questions she never knew the answer and would say to check the syllabus. she never knew the answers on the slides.

i have lots of thoughts, but i will keep it brief. dr. dane is not good at giving feedback, and for a 3990 prof, she should be. when she does give you somewhat detailed feedback, it can come of as rude. she also will air out your business and humiliate you in front of the whole class. it's a no from me.

My A- was an absolute miracle. I met with Dr. Dane about my work and every time she bashed my work with no feedback. I literally had to ace the final to go from a C- to an A-. Dr. Dane was disrespectful to all of the athletes in my class except the two XTCF athletes. This class was treated as a grad level course despite being an intro elective.

People tend to not like Dr. Franz bc he does a lot of 8am classes, but if you get over the time block, everything else is great. I've taken several classes with him, he is very easy going, and clear on his assignment expectations. Also not a tough grader for his entry level courses.

Comes to class un prepared, always late, takes over a month to grade assignments, hardly responds to his emails and does not explain instructions clearly, leaving his students more confused than they originally were in the beginning. Makes you write a 10 page research paper with a week and half left in the semester. SAVE YOURSELF FROM HIS CLASS.

Dr. Franz was great. I took him for a 1 credit class this semester so i can't necessarily talk workload. He's personable and not super serious, as he understands that students have lives outside of class. Would recommend for 130/195
Dr. Franz is truly one of the best professors in the department. Humble, hilarious, caring, and gives very thoughtful and kind feedback. If you have the opportunity to take him, definitely do!
i took this as an online class and he was sometimes hard to reach by email but once i got in contact with him he was more helpful
horrible professor. unclear assignment guidelines. doesnt post things on time. unfair grading, especially since its due to his unclear guidelines for things.
Had Franz for intro. psych. He's a nice guy. ad to study a lot for tests, but you know what's going to be on them. Very straightforward.

Great guy. Makes lectures fun by applying methods and course content to the class and to his family. Always has funny stories to tell. Gives test questions weeks in advance so you have time to answer them and study them before being tested on them. Must participate in class.
Great professor. He's very personable and humble.

Attendance is monitory if you want to do well in the course. He loves to talk which makes class interesting and allows you to choose how the tests are formatted which was great. If you go to his office hours for further understanding it will help a lot.  He's one of my favorite professors i've had so far.
Franz is very helpful if you let him. He likes students who go to his office hours and participate in class. He doesn't grade very hard on papers but make sure you read the book.
Dr. Franz is a very outgoing and personable prof.  If you need a professor who conducts class at a slower pace, he is not your man.
Class is average. He talks about his family a lot. His tests are mega hard if you dont study. Doesn't respond to emails quite often.

Dr. Franz is a wonderful teacher. He can come across as strict or grumpy, but once you get to know him and are engaged in class he is very funny and interesting. I love going to that class just to hear how all aspects of psychology can relate to life. I would reccomend taking a class with him if you get a chance.

Franz is more helpful than any professor I've had in 5 years. He is engaging in the classroom, loves to actually get to know his students, and goes above and beyond if a student seeks him out for help. He is demanding, and a tough grader--but the simple truth is, you get the grade you earn. I highly recommend any class with Dr. Franz.

He is currently my advisor. Very good professor: clear, answers questions, welcomes students into his office for help, etc. Can come off as irritated, but he isn't and after 10 minutes of class it is clear he is doing what he loves to do: teach. He does not tolerate slackers, but very flexible at the same time as long as you show effort.

He's a terrible teacher.  He relates everything to his kids or dogs.  He lectures constantly, and I mean constantly!  He doesn't move around, stays in the same place.  Tries to seem cool, but lacks ability to break through to his students.  Hard tests.  Not very engaging at all. Can put sleep itself to sleep.

worst teacher. hes unfair and never turns back homework you have no idea how good you do in the class at all until the end where he hands out grades to fit his quota. he really needs to spend more time teaching and less time worrying about his kids or how mch students like him
Very Clear, precise, and tells you exactly what he wants. GREAT GUY!!!
Yeah, he's hard, but you'll learn a lot. If you plan on going to graduate school...his classes will prepare you so you won't be surprised.
Dr. Franz is easy to deal with and is very clear to you about what he wants. If you work, it shows off in your grade.
He is grrreat
No Comments
A great prof - a bit on the tough side, but very fair; nice and generally friendly (though he can have his moods); helpful; motivating; knows his stuff.  Doesn't tolerate slacking!
No Comments
No Comments
Doctor Franz is awesome
Just don't.

The workload is manageable if you stay organized, but no late work is accepted. Participation through frequent discussion posts makes up most of the grade. The professor is very strict about MLA and citations. Grading is tough, with lots of reading. I dont recommend taking a class with this professor

tags: ['Tough grader', 'Get ready to read', 'Lots of homework']
comment: Nice lady, lots of work, cancels class a lot, just read and you'll be fine
I hate this class more than anything.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Lots of homework', 'So many papers']
comment: She's a good professor and a decent lady, but she just assigns SO MUCH WORK. Like I understand college is a big step up from high school work, but she has us writing papers EVERY NIGHT. Not to mention, I understand in college you can have "big kid" conversations, but she goes out of her way to push her political beliefs onto her students. Very odd.

She is a very frazzled person but she is very nice. Homework typically most nights. Usually reading 1/4 a book and then writing 2 pages on it. Writing the 2-pagers gets very annoying after awhile and if you're a slow reader you'll have trouble. Decently easy grader though, and easy quizzes.

Lisa Cunningham is by far the worst professor I have ever had here at Fisher. I feel as if this professor does not care at all about the success of her students and sets them up for failure. I have also heard from other students that have her as a professor, and they say similar things. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR if you have a choice.

Lisa is a understanding professor but a horrible grader. She never believes in As and her blackboard assignments are almost impossible to get a 100 on. She loads you with papers every week and believes that her LC class should be taken more serious.

for my class we had to read multiple books and the only complaint i have is that she would post the assignments for the reading like a day before it was due so we had little time to do it. but over she is a great professor and is very understanding

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: I like Dr. Cunningham and I have no doubt that she is a great teacher, but her class was incredibly boring and contained a lot of truly tedious homework. And I get it, this is college and we are supposed to be busy with work, but I felt as though she neglected to recognize that we are full-time students taking 15 other credit hours. HW was too long

I loved her Women in Film class. There was a lot of homework, a group project, and a midterm but I found all of it very easy overall. If you love movies with good and strong female characters this is the class for you. Shes very nice, and and the lectures were more discussion style. Everyone was able to give there input on the films we watched

Very nice lady who cares about her students and acknowledges that not every student is comfortable speaking in front of the class. Must complete 12/18 blackboard assignments based on readings. Only 2 tests (midterm & final). Technically you can slack off and not do the readings, but the readings are important for the 2 tests. 1 group project.

Easy class but very boring. She takes the entire 80 minutes to go over one reading and each reading is very similar in nature. Two projects and a final. First project is easy the second one is more time consuming. The test is on the text information only which we barely spend time on

I love Dr. Cunningham. I had her for my LC and RW. She is a bit frazzled, but in general she is helpful in assisting students in developing their writing skills. BUT she gives WAY too much busy work. For RW we were doing pointless exercises with unstarted papers while almost every other freshman was finished with their final. Love her though!

She's so frazzled all the time its almost uncomfortable! I had her for my RW and I wrote my final paper on disney princesses so that was pretty cool. BUT, She kept assigning LOTS of text book assignments up until the last two weeks of class, which was unnecessary. We were doing practice exercises when other RW's were editing their final papers.
Interesting class but very redundant. She likes to go off on tangents which makes the class really boring, but she's a really nice professor.
Makes class a lot harder than it needs to be- way too picky about some things.

Very easy to get an A in the class. There is no nightly homework, only a mid term, a final, a final group project and a final paper. For both the midterm and final a review sheet is given with only the things on each exam. Very picky about ppts, but other than that no complaints. Take a class with her if you can - easy A!
Good teacher, stresses reading a lot and can be a very tough grader. Makes a 100 level class much harder then it should be
she is really good! she cares about her students and the class is easy. just read the book or spark notes and you will be ready for the quizzes. there are too many quizzes.

BY FAR MY FAVORITE PROFESSOR AT SJFC! she is the nicest lady you will ever meet and she is extremely passionate about her classes! she makes her self available whenever is convenient for you if you need extra help. she is amazing, i would definitly recommend taking a class with her!

Cunningham is terrific! At first I thought that she really didn't know what she was doing, but I was very wrong! She's really a sweetheart, and very understanding. Get on her good side. Make her know your name. Participate! Read the textbook! It will be on the midterm and final. Not a difficult class. Actually it was very interesting. I loved it!=)

great teacher, really passionate about her class. must keep up with the readings for her tests but overall they're pretty easy if you do. she does take attendance but she's really nice and understanding. always willing to help. I loved her class
this lady knows her stuff. you have to do the readings b/c she quizzes you every class, but they're easy. would take other queer theory classes with her if offered.

I've taken three of her classes so far and am looking to take more. If you do the reading, which is always interesting and not a chore to do, then class is a breeze. Be prepared to participate but saying one statement a class is sufficient. Do the reading, write two to three papers and get an A
Lots of reading, but it is a lit class. Easy quizzes and few writing assignments. It would be nice if she would update her wardrobe and maybe do her hair before class.
Scary guy but if you do the readings before class and take notes, you'll do fine. He will cold call on you, do not be on your phone or ipad while he's talking
This guy doesn't know how to teach and grade. He's super vague and doesn't know what's he's talking about. All he does is brag. Worst of the worst.
It's tough to pass his class considering all of his grades are practically exams, but the exams aren't easy at all and he's an extremely tough grader…definitely don't recommend
Very easy class. Very little homework. 4 quizzes. They are short answer questions. You can find the textbook online and for free and then just download to notability. No class work assignments.

Has a lot of knowledge, but doesnt know how to present things in an interesting way. Puts down students for wrong answers. Comes off very arrogant and doesnt invite participation due to his bland response and sarcastic responses.

Professor Vanderlinde was a awesome teacher. Most classes were lecture based. If you read each chapter in the book you will be more than prepared for class discussion. It sometimes feels like a lot of work but if you stay engaged in class you will do great on the test. Make sure to listen to the points he emphasizes and participate regularly.

Would not recommend blurting out stupid answers, he will make you feel stupid. However he does really appreciate participation. Another thing is he roasts the book and says how wrong it is, but gets upset if you don't read it. Also, the tests are completely from the book. Knows what he is talking about. Intimidating. Pretty easy course though.
Will give you a bad grade if you don't participate or speak during class. Very tough grader.
Is arrogant regarding student's opinions. Tests are hard and takes points off for the slightest things. He is a nice guy overall but is not the greatest teacher.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass."]
comment: He tells students what is on the tests, so as long as you study and read, you will do well. He really values participation. I talked every class, handed in assignments, and attended every class and I did not receive full participation.

Nice guy but he made participation a huge part of the class and unless you were speaking up nearly every other 15 minutes, he drops your final grade by a letter grade. Many of us in his class had excellent grades on assignments but got B's due to lack of participation (even though, generally we all participated.

Professor Vanderlinde was a CEO of a family business before teaching. He needs to work on his skills. He lectured for the full class period and did not plan his time well. His tests were tough but fair. If you studied, you'd do fine. I have a A / A- all semester, but somehow ended up with a B after the final with no explanation as to why.

He comes from a background in the business which is great and he will relate some of his lectures to his experience. The class isn't an easy-A you do need to work for it but it's worth it. He does a lot of reading out of the book which is a snore but he will help you out if you need it!

Great professor. As a former CEO he brings a lot of real world examples to lectures, and drives class discussions around applicable scenarios. This class is really valuable for anyone who wants to get into management. Also, professor Vanderlinde is a pretty funny guy. Tests are tough, but if you do the readings you will be fine. I highly recommend.

Brings phenomenal and valuable real world experience to the classroom as a former CEO and one who currently facilitates CEO groups. His Topic Executives as Effective Leaders was extremely eye opening and will help to shape my thinking differently, as an MBA student should.

I highly recommend taking her class; she is one of the only professors I have ever had who doesn't read directly off the slides. Class feels like a conversation (to me anyways). I'm just a bad test taker.
the most amazing professor ive ever had. cares so much for her students and her teaching style is very engaging. if you have ADHD or a difficult time focusing, youll love this lady.

tags: ['Tough grader', 'Get ready to read', 'Graded by few things']
comment: She does not grade fairly, she doesn't outline her expectations clearly, then when you bring it to her attention. She gets really passive aggressive. She isn't a professor who wishes to see you succeed. Do yourself a favor and run the other way!

This professor was very difficult and not understanding. She attempted to fail me. I would never choose to take her course again however, at the time she was the only instructor available for this course so I did not have another option. Please do yourself a favor DO NOT TAKE HER COURSE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!. If you can please go with another professor.
She is an amazing professor and genuinely cares. Will always help you when asked. I really enjoyed this class and having her as a professor built into that.

She has a great way of teaching so that you understand the content and is clearly very knowledgable in her field. Seems like a great nurse to learn from and cares about her students and their success.
Always willing to help at anytime she can even outside of office hours

I had him for orgo lab and gen chem lecture. honestly his orgo lab is not that bad but do not take his gen chem lecture. it was the hardest class i have ever taken. i passed orgo 1 and 2 with an A but got a B+ in his gen chem class. so much homework and his exams were very difficult.
He was very enthusiastic and cared about whether his students understood what he was teaching.
He's a very nice guy who wants everyone to be successful and makes that clear. He is a tough grader with sort of long homeworks but prepares you extremely well for tests and future chemistry classes.

Pls avoid this professor at all costs. His homework's are like over 30 questions and are pretty difficult. Harsh grader when it comes to grading any assignment,  I went to a few office hours and got no help and was told I should just know the material.

I love Professor Sodano! He's good at what he does. He's genuinely cares about his students and will always help them. The class is awful though. Lots of reading and note taking! Too much material is covered in a short amount of time. It's almost impossible to get an A.

Lots of work. Tons of articles to read as well as the book. Projects can be very vague and if there are more than three typos he doesn't finish the paper. Great guy, and you'll prolly like the class if you're a commincations major. very difficult

Great professor! Very relaxed and approachable. TONS of reading outside of class but you get to use a cheat sheet, front & back, smallest font you want, on the midterm and final. I'd recommend taking him but definitely keep up on the weekly readings.
Very strict about participation, he will screw you over if you dont even raise your hand once in class. Its annoying.

Very good of a guy. Terrible class. Structured poorly. Lot of reading outside of class. The reading you do outside of class, you do not discuss in class. Down-to-earth, funny, and approachable. Tests are often difficult (he asks for details and specific dates, but then again it is history of broadcasting). Class is fun and interesting. It's relaxing to be in his presence.

Sodano's a great professor! You will really learn a lot in his production classes. Sodano is great! Very funny and passionate...can be a little long-winded..especially if you start to talk about TV. The man knows his stuff.

Had Todd when still at Syracuse.  Very good with popular culture.  (And he should be, TV is most of his life).  No textbook, but big on articles - lots of reading (but fun reading).  Very helpful, very cool.  Gives a lot of open-ended pick-your-own topic assignments.  Only downfall is strickler for grammar. Loved him and class (on his fav The Wire)

While the content was easy to grasp, and our final project had some individual choice about it, there was too much hand-holding, and she'd spend half of several periods explaining all the work she was going to let us do in class rather than letting us do said work in class. Though I came in with a lot of experience, Professor Harrison makes computer programming learnable for anyone. Very understanding of the human element and is willing to communicate.
