Chill guy, cancels often. Understandably teaches code.
Cool dude tbh

Harrison was my favorite professor, but this semester he dropped the ball majorly. Gave up halfway thru the class and feel like I barely learned anything. Super easy class for me, but to most not at all. Cancelled constantly, at least 15+ times.
Coding is not easy but he taught it well. Definitely challenges you with the homework but is helpful when it comes to the tests. Pretty fun dude. Would take again.

I've enrolled in several of his classes and he's easily the greatest professor period . Great at engaging with the audience, very fluent speaker, extremely smart, makes challenging theory understandable and the guy is hilarious. Harrison is known for extending homework deadlines if the class is behind and he fully grasps the human element.
Similar set up to CSCI 161, focus on object oriented code in Java. HWs were challenging but not overwhelming.

Intro class that teaches the basics of Java coding. Did a good job of teaching the logic behind different coding features and making sure it was understood specifically what the computer reads as opposed to what the coder is thinking when making the code. HWs are helpful, midterm and final are based on class concepts and curved. Good P4 too.

Intro course.  Basically you just learn Java.  He's pretty straightforward with everything, show up to class and he'll teach you the material.  Homeworks aren't bad, if you get stuck he's good at helping students through it.  Study for the tests and you'll do well.  Not a hard class at all.

Terrible teacher for this class.This class should be catering to business students and their needs-he taught it as if we will all be designing webpages. Dont waste your money on the books, didnt even tough access.Doesnt respond to eamils timely, and directions are never clear.Last minute(after official reviews) assigned 4 projects. DONT TAKE HIM

Harrison is extremely unclear in his directions. During class time he simply stands at the computer clickng buttons without explaining what is going on. He does not provide feedback or offer much help outside the class room and rarely responds to his email or follows through with providing help. TAKE SOMEONE ELSE IF POSSIBLE

Harrison is good guy, a bit nerdy. CSCI 161 is essentially JAVA I, as it's the only language you learn. Lectures are a little boring but are clear and on point. HW assignments aren't too bad if you were in class, and he is very helpful if you get stuck. Tests are reasonable. Class might be a bit hard if you unfamiliar with computers.
Easy to understand and the homework isn't too bad.

and CSCI162. Nice guy, if slightly awkward sometimes. Uses PowerPoint for every class, which works well enough if you can pay attention. Is reasonable, i.e. does not make homework due or schedule tests right after breaks. Tests need to be studied for, but good grades can be gotten if you make sure you understand the material. Recommended.

Solid, clear teacher. Knows the stuff and teaches it well. Some of the HW can be a pain, but there isn't too much. Does go a little fast with the slides making it tough to get notes down. Really funny guy, makes his powerpoints interesting and informative. Has review slides, does review classes.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Gives good feedback']
comment: I took his 7-week online bioethics class, it was not too difficult and he's very accommodating. I had to get an extension for one of the modules and he gave me full credit and allows up to a week past the due date according to the syllabus. I'm not sure how he is for in-person courses, but I highly recommend him.
Professor Barnett is very nice! He is well organized and his lectures are clear and understandable. As long as you do the assignments, you will get an A.
Dr. Barnett is a fairly easy grader. DOn't stress too much about how in-depth your answers need to be. Use your retakes on tests and you'll be golden.
He was very organized, which I appreciated for a 7 week online class. He also recorded lecture written and audio lectures which he spoke in with clarity. Overall, I have no complaints.

Loved Brian's online Bioethics course! The class can be difficult no matter which professor you have, but I truly enjoyed being in Brian's. As long as you put in the work and try your best, there should be no problem getting the A.

tags: ['Accessible outside class', 'Get ready to read', 'Participation matters']
comment: I took his bioethics class and honestly it was very good. It was online, but he still made it very engaged. Lots of reading or writing, but as long as you try your best and do the work on time you are fine. He responds to emails very quickly and always had lots of office hours. Not sure how he is in person, but online was amazing! Take him!

Professor Barnett was a nice guy, and clearly passionate about philosophy. Class wasn't too hard. 2 page journals for every unit but if you write what was in the notes and add a few things he said you'll be good. He is a super weird guy but he is really nice. He is actually funny and his classes are just you sitting there and taking a few notes to use in your journal entry's. It really was an easy class and I would recommend taking at least one class with him.

Best professor I've ever had! Brian opened my eyes to new ways of thinking. He's clearly very passionate and quite knowledgeable and willing to spend a lot of time working with students individually outside of class. He's also pretty laid back and quite funny! I'd recommend him to anyone who really wants to learn and is willing to put in effort.

Brian is interesting. He's quirky and his jokes aren't all that bad. He's pretty personal with his students and class is generally casual. it was just lecture and we watched a couple videos. What the hell is wrong with all of you. College is meant to be difficult. It's a privilege to come here and you should expect to have to work for your grades. It's not supposed to be a cakewalk.

Literally the worst professor I have ever had at this school. It took him 4 weeks to grade our papers, and then he didn't give us the actual papers for another week. Currently in his class now, literally THE WORST CLASS EVER. Very dry and boring class, he is very awkward and gives really weird and uncomfortable examples. Class was often confusing because you would get lost in what he was talking about. By far my least favorite professor I've ever had. My recommendation is don't take his class

Super late grading assignments. Haven't seen my fianl grade and it is way past the deadline. Dont take this class.

I had her for my Lifegiving Women's Class and i can honestly say she is a really nice professor. She's strict and actually wants people to participate but the work is not hard. Very unorganized. Never follows syllabus!!!! NEVER emails back. A ton of readings on BB to print out and bring to class. The whole class is dedicated to discussion and some lecture here and there. Easy class if you do the readings and contribute to class discussions...

Easy class, just has a quiz and reflection due each week. Not too much work. Teaching style is a little slow and can get boring.
she is so awesome. knows her stuff and is more than willing to help with anything. take her classes !!
Love love love Dr. Phelan she was awesome. She made statistics understandable and fairly fun. Also, she's super sweet and helpful when you need it. Definitely take her for 201 if you can!
Probably the best psychology professor at Fisher. She makes statistics and research methods so easy to understand and I really looked forward to class with her.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Amazing lectures']
comment: Dr. Phelan is such a sweet & helpful professor! She's one of the best teachers at Fisher, & you learn so much from her lectures. Basic Stats is my favorite class of hers! The way we did problems together and used the statistical software as a class was really helpful. Her homework assignments and quizzes are easy and reasonable.

She is really great! If you have to take basic stats I would definitely recommend taking it with her, she makes everything easy to understand and is super accessible for questions. Her grading criteria is very clear so you'll know what you need to do and when you need to do it each week. She cares about her students and will check in with you a lot

Took a few classes with her, she makes you feel dumb if you ask a question and still don't understand after she tried to explain it once. Overall decent, but awful for a difficult class because she will get frustrated if you don't understand.

Professor Phelan is a great professor, she explains things in a way that is easy to understand and relates the material to real life examples. This is the worst class I've ever taken. Mini papers are assigned through the semester, she comments on things to improve on after you've submitted a final copy? Doesn't make much sense to me. Tests are NOTHING like anything learned. Textbook is not really used. I WOULD NOT recommend this class. EVER.

AMAZING professor. She's understanding and passionate about the subject. Although, she is a very tough grader. I would definitely recommend this class !

Great class! There were fun and relatable activities. She loves teaching and it shows through her lessons. Always available to help. Should be the department head because she sets the example of an amazing professor.
Nice person.  TOUGH grader! You will have NO margin for error!!
really hard grader
She is an excellent and very fair professor. I would recommend you take as many courses with her as you can.
Dr. Phelan is an excellent teacher.
Dr. Phelan is sweet and smart.  She is a great teacher and makes class fun and engaging without being corny about it.  Definitely take her classes if you can!
She is a great teacher looking foward to take other classes with her. very helpfull and considerate.
Best professor to take for statistics, makes it very easy to understand with lots of examples and help. Highly reccommend Dr. Phelan!
good
She is a really great teacher and extrememly nice. A little wierd at times, but she is very helpful.

She explains everything very well, has great notes online, and uses different teaching tools so your not bored, she's very helpful if people don't get things, she is also very understanding. GREAT TEACHER AND GREAT CLASS!
Dr. Phelan is a great teacher, she makes the class fun and everyone I know liked her as a teacher. She is also very helpful outside of class and holds review sessions before tests.
A great teacher, very helpful in and out of class.

I LOVE DR. PHALAN!!! If you have her for 101 she drops the lowest hw, test and quiz grades and the final is optional. She also puts detailed notes on BlackBoard. However people are annoyed by her voice. She sounds like she is going to cry, but she is kool
He's an awesome guy! Understanding, fun, nice, etc. Love him!

definitely a lot of work, which may be due to the fact that it's an online class. however, everything is structured nicely, and due dates are clear. the site used for work can be annoying, and can tweak out often. prof was responsive and helped when needed.

Such a great professor. Very clear and helpful. He responds to his email very quickly too. he shows movies and stories and other European way of life, which are very helpful. He says "Vale" way too much, but it just means ok.

Class was an easy A, he made the class very enjoyable, we did a lot of speaking exercises, which were very helpful. the start of the semester was so bad. had to read 50 pages every night. she was good about us telling her it was too much and she adjusted accordingly which made it better. she was honestly just kind of annoying and we had to read so many books but she was very open to feedback.

Dr. Rossi is one of the most caring and passionate professors Ive ever had! The class is a little reading intensive but Dr. Rossi was understanding and very flexible with changing due dates. As long as you put in the effort, you will do great in a class with her.

tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'EXTRA CREDIT']
comment: Dr. Rossi is really nice! She's a bit scatter brained and doesn't follow the syllabus but she always emails the homework as a reminder. Very respectful and not hard a lot of hard material class time usually spent in discussion.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK', 'EXTRA CREDIT']
comment: Professor Rossi is a very nice person, but is very scatter brained at times. She assigns ALOT of assignments, but they aren't that hard and grades very easy on them. She is a very opinionated individual. She is not very open minded and often only looks at her opinion as the right choice. She is an extreme feminist who often apologizes for comments targeting males. Gives only busy work for homework every night.

Nightly homework and readings, 2 papers  and she is a hard grader. If the content is not exactly what she wants she gives you a poor grade. She is willing to help and she is a nice women, however, for an elective it should not be as intense as she makes it.

Practically every week she's assigning more homework that wasn't listed on the syllabus. I would never take this class voluntarily. It was put in my schedule my first semester by the school. There is a lot of reading and a lot of extra work outside of class. She literally has no idea what she is doing.  I leave the class never knowing what the homework is and she always adds more.  Everytime I have finished a paper she has changed the way it has to be done so I have to change my paper completely

I don't like her style at all.  I feel like she wastes  time teaching things I've know since freshman year. Professor Falanga is a very thorough and sincere professor. At times he may go slightly fast through the material, but if you simply ask for clarification, it will make much more sense. She is a poor grader and deducted points bc of AI. She is incredibly boring and relies on group work rather than teaching. She is not comparable to the other j1 teachers.

Unable to provide clear instructions or effectively elaborate instructions upon request. Unwilling to take responsibility for own errors. Unable to present educational content in a clear, concise manner.

Dr. Gold was very unprofessional. He constantly rambled about things that were not helpful at all. He was often not on campus to help you if needed, and took a while to respond to emails. AVOIDDDD. He is discriminatory and disrespectful to students. Should be fired.
avoid him y'all....if you can't then wishing you the best.

He's a little awkward, but his heart's in it and his class was enlightening
Whole class is group discussions and she is mean. DONT TAKE A CLASS WITH STELLA

I liked her as a person but she asked a lot of questions that were impossible to answer and would get mad if you didn't answer how she wanted you to. She lectures for an hour and a half and cold calls on students.

Stella is a very kind person outside of class. However, she is not understanding to occasional absences and relies HEAVILY on participation. She talks for majority of the class and calls on people to talk. Homework was to watch an entire movie before next class (in Italian) and all students will be called on for precise details. DONT MISS CLASS

Taking Italian with Stella was one of my favorite things at Fisher. Through ITL I & II she was understanding about the pandemic, and an easy grader. She is from Italy and is able to share so much about Italian culture and life. Expect to study and do homework between classes. If you need language credit and have Spanish experience take Italian!

Incredibly kind and caring, very lax with deadlines, a bit disorganized but it doesn't affect students much. Supported me through a small crisis during class, loves chatting with students. Best professor I've had so far.
Dr. Herman is very sweet and really cares about her students. If you are struggling, she will help you as best she can. I really enjoyed the lectures, and the workload was very manageable.
She is amazing and I would highly recommend taking any class with her. She truly cares about her students and will always find time to help. She is a fair grader and leaves thoughtful feedback.
Dr. Herman is a great professor! She is very sweet, and she will do whatever she can to support you.

Dr. Herman is an amazing professor. She has taken time to learn HOW to teach & conducts lectures in a way that is proven to be beneficial. This said, if you like a straight lecture, it will likely take some adjustment to learn how to make the most out of her active teaching. She also does her best to make the class & tests tie to the real world.

Dr. Herman is truly a great proffesor and even better person. But you need to be ready to do work and learn, if you do you will succeed, if not a class will be tough for you. She is always available outside of class and cares for her students deeply, will take time to teach you or find a good tutor. Have taken 2 classes with her and will take more!

comment: You will definitely have to put in an effort for this class. Dr. Herman is amazing and makes the class a lot more interesting. Love her!!!
She's fantastic and passionate.

she expects everyone to be a natural genius. the way she gives notes is terrible. She uses powerpoints that are mostly blank and writes down the answer and erases it two seconds later. You have to scramble to complete the powerpoints and also listen to her lecture at the same time.

Her PowerPoints are terrible. She puts random blanks in that you need to pick the correct word she randomly writes on the bored amidst random other things she writes. She's a sweet and amazing woman but needs to work on her presentation.

Dr. Herman is EXTREMELY passionate about what she does and kept every class very interesting and fun. I had her for the Fungi: Rotting Our World class and she expressed her love for mushrooms and fungus every single class. Her study guides are spot on and she is a fair grader. She cares about her students and is very understanding. Simply the best!

Professor Herman is an excellent teacher! She is so excited to teach us about Fungus and she is great at making your questions seem important. I went into this class not having much of an interest in fungi and hating science, and this ended up being my favorite class of the semester. You should definitely take this class! :)

Herman is not a bad lady. The only problem that I had trouble with was the clarity aspect. The tests are tough, primarily the mc section. She is nice and willing to help. I just wish that the lecture was a little more clear and that she would not state things to be prepared for come test time even though that information isnt even on the test.

I've had Dr. Herman for Plant Bio, Micro Lab, and MedEthnoBot. She is a great woman, absolutely delightful! She is fun in basic level classes and gets even better when you get to upper level electives. Very approachable if you ever need help, very understanding. Tests can be challenging but have always been fair.

Plant bio. Very knowledgeable about the subject, clearly loves what she does. Very understanding of outside issues including computer glitches. Very new to teaching. Book is used but not the best for subject (she admits) so lectures are a must. Grades very favorably! Tests are more on the difficult side, definitely study up.

Best teacher ever!! understands outside emergencies and helps in every way she can. Always tells you what she wants as far as objectives and what will be on the chapter exams. One of the only professors that has a great rating by students at fisher!!

I honestly hated this course, but it wasn't because of Maryann. If i had someone else and not her, i probably would have dropped out. she is so understanding and laidback. half the time i emailed my HW to her after class. just talk 2 her and get on her good side! she'll love u. she kinda confuses herself sometime, but its cute. i really loved her!
Good professor for this class. Two presentations and a final paper. He is willing to help outside of class.
Hard class. Didn't love his lectures as his PowerPoints were often confusing but he is a great guy and willing to explain things in office hours. His exams are quite fair.

Although this class was very challenging, Dr. Hurd really cared about the success of his students. His enthusiasm made lectures much easier to follow along and answered any questions we had thoroughly. Would definitely take him again in future semesters.

comment: Very nice professor and always willing to work with students. But, his lectures are hard to stick with and the class feel so disorganized. Be ready to teach yourself in this class.
Dr. Hurd is amazing and very passionate about what he teaches. He cares that we all learn and take what we learn and can apply it. Great professor!
Dr. Hurd is a wonderful professor. Very passionate about his discipline and really cares about his students. He made lab fun.
Dr. Hurd runs a fun cell biology class.  During class he is all over the place with lecture but at the end of it, everything somehow just comes together.  He is passionate about cell biology.

His lectures are boring and he doesn't explain topics well. It was hard to pay attention for the whole lecture. The tests are easy, especially if you can get your hands on an old exam, they're practically the same. I don't think I learned anything useful in the class.

I love Dr. Hurd! Great teacher and really helps if you have a question. He's also in a band with other faculty members (Big Tuna and the Fishermen) (They're really good!) He's kind of soft spoken, so listen up!
No Comments
Awesome. Makes physics so accessible and easy. Great guy.
Dr. Enck is so approachable and willing to help out. Such an amazing professor and person.

Dr. Enck is an amazing professor! He is extremely knowledgeable about physics and is very good at teaching an explaining things. There is really no reason someone could fail his class as he wants to see everyone succeed. There is usually a quiz every week, but he always tells you exactly what is on it and even lets you do open notes.

Dr. Enck is the best! The course material is difficult to an extent, but he makes it as easy as possible. Lecture/lab combined. Very interactive. Short weekly quizzes and problem sets due once a week. Definitely knows the material well, as he is able to easily explain it. I wish he taught all my classes. I've debated switching to a physics major
he is so sweet, very lecture heavy and there are only 3 exams that you get graded on. he doesn't give any homework, would take again if given the chance. can be boring at times

Very good professor and he loves his job. Lectures can be boring at times but are for the most part interesting. There is homework for each chapter but he gives you a lot of time to do it. Lots of extra credit opportunities and is available outside of class if you need extra help. The tests aren't bad as long as you study. My favorite prof. So far!

This guy truly loves his job and enjoys teaching students. He always has office hours available if you need help, multiple opportunities for extra credit especially in class, and his lectures are enjoyable despite some boring topics. Professor Smith makes it fun and is arguably the best professor I've had yet.

Overall, the class was a college level class, and you definitely need to study the material if you want a good grade. Offers lots of extra credit opportunities to boost your grade because while sitting in the lectures it gets boring very fast. HW assignments for each chapter but lots of time to complete. 3 tests worth the majority of your grade.

Dr. Smith is very nice and cares that his students do well. There was not much homework, the midterm and final were challenging but as long as you take notes and do the practice tests you will do fine.
Love Clair Smith. GOATed teacher. Highly recommend taking his class. Very manageable amount of work and tests are very passable.
Clair Smith has awesome lectures and doesn't give a ton of work. Most of the grade comes from tests but he provides plenty of studying resources.

comment: Dr. Smith is a really good professor and really cares about his students, and is always available to help if you need it. Just make sure you really study for the test or you will not pass...
He's a fun professor that will keep you engaged even while lecturing on difficult material.

Professor Smith is one of the best professors Ive had hes really funny and inspirational he explains topics well and always pauses to see if people have questions before he moves on there are 2 online midterms in the class they were pretty hard but if you meet with him after the first midterm hell go over it so you can do better on the next

Professor Smith is a really nice guy hes always there to help you if you have questions I had him for Microeconomics and I liked him so much I took him again for Macroeconomics hes always prepared with a joke and ready to put a smile on your face he does take a long time to grade tests though

Professor Smith was one of the best professor ive had. He cares about how much you understand in the class and is willing to meet any day to get extra help. The practice test and written examples are almost identical to the test.
Very easy but boring. Tests are open note and open resource, just don't take it with someone else.

*Dr. Smith was great. He is easy going, reasonable, fair, easy to talk to, explains things well, and is happy to answer questions. I've had two classes with him and even though the subject may be complicated, he makes it better by the way he teaches. If you need to take an econ class at Fisher, take his!*

A good guy and an okay professor. He NEVER answers his emails. I emailed him like four times asking him questions and clarifying assigments and he just never answered and did not talk about the questions in class either (I stopped bothering to email him). This is what really annoyed me about him, did not sit well with me.

Dr. Smith is a great guy. He can be a little boring but his lectures are clear and he wants everyone to do well. I fell asleep a few times in class but I did the homework and his review sheets so I did well on the tests. There is no need to purchase his textbook but you do need the online access for the homework. Overall it was a great class.
He was my favorite professor this semester. The class is a little dull, but you can't help but laugh at his corny economics jokes. Took a somewhat boring topic and made it pretty fun.

Honestly a great overall teacher, he knows how to make his lectures matter so that you'll actually understand what he's teaching. Great guy to have my first semester of college. All his classes are lectures, but he makes them interesting and easy enough to pass well because of his teaching ability.

What and awesome dude. Classes can be boring but he makes them A LOT better than all the other Econ professors here. Offers a ton of extra credit. There are not many tests but the ones we do get are pretty hard. Study for them and you will do fine. Easy B or higher. Totally recommend.

He's a great guy and he's very involved with the students during class. It's nice because even though he teaches lecture based classes, they will never put you to sleep. He's lots of fun for what is usually just a textbook class and he explains things very thoroughly and readily until you really understand hard material.

before taking micro i was terrified but professor smith was awesome and was always smiling and loves his job. Always there for you if you have a question or concern about your grade. Made our 9am class entertaining and not too bad! Would definitely take another class with him again!
Very helpful and gives many opportunities to bring grades up

The class didn't flow very well. I thought I would understand the homework easily after attending classes, but it was pretty tough. The tests were also very difficult and not set up like the class or the homework. If you are willing to work hard you will do well but it is not an easy A.

His lectures can get pretty boring at times, but he explains topics well giving clear real-world examples to help you better understand. As long as you go to lecture, pay attention, and take notes, you should easily pass. Gives two tests, a final, a project, and occasional Saplings, and he also offers chances for extra credit.

This was my first college economic class and he made it extremely easy to learn and understand. This class was an introductory class and he treated it as such. Not too much homework. Two test, a final. One project and occasional saplings throughout the year. Do not actually have to do the reading to understand, but you learn a lot. would recommend

Smith's class is kind of boring, mostly lecture, but super easy if you show up and listen. Gives examples in class that are on the tests. Online homework once every couple of weeks and 3 exams which are easy

Easy class if you attend class, review notes, and study! About 5 homework assignments and 1 fun project. 3 tests. The teacher is  funny, easygoing, and tries to make econ interesting for all! take an econ class with him! you wont regret it.
Clair is a great guy.   Class can be a little boring but if you are interested in the topic and discussion you will love him
Clair Smith is the freaking man.
Super boring but the test were easy if you study the practice test materials. Talks about pizza way too much.  Hated showing up for this class.

Had him for intro to Micro. Really nice guy, understands the material is a bit dry and tries to make it as engaging as possible. Tests aren't easy, but aren't overly hard if you go to class and review your notes for an hour or two before the test. Great new professor at Fisher, he will become a favorite in the ECON department.

Had him for Macro.  Good teacher, lectures are kind of boring but you don't have to go to class, although if you don't go you will miss material, however he does review so if you're smart you can skip every now and then.  Study thoroughly for tests(only need an hour) you'll get an A.  Definitely Recommend.

He's a great teacher. It gets boring at times but he really tries to make the class easy to understand and he gives great notes that are very relevant to the tests. He is also very helpful if you don't understand anything and is willing to answer any questions.

I really enjoyed this class. It is not a walk in the park A, but if you put some effort in you will get a good grade. Hw is very easy and there are only 3 or 4 of these assignments all semester. Class is lecture based and you will get a lot of it if you pay attention. I recommend this class.

Class time is used for mostly useless activities. Lecture videos are posted and must be completed before class along with a "checkin" for each one (a small graded quiz). These lectures are how you obtain most of your teaching from him. You must be a good note-taker
Great teacher! He's very flexible. His teaching style is very group-work-heavy but it's very useful for those who like visuals!

I had him for anatomy lab and he was very helpful and kind. He was also always willing to answer questions and knows so much about the material. I always enjoyed going to lab.

I took Muphys gen bio lab last semester and was always lost. his way of teaching is just reading everything off his slides to you and you just memorize it. I really enjoyed her teaching style, she keeps lectures engaging

Dr. Robinson is my favorite psych faculty at Fisher. Truly cares about her students and teaches interesting classes.

I wish I could give 0 out of 5.

Work is easy but lectures are boring
No tests, just weekly quizzes and homework assignments based on class. I loved Robinson and would recommend her to anyone.

Professor Robinson's class doesn't require alot of outside effort. She assigned a few videos as well as a homework each week. These took at most an hour to complete and you can use 2x speed on YouTube to make it faster. There's also weekly online quizzes for homework but you get out of the class what you put in. With little effort you can get an A.
Means well but is very opinionated and does not really know what she is talking about and bores both herself and her students to sleep.

Honestly I think shes a good person. lol, she is not a good data analysis teacher. i will never take a class of hers again. not only is she a tough teacher but you literally teach yourself. assigns hour long youtube videos to watch and they count towards participation. shes so confusing as is her class. 0/10 recommend.

I really hope she gets a permanent position at fisher! She's a really kind and funny person who knows her stuff and wants her students to learn and be their best. She's clear about expectations and always flexible with students.

would make a short PowerPoint last the entire class when it didnt need to and made the lectures very uninteresting. she over explained a lot when she didnt need to. however she is a very nice professor qnd super understanding
This class is easy if you show up and pay attention. Professor Robinson is such a sweet person and cares about her students.

She is really sweet and understanding but she is new, and a little uncertain with herself. Her lectures are kind of dry and she thrives off of class participation. If you have a class that is good at participating then it makes the class better.

Professor Robinson did a great job teaching Childhood & Adolescent Development. I took this course in the Winter Semester of 2020. Every class we had lectures and took notes, and there were quizzes due at the end of the week. She is very down to Earth and kind. Sadly students are disrespectful and several had their phones out during her class.

Okay honestly, don't take her in the morning, you will fall asleep. She spends half the lecture open mouth yawning at students and she doesn't seem excited about what she's teaching. That said it was my easiest class this semester, and she does not require attendance or in class participation. DO NOT BUY THE TEXTBOOK- I didn't look at it one time.

Overall, I would say Professor Robinson is decent. I find her lectures to be quite boring and not very entertaining at all, but the class is really easy. She seems to be really tired all the time, we once counted like 13 yawns in 55 minutes. However, she was working on her PhD dissertation at the time so I give her a lot of credit for doing that.
Great professor and great person, 60% of the grade is based on 4 exams. Lectures everyday but she's good at lecturing and keeps it engaging. Would definitely take her again
She is a wonderful professor, super understanding and I would definitely take her again if I have the opportunity.

Im sorry, but Although she has a great attitude for taking things on, I really do believe she has a lot of work to do when it comes to all her classes, especially, however in the world she grades her exams, but be prepared for super long quizzes with minimal time to complete and EXTREAMLY tough grader on exams. Had 3 classes with this woman sadly.

Professor Saffie Robertson is a nice person. Although, it is an easy class, it is difficult to gauge expectations, there is little feedback provided for each assignment. There is a big group project that you work on throughout the semester that you mostly have to figure it out yourself and guess what the expectations are.

Dr. Saffie Robertson was a great professor. She will make sure that you learn the material through lectures but reading ahead of the lecture helps. She also incorporates other types of media to give examples, usually movie clips. The Trivia after the quiz injects some fun into the class as well.

Dr. Frederick is an awesome professor! She cares for each and every one of her students endlessly. She is very dedicated to her study and has amazing lectures prepared for us! If you want a challenging class that pays off, I recommend this one.

Online lectures are awful with incorrect information. Study guides different from exams. Class time is useless. Came to class late, computer update in middle of class got kicked out of zoom. comment: interesting feller

*Dr. Bowman cares about students and is pretty easygoing/flexible. I heard not great things about him beforehand but really don't know why. Show you're interested/trying, run ideas by him and adjust to his input and I think an A is definitely achievable.*

Gives out a lot of essays and homework and doesn't even grade the homework for credit. He will not grade your essays until the last week of the semester and will not give you feed back on how to improve during the semester. Email him for that. Tough grader, gave out a personal travel essay assignment and apparently my essay was not up to par.

Eh. Nice person, super funny, but he isn't a real great professor in my opinion. He assigns a TON of busy work and you don't get any feedback on many of the assignments. Decent overall. Expectations are mostly clear, feedback is good, available outside of class. Biggest flaw is that he takes half a semester to grade essays.

Bowman is a nice guy but not a great professor. The class isn't terrible, but it's a lot of pointless work, online blogging & use of blackboard. I usually did my hw in class.

I love Dr. Bowman. I had him as my freshman advisor and since I loved him so much I decided to take my Research-based writing class with him. He gives out what I think are fair grades and he's extremely helpful. I think he's a great guy and he has helped me to succeed in my writing thus far.

Dr.  Bowman is a great man who is very passionate about what he does, unfortunately he is very unorganized. It takes almost two months to get grades back on essays and during this time he continues to assign essays without any idea of how you did on the first one. He looses his train of thought super easily and most of hw is busy work.

He is by far my least favorite professor. He assigns way too much work, at least 2-3 hours of homework a night. He is always assigning busy work for us to do and it is nothing that is helpful. He speaks in a monotone voice which makes it hard to be engaged. He is unorganized and is very rude when you ask for extra help. I would not recommend.

Worst professor I've ever had. He is VERY unclear in what he wants, gives no feedback on essay rough draft, and doesn't grade your work in a timely manner. He talks in monotone the entire class and is quite unorganized. If you ask a question he doesn't answer it clearly, rather he goes around in circles. I would not recommend him to anyone.
Very chill!
He is super chill and a very easy grader. I would highly recommend taking lab with him.
Professor Viggiani was very understanding. Not very strict about due dates. Overall, he was a great professor. I recommend taking his chemistry lab.

I've had him for both Chem Lab 103 and 104, and he's absolutely amazing! Super relatable and hilarious, he makes the lab enjoyable while always being willing to help. He's fair with extensions when needed and truly cares about his students' success. If you're looking for a great chemistry professor, I highly recommend taking his class!
Dr. Hoffman is a great professor! He is very passionate about what he teaches and his lectures are very clear and understandable, and is very caring towards all students.
Dr. Hoffman is awesome! We spent a lot of time outside. He is good about helping you out when you are struggling.
he is very nice but hard to listen to, straight lectures all class. test are very hard to study for and are all cumulative

comment: Great professor! He is super funny and teaches his stuff very well making his tests easy. Would take class with him again.

Material is difficult if you don't pay attention/show up, and there is a total of four exams throughout the semester including the final exam which is cumulative. I definitely recommend him but it's something to keep in mind

He's a great teacher with a sense of humor and his lectures are very interesting. Your grade is very test-heavy and if you mess up on one... your grade is gonna remain messed up (no extra credit, no curve, etc.), So just make sure you're aware you will be tested 4x and study!

Dr. Thibodeau's classes are so interesting and he's obviously so passionate about the topics. He cares about his students and responds to emails quickly. He has the dryest and wittiest sense of humor so his lectors are very entertaining. He's probably the best psych professor at Fisher. Take his classes if you can!

Dr. Thibodeau is extremely hilarious. You can tell he loves what he does and truly has a passion for psychology. He was always available to discuss grades and ways to improve. Be sure to study because his exams are primarily lecture based, but he is always willing to clear up confusion. Awesome guy!

Ryan was a visiting professor at UofR this semester and his class was by far my favorite. He was full of life and fun every class and was always open to a class discussion instead of lecturing. Although there are quite a few assignments as well as exams, they're very straightforward and quite enjoyable. Highly recommend any class with him!

Thibodeau is absolutely hilarious. He is very goofy and a little nerdy but I was laughing at every class. He knows what he is talking about and gives clear lectures. His textbook is free and his tests are almost the same as the review sheet he gives you. If you show up and do you work you will pass.

Great guy and fantastic professor. His style of teaching and what you take from the class made me want to go every day. Some professors only teach from the textbook. But Dr. T goes beyond. With outside material, and relatable experiences and situations. He's really funny and 10/10 would recommend his classes.

Dr. Thibodeau has been my favorite teacher my past two years at Fisher. He is hilarious, and makes learning fun and being in class enjoyable. If you show up to class and take the notes, you will do good on the quizzes and tests. Definitely recommend!

Dr. Thibodeau was one of the best professors I have ever had. He is hilarious and also a great teacher. He makes everything so clear and the quizzes and tests are very reasonable. He covers a lot of material, but makes it so fun and makes sure everyone knows exactly what is going on
Great professor for a core class. The class is both easy and interesting.

I'm a graduate of SJFC and I was lucky enough to have Dr. Thibodeau for many different classes. He's a dedicated, intelligent professor and you can tell that he truly knows what he's talking about. He wants students to learn and encourages questions and discussion. Hands down my favorite professor, whom inspired me to continue on to grad school.

I don't think that PSYC211 is as easy as previous reviewers say it is. HOWEVER, his class is a complete blast and is a great way to make any bad day you're having turn for the better. He's a great guy and completely hilarious. But, his tests ARE difficult and you MUST study hard. Textbook use only to clarify things you didnt understand from lecture

Dr. Thibodeau is an amazing professor. He's funny, very clear with his teaching, and his exams aren't too difficult if you look over the lecture slides. Barely ever if at all use the textbook, so I'd skip on buying it.

This class was easy if you take the time to do work. Homework is reading articles and laxly graded written reactions. Tests are fair if you study. Reading the book isn't essential but it definitely helps for clarity. He is funny and realistic but cell phones and noisy disruptions annoy him. Come with questions for review, he won't review otherwise
This was probably the easiest class ive ever taken. He literally gives you a review guide that goes along directly with the test. Such a great professor, enjoyed the class and it was so easy
If you keep up with the notes from the powerpoints, the exams should be very easy.  There were no essays or projects. The class consisted of mastery assignments mini quizzes and unit exams.
BEST TEACHER KNOWN TO MANKIND. HE'S ABSOLUTELY HILARIOUS AND TELLS YOU EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO KNOW ON THE TEST, LITERALLY. IT'S GREAT AND SO IS HE. TAKE HIS CLASSES.
Take his classes!

He is amazing, so down to earth and you learn so much!!! His assignments are actually fun to do, he gets side tracked easily but it makes the class discussions that much better!! Take his class if you have the chance hes amazing! best class ive had at fisher this far!

I took personality psych with prof. Thibodeau and he was honestly the best teacher i have had thus far at fisher!! He is funny, random, and it is so easy to understand his teaching! Just study his study guide for the tests and youll get an A... easy grader. just do your work! Again best teacher yet take him if you have the chance!

I took this class with Dr. Ahmed last year - it was the best class I took at fisher. I'm in med school now and the material has stuck with me. She's the best prof and will help you when you need her! 10/10 recommend!

Had no class plan the entire semester then decided to base students final grade on the last 3 classes. Told all of us we were “guinea pigs” to her new class the first day and that we were guaranteed an A. Did better in my upper level biology courses than this one
I thoroughly enjoyed this class with Dr. Ahmed. Her flipped classrooms helped me better learn the information and succeed in the course. Would recommend any class with her!

He is a terrible teacher!!! Avoid at all costs. He will call you out in front of the entire class if you do not understand a simple concept. He has no grasp on the fact that people learn differently than others. BE PREPARED TO FAIL HIS TESTS. He does not prepare you for them at all.
He is an awful teacher! I highly suggest avoiding his class at all costs. He does not explain anything and expects you to know all the answers. AWFUL teacher

I love having Profe Rucci, she's one of the sweetest people here, I looked forward to coming to class when I can, and if I missed something she was so understanding and just wants your success. Professor Rucci is one of my favorite professors ever! She is so kind and caring and always makes you excited to go to class which is nice for a change! She is always engaging in conversation with students about what is going on with us and makes it really easy and fun to learn with her!

comment: The professor makes statistics the easiest possible class that he can. He has homework that he assigns a week out before its due. Test are based almost directly on the notes so just study/look over those and you'll be good. Easy for me who did not like statistics that much.

This class was very simple and pretty easy. A few homework assignments and a few tests that were not too hard at all. Took notes pretty much every class, easy A. He likes to make jokes and use relevant scenarios. Would take his class again.
he is somewhat confusing in his lectures but very nice and eager to help if you need it and he is always making jokes during class to break up the lecture

comment: He was great. Quite quick with grades and super fair. Kind of awkward but he is funny and it makes him likable. His class is super easy and the tests are too if you understand the homework (it is mainly based off that). His lectures are kind of slow but he gives out candy in the middle of them sometimes (his exams are also mostly multiple choice)
Hes an ok professor just hes really monotone and boring and makes a lot of mistakes in class but overall Im not usually good at Statistics but his class wasnt that hard

Dr. Krieg is a good teacher, but the class is very lecture heavy, but that's expected of stats. You are graded on homework and quizzes (quizzes were take home and open notes) and there is no final. He makes class fun and is easy going. I loved his daily stat that he would ask us and he gave the winner a prize. Take him, its an easy A and you learn.

*I thought this class was easy. Prof. Krieg was nice and reasonable. (He let me take a test at a different time due to another test on the same day.) Have taken 2 classes with him & love him. Very nice & makes jokes/tells stories. Lectures every class but gives notes for every lesson to follow along. He is a weird dude and if you ask him a question he usually cannot answer it. But class was really easy, just show up and pay attention and you'll get an A. There's only 4 quizzes and 10 homework assignments and I got 100's on everything.

He is the best professor I ever had. He made econ so easy to understand. He outlined the notes , so come to class and follow along . The quizzes are 40 multiple choices questions. They are easy because they right off the notes.

Really enjoyed Prof. Krieg. literally the easiest class you can take at fisher. shoutout to my boy Randall, the original OG with lit trivia questions of the day

Professor Krieg is very nice! There are no homework assignments besides reading out of the textbook (but I'm pretty sure no one did). Only 4 tests and he drops your lowest (that includes the final). It was a super easy class. All you had to do was show up and take down notes. He made stats a bearable class. He has an easy-going personality and is super nice. He is always willing to help you if you are struggling in the class. He was fine he just really doesnt know what hes talking about . nice guy, very understanding. you can skip class but be there to turn in the hw. Tests and quizes are easy, I got a B and hate stats. He doesnt know stats well and the students correct him but hes super nice.

The guy used to be the dean of the school, and its probably a good thing that he's not anymore. This man literally does not know how to talk in front of a group of people. It is honestly embarrassing to watch. He dumbs things down so much that you are then lost. Dr. Vacca is extremely smart, she knows her subject matter, and she's pretty sassy too!

awesome professor. very understanding and a fair grader, class is an easy A just go to class, skim the readings answer a few questions in classes... no tests or quizzes.. just readings, 3 papers and a midterm

Good professor overall,  I like her style of teaching, she is also very smart and knows a lot about history.
easy teacher...dont have to read...just read whats given...she provides the rest

too much on sided discussion
I highly recommend taking any history class from her. Classes are always interesting with good discussion, and she is one of the fairest teachers here.
A great teacher and a good lookin' gal!

Professor Lambert is a really good professor I had him for Accounting he makes the class interesting and explains stuff clearly the only thing is the midterm and final are a lot of our grade but theyre only 20 questions over 6 units and you dont know what to study

Professor Lambert is by far my favorite here at Fisher. He is very understanding and a great teacher. Great teacher in an introductory class. Sets up students for the rest of the accounting classes they will have to take.

one of the worst teachers for your beginner/ freshman year because she expects you to be able to write just like her, she loves organ donation and if you disagree with her on that you shouldn't be an organ donator, good luck getting about a C, grades very hard, the endpaper makes no sense and is really hard to get higher than a B. Dr D is a nice person and a solid professor , her reading quizzes are very easy as long as you READ. She is a very tough grader on her papers so be ready to work hard on them .

comment: Graded on 3 exams and a cumulative final, and practice point quizzes, all based on his powerpoints. A really good choice for the class I chose Nothing over the top in terms of requirement's such as hw, studying, etc Gives you great study guides for the tests and will go over questions the class before the quiz Taking Notes is Heavy advised as well as bringing your Computer to go along the class notes
One of my favorite professors. A very nice guy who genuinely cares about how his students are doing. He is lecture heavy, but good at teaching. I found his class to be very fair.

He is an amazing teacher, though monotone, he understands his class is hard and will work with you. On exams he tries to find you points in order to pass and i strongly recommend him for any anatomy class

Great professor! Clear expectations and grading criteria. Study guides for exams are helpful. Very thorough in lab. Takes the time to check in with each student during dissections to be sure theyre getting it.  Allows exam remediation, which reinforces more difficult info so it will stick with you in the future. Loved his class!

One of my favorite professors! Pay attention, study your notes and make sure you really pay attention and focus when it comes to the lab practicals- everything else should go smoothly if you actually make an effort.

Dr. Falanga is an amazing teacher. He is very easy to understand and covers everything you are tested on. In lab he is very helpful. He is a lot of fun and enjoys cracking jokes. I can't wait to take another of his classes.
He is a good teacher, always willing to help his students. If you study for his test you will do fine.

Dr. Falanga is an amazing professor. For a professor that teaches at different colleges he sure does know how to make student understand the matter and he teaches students what they need to know NOTHING more. He is very laid back and easy to follow in lecture and lab. The quizzes are great that he gives since it will help for review on exams.
Falanga is great. He is extremely awkward but a good professor

I AM ACTUALLY A STUDENT FROM MCC THAT TOOK A BIO 142 WITH PROFESSOR FALANGA.  HE IS A GREAT EDUCATOR THAT WANTS THE STUDENTS TO PASS AND BE SUCCESSFUL! MY ADVICE:PRINT POWERPOINT SLIDE, READ THE TEXTBOOK, TAKE GOOD NOTES, AND STUDY THE "STUDY GUIDE" FROM THE M-DRIVE IT'S AVAILABE FOR EVERY EXAM INCLUDING THE FINAL! GREAT PROFESSOR!!!
Such a great person and teacher. He loves his job! Always willing to help and go over things if you dont understand.
Dr. Falanga is a great guy who really wants his students to do well.  He was willing to come to school on a holiday so I could make up a test that I missed.  He even went out with us after the final!
Dr. Falanga is a great teacher. he's always willing to help you with any problems and raises your grade at the end of the semester if you have shown improvement. I always love going to his classes

Dr. Falanga is a good professor once you adjust to his teaching styles and methods. He was always willing to help and enjoyed watching his students understand the material. He does expect you to come to class having covered some of the material prior to class, but he is reasonable.

If you have Professor Berman for managing organizational behavior then the class rocks hes a super funny guy always cracking jokes and has a good sense of humor I would always look forward to his class every week hes always there to help others and he really tries to get to know his students
Professor Berman is just a great human being. His classes are extremely interactive and enjoyable. Highly recommend. Tough grader but the class is worth it.
He does not use powerpoints or anything like that. Everything for notes is written on the board. Very interactive classes.
Highly reccomend, great guy and even better mentor.

An amazing professor! Classes are interactive and interesting and tests are essay based. Attendance is a non issue. Totally recommend this course and this professor. Easily my favorite and most highly respected professor here at fisher.
Shows real passion for his work and his students. The class is a lot of group activities and guest speakers but makes the class go by quick. Not a lot of grades so make the ones you have count.

He is one of the best professors at Fisher. He is caring and is a great role model for students. He is passionate about what he teaches and does and is very open with the students about his life and always cares about how the students are doing. Very conversational and interactive class
Love Jason, he's the embodiment of the fisher family.

He's a great guy and love to talk about deep stuff.  Very personable but a hard graded.  Though I could take this class as an easy A but it made me work moderately hard and got a B+. DO NOT TAKE IF YOU'RE LOOKING FOR A GPA BOOSTER. Like I said, great guy, hard grader.

One of the best people you will ever meet. You will thoroughly enjoy his class. You will expect an A because you feel like you're really putting in the work, but you probably won't get it. He is very willing to explain to you what you did wrong, but won't change your grade. The only way to describe it is that he is a VERY though grader.

Berman is the best professor I've had at fisher. He assigns little homework but the tests are hard, long, and specific. Don't let that discourage you from his course, he goes over all the information in a fun way so as long as you have notes, you'll be fine
He was a wonderful professor to have. Really gets you thinking about your direction in life and who you are and who you want to become. I liked that he doesn't really teach a textbook based class.

You are only graded on a few tests and a final, and one 2-page paper. If you bomb one test consider your "A" out the window. He loves to comment on how much money/assets he has, which gets quite repetitive. The class material is crucial for the test so take notes. You don't need the book.

Berman is awsome! He is such a nice guy and is always willing to help if you are having trouble. Pay attention in class, all the notes you take are the answers for the tests. Don't really need the book, but take good notes. Tests are a bit tough because they are essay questions, but if you study it's generally easy.
Nice guy but is a tough grader and takes weeks to get the tests back to you.

Professor Berman is a great guy but overall he's not that good of a professor. His classes were meant to engage students and give them real life examples of the theories but when it's test time, he is a really tough grader. All short answer questions and doesn't give you much help on what to study. Show up to class and you'll do fine.

Dr. Berman is a great professor. He doesn't lecture to students, but instead uses real life examples and a lot of activities to teach the class. Also he is a funny guy, but at some times I feel his jokes are not suitable for the time or even make me feel rather uncomfortable. I think he tries to impress us too much. But overall he teaches well.

Jason is great. Very helpful and makes class interesting. He encourages you to read the text but the only time I used it was to help me write papers. He uses a lot of different "tools" to relate class topics to life. Takes a huge interest in his students and in helping his students get to know each other. I would definitely recommend him.
AMAZING Teacher. Truly Cares about his students! One of the Best at SJFC. Tests are challenging, but fair.

This class had the potential to be one of my favorite classes, but since there were many people in my class that were to immature to handle it we were unable to accomplish everything that was supposed to be done.

He is overrated and past his prime. It's time for some new blood at Fisher to teach leadership in the MBA program. Someone more innovative at engaging students. This guy has been preaching the same thing for far too long. Extremely boring, especially if you took him for undergrad. Experience papers are somewhat helpful though.

Needlessly hard grader. Class seems so easy until you take the test and your answers are overly scrutinized. I would not recommend him as the grade you receive will not be indicative of your performance in the class.
it really bothered me how it takes him almost one month to grade a test.
Nice guy
I absolutely love this professor. He is easy to follow, keeps the class interested, and cares about his students. If you can take him, take him. You won't regret it.

Berman is really cool. Easy class and easy going professor. Test were ridiculously easy, the only problem I had with the class was you have to wait weeks before you get test results back. Overall great class, take him!!!

Had Jason for undergrad and again for graduate. SAME material! What a waste as is his class, it's all old school business processes that are mostly simply out dated. Have you never heard of Lean Management? Seems to be diplomatic with problems but you'll find he is two faced.
best professor on campus hands down

I love uncle jason, hes the funniest teacher ever. class isn't mandatory but you'll want to go just to see what he'll so. tests are easy if you attend review classes because he basically gives you the answers. i love this guy

Uncle Jason is a great professor! He manages to make learning fun, and tries to get to know his students well. His tests can be difficult, but if you attend review sessions, really study and know the material, you should get a good grade. He kind of plays favorites, but if you're outgoing and active in class, he should like you. TAKE HIM!

Dr. Berman was a great professor. He is really passionate about his job and takes a strong interest in his students.  He is very approachable for help and uses great examples to make coursework easier to understand. However, he is a hard grader, so know your material.

He is a great teacher and looks as his students as friends instead of teachers, I loved his class and looked forward to going. He does tend to play favorites with students who have a hardship or difficulty in their life and make people feel bad for them and he asks for many personal essays. Is a tough grader for writing but is a sweet man.

Dr.Berman is by far the best professor i have had at this college.He is easy to understand.Asks you to read the books, but you don't need to.Attendance is not a necessity from this man.Very smart guy.There is no homework and two tests plus the final.Makes class fun instead of boring.Makes you laugh and a great guy to be around.TAKE HIM!!!!
Amazing Man... Take one of his classes and you will be forever changed...for the positive.

Uncle Jason is the best!!! I took Leadership Through self Development with him and every class was interesting!!  His lectures can get kind of long (but that's ok.. you're not asked to do anything but reflect on them). he really cares about his students and we all loved that class
Cool Guy knows what hes talking about and easy to understand He explains things very well.
awesomee professor!

I took Leadership and Organizational Behaviorism with him. He spoke 9 hours on the Challenger accident. $2500 for an MBA class for that. I had no idea what he wanted. If you are not one of his favorites that "woooo" his every comment he doesn't like you. Don't challenge him. He just talks about himself...and he has a PhD in Psych not Business.

one word describes him.  Uncle J is Amazing.  Casual, laid back, very good at what he does.  relaxed atmosphere.  throws his professor based authority out the window and relies on your respect for him.  I enjoyed every moment of the class, and it was the one class i actually looked forward to.  never know what to expect, but it is sure to be good.

Amazing Teacher! In Class Thier Is Always Fun Activities And You Get To Sit In Groups At Tables. You Can Talk With Your Friends And Socialize During Class. He Let's You Choose When You Want To Schedule Your Tests And Attendance Is Not Required. He Also Lets You Miss Tests If You Have A Conflict. Believe Me If Your Gonna Take This Course Take It Wit
Great Guy--Knows what he is talking about and how to present material.  Very hard grader in terms of writing.  But, if you can write than there is no worry.  He is a transformational teacher.
tough,tough grader! plays his favorites
I love Mr Berman! He changed my life and helped me through some very hard times! 100 cool pnts
Good teacher, but a grades hard. If its not the way Jason wants it than it is wrong.
It was always an interesting seminar.
excellent, excellent professor
Nice guy, good teacher, but is a little full of himself and is a hard grader for simple intro courses.
Dr. Berman is a great teacher.  His style of teaching makes even the most difficult theorys easy to grasp.
He is a terrible teacher without time for his students.  Never assigns any work and bases his grade around nothing. He teaches business and leadership classes and I apologize if you have him.

Helps you to apply concepts, learn  real world  applications, very intelligent and challenging.  Best prof at Fisher!

Extremely tough grader. After editing my paper 4 times, having the writing center give feedback, and having the librarian edit formatting, I still had a bad final grade. I have never had papers graded as harshly as she does (in my masters), its almost comical how nitpicky she is. Dont bother trying your best, its never good enough.
*Super picky on writing, even for people who are good writers. This class was a pain. I do not reccomend.*

Makes it her job to know her students & she really cares. Very knowledgeable about the topic, especially when it comes to burn and neuro. Rude. Absolutely rude.

I did not love Dr. Schultz the first time I had her but she grew on me. I had her for EDUC 226 & 331 this semester. As long as you put in some effort you will do well in any of her classes. A lot of her materials are outdated but she does her best & is always willing to answer stupid questions. She does randomly check if you do the reading on BB

Dr. Schultz drove me crazy. It was clear she didn't have much experience in a classroom and her classes were very unorganized. She was a very easy grader but I found it difficult to want to do work for her. She seems to think students have never interacted with a person with disabilities before and she used very outdated materials.

Dr. Schultz is passionate about education and wants her students to succeed. She'll do whatever it takes to assure her students' success. Also, very easy grader and very understanding. She has inspired me to be a better teacher.

Her class was a very easy A, BUT it was very confusing at times. I had her for an educational technology course and didn't feel like I learned too much about technology in the classroom. Her assignments were confusing and I was confused about when they were due. But I submitted everything and got great grades. She is a very nice woman.

Best professor ever!  It is impossible not to do well if you follow her directions and rubrics.  She is always there to help!  I really enjoyed her class and learned so much. She changes it up so you never get bored.  Chapter reviews were my favorite part of the class, but its all good!  A great teacher and an interesting person.
overall not a bad professor but goes to fast in the lectures
overall just does not teach. REALLY tough grader, if you do not understand you are screwed for the semester.

That other rating is odd as a lone rating for him. Incredibly knowledgeable in statistics and a fantastic teacher of course content. Tests aren't easy but they aren't hard. Homeworks are very helpful.
No Comments

Prof Black is really nice and tries to create an engaging discussion but kinda hard when students don't read. Read 3 novels and 3 hour lecture was way too long. However, if you participate in discussions you don't need to do as well on the papers because she is nice about grading. Would recommend as long as it isn't a three hour class

The professor likes to spin the discussion into a narrative that is contradictory to the actual text. Multiple times she was shown that what she thought the text was saying was directly contradicted within the readings. When the class went online, due to COVID-19, she added MORE work than lessen the work due to the situation.

Corinne is the best English prof or teacher Ive ever had. I dont know why it says St. John Fisher when she is at Binghamton, but if you have the chance to take her class, do it. She creates an engaging class, teaches well, and is just straight up an awesome person.

Professor Black was one of the best professors I've ever had at Binghamton University, even though my experience was through an online class. Professor Black is knowledgeable, and genuinely interested in the material that she teaches. She gives good feedback, and always got our grades back quickly. 10/10.

One of my favorite professors I have ever had, including in high school. Professor Kiani is an exceptional professor and an even better person. She always made time for questions and led class discussions. One of the most understanding professors and made expectations as well as directions clear from the first day.

*I thought this was pretty doable overall.
