I would say though you have a decent shot at an A, the presentation was pretty easy.*

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Group projects', 'So many papers']
comment: The worst professor. She doesn't have timely communication, doesn't grade most work till after course is over and work she does grade, no feedback. Whole course was with group so if your group sucks, oh well. Kiani pays no attention to details. Always gives wrong dates for assignments and was barely present for the online class. DO NOT TAKE HER!!!!

Does not reply to email questions, very vague project requirements, slow to return graded work... All of this in a 7 week online course. Communication is the key to online classes and she was the least communicative professor I have ever had. This was hands down the worst course I have ever taken all due to the professor.

I thought the delivery skills were great. Her presentations and lectures were engaging, while really encouraging her students to participate. I personally don't participate a lot in my classes, but participated more than usual during hers. The course was designed in a way that promoted both academic learning and the real-life application.
She has a poor time speaking English, so if you foresee that being an issue (it is) then shes not for you. There are way better professors than her.

My overall impressions is that Professor Kiani is a great teacher and does different activities to help students learn as must as they can. The course is a great addition to the business school and a solid option for marketing majors. The instructor is someone I would take again, she embodies all that Fisher tries to promote.

Dr Kiani's class is extremely fair. She gives ample class time for group projects and always ties the assignments to the course material gone over that day. Would take again. Exams are easy if you pay attention. She's very sweet

I enjoy the design of this course. Feel as if the checkpoints for different phases of the project help us stay on track and help us to clearly understand what is needed. I enjoyed the in class case studies, it helped to put what we read in the chapter into a real scenario.

We need Dr. Isar Kiani in the American classroom setting, now more than ever. As a former valedictorian she has demonstrated expertise in her subject matter. On a personal note, she has the capacity to build bridges in the classroom, both multi-culturally and multi-generationaly speaking. A true scholar with traits that all should aspire to.

She is such a nice lady and I really enjoyed her class. For this T/Thurs class, each Thursday we have a mini chapter quiz from the chapter covered on Tuesday which if you do a brief study/overview you will ace it. These small A's add up! The group project is all semester long with only minimal outside of class work
Easy A if you show up to class, do the group project, and skim the chapters. Must read book because there are weekly 2 point quizzes on them, not difficult if you look through the book.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read', 'Lecture heavy']
comment: For accounting, he is a very good teacher at fisher, currently, there isn't any better accounting professor in my opinion. Lambert is also very good as well but laude really does a good job of explaining things.

This was my second class with him and I was glad to be a part of his classes. I was impressed with his ability to use technology like an iPad for class lectures, he also posted all the notes on Blackboard. He goes slow through the class so if you stay engaged and don't fall behind it shouldn't be too bad. Overall boring and monotone, but it's math.

He is an overall sweet old man, but teaching is not his thing. If you never took calculus in high school or anytime previous to his calc class, DONT take his class or you will struggle through it all teaching yourself from youtube videos or the math center.

Can be confusing at times, but overall is a good guy and does a decent enough job teaching the course. Biggest criticism is that he will try to do tough arithmetic in his head and doesn't catch those errors very quickly. Exams are fair but will have one or two questions that will throw you off, but it won't hurt your grade.

tags: ['ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS', 'LECTURE HEAVY']
comment: Sweet guy, seems to be very knowledgeable. Cannot teach whatsoever. Muench rambles on and on and makes concepts that would typically be pretty easy to understand terribly confusing. This is my most frustrating class this semester.

Really was a long, boring class to be in. Often times will teach you old school, long ways to do math problems. Says there will be a few tests and 8 or so quizzes, but I think he forgot about half of them.

Muench truly knows his stuff when it comes to calc, however it will take him an hour and a half to explain a simple derivation concept. such as how to determine the derivative of a graph of an x^3, it took him 1.5 hours to say that the derivative crosses the x axis when the x^3 reaches a max and min.

He genuinely doesn't seem to care about what students are learning. Verbally assigns homework and gives out broken code to complete homework assignments. Incapable of answering questions that "think outside the box". He will curve the class if everyone does poorly, so make friends.

Dr. Muench is a nice guy but his lectures often are repetitive. We talked about the same things day after day and did not have much of a chance to practice the concepts in class. We were supposed to have multiple exams and only ended up having two along with some small homework assignments. Help is provided if you ask for it
He has an amazing wealth of knowledge but is very easily distracted. Very hard to stay awake in his modeling class, the material is very boring and simple.

I took Linear Algebra with him.  The class wasn't easy but you have to make sure you understand the concepts discussed otherwise you won't do well on the exams.  Grade is based practically entirely on exams and the final.  Small HWs here and there.

No clue to how his grade was based.  Class was in a computer lab, studied basic math systems.  Often makes mistakes in his work, spends only about 20 minutes learning new material.  Go to class and study for the final, if you do well you should be alright.

Dr. Muench is very helpful outside of class.  He grades fairly and his exams, though difficult, are reasonable.  He does get off track during lecture and he will confuse you (and himself) at times.  He will happily clarify an issue for you during office hours or after class.

Guys all over the place. We would spend 20 min doing a problem that was completely wrong and then as a class had to figure out why "that didnt work?". Great guy and willing to help but I would avoid his classes if you need to know the material for future courses. Otherwise if its the last check in the box this is the class u need to be in!
He does not teach well at all.  Very hard to follow what he is teaching in class and what taught and what you are expected to know are on two different levels.  He does not prepare you at all.
A little hard to understand what he's trying to teach, and sometimes assigns quizzes or homeworks and then forgets the next day. If you somewhat know what you're doing then you should be fine.

This Class is horrible. He is incredibly boring and his explanations about the work don't help you at all. He makes you do most work by hand contrary to using the calculator. He just changed my classes syllabus giving us a 2 question quiz at the end of every week which is more of a pain than anything. I don't recommend you take this teacher.
He just stands up at the board and rambles on and on and on. He gets confused by his own work and it confuses you. I would try to take this with another professor if possible.

Positives: Easy class, minimal assignments, very few notes to take, not stenuous at all. Negatives: Assignments came on top of each other towards end. Importance in his class (10=high, 1=low): Listening: 8, Readings: 1, Participation: 2). A stand-up gentleman. Great teacher, and friendly. Course not hard. Textbook not really needed :-)
He is one of the most helpful professors I have had.  He always found time to help me think my way through a problem,

One of the better professors in the comp. sci. dept. However, he's entitled to his opinion, as I am, and I tend to agree with him about SJFC sports. A pre-requisite to teaching is not a love for the athletic dept.
worst professor ever! he doesn't teach, he confused you. the class seems simple cause its stuff you've learned before but he knows how to mess with your head and leave you completely confused
One of the better computer science teachers

Why take a class with a professor who doesn't respect the school he goes to? I mean we are the ones footing the bill and paying his salary! Plus, the boys play for the love of the game, and with no scholarships, they at least have to have some brains!
Didn't know when to keep his mouth shut.  Div. III Rocks!!!!!!!!!
learned alot

Prof. Leboffe was nothing special. For this online course, she used voice thread powerpoint slides, they were hard to learn from. Weekly assignments were difficult and time-consuming. Also held mandatory zoom meetings once per week to go over homework and tests.
All reading and labs, no lectures. Quizzes nitpick on very specific things, not big pictures. Lectures would've been helpful. Always readily available to help, however.

tags: ['Accessible outside class', 'Get ready to read', 'Tough grader']
comment: Very hard grader, will get you for spelling mistakes even on typos. The book and lectures were pretty ok and she was often available to zoom with. Written feedback on assignments were not helpful, just go to her directly with questions.
Isnt clear about what she wants to teach. Reads off of a power point every class. Tries to do examples on the white board but just does it all herself and doesn't explain.
The most recent CSCI 241 review is accurate and applies to CSCI 470. Plain and simple, right down to the 54 test average. Avoid Ms. Leboffe at all costs.

Since this is a technical class, those who learn by working with code are at an advantage. Learn SQL before this course and be prepared to stare at diagrams while this professor floats her ego and laughs when the entire class fails her exams.

Ms. Leboffe is unable to organize her thoughts and translate them clearly and coherently.  Watching her refuse to take accountability for a consistent class average of 54 on all take-home exams is mind-blowing.  Avoid this professor at all costs, she does not have your best interests in mind, only maintaining her ego.

Nice enough lady, but a majority of the students had no clue what was going on and her assignment descriptions are very very vague, lucky that most of the assignments were done in class. Slow, long class and very frustrating.

She has no idea what she's doing when she walks into class. It's a really easy class because most of the work we do as a class, but most of the time we are just sitting there waiting for her to understand what she has to teach us.

wow, this professor must be doing the ratings. Terrible class with no structure. The class material is easy but the assignments are ridiculously unorganized. 90% of the class has no idea of what is going on  and you dont get assignments back so you cant tell where you stand in the class.
As always, the best. Clear, helpful, and knows her stuff. Three tests, a final, and a paper/presentation. Solid teacher.

Great class, one of the most relaxing you'll take. Very hands-on class, as you make your own website and implement the different technologies into it as we go over them. Homework was straightforward and possible. There are NO tests or quizzes or finals! Amen to that! I loved this class. I wish they were all this way, educational, yet not  annoying.

Positives: You learn much, very much. Best teacher in the department. and of course, "GUESS THE DEVICE!" Positives: Take home tests, learn a lot, interesting. Negatives: final not a take home :-), some lengthy printing on hw. Importance in her class (1=low, 10=high): Listen- 9, Reading- 7, Participate- 4. Nice and helpful, easy to understand, knows her stuff.
One of the best in the dept. Clear, consice, and fair. You take her, you'll learn a lot. IF YOU NEED HELP, MAKE AN APPT!
Strict but fair professor. Very helpful and she expresses ideas very clearly. One of the best comp sci professors at Fisher.

Prof. Pape is from the Ivory Coast and has a slight accent that takes getting used to. Once you get over that, he is a great professor with a wonderful personality. Try to stay on top of the reading that is assigned, it will help your participation. Goes over Quizzes/Tests the class before taking them.

Professor Papé I a great guy don't get me wrong. He is very funny and personable. However, if you can't learn from just listening this class will not be for you. Having little interest in the class (Terrorism & Politics) doesn't help either. Graded based on a few quizzes and a HUGE term project at the end of the year (10 page paper & presentation).

Back at it again for french 2. He's really a great guy and does his best to relate to students and be reasonable. Class was a little harder this semester, and it is beyond helpful to already know French before taking the class. Overall, a great professor and was very understanding with Corona.

Very helpful if you already know french from highschool and are trying to review. Learning new will be challenging because we moved really fast. He's funny and a nice guy, I really did improve in my accent and speaking ability this semester. You do not have the ability to not speak french though, he makes sure everyone speaks at least a few times.
Simply expects too much for a 101 course, unless you are pursuing French do not take this class.

Papé is hilarious and fun but can be frustrating at times. He is knowledgable about Africa and eager to share that knowledge.... In every class... Regardless of relevance. His curriculum never seems quite right, but I still learn a lot. Lots of speaking and presenting practice, read aloud a, conversation. He loves to joke- good class atmosphere :)

This is meant to be an intro class yet I am learning things I never learned in level 3 in high school. Difficult to understand. Very high energy and keeps you focused during class. Study guides are similar to tests. Doesn't translate vocab words for you, much figure them out on your own.

An okay grader and class is a lot of work. Tests are similar to the study guides he gives but they are not easy. He is very helpful though and has a great personality. He definitely cares about his students

Nice guy and ahs a very funny sense of humor.  He is extremely hard to understand and the class is VERY boring if you are not a international studies major.  Stay away if youre looking for an interesting class
He is a very nice professor. I have enjoyed taking the advanced spanish classes with him. His tests are very easy but I do have a lot of spanish background in place so it might be hard for others.
Very nice professor. Class was relatively interesting. He keeps you the whole time in night class. Tests were minimal and there was only one project. Overall, he did a good job.
He's a great guy, very funny. Assignments can be a little unclear, but ask and he'll help you out.
He is a very good prof. He gives the exact exam to the students a few days before (quizzes too) and if you study it hard and understand it, the tests are easy.

Good Professor.  The Class was fun.  It might have been because it revolved around the Lord of the Rings, but she is very helpful and actually makes you see things in the books that you wouldn't have seen before.  I wish she had more classes.
She's funny.
Awesome, she has fun and at the same time can make sure that we know everything we need to. She takes a class that could be potentially boring and makes me look foreward to it.

She's very very kind, never makes you feel like you said something stupid, explains things well, encourages participation, is cute when she's all excited.  She's a gem.  How can you not love this woman?  (To quote another reviewer.)
she is the most amazing professor and person! i wish i could take more classes with her because she is the smartest, kindest person.

How can you not love this woman?  She does take time out of class to help you if needed and still remembers you when you're not in her class anymore. Favors tom boys and males.  Does not grade fair. Impossible to get the grade you deserve.  Highly unrecommended!

Dr. D is sweet and caring and provides comprehensive content without being too work heavy. There are weekly reading quizzes, and the exams are entirely composed of the quizzes. Easy if you show up and put in minimal effort. He is awesome to listen to!

He is the most unprofessional and unreasonable Prof in all of Fisher.  Were it not for a few Prof's in accounting and Finance who actually add value to the program, the MBA would be a comlpete waste.  "Those who can DO, those who can't (Deligonul)TEACH" And he isn't even good at that.

Dr. D. is awesome! Very knowledgeable. His quizzes are take-home, open book, many of his test questions are from the quizzes, so if you do your work, you'll do fine in his class. Real nice guy; I highly recommend him.

*You have to take this class in business and Prof Wallace is prob your best bet. The subject is hard, but pay attention and prepare and you should be good. *I overall had a good experience with Prof. Parrilli. She was easy to learn from and was encouraging if she knew you were trying (whether that meant you got good grades or were average). My favorite professor. I think it's a manageable class but class average wasn't too high.

comment: Professor Parrilli is incredibly caring and will do anything to help her students succeed. She is available almost anytime you ask her to be and has lots of office hours. There is a lot of homework, but it prepares you for the exams. She teaches by doing practice problems which is incredibly helpful in learning accounting.

Very caring, wants her students to get the highest grade possible. Quiz/test just about every week, but ample materials provided to study, and expectations are more than clear. Will be taking ACCT 102 with her.
She is such a great professor, super kind, and understands college is stressful. Amazing
She will inspire you every class to become a better accountant!!!! It's accural world out there!

Tests are tough, the class is hard but she is a very good professor. she wants everyone to do well in the class. she bases the final grade off 5 tests, a final, hw grade, and a group project. take this class but you must want to work hard outside of the classroom

This is a demanding course, it is the material, not her.  She is very fair.  If you do the work, it is very manageable.  As she says, it isn't rocket science.  She is always available for extra help and wants everyone to do well.  Tests are tough but fair.

At first she comes off strong in what she expects, but by the end of the course the syllabus was garbage. She eliminated at least 3 scheduled quizzes which were originally on the syllabus and is a nice grader. She helps everyone and is always in her office when you need her. Quick to respond to emails. Amazing professor. Always around to help during office hours. Willing to ask students for feedback to adjust her teaching style according to her current students needs. Material isn't very interesting, but hey, its accounting after all. My favorite professor at SJFC so far.

My favorite professor at St. John Fisher. She acknowledges if people are struggling and works to find ways to help them. She devotes a lot of time for office hours and helping students. Most of the homework is done online, but is doable with the book.  Overall she a nice lady who wants her students to pass and excel.

I HATE accounting, but she is a very good teacher. Really nice, very helpful, very understanding. I cannot thank her enough for actually passing me through 102 when I was clueless. She is a great teacher. Take  notes, pay attention, do the exercises even though she does not check them, and always go to her for help!

Loved her so much. She was so kind & really cared for her students. Great activities, lectures & notes. Very easy class to pass. One big final project based on the lesson throughout the semester. Great education professor

Dr. Hildenbrand is the sweetest person on the planet. Honestly, all you have to do is show up and participate and you'll be fine. Definitely don't wait to do the final project, but other than that you'll love the class and the professor.

Have enjoyed this class enormously. She has given people the opportunity to develop their creative and critical essays. She is the best.

I learned a lot in this class. 1. The art of film. 2. How to pay attention to details. 3. Understanding social consequences.  I went to extra credit events that ties to the films we watched.  The class was difficult, but  this is my education, and I wanted to learn this material. I would take it again.

Easy grader on papers but definitely picks favorites and yells at you if you aren't trying hard enough. She keeps you in class the whole time and rambles on and on. Boring!

She is a nice person as long as she likes you. Dont take a common opinion of anything- youll lose points on your homework. Dont expect her to be respectful of you or your time. MJ brings me joy everyday I am in her class. She is the sweetest person I have met. She is very informative and drops lots of hints like you should be writing this down. She's a great professor. I  so loved this creative writing class: poetry,fiction, creative nonfiction, loved the quilt essay, my favorite creative work this semester.  Because of her, I'm starting to submit my work.

She's not rude.  She's giving us a wake up call. She's the teacher.  If the last person who commented has this reaction, then you are the one who is guilty.She is very organized.  We've gotten our papers back every week. Assignments have been posted ahead of time.  She's fair and patient.
she is so unorganized and RUDE!!!! her emails are nasty. If one person does something she acts like everyone did it.. would NOT take another course with her..
Great teacher.  Really enjoyed the class.  Get your assignments done on time and you won't have any problems.

Please refrain from reading the prior rating. I was having a bad day and chose to take my anger out on the world. The world being M.J. Iuppa. She is a great advisor, I should have been the bigger person and walked away.
shes my advisor and ive had her many times. shes ok, nice, but a little cooky. didnt learn alot and if she doesnt like your topic it gets a bad grade. eh

M.J. puts the wind in my sails.

AWESOME

awesome teacher

sweetest woman ever. not a lot of work and is very lenient on late work. super easy grader

comment: Dr. Douglas goes a lot slower than all the other professors so he wants students to understand the material but he is also detailed and strict on grading. He is a good professor and is clear when teaching the material. However, he is a hard test grader.

Dr. Bell is a fantastic Professor who challenges you to not just coast but to seriously think about the topic of discussion. great professor. He was extremely willing to help his students&was willing to work with students as long as you show youre trying. Bell really wants the best for students

His classes can be confusing but once you get to know him well, he really tries to help and push you as well as he can. He is a really good guy and one of my favorite Professors even though his content can be confusing.

Awful professor, super confusing all the time and gets passive aggressive when nobody can answer his unclear questions. I'm doing more work than my 300 level courses while retaining less info than them for a 100 level course. He's flexible but if his papers weren't so unclear and confusing he wouldn't need to be.

I was surprised at Prof. Bell's low ratings on here. I absolutely LOVE him. He's probably the funniest professor I've ever had and has great banter with his students. He will change the syllabus if you ask him to and is really willing to help his students. Lots of moviesvideos, 3 papers, and only one test (the final). Take his class!

I liked Dr. Bell as a professor. While his classes can be confusing and his can be hard to get a hold of, he is willing to help. You just have to show up at his office basically or catch him after class. His assignments are not that difficult. As long as you try and actually care he'll give you a decent grade.

Will change the schedule to fit around the students, but is very unclear when giving assignments. I tried to get help from him but he made no move to help me. Doesn't respond to emails and doesn't show up for appointments with students. Expectation similar to grad school, when it is only a 200 level course.

He is very flexible, he was willing to move assignments, even change their requirements at times. However, when I didn't understand something he wouldn't go out of his way to help me. I would go to his office hours, e-mail, and talk to him after class. He expects students to take their notes outside of class. Expectation similar to grad school

This class was mostly a lot of A&P lab quizzes, and 2 lab practicals. If you study, review the materials she gives, and listen to the lectures in the lab, you will do just fine. There is a group project, and sometimes the feedback she gave for that was a bit confusing, but if you have any questions she will gladly answer them and try to help.

I had Dr. Anderson for lab last semester and she was amazing! She was super kind and she really knew her stuff! The content is hard to follow sometimes no matter who you have, but she made it much easier to understand.

Dr. Anderson was my favorite professor this year. She made reference to how it was her first year teaching a couple of times in the beginning of the semester, but honestly, I never would have noticed; it seemed like it all came naturally to her. She was one of the most caring and kind-hearted professors I have had the privilege of getting to know.

Forbes is a solid teacher. He likes to talk and repeat things over and over, so be prepared. Otherwise he is very knowledgeable, easy to talk to, and his class is interesting. Large project that is due at the end of the semester, but Forbes lets makes you work on it throughout the semester, and works on it in class with you so pretty easy to do

comment: Professor Fee was a nice professor, however, he was a very tough grader, and only 5 assignments comprised your final grade. So, as you can imagine, they were very heavily weighted. 3 quizzes (20MC, 20T/F) very factual/statistic based questions that you probably won't know/remember.

Fee is an adjunct professor, he is really nice but I feel like this class is a waste of money, he doesn't add any interesting or useful content to the lesson because he just reads out of the text book, I don't even read the text book anymore bc he does it for us in class. First test is hard & rest are easy.

This teacher grades people on her favorites in class. For instance, I prepared for a writing exam with a few of my friends and they received much higher grades than I did despite having similar works. This isn't the only issue with this teacher. If ever ever had a question, she would follow with another one. How is one supposed to learn like this!
This is a fantastic professor. He is hilarious and very passionate about what he is teaching. You will definitely leave his class knowing how to write a research paper.

Dr. O'Neil is an amazing teacher, he is very helpful in writing. Scott was a great teacher and for sure what you would want in a English professor.

Dr. Maples is easily one of my favorite professors at SJFC. She is so bold and really gets students out of their comfort zones. We had about four papers the whole semester and 3/4 were very easy. She is so funny and does not hold anything back. There is a decent amount of group work/projects. We really talked about things that matter in society
Doc Mapes is The G.O.A.T.!!!!!

I learned so much about writing from her class. She gave us so much feedback that was helpful plus we broke the paper down into smaller papers which made the assignment less intimidating. Shes hilarious and really cares and wants you to do well.
Dr. Maples is definitely the best teacher I have had since I entered college. She always found a way to include us in the lecture, which was one of the reasons I loved going to her class!
We all love her! Shes funny, caring, passionate and makes you always do your best.

Capstone is hard, but Dr. Maples supports you the whole way and has such high expectations for you. She gives you a lot of feedback to revise your paper and make it better. Be prepared to write and rewrite but then you are surprised at what you have written because its really good. Could not imagine taking this course with anyone else.

Best class I took at Fisher. Learned a lot about technology, and they were things I could ACTUALLY use in the classroom. She makes you work for it, but she cares so much about you being the best teacher you can be it doesn't seem that bad.
I had her for two semesters in a row. I learned a lot. She is a mama bear about us. You can go to her for anything and she will help.

I had a professor before her who made me want to quit teaching. Dr. Maples changed that for me. I learned more in the first night from her than the entire class with the other professor. She challenges you, makes you think, and really cares about you.

In my first class with her I learned more than I have in an entire semester with other professors. She gives interesting lectures with real life experiences. She's funny and we read really good books in her class. She knows what she is talking about. Take her if you can. You won't regret it!
She changed my life. Changed me. Made me think about issues in ways I hadnt before. I learned a lot about myself.

Good books--so good they were the first books I ever read from start to finish. She's funny, demanding, challenges you, but you know she cares about you. Goes above and beyond for you. I wish I had more classes with her.
Read a lot of good books in her class. Demanding, but caring. I learned a lot.

Read the best young adult literature in this class. She knows her stuff when it comes to teen books. We read a lot but they were so good! Wants you to be creative. Challenges your views in class--doesn't let comments slide without you backing them up. Give her a raise! She's the best at Fisher.

How does she make an online class as good as her face to face classes? I was really nervous about capstone online, but it is well organized, interesting, and she is still there for you all the way til the end.

Maples made my undergrad experience worth it. Unique in her views and approaches and makes you think about issues on a larger scale. Pushes the limits of your comfort zone. She is passionate about advocating for students and she genuinely cares about you as a person and as a future educator. Reconfirmed for me why I want to teach. Best professor.
Could not have done capstone without her

Was worried about diversity with her as I've heard she's tough and makes people really admit to their prejudices. 3 weeks in the class, I love her. She's such an inspirational teacher. We stay late after class because her class is so interesting. I'm learning so much about myself. First professor I've had that's actually changing my life.

Tough when it comes to her expectations of you. She simply will expect nothing less than the best from you. But she will help you get there unlike some other profs. I never thought I could do the work I've done in her class. She's awesome and I'm so glad I finished my thesis with her.

I want to be a teacher like her--passionate, funny, caring, and pushes our thinking. She cares about us and challenges us. I look forward to her class every time. I never know what to expect and I always learn a lot.
Class flies by because she is so interesting. Really pushes our thinking. I want to be a teacher just like her. It doesn't hurt that she's easy on the eyes either!

I had her for methods courses and she was fabulous. Now have her for master's capstone. She is amazing--has high expectations for us and expects good work, but she also cares about us and helps us be the best too. I hate this is my last class with her.

Had her for the first time this summer. Her reputation is stellar--she's funny, caring, has high expectations, and knows her stuff. She made me a reader again. I love all her book selections. I loved coming to class in the summer! That says a lot.

Amazing! She knows her stuff and is really passionate about teaching. Pushes us to think. Cares about us. I'm a better person for having her as a teacher. I hope I can influence my students like she has me.

Had her for a literature class and learned so much from her. She makes us think outside of the box and encourages us to use technology. She is passionate about her teaching and she really cares about us. If you can take her, you should!
Dr. Maples is awesome. I actually like going to her class unlike the other ones in my program. She is smart, caring, and we learn so much from her. She really loves what she does!
Dr. Maples rocks! She cares if you learn and mixes theory with practice. Best literacy prof at SJFC.

Dr. Maples is the best professor I have ever had within my college career! You can tell she really wants her students to succeed and that her heart is there! She makes class fun, interesting, and interactive! The work is not to hard, just time consuming- but definitely worth it! I learned a lot about myself within her class!
One of the most down to earth ladies you will ever meet. She is from the south so you can poke fun at her a lot at the way she talks

Dr. Maples makes anything interesting and really understands her subject area and the people she is teaching. She advocates for you and really listens to what you have to say. I wish she taught all of the classes in the Literacy Master's program.
doesn't lecture that well. just watch videos and do the problems at the end of each chapter.

Only four easy homework assignments the whole semester and a final project. She gave extra credit opportunities for every test (very easy) and she drops your lowest test grade. Love her!

Professor Tweet is one of my favorite professors. She is very nice and if you miss class she lets you make anything up. She does a lot of group projects and is a really easy grader.

she is an amazing professor, trust me we aren't laughing wither her we are laughing at her but she loves it. but get ready to read and write. lots of in-class writings. but if you just read the syllabus and stay on top of your work you will be successful. very good with missing work as well, she will always let you make it up.

I like her as a person, but this class was way too difficult for a 100 level course. I only took this course because I thought it would raise my GPA and IT'S MY LOWEST GRADE. Professor tweets lectures can sometimes be boring, but there were not many for my class. We watched a few films and mostly did a lot of really simple group presentations on an assigned book chapter. I had Tweet for the Helping Relationships course, and the semester flew by. We had a few papers, but they were about yourself and experiences which made them very easy, and I never received a grade below a 90. Her tests are the easiest I've taken while in college, as the material is common sense and she goes over what she wants you to know.

If you do not intend to become a social worker, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.  I thought it would interesting but I was wrong.  Classes are extremely boring, assignments are unclear and ALL papers have to be 5 pages long.  Save yourself the regret, I will NEVER take another class with her ever again.  It was a complete waste of my time and money.

5 textbooks that were barely, if at all, used. Her lectures are pointless because they make no sense. Her tests require no studying, such a joke. The guest speakers were actually beneficial and I wish there were more. Also wish that she didn't quiz you on every little thing the speaker said.

I feel myself fighting to stay awake. We had to buy 3 texts books and she assigns reading every night. She has a lot of guest speakers come in, but they usually talk about boring topics. She makes you do a project with the whole class. I don't even know what she's talking about some times. Very scattered. Wouldn't take a class with her again.

I was really looking forward to this class. But she ruined it. I had to buy 5 textbooks for this class, she taught nothing. She has too high expectations for a 100-level course

She doesn't even know the material. She takes a very round about way to teach. We had to buy 5 books which we wound up only reading about 4 chapters from each. We have to write four papers which are impossible because they don't at all relate to the class. DON'T TAKE ANY OF HER CLASSES!!!
DO NOT TAKE ANY CLASS WITH HER. She is awful. She's so awkward and teaches nothing. She's not flexible with anything. I taught myself everything for this course.

201 is a hard course because of the material, not because of the professor. Dr. Tyson makes you work for your grade, so it isn't an easy A. He is a terrible teacher all he does is stand in front of the class and read from slides, he takes about 10 seconds going over the slide then he moves on to the next one. comment: Extremely tough class. Class material and quizzes are completely different from exam material. Exams are nothing like quizzes and homework, and he tries to trip students up on exams. Terrible. Make sure you are prepared to teach yourself. Powerpoint lectures, doesn't go over problems, just shows you the answers.

Just as bad as I remember him in acct 201. Still just stands up in front of class and reads off of his slides. Not very good at explaining things to students. powerpoint and wileyplus

He is a horrible teacher and cannot teach without the powerpoint and he claims he is in head of the accouting dept.  I do not recommend this prof to anyone.  Take 201 at MCC if at all possible!!  He is not clear and very hard to understand.  He does not explain anything.  Do not take him!

not a bad guy, get to know him and he'll help you out. tests are a bit ridiculous but a little studying never hurts anyone
awesome teacher, kind of a hard class, but once you get pass this class, i have heard that it gets a little easier

really tough class, and i didn't like his teaching format.  teaches by powerpoint and lecture, not a very good way to teach accounting.  this is the class where they separate the students who can handle being accounting majors and those who can't.
terrible class, he is the number one reason accounting majors swich to managemant

Really nice professor and she keeps lectures interesting and talks to the students a lot, but its hard to prepare for tests, no one does well, you have to study the lectures, notes, book, and something no one knows yet, in order to do well on tests.

his classes are pretty simple: you do the homework and then talk about it in class. you have to participate once for the class and thats it. papers aren't difficult as long as you follow his directions, and they're only one-two pages max. he's a cool guy if you participate and know what you're talking about

love him! he is very interesting and intelligent and he's easy to get along with and easy going. if you participate in class discussions it'll be a good class. simple presentation with a partner and super easy midterm paper and final paper based off class discussion questions.

Quizzes every week but he doesn't teach you anything before the quiz as you are expected to read between 40-50 pages, take the quiz, then the next two days of class learn about what you took the quiz on.
He's great!

Love Professor Clarke! I've taken numerous classes with him and although he quizzes each Monday on readings, even if you don't ace every quiz you have the opportunity to do well. Lectures are interesting and make you want to participate. Gives ample opportunities for extra credit and his papers are simple and straight forward.
Amazing! Take his classes!
Awesome guy. He conveys his interest in sociology in every lecture he teaches.  Great course, great professor
Awesome guy, easy class, do the readings, fun!

Professor Clarke is the man.  Simple as that.  He cares about what he teaches and really engages the class.  If you do the work you will recieve a good grade.  I'm praying Fisher keeps Clarke here.  This guy is the best professor around.  Number 1!!

Probably the best teacher at Fisher. He was always animated about what he was talking about and very passionate, it kept the class engaged. He's willing to help and there was tons of extra credit. Quizes weren't always easy but if you did the work you got good quiz scores. I thik 2013 is his last year teaching at Fisher though. Bummer!

Nicest and easy going professor. My favorite professor at fisher. Very helpful and is willing to help students outside of class. His lectures are amazing even if you aren't that into sociology, because he is very animated about what he teaches. Side note, study for the quizzes and do the extra credit, then it's an easy A!
Amazing. Very interesting to listen to. Nicest teacher. Easy going. Make sure you study for his quizes and you will be fine. I'd take all his classes if possible.
Nicest person I have ever met. Very smart about sociology and makes the class interesting. Take him at all costs

Took this as my RW and found it very easy. Only a few assignments given (allowed to redo to raise your grade). Class time is devoted to helping you with your paper and questions you have. Very nice guy that is available to help whenever needed. 15 page paper was EASY with Clarke's expectations for the content of the paper. Take this RW if you can!!

I took this as my RW class. Clarke is very nice and most of the time he gives you little assignments just to give you a good grade. He wasn't very clear about how to write our research paper but if you go to him he's very helpful.
Great guy
love this guy! so engaging and just all around a nice person. but if you dont like to read and take notes dont take his class. great guy though!
Extremely smart and a great teacher. weekly quizzes make up majority of grade based on reading. awesome lectures! loved going to this class.

I liked Kevin. I though he was a very good professor and helps you learn the material. He also engages in good class discussions. Gives out weekly reading quizes, but no final! Overall, good professor.

HE'S AWESOME! :) Class was always fun, great lectures, very enthusiastic and interesting. No midterm, no final, just read the chapters, take a quiz once a week and write 4 or 5 really easy papers about yourself! He's very approachable and helpful. Definitely favorite teacher at fisher, take any class with him and you'll love it! He's the man! :)

She gave good feedback, and I liked how she kept the class interesting by constantly doing group activities. I enjoyed the class, I got a lot out of it, I just wish she would fix the way how she did her quizzes.

She is a very kind professor, however what frustrated me was that she constantly disagreed with the textbook that was required for the class. When I would take her quizzes, I would answer how the textbook stated it and it ended up being wrong. She created her own workbook, focus on that.

Class is 95% lecture so be ready to take notes. He is very straight forward and makes things clear and easy to understand. Midterm and final with a few assignments thrown in. He's one of those professors who doesn't want to make your life difficult.

Dr. Bentivegna is incredibly helpful and makes it impossible to get anything but an A in the class. There is a lot of material to get through but he makes it easy to understand and the tests are both open notebook! He is by far one of the nicest people ever and definitely the best professor I've ever had!

Open book tests and extra credit...easiest prof at Fisher. What I learned from this guy got me into graduate school. If you're interested in psyc&law or forensics, do an internship with him. I learned more practical applications from him than I did in my 4 years at Fisher.
No Comments
First classs pompous jerk
No Comments

Had a night class with him, would always let us out early, but it made it difficult to soak in everything . All lecture is hand written, no slides to refer to after. Has terrible hand writing, which can cause problems in notes. Emailed him once to talk about a grade, never responded. Said he saw it, but apparently didn't care enough to respond.

Seriously one of the best teachers. You get a formula sheet on every test, but you need to do problems to practice or you will have some trouble. Very helpful and quick response to e-mails. First finace class I ever took and he made it enjoyable. It is a bit long at times but he breaks it up with group presentations that are an easy A.

I'm incredibly confused how people are giving him a 5.0 easiness. No way he is 5.0 easiness. Shady, Reinson, Dr. White those are the 5.0 easiness. On that scale Casino is at a 1-2 easiness. You will have to drag thru long boring classes with him. Also, his tests are hard. You will have to study a while for his class. Good guy though.
No Comments
Best finance professor anyone can ever have. Cool teacher that teaches alot without stressing you out.

comment: Med surg and it of itself is hard. Dr. Roman rushed through PowerPoints, claimed she cared but really had very little compassion, is tough, and had exams with questions from slides she didn't go over then expected us to know one minute detail off them. I often left class more confused  than when I arrived, despite asking questions and working hard.

tags: ['Get ready to read', 'ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS', 'Clear grading criteria']
comment: Extremely knowledgeable & great lecturer. Challenging teacher but she wants to make her students better nurses. If you don't do well in her class or don't like her you're simply lazy & don't put in enough effort. Medsurg is not easy content but she lays out how to be successful & is always at office hours, VERY helpful outside class.  NEED TO READ!

Extremely knowledgeable person, but has absolutely no sympathy for her students. She provides a lot of help outside of the classroom but her tests are absolutely ridiculous. I might know the material inside and out for the test but she literally pulls her questions out of nowhere.
Very hard exams definitely have to study a lot and do a lot of practice questions. Hard grader on homework. Very knowledgeable lady but has no soul.

She's really smart, she just doesn't have patience for laziness. The tests can be a little scary, but if you know what you're doing you'll be fine. She always explains everything well and is available to help. People just do bad in her class and want to blame her for it because she doesn't just hand you a good grade. Overall she's a good professor.

Her exams are based on NCLEX questions. I would reccomend buying Med-Surg Success and an NCLEX book to study with the content you will be learning in her class. Do yourself a favor and read the book! She will pull material she did not in the book for her exams even if she didn't cover it in the class.

Tests are terrible, read the book and learn how to take the tests. She's helpful if you need it but has been pretty rude to students with her comments. Try not to get noticed by her and study in groups.

Dr. Roman may know what she is talking about, but is by no means an educator that is effective in educating.  She throws a million things at you, and you have no idea what exactly to study.  She is not helpful, not supportive, and yet WSON will not allow you through unless you suffer through her.

Professor Roman is very to the book. She is a very intelligent women and knows a lot about medsurg. She is always available to help and go over tests with any student. Her tests are difficult, I would suggest using practice questions to study along with ppts, and book. She is very specific about what content you need to know to pass the course.
A professor who genuinely cares for her students. She's considered difficult because she has high expectations for her students, not just to be mean. great professor all around!

Great professor who really cares about each of her students. She may come off as being a harder professor, but that's because she has such high expectations of her students and knows they all have the potential to do great things.
WORST PROFESSOR INHAVE EVER HAD!!!!
Worst teacher I have ever had. Rude and not helpful. Reads off the PowerPoint slides, read the textbook as best you can because using just the powerpoints does not help

awesome teacher. if you read and study from the book as well as doing practice questions (NCLEX style) you will do great. she is always available to help and answer questions and offers great ideas and studying tips. Roman really wants her students to succeed but she is a tough cookie and makes you work for it.

she is very nice and understanding.....if you cant understand the content she will be more than happy to help....if you cant do nursing style questions then your out of luck...she cant sprinkle magic pixie dust on you to make you do good, you have to practice nclex questions to do good on her test

Rushed through the power points as the semester went on and is not clear in what her slides mean when she does not lecture on them. Tests do not reflect what the student has learned. they are more a matter of luck for studying the right material. If you struggle, she is of no help in office hours. Hard to believe she is an RN, little compassion.

One of the nicest professors! So sweet and helpful. Come in and dance for most classes with a few classes of watching dance videos. Journals due twice a semester. Two papers (midterm and final). Spend most time in group choreographing a dance. Very easy and fun! Three skips allowed but extra credit if you miss more. Quizzes every couple of weeks.

comment: Very divers man. Has real world experience which he uses to try to inform students of the adult life.

Let me start off saying Heitz is the man!! Such a cool class with REAL LIFE knowledge to learn. Take the class at night it only lasts one hour. ALL tests are take home. Such a great professor. I would take this class over just for fun.

If able to take this class with Heitz, DO IT!! You won't regret it. He is a lawyer outside of teaching this class and also is a guy with great care for his students. 4 quizzes that are open note and a few assignments. His stories are very interesting and he has so many because he's had so many different professions. Cancels class at times as well.

I got a bad grade because I poorly on one quiz... There were only 4 quizzes so doing bad on one will be a death sentence. Other than that complaint, he's a rich lawyer with loads of REAL experiences and that's what I took away from it. His lectures were more on real world examples and that's why I liked it. Good guy but the grading should be better

Professor Heitz is the MAN! Love this guy! Class wasn't too bad, it was actually very interesting. He's very open-minded and if I ever need any legal help with contracts etc, I will definitely go to him in the future!

Great guy, very nice, very easy. I would suggest to take it as a night class, because he cancels often and uses 2 hours and some change at the most. Take home quizzes here and there, no homework or tests. Fun subject matter and even better coming from a real lawyer.

He seemed to change his MO this semester.  He gave us take home quizzes at the beginning but then out of the blue, he gave us an in class test that was 4 questions from former Florida BAR exams!  It was impossible!!! Hes a great guy but i would not take this class
Fairly easy class. Heitz is a lawyer first and a teacher second. He cancelled night class a few times, which made it easier on us. All tests are take home, class gets out early every night.

He's not as great as I'd heard and his class was kinda useless.  I liked him as a guy, but his quizzes are extremely ambiguous and even if you do well it's tough to get an A.  He is probably the best option for an low demand MGMT 203 class though.

Easy class. All tests are take home and in class all you do is listen to him talk about the powerpoints. If you take the night class it only lasts 2 hours instead of 3 and you get a couple breaks during class.
Nice, intelligent professor. Helps as much as he can and makes you want to attend class.

Very Intelligent. If you actually do the work, you should have no problems getting a good grade in his class. People who don't like him just slack off. Yes the final was kind of long but that was the only thing that took awhile.
Heitz is the best.. trust me when I say he knows what he's talking about. Getting out early and take home tests are a nice plus too!

This Guy is the man. I loved his class. Yeah It's a little boring but he's cool and has some great stories as a policeman.Usually lets you out early. You'll get an A and you won't get too stressed either.
Very Interesting class.  Alot of real life information.  Everything is take home.  If you read & participate you will do good.  Lets you out early almost every class.
Easiest Class I have taken yet, Take home EVERYTHING
Best Professor I have had at Fisher so far!!

comment: Hardest lab professor I've ever taken and probably the hardest one I will ever take. She is very vague and sometimes it's questionable if she knows what she's talking about.  Has no office hours. Her grading criteria is so clear but even when your lab is perfect with the criteria you will still get a B. Very hard a frustrating class. You are solo.

Goes by the book. Somehow I got a 45 on my first lab report, despite providing a 4 page lab analysis. She doesn't have any office hours, and she took SEVERAL DAYS to respond back to me regarding my grade which I emailed to her about. Sometimes she wouldn't make instructions clear, and is very difficult to follow. Would not recommend.
Very hard grader, no office hours to meet, unclear on options, expects students to know things without learning them prior.

This is a beginning level course and she treats the class as if they are French majors. Directions are incredibly unclear, including what assignments are graded and what your grades are. Asking questions is frowned upon, and you will usually get a condescending answer. Good luck.

Adjusts erratically, bounces wo clarifying, few reminders, unforgiving towards confusion. Condescending, rude. Criticizes mocks wo helping (doing job). Refuses to adjust material to level-appropriateness. Illusion of friendliness- subtly demeans. Good: dynamic teacher, expressive, creative, expertise evident. Concl: Awful belittling experience!
Simply horrible

She is very unclear with directions, contradicts what she tells the class, changes assignments constantly, gives pointless busy work, doesn't give grades back in a timely manor,  and if your writing style varies from her views the outcome is not going to be in your favor.
Horrible teacher. Do not take anything with her.

Worst professor I had as a freshman.  She was very unclear about what the homework assignment was and was not very understanding.  She was very focused on French cultural topics for a class that was supposed to be based on American's as seen from abroad.  I would never take a class with her again, she made easy concepts difficult.

Tough grader. Being a freshman, I was terrified when she told us her class was as hard as a senior class. I'm still intimidated by her and the semester is almost over. She never is clear on what the homework is or what the essays are about. Speaks more French than English. Does help with writing skills, but will never again take a class with her.

Never tells you what the homework is and if she does it's never clear yet she always expects it to be done and there's always a lot of it.  She never understands any of the questions you ask so she can never give you a clear answer.  She takes forever to grade papers and never gives feedback.  Will never take a class with her again.

Cass is a great guy, he knows his stuff, and the leniency of his grading is awesome, he steps out to smoke during his exams and he gave our midterms a 'check' mark. like that was it, no grade or anything. half the class was ever there and there are very few graded homework's, highly recommend if you need a GPA boost or just to take a cool guy!

It's easier to like the course if a political science major than if taking it just for a core class, but it was good for what it was. The first few months were lecture-based with a midterm and then watched films in the last month with a paper for each one. (4 papers, only need to do 3). Generous grader, but says up front it's tough to earn an A.

tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS', 'Amazing lectures']
comment: Dr. Renfro is one of the real gems of Fisher. His class is entertaining, he ties giant concept together over the course of the semester, and he enjoys seeing students achieve success. He won't reward you if you don't put the effort in, but he'll greatly reward those that do.
Great guy

He's very smart, i took his world politics LC last semester and i thoroughly enjoyed it, i'm currently taking his Middle east politics class right now SOLELY because he is teaching it. Last semester was not easy, i had to work for my A-, and i don't expect this to be any easier, but he's very fair and funny. highly recommend him, he's a great guy!

Excellent professor! Really helped solidify my interest in this field. Though holding very different ideologies (he's a big statist!) he does a great job of keeping his bias away from the grade book, and treats everyone respectfully. All in all a great guy and a great professor. Highly recommend you take a class with him!
Renfro, He is a great professor. He keeps things interesting but he does grade very hard. Deffinitly worth taking a class with him, you will learn alot!

hands down my favorite professor at Fisher. He makes complicated poli sci concepts easier tounderstand. He knows how to engage with the class making time fly and the class interesting. Not an easy grader by any means but you will leave his class a better writer becasue of that.

Always helpful. You can always count on clear directives in papers, which really helps out a lot. An A is hard to get one one of his papers, but if you give a draft to him he reads it over and gives comments which help out a lot.

Renfro is one of my favorite professors I've had at Fisher. He is VERY clear on what he wants as far as papers and classes. Always has a great story to tell. Depending on the level of the class papers can vary from 5 pages for a 100 level and 15 for a 300 level class. An A is hard to get, but not impossible.

Renfro is an awesome professor. He is engaging and unbelievably adept at turning complex political phenomenon into examples and anecdotes that students can understand. He grades tough; you really need to do this work. But hands down, Renfro is one of the greatest professors at Fisher.

Dr. Gibbs is a great professor and really cares that his students succeed. He is very willing to help and encourages that you ask questions if you need to. He grades labs very thoroughly and gives you a chance to redeem yourself. Very great sense of humor.

Dr. Gibbs always goes out of his way to make sure you completely understand everything. He is constantly providing feedback so you can do better. You can tell he cares and puts in a lot of effort. He can sometimes be a tough grader but with his help and if you put in the work, you can easily succeed. He is also super funny and makes class more fun.
Professor Freligh is the best writing professor I have had.  She challenged me every step of the way to strengthen my writing skills.

I felt like I received a lower grade than I should have, but she is a phenomenal teacher and one can really learn and improve from her instruction. Going to class and participating is a necessity to passing. If you want to become a better writer, you've found the right Professor, but don't expect an A.

She started off as a really nice lady. Now she'll go off on a rant for half an hour about how we aren't putting in enough work and we're not focused students (comes completely out of nowhere, we were all participating). She'll yell at us like we are 5 and tell us to get out. Week 11 into the semester and we only have had 1 paper worth 10% graded.

Freligh is a bit odd and she sometimes goes off on the students but she really made me a better writer. I've taken both the Creative Writing and the Creative Nonfiction courses, and I couldn't have been happier with the outcome. She gives excellent feedback. Do the readings, speak up in class, and put your heart into your writing and you're golden.

She has made me a better writer and I felt like I could go to her with questions. She broke it up with lots of different activities. You read interesting short stories and had 2 writing assignments. You have to do the work and come to class though. She will not hesitate to call you out in front of everyone.Pretty good class, overall.

She is a good teacher, but she can be very rude...she'll just start yelling, talk over people, or call students out on not doing homework etc. A lot of reading, but they are all short stories. Some writing assignments. You get homework every night. An okay class. Didn't hate it or love it.

What you need to know: She is a tough grader, takes no bs, and you have to go to class. If you want to become a better writer, take a class with her. She has  made me a much better writer through 2 classes. She only gives out A's for exceptional work. She is entertaining and fun as well. I always enjoyed being in her class. Definitely recommend her

Freligh is really great despite her odd temper and mood swings. She's funny, really good at writing, and she's helpful in her own way. I wouldn't recommend her to just anyone, but if you like writing and you're good at it, it's an easy A. I preferred her Creative Writing class, but Creative Nonfiction was almost as good.

She is a nice woman... outside of class. She treats her students like they're in kindergarten. I was trying to help a student who had missed some days due to epilepsy, she screamed at me in front of the whole class, for trying to help someone out, because I am "wasting time". Her class isn't very organized either, and she can be very unclear.

Sarah Freligh is the best.  She inspires you to want to write your best. She wants you to dig deep and get the most out of every assignment. It's not mindless busywork. If you actually care enough you will get more than you expect out of her class.

Had her for creative writing. She wants students to do their best and is really willing to help. She reacts strongly when you aren't paying attention and tells everyone that she's sick of us not doing anything.
She is the best professor I've EVER had!!! Everytime I think about her class I smile because I am graced by her presence!!! She loves every single student and is never rude or mean. What a nice lady.
Good professor, but can be moody towards students. Feels like highschool atmosphere. (Babied)
She is a very funny, chill lady. Can be a tough grader at times but is always willing to meet to go over struggles you are having with your writing.

Single best English class this Writing minor ever took @ Fisher. Wish I'd known of Freligh before my last semester. Show up on time & treat her & the class with respect, do the work assigned, and I don't know how you could possibly not love having this woman teach you.

Other than Sarah being an Anti-Yankee fan, she was pretty cool.  Her films and reading assignments really pertained to the class.  I just don't understand why she would never take attendance.  I mean, I only went to class like once a week and I still got an A!

She was the best teacher.  She always had amazing feedback and I actually felt like she pushed me to do better and to grow as a writer, something I have never had from a prof.  She was knowledgable, funny and create an amazing REAL learning environment.

She was a great teacher, and gave positive feedback on everything. Very helpful, and very knowledgable in the field of creative writing. She is an interesting teacher, and I loved her history that she shared with us. She's an influential teacher, and I would love to take a class with her again! =)
Love her !

Very fair, very sweet, has a relaxing voice, very positive and always smiling. Her class is boring but she's a very fair and easy grader as a long as you use her correctly. Send her your paper ahead of time so she can tell u want u need to fix and you'll get a good grade. She follows the rubric very seriously so look @ it. Lovely lady :)
Great lectures with real life examples and practical experience

Avoid this professor at all costs!!! This class is THE worst! Be prepared to get 15+ points of an assignment for not completing one small part. He will expect above and beyond what is stated in the directions and expects students to be mind readers and know that. I have a 3.8 GPA and feel stupid because of how harshly he grades assignments.
Would recommend dropping out before having this guy as a professor. Does not even know the material.
He is the WORST professor I've ever taken! Avoid him at all costs!
Awful teacher DO NO TAKE HIM

He's very knowledgeable, but he is NOT a good teacher. He is condescending and truly could care less about passing his students. His expectations are unrealistically high, and you basically have to give up your life to get an A in his class. He also likes to embarrass people and call them out, especially if he doesn't agree with you or your answer.

Is an adjunct from RIT. If the student ever has a problem, he talks down to them, makes them feel stupid. If your opinion doesn't match his he shuts yours down immediately. Lectures are boring and dry, they come straight from the teaching of the book. He is really good at calling out students, even if they're not paying attention for a split second

Dr. Rapp is amazing and funny and I love her! If you tell her the work load is too much, she will always push it back. She is very understanding. I only used the textbook to get quotes for hw assignments. It seems like there is a lot of work for he class but it is VERY easy and kind of fun. I would recommend her for anyone!

Dr. Rapp is very fair, she knows everything! If you do your work in assigned in her class you will not have a problem. It is a lot of work but the course is worth 6 credits. You will not be disappointed!
She is a wonderful teacher and I recommend her to anybody in the education field.  She is really dedicated in this field and truly cares about her students.  Amazing teacher!!!
Great teacher!
No Comments
Good teacher, hard grader.
Whitney is great. go Whitney go Whitney go Whitney
Dr. Rapp is a great teacher, she is funny and smart and knows her stuff. She was helpful outside of class and didn't give any tests. Usually let us out early :)

He challenges his students and wants to see them reach their potential. My advice is to take on the challenge and be active and participate in the class. Go to him for help, you will get a better grade. He was probably the best professor I have ever had, and that is because I stepped up when he challenged me.

The best professor I have ever had. If you ask him for help, he will make sure that you will do well in his class. He will always help and grades on improvement throughout the semester. Show an interest in his class and be ready to work and he will always go the extra mile.

For serious folks only, very diciplened course, and a very practical professor. I loved his style because I hate academia and pure theory professors. they are posinously boring. He is very activeand he challenges you. Learned a great deal.

This guy teaches at RIT. His Corp Finance class is pretty ridiculous. He wants students to learn on there own... from the textbook. He makes a simple class extraordinarily more difficult than it should be. Class consists of students teaching and unclear material. Its his way or drop. Avoid this guy unless you know what you're doing.

Worst teacher out there. He doesnt teach. He makes the students teach each other and cant explain things when the entire class is lost. He thinks he God-sent but in reality hes so lazy he might as well not show up to class.
He was tough but fair.  You had to do the homework and be prepared but in the end the classmates helped you learn what the material was about.
This guy is a genious! He reminded me of my grandfather. All you have to do is show improvment and goto him for help and you'll do great.
Very hard course. You have to do pretty much everything on your own. If you can teach yourself from reading, this class is for you. Hardest professor ever!

Courses are difficult but rewarding, I learned the most in his classes. I had Merouane for 336, 337, and 470 and he was always helpful and interested in students' success. He likes when students contribute to class discussions and demonstrate understanding, as classes are mostly discussion based. Always highly accessible for students needing help.

If you are a slacker, your going to fail. He knows the type of student you are from the first time you talk to him. Great Guy, always willing to help. His office is always opened and i would highly recommend him. I wish every professor at fisher was like him.
Great Prof comparing with others in the same field. He tought me 2 years ago, and I think it's difficult to find same as this Prof. Many thanks for him...
Real tough and needs to get better at listening to his students needs.  We never understand what he wants or expects and how to do the problems.  We need help Merouane!

If you like to teach your self, sign up for this class. We are in november, more than half way through the class, and all he still talks about is how great of a teacher he is, and how he is hard because he wants us to do well over and over.. he is hard because he doesn't ever teach, he has a student teach the material.

If you demonstrate a solid ability to do the coursework and understand the material, Merouane will call on you often to demonstrate your method to the class. Definitely not favoritism of one person, but gives any capable student the chance to prove him/herself and help teach their peers.  Builds confidence in the material & public speaking ability

The class is hard, but he'll definitely help you out, and your grades aren't just performance based, they're curved and he grades on effort.  And he's easy to understand. You'll need to learn the steps for financial analysis and write a good formula sheet, but like any class, if you do the problems right you'll earn the grade. Take responsibility.

capacity. The second was to inspire. I thought that if a teacher could inspire a group of students out of apathy and teach them something in the process, then that teacher would be legendary.  Among all of the teachers that I have had, Dr. Merouane Lakehal-Ayat is someone that can truly educate as well as inspire. I do not need someone to hold my h

It must have been my first day in AP United States history (in high school) when I realized that the teacher would no longer be there to hold my hand while navigating this microcosm of higher education. From that point onward, the teacher from my perspective had two roles. The first was to educate; a role that was solely based upon an informative c

In the first week of this course, I almost dropped it because of the professor. Very difficult to understand. Has one student (same every week) go over homework problems. Never gives all the info. needed for papers/exams. Blames low scores on papers on students' laziness/irresponsibility - he never takes any responsibility. Don't take him!

Adjunct at RIT..they shouldn't invite him back - teaching a quarter class on semester schedule...disorganized teaching style...not clear on expectations but scolds when you don't understand - it's a 100 level class and we're expected to write a paper as an upper-level finance student. Avoid him.

One student from each class acts as the TA and basically teaches class. Lakehal will just go over what he WANTS you to learn from each chapter and leaves the learning & application up to you. Merouane has taught me more about Finance in 15 weeks than I even thought I could or would want to learn. He pushes you to do well, but only so you will succeed.
